name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.methodOfMomentsEstimator_tendstoInMeasure
statement:
theorem methodOfMomentsEstimator_tendstoInMeasure (P : Kernel Θ 𝓧) [IsMarkovKernel P]
    (T : 𝓧 → 𝓨) (S : ℕ → 𝓧 → 𝓨) (θhat : ℕ → 𝓧 → Θ) (θ₀ : Θ)
    (hwp : MomentEquationWellPosedAt P T θ₀)
    (hS : TendstoInMeasure (P θ₀) S atTop (fun _ => momentMap P T θ₀))
    (hθ : ∀ n, IsMethodOfMomentsEstimator P T (S n) (θhat n)) :
    TendstoInMeasure (P θ₀) θhat atTop (fun _ => θ₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ := hwp ε hε
  have hle : ∀ n, (P θ₀) {x | ε ≤ edist (θhat n x) θ₀} ≤
      (P θ₀) {x | δ ≤ edist (S n x) (momentMap P T θ₀)} := by
    intro n
    refine measure_mono fun x hx => ?_
    have hxε : ¬ edist (θhat n x) θ₀ < ε := not_lt.mpr hx
    by_contra hcon
    exact hxε (hδ (θhat n x) (by rw [(hθ n).2 x]; exact not_le.mp hcon))
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds (hS δ hδpos)
    (fun _ => bot_le) hle

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.sufficientStatistic_reconstructs
statement:
theorem sufficientStatistic_reconstructs
    {Θ 𝓧 𝓨 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Θ] [MeasurableSpace 𝓧] [MeasurableSpace 𝓨]
    [StandardBorelSpace 𝓧] [Nonempty 𝓧]
    (P : Kernel Θ 𝓧) [IsMarkovKernel P] (S : 𝓧 → 𝓨)
    (h : IsSufficientStatistic P S) :
    ReconstructsFromStatistic P S h.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hS, Q, hQ, hcond⟩
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_⟩
  rw [Kernel.deterministic_comp_eq_map hS]
  ext θ : 1
  rw [Kernel.comp_apply, Kernel.map_apply P hS]
  calc
    Q ∘ₘ (P θ).map S = condDistrib id S (P θ) ∘ₘ (P θ).map S :=
      Measure.comp_congr (hcond θ).symm
    _ = (P θ).map id := condDistrib_comp_map hS.aemeasurable aemeasurable_id
    _ = P θ := Measure.map_id

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.finite_normalizedFactorization_implies_reconstruction
statement:
theorem finite_normalizedFactorization_implies_reconstruction
    (p : Θ → 𝓧 → ℝ≥0) (S : 𝓧 → 𝓨)
    (hfac : FiniteNormalizedFactorization p S) :
    FiniteReconstruction p S
proof:
:= by
  rcases hfac with ⟨g, h, hp, hh⟩
  refine ⟨fun y x ↦ if S x = y then h x else 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    simpa [Finset.sum_filter] using hh y
  · intro θ x
    have hmass (y : 𝓨) : finiteStatisticMass p S θ y = g θ y := by
      unfold finiteStatisticMass
      calc
        ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z ↦ S z = y), p θ z =
            ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z ↦ S z = y), g θ (S z) * h z := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro z _
              exact hp θ z
        _ = ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z ↦ S z = y), g θ y * h z := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro z hz
              rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hz
              rw [hz.2]
        _ = g θ y * ∑ z ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun z ↦ S z = y), h z := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = g θ y := by rw [hh y, mul_one]
    rw [hp θ x]
    simp [hmass]

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_integral_sq
proof:
:= by
  have h22 : (2 : ℝ).HolderConjugate 2 := ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  have hf' : MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal 2) μ := by simpa using hf
  have hg' : MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal 2) μ := by simpa using hg
  have hholder := integral_mul_norm_le_Lp_mul_Lq (μ := μ) h22 hf' hg'
  have hA : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  have hB : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  have habs : |∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ| ≤
      (∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    calc |∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ| ≤ ∫ x, |f x * g x| ∂μ := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ = ∫ x, ‖f x‖ * ‖g x‖ ∂μ := by simp [abs_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            (∫ x, ‖g x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := hholder
      _ = (∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            (∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          simp only [Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hsq : (∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤
      ((∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp habs).1 (abs_le.mp habs).2
  calc (∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ) ^ 2
      ≤ ((∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := hsq
    _ = (∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂μ) * (∫ x, (g x) ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sq_sqrt hA,
          Real.sq_sqrt hB]

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.cramerRao_lower_bound
statement:
theorem cramerRao_lower_bound {ν : Measure 𝓧} {p : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ} {s : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ}
    (h : IsRegularDominatedFamily ν p s) (T : 𝓧 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hT : MemLp T 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hs : MemLp (s θ) 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hswap : HasDerivAt (densityMean ν p T) (∫ x, T x * s θ x * p θ x ∂ν) θ) :
    (deriv (densityMean ν p T) θ) ^ 2 ≤
      fisherInformation ν p s θ * variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := modelMeasure ν p θ
  have hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := isProbabilityMeasure_modelMeasure h θ
  have hbridge : ∫ x, T x * s θ x ∂μ = ∫ x, T x * s θ x * p θ x ∂ν :=
    integral_modelMeasure h θ fun x => T x * s θ x
  have hswapμ : HasDerivAt (densityMean ν p T) (∫ x, T x * s θ x ∂μ) θ := by
    rw [hbridge]
    exact hswap
  rw [hswapμ.deriv]
  have hscore : ∫ x, s θ x ∂μ = 0 := by
    rw [integral_modelMeasure h θ fun x => s θ x]
    exact score_integral_eq_zero h θ
  have hf : MemLp (fun x => T x - ∫ y, T y ∂μ) 2 μ := hT.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hcs := sq_integral_mul_le_integral_sq_mul_integral_sq hf hs
  have hleft : ∫ x, (T x - ∫ y, T y ∂μ) * s θ x ∂μ = ∫ x, T x * s θ x ∂μ := by
    have hTs : Integrable (fun x => T x * s θ x) μ := hT.integrable_mul hs
    have hms : Integrable (fun x => (∫ y, T y ∂μ) * s θ x) μ :=
      (hs.integrable (by norm_num)).const_mul _
    simp_rw [sub_mul]
    rw [integral_sub hTs hms, integral_const_mul, hscore, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [hleft] at hcs
  have hvar : ∫ x, (T x - ∫ y, T y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ = variance T μ := by
    rw [squaredError_integral_eq_variance_add_bias_sq μ T hT (∫ y, T y ∂μ)]
    ring
  rw [hvar, ← fisherInformation_eq_integral_modelMeasure h θ] at hcs
  exact hcs.trans_eq (mul_comm (variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ)) (fisherInformation ν p s θ))

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.cramerRao_variance_ge
statement:
theorem cramerRao_variance_ge {ν : Measure 𝓧} {p : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ} {s : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ}
    (h : IsRegularDominatedFamily ν p s) (T : 𝓧 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hT : MemLp T 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hs : MemLp (s θ) 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hswap : HasDerivAt (densityMean ν p T) (∫ x, T x * s θ x * p θ x ∂ν) θ)
    (hI : 0 < fisherInformation ν p s θ) :
    (deriv (densityMean ν p T) θ) ^ 2 / fisherInformation ν p s θ ≤
      variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hI]
  calc (deriv (densityMean ν p T) θ) ^ 2
      ≤ fisherInformation ν p s θ * variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ) :=
        cramerRao_lower_bound h T θ hT hs hswap
    _ = variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ) * fisherInformation ν p s θ := mul_comm _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.cramerRao_variance_ge_inv_of_unbiased
statement:
theorem cramerRao_variance_ge_inv_of_unbiased {ν : Measure 𝓧} {p : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ}
    {s : ℝ → 𝓧 → ℝ} (h : IsRegularDominatedFamily ν p s) (T : 𝓧 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hT : MemLp T 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hs : MemLp (s θ) 2 (modelMeasure ν p θ))
    (hswap : HasDerivAt (densityMean ν p T) (∫ x, T x * s θ x * p θ x ∂ν) θ)
    (hunbiased : densityMean ν p T = fun θ' => θ')
    (hI : 0 < fisherInformation ν p s θ) :
    1 / fisherInformation ν p s θ ≤ variance T (modelMeasure ν p θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : deriv (densityMean ν p T) θ = 1 := by
    rw [hunbiased]
    simp
  have hmain := cramerRao_variance_ge h T θ hT hs hswap hI
  rwa [hd, one_pow] at hmain

    IsMaxOn (fun x => φ (f x)) Set.univ a ↔ IsMaxOn f Set.univ a
proof:

  rw [isMaxOn_univ_iff, isMaxOn_univ_iff]

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.isMaxOn_univ_comp_equiv_iff

theorem isMaxOn_univ_comp_equiv_iff {Θ Θ' 𝓧 : Type*} [Preorder 𝓧]
    (e : Θ' ≃ Θ) (p : Θ → 𝓧) (θ' : Θ') :
    IsMaxOn (fun θ' => p (e θ')) Set.univ θ' ↔
      IsMaxOn p Set.univ (e θ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [isMaxOn_univ_iff, isMaxOn_univ_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h θ
    obtain ⟨θ'', rfl⟩ := e.surjective θ
    exact h θ''
  · intro h θ''
    exact h (e θ'')

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.likelihood_lintegral_eq_one
statement:
theorem likelihood_lintegral_eq_one
    (P : Kernel Θ 𝓧) [IsMarkovKernel P] (ν : Measure 𝓧) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (θ : Θ) (hPν : P θ ≪ ν) :
    ∫⁻ x, likelihood P ν θ x ∂ν = 1
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.maximumLikelihoodEstimator_reparametrize
statement:
theorem maximumLikelihoodEstimator_reparametrize
    (P : Kernel Θ 𝓧) (ν : Measure 𝓧) (e : Θ' ≃ᵐ Θ) (θhat : 𝓧 → Θ) :
    IsMaximumLikelihoodEstimator P ν θhat ↔
      Measurable (fun x => e.symm (θhat x)) ∧
        ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, IsMaxOn (fun θ' => likelihood P ν (e θ') x) Set.univ
          (e.symm (θhat x))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨e.symm.measurable.comp h.1, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [h.2] with x hx
    have hiff := isMaxOn_univ_comp_equiv_iff (e : Θ' ≃ Θ)
      (fun θ => likelihood P ν θ x) (e.symm (θhat x))
    exact hiff.mpr (by simpa using hx)
  · rintro ⟨hmeas, hae⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h' : Measurable (fun x => e (e.symm (θhat x))) := e.measurable.comp hmeas
      simpa using h'
    · filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
      have hiff := isMaxOn_univ_comp_equiv_iff (e : Θ' ≃ Θ)
        (fun θ => likelihood P ν θ x) (e.symm (θhat x))
      simpa using hiff.mp hx

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.squaredError_integral_eq_variance_add_bias_sq
statement:
theorem squaredError_integral_eq_variance_add_bias_sq
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ν : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (Y : Ω → ℝ) (hY : MemLp Y 2 ν) (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, (Y ω - a) ^ 2 ∂ν = Var[Y; ν] + (∫ ω, Y ω ∂ν - a) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hYint : Integrable Y ν := hY.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hYsq : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (Y ω) ^ 2) ν :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hY.1).mp hY
  calc
    ∫ ω, (Y ω - a) ^ 2 ∂ν =
        ∫ ω, (Y ω) ^ 2 - (2 * a) * Y ω + a ^ 2 ∂ν := by
      congr 1
      funext ω
      ring
    _ = (∫ ω, (Y ω) ^ 2 - (2 * a) * Y ω ∂ν) + ∫ _ : Ω, a ^ 2 ∂ν := by
      exact integral_add (hYsq.sub (hYint.const_mul _)) (integrable_const _)
    _ = (∫ ω, (Y ω) ^ 2 ∂ν) - (2 * a) * (∫ ω, Y ω ∂ν) + a ^ 2 := by
      rw [integral_sub hYsq (hYint.const_mul _), integral_const_mul, integral_const]
      simp
    _ = Var[Y; ν] + (∫ ω, Y ω ∂ν - a) ^ 2 := by
      rw [variance_eq_sub hY]
      simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
      ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Statistics.estimator_squaredLossRisk_eq_variance_add_bias_sq
statement:
theorem estimator_squaredLossRisk_eq_variance_add_bias_sq
    {Θ 𝓧 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Θ] [MeasurableSpace 𝓧]
    (P : Kernel Θ 𝓧) [IsMarkovKernel P]
    (κ : Kernel 𝓧 ℝ) [IsMarkovKernel κ]
    (τ : Θ → ℝ) (θ : Θ)
    (hκ : MemLp id 2 ((κ ∘ₖ P) θ)) :
    ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal ((y - τ θ) ^ 2) ∂((κ ∘ₖ P) θ) =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (Var[id; (κ ∘ₖ P) θ] + (∫ y, y ∂((κ ∘ₖ P) θ) - τ θ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let ν : Measure ℝ := (κ ∘ₖ P) θ
  have hshift : MemLp (fun y : ℝ ↦ y - τ θ) 2 ν := by
    convert hκ.sub (memLp_const (τ θ)) using 1
    ext y
    rfl
  have hsq : Integrable (fun y : ℝ ↦ (y - τ θ) ^ 2) ν :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hshift.1).mp hshift
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hsq (.of_forall fun y ↦ sq_nonneg _)]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal
    (squaredError_integral_eq_variance_add_bias_sq ν id hκ (τ θ))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.reverseAllFramedCellEdges_eq_framedBlocks
statement:
theorem reverseAllFramedCellEdges_eq_framedBlocks
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length) :
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod,
    reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod]
  simp only [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdgeChain,
    PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedBlockChain,
    List.map_flatten, List.map_ofFn]
  simpa [Function.comp_def, reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod] using
    (reverse_flatten_prod
      (G := binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
      (List.ofFn fun i =>
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i).map Prod.snd))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.reverseAllFramedCellEdges_eq_gridLeftBoundaryWord
statement:
theorem reverseAllFramedCellEdges_eq_gridLeftBoundaryWord
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        (A.subdivision.steps - 1)
        (Nat.sub_lt A.subdivision.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod,
    A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_reverseRows
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV,
    reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod]
  apply congrArg List.prod
  apply congrArg List.reverse
  let rowValue := fun r : Fin A.subdivision.steps =>
    let frames := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val r.isLt
    let compat := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val r.isLt
    (A.subdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV r frames compat).leftEdge
  have hindices := A.segmentGridEdgeIndices_flatten hn
  have hvalues := congrArg (List.map rowValue) hindices
  simp only [List.map_flatten, List.map_ofFn] at hvalues
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdgeChain
  simp only [List.map_ofFn]
  change
    ((List.ofFn fun i : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
      A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i).flatten.map Prod.snd) =
      List.ofFn rowValue
  rw [List.map_flatten]
  simp only [List.map_ofFn]
  trans (List.ofFn (List.map rowValue ∘ fun i : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
      List.ofFn fun s : Fin
        (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i) =>
          A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)).flatten
  · apply congrArg List.flatten
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext i
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
    rw [List.map_ofFn, List.map_ofFn]
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext s
    exact A.rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge_eq_rowLeftEdge
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
  · simpa [Function.comp_def] using hvalues

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rebasedLetterBlockChain_eq_framedBlocks
statement:
private theorem rebasedLetterBlockChain_eq_framedBlocks
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let i₀ : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let hL₀ := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i₀
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i₀ ⟨0, hL₀⟩
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct start
        (A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let startFrame := fun i : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
    A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
      ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
        A.factor_pos i⟩
  let endFrame := fun i : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
    A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
      (finLastOfPos
        (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i)
        (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
          A.factor_pos i))
  let factor := fun i : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1 (letters.reverse.get i).2 :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  change rebasedEdgeChainProduct (startFrame ⟨0, hn⟩)
      (List.ofFn fun i => (endFrame i, factor i)) =
    reverseEdgeChainProduct (List.ofFn fun i =>
      (endFrame i, reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i)))
  rw [rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct_of_pos
    letters.reverse.length hn startFrame endFrame factor]
  · apply congrArg reverseEdgeChainProduct
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext i
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter_explicit
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i).symm
  · intro i j hij
    exact A.leftBoundaryCombinedBlockFrames_adjacent
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i j hij

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseLetterChain
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseLetterChain
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let i₀ : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let hL₀ := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i₀
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i₀ ⟨0, hL₀⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (reverseEdgeChainProduct chain)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← A.rebasedLetterBlockChain_eq_framedBlocks
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn]
  exact rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_rebaseEdge _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPath_map_toPiece_cast_eq
statement:
private theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPath_map_toPiece_cast_eq
    {U V : Set X} {z w : X} {b c d : Bool} (q : Path z w)
    (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (hd : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d) :
    let qUV := binaryOpenCoverDualPathInIntersection q hb hc hne
    let f := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d
    let zUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨z, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
        (by simpa using hb 0) (by simpa using hc 0) hne⟩
    let wUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨w, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
        (by simpa using hb 1) (by simpa using hc 1) hne⟩
    let zd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩
    let wd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩
    let hz : zd = f zUV := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change z = ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d zUV :
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d) : X)
      rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
    let hw : wd = f wUV := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change w = ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d wUV :
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d) : X)
      rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
    (qUV.map f.continuous).cast hz hw = binaryOpenCoverPathInPiece q hd
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  rw [Path.cast_coe]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_map
statement:
private theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_map
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (d : Bool) :
    binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne d =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV d
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
          (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV _)
          (binaryOpenCoverDualPathInIntersection q hb hc hne)
          (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV _)⟧)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_correctedLoop
statement:
private theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_correctedLoop
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (d : Bool) :
    let qUV := binaryOpenCoverDualPathInIntersection q hb hc hne
    let f := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d
    let hbase := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d
    binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne d =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
        ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV _).map f.continuous |>.cast hbase rfl)
        (qUV.map f.continuous)
        ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV _).map f.continuous |>.cast
          hbase rfl)⟧
proof:
:= by
  cases d <;>
    exact fundamentalGroup_map_correctedLoop _ _ _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq_of_ne
statement:
private theorem binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq_of_ne
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (g : FundamentalGroup (↥(U ∩ V))
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV))
    {b c : Bool} (hne : b ≠ c) :
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of b (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV b g) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      Monoid.PushoutI.of c (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV c g)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c
  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)
  · exact binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq hxU hxV g
  · exact (binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq hxU hxV g).symm
  · exact False.elim (hne rfl)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElements_pushout_eq
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElements_pushout_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c) :
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of b
        (binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne b) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      Monoid.PushoutI.of c
        (binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne c)
proof:
:= by
  let g : FundamentalGroup (↥(U ∩ V))
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV) :=
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV _)
      (binaryOpenCoverDualPathInIntersection q hb hc hne)
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV _)⟧
  rw [binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_map,
    binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_map]
  exact binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq_of_ne hxU hxV g hne

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_cast_all_proof_irrel
statement:
private theorem correctedLoop_cast_all_proof_irrel
    {x₀ z w x₀' z' w' : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w)
    (hxLeft hxRight : x₀' = x₀)
    (hzLeft hzSegment : z' = z) (hwSegment hwRight : w' = w) :
    Path.correctedLoop (left.cast hxLeft hzLeft)
        (segment.cast hzSegment hwSegment) (right.cast hxRight hwRight) =
      (Path.correctedLoop left segment right).cast hxLeft hxRight
proof:
:= by
  cases hxLeft
  cases hzLeft
  cases hwSegment
  simp only [Path.cast_rfl_rfl]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_leftElement
statement:
private theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_leftElement
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c d : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (hd : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)) :
    (binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne hd
      localStart localEnd).leftElement =
      binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne d
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement_eq_correctedLoop]
  unfold CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftElement
    binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftStart,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edge, CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftEnd]
  let qUV := binaryOpenCoverDualPathInIntersection q hb hc hne
  let f := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d
  let zUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
    ⟨z, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
      (by simpa using hb 0) (by simpa using hc 0) hne⟩
  let wUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
    ⟨w, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
      (by simpa using hb 1) (by simpa using hc 1) hne⟩
  let zd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩
  let wd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩
  let hbase := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d
  let hz : zd = f zUV := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change z = ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d zUV :
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d) : X)
    rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
  let hw : wd = f wUV := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change w = ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d wUV :
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d) : X)
    rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
  have hedge := binaryOpenCoverDualPath_map_toPiece_cast_eq q hb hc hne hd
  dsimp only at hedge
  rw [← hedge]
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
    (correctedLoop_cast_all_proof_irrel
      ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV zUV).map f.continuous)
      (qUV.map f.continuous)
      ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV wUV).map f.continuous)
      hbase hbase hz hz hw hw)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_relation
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_relation
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c d : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (hd : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)) :
    let C := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd
    C.endChange⁻¹ *
        binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne d *
        C.startChange = C.rightElement
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_leftElement
    hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd]
  exact (binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd).rightElement_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_vertexPotential
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_vertexPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V)) (i j : Fin D.steps) (a b : Fin 2)
    (hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j a b) :
    D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        z i j a b hz =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV z
        (D.label i j) (D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j a b)
        (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j a b) hz
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_proof_irrel
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_proof_irrel
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) (z : ↥(U ∩ V)) (d : Bool)
    (w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localConnector : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d) w)
    (hz₁ hz₂ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d z = w) :
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV z d w localConnector hz₁ =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV z d w localConnector hz₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim hz₁ hz₂]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) (d : Bool)
    (z₁ z₂ : ↥(U ∩ V)) (hz : z₁ = z₂)
    (w₁ w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d) (hw : w₁ = w₂)
    (local₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d) w₁)
    (local₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d) w₂)
    (hlocal : local₁.cast rfl hw.symm = local₂)
    (h₁ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d z₁ = w₁)
    (h₂ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d z₂ = w₂) :
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z₁ d w₁ local₁ h₁ =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z₂ d w₂ local₂ h₂
proof:
:= by
  subst z₂
  subst w₂
  simp only [Path.cast_rfl_rfl] at hlocal
  subst local₂
  exact binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_proof_irrel
    hxU hxV hUV z₁ d w₁ local₁ h₁ h₂

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast_label
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast_label
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (d₁ d₂ : Bool) (hd : d₁ = d₂)
    (z₁ z₂ : ↥(U ∩ V)) (hz : z₁ = z₂)
    (w₁ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₁)
    (w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₂) (hw : (w₁ : X) = (w₂ : X))
    (local₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₁) w₁)
    (local₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₂) w₂)
    (hlocal : ∀ u, (local₁ u : X) = (local₂ u : X))
    (h₁ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d₁ z₁ = w₁)
    (h₂ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d₂ z₂ = w₂) :
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z₁ d₁ w₁ local₁ h₁ =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z₂ d₂ w₂ local₂ h₂
proof:
:= by
  subst d₂
  have hw' : w₁ = w₂ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hw
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    hxU hxV hUV d₁ z₁ z₂ hz w₁ w₂ hw' local₁ local₂
  · apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact hlocal u

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps_connectorChange
statement:
private theorem binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps_connectorChange
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (d : Bool) {z : ↥(U ∩ V)}
    (p q : Path (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV) z) :
    binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV d (connectorChange p q) =
      connectorChange
        ((p.map (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d).continuous).cast
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d) rfl)
        ((q.map (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d).continuous).cast
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  cases d <;>
    exact fundamentalGroup_map_connectorChange
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V _) p q

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_of_intersectionConnector
statement:
private theorem binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_of_intersectionConnector
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (q : Path (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV) z)
    (d₁ d₂ : Bool)
    (w₁ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₁)
    (w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₂)
    (local₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₁) w₁)
    (local₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₂) w₂)
    (hlocal₁ : ∀ u, (local₁ u : X) = q u)
    (hlocal₂ : ∀ u, (local₂ u : X) = q u)
    (h₁ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d₁ z = w₁)
    (h₂ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d₂ z = w₂) :
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z d₁ w₁ local₁ h₁ =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z d₂ w₂ local₂ h₂
proof:
:= by
  let p := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnector hxU hxV hUV z
  let g : FundamentalGroup (↥(U ∩ V))
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV) := connectorChange p q
  have hpotential (d : Bool) (w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
      (pLocal : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d) w)
      (hlocal : ∀ u, (pLocal u : X) = q u)
      (h : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d z = w) :
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
          hxU hxV hUV z d w pLocal h =
        Monoid.PushoutI.of d
          (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV d g) := by
    unfold binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps_connectorChange hxU hxV d p q]
    let mappedP :=
      ((p.map (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d).continuous).cast
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d) rfl)
    let mappedQ :=
      ((q.map (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d).continuous).cast
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d) rfl)
    rw [← connectorChange_cast mappedP mappedQ h.symm]
    apply congrArg (Monoid.PushoutI.of d)
    apply congrArg₂ connectorChange
    · apply Path.ext
      funext u
      apply Subtype.ext
      dsimp only [mappedP]
      rw [Path.cast_coe, Path.cast_coe]
      cases d <;>
        exact coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece
          hxU hxV hUV _ z u
    · apply Path.ext
      funext u
      apply Subtype.ext
      dsimp only [mappedQ]
      rw [Path.cast_coe, Path.cast_coe]
      cases d <;> exact hlocal u
  rw [hpotential d₁ w₁ local₁ hlocal₁ h₁,
    hpotential d₂ w₂ local₂ hlocal₂ h₂]
  by_cases hd : d₁ = d₂
  · subst d₂
    rfl
  · exact binaryVanKampenPushout_of_intersection_eq_of_ne hxU hxV g hd

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_basepoint_eq_of_coe
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_basepoint_eq_of_coe
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) (d₁ d₂ : Bool)
    (w₁ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₁)
    (w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₂)
    (local₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₁) w₁)
    (local₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₂) w₂)
    (hlocal₁ : ∀ u, (local₁ u : X) = x₀)
    (hlocal₂ : ∀ u, (local₂ u : X) = x₀)
    (h₁ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d₁
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV) = w₁)
    (h₂ : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d₂
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV) = w₂) :
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV
        (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)
        d₁ w₁ local₁ h₁ =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV
        (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)
        d₂ w₂ local₂ h₂
proof:
:= by
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_of_intersectionConnector
    hxU hxV hUV (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)
      (Path.refl (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV))
      d₁ d₂ w₁ w₂ local₁ local₂
  · intro u
    exact (hlocal₁ u).trans rfl
  · intro u
    exact (hlocal₂ u).trans rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential_cast_label
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential_cast_label
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (d₁ d₂ : Bool) (hd : d₁ = d₂)
    (w₁ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₁)
    (w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d₂) (hw : (w₁ : X) = (w₂ : X))
    (reference₁ local₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₁) w₁)
    (reference₂ local₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d₂) w₂)
    (href : ∀ u, (reference₁ u : X) = (reference₂ u : X))
    (hlocal : ∀ u, (local₁ u : X) = (local₂ u : X)) :
    binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV d₁ w₁ reference₁ local₁ =
      binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV d₂ w₂ reference₂ local₂
proof:
:= by
  subst d₂
  have hw' : w₁ = w₂ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hw
  have href' : reference₁.cast rfl hw'.symm = reference₂ := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact href u
  have hlocal' : local₁.cast rfl hw'.symm = local₂ := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact hlocal u
  unfold binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential
  apply congrArg (Monoid.PushoutI.of d₁)
  calc
    connectorChange reference₁ local₁ =
        connectorChange (reference₁.cast rfl hw'.symm)
          (local₁.cast rfl hw'.symm) :=
      (connectorChange_cast reference₁ local₁ hw'.symm).symm
    _ = connectorChange reference₂ local₂ := by rw [href', hlocal']

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.pushout_startChange_inv_eq_vertexPotentials
statement:
theorem CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.pushout_startChange_inv_eq_vertexPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) (d : Bool)
    (C : CommonEdgeConnectorComparison (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d))
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d z = C.edgeSource) :
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      transitionFromPotentials
        (binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
          hxU hxV hUV z d C.edgeSource C.leftStart hz)
        (binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
          hxU hxV hUV z d C.edgeSource C.rightStart hz)
proof:
:= by
  let f := Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) d
  let reference :=
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV d z).cast
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV d) hz.symm
  change (f C.startChange)⁻¹ = _
  rw [C.map_startChange_inv_eq_potentials f reference]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_startPotential_eq
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_startPotential_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c d : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (hd : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)) :
    let C := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd
    let zUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨z, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
        (by simpa using hb 0) (by simpa using hc 0) hne⟩
    let zd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩
    let hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d zUV = zd := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV zUV d zd localStart hz
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let C := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd
  rw [C.map_startChange_inv]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_endPotential_eq
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_endPotential_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c d : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (hd : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hd 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)) :
    let C := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd
    let wUV : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨w, mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
        (by simpa using hb 1) (by simpa using hc 1) hne⟩
    let wd : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨w, by simpa using hd 1⟩
    let hw : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V d wUV = wd := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV wUV d wd localEnd hw
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let C := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    q hb hc hne hd localStart localEnd
  rw [C.map_endChange_inv]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_sharedPotential
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_sharedPotential
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {a v₁ v₂ w : X} (hv : v₁ = v₂)
    {b₁ c₁ b₂ c₂ d : Bool}
    (q₁ : Path a v₁)
    (hb₁ : ∀ t, q₁ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b₁)
    (hc₁ : ∀ t, q₁ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c₁) (hne₁ : b₁ ≠ c₁)
    (q₂ : Path v₂ w)
    (hb₂ : ∀ t, q₂ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b₂)
    (hc₂ : ∀ t, q₂ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c₂) (hne₂ : b₂ ≠ c₂)
    (hd₁ : ∀ t, q₁ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (hd₂ : ∀ t, q₂ t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d)
    (localStart₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨a, by simpa using hd₁ 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd₁ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨v₁, by simpa using hd₁ 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localStart₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨v₂, by simpa using hd₂ 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (localEnd₂ : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV d)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hd₂ 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d))
    (hlocal :
      let w₁ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨v₁, by simpa using hd₁ 1⟩
      let w₂ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V d := ⟨v₂, by simpa using hd₂ 0⟩
      let hw : w₁ = w₂ := by apply Subtype.ext; exact hv
      localEnd₁.cast rfl hw.symm = localStart₂) :
    let C₁ := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q₁ hb₁ hc₁ hne₁ hd₁ localStart₁ localEnd₁
    let C₂ := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q₂ hb₂ hc₂ hne₂ hd₂ localStart₂ localEnd₂
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C₁.endChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of d C₂.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_endPotential_eq
      hxU hxV hUV q₁ hb₁ hc₁ hne₁ hd₁ localStart₁ localEnd₁,
    binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_startPotential_eq
      hxU hxV hUV q₂ hb₂ hc₂ hne₂ hd₂ localStart₂ localEnd₂]
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    hxU hxV hUV d
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact hv
  · exact hlocal
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact hv

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.existsUnique_coveringMap_pathLift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_coveringMap_pathLift
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) {x y : X} (gamma : Path x y)
    (e : E) (he : p e = x) :
    ∃! Gamma : C(unitInterval, E),
      Gamma 0 = e ∧ p ∘ Gamma = gamma
proof:
:= by
  let hzero : gamma 0 = p e := gamma.source.trans he.symm
  refine ⟨cov.liftPath gamma e hzero,
    ⟨cov.liftPath_zero gamma e hzero, cov.liftPath_lifts gamma e hzero⟩, ?_⟩
  intro Gamma hGamma
  exact (cov.eq_liftPath_iff' hzero).mpr ⟨hGamma.2, hGamma.1⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.dist_convexComb_left_le
statement:
private theorem dist_convexComb_left_le (a b u : unitInterval) :
    dist (Set.Icc.convexComb a b u) a ≤ dist b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  change
    |((1 - (u : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) - (a : ℝ)| ≤
      |(b : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)|
  rw [show ((1 - (u : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) - (a : ℝ) =
      (u : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) by ring, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg u.2.1]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) u.2.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.switchVertex_mem_intersection
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.switchVertex_mem_intersection
    {x y : X} {p : Path x y} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V) (i j : Fin D.steps)
    (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) (hswitch : D.label i ≠ D.label j) :
    p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ) ∈ U ∩ V
proof:
:= by
  have hi := D.subpath_mem i 1
  have hj := D.subpath_mem j 0
  simp only [Path.subpath] at hi
  simp only [Path.subpath] at hj
  rw [← hshared] at hj
  cases hli : D.label i <;> cases hlj : D.label j <;>
    simp_all [binaryOpenCoverPiece]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.concatSubpaths_homotopic
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.concatSubpaths_homotopic
    {x y : X} {p : Path x y} {U V : Set X}

        (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos)

          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ)))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_binaryOpenCoverSubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_binaryOpenCoverSubdivision
    {x y : X} (p : Path x y) {U V : Set X}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hp : ∀ t, p t ∈ U ∨ p t ∈ V) :
    Nonempty (BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V)
proof:
:= by
  let C : Bool → Set unitInterval
    | false => p ⁻¹' U
    | true => p ⁻¹' V
  have hCopen : ∀ b, IsOpen (C b) := by
    intro b
    cases b
    · exact hU.preimage p.continuous
    · exact hV.preimage p.continuous
  have hCcover : (Set.univ : Set unitInterval) ⊆ ⋃ b, C b := by
    intro t _
    rcases hp t with ht | ht
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨false, ht⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨true, ht⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ :=
    lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric (s := (Set.univ : Set unitInterval))
      isCompact_univ hCopen hCcover
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hmesh⟩ := Real.exists_nat_pos_inv_lt hδ
  have hchoice : ∀ i : Fin N, ∃ b : Bool,
      Metric.ball (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) δ ⊆ C b := by
    intro i
    exact hball _ (Set.mem_univ _)
  let label : Fin N → Bool := fun i => Classical.choose (hchoice i)
  refine ⟨{
    steps := N
    steps_pos := hN
    label := label
    subpath_mem := ?_ }⟩
  intro i u
  have hdist :
      dist (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ) u)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) < δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) := dist_convexComb_left_le _ _ _
      _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
      _ < δ := hmesh
  have hmem := Classical.choose_spec (hchoice i) (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist)
  cases hli : label i <;>
    simpa [label, C, binaryOpenCoverPiece, Path.subpath, hli] using hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_meshBallSubdivision
statement:
theorem Path.exists_meshBallSubdivision {x y : E} (p : Path x y)
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : ∀ t, p t ∈ U) :
    Nonempty (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.MeshBallSubdivision p U)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.range p) := isCompact_range p.continuous
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδU⟩ :=
    hK.exists_cthickening_subset_open hU (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr hpU)
  have hpUC : UniformContinuous p :=
    CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous p.continuous
  obtain ⟨η, hηpos, hcontrol⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp hpUC δ hδpos
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hmesh⟩ := Real.exists_nat_pos_inv_lt hηpos
  refine ⟨{
    steps := N
    steps_pos := hN
    radius := δ
    radius_pos := hδpos
    path_mem := hpU
    ball_subset := ?_
    subpath_mem := ?_
    segment_mem := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i z hz
    apply hδU
    exact Metric.mem_cthickening_of_dist_le z
      (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc)) δ (Set.range p)
      ⟨unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc, rfl⟩ (le_of_lt hz)
  · intro i u
    let a := unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc
    let b := unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ
    have htime : dist (Set.Icc.convexComb a b u) a < η := by
      calc
        _ ≤ dist b a := dist_unitInterval_convexComb_left_le a b u
        _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
        _ < η := hmesh
    exact hcontrol htime
  · intro i u
    let a := unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc
    let b := unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ
    have habTime : dist a b < η := by
      rw [dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
      exact hmesh
    have hab : p b ∈ Metric.ball (p a) δ := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hcontrol habTime
    exact (convex_ball (p a) δ).lineMap_mem
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hδpos) hab u.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_mesh_segments_subset_open
statement:
theorem Path.exists_mesh_segments_subset_open {x y : E} (p : Path x y)
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : ∀ t, p t ∈ U) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ hN : 0 < N, ∀ i : Fin N,
      Set.range (Path.segment
        (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc))
        (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ))) ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_meshBallSubdivision p hU hpU
  refine ⟨D.steps, D.steps_pos, ?_⟩
  intro i z hz
  rcases hz with ⟨u, rfl⟩
  exact D.ball_subset i (D.segment_mem i u)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal_eq_concat
statement:
theorem Path.meshPolygonal_eq_concat {x y : E} (p : Path x y)

      (Path.concat
        (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN)
        (fun i ↦ Path.segment
          (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc))
          (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ)))).cast
        (by simp) (by simp)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal_range_subset_open
statement:
theorem Path.meshPolygonal_range_subset_open {x y : E} (p : Path x y)
    {U : Set E} (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hpU : ∀ t, p t ∈ U)
    (hsegments : ∀ i : Fin N,
      Set.range (Path.segment
        (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc))
        (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ))) ⊆ U) :
    Set.range (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal p N hN) ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.range_subset_iff]
  intro t
  simp only [SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal, Path.cast_coe]
  exact Set.range_subset_iff.mp
    (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concat_range_subset
      (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN)
      (fun i ↦ Path.segment
        (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc))
        (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ)))
      (fun i ↦ hpU (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i)) hsegments) t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_meshPolygonal_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
statement:
theorem Path.exists_meshPolygonal_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
    {x y : E} (p : Path x y) {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : ∀ t, p t ∈ U) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ hN : 0 < N,
      Set.range (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal p N hN) ⊆ U ∧
        ∃ K : p.Homotopy
            (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal p N hN),
          ∀ t s : unitInterval, K (t, s) ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_meshBallSubdivision p hU hpU
  let certified :=
    SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonalHomotopyWithMapsTo p D
  refine ⟨D.steps, D.steps_pos, ?_, certified.1, certified.2⟩
  exact
    SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal_range_subset_open
      p D.steps D.steps_pos D.path_mem
      (fun i z hz ↦ by
        rcases hz with ⟨u, rfl⟩
        exact D.ball_subset i (D.segment_mem i u))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_meshPolygonal_range_subset_open_and_homotopy
statement:
theorem Path.exists_meshPolygonal_range_subset_open_and_homotopy

    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ hN : 0 < N,
      Set.range (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal p N hN) ⊆ U ∧
        Nonempty (p.Homotopy
          (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal p N hN))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hpoly, K, _⟩ :=
    SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_meshPolygonal_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
      p hU hpU
  exact ⟨N, hN, hpoly, ⟨K⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision
    (H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)) {U V : Set X}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hH : ∀ z, H z ∈ U ∨ H z ∈ V) :
    Nonempty (BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
proof:
:= by
  let C : Bool → Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)
    | false => H ⁻¹' U
    | true => H ⁻¹' V
  have hCopen : ∀ b, IsOpen (C b) := by
    intro b
    cases b
    · exact hU.preimage H.continuous
    · exact hV.preimage H.continuous
  have hCcover : (Set.univ : Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)) ⊆ ⋃ b, C b := by
    intro z _
    rcases hH z with hz | hz
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨false, hz⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨true, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ :=
    lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric
      (s := (Set.univ : Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)))
      isCompact_univ hCopen hCcover
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hmesh⟩ := Real.exists_nat_pos_inv_lt hδ
  have hchoice : ∀ i j : Fin N, ∃ b : Bool,
      Metric.ball
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc,
          unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) δ ⊆ C b := by
    intro i j
    exact hball _ (Set.mem_univ _)
  let label : Fin N → Fin N → Bool := fun i j => Classical.choose (hchoice i j)
  refine ⟨{
    steps := N
    steps_pos := hN
    label := label
    cell_mem := ?_ }⟩
  intro i j u v
  have hx : dist
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ) u)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) < δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) := dist_convexComb_left_le _ _ _
      _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
      _ < δ := hmesh
  have hy : dist
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.succ) v)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) < δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) := dist_convexComb_left_le _ _ _
      _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
      _ < δ := hmesh
  have hdist : dist
      (unitSquareCellPoint N hN i j u v)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc,
        unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) < δ := by
    simpa [unitSquareCellPoint, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] using And.intro hx hy
  have hmem := Classical.choose_spec (hchoice i j) (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist)
  cases hlabel : label i j <;>
    simpa [label, C, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hlabel] using hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) (v : unitInterval) :
    H (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ,
      Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.succ) v) ∈ U ∩ V
proof:
:= by
  have hi := D.cell_mem i j 1 v
  have hk := D.cell_mem k j 0 v
  simp only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_one, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] at hi hk
  rw [← hshared] at hk
  cases hli : D.label i j <;> cases hlk : D.label k j <;>
    simp_all [binaryOpenCoverPiece]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) (u : unitInterval) :
    H (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ) u,
      unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.succ) ∈ U ∩ V
proof:
:= by
  have hj := D.cell_mem i j u 1
  have hl := D.cell_mem i l u 0
  simp only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_one, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] at hj hl
  rw [← hshared] at hl
  cases hlj : D.label i j <;> cases hll : D.label i l <;>
    simp_all [binaryOpenCoverPiece]

    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (b : Bool) :
    ((binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b) : X) = x₀

:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_compatible
statement:
theorem potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_compatible
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (sourcePotential targetPotential sourceFrame targetFrame transition : G)
    (htransition : transition =
      transitionFromPotentials sourcePotential targetPotential)
    (hframe : targetFrame = transition * sourceFrame) :
    sourcePotential⁻¹ * sourceFrame = targetPotential⁻¹ * targetFrame
proof:
:= by
  rw [hframe, htransition]
  simp [transitionFromPotentials, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_two_rebases
statement:
theorem potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_two_rebases
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (sourcePotential targetPotential sourceFrame targetFrame edge : G)
    (hpotential : rebaseEdge sourcePotential targetPotential edge = 1)
    (hframe : rebaseEdge sourceFrame targetFrame edge = 1) :
    sourcePotential⁻¹ * sourceFrame = targetPotential⁻¹ * targetFrame
proof:
:= by
  have hp : edge * sourcePotential = targetPotential := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => targetPotential * z) hpotential
    simpa [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc] using h
  have hf : edge * sourceFrame = targetFrame := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => targetFrame * z) hframe
    simpa [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc] using h
  rw [← hp, ← hf]
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps) (a b : Fin 2)
    (hvertex : D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j a b =
      binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) :
    D.gridCellBasepointPotential hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j a b hvertex =
      Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
        (connectorChange
          (Path.refl (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)))
          ((D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j a b).cast
            rfl hvertex.symm))
proof:
:= by
  let hz := D.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
    hxU hxV i j a b hvertex
  let reference :=
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j)
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)).cast
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j)) hz.symm
  change Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
      (connectorChange reference
        (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j a b)) = _
  apply congrArg (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j))
  rw [← connectorChange_cast reference
    (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j a b) hvertex.symm]
  congr 1
  apply Path.ext
  funext u
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Path.cast_coe, Path.cast_coe]
  have href := congrArg (fun path : Path
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j))
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) =>
        ((path u : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) : X))
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece_basepoint
      hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j))
  rw [Path.cast_coe] at href
  exact href

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasepointPotential_bottom_eq
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasepointPotential_bottom_eq
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i : Fin D.steps) (a : Fin 2) :
    let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let hvertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint
      Fhom hxU hxV i a
    D.gridCellBasepointPotential
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row a 0 hvertex =
      D.gridCellBottomBoundaryPotential Fhom hxU hxV hU hV i a
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [D.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.bottomResidualGauge_inside
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.bottomResidualGauge_inside
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let hleft := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
    let hright := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 1
    let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 0 hleft
    let rightPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 0 hright
    let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i
    leftPotential⁻¹ * frame.bottomLeft =
      rightPotential⁻¹ * frame.bottomRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let hleft := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
  let hright := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 1
  let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 0 hleft
  let rightPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 0 hright
  let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i
  let edge : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i row)
      (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i row 0)
  have hpotential : rebaseEdge leftPotential rightPotential edge = 1 := by
    dsimp only [leftPotential, rightPotential, edge]
    rw [D.gridCellBasepointPotential_bottom_eq
        Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i 0,
      D.gridCellBasepointPotential_bottom_eq
        Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i 1]
    exact D.gridCellBottomEdge_rebase_eq_one Fhom hxU hxV hU hV i
  have hframe :=
    (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_horizontal_edges
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i).1
  exact potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_two_rebases
    leftPotential rightPotential frame.bottomLeft frame.bottomRight edge
      hpotential hframe

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellTopEdge_basepointPotential_rebase_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellTopEdge_basepointPotential_rebase_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let row : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let hstart := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
    let hend := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 1
    rebaseEdge
        (D.gridCellBasepointPotential hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 1 hstart)
        (D.gridCellBasepointPotential hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 1 hend)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i row)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i row 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let base := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i row)
  let startConnector := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i row 0 1
  let endConnector := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i row 1 1
  let segment := ((squareGridHorizontalEdge
      (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
      1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i row).continuous)
  let hstart := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
  let hend := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 1
  let hz : base = D.gridCellVertexInPiece i row 0 1 := hstart.symm
  let hw : base = D.gridCellVertexInPiece i row 1 1 := hend.symm
  have hbase : ((base : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i row)) : X) = x₀ := by
    exact coe_binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_for_residualGauge hxU hxV (D.label i row)
  have hsegment : segment.cast hz hw = Path.refl base := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    dsimp only [segment, base]
    rw [D.coe_gridCellTopEdge_eq Fhom i t]
    exact hbase.symm
  rw [D.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 1 hstart,
    D.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 1 hend]
  change rebaseEdge
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i row)
        (connectorChange (Path.refl base) (startConnector.cast rfl hz)))
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i row)
        (connectorChange (Path.refl base) (endConnector.cast rfl hw)))
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i row)
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector segment endConnector⟧)) = 1
  exact map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_cast_eq_refl
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i row))
      (Path.refl base) startConnector segment endConnector hz hw hsegment

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.topResidualGauge_inside
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.topResidualGauge_inside
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let row : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let hleft := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
    let hright := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 1
    let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 1 hleft
    let rightPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 1 hright
    let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt i
    leftPotential⁻¹ * frame.topLeft =
      rightPotential⁻¹ * frame.topRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let hleft := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
  let hright := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 1
  let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 1 hleft
  let rightPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 1 hright
  let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt i
  let edge : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i row)
      (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i row 1)
  have hpotential : rebaseEdge leftPotential rightPotential edge = 1 := by
    exact D.gridCellTopEdge_basepointPotential_rebase_eq_one
      Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i
  have hframe :=
    (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_horizontal_edges
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt i).2
  exact potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_two_rebases
    leftPotential rightPotential frame.topLeft frame.topRight edge
      hpotential hframe

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellRightEdge_basepointPotential_rebase_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellRightEdge_basepointPotential_rebase_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p (Path.refl x₀)) {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) :
    let col : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let hstart := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV j 0
    let hend := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV j 1
    rebaseEdge
        (D.gridCellBasepointPotential hxU hxV hUV hU hV col j 1 0 hstart)
        (D.gridCellBasepointPotential hxU hxV hUV hU hV col j 1 1 hend)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label col j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV col j 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let base := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label col j)
  let startConnector := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV col j 1 0
  let endConnector := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV col j 1 1
  let segment := ((squareGridVerticalEdge
      (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
      1 unitSquareOnePos 1 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece col j).continuous)
  let hstart := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV j 0
  let hend := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV j 1
  let hz : base = D.gridCellVertexInPiece col j 1 0 := hstart.symm
  let hw : base = D.gridCellVertexInPiece col j 1 1 := hend.symm
  have hbase : ((base : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label col j)) : X) = x₀ := by
    exact coe_binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_for_residualGauge hxU hxV (D.label col j)
  have hsegment : segment.cast hz hw = Path.refl base := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    dsimp only [segment, base]
    rw [D.coe_gridCellRightEdge_eq Fhom j t]
    exact hbase.symm
  rw [D.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col j 1 0 hstart,
    D.gridCellBasepointPotential_eq_reflPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col j 1 1 hend]
  change rebaseEdge
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label col j)
        (connectorChange (Path.refl base) (startConnector.cast rfl hz)))
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label col j)
        (connectorChange (Path.refl base) (endConnector.cast rfl hw)))
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label col j)
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector segment endConnector⟧)) = 1
  exact map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_cast_eq_refl
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label col j))
      (Path.refl base) startConnector segment endConnector hz hw hsegment

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightResidualGauge_inside
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightResidualGauge_inside
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p (Path.refl x₀)) {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < D.steps) :
    let col : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨r, hr⟩
    let hbottom := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV row 0
    let htop := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV row 1
    let bottomPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col row 1 0 hbottom
    let topPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col row 1 1 htop
    let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV r hr col
    bottomPotential⁻¹ * frame.bottomRight =
      topPotential⁻¹ * frame.topRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨r, hr⟩
  let hbottom := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV row 0
  let htop := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV row 1
  let bottomPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col row 1 0 hbottom
  let topPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col row 1 1 htop
  let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV r hr col
  let edge : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label col row)
      (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV col row 1)
  have hpotential : rebaseEdge bottomPotential topPotential edge = 1 :=
    D.gridCellRightEdge_basepointPotential_rebase_eq_one
      Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV row
  have hframe := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_right_edge_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV r hr
  exact potentialNormalizedFrame_eq_of_two_rebases
    bottomPotential topPotential frame.bottomRight frame.topRight edge
      hpotential hframe
