statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.bottomResidualGauge_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let leftVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint
      Fhom hxU hxV i 1
    let rightVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint
      Fhom hxU hxV k 0
    let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 0 leftVertex
    let rightPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV k row 0 0 rightVertex
    let leftFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i
    let rightFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos k
    leftPotential⁻¹ * leftFrame.bottomRight =
      rightPotential⁻¹ * rightFrame.bottomLeft
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let leftVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV i 1
  let rightVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV k 0
  let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 0 leftVertex
  let rightPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV k row 0 0 rightVertex
  let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k row hshared
  let leftFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i
  let rightFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos k
  have htransition : T.startChange =
      transitionFromPotentials leftPotential rightPotential := by
    exact D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k row hshared
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)
      (D.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
        hxU hxV i row 1 0 leftVertex)
      (D.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
        hxU hxV k row 0 0 rightVertex)
  have hframes := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i k hshared
  exact hframes.potentialNormalized_bottom
    leftPotential rightPotential htransition

statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.topResidualGauge_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)

    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)

    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :

      Fhom hxU hxV i 1

      Fhom hxU hxV k 0
    let leftPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 1 1 leftVertex

      rightPotential⁻¹ * rightFrame.topLeft

  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let leftVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV i 1
  let rightVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightResidualGauge_succ
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightResidualGauge_succ
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p (Path.refl x₀)) {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < D.steps) :
    let col : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let lowerRow : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩
    let upperRow : Fin D.steps := ⟨r + 1, hr⟩
    let lowerVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint
      Fhom hxU hxV lowerRow 1
    let upperVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint
      Fhom hxU hxV upperRow 0
    let lowerPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lowerRow 1 1 lowerVertex
    let upperPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col upperRow 1 0 upperVertex
    let lowerFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV r (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr) col
    let upperFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV (r + 1) hr col
    lowerPotential⁻¹ * lowerFrame.topRight =
      upperPotential⁻¹ * upperFrame.bottomRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let hp : r < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr
  let col : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let lowerRow : Fin D.steps := ⟨r, hp⟩
  let upperRow : Fin D.steps := ⟨r + 1, hr⟩
  have hshared : lowerRow.succ = upperRow.castSucc := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  let lowerVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV lowerRow 1
  let upperVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV upperRow 0
  let lowerPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lowerRow 1 1 lowerVertex
  let upperPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col upperRow 1 0 upperVertex
  let T := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lowerRow upperRow hshared
  let lowerFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV r hp col
  let upperFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV (r + 1) hr col
  have htransition : T.endChange =
      transitionFromPotentials lowerPotential upperPotential := by
    exact D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lowerRow upperRow hshared
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)
      (D.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
        hxU hxV col lowerRow 1 1 lowerVertex)
      (D.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
        hxU hxV col upperRow 1 0 upperVertex)
  have hframes := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV r hr col
  exact hframes.potentialNormalized_right
    lowerPotential upperPotential htransition

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.fin_zero_eq_last_of_succ
statement:
private theorem fin_zero_eq_last_of_succ
    {G : Type*} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (value : Fin n → G)
    (hstep : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < n),
      value ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩ = value ⟨r + 1, hr⟩) :
    value ⟨0, hn⟩ = value ⟨n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < n),
      value ⟨0, hn⟩ = value ⟨m, hm⟩ := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        intro hm
        rfl
    | succ m ih =>
        intro hm
        exact (ih (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self m) hm)).trans
          (hstep m hm)
  exact hprefix (n - 1) (Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one)

    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}

    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let col : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let firstVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let lastVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV last 1
    let firstPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col first 1 0 firstVertex
    let lastPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col last 1 1 lastVertex
    let firstFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos col
    let lastFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV last.val last.isLt col
    firstPotential⁻¹ * firstFrame.bottomRight =
      lastPotential⁻¹ * lastFrame.topRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let bottomGauge : Fin D.steps → binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV := fun row =>
    let hvertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_right_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV row 0
    let potential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col row 1 0 hvertex
    let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt col
    potential⁻¹ * frame.bottomRight
  have hstep : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < D.steps),
      bottomGauge ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩ =
        bottomGauge ⟨r + 1, hr⟩ := by
    intro r hr
    exact (D.rightResidualGauge_inside Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV r
      (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr)).trans
        (D.rightResidualGauge_succ Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV r hr)
  have hbottom : bottomGauge first = bottomGauge last :=
    fin_zero_eq_last_of_succ D.steps_pos bottomGauge hstep
  exact hbottom.trans
    (D.rightResidualGauge_inside Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV last.val last.isLt)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.bottomResidualGauge_first_eq_last
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.bottomResidualGauge_first_eq_last
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let firstVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let lastVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV last 1
    let firstPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV first row 0 0 firstVertex
    let lastPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV last row 1 0 lastVertex
    let firstFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos first
    let lastFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos last
    firstPotential⁻¹ * firstFrame.bottomLeft =
      lastPotential⁻¹ * lastFrame.bottomRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let leftGauge : Fin D.steps → binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV := fun i =>
    let hvertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
    let potential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 0 hvertex
    let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos i
    potential⁻¹ * frame.bottomLeft
  have hstep : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < D.steps),
      leftGauge ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩ =
        leftGauge ⟨r + 1, hr⟩ := by
    intro r hr
    let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩
    let k : Fin D.steps := ⟨r + 1, hr⟩
    have hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    exact (D.bottomResidualGauge_inside Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i).trans
      (D.bottomResidualGauge_adjacent Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k hshared)
  have hleft : leftGauge first = leftGauge last :=
    fin_zero_eq_last_of_succ D.steps_pos leftGauge hstep
  exact hleft.trans
    (D.bottomResidualGauge_inside Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV last)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.topResidualGauge_first_eq_last
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.topResidualGauge_first_eq_last
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let row : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let firstVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let lastVertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV last 1
    let firstPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV first row 0 1 firstVertex
    let lastPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV last row 1 1 lastVertex
    let firstFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt first
    let lastFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt last
    firstPotential⁻¹ * firstFrame.topLeft =
      lastPotential⁻¹ * lastFrame.topRight
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let row : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let leftGauge : Fin D.steps → binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV := fun i =>
    let hvertex := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV i 0
    let potential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i row 0 1 hvertex
    let frame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt i
    potential⁻¹ * frame.topLeft
  have hstep : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < D.steps),
      leftGauge ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩ =
        leftGauge ⟨r + 1, hr⟩ := by
    intro r hr
    let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨r, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hr⟩
    let k : Fin D.steps := ⟨r + 1, hr⟩
    have hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    exact (D.topResidualGauge_inside Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i).trans
      (D.topResidualGauge_adjacent Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k hshared)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.leftResidualGauge_bottom_eq_top
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.leftResidualGauge_bottom_eq_top
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p (Path.refl x₀)) {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let first : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let hbottom := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let htop := D.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint Fhom hxU hxV first 0
    let bottomPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV first first 0 0 hbottom
    let topPotential := D.gridCellBasepointPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV first last 0 1 htop
    let bottomFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 D.steps_pos first
    let topFrame := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV last.val last.isLt first
    bottomPotential⁻¹ * bottomFrame.bottomLeft =
      topPotential⁻¹ * topFrame.topLeft
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hbottom := D.bottomResidualGauge_first_eq_last
    Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV
  have hright := D.rightResidualGauge_first_eq_last
    Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV
  have htop := D.topResidualGauge_first_eq_last
    Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV
  exact hbottom.trans (hright.trans htop.symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.dist_convexComb_left_le_indexed
statement:
private theorem dist_convexComb_left_le_indexed (a b u : unitInterval) :
    dist (Set.Icc.convexComb a b u) a ≤ dist b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  change
    |((1 - (u : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) - (a : ℝ)| ≤
      |(b : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)|
  rw [show ((1 - (u : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) - (a : ℝ) =
      (u : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) by ring, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg u.2.1]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) u.2.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_dyadic_steps_inv_lt
statement:
private theorem exists_dyadic_steps_inv_lt {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ < δ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hnmesh⟩ := Real.exists_nat_pos_inv_lt hδ
  have nat_le_two_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ 2 ^ m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
        have hpow : 1 ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.one_le_two_pow
        calc
          m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right ih 1
          _ ≤ 2 ^ m + 2 ^ m := Nat.add_le_add_left hpow (2 ^ m)
          _ = 2 ^ (m + 1) := by simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
  have hnle : n ≤ 2 ^ n := nat_le_two_pow n
  refine ⟨n, lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hnmesh⟩
  exact inv_anti₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn) (by exact_mod_cast hnle)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_indexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_atLeastDepth
statement:
private theorem exists_indexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_atLeastDepth {ι : Type*}
    (H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)) (W : ι → Set X)
    (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k)) (hH : ∀ z, ∃ k, H z ∈ W k)
    (minimumDepth : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : IndexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H W,
      ∃ n : ℕ, minimumDepth ≤ n ∧ D.steps = 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let C : ι → Set (unitInterval × unitInterval) := fun k ↦ H ⁻¹' W k
  have hCopen : ∀ k, IsOpen (C k) := fun k ↦ (hW k).preimage H.continuous
  have hCcover : (Set.univ : Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)) ⊆ ⋃ k, C k := by
    intro z _
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hH z
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, hk⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ :=
    lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric
      (s := (Set.univ : Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)))
      isCompact_univ hCopen hCcover
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀mesh⟩ := exists_dyadic_steps_inv_lt hδ
  let n := max minimumDepth n₀
  have hn₀n : n₀ ≤ n := le_max_right _ _
  have hpow : 2 ^ n₀ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hn₀n
  have hmesh : (((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ < δ) := by
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt
      (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hpow)) hn₀mesh
  let N : ℕ := 2 ^ n
  have hN : 0 < N := by simp [N]
  have hchoice : ∀ i j : Fin N, ∃ k,
      Metric.ball
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc,
          unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) δ ⊆ C k := by
    intro i j
    exact hball _ (Set.mem_univ _)
  let label : Fin N → Fin N → ι := fun i j ↦ Classical.choose (hchoice i j)
  refine ⟨{
    steps := N
    steps_pos := hN
    steps_dyadic := ⟨n, rfl⟩
    label := label
    cell_mem := ?_ }, n, le_max_left _ _, rfl⟩
  intro i j u v
  have hx : dist
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ) u)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) < δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) :=
        dist_convexComb_left_le_indexed _ _ _
      _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
      _ < δ := hmesh
  have hy : dist
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.succ) v)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) < δ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) :=
        dist_convexComb_left_le_indexed _ _ _
      _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
      _ < δ := hmesh
  have hdist : dist
      (unitSquareCellPoint N hN i j u v)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc,
        unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) < δ := by
    simpa [unitSquareCellPoint, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] using And.intro hx hy
  exact Classical.choose_spec (hchoice i j) (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_indexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivisionData_atLeastDepth
statement:
theorem exists_indexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivisionData_atLeastDepth {ι : Type*}
    (H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)) (W : ι → Set X)
    (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k)) (hH : ∀ z, ∃ k, H z ∈ W k)
    (minimumDepth : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, minimumDepth ≤ n ∧
      ∃ label : Fin (2 ^ n) → Fin (2 ^ n) → ι,
        ∀ i j u v,
          H (unitSquareCellPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i j u v) ∈ W (label i j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, n, hn, hsteps⟩ :=
    exists_indexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_atLeastDepth H W hW hH minimumDepth
  let castIndex : Fin (2 ^ n) → Fin D.steps := Fin.cast hsteps.symm
  let label : Fin (2 ^ n) → Fin (2 ^ n) → ι :=
    fun i j ↦ D.label (castIndex i) (castIndex j)
  refine ⟨n, hn, label, fun i j u v ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcell := D.cell_mem (castIndex i) (castIndex j) u v
  simpa [label, castIndex, unitSquareCellPoint, unitIntervalMeshPoint, hsteps] using hcell

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.real_isOpen_iff_abs
statement:
theorem real_isOpen_iff_abs (s : Set ℝ) :
    _root_.IsOpen s ↔
      ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ y, |y - x| < ε → y ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := h x hx
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun y hy ↦ hball (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hy)⟩
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := h x hx
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun y hy ↦ hball y (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hy)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.isOpen_unitInterval_iff
statement:
theorem isOpen_unitInterval_iff (s : Set UnitInterval) :
    unitInterval.IsOpen s ↔
      ∀ t ∈ s, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : UnitInterval, |u.1 - t.1| < ε → u ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ t ht
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hv t.1 ht
    exact ⟨ε, hε, fun u hu ↦ hball u.1 hu⟩
  · intro hs
    let v : Set ℝ := {x | ∃ t ∈ s, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      (∀ u : UnitInterval, |u.1 - t.1| < ε → u ∈ s) ∧ |x - t.1| < ε}
    have hv : realLine.IsOpen v := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨t, ht, ε, hε, hinside, hxt⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨ε - |x - t.1|, sub_pos.mpr hxt, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
      refine ⟨t, ht, ε, hε, hinside, ?_⟩
      calc
        |y - t.1| = |(y - x) + (x - t.1)| := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ |y - x| + |x - t.1| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ < (ε - |x - t.1|) + |x - t.1| := add_lt_add_left hy _
        _ = ε := sub_add_cancel ε |x - t.1|
    refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, ε, hε, hinside, htq⟩
      exact hinside t htq
    · intro ht
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hinside⟩ := hs t ht
      exact ⟨t, ht, ε, hε, hinside, by simpa using hε⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.continuous_from_unitInterval_iff
statement:
theorem continuous_from_unitInterval_iff {X : Type*} (τX : TextbookTopology X)
    (f : UnitInterval → X) :
    Continuous unitInterval τX f ↔
      ∀ t v, τX.IsOpen v → f t ∈ v →
        ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : UnitInterval, |u.1 - t.1| < ε → f u ∈ v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf t v hv hft
    exact (isOpen_unitInterval_iff (f ⁻¹' v)).mp (hf v hv) t hft
  · intro hf v hv
    apply (isOpen_unitInterval_iff (f ⁻¹' v)).mpr
    intro t hft
    exact hf t v hv hft

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.mono
statement:
theorem Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.mono
    {x y : E} {gamma : Path x y} {n m : ℕ}
    (hgamma : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma n) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma m
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma generalizing m with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma regular n =>
      exact .of_contDiffOn gamma regular m
  | @trans x y z gamma delta n hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          apply Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.trans
          · exact ihgamma (by omega)
          · exact ihdelta (by omega)
  | @cast x y x' y' gamma n hgamma hx hy ih =>
      exact .cast (ih hnm) hx hy

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.piecewiseC1
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma regular n =>
      exact .of_contDiffOn gamma regular
  | trans hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      exact .trans _ _ ihgamma ihdelta
  | cast hgamma hx hy ih =>
      exact .cast _ ih hx hy

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.PiecewiseC1.exists_dyadicC1AtDepth
statement:
theorem Path.PiecewiseC1.exists_dyadicC1AtDepth
    {x y : E} {gamma : Path x y} (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma n
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma regular =>
      exact ⟨0, .of_contDiffOn gamma regular 0⟩
  | trans gamma delta hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ihgamma
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ihdelta
      let k := max n m
      exact ⟨k + 1, .trans (hn.mono (le_max_left n m))
        (hm.mono (le_max_right n m))⟩
  | cast gamma hgamma hx hy ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨n, .cast hn hx hy⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_leftHalf_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_leftHalf_apply
    {x y z : E} (gamma : Path x y) (delta : Path y z)
    (a b t : unitInterval) :
    (gamma.trans delta).subpath (unitIntervalLeftHalf a)
        (unitIntervalLeftHalf b) t = gamma.subpath a b t
proof:
:= by
  change (gamma.trans delta)
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalLeftHalf a) (unitIntervalLeftHalf b) t) =
    gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb a b t)
  rw [Path.trans_apply, dif_pos]
  · congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalLeftHalf]
    ring
  · change ((1 - (t : ℝ)) * ((a : ℝ) / 2) +
      (t : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) / 2)) ≤ 1 / 2
    nlinarith [a.2.1, a.2.2, b.2.1, b.2.2, t.2.1, t.2.2]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_rightHalf_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_rightHalf_apply
    {x y z : E} (gamma : Path x y) (delta : Path y z)
    (a b t : unitInterval) :
    (gamma.trans delta).subpath (unitIntervalRightHalf a)
        (unitIntervalRightHalf b) t = delta.subpath a b t
proof:
:= by
  change (gamma.trans delta)
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalRightHalf a) (unitIntervalRightHalf b) t) =
    delta (Set.Icc.convexComb a b t)
  rw [Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · have hlower : 1 / 2 ≤
        (1 - (t : ℝ)) * (((a : ℝ) + 1) / 2) +
          (t : ℝ) * (((b : ℝ) + 1) / 2) := by
      nlinarith [a.2.1, b.2.1, t.2.1, t.2.2]
    have heq :
        (1 - (t : ℝ)) * (((a : ℝ) + 1) / 2) +
          (t : ℝ) * (((b : ℝ) + 1) / 2) = 1 / 2 := by
      simpa [unitIntervalRightHalf] using le_antisymm h hlower
    have hab : Set.Icc.convexComb a b t = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (1 - (t : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (t : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) = 0
      simp at heq
      norm_num at heq
      linear_combination 2 * heq
    have hleftArg :
        (⟨2 * (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalRightHalf a)
          (unitIntervalRightHalf b) t : ℝ), by
            constructor
            · exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
                (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalRightHalf a)
                  (unitIntervalRightHalf b) t).2.1
            · linarith⟩ : unitInterval) = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [unitIntervalRightHalf]
      nlinarith
    rw [hleftArg, gamma.target, hab, delta.source]
  · congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalRightHalf]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.PiecewiseC1.trans_subpath_leftHalf
statement:
private theorem Path.PiecewiseC1.trans_subpath_leftHalf
    {x y z : E} (gamma : Path x y) (delta : Path y z)
    (a b : unitInterval) (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 (gamma.subpath a b)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 ((gamma.trans delta).subpath
      (unitIntervalLeftHalf a) (unitIntervalLeftHalf b))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (gamma.trans delta) (unitIntervalLeftHalf a) = gamma a := by
    simpa using Path.trans_subpath_leftHalf_apply gamma delta a b 0
  have hy : (gamma.trans delta) (unitIntervalLeftHalf b) = gamma b := by
    simpa using Path.trans_subpath_leftHalf_apply gamma delta a b 1
  have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1 ((gamma.subpath a b).cast hx hy) :=
    .cast _ hgamma hx hy
  have heq : ((gamma.subpath a b).cast hx hy) =
      (gamma.trans delta).subpath
        (unitIntervalLeftHalf a) (unitIntervalLeftHalf b) := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact (Path.trans_subpath_leftHalf_apply gamma delta a b t).symm
  rwa [heq] at hcast

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.PiecewiseC1.trans_subpath_rightHalf
statement:
private theorem Path.PiecewiseC1.trans_subpath_rightHalf
    {x y z : E} (gamma : Path x y) (delta : Path y z)
    (a b : unitInterval) (hdelta : Path.PiecewiseC1 (delta.subpath a b)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 ((gamma.trans delta).subpath
      (unitIntervalRightHalf a) (unitIntervalRightHalf b))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (gamma.trans delta) (unitIntervalRightHalf a) = delta a := by
    simpa using Path.trans_subpath_rightHalf_apply gamma delta a b 0
  have hy : (gamma.trans delta) (unitIntervalRightHalf b) = delta b := by
    simpa using Path.trans_subpath_rightHalf_apply gamma delta a b 1
  have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1 ((delta.subpath a b).cast hx hy) :=
    .cast _ hdelta hx hy
  have heq : ((delta.subpath a b).cast hx hy) =
      (gamma.trans delta).subpath
        (unitIntervalRightHalf a) (unitIntervalRightHalf b) := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact (Path.trans_subpath_rightHalf_apply gamma delta a b t).symm
  rwa [heq] at hcast

statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.subpathAffine_mem_Icc
statement:
private theorem subpathAffine_mem_Icc (a b : unitInterval) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : subpathAffine a b t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) a.property.1)
      (mul_nonneg ht.1 b.property.1)
  · calc
      subpathAffine a b t ≤ (1 - t) * 1 + t * 1 :=
        add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a.property.2 (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b.property.2 ht.1)
      _ = 1 := by ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.subpath_extend_eq
statement:
private theorem subpath_extend_eq
    {x y : E} (gamma : Path x y) (a b : unitInterval) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (gamma.subpath a b).extend t = gamma.extend (subpathAffine a b t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ (subpathAffine_mem_Icc a b ht)]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.piecewiseC1_subpath_of_contDiffOn'
statement:
private theorem Path.piecewiseC1_subpath_of_contDiffOn'
    {x y : E} (gamma : Path x y)
    (regular : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 gamma.extend (Icc 0 1))
    (a b : unitInterval) : Path.PiecewiseC1 (gamma.subpath a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.piecewiseC1_of_contDiffOn
  have haffine : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (subpathAffine a b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    unfold subpathAffine
    fun_prop
  have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (gamma.extend ∘ subpathAffine a b) (Icc 0 1) :=
    regular.comp haffine (fun _ ht => subpathAffine_mem_Icc a b ht)
  apply hcomp.congr
  intro t ht
  exact subpath_extend_eq gamma a b ht

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1_aux
statement:
private theorem Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1_aux
    {x y : E} {gamma : Path x y} {n : ℕ}
    (hgamma : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma n) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 (gamma.subpath
      (dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc) (dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ))
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma regular n =>
      exact Path.piecewiseC1_subpath_of_contDiffOn' gamma regular _ _
  | @trans x y z gamma delta n hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      by_cases hi : i.val < 2 ^ n
      · let j : Fin (2 ^ n) := ⟨i, hi⟩
        have hstart : i.castSucc = dyadicLeftPointIndex n j.castSucc := by
          apply Fin.ext
          rfl
        have hend : i.succ = dyadicLeftPointIndex n j.succ := by
          apply Fin.ext
          rfl
        rw [hstart, hend, dyadicMeshPoint_leftIndex, dyadicMeshPoint_leftIndex]
        exact Path.PiecewiseC1.trans_subpath_leftHalf gamma delta _ _ (ihgamma j)
      · have hpow : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by
          simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
        let j : Fin (2 ^ n) := ⟨i.val - 2 ^ n, by
          have hiLt : i.val < 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by
            simpa [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two] using i.isLt
          omega⟩
        have hstart : i.castSucc = dyadicRightPointIndex n j.castSucc := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp only [dyadicRightPointIndex, Fin.val_castSucc, j]
          omega
        have hend : i.succ = dyadicRightPointIndex n j.succ := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp only [Fin.val_succ, dyadicRightPointIndex, j]
          omega
        rw [hstart, hend, dyadicMeshPoint_rightIndex, dyadicMeshPoint_rightIndex]
        exact Path.PiecewiseC1.trans_subpath_rightHalf gamma delta _ _ (ihdelta j)
  | @cast x y x' y' gamma n hgamma hx hy ih =>
      have hsub := ih i
      have hsource : (gamma.cast hx hy) (dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc) =
          gamma (dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc) := by simp
      have htarget : (gamma.cast hx hy) (dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ) =
          gamma (dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ) := by simp
      have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1
          ((gamma.subpath (dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)).cast hsource htarget) :=
        .cast _ hsub hsource htarget
      have heq :
          ((gamma.subpath (dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)).cast hsource htarget) =
          (gamma.cast hx hy).subpath (dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ) := by
        apply Path.ext
        funext t
        change gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb _ _ t) =
          (gamma.cast hx hy) (Set.Icc.convexComb _ _ t)
        rw [Path.cast_coe]
      rwa [heq] at hcast

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1
    {x y : E} {gamma : Path x y} {n : ℕ}
    (hgamma : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma n) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 (gamma.subpath
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [dyadicMeshPoint] using hgamma.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1_aux i

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.PiecewiseC1.exists_dyadicGrid_segments_piecewiseC1

theorem Path.PiecewiseC1.exists_dyadicGrid_segments_piecewiseC1

      Path.PiecewiseC1 (gamma.subpath
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathHomotopySquare_horizontal_zero_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem pathHomotopySquare_horizontal_zero_piecewiseC1
    {x y : E} {gamma delta : Path x y} (F : gamma.Homotopy delta)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin N) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1
      (squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i.castSucc 0 = x := by
    simp [squareGridVertex]
  have htarget : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i.succ 0 = x := by
    simp [squareGridVertex]
  have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1 ((Path.refl x).cast hsource htarget) :=
    .cast _ (Path.piecewiseC1_refl x) hsource htarget
  have heq : ((Path.refl x).cast hsource htarget) =
      squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i 0 := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    simp [squareGridHorizontalEdge]
  rwa [heq] at hcast

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathHomotopySquare_horizontal_last_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem pathHomotopySquare_horizontal_last_piecewiseC1
    {x y : E} {gamma delta : Path x y} (F : gamma.Homotopy delta)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin N) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1
      (squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i (Fin.last N))
proof:
:= by

      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i.castSucc (Fin.last N) = y := by
    simp [squareGridVertex]
  have htarget :
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i.succ (Fin.last N) = y := by
    simp [squareGridVertex]
  have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1 ((Path.refl y).cast hsource htarget) :=
    .cast _ (Path.piecewiseC1_refl y) hsource htarget
  have heq : ((Path.refl y).cast hsource htarget) =
      squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) N hN i (Fin.last N) := by

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.pathHomotopySquare_vertical_zero_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.pathHomotopySquare_vertical_zero_piecewiseC1
    {x y : E} {gamma delta : Path x y} (F : gamma.Homotopy delta)
    {n : ℕ} (hgamma : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma n) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1
      (squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i)
proof:
:= by
  let a := dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc
  let b := dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ
  have hsource :
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i.castSucc =
        gamma a := by
    simp [squareGridVertex, a, dyadicMeshPoint]
  have htarget :
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i.succ =
        gamma b := by
    simp [squareGridVertex, b, dyadicMeshPoint]
  have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1 ((gamma.subpath a b).cast hsource htarget) :=
    .cast _ (hgamma.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1 i) hsource htarget
  have heq : ((gamma.subpath a b).cast hsource htarget) =
      squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    simp [Path.subpath, squareGridVerticalEdge, a, b, dyadicMeshPoint]
    rfl
  rwa [heq] at hcast

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.pathHomotopySquare_vertical_last_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem Path.DyadicC1AtDepth.pathHomotopySquare_vertical_last_piecewiseC1
    {x y : E} {gamma delta : Path x y} (F : gamma.Homotopy delta)
    {n : ℕ} (hdelta : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth delta n) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1
      (squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity)
        (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i)
proof:
:= by
  let a := dyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc
  let b := dyadicMeshPoint n i.succ
  have hsource :
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity)
          (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i.castSucc = delta a := by
    simp [squareGridVertex, a, dyadicMeshPoint]
  have htarget :
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity)
          (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i.succ = delta b := by
    simp [squareGridVertex, b, dyadicMeshPoint]
  have hcast : Path.PiecewiseC1 ((delta.subpath a b).cast hsource htarget) :=
    .cast _ (hdelta.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1 i) hsource htarget
  have heq : ((delta.subpath a b).cast hsource htarget) =
      squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity)
        (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    simp [Path.subpath, squareGridVerticalEdge, a, b, dyadicMeshPoint]
    rfl
  rwa [heq] at hcast

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralVertex_mem_intersection_of_not_all_eq
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralVertex_mem_intersection_of_not_all_eq
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hmixed : ¬ (D.label i j = D.label k j ∧
      D.label i j = D.label i l ∧ D.label i j = D.label k l)) :
    squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ j.succ ∈ U ∩ V
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hBottom : D.label i j = D.label k j
  · by_cases hLeft : D.label i j = D.label i l
    · have hRight : D.label k j ≠ D.label k l := by
        intro h
        exact hmixed ⟨hBottom, hLeft, hBottom.trans h⟩
      simpa [squareGridVertex, hHorizontal, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
        using D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection k j l hVertical hRight 0
    · simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]
        using D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i j l hVertical hLeft 1
  · simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]
      using D.horizontalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i k j hHorizontal hBottom 1

    (hw : target = binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V b w) :

  subst w

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeft_endPotential_eq_central
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeft_endPotential_eq_central
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hBottom : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j)
    (hmixed : ¬ (D.label i j = D.label k j ∧
      D.label i j = D.label i l ∧ D.label i j = D.label k l)) :
    let C := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal hBottom
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.endChange :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      D.centralPotentialBottomLeft hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [(D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i k j hHorizontal hBottom).map_endChange_inv]
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftEnd,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightEnd]
  rw [connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
    (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece
      hxU hxV (D.label i j))
    (D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_target_eq i k j hHorizontal hBottom)]
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralPotentialBottomLeft
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
  apply congrArg (Monoid.PushoutI.of (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV)
    (D.label i j))
  apply congrArg₂ connectorChange
  · let z : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ j.succ, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]
          using D.horizontalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
            i k j hHorizontal hBottom 1⟩
    have hzc : z = D.centralIntersectionVertex
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    exact binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece_cast_eq hxU hxV hUV
      (D.label i j) hzc
      (D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_target_eq i k j hHorizontal hBottom).symm
      (D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_bottomLeft
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed).symm
  · rfl

      D.label i j = D.label i l ∧ D.label i j = D.label k l)) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdgeTransitions_end_centralPotential
statement:
private theorem
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdgeTransitions_end_centralPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hBottom : D.label i j = D.label k j)
    (hmixed : ¬ (D.label i j = D.label k j ∧
      D.label i j = D.label i l ∧ D.label i j = D.label k l)) :
    let T := D.horizontalCommonEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal hBottom
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (D.centralPotentialBottomLeft hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
      (D.centralPotentialBottomRight hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
proof:
:= by
  let C := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
    i k j hHorizontal hBottom
  let f := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j) :
    FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j))
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  let z := D.centralIntersectionVertex i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed
  have hzLeft : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel i j 1 1 (D.label i j) rfl :=
    D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_bottomLeft
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed
  have hzRight : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel k j 0 1 (D.label i j) hBottom.symm := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece, D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel]
    have hone : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
      simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
    simp [z, BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralIntersectionVertex,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece, unitSquareGridVertex,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece, squareGridVertex,
      unitSquareCellPoint, hHorizontal, hone]
  have href : C.edgeTarget =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z :=
    (D.horizontalCommonEdge_target_eq_left i k j hHorizontal hBottom).trans hzLeft.symm
  let reference :=
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j) z).cast
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j)) href
  change (f C.endChange)⁻¹ = _
  rw [C.map_endChange_inv_eq_potentials f reference]
  congr 1
  · unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralPotentialBottomLeft
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
    change f (connectorChange reference C.leftEnd) =
      f (connectorChange
        ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV
          (D.label i j) z).cast
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
            hzLeft.symm)
        (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 1))
    apply congrArg f
    rw [show C.leftEnd =
      (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 1).cast rfl
        (D.horizontalCommonEdge_target_eq_left i k j hHorizontal hBottom) by rfl]
    exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
      hzLeft href (D.horizontalCommonEdge_target_eq_left i k j hHorizontal hBottom)
  · let explicitRight := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z k j 0 1 (D.label i j) hBottom.symm hzRight
    have hactual := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel_eq
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z k j 0 1
      (D.label i j) (D.label k j) hBottom.symm rfl hzRight
      (D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_bottomRight
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
    calc
      f (connectorChange reference C.rightEnd) = explicitRight := by
        unfold explicitRight
        unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
        apply congrArg f
        rw [show C.rightEnd =
          (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
            k j 0 1 (D.label i j) hBottom.symm).cast rfl
              (D.horizontalCommonEdge_target_eq_right
                i k j hHorizontal hBottom) by rfl]
        exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
          hzRight href (D.horizontalCommonEdge_target_eq_right i k j hHorizontal hBottom)
      _ = D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          z k j 0 1 (D.label k j) rfl
          (D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_bottomRight
            i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed) := hactual
      _ = D.centralPotentialBottomRight hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed := rfl

      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label k j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  let z := D.centralIntersectionVertex i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed
  have hzBottom : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label k j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel k j 0 1 (D.label k j) rfl :=
    D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_bottomRight
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed
  have hzTop : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label k j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel k l 0 0 (D.label k j) hRight.symm := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece, D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel]
    simp [z, BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralIntersectionVertex,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece, unitSquareGridVertex,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece, squareGridVertex,
      unitSquareCellPoint, hHorizontal, hVertical]
  have href : C.edgeSource =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label k j) z :=
    (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom k j l hVertical hRight).trans hzBottom.symm
  let reference :=
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV (D.label k j) z).cast
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label k j)) href
  change (f C.startChange)⁻¹ = _

  congr 1
  · unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralPotentialBottomRight
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
    change f (connectorChange reference C.leftStart) =
      f (connectorChange
        ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV
          (D.label k j) z).cast
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label k j))

    apply congrArg f
    rw [show C.leftStart =
      (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0 1).cast rfl
        (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom k j l hVertical hRight) by rfl]
    exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label k j))
      hzBottom href (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom k j l hVertical hRight)
  · let explicitTop := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z k l 0 0 (D.label k j) hRight.symm hzTop
    have hactual := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel_eq
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z k l 0 0
      (D.label k j) (D.label k l) hRight.symm rfl hzTop
      (D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_topRight
        i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
    calc
      f (connectorChange reference C.rightStart) = explicitTop := by
        unfold explicitTop
        unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
        apply congrArg f
        rw [show C.rightStart =
          (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
            k l 0 0 (D.label k j) hRight.symm).cast rfl
              (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top k j l hVertical hRight) by rfl]
        exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label k j))
          hzTop href (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top k j l hVertical hRight)
      _ = D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          z k l 0 0 (D.label k l) rfl
          (D.centralIntersectionVertex_toPiece_eq_topRight
            i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed) := hactual
      _ = D.centralPotentialTopRight hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed := rfl

statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.mixedCentralInternalTransitions_square
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hmixed : ¬ (D.label i j = D.label k j ∧
      D.label i j = D.label i l ∧ D.label i j = D.label k l)) :
    let HB := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal
    let VR := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      k j l hVertical
    let VL := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hVertical

      i k l hHorizontal

proof:
:= by
  apply edgeTransitions_gridVertex_square
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV k j l hVertical)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
    (D.centralPotentialBottomLeft hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
    (D.centralPotentialBottomRight hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
    (D.centralPotentialTopLeft hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
    (D.centralPotentialTopRight hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed)
  · exact D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions_end_centralPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed
  · exact D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_start_centralPotentialRight
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hmixed

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.allCommonCentralInternalTransitions_square
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.allCommonCentralInternalTransitions_square
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hBottom : D.label i j = D.label k j)
    (hLeft : D.label i j = D.label i l)
    (hDiagonal : D.label i j = D.label k l) :
    let HB := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal
    let VR := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      k j l hVertical
    let VL := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hVertical
    let HT := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal
    VR.startChange * HB.endChange = HT.startChange * VL.endChange
proof:
:= by
  have hRight : D.label k j = D.label k l := hBottom.symm.trans hDiagonal
  have hTop : D.label i l = D.label k l := hLeft.symm.trans hDiagonal
  have h := D.commonCentralEdgeTransitionsOfLabel_square hxU hxV hU hV
    i k j l hHorizontal hVertical (D.label i j)
    rfl hBottom.symm hLeft.symm hDiagonal.symm
  rw [D.horizontalCommonEdgeTransitionsOfLabel_eq hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal (D.label i j) rfl hBottom.symm,
    D.verticalCommonEdgeTransitionsOfLabel_eq hxU hxV hU hV
      k j l hVertical (D.label i j) hBottom.symm hDiagonal.symm,
    D.verticalCommonEdgeTransitionsOfLabel_eq hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hVertical (D.label i j) rfl hLeft.symm,
    D.horizontalCommonEdgeTransitionsOfLabel_eq hxU hxV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal (D.label i j) hLeft.symm hDiagonal.symm] at h
  simp only [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions,
    dif_pos hBottom, dif_pos hTop,
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
    dif_pos hRight, dif_pos hLeft]
  exact h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralInternalTransitions_square
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralInternalTransitions_square
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))

    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc) :
    let HB := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal
    let VR := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      k j l hVertical
    let VL := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hVertical
    let HT := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal
    VR.startChange * HB.endChange = HT.startChange * VL.endChange
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hAll : D.label i j = D.label k j ∧
      D.label i j = D.label i l ∧ D.label i j = D.label k l
  · exact D.allCommonCentralInternalTransitions_square hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hAll.1 hAll.2.1 hAll.2.2
  · exact D.mixedCentralInternalTransitions_square hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical hAll

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint
    {x₀ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₀} (F : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare F) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (i : Fin D.steps) (a : Fin 2) :
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    D.gridCellVertexInPiece i last a 1 =
      binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i last)
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  have hsucc : last.succ = Fin.last D.steps := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [last]
    have := D.steps_pos
    omega
  have hlocal : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
    simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
  have hmesh : unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos last.succ = 1 := by
    rw [hsucc]
    exact unitIntervalMeshPoint_last D.steps D.steps_pos
  have hbase : ((binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i last) :
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i last)) : X) = x₀ := by
    cases h : D.label i last <;> rfl
  apply Subtype.ext
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece
  dsimp only [unitSquareGridVertex, unitSquareCellPoint, squareGridVertex]
  rw [hbase]
  change pathHomotopySquare F
      (Set.Icc.convexComb
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos a),
        Set.Icc.convexComb
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos last.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos last.succ)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos 1)) = x₀
  rw [hlocal, Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hmesh]
  exact pathHomotopySquare_top F _
