name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBottomEdge_rebase_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBottomEdge_rebase_eq_one
    {x₀ x₁ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₁} (F : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare F) U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i : Fin D.steps) :
    rebaseEdge
        (D.gridCellBottomBoundaryPotential F hxU hxV hU hV i 0)
        (D.gridCellBottomBoundaryPotential F hxU hxV hU hV i 1)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
            i ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ 0)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩
  let base := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)
  let startConnector := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 0
  let endConnector := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 0
  let segment := ((squareGridHorizontalEdge
      (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
      1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous)
  let hz : base = D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 0 0 :=
    (D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint F hxU hxV i 0).symm
  let hw : base = D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 1 0 :=
    (D.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint F hxU hxV i 1).symm
  have hsegment : segment.cast hz hw = Path.refl base := by
    simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBottomEdgeAtBasepoint,
      segment, hz, hw, j, base] using
      D.gridCellBottomEdgeAtBasepoint_eq_refl F hxU hxV i
  change rebaseEdge
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
        (connectorChange (Path.refl base) (startConnector.cast rfl hz)))
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
        (connectorChange (Path.refl base) (endConnector.cast rfl hw)))
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector segment endConnector⟧)) = 1
  exact map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_cast_eq_refl
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j))
      (Path.refl base)
      startConnector segment endConnector hz hw hsegment

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
      (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j i)
      (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨iv, hiv⟩
  rcases k with ⟨kv, hkv⟩
  have hval : iv + 1 = kv := congrArg Fin.val hshared
  change iv + 1 = kv at hval
  subst kv
  constructor <;> rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j i : Fin D.steps) :
    let F := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j i
    rebaseEdge F.bottomLeft F.bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1 ∧
      rebaseEdge F.topLeft F.topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨_ | p, hp⟩
  · let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, hp⟩
    constructor
    · change rebaseEdge 1
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of
            (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0))
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of
            (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1
      simpa using rebaseEdge_mul_start_eq_one
        (1 : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of
          (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0))
    · change rebaseEdge 1
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of
            (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1))
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of
            (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1
      simpa using rebaseEdge_mul_start_eq_one
        (1 : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of
          (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1))
  · have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let previous := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV j p hp'
    let left : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
    let current : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
    let hshared : left.succ = current.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
    let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      left current j hshared
    let bottomLeft := T.startChange * previous.bottomRight
    let topLeft := T.endChange * previous.topRight
    let bottom : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
      Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label current j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV current j 0)
    let top : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
      Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label current j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV current j 1)
    change rebaseEdge bottomLeft (bottom * bottomLeft) bottom = 1 ∧
      rebaseEdge topLeft (top * topLeft) top = 1
    exact ⟨rebaseEdge_mul_start_eq_one bottomLeft bottom,
      rebaseEdge_mul_start_eq_one topLeft top⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
statement:
private theorem
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) :
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : q < D.steps),
    let frames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
    let S := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j frames (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j) q hq
    S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1
proof:
| 0, hq => by
      let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, hq⟩
      let frames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
      let S := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV j) 0 hq
      have hedge := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j i
      change rebaseEdge (frames i).topLeft (frames i).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1 ∧
        rebaseEdge (frames i).bottomLeft (frames i).bottomRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) * 1 = 1
      exact ⟨hedge.2, by simpa using hedge.1⟩
  | q + 1, hq => by
      have hq' : q < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self q) hq
      let frames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
      let compat := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
      let previous := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames compat q hq'
      let current := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames compat (q + 1) hq
      let k : Fin D.steps := ⟨q + 1, hq⟩
      have ih := D.gaugeNormalizedFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j q hq'
      have hedge := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j k
      change current.topWord = 1 ∧
        current.boundary.after * current.bottomPrefix = 1
      change previous.topWord = 1 ∧
        previous.boundary.after * previous.bottomPrefix = 1 at ih
      have htop : current.topWord =
          rebaseEdge (frames k).topLeft (frames k).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 1)) *
            previous.topWord := by rfl
      have hbottom : current.boundary.after * current.bottomPrefix =
          rebaseEdge (frames k).bottomLeft (frames k).bottomRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0)) *
            (previous.boundary.after * previous.bottomPrefix) := by
        rw [current.after_eq]
        rfl
      rw [htop, hbottom, hedge.2, hedge.1, ih.1, ih.2]
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedFramedFullRow_horizontal_words_eq_one
statement:
private theorem
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedFramedFullRow_horizontal_words_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) :
    let frames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j frames (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j)
    S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact D.gaugeNormalizedFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j (D.steps - 1)
      (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeNormalizedFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) :
    let frames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j frames (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j)
    S.leftEdge = S.boundary.focus
proof:
:= by
  let frames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
  let compat := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
  let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    j frames compat
  have hrel := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames compat
  have hwords := D.gaugeNormalizedFramedFullRow_horizontal_words_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
  change S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus *
      (S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix) = 1 at hrel
  change S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1 at hwords
  rw [hwords.1, hwords.2] at hrel
  simp only [inv_one, mul_one] at hrel
  have hmul := congrArg (fun z => S.leftEdge * z) hrel
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hmul.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.liftHorizontalRowFramesWithTop_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.liftHorizontalRowFramesWithTop_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j l : Fin D.steps) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (lowerFrames topFrames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hLower : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
        (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k))
    (hTop : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
        (topFrames i) (topFrames k))
    (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
      (D.liftHorizontalRowFramesWithTop hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j l hVertical lowerFrames topFrames i)
      (D.liftHorizontalRowFramesWithTop hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j l hVertical lowerFrames topFrames k)
proof:
:= by
  apply horizontalCellFramesCompatible_liftAcrossVertical
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV k j l hVertical)
    (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k)
    ((topFrames i).topRight) ((topFrames i).topLeft)
    ((topFrames k).topRight) ((topFrames k).topLeft)
  · exact hLower i k hHorizontal
  · exact D.centralInternalTransitions_square hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical
  · exact (hTop i k hHorizontal).top

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps)
      (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          i k ⟨p, hp⟩ hHorizontal)
        (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i)
        (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp k)
proof:
| 0, hp, i, k, hHorizontal =>
      D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨0, hp⟩ i k hHorizontal
  | p + 1, hp, i, k, hHorizontal => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
      let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
      have hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
      apply D.liftHorizontalRowFramesWithTop_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j l hVertical
        (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp')
        (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l)
      · intro i' k' hHorizontal'
        exact D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          p hp' i' k' hHorizontal'
      · exact D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV l

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_eq
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_eq
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps),
      let actual := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
      let normalized := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV ⟨p, hp⟩ i
      actual.topLeft = normalized.topLeft ∧ actual.topRight = normalized.topRight
proof:
| 0, hp, i => by
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | p + 1, hp, i => by
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_edge_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_edge_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let F := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
    rebaseEdge F.topLeft F.topRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp⟩)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp⟩ 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have htop := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_eq hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
  have hnorm := (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV ⟨p, hp⟩ i).2
  dsimp only at htop ⊢
  rw [htop.1, htop.2]
  exact hnorm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
    let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
    let lower := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp' i
    let upper := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp i
    rebaseEdge lower.topLeft lower.topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) =
      rebaseEdge upper.bottomLeft upper.bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
proof:
:= by
  let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
  let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
  let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
  have hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
  let lowerFrames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
  have h := D.verticalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i j l hVertical (lowerFrames i).topLeft (lowerFrames i).topRight
  simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt,
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.liftHorizontalRowFramesWithTop,
    CellVertexFrames.liftAcrossVertical, lowerFrames, j, l, hp'] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_bottom_edge_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_bottom_edge_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps),
    let F := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
    rebaseEdge F.bottomLeft F.bottomRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp⟩)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp⟩ 0)) = 1
proof:
| 0, hp, i => by
      exact (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV ⟨0, hp⟩ i).1
  | p + 1, hp, i => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      have hshared := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
      have htop := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_edge_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp' i
      dsimp only at hshared htop ⊢
      rw [← hshared]
      exact htop

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : q < D.steps),
    let frames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let S := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      ⟨p, hp⟩ frames (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp) q hq
    S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1
proof:
| 0, hq => by
      let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, hq⟩
      let frames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
      let S := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp⟩ frames (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp) 0 hq
      have htop := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_edge_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
      have hbottom := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_bottom_edge_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
      dsimp only at htop hbottom ⊢
      change rebaseEdge (frames i).topLeft (frames i).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp⟩)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp⟩ 1)) = 1 ∧
        rebaseEdge (frames i).bottomLeft (frames i).bottomRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp⟩)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp⟩ 0)) * 1 = 1
      exact ⟨htop, by simpa using hbottom⟩
  | q + 1, hq => by
      have hq' : q < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self q) hq
      let frames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
      let compat := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
      let previous := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat q hq'
      let current := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat (q + 1) hq
      let k : Fin D.steps := ⟨q + 1, hq⟩
      have ih := D.gaugeGridFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp q hq'
      have htopEdge := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_top_edge_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp k
      have hbottomEdge := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_bottom_edge_eq_one
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp k
      dsimp only at htopEdge hbottomEdge
      change current.topWord = 1 ∧
        current.boundary.after * current.bottomPrefix = 1
      change previous.topWord = 1 ∧
        previous.boundary.after * previous.bottomPrefix = 1 at ih
      have htop : current.topWord =
          rebaseEdge (frames k).topLeft (frames k).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k ⟨p, hp⟩)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k ⟨p, hp⟩ 1)) *
            previous.topWord := by rfl
      have hbottom : current.boundary.after * current.bottomPrefix =
          rebaseEdge (frames k).bottomLeft (frames k).bottomRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k ⟨p, hp⟩)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k ⟨p, hp⟩ 0)) *
            (previous.boundary.after * previous.bottomPrefix) := by
        rw [current.after_eq]
        rfl
      rw [htop, hbottom, htopEdge, hbottomEdge, ih.1, ih.2]
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_horizontal_words_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_horizontal_words_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let frames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      ⟨p, hp⟩ frames (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)
    S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact D.gaugeGridFramedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp (D.steps - 1)
      (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let frames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      ⟨p, hp⟩ frames (D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)
    S.leftEdge = S.boundary.focus
proof:
:= by
  let frames := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  let compat := D.gaugeGridRowFramesAt_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat
  have hrel := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat
  have hwords := D.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_horizontal_words_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  change S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus *
      (S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix) = 1 at hrel
  change S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1 at hwords
  rw [hwords.1, hwords.2] at hrel
  simp only [inv_one, mul_one] at hrel
  have hmul := congrArg (fun z => S.leftEdge * z) hrel
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hmul.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridBoundaryWordsAt_left_eq_right
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridBoundaryWordsAt_left_eq_right
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      D.gaugeGridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp =
        D.gaugeGridRightBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
proof:
| 0, hp =>
      D.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 hp
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      have hrow := D.gaugeGridFramedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
      change (D.gaugeGridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        (p + 1) hp).leftEdge =
        (D.gaugeGridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          (p + 1) hp).boundary.focus at hrow
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridLeftBoundaryWordAt,
        BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridRightBoundaryWordAt,
        hrow,
        D.gaugeGridBoundaryWordsAt_left_eq_right hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp']

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFullBoundary_left_eq_right
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gaugeGridFullBoundary_left_eq_right
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}

        (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)

:=

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)
    (frames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k))
    (hedges : ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      rebaseEdge (frames i).bottomLeft (frames i).bottomRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1 ∧
        rebaseEdge (frames i).topLeft (frames i).topRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1) :
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : q < D.steps),
      let S := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames hcompat q hq
      S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1
proof:
| 0, hq => by
      let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, hq⟩
      let S := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames hcompat 0 hq
      change rebaseEdge (frames i).topLeft (frames i).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1 ∧
        rebaseEdge (frames i).bottomLeft (frames i).bottomRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) * 1 = 1
      exact ⟨(hedges i).2, by simpa using (hedges i).1⟩
  | q + 1, hq => by
      have hq' : q < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self q) hq
      let previous := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames hcompat q hq'
      let current := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames hcompat (q + 1) hq
      let k : Fin D.steps := ⟨q + 1, hq⟩
      have ih := D.framedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames hcompat hedges q hq'
      have hedge := hedges k
      change current.topWord = 1 ∧
        current.boundary.after * current.bottomPrefix = 1
      change previous.topWord = 1 ∧
        previous.boundary.after * previous.bottomPrefix = 1 at ih
      have htop : current.topWord =
          rebaseEdge (frames k).topLeft (frames k).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 1)) *
            previous.topWord := by rfl
      have hbottom : current.boundary.after * current.bottomPrefix =
          rebaseEdge (frames k).bottomLeft (frames k).bottomRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0)) *
            (previous.boundary.after * previous.bottomPrefix) := by
        rw [current.after_eq]
        rfl
      rw [htop, hbottom, hedge.2, hedge.1, ih.1, ih.2]
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)
    (frames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k))
    (hedges : ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      rebaseEdge (frames i).bottomLeft (frames i).bottomRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1 ∧
        rebaseEdge (frames i).topLeft (frames i).topRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1) :
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat
    S.leftEdge = S.boundary.focus
proof:
:= by
  let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat
  have hrel := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation

  have hwords := D.framedRowPrefix_horizontal_words_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat hedges
    (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)
  change S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus *
      (S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix) = 1 at hrel
  change S.topWord = 1 ∧ S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix = 1 at hwords
  rw [hwords.1, hwords.2] at hrel
  simp only [inv_one, mul_one] at hrel
  have hmul := congrArg (fun z => S.leftEdge * z) hrel
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hmul.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge_eq_rowLeftEdge
statement:
theorem rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge_eq_rowLeftEdge
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)

    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))

      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))

statement:
theorem leftBoundaryCombinedBlockFrames_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
        (finLastOfPos Li hi) =
      A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom j
        ⟨0, hj⟩
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
    PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
  dsimp only
  rw [A.leftBoundaryBlockTransitions_cocycle
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i j hshared,
    A.rightAnchoredBlockFrames_adjacent
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i j hshared,
    mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredFramedLeftEdge_eq_rebaseBlockFactor
statement:
private theorem rightAnchoredFramedLeftEdge_eq_rebaseBlockFactor
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i)) :
    let row := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let F := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt col
    let T := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      letters Fhom i s
    let b := A.subdivision.label col row
    let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
    rebaseEdge F.bottomLeft F.topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of b
          (A.subdivision.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
            col row 0)) =
      rebaseEdge (T.startChange * F.bottomLeft) (T.endChange * F.topLeft)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of c
          (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters
              A.factor A.factor_pos i s.castSucc)
            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters
              A.factor A.factor_pos i s)
            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters
              A.factor A.factor_pos i s.succ)⟧))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.leftBoundaryCellEdgeToBlockFactor_relation
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s]
  exact rebaseEdge_rebaseEdge _ _ _ _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredFramedLeftEdge_eq_rebaseNamedBlockFactor
statement:
private theorem rightAnchoredFramedLeftEdge_eq_rebaseNamedBlockFactor
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i)) :
    let row := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let F := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt col
    rebaseEdge F.bottomLeft F.topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (A.subdivision.label col row)
          (A.subdivision.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
            col row 0) : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge
        (A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryBlockFactor hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
proof:
:= by
  exact A.rightAnchoredFramedLeftEdge_eq_rebaseBlockFactor
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rebasedLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_framedCellEdges
statement:
private theorem rebasedLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_framedCellEdges
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
          ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
            A.factor_pos i⟩)
        (A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i)
proof:
:= by
  change
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
          ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
            A.factor_pos i⟩)
        (List.ofFn fun s =>
          (A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s,
            A.leftBoundaryBlockFactor hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (List.ofFn fun s =>
          (A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s,
            A.rightAnchoredFramedLeftBoundaryCellEdge
              hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s))
  rw [rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct_of_pos
    (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i)
    (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos i)
    (fun s => A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (fun s => A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (fun s => A.leftBoundaryBlockFactor hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (fun s t hshared => A.leftBoundaryCombinedFrames_adjacent
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared)]
  apply congrArg reverseEdgeChainProduct
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext s
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · exact (A.rightAnchoredFramedLeftEdge_eq_rebaseNamedBlockFactor
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.reverseLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_of_gridWord
statement:
private theorem reverseLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_of_gridWord
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1
        (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord hxU hxV hU hV letters
          A.factor A.factor_pos i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod]
  simp only [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain,
    List.map_ofFn]
  change
    (List.ofFn fun s =>
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters
            A.factor A.factor_pos i s.castSucc)
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters
            A.factor A.factor_pos i s)
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters
            A.factor A.factor_pos i s.succ)⟧) :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)).reverse.prod = _
  rw [← reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod]
  rw [← Path.map_reverseDfoldl]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.reverseLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_of_letter
statement:
private theorem reverseLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_of_letter

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_end
statement:
private theorem leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_end
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i ⟨0, hL⟩
    edgeChainEnd start
        (A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
        (finLastOfPos L hL)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain
  exact edgeChainEnd_ofFn_of_pos _ _ _ _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseBlockWord
statement:
private theorem leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseBlockWord
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
        ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
          A.factor_pos i⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (reverseEdgeChainProduct chain)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← A.rebasedLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_framedCellEdges
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i]
  exact rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_rebaseEdge _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
        ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
          A.factor_pos i⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1 (letters.reverse.get i).2)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseBlockWord
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i]
  rw [A.reverseLeftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_eq_of_letter
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter_explicit
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter_explicit
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i ⟨0, hL⟩
    let finish := A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i (finLastOfPos L hL)
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i) =
      rebaseEdge start finish
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1 (letters.reverse.get i).2)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.leftBoundaryFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseLetter
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i]
  rw [A.leftBoundaryBlockEdgeChain_end
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Compact.compact_singleton
statement: theorem compact_singleton {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : IsCompact ({x} : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [isCompact_iff_finite_subcover]
  intro ι U hUo hsub
  have hx : x ∈ ⋃ i : ι, U i := hsub (by simp)
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩
  refine ⟨{i}, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hyx : y = x := by simpa using hy
  rw [hyx]
  exact Set.mem_biUnion (by simp) hxi

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.fundamentalGroup_mapOfEq_comp_apply
statement:
private theorem fundamentalGroup_mapOfEq_comp_apply
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B] [TopologicalSpace Z]
    (f : C(A, B)) (g : C(B, Z)) {a : A} {b : B} {z : Z}
    (hf : f a = b) (hg : g b = z) (p : FundamentalGroup A a) :
    FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq g hg (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq f hf p) =
      FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq (g.comp f) ((congrArg g hf).trans hg) p
proof:
:= by
  cases hf
  cases hg
  simp only [FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_apply]
  rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map_cast]
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast_rfl_rfl]
  exact (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map_comp (p := p) (f := f) (g := g)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.fundamentalGroup_mapOfEq_congr
statement:
private theorem fundamentalGroup_mapOfEq_congr
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    {f g : C(A, B)} (hfg : f = g) {a : A} {b : B}
    (hf : f a = b) (hg : g a = b) (p : FundamentalGroup A a) :
    FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq f hf p = FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq g hg p
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  have hproof : hf = hg := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hg
  rfl

statement:
private theorem recoveredSubgroup_le_of_equiv {C D : PointedCovering X x0} (e : Equiv C D) :

proof:
:= by
  rintro g ⟨a, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq e.totalContinuousMap e.totalContinuousMap_point a, ?_⟩
  rw [fundamentalGroup_mapOfEq_comp_apply]
  apply fundamentalGroup_mapOfEq_congr e.projectionContinuousMap_comp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.topologicalSpace_open_axioms
statement:
theorem topologicalSpace_open_axioms [TopologicalSpace X] :
    IsOpen (Set.univ : Set X) ∧
      (∀ s t : Set X, IsOpen s → IsOpen t → IsOpen (s ∩ t)) ∧
      ∀ S : Set (Set X), (∀ s ∈ S, IsOpen s) → IsOpen (⋃₀ S)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨isOpen_univ, fun _ _ hs ht ↦ hs.inter ht,
    fun _ hS ↦ isOpen_sUnion hS⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.continuous_iff_preimage_open
statement:
theorem continuous_iff_preimage_open [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) :
    _root_.Continuous f ↔ ∀ u : Set Y, _root_.IsOpen u → _root_.IsOpen (f ⁻¹' u)
proof:
:= by
  exact _root_.continuous_def

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.continuous_iff_preimage_closed
statement:
theorem continuous_iff_preimage_closed [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) :
    _root_.Continuous f ↔
      ∀ s : Set Y, _root_.IsClosed s → _root_.IsClosed (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf s hs
    exact hs.preimage hf
  · intro h
    rw [continuous_iff_preimage_open]
    intro u hu
    have hclosed : _root_.IsClosed (uᶜ) := hu.isClosed_compl
    have hpre := h (uᶜ) hclosed
    have hopen := hpre.isOpen_compl
    simpa only [preimage_compl, compl_compl] using hopen

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.mem_nhds_iff_exists_open
statement:
theorem mem_nhds_iff_exists_open [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) (s : Set X) :
    s ∈ 𝓝 x ↔ ∃ u : Set X, _root_.IsOpen u ∧ x ∈ u ∧ u ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.mem_nhds_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hus, hu, hxu⟩
    aesop
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hxu, hus⟩
    exact ⟨u, hus, hu, hxu⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_homeomorph_iff_exists_equiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_homeomorph_iff_exists_equiv [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] :
    Nonempty (X ≃ₜ Y) ↔
      ∃ e : X ≃ Y, _root_.Continuous (e : X → Y) ∧
        _root_.Continuous (e.symm : Y → X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact ⟨e.toEquiv, e.continuous, e.symm.continuous⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he, he'⟩
    exact ⟨{ toEquiv := e, continuous_toFun := he, continuous_invFun := he' }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.continuous_iff_isClosed_preimage
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf s hs
    exact hf.isClosed_preimage hs
  · intro hf s hs
    have hclosed : τY.IsClosed sᶜ := by
      change τY.IsOpen (sᶜ)ᶜ
      simpa using hs
    have hpre := hf sᶜ hclosed
    change τX.IsOpen ((f ⁻¹' sᶜ)ᶜ) at hpre
    simpa only [preimage_compl, compl_compl] using hpre

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.continuous_const
statement:
theorem continuous_const (τX : TextbookTopology X) (τY : TextbookTopology Y) (y : Y) :
    Continuous τX τY (fun _ : X ↦ y)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  by_cases hy : y ∈ v
  · have hpre : (fun _ : X ↦ y) ⁻¹' v = univ := by ext; simp [hy]
    rw [hpre]
    exact τX.isOpen_univ
  · have hpre : (fun _ : X ↦ y) ⁻¹' v = ∅ := by ext; simp [hy]
    rw [hpre]
    exact τX.isOpen_empty
