:= by
  intro w hw
  change τX.IsOpen (f ⁻¹' (g ⁻¹' w))
  exact hf _ (hg _ hw)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.verticalFrames_start_of_right
statement:
private theorem verticalFrames_start_of_right
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (vertical : EdgeTransitions G)
    (lowerStart lowerEnd upperStart upperEnd lowerEdge upperEdge : G)
    (hedge : lowerEdge = rebaseEdge vertical.startChange vertical.endChange upperEdge)
    (hlower : rebaseEdge lowerStart lowerEnd lowerEdge = 1)
    (hupper : rebaseEdge upperStart upperEnd upperEdge = 1)
    (hright : upperEnd = vertical.endChange * lowerEnd) :
    upperStart = vertical.startChange * lowerStart
proof:
:= by
  have htransport := rebaseEdge_relation_in_frame lowerStart lowerEnd
    vertical.startChange vertical.endChange lowerEdge upperEdge hedge
  have hexpected : rebaseEdge
      (vertical.startChange * lowerStart)
      (vertical.endChange * lowerEnd) upperEdge = 1 := by
    rw [← htransport]
    exact hlower
  rw [← hright] at hexpected
  exact rebaseEdge_startFrame_unique upperStart
    (vertical.startChange * lowerStart) upperEnd upperEdge hupper hexpected

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.verticalFrames_descend_across_horizontal
statement:
private theorem verticalFrames_descend_across_horizontal
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (horizontalLower horizontalUpper verticalLeft verticalRight : EdgeTransitions G)
    (leftLower rightLower leftUpper rightUpper : CellVertexFrames G)
    (hLower : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible horizontalLower leftLower rightLower)
    (hUpper : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible horizontalUpper leftUpper rightUpper)
    (hSquare : verticalRight.startChange * horizontalLower.endChange =
      horizontalUpper.startChange * verticalLeft.endChange)
    (hRightStart : rightUpper.bottomLeft =
      verticalRight.startChange * rightLower.topLeft) :
    leftUpper.bottomRight = verticalLeft.endChange * leftLower.topRight
proof:
:= by
  have h : horizontalUpper.startChange * leftUpper.bottomRight =
      horizontalUpper.startChange * (verticalLeft.endChange * leftLower.topRight) := by
    calc
      horizontalUpper.startChange * leftUpper.bottomRight =
          rightUpper.bottomLeft := hUpper.bottom.symm
      _ = verticalRight.startChange * rightLower.topLeft := hRightStart
      _ = verticalRight.startChange *
          (horizontalLower.endChange * leftLower.topRight) := by rw [hLower.top]
      _ = (verticalRight.startChange * horizontalLower.endChange) *
          leftLower.topRight := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (horizontalUpper.startChange * verticalLeft.endChange) *
          leftLower.topRight := by rw [hSquare]
      _ = horizontalUpper.startChange *
          (verticalLeft.endChange * leftLower.topRight) := by rw [mul_assoc]
  exact mul_left_cancel h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.verticalCellFramesCompatible_of_right
statement:
private theorem verticalCellFramesCompatible_of_right
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (vertical : EdgeTransitions G) (lower upper : CellVertexFrames G)
    (lowerEdge upperEdge : G)
    (hedge : lowerEdge = rebaseEdge vertical.startChange vertical.endChange upperEdge)
    (hlower : rebaseEdge lower.topLeft lower.topRight lowerEdge = 1)
    (hupper : rebaseEdge upper.bottomLeft upper.bottomRight upperEdge = 1)
    (hright : upper.bottomRight = vertical.endChange * lower.topRight) :
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible vertical lower upper
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨verticalFrames_start_of_right vertical
    lower.topLeft lower.topRight upper.bottomLeft upper.bottomRight
    lowerEdge upperEdge hedge hlower hupper hright, hright⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.verticalCellFramesCompatible_descend
statement:
private theorem verticalCellFramesCompatible_descend
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (horizontalLower horizontalUpper verticalLeft verticalRight : EdgeTransitions G)
    (leftLower rightLower leftUpper rightUpper : CellVertexFrames G)
    (leftLowerEdge leftUpperEdge : G)
    (hHorizontalLower : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      horizontalLower leftLower rightLower)
    (hHorizontalUpper : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      horizontalUpper leftUpper rightUpper)
    (hSquare : verticalRight.startChange * horizontalLower.endChange =
      horizontalUpper.startChange * verticalLeft.endChange)
    (hRight : VerticalCellFramesCompatible verticalRight rightLower rightUpper)
    (hLeftEdge : leftLowerEdge =
      rebaseEdge verticalLeft.startChange verticalLeft.endChange leftUpperEdge)
    (hLeftLower : rebaseEdge leftLower.topLeft leftLower.topRight leftLowerEdge = 1)
    (hLeftUpper : rebaseEdge leftUpper.bottomLeft leftUpper.bottomRight leftUpperEdge = 1) :
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible verticalLeft leftLower leftUpper
proof:
:= by
  have hrightEndpoint : leftUpper.bottomRight =
      verticalLeft.endChange * leftLower.topRight :=
    verticalFrames_descend_across_horizontal
      horizontalLower horizontalUpper verticalLeft verticalRight
      leftLower rightLower leftUpper rightUpper
      hHorizontalLower hHorizontalUpper hSquare hRight.left
  exact verticalCellFramesCompatible_of_right verticalLeft leftLower leftUpper
    leftLowerEdge leftUpperEdge hLeftEdge hLeftLower hLeftUpper hrightEndpoint

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCellFramesCompatible_descend
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCellFramesCompatible_descend
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (lowerFrames upperFrames : Fin D.steps →
      CellVertexFrames (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hLower : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
      (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k))
    (hUpper : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
      (upperFrames i) (upperFrames k))
    (hRight : VerticalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV k j l hVertical)
      (lowerFrames k) (upperFrames k))
    (hLowerEdge : rebaseEdge (lowerFrames i).topLeft (lowerFrames i).topRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1)
    (hUpperEdge : rebaseEdge (upperFrames i).bottomLeft (upperFrames i).bottomRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0)) = 1) :
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
      (lowerFrames i) (upperFrames i)
proof:
:= by
  apply SandronesLibrary.Topology.verticalCellFramesCompatible_descend
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV k j l hVertical)
    (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k) (upperFrames i) (upperFrames k)
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
      (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1))
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
      (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
  · exact hLower
  · exact hUpper
  · exact D.centralInternalTransitions_square hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical
  · exact hRight
  · exact D.verticalInternalEdge_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical
  · exact hLowerEdge
  · exact hUpperEdge

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCellFramesCompatible_all_of_last
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCellFramesCompatible_all_of_last
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j l : Fin D.steps) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (lowerFrames upperFrames : Fin D.steps →
      CellVertexFrames (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hLower : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
        (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k))
    (hUpper : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
        (upperFrames i) (upperFrames k))
    (hLowerEdge : ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      rebaseEdge (lowerFrames i).topLeft (lowerFrames i).topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1)
    (hUpperEdge : ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      rebaseEdge (upperFrames i).bottomLeft (upperFrames i).bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0)) = 1)
    (hLast : let last : Fin D.steps :=
        ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
      VerticalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV last j l hVertical)
        (lowerFrames last) (upperFrames last)) :
    ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      VerticalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
        (lowerFrames i) (upperFrames i)
proof:
:= by
  let n := D.steps - 1
  have hsteps : n + 1 = D.steps := Nat.sub_add_cancel D.steps_pos
  let castIndex : Fin (n + 1) → Fin D.steps := Fin.cast hsteps
  let P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop := fun i =>
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        (castIndex i) j l hVertical)
      (lowerFrames (castIndex i)) (upperFrames (castIndex i))
  have hall : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), P i := by
    apply Fin.reverseInduction
    · have hlastIndex : castIndex (Fin.last n) =
          (⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Fin D.steps) := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp [castIndex, n]
      simpa [P, hlastIndex] using hLast
    · intro i hi
      let left : Fin D.steps := castIndex i.castSucc
      let right : Fin D.steps := castIndex i.succ
      have hHorizontal : left.succ = right.castSucc := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [left, right, castIndex]
      exact D.verticalCellFramesCompatible_descend hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        left right j l hHorizontal hVertical lowerFrames upperFrames
        (hLower left right hHorizontal) (hUpper left right hHorizontal) hi
        (hLowerEdge left) (hUpperEdge left)
  intro i
  have hi := hall (Fin.cast hsteps.symm i)
  simpa [P, castIndex] using hi

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRows_last_vertical_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRows_last_vertical_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j l : Fin D.steps) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (lowerBottomRight upperBottomRight : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
    (hAnchor : let last : Fin D.steps :=
        ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
      let vertical := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        last j l hVertical
      upperBottomRight = vertical.endChange *
        (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          j lowerBottomRight last).topRight) :
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV last j l hVertical)
      (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j lowerBottomRight last)
      (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l upperBottomRight last)
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let lower := D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    j lowerBottomRight last
  let upper := D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    l upperBottomRight last
  let vertical := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    last j l hVertical
  apply verticalCellFramesCompatible_of_right vertical lower upper
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label last j)
      (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV last j 1))
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label last l)
      (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV last l 0))
  · exact D.verticalInternalEdge_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      last j l hVertical
  · exact (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j lowerBottomRight last).2
  · exact (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      l upperBottomRight last).1
  · change upper.bottomRight = vertical.endChange * lower.topRight
    have hupper : upper.bottomRight = upperBottomRight := by
      simp [upper, BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames, last]
    rw [hupper]
    exact hAnchor

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRows_vertical_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRows_vertical_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j l : Fin D.steps) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (lowerBottomRight upperBottomRight : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
    (hAnchor : let last : Fin D.steps :=
        ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
      let vertical := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        last j l hVertical
      upperBottomRight = vertical.endChange *
        (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          j lowerBottomRight last).topRight) :
    ∀ i : Fin D.steps,
      VerticalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
        (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j lowerBottomRight i)
        (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l upperBottomRight i)
proof:
:= by
  apply D.verticalCellFramesCompatible_all_of_last hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    j l hVertical
    (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j lowerBottomRight)
    (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l upperBottomRight)
  · exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j lowerBottomRight
  · exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      l upperBottomRight
  · intro i
    exact (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j lowerBottomRight i).2
  · intro i
    exact (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      l upperBottomRight i).1
  · exact D.rightAnchoredRows_last_vertical_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j l hVertical lowerBottomRight upperBottomRight hAnchor

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_reanchor
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_reanchor
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) (desiredBottomRight : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let frames := D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j desiredBottomRight
    D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j (frames last).bottomRight = frames
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let frames := D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j desiredBottomRight
  have hlast : (frames last).bottomRight = desiredBottomRight := by
    simp [frames, BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames, last]
  dsimp only
  rw [hlast]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps)
    (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        i k ⟨p, hp⟩ hHorizontal)
      (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i)
      (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp k)
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨0, hp⟩ 1 i k hHorizontal
  | succ p =>
      exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
        ((D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
            ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
            ⟨p, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp⟩ ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
            (by apply Fin.ext; rfl)).endChange *
          (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p
            (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp)
            ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).topRight)
        i k hHorizontal

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
    let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
    let hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
    VerticalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
      (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp' i)
      (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp i)
proof:
:= by
  let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
  let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
  let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
  have hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let lower := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
  let vertical := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    last j l hVertical
  have hAll := D.rightAnchoredRows_vertical_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    j l hVertical (lower last).bottomRight
    (vertical.endChange * (lower last).topRight)
  have hlowerAnchor : D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j (lower last).bottomRight = lower := by
    cases p with
    | zero =>
        exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_reanchor hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          j 1
    | succ p =>
        exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_reanchor hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          j ((D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV last
            ⟨p, Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp'⟩ j
            (by apply Fin.ext; rfl)).endChange *
              (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p
                (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp') last).topRight)
  have hAnchor : vertical.endChange * (lower last).topRight =
      vertical.endChange *
        (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          j (lower last).bottomRight last).topRight := by
    rw [hlowerAnchor]
  have hi := hAll hAnchor i
  rw [hlowerAnchor] at hi
  simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt,
    hp', j, l, hVertical, last, lower, vertical] using hi

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_horizontal_edges
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_horizontal_edges
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let F := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
    rebaseEdge F.bottomLeft F.bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp⟩)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp⟩ 0)) = 1 ∧
      rebaseEdge F.topLeft F.topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp⟩)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp⟩ 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨0, hp⟩ 1 i
  | succ p =>
      exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ _ i

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_right_edge_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_right_edge_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let F := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp last
    rebaseEdge F.bottomRight F.topRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label last ⟨p, hp⟩)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV last ⟨p, hp⟩ 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_right_edge_eq_one hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨0, hp⟩ 1
  | succ p =>
      exact D.rightAnchoredRowFrames_right_edge_eq_one hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_leftmost
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_leftmost
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    (D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat).leftEdge =
      rebaseEdge (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).bottomLeft
        (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
            ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩ 0))
proof:
:= by
  exact D.framedHorizontalFullRowState_leftEdge
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV ⟨p, hp⟩
    (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)
    (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat
    S.leftEdge = 1
proof:
:= by
  let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat
  have hlr := D.framedFullRow_leftEdge_eq_rightEdge hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    ⟨p, hp⟩ frames compat
    (D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_horizontal_edges hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)
  have hright := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_right_edge_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
  change S.leftEdge = S.boundary.focus at hlr
  change rebaseEdge
      (frames ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).bottomRight
      (frames ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩).topRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of
        (D.label ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
          ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ ⟨p, hp⟩ 1)) = 1
    at hright
  exact hlr.trans (S.focus_eq.trans hright)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt_eq_reverseRows
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt_eq_reverseRows
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      D.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp =
        reverseEdgeChainProduct (List.ofFn fun r : Fin (p + 1) =>
          let hr : r.val < D.steps :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ r.isLt) hp
          let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
            hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val hr
          let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
            hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val hr
          (1, (D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
            ⟨r.val, hr⟩ frames compat).leftEdge))
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | zero =>
      intro hp
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt]
      simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero, reverseEdgeChainProduct]
      simp
  | succ p ih =>
      intro hp
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt]
      rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append,
        reverseEdgeChainProduct_append]
      simp only [reverseEdgeChainProduct]
      rw [ih hp']
      congr 1
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_reverseRows
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_reverseRows
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    D.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct (List.ofFn fun r : Fin D.steps =>
        let frames := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val r.isLt
        let compat := D.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_compatible
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV r.val r.isLt
        (1, (D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          r frames compat).leftEdge))
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : D.steps - 1 + 1 = D.steps :=
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt D.steps_pos))
  have h := D.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt_eq_reverseRows
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV (D.steps - 1)
      (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)
  rw [h]
  apply congrArg reverseEdgeChainProduct
  rw [List.ofFn_congr hlen]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext r
  congr

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt_eq_one
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      D.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp = 1
proof:
| 0, hp =>
      D.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_one hxU hxV hUV hU hV 0 hp
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt,
        D.rightAnchoredGridFullRow_leftEdge_eq_one hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp,
        D.rightAnchoredGridLeftBoundaryWordAt_eq_one hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp']
      exact one_mul 1

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_one

    (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_rebaseEdge
statement:
theorem rebaseEdge_rebaseEdge
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (outerStart outerEnd innerStart innerEnd edge : G) :
    rebaseEdge outerStart outerEnd
        (rebaseEdge innerStart innerEnd edge) =
      rebaseEdge (innerStart * outerStart) (innerEnd * outerEnd) edge
proof:
:= by
  simp [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.combinedVertexFrames_compatible
statement:
theorem combinedVertexFrames_compatible
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (vertical lowerToTarget upperToTarget : EdgeTransitions G)
    (lower upper : CellVertexFrames G)
    (hFrames : VerticalCellFramesCompatible vertical lower upper)
    (hTransitions : lowerToTarget.endChange =
      upperToTarget.startChange * vertical.startChange) :
    lowerToTarget.endChange * lower.topLeft =
      upperToTarget.startChange * upper.bottomLeft
proof:
:= by
  rw [hFrames.left, hTransitions, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.edgeTransitions_cocycle_of_potentials
statement:
theorem edgeTransitions_cocycle_of_potentials
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (lowerPotential upperPotential targetPotential : G)
    (lowerToTarget upperToTarget vertical : EdgeTransitions G)
    (hlower : lowerToTarget.endChange =
      transitionFromPotentials lowerPotential targetPotential)
    (hupper : upperToTarget.startChange =
      transitionFromPotentials upperPotential targetPotential)
    (hvertical : vertical.startChange =
      transitionFromPotentials lowerPotential upperPotential) :
    lowerToTarget.endChange =
      upperToTarget.startChange * vertical.startChange
proof:
:= by
  rw [hlower, hupper, hvertical, transitionFromPotentials_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_common_ne
statement:
private theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_common_ne
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hs : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (ht : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (hlabel : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) =
      A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t)) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let verticalT := A.subdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hU hV col lower upper hrows hlabel
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * verticalT.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let qs := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let qt := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
  let hbs := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hbt := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
  let hcs := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hct := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
  let CBs := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    qs hbs hcs hs hbs
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
  let CCs := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    qs hbs hcs hs hcs
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
  let CBt := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    qt hbt hct ht hbt
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
  let CCt := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    qt hbt hct ht hct
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
  let lowerPotential : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)) CBs.endChange)⁻¹
  let upperPotential : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t)) CBt.startChange)⁻¹
  let targetPotential : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1 CCs.endChange)⁻¹
  apply edgeTransitions_cocycle_of_potentials
    lowerPotential upperPotential targetPotential
  · exact A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_potential_of_ne
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s hs
  · rw [A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_potential_of_ne
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t ht]
    unfold targetPotential
    congr 1
    exact (A.leftBoundaryDualLetterPotential_adjacent
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht).symm
  · let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let z : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ,
        mem_intersection_of_mem_binaryOpenCoverPieces_of_ne
          (by simpa using hbs 1) (by simpa using hcs 1) hs⟩
    let hzBottom : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label col lower) z =
      A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece col lower 0 1 := by
      calc
        binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
            (A.subdivision.label col lower) z =
            (⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
                A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ,
              by simpa using hbs 1⟩ :
              binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (A.subdivision.label col lower)) := by
                apply Subtype.ext
                rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
        _ = A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece col lower 0 1 :=
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_cellTarget_eq
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
    let hzTop : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label col upper) z =
      A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece col upper 0 0 := by
      calc
        binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
            (A.subdivision.label col upper) z =
            (⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
                A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 upper.castSucc,
              by simpa using hbt 0⟩ :
              binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (A.subdivision.label col upper)) := by
                apply Subtype.ext
                rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
                exact A.leftBoundary_segmentGridEdgeIndex_shared_vertex
                  i s t hshared
        _ = A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece col upper 0 0 :=
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_cellSource_eq
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
    rw [A.subdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hlabel z hzBottom hzTop]
    unfold lowerPotential upperPotential
    rw [A.leftBoundaryDualCellEndPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s hs]
    rw [A.leftBoundaryDualCellStartPotential_at_sharedVertex
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared ht]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySameComparisonTarget_eq_switchSource
statement:
private theorem leftBoundarySameComparisonTarget_eq_switchSource
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hs : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) = (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (ht : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
        A.subdivision.label col upper := by
      intro h
      exact ht (h.symm.trans hs)
    let Csame := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      hs
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    let Cbottom := A.subdivision.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hswitch
    Csame.edgeTarget = Cbottom.edgeSource
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_edgeTarget]
  apply Subtype.ext
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edgeSource]
  rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySameTransitionEnd_eq_switchVertexPotentials
statement:
private theorem leftBoundarySameTransitionEnd_eq_switchVertexPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hs : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) = (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (ht : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
        A.subdivision.label col upper := by
      intro h
      exact ht (h.symm.trans hs)
    let Csame := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      hs
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    let z : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos col.castSucc lower.succ, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
          A.subdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
            col lower upper hrows hswitch 0⟩
    let hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label col lower) z = Csame.edgeTarget :=
      (A.leftBoundarySameComparisonTarget_eq_switchSource

    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hs : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (ht : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t) = (letters.reverse.get i).1) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
        A.subdivision.label col upper := by
      intro h
      exact hs (h.trans ht)
    let Csame := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i t)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i t)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i t)
      ht
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
    let Ctop := A.subdivision.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hswitch
    let z : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos col.castSucc lower.succ, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
          A.subdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection
            col lower upper hrows hswitch 0⟩
    let hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label col upper) z = Csame.edgeSource :=
      (A.leftBoundaryUpperSameComparisonSource_eq_switchTopSource
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht).symm
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z (A.subdivision.label col upper)
        Csame.edgeSource Csame.leftStart hz =
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (A.subdivision.label col upper)
        Ctop.startChange : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.subdivision.verticalSwitchTop_startPotential_eq_vertexPotential]
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    hxU hxV hUV
      (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t))
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  · apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe,
      coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_leftStart]
    have hconnector := A.leftBoundaryCellStart_eq_verticalSwitchTopStart
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared
      (by
        intro h
        exact hs (h.trans ht))
    have hu := congrArg (fun p => ((p u :
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t))) : X)) hconnector
    simpa only [Path.cast_coe] using hu
  · exact A.leftBoundaryUpperSameComparisonSource_eq_switchTopSource
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_upper_eq

private theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_upper_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hs : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (ht : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t) = (letters.reverse.get i).1) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
        A.subdivision.label col upper := by
      intro h
      exact hs (h.trans ht)
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let verticalT := A.subdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hswitch
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * verticalT.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
  let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
  let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
  have hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
      A.subdivision.label col upper := by
    intro h
    exact hs (h.trans ht)
  let qLower := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hbLower := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hcLower := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let CBlower := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    qLower hbLower hcLower hs hbLower
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
  let CClower := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    qLower hbLower hcLower hs hcLower
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
  let Cbottom := A.subdivision.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hswitch
  let Ctop := A.subdivision.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hswitch
  let bottomPotential : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (A.subdivision.label col lower)
      Cbottom.startChange)⁻¹
  let topPotential : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (A.subdivision.label col upper)
      Ctop.startChange)⁻¹
  let targetPotential : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (letters.reverse.get i).1
      CClower.endChange)⁻¹
  apply edgeTransitions_cocycle_of_potentials
    bottomPotential topPotential targetPotential
  · rw [A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_potential_of_ne
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s hs]
    unfold bottomPotential targetPotential
    rw [A.leftBoundaryDualCellEndPotential_eq_verticalSwitchBottom
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs hswitch]
  · rw [A.leftBoundaryUpperSameTransitionStart_eq_switchVertexPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht]
    rw [A.leftBoundaryUpperSameCellStartPotential_eq_switchTop
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht]
    rw [A.leftBoundaryUpperSameLetterStartPotential_eq_lowerDual
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht]
  · exact A.subdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions_start_potential
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows hswitch

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_both_eq
statement:
private theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_both_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc)
    (hs : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) = (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (ht : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t) = (letters.reverse.get i).1) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let hlabel : A.subdivision.label col lower =
        A.subdivision.label col upper := hs.trans ht.symm
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let verticalT := A.subdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hU hV col lower upper hrows hlabel
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * verticalT.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
  let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
  let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
  let hlabel : A.subdivision.label col lower =
      A.subdivision.label col upper := hs.trans ht.symm
  let qs := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let qt := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
  let hbs := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hbt := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
  let hcs := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hct := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
    hxU hxV letters Fhom i t
  let Cs := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
    qs hbs hcs hs
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
  let Ct := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
    qt hbt hct ht
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
    (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
  let Cv := A.subdivision.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison
    hxU hxV hU hV col lower upper hrows hlabel
  let fLower := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV)
    (A.subdivision.label col lower) :
    FundamentalGroup
      (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (A.subdivision.label col lower))
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (A.subdivision.label col lower)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have hCsTarget : (Cs.edgeTarget : X) = (Cv.edgeSource : X) := by
    rw [binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_edgeTarget]
    rfl
  have hCsTarget' : Cs.edgeTarget = Cv.edgeSource := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hCsTarget
  have hCtSource : (Ct.edgeSource : X) = (Cv.edgeSource : X) := by
    rw [binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_edgeSource]
    exact A.leftBoundary_segmentGridEdgeIndex_shared_vertex i s t hshared |>.symm
  let targetConnector := Cs.rightEnd.cast rfl hCsTarget'.symm
  let lowerPotential := binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
    (A.subdivision.label col lower) Cv.edgeSource Cv.leftStart targetConnector
  let upperPotential := binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
    (A.subdivision.label col lower) Cv.edgeSource Cv.rightStart targetConnector
  let verticalPotential := binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
    (A.subdivision.label col lower) Cv.edgeSource Cv.leftStart Cv.rightStart
  have hLower : binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
      (A.subdivision.label col lower) Cs.edgeTarget Cs.leftEnd Cs.rightEnd =
      lowerPotential := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential_cast_label
      hxU hxV (A.subdivision.label col lower)
        (A.subdivision.label col lower) rfl
    · exact hCsTarget
    · intro u
      have hconnector := A.leftBoundaryCellEnd_eq_verticalCommonLeftStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hlabel
      have hu := congrArg (fun p => ((p u :
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (A.subdivision.label col lower)) : X)) hconnector
      exact (coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_leftEnd
        hxU hxV qs hbs hcs hs
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s) u).trans (by
          simpa only [Path.cast_coe] using hu)
    · intro u
      rw [Path.cast_coe]
  have hUpper : binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
      (A.subdivision.label col upper) Ct.edgeSource Ct.leftStart Ct.rightStart =
      upperPotential := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential_cast_label
      hxU hxV (A.subdivision.label col upper)
        (A.subdivision.label col lower) hlabel.symm
    · exact hCtSource
    · intro u
      exact (coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_leftStart
        hxU hxV qt hbt hct ht
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t) u).trans
        (A.coe_leftBoundaryCellStart_eq_verticalCommonRightStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hlabel u).symm
    · intro u
      have hstart := coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_rightStart
        hxU hxV qt hbt hct ht
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t) u
      have hconnector := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterConnector_adjacent
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared
      have hu := congrArg (fun p => ((p u :
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1) : X)) hconnector
      have hsEnd := coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_rightEnd
        hxU hxV qs hbs hcs hs
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s) u
      have hletters :
          ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
            hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t) u : X) =
          ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
            hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s) u : X) := by
        simpa only [Path.cast_coe] using hu.symm
      calc
        (Ct.rightStart u : X) =
            ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
              hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i t) u : X) := hstart
        _ = ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
              hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s) u : X) := hletters
        _ = (Cs.rightEnd u : X) := hsEnd.symm
        _ = (targetConnector u : X) := by rw [Path.cast_coe]
  rw [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
    dif_pos hs,
    PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
    dif_pos ht]
  dsimp only
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions
  dsimp only
  rw [Cs.map_endChange_inv, Ct.map_startChange_inv, Cv.map_startChange_inv]
  change binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
      (A.subdivision.label col lower) Cs.edgeTarget Cs.leftEnd Cs.rightEnd =
    binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential hxU hxV
        (A.subdivision.label col upper) Ct.edgeSource Ct.leftStart Ct.rightStart *
      verticalPotential
  rw [hLower, hUpper]
  unfold lowerPotential upperPotential verticalPotential
    binaryOpenCoverConnectorPotential
  exact (map_connectorChange_mul fLower
    Cv.leftStart Cv.rightStart targetConnector).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
      A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let verticalT := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * verticalT.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
  let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
  let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
  let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
  by_cases hs : A.subdivision.label col lower = c
  · by_cases ht : A.subdivision.label col upper = c
    · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
        dif_pos (hs.trans ht.symm)]
      exact A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_both_eq
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht
    · have hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
          A.subdivision.label col upper := by
        intro h
        exact ht (h.symm.trans hs)
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
        dif_neg hswitch]
      exact A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_lower_eq
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht
  · by_cases ht : A.subdivision.label col upper = c
    · have hswitch : A.subdivision.label col lower ≠
          A.subdivision.label col upper := by
        intro h
        exact hs (h.trans ht)
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
        dif_neg hswitch]
      exact A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_upper_eq
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht
    · have hlabel : A.subdivision.label col lower =
          A.subdivision.label col upper := by
        cases hc : c <;>
          cases hsl : A.subdivision.label col lower <;>
          cases htu : A.subdivision.label col upper <;>
          simp_all
      rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
        dif_pos hlabel]
      exact A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent_of_common_ne
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared hs ht hlabel

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_exists_open_loops
statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_exists_open_loops (x : X) :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x ↔
      ∃ (U : Set X) (_hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x ∈ U),
        ∀ q : FundamentalGroup U ⟨x, hx⟩,
          FundamentalGroup.map
            (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(U, X)) ⟨x, hx⟩ q = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, hx, hrange⟩
    refine ⟨U, hU, hx, fun q => ?_⟩
    have hmem : FundamentalGroup.map
        (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(U, X)) ⟨x, hx⟩ q ∈
        (FundamentalGroup.map
          (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(U, X)) ⟨x, hx⟩).range :=
      ⟨q, rfl⟩
    rw [hrange] at hmem
    simpa using hmem
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, hx, hloops⟩
    refine ⟨U, hU, hx, le_antisymm ?_ bot_le⟩
    rintro g ⟨q, rfl⟩
    simp [hloops q]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace_iff_forall_exists_open_loops
statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace_iff_forall_exists_open_loops :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X ↔
      ∀ x : X, ∃ (U : Set X) (_hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x ∈ U),
        ∀ q : FundamentalGroup U ⟨x, hx⟩,
          FundamentalGroup.map
            (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(U, X)) ⟨x, hx⟩ q = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    exact (semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_exists_open_loops x).mp
      (h.semilocallySimplyConnectedAt x)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun x => (semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_exists_open_loops x).mpr (h x)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace_of_stronglyLocallyContractible
statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace_of_stronglyLocallyContractible
    [StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace X] :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x
  obtain ⟨S, ⟨hSnhds, hScontractible⟩, _⟩ :=
    (contractible_basis x).mem_iff.mp (Filter.univ_mem : Set.univ ∈ 𝓝 x)
  obtain ⟨U, hUS, hUopen, hxU⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hSnhds
  refine ⟨U, hUopen, hxU, le_antisymm ?_ bot_le⟩
  rintro g ⟨q, rfl⟩
  let iUS : C(U, S) := ContinuousMap.inclusion hUS
  let iSX : C(S, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let iUX : C(U, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let _ : ContractibleSpace S := hScontractible
  have hq : FundamentalGroup.map iUS ⟨x, hxU⟩ q = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hq' : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map q iUS =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl (iUS ⟨x, hxU⟩) := hq
  have hi : iSX.comp iUS = iUX := by ext; rfl
  have hcomp : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map q (iSX.comp iUS) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map q iUS) iSX :=
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map_comp
  change FundamentalGroup.map iUX ⟨x, hxU⟩ q = 1
  rw [← hi, FundamentalGroup.map_apply, hcomp, ← FundamentalGroup.map_apply, hq']
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace_of_simplyConnected
statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace_of_simplyConnected
    [SimplyConnectedSpace X] :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ x, le_antisymm ?_ bot_le⟩
  rintro g ⟨q, rfl⟩
  change FundamentalGroup.map
    (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Set.univ, X)) ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x⟩ q = 1
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.existsUnique_coveringMap_homotopyLift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_coveringMap_homotopyLift
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) (H : C(unitInterval × A, X))
    (f0Lift : C(A, E)) (H0 : ∀ a, H (0, a) = p (f0Lift a)) :
    ∃! Hlift : C(unitInterval × A, E),
      p ∘ Hlift = H ∧ ∀ a, Hlift (0, a) = f0Lift a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cov.liftHomotopy H f0Lift H0,
    ⟨cov.liftHomotopy_lifts H f0Lift H0,
      cov.liftHomotopy_zero H f0Lift H0⟩, ?_⟩
  intro Hlift hHlift
  exact (cov.eq_liftHomotopy_iff' H0 Hlift).mpr hHlift

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.coveringMapHomotopyLift_lifts
statement:
theorem coveringMapHomotopyLift_lifts
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) {f0 f1 : C(A, X)} (F : f0.Homotopy f1)
    (f0Lift : C(A, E)) (hf0 : p ∘ f0Lift = f0)
    (z : unitInterval × A) :
    p (coveringMapHomotopyLift cov F f0Lift hf0 z) = F z
proof:
:= by
  let H0 : ∀ a, F (0, a) = p (f0Lift a) :=
    fun a => (F.apply_zero a).trans (congr_fun hf0 a).symm
  exact congr_fun (cov.liftHomotopy_lifts F f0Lift H0) z

    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) {f0 f1 : C(A, X)} (F : f0.Homotopy f1)
    (f0Lift : C(A, E)) (hf0 : p ∘ f0Lift = f0) (a : A) :
    p (coveringMapHomotopyLiftEndpoint cov F f0Lift hf0 a) = f1 a
proof:
:=
  (coveringMapHomotopyLift_lifts cov F f0Lift hf0 (1, a)).trans (F.apply_one a)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.prepend_one
statement:
theorem prepend_one (a : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0) :
    prepend H 1 a = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨y, gamma⟩
  unfold prepend
  congr 1
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x0).trans gamma = gamma
  exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans gamma

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.prepend_mul
statement:
theorem prepend_mul (h k : H) (a : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0) :
    prepend H (h * k) a = prepend H k (prepend H h a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨y, gamma⟩
  unfold prepend
  congr 1
  change (k.1.trans h.1).trans gamma = k.1.trans (h.1.trans gamma)
  exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc k.1 h.1 gamma

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundary_mem
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundary_mem
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V) (i j : Fin D.steps)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    squareGridCellBoundary H D.steps D.steps_pos i j t ∈
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [squareGridCellBoundary, Path.trans_apply, squareGridHorizontalEdge,
    squareGridVerticalEdge, Path.symm_apply]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₃
  · change H (Set.Icc.convexComb
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ) _,
      unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.castSucc) ∈
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)
    simpa only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using D.cell_mem i j _ 0
  · change H (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ,
      Set.Icc.convexComb
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.succ) _) ∈
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)
    simpa only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_one] using D.cell_mem i j 1 _
  · change H (Set.Icc.convexComb
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ) _,
      unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.succ) ∈
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)
    simpa only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_one] using D.cell_mem i j _ 1
  · change H (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc,
      Set.Icc.convexComb
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos j.succ) _) ∈
        binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)
    simpa only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using D.cell_mem i j 0 _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.unitSquareOnePos
statement: theorem unitSquareOnePos : 0 < (1 : ℕ)
