name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundary_eq_map_unitSquareBoundary
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundary_eq_map_unitSquareBoundary
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V) (i j : Fin D.steps)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    squareGridCellBoundary H D.steps D.steps_pos i j t =
      (unitSquareBoundaryLoop.map (D.gridCellMapToSpace i j).continuous) t
proof:
:= by
  change squareGridCellBoundary H D.steps D.steps_pos i j t =
    D.gridCellMapToSpace i j (unitSquareBoundaryLoop t)
  unfold unitSquareBoundaryLoop squareGridCellBoundary
  simp only [Path.trans_apply, squareGridHorizontalEdge, squareGridVerticalEdge,
    Path.symm_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapToSpace
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece unitSquareCellPoint
  simp only [ContinuousMap.coe_mk, ContinuousMap.comp_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp [unitIntervalMeshPoint]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundaryInPiece_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundaryInPiece_eq_one
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V) (i j : Fin D.steps) :
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece i j⟧ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh : Path.Homotopic (D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece i j) _ :=
    ⟨D.gridCellBoundaryHomotopyInPiece i j⟩
  have h : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece i j) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk _ := Quotient.sound hh
  change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece i j) =
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl _
  calc
    _ = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk _ := h
    _ = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Path.refl _) := by
      apply congr_arg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      ext t
      rfl
    _ = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl _ := Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_refl _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_reverse_eq_inv
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_reverse_eq_inv {x₀ z w : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w) :
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop right segment.symm left⟧ =
      (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop left segment right⟧)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
  rw [Path.correctedLoop_product left segment right segment.symm left]
  rw [FundamentalGroup.one_def]
  unfold Path.correctedLoop FundamentalGroup.fromPath FundamentalGroup.fromArrow
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.coe_gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel_eq
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.coe_gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel_eq
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps) (a b : Fin 2)
    (label₁ label₂ : Bool) (hlabel₁ : D.label i j = label₁)
    (hlabel₂ : D.label i j = label₂) (t : unitInterval) :
    ((D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i j a b label₁ hlabel₁ t : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V label₁) : X) =
    ((D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i j a b label₂ hlabel₂ t : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V label₂) : X)
proof:
:= by
  cases hlabel₁
  cases hlabel₂
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundaryInPiece_decompose
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundaryInPiece_decompose
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V) (i j : Fin D.steps) :
    D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece i j =
      ((squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
        1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).trans
        (((squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
          1 unitSquareOnePos 1 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).trans
          (((squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
            1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).symm.trans
            ((squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
              1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).symm))
proof:
:= by
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBoundaryInPiece unitSquareBoundaryLoop
    squareGridCellBoundary
  simp only [Path.map_trans]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedBoundaryViaCorners_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedBoundaryViaCorners_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps) :
    D.gridCellBasedBoundaryViaCorners hxU hxV hU hV i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 0
  let s := D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece i j
  change FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop c s c⟧ = 1
  rw [FundamentalGroup.one_def]
  change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Path.correctedLoop c s c) =
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl _
  unfold Path.correctedLoop
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm]
  have hs := D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece_eq_one i j
  change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk s = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl _ at hs
  rw [hs]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPieceEdgeWord_eq_boundary
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPieceEdgeWord_eq_boundary
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps) :
    (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)⁻¹ *
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)⁻¹ *
        D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 *
        D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 =
      D.gridCellBasedBoundaryViaCorners hxU hxV hU hV i j
proof:
:= by
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedBoundaryViaCorners
  rw [← correctedLoop_reverse_eq_inv
    (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 0)
    ((squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
      1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous)
    (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 1)]
  rw [← correctedLoop_reverse_eq_inv
    (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 1)
    ((squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
      1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous)
    (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 1)]
  rw [Path.correctedLoop_product,
    Path.correctedLoop_product, Path.correctedLoop_product]
  rw [D.gridCellBoundaryInPiece_decompose i j]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPieceEdgeWord_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPieceEdgeWord_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps) :
    (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)⁻¹ *
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)⁻¹ *
        D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 *
        D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.gridCellPieceEdgeWord_eq_boundary hxU hxV hU hV i j,
    D.gridCellBasedBoundaryViaCorners_eq_one hxU hxV hU hV i j]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps) :
    D.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord hxU hxV hU hV i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord
  rw [← map_inv, ← map_inv]
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  rw [D.gridCellPieceEdgeWord_eq_one hxU hxV hU hV i j]
  exact map_one (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.coveringMap_monodromy_mk_eq_pathLift_endpoint
statement:
theorem coveringMap_monodromy_mk_eq_pathLift_endpoint
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) {x y : X} (gamma : Path x y) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) :
    cov.monodromy ⟦gamma⟧ e =
      ⟨coveringMapPathLift cov gamma e.1 e.2 1,
        coveringMapPathLift_endpoint_mem_fiber cov gamma e.1 e.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.coveringMap_pathLift_closed_iff_monodromy_fixed
statement:
theorem coveringMap_pathLift_closed_iff_monodromy_fixed
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) {x : X} (gamma : Path x x) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) :
    coveringMapPathLift cov gamma e.1 e.2 1 = e.1 ↔
      cov.monodromy ⟦gamma⟧ e = e
proof:
:= by
  rw [coveringMap_monodromy_mk_eq_pathLift_endpoint]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => Subtype.ext h
  · exact fun h => congr_arg Subtype.val h

    (b : Bool) :

      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)).cast

      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV)) :
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of false
        (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV false g) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =

        (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV true g) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.fundamentalGroup_map_correctedLoop
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroup_map_correctedLoop
    {S T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [TopologicalSpace T]
    (f : C(S, T)) {base z w : S}
    (left : Path base z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path base w) :
    FundamentalGroup.map f base
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop left segment right⟧) =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
        (left.map f.continuous) (segment.map f.continuous) (right.map f.continuous)⟧
proof:
:= by
  change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Path.correctedLoop left segment right)) f =
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Path.correctedLoop
      (left.map f.continuous) (segment.map f.continuous) (right.map f.continuous))
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_map]
  congr 1
  unfold Path.correctedLoop
  simp only [Path.map_trans, Path.map_symm]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImage_eq_map
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImage_eq_map
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) (b : Bool) :
    D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImage hxU hxV hUV i k j hshared hswitch b =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV b
        (D.horizontalSwitchEdgeIntersectionElement hxU hxV hUV
          i k j hshared hswitch)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;>
    unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImage
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgeIntersectionElement
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps <;>
    symm <;>
    exact fundamentalGroup_map_correctedLoop _ _ _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImage_eq_map

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgeInLeftPiece_eq_cellEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdgeInLeftPiece_eq_cellEdge
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    D.horizontalSwitchEdgeInPiece i k j hshared hswitch (D.label i j) =
      (((squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
        1 unitSquareOnePos 1 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).cast
          (D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_source_eq i k j hshared hswitch)
          (D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_target_eq i k j hshared hswitch))
proof:
:= by
  let q := (squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 1 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous
  let hs := D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_source_eq i k j hshared hswitch
  let ht := D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_target_eq i k j hshared hswitch
  apply Path.ext
  calc
    (D.horizontalSwitchEdgeInPiece i k j hshared hswitch (D.label i j) :
        unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) =
        (q : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) := by
      funext t
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hone : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
        simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
      have hqt : q t = D.gridCellMapInPiece i j
          (squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
            1 unitSquareOnePos 1 0 t) := by
        rfl
      rw [D.coe_horizontalSwitchEdgeInPiece]
      rw [hqt]
      simp [squareGridVerticalEdge,
        BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece,
        unitSquareCellPoint, hone]
      rfl
    _ = (q.cast hs ht : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
      (Path.cast_coe q hs ht).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeftComparison_rightElement
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeftComparison_rightElement
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))

    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    (D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch).rightElement =
      D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1
proof:
:= by
  let l := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j 1 0 (D.label i j) rfl
  let q := (squareGridVerticalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 1 0).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous
  let r := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j 1 1 (D.label i j) rfl
  let hs := D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_source_eq i k j hshared hswitch
  let ht := D.horizontalSwitchEdge_left_target_eq i k j hshared hswitch
  have hp : Path.correctedLoop (l.cast rfl hs) (q.cast hs ht) (r.cast rfl ht) =
      Path.correctedLoop l q r := correctedLoop_cast l q r hs ht
  unfold CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightElement
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightStart,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edge, CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightEnd]
  rw [D.horizontalSwitchEdgeInLeftPiece_eq_cellEdge i k j hshared hswitch]
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk hp

        (D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
          i k j hshared hswitch (D.label i j)) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
        (D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
          i k j hshared hswitch (D.label k j)) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
proof:
:= by
  cases hli : D.label i j <;> cases hlk : D.label k j
  · exact False.elim (hswitch (hli.trans hlk.symm))
  · rw [D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i k j hshared hswitch false,
      D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i k j hshared hswitch true]
    exact D.horizontalSwitchEdge_pieceImages_pushout_eq hxU hxV hUV
      i k j hshared hswitch
  · rw [D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i k j hshared hswitch true,
      D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i k j hshared hswitch false]
    exact (D.horizontalSwitchEdge_pieceImages_pushout_eq hxU hxV hUV
      i k j hshared hswitch).symm
  · exact False.elim (hswitch (hli.trans hlk.symm))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.edgeElements_eq_of_change_relations
statement:
theorem edgeElements_eq_of_change_relations
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (endL startL commonL cellL : G)
    (endR startR commonR cellR : G)
    (hL : endL⁻¹ * commonL * startL = cellL)
    (hR : endR⁻¹ * commonR * startR = cellR)
    (hcommon : commonL = commonR) :
    cellL = endL⁻¹ * (endR * cellR * startR⁻¹) * startL
proof:
:= by
  have hsolve : commonR = endR * cellR * startR⁻¹ := by
    calc
      commonR = endR * (endR⁻¹ * commonR * startR) * startR⁻¹ := by
        simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = endR * cellR * startR⁻¹ := by rw [hR]
  calc
    cellL = endL⁻¹ * commonL * startL := hL.symm
    _ = endL⁻¹ * commonR * startL := by rw [hcommon]
    _ = endL⁻¹ * (endR * cellR * startR⁻¹) * startL := by rw [hsolve]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_pushout_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_pushout_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let CL := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    let CR := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.endChange)⁻¹ *
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.endChange) *
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
            (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0)) *
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.startChange)⁻¹) *
        Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let CL := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i k j hshared hswitch
  let CR := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i k j hshared hswitch
  let fL := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j) :
    FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j))
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  let fR := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label k j) :
    FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label k j))
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label k j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have hL := congrArg fL
    (D.horizontalSwitchLeft_pieceElement_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch)
  have hR := congrArg fR
    (D.horizontalSwitchRight_pieceElement_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch)
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv] at hL hR
  have hcommon := D.horizontalSwitchEdge_normalized_pushout_eq hxU hxV hUV
    i k j hshared hswitch
  exact edgeElements_eq_of_change_relations
    (fL CL.endChange) (fL CL.startChange)
    (fL (D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
      i k j hshared hswitch (D.label i j)))
    (fL (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1))
    (fR CR.endChange) (fR CR.startChange)
    (fR (D.horizontalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
      i k j hshared hswitch (D.label k j)))
    (fR (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0))
    hL hR hcommon

statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_source_eq
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}

    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)

          simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
            using D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i j l hshared hswitch 0⟩ :
          ↥(U ∩ V)) =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel i j 0 1 (D.label i j) rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeInBottomPiece_eq_cellEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeInBottomPiece_eq_cellEdge
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    D.verticalSwitchEdgeInPiece i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i j) =
      (((squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
        1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).cast
          (D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
          (D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_target_eq i j l hshared hswitch))
proof:
:= by
  let q := (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous
  let hs := D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch
  let ht := D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_target_eq i j l hshared hswitch
  apply Path.ext
  calc
    (D.verticalSwitchEdgeInPiece i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i j) :
        unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) =
        (q : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) := by
      funext t
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hone : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
        simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
      have hqt : q t = D.gridCellMapInPiece i j
          (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
            1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1 t) := by
        rfl
      rw [D.coe_verticalSwitchEdgeInPiece]
      rw [hqt]
      simp [squareGridHorizontalEdge,
        BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece,
        unitSquareCellPoint, hone]
      rfl
    _ = (q.cast hs ht : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
      (Path.cast_coe q hs ht).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottomComparison_rightElement
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottomComparison_rightElement
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    (D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch).rightElement =
      D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1
proof:
:= by
  let a := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j 0 1 (D.label i j) rfl
  let q := (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous
  let r := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j 1 1 (D.label i j) rfl
  let hs := D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch
  let ht := D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_target_eq i j l hshared hswitch
  have hp : Path.correctedLoop (a.cast rfl hs) (q.cast hs ht) (r.cast rfl ht) =
      Path.correctedLoop a q r := correctedLoop_cast a q r hs ht
  unfold CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightElement
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightStart,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edge, CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightEnd]
  rw [D.verticalSwitchEdgeInBottomPiece_eq_cellEdge i j l hshared hswitch]
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk hp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottom_pieceElement_relation
statement:

    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)

    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightStart,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edge, CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightEnd]
  rw [D.verticalSwitchEdgeInTopPiece_eq_cellEdge i j l hshared hswitch]
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk hp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTop_pieceElement_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTop_pieceElement_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    let C := D.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    C.endChange⁻¹ *
        D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
          i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i l) * C.startChange =
      D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← D.verticalSwitchTopComparison_leftElement_normalized
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch]
  rw [D.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison_relation
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch]
  exact D.verticalSwitchTopComparison_rightElement
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_normalized_pushout_eq
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_normalized_pushout_eq
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
          i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i j)) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
        (D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
          i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i l)) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
proof:
:= by
  cases hij : D.label i j <;> cases hil : D.label i l
  · exact False.elim (hswitch (hij.trans hil.symm))
  · rw [D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i j l hshared hswitch false,
      D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i j l hshared hswitch true]
    exact D.verticalSwitchEdge_pieceImages_pushout_eq hxU hxV hUV
      i j l hshared hswitch
  · rw [D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i j l hshared hswitch true,
      D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized_eq hxU hxV hUV
        i j l hshared hswitch false]
    exact (D.verticalSwitchEdge_pieceImages_pushout_eq hxU hxV hUV
      i j l hshared hswitch).symm
  · exact False.elim (hswitch (hij.trans hil.symm))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_pushout_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_pushout_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    let CB := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    let CT := D.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CB.endChange)⁻¹ *
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l) CT.endChange *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0) *
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l) CT.startChange)⁻¹) *
        Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CB.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let CB := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i j l hshared hswitch
  let CT := D.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i j l hshared hswitch
  let fB := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j) :
      FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j))
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  let fT := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i l) :
      FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i l))
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i l)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have hB := congrArg fB
    (D.verticalSwitchBottom_pieceElement_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch)
  have hT := congrArg fT
    (D.verticalSwitchTop_pieceElement_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch)
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv] at hB hT
  have hcommon := D.verticalSwitchEdge_normalized_pushout_eq hxU hxV hUV
    i j l hshared hswitch
  exact edgeElements_eq_of_change_relations
    (fB CB.endChange) (fB CB.startChange)
    (fB (D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
      i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i j)))
    (fB (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1))
    (fT CT.endChange) (fT CT.startChange)
    (fT (D.verticalSwitchEdgePieceImageNormalized hxU hxV hUV
      i j l hshared hswitch (D.label i l)))
    (fT (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
    hB hT hcommon

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.toMathlib_subspace

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.toMathlib_product
statement:
theorem toMathlib_product (τX : TextbookTopology X) (τY : TextbookTopology Y) :
    (product τX τY).toMathlib = @instTopologicalSpaceProd X Y τX.toMathlib τY.toMathlib
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.ext
  funext s
  apply propext
  let _ := τX.toMathlib
  let _ := τY.toMathlib
  rw [SandronesLibrary.Topology.isOpen_prod_iff_rectangles]
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy
    obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hmem, hsub⟩ := h (x, y) hxy
    exact ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hmem.1, hmem.2, hsub⟩
  · intro h p hp
    obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hpu, hpv, hsub⟩ := h p.1 p.2 hp
    exact ⟨u, v, hu, hv, ⟨hpu, hpv⟩, hsub⟩

  rw [toMathlib_subspace, toMathlib_realLine]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (t : unitInterval) :
    A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s t ∈
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s))
proof:
:= by
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge
    squareGridVerticalEdge
  change pathHomotopySquare Fhom
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint A.subdivision.steps A.subdivision.steps_pos 0,
        Set.Icc.convexComb
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint A.subdivision.steps A.subdivision.steps_pos
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint A.subdivision.steps A.subdivision.steps_pos
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ) t) ∈ _
  have hzero :
      (⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩ : Fin A.subdivision.steps).castSucc =
        (0 : Fin (A.subdivision.steps + 1)) := by rfl
  simpa only [unitSquareCellPoint, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hzero] using
    A.subdivision.cell_mem ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) 0 t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_cellSource_eq
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_cellSource_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_cellTarget_eq
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_cellTarget_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_letterSource_eq
statement:
private theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_letterSource_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy

          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,

  rw [squareGridVertex, unitIntervalMeshPoint_zero,

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_letterTarget_eq
statement:

    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterConnector_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterConnector_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc) :
    let ws : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1 :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩
    let wt : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1 :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t).castSucc,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i t 0⟩

statement:
theorem HorizontalCellFramesCompatible.mulRight
    {G : Type*} [Group G] {T : EdgeTransitions G}
    {left right : CellVertexFrames G}
    (h : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible T left right)
    (bottomGauge topGauge : G) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible T
      (left.mulRight bottomGauge topGauge)
      (right.mulRight bottomGauge topGauge)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change right.bottomLeft * bottomGauge =
      T.startChange * (left.bottomRight * bottomGauge)
    rw [h.bottom, mul_assoc]
  · change right.topLeft * topGauge =
      T.endChange * (left.topRight * topGauge)
    rw [h.top, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rowFramesMulRight_compatible

private theorem rowFramesMulRight_compatible
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (transitions : ∀ (i k : Fin n), i.succ = k.castSucc → EdgeTransitions G)
    (frames : Fin n → CellVertexFrames G)
    (hframes : ∀ (i k : Fin n) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible (transitions i k hshared) (frames i) (frames k))
    (bottomGauge topGauge : G)
    (i k : Fin n) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible (transitions i k hshared)
      (rowFramesMulRight frames bottomGauge topGauge i)
      (rowFramesMulRight frames bottomGauge topGauge k)
proof:
:=
  (hframes i k hshared).mulRight bottomGauge topGauge

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_compatible
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) (desiredBottomRight : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
    (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
      (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j desiredBottomRight i)
      (D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j desiredBottomRight k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames
  apply anchorRowFramesRight_compatible
    (fun i k h => D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j h)
    (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j)
    (D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV j)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_horizontal_edges
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) (desiredBottomRight : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
    (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let F := D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j desiredBottomRight i
    rebaseEdge F.bottomLeft F.bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1 ∧
      rebaseEdge F.topLeft F.topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let baseFrames := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let rightEdge : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label last j)
      (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV last j 1)
  let bottomGauge := (baseFrames last).bottomRight⁻¹ * desiredBottomRight
  let topGauge := (baseFrames last).topRight⁻¹ *
    (rightEdge * desiredBottomRight)
  have hbase := D.gaugeNormalizedRowFrames_horizontal_edges
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j i
  change rebaseEdge
      ((baseFrames i).bottomLeft * bottomGauge)
      ((baseFrames i).bottomRight * bottomGauge)
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1 ∧
    rebaseEdge
      ((baseFrames i).topLeft * topGauge)
      ((baseFrames i).topRight * topGauge)
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) = 1
  exact ⟨rebaseEdge_mulRight_eq_one _ _ _ bottomGauge hbase.1,
    rebaseEdge_mulRight_eq_one _ _ _ topGauge hbase.2⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_right_edge_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames_right_edge_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) (desiredBottomRight : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    let last : Fin D.steps :=
      ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let F := D.rightAnchoredRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j desiredBottomRight last
    rebaseEdge F.bottomRight F.topRight
      (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label last j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV last j 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let last : Fin D.steps :=
    ⟨D.steps - 1, Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let rightEdge : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label last j)
      (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV last j 1)
  dsimp only
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredRowFrames
  rw [anchorRowFramesRight_last_bottomRight,
    anchorRowFramesRight_last_topRight]
  change rebaseEdge desiredBottomRight (rightEdge * desiredBottomRight) rightEdge = 1
  exact rebaseEdge_mul_start_eq_one desiredBottomRight rightEdge

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_startFrame_unique
statement:
theorem rebaseEdge_startFrame_unique
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (firstStart secondStart endFrame edge : G)
    (hfirst : rebaseEdge firstStart endFrame edge = 1)
    (hsecond : rebaseEdge secondStart endFrame edge = 1) :
    firstStart = secondStart
proof:
:= by
  have h : (endFrame⁻¹ * edge) * firstStart =
      (endFrame⁻¹ * edge) * secondStart := by
    simpa [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc] using hfirst.trans hsecond.symm
  exact mul_left_cancel h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_endFrame_unique
statement:
theorem rebaseEdge_endFrame_unique
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (startFrame firstEnd secondEnd edge : G)
    (hfirst : rebaseEdge startFrame firstEnd edge = 1)
    (hsecond : rebaseEdge startFrame secondEnd edge = 1) :
    firstEnd = secondEnd
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst' : edge * startFrame = firstEnd := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => firstEnd * z) hfirst
    simpa [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc] using h
  have hsecond' : edge * startFrame = secondEnd := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => secondEnd * z) hsecond
    simpa [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc] using h
  exact hfirst'.symm.trans hsecond'

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_pathHomotopy_iff_exists_fixed_endpoint_deformation
statement:
theorem nonempty_pathHomotopy_iff_exists_fixed_endpoint_deformation :
    Nonempty (p.Homotopy q) ↔
      ∃ F : unitInterval × unitInterval → X, Continuous F ∧
        (∀ s, F (0, s) = p s) ∧
        (∀ s, F (1, s) = q s) ∧
        (∀ t, F (t, 0) = x) ∧
        (∀ t, F (t, 1) = y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨H⟩
    exact ⟨H, H.continuous, H.apply_zero, H.apply_one, H.source, H.target⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF, hzero, hone, hsource, htarget⟩
    refine ⟨{
      toHomotopy := {
        toFun := F
        continuous_toFun := hF
        map_zero_left := hzero
        map_one_left := hone
      }
      prop' := ?_
    }⟩
    intro t s hs
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hsource t).trans p.source.symm
    · exact (htarget t).trans p.target.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterWord_append
statement:
private theorem binaryVanKampenLetterWord_append (U V : Set X) {x₀ : X}
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (first second : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV)) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV (first ++ second) =
      binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV first *
        binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV second
proof:
:= by
  induction first with
  | nil => simp [binaryVanKampenLetterWord]
  | cons head rest ih =>
      rcases head with ⟨b, g⟩
      simp only [List.cons_append, binaryVanKampenLetterWord, ih, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_binaryVanKampenLetterWord
statement:
theorem exists_binaryVanKampenLetterWord (U V : Set X) {x₀ : X}
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (a : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    ∃ letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV),
      binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Monoid.PushoutI.induction_on with
  | of b g =>
      exact ⟨[⟨b, g⟩], by simp [binaryVanKampenLetterWord]⟩
  | base h =>
      refine ⟨[⟨false, binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV false h⟩], ?_⟩
      simp [binaryVanKampenLetterWord, Monoid.PushoutI.of_apply_eq_base]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
      rcases ha with ⟨wa, hwa⟩
      rcases hb with ⟨wb, hwb⟩
      exact ⟨wa ++ wb, by rw [binaryVanKampenLetterWord_append, hwa, hwb]⟩

        (Monoid.PushoutI.of letter.1 letter.2) =

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockLastVertex_eq_basepoint
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockLastVertex_eq_basepoint
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
      A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos L hL)).succ = x₀
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
  let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
    A.factor_pos i
  have h := A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLastLetterEnd
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i (1 : unitInterval)
  simpa [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd,
    Path.cast_coe] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockFirstVertex_eq_basepoint
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockFirstVertex_eq_basepoint
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (j : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
      A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j ⟨0, hL⟩).castSucc = x₀
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have h := A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockFirstLetterStart
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j (1 : unitInterval)
  simpa [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart,
    Path.cast_coe] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockTransitions_cocycle
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryBlockTransitions_cocycle
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    let si := finLastOfPos Li hi
    let sj : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor j) :=
      ⟨0, hj⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i si
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j sj
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i si
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom j sj
    let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared)
    lowerT.endChange = upperT.startChange * vertical.startChange
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
  let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
    A.factor_pos i
  let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
    A.factor_pos j
  let si := finLastOfPos Li hi
  let sj : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor j) :=
    ⟨0, hj⟩
  let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i si
  let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j sj
  let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let z₀ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV
  have hlowerVertex : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom)
      A.subdivision.steps A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ = x₀ := by
    exact A.leftBoundaryBlockLastVertex_eq_basepoint
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i
  have hupperVertex : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom)
      A.subdivision.steps A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 upper.castSucc = x₀ := by
    exact A.leftBoundaryBlockFirstVertex_eq_basepoint
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j
  have hlowerCell : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label col lower) z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ,
        by simpa [col, lower, si] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i si 1⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hlowerVertex
  have hlowerLetter : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (letters.reverse.get i).1 z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ,
        by simpa [lower, si] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i si 1⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hlowerVertex
  have hupperCell : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label col upper) z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 upper.castSucc,
        by simpa [col, upper, sj] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom j sj 0⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hupperVertex
  have hupperLetter : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (letters.reverse.get j).1 z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 upper.castSucc,
        by simpa [upper, sj] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom j sj 0⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hupperVertex
  have hlowerGrid : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label col lower) z₀ =
      A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece col lower 0 1 := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    have hone : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
      simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
    simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece,
      unitSquareGridVertex, unitSquareCellPoint, squareGridVertex, col,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hone] using
        hlowerVertex
  have hupperGrid : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label col upper) z₀ =
      A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece col upper 0 0 := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece,
      unitSquareGridVertex, unitSquareCellPoint, squareGridVertex, col,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
        hupperVertex
  let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i si
  let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom j sj
  let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared)
  have hlower := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_eq_intersectionPotentials
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i si z₀ hlowerCell hlowerLetter
  dsimp only at hlower
  rw [A.leftBoundaryCellEndPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i si z₀ hlowerCell hlowerGrid] at hlower
  have hupper := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_eq_intersectionPotentials
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom j sj z₀ hupperCell hupperLetter
  dsimp only at hupper
  rw [A.leftBoundaryCellStartPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom j sj z₀ hupperCell hupperGrid] at hupper
  have hvertical :=
    A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared)
        z₀ hlowerGrid hupperGrid
  have hletters :=
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_basepoint_eq_of_coe
      hxU hxV hUV (letters.reverse.get i).1 (letters.reverse.get j).1
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ,
        by simpa [lower, si] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i si 1⟩
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 upper.castSucc,
        by simpa [upper, sj] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom j sj 0⟩
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i si)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j sj)
      (A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLastLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i)
      (A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockFirstLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j)
      hlowerLetter hupperLetter
  apply edgeTransitions_cocycle_of_potentials
    (A.subdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z₀ col lower 0 1 hlowerGrid)
    (A.subdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z₀ col upper 0 0 hupperGrid)
    (binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV z₀
      (letters.reverse.get i).1
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 lower.succ,
        by simpa [lower, si] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i si 1⟩
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i si) hlowerLetter)
    lowerT upperT vertical
  · exact hlower
  · rw [hletters]
    exact hupper
  · exact hvertical

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLetterConnectors_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLetterConnectors_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (_hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc)
    (u : unitInterval) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i (finLastOfPos Li hi)) u : X) =
      ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j ⟨0, hj⟩) u : X)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLastLetterEnd hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i u,
    A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockFirstLetterStart hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j u]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.isOpen_prod_iff_rectangles
statement:
theorem isOpen_prod_iff_rectangles [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (s : Set (X × Y)) :
    _root_.IsOpen s ↔ ∀ x y, (x, y) ∈ s →
      ∃ u : Set X, ∃ v : Set Y,
        _root_.IsOpen u ∧ _root_.IsOpen v ∧ x ∈ u ∧ y ∈ v ∧ u ×ˢ v ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  exact _root_.isOpen_prod_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.continuous_prod_mk_iff
statement:
theorem continuous_prod_mk_iff [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [TopologicalSpace Z] (f : Z → X) (g : Z → Y) :
    _root_.Continuous (fun z ↦ (f z, g z)) ↔
      _root_.Continuous f ∧ _root_.Continuous g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨_root_.continuous_fst.comp h, _root_.continuous_snd.comp h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    exact hf.prodMk hg

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.continuous_fst
statement:
theorem continuous_fst (τX : TextbookTopology X) (τY : TextbookTopology Y) :
    Continuous (product τX τY) τX Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  have hpre : Prod.fst ⁻¹' u = u ×ˢ (univ : Set Y) := by ext; simp
  rw [hpre]

proof:

  rw [hpre]
  exact isOpen_prod τX.isOpen_univ hv

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.continuous_prod_mk
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  let S : Set (Set W) := {u | τW.IsOpen u ∧ u ⊆ (fun w ↦ (f w, g w)) ⁻¹' s}
  have hopen : τW.IsOpen (⋃₀ S) :=
    τW.isOpen_sUnion S (fun u hu ↦ hu.1)
  have heq : (⋃₀ S) = (fun w ↦ (f w, g w)) ⁻¹' s := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, hwu⟩
      exact hu.2 hwu
    · intro hw
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hwuv, huv⟩ := hs (f w, g w) hw
      let q := f ⁻¹' u ∩ g ⁻¹' v
      have hqopen : τW.IsOpen q := τW.isOpen_inter _ _ (hf u hu) (hg v hv)
      have hqsub : q ⊆ (fun z ↦ (f z, g z)) ⁻¹' s := by
        intro z hz
        exact huv hz
      exact ⟨q, ⟨hqopen, hqsub⟩, hwuv⟩
  rw [← heq]
  exact hopen

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_path_iff_exists_continuous
statement:
theorem nonempty_path_iff_exists_continuous [TopologicalSpace X] (x y : X) :
    Nonempty (_root_.Path x y) ↔
      ∃ f : unitInterval → X, _root_.Continuous f ∧
        f ⟨0, unitInterval.zero_mem⟩ = x ∧ f ⟨1, unitInterval.one_mem⟩ = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨γ⟩
    exact ⟨γ, γ.continuous, γ.source, γ.target⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, h0, h1⟩
    exact ⟨{ toFun := f, continuous_toFun := hf, source' := h0, target' := h1 }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.Path.transFun_of_le
statement:
theorem transFun_of_le (gamma : Path tau a b) (delta : Path tau b c) (t : UnitInterval)
    (h : t.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    transFun gamma delta t = gamma (UnitInterval.leftDouble t h)

  · rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.Path.transFun_of_not_le
statement:

proof:
:= by

  split

  · rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.Path.continuous_transFun
statement:
theorem continuous_transFun (gamma : Path tau a b) (delta : Path tau b c) :
    Continuous unitInterval tau (transFun gamma delta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_from_unitInterval_iff]
  intro t v hv ht
  by_cases hleft : t.1 < (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  · have htle : t.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := le_of_lt hleft
    have hvalue := transFun_of_le gamma delta t htle
    obtain ⟨eta, heta, hgamma⟩ :=
      (continuous_from_unitInterval_iff tau gamma).mp gamma.continuous
        (UnitInterval.leftDouble t htle) v hv (hvalue ▸ ht)
    refine ⟨min ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - t.1) (eta / 2), lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hleft) (half_pos heta), ?_⟩
    intro u hu
    have habs := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _))
    have huhalf : u.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [transFun_of_le gamma delta u huhalf]
    apply hgamma
    dsimp [UnitInterval.leftDouble]
    have hsmall := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_right _ _))
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · by_cases hright : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < t.1
    · have htno : ¬ t.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := not_le.mpr hright
      have hvalue := transFun_of_not_le gamma delta t htno
      obtain ⟨eta, heta, hdelta⟩ :=
        (continuous_from_unitInterval_iff tau delta).mp delta.continuous
          (UnitInterval.rightDouble t htno) v hv (hvalue ▸ ht)
      refine ⟨min (t.1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (eta / 2),
        lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hright) (half_pos heta), ?_⟩
      intro u hu
      have habs := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _))
      have huno : ¬ u.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := not_le.mpr (by linarith)
      rw [transFun_of_not_le gamma delta u huno]
      apply hdelta
      dsimp [UnitInterval.rightDouble]
      have hsmall := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_right _ _))
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · have htval : t.1 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
      have htle : t.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := le_of_eq htval
      have hleftPoint : UnitInterval.leftDouble t htle = UnitInterval.one := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        dsimp [UnitInterval.leftDouble]
        linarith
      have hvalue : transFun gamma delta t = b := by
        simp only [transFun]
        split
        · rw [hleftPoint, gamma.target]
        · rename_i hbad
          exact (hbad htle).elim
      have hb : b ∈ v := hvalue ▸ ht
      obtain ⟨etaG, hetaG, hgamma⟩ :=
        (continuous_from_unitInterval_iff tau gamma).mp gamma.continuous UnitInterval.one v hv
          (gamma.target.symm ▸ hb)
      obtain ⟨etaD, hetaD, hdelta⟩ :=
        (continuous_from_unitInterval_iff tau delta).mp delta.continuous UnitInterval.zero v hv
          (delta.source.symm ▸ hb)
      refine ⟨min (etaG / 2) (etaD / 2), lt_min (half_pos hetaG) (half_pos hetaD), ?_⟩
      intro u hu
      by_cases hule : u.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      · rw [transFun_of_le gamma delta u hule]
        apply hgamma
        dsimp [UnitInterval.leftDouble, UnitInterval.one]
        have hsmall := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _))
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      · rw [transFun_of_not_le gamma delta u hule]
        apply hdelta
        dsimp [UnitInterval.rightDouble, UnitInterval.zero]
        have hsmall := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_right _ _))
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.Path.trans_apply_of_le
statement:
theorem trans_apply_of_le (gamma : Path tau a b) (delta : Path tau b c) (t : UnitInterval)
    (h : t.1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    gamma.trans delta t = gamma (UnitInterval.leftDouble t h)
proof:
:=
  transFun_of_le gamma delta t h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.coveringMap_lift_range_le_of_exists
statement:
theorem coveringMap_lift_range_le_of_exists
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) {f : C(A, X)} {a0 : A} {e0 : E} (he : p e0 = f a0)
    (hex : ∃ F : C(A, E), F a0 = e0 ∧ p ∘ F = f) :
    (FundamentalGroup.map f a0).range ≤
      (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨p, cov.continuous⟩ he).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF0, hpF⟩ := hex
  subst e0
  have hmap : (⟨p, cov.continuous⟩ : C(E, X)).comp F = f :=
    ContinuousMap.ext fun a => congr_fun hpF a
  subst f
  cases he
  rintro g ⟨q, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨FundamentalGroup.map F a0 q, ?_⟩
  rw [FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_apply, FundamentalGroup.map_apply,
    FundamentalGroup.map_apply]
  have hcomp : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map q
      ((⟨p, cov.continuous⟩ : C(E, X)).comp F) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map q F)
        (⟨p, cov.continuous⟩ : C(E, X)) :=
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map_comp
  simpa using hcomp.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_coveringMap_lift_iff_range_le
statement:
theorem exists_coveringMap_lift_iff_range_le
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) [PathConnectedSpace A] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace A]
    {f : C(A, X)} {a0 : A} {e0 : E} (he : p e0 = f a0) :
    (∃ F : C(A, E), F a0 = e0 ∧ p ∘ F = f) ↔
      (FundamentalGroup.map f a0).range ≤
        (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨p, cov.continuous⟩ he).range
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact coveringMap_lift_range_le_of_exists cov he
  · exact fun h => (cov.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts_of_range_le he h).exists

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.existsUnique_coveringMap_lift_iff_range_le
statement:
theorem existsUnique_coveringMap_lift_iff_range_le
    (cov : IsCoveringMap p) [PathConnectedSpace A] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace A]
    {f : C(A, X)} {a0 : A} {e0 : E} (he : p e0 = f a0) :
    (∃! F : C(A, E), F a0 = e0 ∧ p ∘ F = f) ↔
      (FundamentalGroup.map f a0).range ≤
        (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨p, cov.continuous⟩ he).range
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact coveringMap_lift_range_le_of_exists cov he h.exists
  · exact cov.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts_of_range_le he

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_prod
statement:
private theorem binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_prod
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) :
    ∀ letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV),
      binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV
          (binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters) =
        (letters.map (fun letter => FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦letter.ambientLoop hxU hxV⟧)).prod
proof:
| [] => by simp [binaryVanKampenLetterWord]
  | letter :: rest => by
      rw [binaryVanKampenLetterWord, map_mul,
        binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_of_letter hxU hxV letter,
        binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_prod hxU hxV rest]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_concatLoop
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_concatLoop
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV)) :
    binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV
        (binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters) =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters⟧
proof:
:= by
  let reversed := letters.reverse
  let q : Fin (reversed.length + 1) → X := fun _ => x₀
  let F : (i : Fin reversed.length) → Path (q i.castSucc) (q i.succ) :=
    fun i => (reversed.get i).ambientLoop hxU hxV
  let connector : (i : Fin (reversed.length + 1)) → Path x₀ (q i) :=
    fun _ => Path.refl x₀
  have hconcat := Path.correctedLoopWord_eq_concat q F connector
  have hfold := reverseDfoldl_reverse_get_eq_map_prod
    (fun letter : BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV =>
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦letter.ambientLoop hxU hxV⟧) letters
  rw [binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_prod hxU hxV letters]
  unfold Path.correctedLoopWord at hconcat
  have hleft : Fin.dfoldl reversed.length (fun _ => FundamentalGroup X x₀)
      (fun i acc => FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦Path.correctedLoop (connector i.castSucc) (F i) (connector i.succ)⟧ * acc) 1 =
      Fin.dfoldl reversed.length (fun _ => FundamentalGroup X x₀)
        (fun i acc => FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦(reversed.get i).ambientLoop hxU hxV⟧ * acc) 1 := by
    apply congr_arg (fun a : Fin reversed.length → FundamentalGroup X x₀ =>
      Fin.dfoldl reversed.length (fun _ => FundamentalGroup X x₀)
        (fun i acc => a i * acc) 1)
    funext i
    dsimp [connector, F, q]
    exact fundamentalGroup_fromPath_correctedLoop_refl _
  have hright : FundamentalGroup.fromPath
      ⟦Path.correctedLoop (connector 0) (Path.concat q F)
        (connector (Fin.last reversed.length))⟧ =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters⟧ := by
    dsimp [connector, q]
    exact (fundamentalGroup_fromPath_correctedLoop_refl (Path.concat (fun _ => x₀) F)).trans
      (by rfl)
  calc
    (letters.map (fun letter => FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦letter.ambientLoop hxU hxV⟧)).prod =
        Fin.dfoldl reversed.length (fun _ => FundamentalGroup X x₀)
          (fun i acc => FundamentalGroup.fromPath
            ⟦(reversed.get i).ambientLoop hxU hxV⟧ * acc) 1 := hfold.symm
    _ = Fin.dfoldl reversed.length (fun _ => FundamentalGroup X x₀)
          (fun i acc => FundamentalGroup.fromPath
            ⟦Path.correctedLoop (connector i.castSucc) (F i) (connector i.succ)⟧ * acc) 1 :=
      hleft.symm
    _ = FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop (connector 0) (Path.concat q F)
            (connector (Fin.last reversed.length))⟧ := hconcat
    _ = FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters⟧ := hright

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_binaryVanKampenKernelConcatLoopHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_binaryVanKampenKernelConcatLoopHomotopy
    (U V : Set X) {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (a : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
    (ha : binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV a = 1) :
    ∃ letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV),
      binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters = a ∧
        Nonempty ((binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters).Homotopy
          (Path.refl x₀))
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV a with ⟨letters, hletters⟩
  refine ⟨letters, hletters, ?_⟩
  apply pathHomotopic_refl_of_fromPath_eq_one
  rw [← binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_letterWord_eq_concatLoop hxU hxV letters,
    hletters, ha]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_eq_one_imp
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_eq_one_imp
    {x₀ : X} (U V : Set X) (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (a : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
    (ha : binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV a = 1) :
    a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_binaryVanKampenKernelConcatLoopHomotopy
    U V hxU hxV a ha with ⟨letters, hletters, ⟨Fhom⟩⟩
  by_cases hempty : letters = []
  · subst letters
    simpa [binaryVanKampenLetterWord] using hletters.symm
  · have hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length := by
      exact List.length_pos_iff.mpr (List.reverse_ne_nil_iff.mpr hempty)
    have hSquare : ∀ z, pathHomotopySquare Fhom z ∈ U ∨
        pathHomotopySquare Fhom z ∈ V := by
      intro z
      have hz : pathHomotopySquare Fhom z ∈ U ∪ V := by
        rw [hcover]
        exact Set.mem_univ _
      exact hz
    obtain ⟨A⟩ := exists_pathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision
      (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) hUopen hVopen hSquare letters.reverse.length
    exact hletters.symm.trans
      (A.letterWord_eq_one_of_homotopy_of_nonempty
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.injective_binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap
statement:
theorem injective_binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap
    {x₀ : X} (U V : Set X) (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) :
    Function.Injective (binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff]
  ext a
  simp only [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.mem_bot]
  exact ⟨binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap_eq_one_imp
    U V hxU hxV hUopen hVopen hcover hU hV hUV a,
    fun ha => by simp [ha]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv_apply
    {x₀ : X} (U V : Set X) (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (a : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv U V hxU hxV hUopen hVopen hcover hU hV hUV a =
      binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV a

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv_of
    {x₀ : X} (U V : Set X) (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) (b : Bool)
    (g : FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)) :
    binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv U V hxU hxV hUopen hVopen hcover hU hV hUV
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of b g) =
      binaryOpenCoverPieceMaps U V hxU hxV b g
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryVanKampenCanonicalEquiv_apply, binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap,
    Monoid.PushoutI.lift_of]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.TextbookTopology.IsPathConnected.image

:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_le_succ
statement:
theorem unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_le_succ
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin N) :
    unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc ≤ unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ
proof:
:= by
  change (i : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) ≤ ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ i.val

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ
statement:
theorem dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin N) :
    dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc)
      (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ) = (N : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  change |(i.val : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) - ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)| = (N : ℝ)⁻¹
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hN)
  rw [show (i : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) - ((i : ℝ) + 1) / (N : ℝ) = -(N : ℝ)⁻¹ by
    field_simp
    ring]
  rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg N))]
