name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverPieceMaps_compat
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverPieceMaps_compat (U V : Set X) {x₀ : X}
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) :
    ∀ b, (binaryOpenCoverPieceMaps U V hxU hxV b).comp
        (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV b) =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMapToSpace U V hxU hxV
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  cases b
  · ext g
    rcases Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective g with ⟨p, rfl⟩
    change ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p).map
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V false)).map
        (binaryOpenCoverPieceToSpace U V false) =
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p).map (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToSpace U V)
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map_comp]
    rfl
  · ext g
    rcases Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective g with ⟨p, rfl⟩
    change ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p).map
      (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V true)).map
        (binaryOpenCoverPieceToSpace U V true) =
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p).map (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToSpace U V)
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.map_comp]
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_basedPieceLoop_subtypeVal
statement:
theorem map_basedPieceLoop_subtypeVal {x₀ z w : X} (S : Set X)
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ S) (hz : z ∈ S) (hw : w ∈ S)
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w)
    (hleft : ∀ t, left t ∈ S) (hsegment : ∀ t, segment t ∈ S)
    (hright : ∀ t, right t ∈ S) :
    FundamentalGroup.map (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(S, X)) ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
        (basedPieceLoop S hx₀ hz hw left segment right hleft hsegment hright) =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦left.trans (segment.trans right.symm)⟧
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basedPieceLoop, FundamentalGroup.map_apply]
  apply congr_arg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
  ext t
  simp [Path.trans_apply, pathCodRestrict]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.exists_basedConnectors
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.exists_basedConnectors {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀}
    {U V : Set X} (D : BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) : Nonempty D.BasedConnectors
proof:
:= by
  have hvertex : ∀ i : Fin (D.steps + 1), ∃ c :
      Path x₀ (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i)),
      (∀ j : Fin D.steps, j.castSucc = i → ∀ t,
        c t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label j)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin D.steps, j.succ = i → ∀ t,
        c t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label j)) ∧
      (i = 0 → HEq c (D.firstReflConnector p)) ∧
      (i = Fin.last D.steps → HEq c (D.lastReflConnector p)) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      refine ⟨D.firstReflConnector p, ?_, ?_, fun _ => HEq.rfl, ?_⟩
      · intro j hj t
        cases h : D.label j <;>
          simp [BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.firstReflConnector, Path.cast_coe,
            binaryOpenCoverPiece, hxU, hxV]
      · intro j hj
        exfalso
        have : j.val + 1 = 0 := congr_arg Fin.val hj
        omega
      · intro hlast
        have : 0 = D.steps := by
          simpa using congr_arg Fin.val hlast
        exact False.elim ((Nat.ne_of_gt D.steps_pos) this.symm)
    by_cases hilast : i = Fin.last D.steps
    · subst i
      refine ⟨D.lastReflConnector p, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun _ => HEq.rfl⟩
      · intro j hj
        exfalso
        have : j.val = D.steps := congr_arg Fin.val hj
        omega
      · intro j hj t
        cases h : D.label j <;>
          simp [BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.lastReflConnector, Path.cast_coe,
            binaryOpenCoverPiece, hxU, hxV]
      · intro hzero
        exact (hi0 hzero).elim
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero hi0
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Fin.eq_castSucc_of_ne_last hilast
    have hshared : l.succ = r.castSucc := hl.trans hr.symm
    by_cases hlabels : D.label l = D.label r
    · cases hb : D.label r
      · have hz : p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i) ∈ U := by
          have := D.subpath_mem r 0
          simpa [Path.subpath, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb, ← hr] using this
        let q := (hU.joinedIn x₀ hxU _ hz).somePath
        refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, (fun h => (hi0 h).elim), (fun h => (hilast h).elim)⟩
        · intro j hj t
          have hjr : j = r := (Fin.castSucc_injective _) (hj.trans hr.symm)
          subst j
          simp only [hb, binaryOpenCoverPiece]
          change (hU.joinedIn x₀ hxU _ hz).somePath t ∈ U
          simpa only [q] using (hU.joinedIn x₀ hxU _ hz).somePath_mem t
        · intro j hj t
          have hjl : j = l := (Fin.succ_injective _) (hj.trans hl.symm)
          subst j
          have hbl : D.label l = false := hlabels.trans hb
          simp only [hbl, binaryOpenCoverPiece]
          change (hU.joinedIn x₀ hxU _ hz).somePath t ∈ U
          simpa only [q] using (hU.joinedIn x₀ hxU _ hz).somePath_mem t
      · have hz : p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i) ∈ V := by
          have := D.subpath_mem r 0
          simpa [Path.subpath, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb, ← hr] using this
        let q := (hV.joinedIn x₀ hxV _ hz).somePath
        refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, (fun h => (hi0 h).elim), (fun h => (hilast h).elim)⟩
        · intro j hj t
          have hjr : j = r := (Fin.castSucc_injective _) (hj.trans hr.symm)
          subst j
          simp only [hb, binaryOpenCoverPiece]
          change (hV.joinedIn x₀ hxV _ hz).somePath t ∈ V
          simpa only [q] using (hV.joinedIn x₀ hxV _ hz).somePath_mem t
        · intro j hj t
          have hjl : j = l := (Fin.succ_injective _) (hj.trans hl.symm)
          subst j
          have hbl : D.label l = true := hlabels.trans hb
          simp only [hbl, binaryOpenCoverPiece]
          change (hV.joinedIn x₀ hxV _ hz).somePath t ∈ V
          simpa only [q] using (hV.joinedIn x₀ hxV _ hz).somePath_mem t
    · have hz : p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i) ∈ U ∩ V := by
        rw [← hl]
        exact D.switchVertex_mem_intersection l r hshared hlabels
      let q := (hUV.joinedIn x₀ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩ _ hz).somePath
      refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, (fun h => (hi0 h).elim), (fun h => (hilast h).elim)⟩
      · intro j hj t
        have hjr : j = r := (Fin.castSucc_injective _) (hj.trans hr.symm)
        subst j
        cases hb : D.label r
        · exact (hUV.joinedIn x₀ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩ _ hz).somePath_mem t |>.1
        · exact (hUV.joinedIn x₀ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩ _ hz).somePath_mem t |>.2
      · intro j hj t
        have hjl : j = l := (Fin.succ_injective _) (hj.trans hl.symm)
        subst j
        cases hb : D.label l
        · exact (hUV.joinedIn x₀ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩ _ hz).somePath_mem t |>.1
        · exact (hUV.joinedIn x₀ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩ _ hz).somePath_mem t |>.2
  let connector := fun i => Classical.choose (hvertex i)
  refine ⟨{
    connector := connector
    left_mem := ?_
    right_mem := ?_
    connector_zero := ?_
    connector_last := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i t
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hvertex i.castSucc)).1 i rfl t
  · intro i t
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hvertex i.succ)).2.1 i rfl t
  · exact eq_of_heq ((Classical.choose_spec (hvertex 0)).2.2.1 rfl)
  · exact eq_of_heq ((Classical.choose_spec (hvertex (Fin.last D.steps))).2.2.2 rfl)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.map_reverseDfoldl
statement:
theorem map_reverseDfoldl {M N : Type*} [Monoid M] [Monoid N]
    (φ : M →* N) {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → M) :
    φ (Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => M) (fun i acc => a i * acc) 1) =
      Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => N) (fun i acc => φ (a i) * acc) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Fin.dfoldl_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Fin.dfoldl_succ_last, Fin.dfoldl_succ_last, map_mul]
      congr 1
      change φ (Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => M) (fun i acc => a i.castSucc * acc) 1) =
        Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => N) (fun i acc => φ (a i.castSucc) * acc) 1
      exact ih (fun i => a i.castSucc)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.canonicalMap_of_segmentPieceLoopOfLabel
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.canonicalMap_of_segmentPieceLoopOfLabel
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V) (C : D.BasedConnectors)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (i : Fin D.steps)
    (b : Bool) (hb : D.label i = b) :
    binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of b (D.segmentPieceLoopOfLabel C hxU hxV i b hb)) =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop
        (C.connector i.castSucc)
        (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))
        (C.connector i.succ)⟧
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap, Monoid.PushoutI.lift_of]
  cases b
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.segmentPieceLoopOfLabel]
    exact map_basedPieceLoop_subtypeVal U hxU
      (by simpa [Path.subpath, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using D.subpath_mem i 0)
      (by simpa [Path.subpath, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using D.subpath_mem i 1)
      (C.connector i.castSucc)
      (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))
      (C.connector i.succ)
      (by simpa [binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using C.left_mem i)
      (by simpa [binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using D.subpath_mem i)
      (by simpa [binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using C.right_mem i)
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.segmentPieceLoopOfLabel]
    exact map_basedPieceLoop_subtypeVal V hxV
      (by simpa [Path.subpath, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using D.subpath_mem i 0)
      (by simpa [Path.subpath, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using D.subpath_mem i 1)
      (C.connector i.castSucc)
      (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))
      (C.connector i.succ)
      (by simpa [binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using C.left_mem i)
      (by simpa [binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using D.subpath_mem i)
      (by simpa [binaryOpenCoverPiece, hb] using C.right_mem i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.canonicalMap_of_segmentPieceLoop
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.canonicalMap_of_segmentPieceLoop
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V) (C : D.BasedConnectors)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i) (D.segmentPieceLoop C hxU hxV i)) =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop
        (C.connector i.castSucc)
        (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))
        (C.connector i.succ)⟧
proof:
:=
  D.canonicalMap_of_segmentPieceLoopOfLabel C hxU hxV i (D.label i) rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.canonicalMap_pushoutSegmentWord
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.canonicalMap_pushoutSegmentWord
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V) (C : D.BasedConnectors)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) :
    binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV (D.pushoutSegmentWord C hxU hxV) =
      correctedLoopWord
        (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos)
        (fun i => p.subpath
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))
        C.connector
proof:
:= by
  unfold BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.pushoutSegmentWord
  rw [map_reverseDfoldl]
  unfold correctedLoopWord
  apply congr_arg (fun a : Fin D.steps → FundamentalGroup X x₀ =>
    Fin.dfoldl D.steps (fun _ => FundamentalGroup X x₀)
      (fun i acc => a i * acc) 1)
  funext i
  exact D.canonicalMap_of_segmentPieceLoop C hxU hxV i

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.quotient_reflCast_trans_trans_reflCast_symm
statement:
theorem quotient_reflCast_trans_trans_reflCast_symm
    {x z w : X} (hz : z = x) (hw : w = x)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient z w) :
    ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x).cast rfl hz).trans
        (q.trans ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x).cast rfl hw).symm) =
      q.cast hz.symm hw.symm
proof:
:= by
  cases hz
  cases hw
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast_rfl_rfl]
  induction q using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with
  | mk q =>
      apply Quotient.sound
      exact (show ((Path.refl x).trans (q.trans (Path.refl x).symm)).Homotopic
          (q.trans (Path.refl x).symm) from
        ⟨Path.Homotopy.reflTrans (q.trans (Path.refl x).symm)⟩).trans
        (by simpa using (show (q.trans (Path.refl x)).Homotopic q from
          ⟨Path.Homotopy.transRefl q⟩))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.quotient_subpath_cast_eq_loop
statement:
theorem quotient_subpath_cast_eq_loop {x : X} (p : Path x x)
    (t₀ t₁ : unitInterval) (ht₀ : t₀ = 0) (ht₁ : t₁ = 1)
    (hz : p t₀ = x) (hw : p t₁ = x) :
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (p.subpath t₀ t₁)).cast hz.symm hw.symm =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p
proof:
:= by
  subst t₀
  subst t₁
  simp [Path.subpath_zero_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.correctedLoopWord_eq_loop
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.correctedLoopWord_eq_loop
    {x₀ : X} {p : Path x₀ x₀} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision p U V) (C : D.BasedConnectors) :
    correctedLoopWord
        (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos)
        (fun i => p.subpath
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))
        C.connector = FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦p⟧
proof:
:= by
  rw [correctedLoopWord_eq_concat]
  unfold correctedLoop
  rw [C.connector_zero, C.connector_last]
  change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      ((D.firstReflConnector p).trans
        ((Path.concat (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos)
          (fun i => p.subpath
            (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
            (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))).trans
          (D.lastReflConnector p).symm)) = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm]
  have hconcat : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      (Path.concat (p ∘ unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos)
        (fun i => p.subpath
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ))) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
        (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos 0)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos (Fin.last D.steps))) :=
    Quotient.sound D.concatSubpaths_homotopic
  rw [hconcat]
  have hz : p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos 0) = x₀ := by
    simp [p.source]
  have hw : p (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos (Fin.last D.steps)) = x₀ := by
    simp [p.target]
  calc
    _ = (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
          (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos 0)
            (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos (Fin.last D.steps)))).cast
          hz.symm hw.symm := by
      simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.firstReflConnector,
        BinaryOpenCoverSubdivision.lastReflConnector] using
        quotient_reflCast_trans_trans_reflCast_symm hz hw
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
            (p.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos 0)
              (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos (Fin.last D.steps))))
    _ = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p :=
      quotient_subpath_cast_eq_loop p
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos 0)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint D.steps D.steps_pos (Fin.last D.steps))
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint_zero D.steps D.steps_pos)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint_last D.steps D.steps_pos) hz hw

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.surjective_binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap
statement:
theorem surjective_binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap
    {x₀ : X} (U V : Set X) (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) :
    Function.Surjective (binaryVanKampenCanonicalMap U V hxU hxV)
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  rcases Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective g with ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hp : ∀ t, p t ∈ U ∨ p t ∈ V := by
    intro t
    have ht : p t ∈ U ∪ V := by rw [hcover]; exact Set.mem_univ _
    exact ht
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Path.exists_binaryOpenCoverSubdivision p hUopen hVopen hp
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := D.exists_basedConnectors hxU hxV hU hV hUV
  refine ⟨D.pushoutSegmentWord C hxU hxV, ?_⟩
  rw [D.canonicalMap_pushoutSegmentWord C hxU hxV]
  exact D.correctedLoopWord_eq_loop C

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeft_startPotential_eq_vertexPotential
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchLeft_startPotential_eq_vertexPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let C := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch
    let z : ↥(U ∩ V) :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ j.castSucc, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
          D.horizontalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i k j hshared hswitch 0⟩
    let w := C.edgeSource
    let hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z = w := rfl
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z (D.label i j) w C.rightStart hz
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let C := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch
  rw [C.map_startChange_inv]
  rfl

statement:
theorem horizontalSwitchEdgeTransitions_start_eq_comparisonPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)

      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hswitch

        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.startChange :

    transitionFromPotentials]

    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))

        hxU hxV hUV z (D.label i j) C.edgeSource C.rightStart hz)

    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV z (D.label i j) w C.rightStart hz
proof:

  dsimp only
  let C := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l)
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hzBottom : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 0 1)
    (hzTop : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i l) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i l 0 0) :
    let T := D.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hshared hlabel
    T.startChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 0 1 hzBottom)
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 0 0 hzTop)
proof:
:= by
  let C := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
    i j l hshared hlabel
  let f := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j) :
    FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j))
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have hzTop' : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel i l 0 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel]
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] using
      congrArg Subtype.val hzTop
  have href : C.edgeSource =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z :=
    (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel).trans
      hzBottom.symm
  let reference :=
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j) z).cast
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j)) href
  change (f C.startChange)⁻¹ = _
  rw [C.map_startChange_inv_eq_potentials f reference]
  congr 1
  · unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
    change f (connectorChange reference C.leftStart) =
      f (connectorChange
        ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV
          (D.label i j) z).cast
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
            hzBottom.symm)
        (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 1))
    apply congrArg f
    rw [show C.leftStart =
      (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0 1).cast rfl
        (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel) by rfl]
    exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
      hzBottom href (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel)
  · let explicitTop := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 0 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm hzTop'
    have hactual := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel_eq
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 0 0
      (D.label i j) (D.label i l) hlabel.symm rfl hzTop' hzTop
    calc
      f (connectorChange reference C.rightStart) = explicitTop := by
        unfold explicitTop
        unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
        apply congrArg f
        rw [show C.rightStart =
          (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
            i l 0 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).cast rfl
              (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel) by rfl]
        exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
          hzTop' href (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel)
      _ = D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          z i l 0 0 (D.label i l) rfl hzTop := hactual
      _ = D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          z i l 0 0 hzTop := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryOpenCoverDualPath_localElements_pushout_rebase
statement:
theorem binaryOpenCoverDualPath_localElements_pushout_rebase
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V)) {z w : X} {b c : Bool}
    (q : Path z w) (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (hne : b ≠ c)
    (bStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hb 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b))
    (bEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hb 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b))
    (cStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hc 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c))
    (cEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hc 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c)) :
    let CB := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hb bStart bEnd
    let CC := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hc cStart cEnd
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.rightElement :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.startChange)⁻¹ *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.startChange)
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.endChange)⁻¹ *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.endChange)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.rightElement)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let CB := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    q hb hc hne hb bStart bEnd
  let CC := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
    q hb hc hne hc cStart cEnd
  let fB := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) b)
  let fC := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) c)
  have hB := congrArg fB
    (binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_relation hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hb bStart bEnd)
  have hC := congrArg fC
    (binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_relation hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hc cStart cEnd)
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv] at hB hC
  have hcommon := binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElements_pushout_eq
    hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne
  exact edgeElements_eq_rebaseEdge_of_change_relations
    (fB CB.endChange) (fB CB.startChange)
    (fB (binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne b))
    (fB CB.rightElement)
    (fC CC.endChange) (fC CC.startChange)
    (fC (binaryOpenCoverDualPathPieceElement hxU hxV hUV q hb hc hne c))
    (fC CC.rightElement) hB hC hcommon

      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))

      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let firstBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩

      letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos firstBlock
    let lastBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length :=
      ⟨letters.reverse.length - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let lastLength := pathConcatSegmentGridLength
      letters.reverse.length A.factor lastBlock

      letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos lastBlock
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock ⟨0, firstLengthPos⟩
    edgeChainEnd start
        (A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock
          (finLastOfPos lastLength lastLengthPos)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
  exact edgeChainEnd_ofFn_of_pos _ hn _ _ _

theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryGlobalCombinedFrames_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let firstBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let firstLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
      letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos firstBlock
    let firstEdge : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength
      letters.reverse.length A.factor firstBlock) := ⟨0, firstLengthPos⟩
    let lastBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length :=
      ⟨letters.reverse.length - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let lastLength := pathConcatSegmentGridLength
      letters.reverse.length A.factor lastBlock
    let lastLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
      letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos lastBlock
    let lastEdge := finLastOfPos lastLength lastLengthPos
    A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge =
      A.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let firstBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let firstLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
    letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos firstBlock
  let firstEdge : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength
      letters.reverse.length A.factor firstBlock) := ⟨0, firstLengthPos⟩
  let lastBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length :=
    ⟨letters.reverse.length - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let lastLength := pathConcatSegmentGridLength
    letters.reverse.length A.factor lastBlock
  let lastLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
    letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos lastBlock
  let lastEdge := finLastOfPos lastLength lastLengthPos
  let first : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let last : Fin A.subdivision.steps :=
    ⟨A.subdivision.steps - 1,
      Nat.sub_lt A.subdivision.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let z₀ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionBasepoint hxU hxV
  have hfirstRow : A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge = first := by
    exact A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_first hn
  have hlastRow : A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge = last := by
    exact A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_last hn
  have hfirstFrame := congrArg (fun row : Fin A.subdivision.steps =>
      (A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt first).bottomLeft) hfirstRow
  have hlastFrame := congrArg (fun row : Fin A.subdivision.steps =>
      (A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV row.val row.isLt first).topLeft) hlastRow
  have hfirstVertex := A.leftBoundaryBlockFirstVertex_eq_basepoint
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock
  have hlastVertex := A.leftBoundaryBlockLastVertex_eq_basepoint
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock
  have hfirstCell : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label first (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge)) z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge).castSucc,
        by simpa [first, firstBlock, firstEdge] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge 0⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hfirstVertex
  have hlastCell : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label first (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge)) z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge).succ,
        by simpa [first, lastBlock, lastEdge] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge 1⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hlastVertex
  have hfirstLetter : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (letters.reverse.get firstBlock).1 z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge).castSucc,
        by simpa [firstBlock, firstEdge] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge 0⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hfirstVertex
  have hlastLetter : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (letters.reverse.get lastBlock).1 z₀ =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge).succ,
        by simpa [lastBlock, lastEdge] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge 1⟩ := by
    apply binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece_basepoint_eq_of_coe hxU hxV
    exact hlastVertex
  let hbottom := A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece_bottom_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV first 0
  let htop := A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece_top_eq_basepoint
    Fhom hxU hxV first 0
  have hfirstGrid : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label first (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge)) z₀ =
      A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece first
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge) 0 0 := by
    rw [hfirstRow]
    exact A.subdivision.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
      hxU hxV first first 0 0 hbottom
  have hlastGrid : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
      (A.subdivision.label first (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge)) z₀ =
      A.subdivision.gridCellVertexInPiece first
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge) 0 1 := by
    rw [hlastRow]
    exact A.subdivision.intersectionBasepoint_eq_gridCellVertexInPiece_of_eq_basepoint
      hxU hxV first last 0 1 htop
  have hfirstTransition :=
    A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_eq_intersectionPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge z₀
        hfirstCell hfirstLetter
  dsimp only at hfirstTransition
  rw [A.leftBoundaryCellStartPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge z₀
      hfirstCell hfirstGrid] at hfirstTransition
  have hlastTransition :=
    A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_eq_intersectionPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge z₀
        hlastCell hlastLetter
  dsimp only at hlastTransition
  rw [A.leftBoundaryCellEndPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge z₀
      hlastCell hlastGrid] at hlastTransition
  have htarget :=
    binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_basepoint_eq_of_coe
      hxU hxV hUV
      (letters.reverse.get firstBlock).1 (letters.reverse.get lastBlock).1
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex firstBlock firstEdge).castSucc,
        by simpa [firstBlock, firstEdge] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge 0⟩
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0
            (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex lastBlock lastEdge).succ,
        by simpa [lastBlock, lastEdge] using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge 1⟩
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock firstEdge)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock lastEdge)
      (A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockFirstLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock)
      (A.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLastLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom lastBlock)
      hfirstLetter hlastLetter
  have hnormalized := A.subdivision.leftResidualGauge_bottom_eq_top
    Fhom hxU hxV hUV hU hV
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
    PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCombinedEndFrame
  dsimp only
  rw [hfirstTransition, hlastTransition]
  apply combinedFrame_eq_of_target_and_normalized
  · exact htarget
  · simp only [hfirstRow, hlastRow]
    rw [hfirstFrame, hlastFrame]
    unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasepointPotential at hnormalized
    simpa [first, last, z₀] using hnormalized

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.letterWord_eq_one_of_homotopy_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.letterWord_eq_one_of_homotopy_of_nonempty
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters = 1
proof:
:= by
  let firstBlock : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let firstLengthPos := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
    letters.reverse.length A.factor A.factor_pos firstBlock
  let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom firstBlock ⟨0, firstLengthPos⟩
  let chain := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom
  have hrebased := A.rebasedLetterWord_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn
  dsimp only at hrebased
  have hend := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain_end
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn
  dsimp only at hend
  have hframes := A.leftBoundaryGlobalCombinedFrames_eq
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn
  dsimp only at hframes
  change rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
      (binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters) = 1 at hrebased
  rw [hend, ← hframes] at hrebased
  have hconjugated := congrArg (fun g =>
      start * g * start⁻¹) hrebased
  dsimp only [start, firstBlock, firstLengthPos] at hconjugated
  simpa [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc] using hconjugated

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concat_range_subset
statement:
theorem Path.concat_range_subset
    {n : ℕ} (vertices : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (pieces : (i : Fin n) → Path (vertices i.castSucc) (vertices i.succ))
    {S : Set X} (hvertices : ∀ i, vertices i ∈ S)
    (hpieces : ∀ i, Set.range (pieces i) ⊆ S) :
    Set.range (Path.concat vertices pieces) ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa using hvertices 0
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Path.concat_succ]
      have hu := Set.union_subset
        (ih (vertices ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i ↦ pieces i.castSucc)
          (fun i ↦ hvertices i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ hpieces i.castSucc))
        (hpieces (Fin.last n))
      simpa only [Path.trans_range] using hu

      ∃ F : unitInterval × unitInterval → X, Continuous F ∧
        (∀ s, F (0, s) = p s) ∧

        (∀ t, F (t, 1) = y)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_homotopy_iff_exists_continuous_deformation
statement:
theorem nonempty_homotopy_iff_exists_continuous_deformation
    {f g : C(X, Y)} :
    Nonempty (f.Homotopy g) ↔
      ∃ F : unitInterval × X → Y, Continuous F ∧
        (∀ x, F (0, x) = f x) ∧
        (∀ x, F (1, x) = g x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨H⟩
    exact ⟨H, H.continuous, H.apply_zero, H.apply_one⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF, hzero, hone⟩
    exact ⟨{
      toFun := F
      continuous_toFun := hF
      map_zero_left := hzero
      map_one_left := hone
    }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.nonempty_homotopyRel_iff_exists_continuous_deformation_fixed_on
statement:
theorem nonempty_homotopyRel_iff_exists_continuous_deformation_fixed_on
    {f g : C(X, Y)} {S : Set X} :
    Nonempty (f.HomotopyRel g S) ↔
      ∃ F : unitInterval × X → Y, Continuous F ∧
        (∀ x, F (0, x) = f x) ∧
        (∀ x, F (1, x) = g x) ∧
        (∀ t x, x ∈ S → F (t, x) = f x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨H⟩
    exact ⟨H, H.continuous, H.apply_zero, H.apply_one, fun t x hx ↦ H.eq_fst t hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF, hzero, hone, hfixed⟩
    exact ⟨{
      toHomotopy := {
        toFun := F
        continuous_toFun := hF
        map_zero_left := hzero
        map_one_left := hone
      }
      prop' := hfixed
    }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.circleWindingHom_eq_iff_lift_endpoint
statement:
theorem circleWindingHom_eq_iff_lift_endpoint (g : Path (1 : Circle) 1) (n : ℤ) :
    circleWindingHom (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk g)) =
        Multiplicative.ofAdd n ↔
      circleLoopLift g 1 = n • (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  change mulOppositeDeckEquivInt
      (Circle.isAddQuotientCoveringMap_exp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite
        circleExpBasepoint (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk g))) = _ ↔ _
  let core := Circle.isAddQuotientCoveringMap_exp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite
    circleExpBasepoint (FundamentalGroup.fromPath (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk g))
  have hdeck :
      ((mulOppositeDeckEquivInt.symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd n)).unop.toAdd : ℝ) =
        n • (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcore : core = mulOppositeDeckEquivInt.symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) := by
      apply mulOppositeDeckEquivInt.injective
      simpa [core] using h
    have hm :=
      (Circle.isAddQuotientCoveringMap_exp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite_apply_eq_Iff).mp hcore
    change ((mulOppositeDeckEquivInt.symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd n)).unop.toAdd : ℝ) + 0 =
      circleLoopLift g 1 at hm
    simpa [hdeck] using hm.symm
  · intro h
    have hm :
        ((mulOppositeDeckEquivInt.symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd n)).unop.toAdd : ℝ) + 0 =
          circleLoopLift g 1 := by simpa [hdeck] using h.symm
    have hcore : core = mulOppositeDeckEquivInt.symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) :=
      (Circle.isAddQuotientCoveringMap_exp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite_apply_eq_Iff).mpr hm
    simpa [core] using congr_arg mulOppositeDeckEquivInt hcore

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.combinedLeftBoundaryFrames_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.combinedLeftBoundaryFrames_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hshared : s.succ = t.castSucc) :
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
    let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
    let lowerF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val lower.isLt col
    let upperF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV upper.val upper.isLt col
    lowerT.endChange * lowerF.topLeft =
      upperT.startChange * upperF.bottomLeft
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s
  let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i t
  let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc i s t hshared
  have hval : lower.val + 1 = upper.val := congrArg Fin.val hrows
  have hp : lower.val + 1 < A.subdivision.steps := by
    rw [hval]
    exact upper.isLt
  let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows
  let lowerT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
  let upperT := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i t
  let lowerF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val lower.isLt col
  let upperF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV upper.val upper.isLt col
  have htransition := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_adjacent
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s t hshared
  have hf := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val hp col
  have hleft := hf.left
  have hframe : upperF.bottomLeft = vertical.startChange * lowerF.topLeft := by
    simpa [vertical, lowerF, upperF, hval] using hleft
  calc
    lowerT.endChange * lowerF.topLeft =
        (upperT.startChange * vertical.startChange) * lowerF.topLeft := by
      rw [htransition]
    _ = upperT.startChange * (vertical.startChange * lowerF.topLeft) := by
      rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = upperT.startChange * upperF.bottomLeft := by rw [← hframe]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
statement:
theorem pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i j : Fin n)
    (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk j
    (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i (finLastOfPos Li hi)).succ =
      (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k j ⟨0, hj⟩).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i
  let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i
  let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk j
  let si := finLastOfPos Li hi
  have hsi : si.succ = Fin.last Li := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [si, finLastOfPos]
    omega
  calc
    (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i si).succ =
        pathConcatSegmentGridIndex n k i si.succ :=
      pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_succ n k i si
    _ = pathConcatSegmentGridIndex n k i (Fin.last Li) := by rw [hsi]
    _ = pathConcatBreakpointGridIndex n k i.succ :=
      pathConcatSegmentGridIndex_last n k i
    _ = pathConcatBreakpointGridIndex n k j.castSucc := by rw [hshared]
    _ = pathConcatSegmentGridIndex n k j 0 :=
      (pathConcatSegmentGridIndex_zero n k j).symm
    _ = (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k j ⟨0, hj⟩).castSucc :=
      (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_castSucc n k j ⟨0, hj⟩).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X} {n : ℕ}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision H U V n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n A.factor A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n A.factor A.factor_pos j
    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos Li hi)).succ =
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j ⟨0, hj⟩).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  apply Fin.ext
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex
  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_cast]
  exact congrArg Fin.val
    (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent
      n A.factor A.factor_pos i j hshared)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredBlockFrames_adjacent
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rightAnchoredBlockFrames_adjacent
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (hshared : i.succ = j.castSucc) :
    let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos Li hi)
    let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j ⟨0, hj⟩
    let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper
        (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared)
    let lowerF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val lower.isLt col
    let upperF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV upper.val upper.isLt col
    upperF.bottomLeft = vertical.startChange * lowerF.topLeft
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let Li := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
  let hi := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
    A.factor_pos i
  let hj := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
    A.factor_pos j
  let col : Fin A.subdivision.steps := ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
  let lower := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos Li hi)
  let upper := A.segmentGridEdgeIndex j ⟨0, hj⟩
  let hrows : lower.succ = upper.castSucc :=
    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex_block_adjacent i j hshared
  have hval : lower.val + 1 = upper.val := congrArg Fin.val hrows
  have hp : lower.val + 1 < A.subdivision.steps := by
    rw [hval]
    exact upper.isLt
  let vertical := A.subdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV col lower upper hrows
  let lowerF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val lower.isLt col
  let upperF := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV upper.val upper.isLt col
  have hf := A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridRowFramesAt_vertical_compatible
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV lower.val hp col
  have hleft := hf.left
  simpa [vertical, lowerF, upperF, hval] using hleft

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions_start_eq_comparisonPotentials
statement:
private theorem verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions_start_eq_comparisonPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    let CB := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch
    let CT := D.verticalSwitchTopConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch
    let T := D.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch
    T.startChange = transitionFromPotentials
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CB.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l) CT.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  simp [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions,
    transitionFromPotentials]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
statement:
private theorem verticalCommonEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l) (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hzBottom : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 1 1)
    (hzTop : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i l) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i l 1 0) :
    let T := D.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hshared hlabel
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 1 1 hzBottom)
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 1 0 hzTop)
proof:
:= by
  let C := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
    i j l hshared hlabel
  let f := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
    (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j) :
    FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j))
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have hzTop' : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel i l 1 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel]
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] using
      congrArg Subtype.val hzTop
  have href : C.edgeTarget =
      binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z :=
    (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel).trans
      hzBottom.symm
  let reference :=
    (binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j) z).cast
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j)) href
  change (f C.endChange)⁻¹ = _
  rw [C.map_endChange_inv_eq_potentials f reference]
  congr 1
  · unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
    change f (connectorChange reference C.leftEnd) =
      f (connectorChange
        ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hUV
          (D.label i j) z).cast
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
            hzBottom.symm)
        (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 1))
    apply congrArg f
    rw [show C.leftEnd =
      (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1 1).cast rfl
        (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel) by rfl]
    exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
      hzBottom href (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel)
  · let explicitTop := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 1 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm hzTop'
    have hactual := D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel_eq
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 1 0
      (D.label i j) (D.label i l) hlabel.symm rfl hzTop' hzTop
    calc
      f (connectorChange reference C.rightEnd) = explicitTop := by
        unfold explicitTop
        unfold BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel
        apply congrArg f
        rw [show C.rightEnd =
          (D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
            i l 1 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).cast rfl
              (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_top
                i j l hshared hlabel) by rfl]
        exact connectorChange_cast_four_endpoints_right _ _
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint_eq_intersectionToPiece hxU hxV (D.label i j))
          hzTop' href (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel)
      _ = D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersectionOfLabel hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          z i l 1 0 (D.label i l) rfl hzTop := hactual
      _ = D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 1 0 hzTop := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottom_endPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
statement:
private theorem verticalSwitchBottom_endPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 1 1) :
    let C := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.endChange :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 1 1 hz
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [D.verticalSwitchBottom_endPotential_eq_vertexPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch,
    D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_vertexPotential]
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j)
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hs := congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_target_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
    have hzval := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    simp only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel] at hs
    simp only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] at hzval
    exact hs.trans hzval.symm
  · apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j)
      (⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.succ j.succ, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_one] using
          D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i j l hshared hswitch 1⟩ :
        ↥(U ∩ V)) : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) : X) =
      (D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 1 1 : X)
    have hs := congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_target_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel] using hs

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTop_endPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
statement:

    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
statement:
theorem verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)

theorem horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hzLeft : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 1 1)
    (hzRight : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label k j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece k j 0 1) :
    let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 1 1 hzLeft)
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z k j 0 1 hzRight)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlabel : D.label i j = D.label k j
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_pos hlabel]
    exact D.horizontalCommonEdgeTransitions_end_eq_gridCellPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hlabel z hzLeft hzRight
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_neg hlabel]
    dsimp only
    rw [D.horizontalSwitchEdgeTransitions_end_eq_comparisonPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hlabel]
    rw [D.horizontalSwitchLeft_endPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hlabel z hzLeft,
      D.horizontalSwitchRight_endPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared hlabel z hzRight]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchBottom_startPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
statement:
private theorem verticalSwitchBottom_startPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l)
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hz : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 0 1) :
    let C := D.verticalSwitchBottomConnectorComparison
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch
    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.startChange :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 0 1 hz
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [D.verticalSwitchBottom_startPotential_eq_vertexPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch,
    D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_vertexPotential]
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    hxU hxV hUV (D.label i j)
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hs := congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
    have hzval := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    simp only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel] at hs
    simp only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] at hzval
    exact hs.trans hzval.symm
  · apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j)
      (⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc j.succ, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
          D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i j l hshared hswitch 0⟩ :
        ↥(U ∩ V)) : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) : X) =
      (D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 0 1 : X)
    have hs := congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.verticalSwitchEdge_bottom_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel] using hs

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchTop_startPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
statement:
private theorem verticalSwitchTop_startPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))

    ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l) C.startChange :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) =
      D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 0 0 hz
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [D.verticalSwitchTop_startPotential_eq_vertexPotential
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hswitch,
    D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection_eq_vertexPotential]
  apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
    hxU hxV hUV (D.label i l)
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hs := congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.verticalSwitchEdge_top_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
    have hzval := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    simp only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
