    simp only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] at hzval
    exact hs.trans hzval.symm
  · apply Path.ext
    funext u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change ((binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i l)
      (⟨squareGridVertex H D.steps D.steps_pos i.castSucc j.succ, by
        simpa [squareGridVertex, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] using
          D.verticalSwitchEdge_mem_intersection i j l hshared hswitch 0⟩ :
        ↥(U ∩ V)) : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i l)) : X) =
      (D.gridCellVertexInPiece i l 0 0 : X)
    have hs := congrArg Subtype.val
      (D.verticalSwitchEdge_top_source_eq i j l hshared hswitch)
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece,
      D.coe_gridCellVertexInPieceOfLabel] using hs

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
statement:
theorem verticalInternalEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hzBottom : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i j) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i j 0 1)
    (hzTop : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V (D.label i l) z =
      D.gridCellVertexInPiece i l 0 0) :
    let T := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared
    T.startChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i j 0 1 hzBottom)
      (D.gridCellVertexPotentialFromIntersection
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV z i l 0 0 hzTop)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_pos hlabel]
    exact D.verticalCommonEdgeTransitions_start_eq_gridCellPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hlabel z hzBottom hzTop
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_neg hlabel]
    dsimp only
    rw [D.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions_start_eq_comparisonPotentials
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hlabel]
    rw [D.verticalSwitchBottom_startPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hlabel z hzBottom,
      D.verticalSwitchTop_startPotential_eq_gridCellPotential
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hshared hlabel z hzTop]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLastLetterEnd
statement:
@[simp] theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.coe_leftBoundaryBlockLastLetterEnd
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) (u : unitInterval) :
    let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i
    ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i (finLastOfPos L hL)) u : X) = x₀
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i
  let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
    A.factor_pos i
  let s := finLastOfPos L hL
  have hs : s.succ = Fin.last L := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [s, finLastOfPos]
    omega
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
  rw [Path.cast_coe, hs, binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector_last,
    Path.cast_coe]
  cases h : (letters.reverse.get i).1 <;> rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.coe_leftBoundaryBlockFirstLetterStart
statement:
@[simp] theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.coe_leftBoundaryBlockFirstLetterStart
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (j : Fin letters.reverse.length) (u : unitInterval) :
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j
    ((A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom j ⟨0, hL⟩) u : X) = x₀
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hz : (⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos j⟩ : Fin
        (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor j)).castSucc =
      (0 : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor j + 1)) := rfl
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
  rw [Path.cast_coe, hz, binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector_zero,
    Path.cast_coe]
  cases h : (letters.reverse.get j).1 <;> rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_nat_pos_multiple_inv_lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkmesh⟩ := Real.exists_nat_pos_inv_lt hδ
  refine ⟨m * k, Nat.mul_pos hm hk, ⟨k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have hk_le : k ≤ m * k := by
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left k hm
  calc
    ((m * k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (k : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (by exact_mod_cast hk) (by exact_mod_cast hk_le)
    _ < δ := hkmesh

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.dist_convexComb_left_le_for_multiple_grid
statement:
private theorem dist_convexComb_left_le_for_multiple_grid (a b u : unitInterval) :
    dist (Set.Icc.convexComb a b u) a ≤ dist b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  change
    |((1 - (u : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) - (a : ℝ)| ≤
      |(b : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)|
  rw [show ((1 - (u : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) - (a : ℝ) =
      (u : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) by ring, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg u.2.1]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) u.2.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_steps_multiple
statement:
theorem exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_steps_multiple
    (H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)) {U V : Set X}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hH : ∀ z, H z ∈ U ∨ H z ∈ V)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V, m ∣ D.steps
proof:
:= by
  let C : Bool → Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)
    | false => H ⁻¹' U
    | true => H ⁻¹' V
  have hCopen : ∀ b, IsOpen (C b) := by
    intro b
    cases b
    · exact hU.preimage H.continuous
    · exact hV.preimage H.continuous
  have hCcover : (Set.univ : Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)) ⊆ ⋃ b, C b := by
    intro z _
    rcases hH z with hz | hz
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨false, hz⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨true, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ :=
    lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric
      (s := (Set.univ : Set (unitInterval × unitInterval)))
      isCompact_univ hCopen hCcover
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hmN, hmesh⟩ :=
    exists_nat_pos_multiple_inv_lt m hm hδ
  have hchoice : ∀ i j : Fin N, ∃ b : Bool,
      Metric.ball
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc,
          unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) δ ⊆ C b := by
    intro i j
    exact hball _ (Set.mem_univ _)
  let label : Fin N → Fin N → Bool := fun i j => Classical.choose (hchoice i j)
  let D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V := {
    steps := N
    steps_pos := hN
    label := label
    cell_mem := by
      intro i j u v
      have hx : dist
          (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc)
            (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ) u)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) < δ := by
        calc
          _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ)
              (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc) :=
            dist_convexComb_left_le_for_multiple_grid _ _ _
          _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
            rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
          _ < δ := hmesh
      have hy : dist
          (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc)
            (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.succ) v)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) < δ := by
        calc
          _ ≤ dist (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.succ)
              (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) :=
            dist_convexComb_left_le_for_multiple_grid _ _ _
          _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
            rw [dist_comm, dist_unitIntervalMeshPoint_castSucc_succ]
          _ < δ := hmesh
      have hdist : dist
          (unitSquareCellPoint N hN i j u v)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc,
            unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN j.castSucc) < δ := by
        simpa [unitSquareCellPoint, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] using And.intro hx hy
      have hmem := Classical.choose_spec (hchoice i j)
        (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist)
      cases hlabel : label i j <;>
        simpa [label, C, binaryOpenCoverPiece, hlabel] using hmem }
  exact ⟨D, hmN⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatDyadicScale_pos
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathConcatDyadicScale_pos (n : ℕ) :
    0 < pathConcatDyadicScale n
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathConcatDyadicScale]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_concat_multiple
statement:
theorem exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_concat_multiple
    (H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)) {U V : Set X}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hH : ∀ z, H z ∈ U ∨ H z ∈ V) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V,
      pathConcatDyadicScale n ∣ D.steps
proof:
:=
  exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_steps_multiple H hU hV hH
    (pathConcatDyadicScale n) (pathConcatDyadicScale_pos n)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_zero
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_zero (n : ℕ) :
    pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold pathConcatBreakpointNumerator
      rw [show (0 : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) = (0 : Fin (n + 1)).castSucc by rfl]
      rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
      exact ih

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_last (n : ℕ) :
    pathConcatBreakpointNumerator (n + 1) (Fin.last (n + 1)) =
      pathConcatDyadicScale (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    pathConcatBreakpointNumerator (n + 1) i.castSucc =
      pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_le_scale
statement:
theorem pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_le_scale :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
      pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale n
proof:
| 0, i => by simp [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator, pathConcatDyadicScale]
  | n + 1, i => by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp
      · rw [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc]
        calc
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n j ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale n :=
            pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_le_scale n j
          _ ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale (n + 1) := by
            simp [pathConcatDyadicScale, pow_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_strictMonoAdjacent
statement:
theorem pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_strictMonoAdjacent :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n),
      pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i.castSucc <
        pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i.succ
proof:
| 0, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | n + 1, i => by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc, Fin.succ_last,
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_last]
        calc
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n (Fin.last n) ≤ pathConcatDyadicScale n :=
            pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_le_scale n (Fin.last n)
          _ < pathConcatDyadicScale (n + 1) := by
            simp [pathConcatDyadicScale, pow_succ]
      · rw [Fin.succ_castSucc, pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc,
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc]
        exact pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_strictMonoAdjacent n j

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpoint_zero
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pathConcatBreakpoint_zero :
    pathConcatBreakpoint 0 (0 : Fin 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [pathConcatBreakpoint, pathConcatBreakpointNumerator,
    pathConcatDyadicScale]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpoint_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathConcatBreakpoint_last (n : ℕ) :
    pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 1) (Fin.last (n + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [pathConcatBreakpoint, ne_of_gt (pathConcatDyadicScale_pos (n + 1))]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 1) i.castSucc =
      unitIntervalHalf (pathConcatBreakpoint n i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [pathConcatBreakpoint, pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_castSucc,
    unitIntervalHalf]
  change (pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i : ℝ) /
      (pathConcatDyadicScale (n + 1) : ℝ) =
    ((pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i : ℝ) /
      (pathConcatDyadicScale n : ℝ)) / 2
  rw [show pathConcatDyadicScale (n + 1) = 2 * pathConcatDyadicScale n by
    simp [pathConcatDyadicScale, pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]]
  have hs0 : (pathConcatDyadicScale n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (pathConcatDyadicScale_pos n))
  field_simp
  push_cast
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_zero_midpoint_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_zero_midpoint_apply
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b c : Y}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) (t : unitInterval) :
    (p.trans q).subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint t = p t
proof:
:= by
  change (p.trans q) (Set.Icc.convexComb 0 unitIntervalMidpoint t) = p t
  rw [Path.trans_apply, dif_pos]
  · congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalMidpoint]
    ring
  · simp [unitIntervalMidpoint]
    linarith [t.2.2]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_midpoint_one_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_midpoint_one_apply
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b c : Y}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) (t : unitInterval) :
    (p.trans q).subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1 t = q t
proof:
:= by
  change (p.trans q) (Set.Icc.convexComb unitIntervalMidpoint 1 t) = q t
  rw [Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · have ht : (t : ℝ) = 0 := by
      simp [Set.Icc.convexComb, unitIntervalMidpoint] at h
      linarith [t.2.1]
    have ht' : t = 0 := Subtype.ext ht
    subst t
    simp [unitIntervalMidpoint, p.target, q.source]
  · congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalMidpoint]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_zero_midpoint
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_zero_midpoint
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b c : Y}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) :
    ((p.trans q).subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).cast
        (by simp)
        (by simp [unitIntervalMidpoint, Path.trans_apply, p.target]) = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  rw [Path.cast_coe]
  exact SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_zero_midpoint_apply p q t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_midpoint_one
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_midpoint_one
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b c : Y}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) :
    ((p.trans q).subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1).cast
        (by simp [unitIntervalMidpoint, Path.trans_apply, p.target])
        (by simp) = q
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  rw [Path.cast_coe]
  exact SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_midpoint_one_apply p q t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_half_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_subpath_half_apply
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b c : Y}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) (s t u : unitInterval) :
    (p.trans q).subpath (unitIntervalHalf s) (unitIntervalHalf t) u =
      p.subpath s t u
proof:
:= by
  change (p.trans q)
      (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalHalf s) (unitIntervalHalf t) u) =
    p (Set.Icc.convexComb s t u)
  rw [Path.trans_apply, dif_pos]
  · congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalHalf]
    ring
  · change ((1 - (u : ℝ)) * ((s : ℝ) / 2) +
      (u : ℝ) * ((t : ℝ) / 2)) ≤ 1 / 2
    nlinarith [s.2.1, s.2.2, t.2.1, t.2.2, u.2.1, u.2.2]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_half_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.trans_half_apply
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b c : Y}
    (p : Path a b) (q : Path b c) (t : unitInterval) :
    (p.trans q) (unitIntervalHalf t) = p t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.trans_apply, dif_pos]
  · congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalHalf]
    ring
  · change (t : ℝ) / 2 ≤ 1 / 2
    linarith [t.2.2]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concat_breakpoint_apply
statement:
theorem Path.concat_breakpoint_apply
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
      (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
      (r : Fin (n + 1)),
      Path.concat p F (pathConcatBreakpoint n r) = p r
proof:
| 0, p, F, r => by
      have hr : r = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; omega
      subst r
      simp [Path.concat_zero, pathConcatBreakpoint_zero]
  | n + 1, p, F, r => by
      rw [Path.concat_succ]
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) r
      · rw [pathConcatBreakpoint_last]
        simp
      · rw [pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc]
        exact (SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_half_apply
          (Path.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => F i.castSucc))
          (F (Fin.last n)) (pathConcatBreakpoint n j)).trans
            (Path.concat_breakpoint_apply
              (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => F i.castSucc) j)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_eq_concat
statement:
private theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_eq_concat
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : Fin 2 → Y) (F : (i : Fin 1) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    Path.concatDyadicSegment p F 0 = Path.concat p F
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : pathConcatBreakpoint 1 (0 : Fin 2) = 0 := by
    rw [show (0 : Fin 2) = (0 : Fin 1).castSucc by rfl,
      pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc, pathConcatBreakpoint_zero]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalHalf]
  have hone : pathConcatBreakpoint 1 (1 : Fin 2) = 1 :=
    pathConcatBreakpoint_last 0
  have hzero' : pathConcatBreakpoint 1 (Fin.castSucc (0 : Fin 1)) = 0 := by
    simpa using hzero
  have hone' : pathConcatBreakpoint 1 (Fin.succ (0 : Fin 1)) = 1 := by
    simpa using hone
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  unfold Path.concatDyadicSegment
  rw [Path.cast_coe]
  change Path.concat p F
    (Set.Icc.convexComb
      (pathConcatBreakpoint 1 (Fin.castSucc (0 : Fin 1)))
      (pathConcatBreakpoint 1 (Fin.succ (0 : Fin 1))) t) = _
  rw [hzero', hone']
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_homotopic
statement:
private theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_homotopic
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : Fin 2 → Y) (F : (i : Fin 1) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    (Path.concatDyadicSegment p F 0).Homotopic (F 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_eq_concat]
  exact Path.Homotopic.concat_one p F

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_last_eq
statement:
private theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_last_eq
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (n : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (n + 2 + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin (n + 2)) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    Path.concatDyadicSegment p F (Fin.last (n + 1)) = F (Fin.last (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  unfold Path.concatDyadicSegment
  rw [Path.cast_coe, Path.concat_succ]
  have hleft : pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) (Fin.last (n + 1)).castSucc =
      unitIntervalMidpoint := by
    rw [pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc,
      pathConcatBreakpoint_last n]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalHalf, unitIntervalMidpoint]
  have hright : pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) (Fin.last (n + 1)).succ = 1 := by
    rw [show (Fin.last (n + 1)).succ = Fin.last (n + 2) by apply Fin.ext; rfl]
    exact pathConcatBreakpoint_last (n + 1)
  change ((Path.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc)).trans
      (F (Fin.last (n + 1)))).subpath
        (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) (Fin.last (n + 1)).castSucc)
        (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) (Fin.last (n + 1)).succ) t = _
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_midpoint_one_apply
    (Path.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc))
    (F (Fin.last (n + 1))) t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_castSucc_eq
statement:
private theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_castSucc_eq
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (n : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (n + 2 + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin (n + 2)) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i.castSucc =
      Path.concatDyadicSegment (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc) i
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  unfold Path.concatDyadicSegment
  rw [Path.cast_coe, Path.cast_coe, Path.concat_succ]
  have hleft : pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) i.castSucc.castSucc =
      unitIntervalHalf (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 1) i.castSucc) := by
    rw [pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc]
  have hright : pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) i.castSucc.succ =
      unitIntervalHalf (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 1) i.succ) := by
    rw [show i.castSucc.succ = i.succ.castSucc by apply Fin.ext; rfl,
      pathConcatBreakpoint_castSucc]
  change ((Path.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc)).trans
      (F (Fin.last (n + 1)))).subpath
        (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) i.castSucc.castSucc)
        (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 2) i.castSucc.succ) t = _
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.trans_subpath_half_apply
    (Path.concat (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc))
    (F (Fin.last (n + 1)))
    (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 1) i.castSucc)
    (pathConcatBreakpoint (n + 1) i.succ) t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic
statement:
theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
      (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) (i : Fin n),
      (Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i).Homotopic (F i)
proof:
| 0, p, F, i => Fin.elim0 i
  | 1, p, F, i => by
      have hi : i = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; omega
      subst i
      exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_homotopic p F
  | n + 2, p, F, i => by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_last_eq]
      · rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_castSucc_eq]
        exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic
          (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc) j

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_eq_of_ne_zero
proof:
| Y, _, 0, p, F, i, hi => by
      have hizero : i = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; omega
      exact (hi hizero).elim
  | Y, _, n + 1, p, F, i, hi => by
      revert hi
      refine Fin.lastCases (fun _ => ?_) (fun j hi => ?_) i
      · exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_last_eq n p F
      · rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_castSucc_eq]
        apply Path.concatDyadicSegment_eq_of_ne_zero
        intro hj
        apply hi
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [hj]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_eq_of_val_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_eq_of_val_ne_zero
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val ≠ 0) : Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i = F i
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n =>
      apply Path.concatDyadicSegment_eq_of_ne_zero
      intro hizero
      apply hi
      simp [hizero]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_zero_eq_refl_trans
proof:
| Y, _, 0, p, F => by
      rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_eq_concat, Path.concat_succ,
        Path.concat_zero]
      rfl
  | Y, _, n + 1, p, F => by
      rw [show (0 : Fin (n + 2)) = (0 : Fin (n + 1)).castSucc by rfl,
        Path.concatDyadicSegment_castSucc_eq]
      exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_zero_eq_refl_trans
        (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => F i.castSucc)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_zero_eq_refl_trans_of_pos
statement:
private theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_zero_eq_refl_trans_of_pos
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) :
    Path.concatDyadicSegment p F ⟨0, hn⟩ =
      (Path.refl (p (Fin.castSucc ⟨0, hn⟩))).trans (F ⟨0, hn⟩)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_zero_eq_refl_trans p F

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concat_one_mem
statement:
private theorem Path.concat_one_mem
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : Fin 2 → Y) (F : (i : Fin 1) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (S : Set Y) (hF : ∀ t, F 0 t ∈ S) (t : unitInterval) :
    Path.concat p F t ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Path.concat_succ, Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs
  · simpa [Path.concat_zero] using hF 0
  · exact hF _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem
statement:
theorem Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem :
    ∀ {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
      (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
      (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
      (i : Fin n) (S : Set Y),
      (∀ t, F i t ∈ S) → ∀ t, Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i t ∈ S
proof:
| Y, _, 0, p, F, i, S, hF => Fin.elim0 i
  | Y, _, 1, p, F, i, S, hF => by
      have hi : i = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; omega
      subst i
      rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_one_eq_concat]
      exact Path.concat_one_mem p F S hF
  | Y, _, n + 2, p, F, i, S, hF => by
      revert hF
      refine Fin.lastCases (fun hF => ?_) (fun j hF => ?_) i
      · rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_last_eq]
        exact hF
      · rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_castSucc_eq]
        exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem
          (p ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun k => F k.castSucc) j S hF

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop_dyadicSegment_mem_piece
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop_dyadicSegment_mem_piece
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) (t : unitInterval) :
    Path.concatDyadicSegment
        (fun _ : Fin (letters.reverse.length + 1) => x₀)
        (fun j : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
          (letters.reverse.get j).ambientLoop hxU hxV) i t ∈
      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1
proof:
:= by
  exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem
    (fun _ : Fin (letters.reverse.length + 1) => x₀)
    (fun j : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
      (letters.reverse.get j).ambientLoop hxU hxV)
    i (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop_segment_mem hxU hxV letters i) t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.coe_binaryOpenCoverBasepoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_binaryOpenCoverBasepoint
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (b : Bool) :
    ((binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b) : X) = x₀
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece_homotopic_representative
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece_homotopic_representative
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    (binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i).Homotopic
      (fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
        (letters.reverse.get i).2)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Fin (letters.reverse.length + 1) → X := fun _ => x₀
  let F : (j : Fin letters.reverse.length) → Path (p j.castSucc) (p j.succ) :=
    fun j => (letters.reverse.get j).ambientLoop hxU hxV
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · have hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by
      intro hzero
      have : i.val < 0 := by simpa [hzero] using i.isLt
      omega)
    have hizero : i = ⟨0, hn⟩ := by apply Fin.ext; exact hi
    have hpath : binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i =
        (Path.refl (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)).trans
          (fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
            (letters.reverse.get i).2) := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece]
      calc
        Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i t =
            ((Path.refl x₀).trans ((letters.reverse.get i).ambientLoop hxU hxV)) t := by
          rw [hizero, Path.concatDyadicSegment_zero_eq_refl_trans_of_pos hn p F]
        _ = (fun z : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1 => (z : X))
              (((Path.refl (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV
                (letters.reverse.get i).1)).trans
                (fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
                  (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
                  (letters.reverse.get i).2)) t) := by
          rw [Path.trans_apply, Path.trans_apply]
          split_ifs
          · simp
          · exact BinaryVanKampenLetter.ambientLoop_apply
              hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i) _
    rw [hpath]
    exact ⟨Path.Homotopy.reflTrans _⟩
  · have hpath : binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i =
        fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
          (letters.reverse.get i).2 := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece]
      calc
        Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i t =
            (letters.reverse.get i).ambientLoop hxU hxV t := by
          rw [Path.concatDyadicSegment_eq_of_val_ne_zero p F i hi]
        _ = (fun z : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1 => (z : X))
              (fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
                (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
                (letters.reverse.get i).2 t) :=
          BinaryVanKampenLetter.ambientLoop_apply
            hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i) t
    rw [hpath]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge_eq_subpath
statement:
private theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge_eq_subpath
    {x₀ x₁ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₁} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X} {n : ℕ}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V n)
    (i : Fin n) (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i)) :
    A.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge Fhom i s =
      p.subpath
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i s.castSucc)
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i s.succ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  unfold PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge
  rw [Path.cast_coe]
  exact A.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge_apply Fhom i s t

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySegmentGridConcat_homotopic_subpath
statement:
private theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundarySegmentGridConcat_homotopic_subpath
    {x₀ x₁ : X} {p q : Path x₀ x₁} (Fhom : Path.Homotopy p q)
    {U V : Set X} {n : ℕ}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V n)
    (i : Fin n) :
    (A.leftBoundarySegmentGridConcat Fhom i).Homotopic
      (p.subpath
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i 0)
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i
          (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i))))
proof:
:= by
  have hedge : ∀ s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i),
      (A.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge Fhom i s).Homotopic
        (p.subpath
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i s.castSucc)
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i s.succ)) := by
    intro s
    rw [A.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge_eq_subpath Fhom i s]
  exact (Path.Homotopic.concat_hcomp
    (p ∘ pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i)
    (fun s => A.leftBoundarySegmentGridEdge Fhom i s)
    (fun s => p.subpath
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i s.castSucc)
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i s.succ)) hedge).trans
    (Path.concatSegmentMeshSubpaths_homotopic p n A.factor A.factor_pos i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_homotopic
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_homotopic
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (vertices : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (segments : (i : Fin n) → Path (vertices i.castSucc) (vertices i.succ))
    {q : Path (vertices 0) (vertices (Fin.last n))}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy (Path.concat vertices segments) q)
    {U V : Set Y}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V n)
    (i : Fin n) :
    (A.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment vertices segments Fhom i).Homotopic
      (segments i)
proof:
:= by
  let γ := Path.concat vertices segments
  have hblock := A.leftBoundarySegmentGridConcat_homotopic_subpath Fhom i
  have hsource : vertices i.castSucc = γ
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i 0) := by
    rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_zero,
      Path.concat_breakpoint_apply vertices segments i.castSucc]
  have htarget : vertices i.succ = γ
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i
        (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i))) := by
    rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_last,
      Path.concat_breakpoint_apply vertices segments i.succ]
  have hcast := hblock.pathCast hsource htarget
  have hright :
      ((γ.subpath
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i 0)
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i
          (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i)))).cast hsource htarget) =
        Path.concatDyadicSegment vertices segments i := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    change γ (Set.Icc.convexComb
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i 0)
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n A.factor A.factor_pos i
        (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i))) t) =
      γ (Set.Icc.convexComb
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.castSucc)
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.succ) t)
    rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_zero, pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_last]
  have hleft : A.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment vertices segments Fhom i =
      (A.leftBoundarySegmentGridConcat Fhom i).cast hsource htarget := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rfl
  rw [hleft]
  exact hcast.trans (by
    rw [hright]
    exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic vertices segments i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.mk_leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_eq
statement:
private theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.mk_leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_eq
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (vertices : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (segments : (i : Fin n) → Path (vertices i.castSucc) (vertices i.succ))
    {q : Path (vertices 0) (vertices (Fin.last n))}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy (Path.concat vertices segments) q)
    {U V : Set Y}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V n)
    (i : Fin n) :
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
        (A.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment vertices segments Fhom i) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (segments i)
proof:
:= by
  exact Quotient.sound
    (A.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_homotopic vertices segments Fhom i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.correctedLoop_leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_eq
statement:
private theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.correctedLoop_leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_eq
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (vertices : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (segments : (i : Fin n) → Path (vertices i.castSucc) (vertices i.succ))
    {q : Path (vertices 0) (vertices (Fin.last n))}
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy (Path.concat vertices segments) q)
    {U V : Set Y}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V n)
    {y₀ : Y} (i : Fin n)
    (left : Path y₀ (vertices i.castSucc))
    (right : Path y₀ (vertices i.succ)) :
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦Path.correctedLoop left
          (A.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment vertices segments Fhom i) right⟧ =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦Path.correctedLoop left (segments i) right⟧
proof:
:= by
  apply congr_arg FundamentalGroup.fromPath
  apply Quotient.sound
  exact (Path.Homotopic.refl left).hcomp
    ((A.leftBoundaryConcatDyadicSegment_homotopic vertices segments Fhom i).hcomp
      (Path.Homotopic.refl right.symm))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.reverseDfoldl_reverse_get_eq_map_prod
statement:
theorem reverseDfoldl_reverse_get_eq_map_prod
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (value : α → G) (items : List α) :
    Fin.dfoldl items.reverse.length (fun _ => G)
        (fun i acc => value (items.reverse.get i) * acc) 1 =
      (items.map value).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod]
  have hofn : List.ofFn (fun i => value (items.reverse.get i)) =
      items.reverse.map value := by
    simpa only [List.get_eq_getElem] using
      (List.ofFn_getElem_eq_map items.reverse value)
  rw [hofn]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterWord_eq_map_prod
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenLetterWord_eq_map_prod
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV)) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters =
      (letters.map fun letter =>
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of letter.1 letter.2 :
          binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction letters with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons letter rest ih =>
      rcases letter with ⟨b, g⟩
      simp only [binaryVanKampenLetterWord, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
      rw [ih]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.reverseLeftBoundaryLetterBlockChain_eq_word
statement:
private theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.reverseLeftBoundaryLetterBlockChain_eq_word
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length) :
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod,
    binaryVanKampenLetterWord_eq_map_prod]
  simp only [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain,
    List.map_ofFn]
  let value := fun letter : BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV =>
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of letter.1 letter.2 :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have hofn : List.ofFn (fun i => value (letters.reverse.get i)) =
      letters.reverse.map value := by
    simpa only [List.get_eq_getElem] using
      (List.ofFn_getElem_eq_map letters.reverse value)
  change (List.ofFn (fun i => value (letters.reverse.get i))).reverse.prod =
    (letters.map value).prod
  rw [hofn]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseWord
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseWord
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let i₀ : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let hL₀ := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i₀
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i₀ ⟨0, hL₀⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryFramedBlockChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseLetterChain
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn]
  rw [A.reverseLeftBoundaryLetterBlockChain_eq_word
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseWord
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseWord
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let i₀ : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let hL₀ := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i₀
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i₀ ⟨0, hL₀⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom
    reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (A.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdgeChain
          hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom) =
      rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [A.reverseAllFramedCellEdges_eq_framedBlocks
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom]
  exact A.leftBoundaryFramedBlocks_eq_rebaseWord

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rebasedLetterWord_eq_one
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.rebasedLetterWord_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (hn : 0 < letters.reverse.length) :
    let i₀ : Fin letters.reverse.length := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let hL₀ := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length A.factor
      A.factor_pos i₀
    let start := A.leftBoundaryCombinedStartFrame
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i₀ ⟨0, hL₀⟩
    let chain := A.leftBoundaryLetterBlockChain
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom
    rebaseEdge start (edgeChainEnd start chain)
        (binaryVanKampenLetterWord U V hxU hxV letters) = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← A.leftBoundaryAllFramedCellEdges_eq_rebaseWord
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn]
  rw [A.reverseAllFramedCellEdges_eq_gridLeftBoundaryWord
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom hn]
  exact A.subdivision.rightAnchoredGridFullLeftBoundary_eq_one
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.correctedLoop_product
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_product {x₀ z w v : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (first : Path z w) (middle : Path x₀ w)
    (second : Path w v) (right : Path x₀ v) :
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop middle second right⟧ *
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦correctedLoop left first middle⟧ =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦correctedLoop left (first.trans second) right⟧
proof:
:= by
  rw [FundamentalGroup.mul_def]
  unfold FundamentalGroup.fromPath FundamentalGroup.fromArrow
  change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (correctedLoop left first middle))
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (correctedLoop middle second right)) =
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      (correctedLoop left (first.trans second) right)
  unfold correctedLoop
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm]
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc]
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk middle).symm
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk middle)]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.correctedLoopWord_eq_concat
statement:
theorem correctedLoopWord_eq_concat {x₀ : X} {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → X)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (q i.castSucc) (q i.succ))
    (connector : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → Path x₀ (q i)) :
    correctedLoopWord q F connector =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦correctedLoop (connector 0) (Path.concat q F)
          (connector (Fin.last n))⟧
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [correctedLoopWord, Fin.dfoldl_zero, Path.concat_zero]
      rw [FundamentalGroup.one_def]
      unfold correctedLoop FundamentalGroup.fromPath FundamentalGroup.fromArrow
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [correctedLoopWord, Fin.dfoldl_succ_last]
      rw [Path.concat_succ]
      change FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦correctedLoop (connector (Fin.last n).castSucc) (F (Fin.last n))
            (connector (Fin.last (n + 1)))⟧ *
          correctedLoopWord (q ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => F i.castSucc)
            (fun i => connector i.castSucc) = _
      rw [ih]
      exact correctedLoop_product (connector 0)
        (Path.concat (q ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => F i.castSucc))
        (connector (Fin.last n).castSucc) (F (Fin.last n))
        (connector (Fin.last (n + 1)))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex_zero
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :

    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex hxU hxV letters k hk i
        (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)) =

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector_zero
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i 0 =
      (Path.refl (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV
        (letters.reverse.get i).1)).cast rfl
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex_zero hxU hxV letters k hk i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector, dif_pos rfl]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector_last
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i
        (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)) =
      (Path.refl (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV
        (letters.reverse.get i).1)).cast rfl
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex_last hxU hxV letters k hk i)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i) :
      Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at this
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos
      letters.reverse.length k hk i)) this
  rw [binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector, dif_neg hne, dif_pos rfl]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece_eq_subpath
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece_eq_subpath
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters k hk i s =
      (binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i).subpath
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)
          (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length k hk i) s.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)
          (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length k hk i) s.succ)
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdges_concat_homotopic_dyadicSegment
statement:
private theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdges_concat_homotopic_dyadicSegment
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    (Path.concat
      (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex hxU hxV letters k hk i)
      (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters k hk i)).Homotopic
        ((binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i).subpath
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint
            (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)
            (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length k hk i) 0)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint
            (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)
            (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length k hk i)
            (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i))))
proof:
:= by
  let γ := binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i
  let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i
  let hL : 0 < L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos letters.reverse.length k hk i
  let mesh := unitIntervalMeshPoint L hL
  have hedges : ∀ s : Fin L,
      (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters k hk i s).Homotopic
        (γ.subpath (mesh s.castSucc) (mesh s.succ)) := by
    intro s
    rw [binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece_eq_subpath]
    exact Path.Homotopic.refl _
  have hfirst := Path.Homotopic.concat_hcomp
    (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex hxU hxV letters k hk i)
    (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters k hk i)
    (fun s => γ.subpath (mesh s.castSucc) (mesh s.succ)) hedges
  have hsecond := Path.Homotopic.concat_subpath γ mesh
  exact hfirst.trans hsecond

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord_eq_concat
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord_eq_concat
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦Path.correctedLoop
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i 0)
          (Path.concat
            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex hxU hxV letters k hk i)
            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters k hk i))
          (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i
            (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length k i)))⟧
proof:
:= by
  exact Path.correctedLoopWord_eq_concat
    (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridVertex hxU hxV letters k hk i)
    (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters k hk i)
    (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord_eq_letter
statement:
theorem binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord_eq_letter
    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin letters.reverse.length) :
    binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i =
      (letters.reverse.get i).2
proof:
:= by
  let D := binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridSubdivision hxU hxV letters k hk i
  let C := binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridBasedConnectors
    hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i
  let γ := binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece hxU hxV letters i
  have hword := D.correctedLoopWord_eq_loop C
  have hword' : binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord
      hxU hxV hU hV letters k hk i = FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦γ⟧ := by
    unfold binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridWord
    dsimp [D, C, binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridSubdivision,
      binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridBasedConnectors] at hword
    convert hword using 1 <;> rfl
  rw [hword']
  have hhom := binaryVanKampenLetterDyadicSegmentInPiece_homotopic_representative
    hxU hxV letters i
  have hmk : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
        (fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
          (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
          (letters.reverse.get i).2) := Quotient.sound hhom
  calc
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦γ⟧ =
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (letters.reverse.get i).1)
            (letters.reverse.get i).2⟧ :=
      congrArg FundamentalGroup.fromPath hmk
    _ = (letters.reverse.get i).2 :=
      fundamentalGroupPathRepresentative_mk _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_change_connectors
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_change_connectors {x₀ z w : X}
    (left left' : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right right' : Path x₀ w) :
    (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦Path.correctedLoop right' (Path.refl w) right⟧)⁻¹ *
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop left segment right⟧ *
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop left' (Path.refl z) left⟧ =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop left' segment right'⟧
proof:
:= by
  rw [← correctedLoop_reverse_eq_inv right' (Path.refl w) right]
  rw [Path.correctedLoop_product, Path.correctedLoop_product]
  unfold Path.correctedLoop FundamentalGroup.fromPath FundamentalGroup.fromArrow
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_cast
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_cast {x₀ z w z' w' : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w)
    (hz : z' = z) (hw : w' = w) :
    Path.correctedLoop (left.cast rfl hz) (segment.cast hz hw) (right.cast rfl hw) =
      Path.correctedLoop left segment right
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  unfold Path.correctedLoop
  funext t
  simp only [Path.trans_apply, Path.symm_apply]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.correctedLoop_cast_proof_irrel
statement:
theorem correctedLoop_cast_proof_irrel {x₀ z w z' w' : X}
    (left : Path x₀ z) (segment : Path z w) (right : Path x₀ w)
    (hzLeft hzSegment : z' = z) (hwSegment hwRight : w' = w) :
    Path.correctedLoop (left.cast rfl hzLeft) (segment.cast hzSegment hwSegment)
        (right.cast rfl hwRight) =
      Path.correctedLoop left segment right
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim hzLeft hzSegment, Subsingleton.elim hwRight hwSegment]
  exact correctedLoop_cast left segment right hzSegment hwSegment

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdge_eq_bottomCellEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdge_eq_bottomCellEdge
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l) :
    D.verticalCommonEdgeInPiece i j l hshared hlabel =
      (((squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
        1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous).cast
          (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel)
          (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel))
proof:
:= by
  let q := (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous
  let hs := D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel
  let ht := D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel
  apply Path.ext
  calc
    (D.verticalCommonEdgeInPiece i j l hshared hlabel :
        unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) =
        (q : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) := by
      funext t
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hone : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
        simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
      have hqt : q t = D.gridCellMapInPiece i j
          (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
            1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1 t) := by
        rfl
      rw [D.coe_verticalCommonEdgeInPiece]
      rw [hqt]
      simp [squareGridHorizontalEdge,
        BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellMapInPiece,
        unitSquareCellPoint, hone]
      rfl
    _ = (q.cast hs ht : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
      (Path.cast_coe q hs ht).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdge_eq_topCellEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdge_eq_topCellEdge
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l) :
    D.verticalCommonEdgeInPiece i j l hshared hlabel =
      (((squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
        1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map
          (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel i l (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).continuous).cast
          ((D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel).trans
            (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex i l 0 0
              (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm)
          ((D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel).trans
            (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex i l 1 0
              (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm))
proof:
:= by
  let q := (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map
      (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel i l (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).continuous
  let hs := (D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel).trans
    (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex i l 0 0
      (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm
  let ht := (D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel).trans
    (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex i l 1 0
      (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm
  apply Path.ext
  calc
    (D.verticalCommonEdgeInPiece i j l hshared hlabel :
        unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) =
        (q : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) := by
      funext t
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hqt : q t = D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel i l (D.label i j) hlabel.symm
          (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
            1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0 t) := by
        rfl
      have hone : unitIntervalMeshPoint 1 unitSquareOnePos (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
        simpa using unitIntervalMeshPoint_last 1 unitSquareOnePos
      rw [D.coe_verticalCommonEdgeInPiece]
      rw [hqt, D.coe_gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel]
      simp [squareGridHorizontalEdge, unitSquareCellPoint, hshared, hone]
    _ = (q.cast hs ht : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
      (Path.cast_coe q hs ht).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeComparison_leftElement
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeComparison_leftElement
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l) :
    (D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hshared hlabel).leftElement =
      D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1
proof:
:= by
  let p := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j 0 1 (D.label i j) rfl
  let q := (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 0 1).map (D.gridCellMapInPiece i j).continuous
  let r := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j 1 1 (D.label i j) rfl
  let hs := D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel
  let ht := D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_bottom i j l hshared hlabel
  have hp : Path.correctedLoop (p.cast rfl hs) (q.cast hs ht) (r.cast rfl ht) =
      Path.correctedLoop p q r := correctedLoop_cast p q r hs ht
  unfold CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftElement
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellVertexConnectorInPiece
  rw [D.verticalCommonEdge_eq_bottomCellEdge i j l hshared hlabel]
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftStart,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edge, CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftEnd]
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk hp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeComparison_rightElement
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeComparison_rightElement
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l) :
    (D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hshared hlabel).rightElement =
      D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
        i l 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm
proof:
:= by
  let p := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i l 0 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm
  let q₀ := (squareGridHorizontalEdge (ContinuousMap.id (unitInterval × unitInterval))
    1 unitSquareOnePos 0 0).map
      (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel i l (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).continuous
  let hv₀ := (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex i l 0 0
    (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm
  let hv₁ := (D.gridCellMapInPieceOfLabel_unitSquareGridVertex i l 1 0
    (D.label i j) hlabel.symm).symm
  let q := q₀.cast hv₀ hv₁
  let r := D.gridCellVertexConnectorInPieceOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i l 1 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm
  let hs := D.verticalCommonEdge_source_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel
  let ht := D.verticalCommonEdge_target_eq_top i j l hshared hlabel
  let hsQ := hs.trans hv₀
  let htQ := ht.trans hv₁
  have hsegment : q₀.cast hsQ htQ = q.cast hs ht := by
    apply Path.ext
    calc
      (q₀.cast hsQ htQ : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) =
          (q₀ : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
        Path.cast_coe q₀ hsQ htQ
      _ = (q : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
        (Path.cast_coe q₀ hv₀ hv₁).symm
      _ = (q.cast hs ht : unitInterval → binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j)) :=
        (Path.cast_coe q hs ht).symm
  have hp : Path.correctedLoop (p.cast rfl hs) (q.cast hs ht) (r.cast rfl ht) =
      Path.correctedLoop p q r := correctedLoop_cast p q r hs ht
  unfold CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightElement
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPieceOfLabel
  rw [D.verticalCommonEdge_eq_topCellEdge i j l hshared hlabel]
  dsimp only [CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightStart,
    CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.edge, CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.rightEnd]
  rw [hsegment]
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk hp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.contiguousRanges_ofFn
statement:
private theorem contiguousRanges_ofFn
    (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) (ha : Monotone a) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
      List.range' (a i.castSucc) (a i.succ - a i.castSucc)).flatten =
      List.range' (a 0) (a (Fin.last n) - a 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.ofFn_succ']
      rw [List.concat_eq_append, List.flatten_concat]
      let a' : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ := fun r => a r.castSucc
      have ha' : Monotone a' := fun _ _ h =>
        ha (Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.mpr h)
      have hih := ih a' ha'
      rw [show (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
          List.range' (a i.castSucc.castSucc)
            (a i.castSucc.succ - a i.castSucc.castSucc)).flatten =
          List.range' (a 0) (a (Fin.last n).castSucc - a 0) by
        simpa only [a', ← Fin.castSucc_succ, Fin.castSucc_zero] using hih]
      let start := a 0
      let middle := a (Fin.last n).castSucc
      let finish := a (Fin.last (n + 1))
      have hstart : start ≤ middle := by
        apply ha
        exact Fin.zero_le _
      have hmiddle : middle ≤ finish := by
        apply ha
        exact Fin.le_last _
      change List.range' start (middle - start) ++
          List.range' middle (finish - middle) =
        List.range' start (finish - start)
      have hadd : start + (middle - start) = middle :=
        Nat.add_sub_of_le hstart
      have hlen : (middle - start) + (finish - middle) = finish - start := by
        omega
      calc
        List.range' start (middle - start) ++
            List.range' middle (finish - middle) =
          List.range' start (middle - start) ++
            List.range' (start + 1 * (middle - start))
              (finish - middle) := by rw [one_mul, hadd]
        _ = List.range' start
            ((middle - start) + (finish - middle)) := List.range'_append
        _ = List.range' start (finish - start) := by rw [hlen]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndices_flatten
statement:
theorem pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndices_flatten
    (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
      List.ofFn fun s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i) =>
        pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i s).flatten =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin (pathConcatDyadicScale n * k) => r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (List.map_injective_iff.mpr Fin.val_injective)
  rw [List.map_flatten]
  rw [show (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
      List.ofFn fun s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i) =>
        pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i s).map (List.map Fin.val) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n =>
        List.ofFn fun s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i) =>
          (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i s).val) by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext i
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    rfl]
  rw [show (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin (pathConcatDyadicScale n * k) => r)).map
      Fin.val = List.ofFn (fun r : Fin (pathConcatDyadicScale n * k) => r.val) by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    rfl]
  let a : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ := fun r =>
    pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n r * k
  have ha : Monotone a := Fin.monotone_iff_le_succ.mpr fun i =>
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right k
      (Nat.le_of_lt (pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_strictMonoAdjacent n i))
  have hinner : ∀ i : Fin n,
      List.ofFn (fun s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i) =>
        (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i s).val) =
      List.range' (a i.castSucc) (a i.succ - a i.castSucc) := by
    intro i
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · simp [pathConcatSegmentGridLength, a, Nat.sub_mul]
    · intro m hm₁ hm₂
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, List.getElem_range'_1]
      rfl
  rw [show List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n =>
      List.ofFn (fun s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i) =>
        (pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex n k i s).val)) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n =>
        List.range' (a i.castSucc) (a i.succ - a i.castSucc)) by
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext i
    exact hinner i]
  rw [contiguousRanges_ofFn n a ha]
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by
    simp [a]
  have halast : a (Fin.last n) = pathConcatDyadicScale n * k := by
    cases n with
    | zero => omega
    | succ n => simp [a]
  rw [ha0, halast]
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero]
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro m hm₁ hm₂
    rw [List.getElem_range'_1, List.getElem_ofFn]
    simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatSegmentGridIndex_last

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_eq_convexComb
statement:
theorem pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_eq_convexComb
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin n)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i + 1)) :
    pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s =
      Set.Icc.convexComb
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.castSucc)
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.succ)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)
          (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i) s)
proof:
:= by
  let a := pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i.castSucc
  let b := pathConcatBreakpointNumerator n i.succ
  let scale := pathConcatDyadicScale n
  have hab : a < b := pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_strictMonoAdjacent n i
  have hd : 0 < b - a := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hab
  have hscale : 0 < scale := pathConcatDyadicScale_pos n
  have hk0 : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
  have hd0 : ((b - a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hd)
  have hs0 : (scale : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hscale)
  apply Subtype.ext
  dsimp [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint, pathConcatSegmentGridIndex,
    pathConcatBreakpoint, unitIntervalMeshPoint, pathConcatSegmentGridLength,
    Set.Icc.convexComb, a, b, scale]
  push_cast
  have hab_sub : (a : ℝ) + ((b - a : ℕ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hab)
  field_simp [hk0, hd0, hs0, a, b, scale]
  dsimp [a, b] at hab_sub
  nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathConcatSegmentFineInterval_eq_convexComb
statement:
theorem pathConcatSegmentFineInterval_eq_convexComb
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin n)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)) (t : unitInterval) :
    Set.Icc.convexComb
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.castSucc)
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.succ) t =
      Set.Icc.convexComb
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.castSucc)
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.succ)
        (Set.Icc.convexComb
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)
            (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i) s.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)
            (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i) s.succ) t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_eq_convexComb,
    pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_eq_convexComb]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Set.Icc.convexComb, Subtype.coe_mk]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatSegmentFineInterval_mem
statement:
private theorem Path.concatSegmentFineInterval_mem
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin n)
    (S : Set Y) (hF : ∀ t, F i t ∈ S)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)) (t : unitInterval) :
    Path.concat p F
        (Set.Icc.convexComb
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.castSucc)
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.succ) t) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  let uLocal := Set.Icc.convexComb
    (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)
      (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i) s.castSucc)
    (unitIntervalMeshPoint (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)
      (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i) s.succ) t
  have hmem := Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem p F i S hF uLocal
  unfold Path.concatDyadicSegment at hmem
  rw [Path.cast_coe] at hmem
  rw [pathConcatSegmentFineInterval_eq_convexComb n k hk i s t]
  exact hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatSegmentMeshPoint_mem
statement:
private theorem Path.concatSegmentMeshPoint_mem
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin n)

proof:
:= by

    (pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n k hk i) r
  have hmem := Path.concatDyadicSegment_mem p F i S hF uLocal
  unfold Path.concatDyadicSegment at hmem
  rw [Path.cast_coe] at hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatSegmentMeshSubpaths_homotopic
statement:
theorem Path.concatSegmentMeshSubpaths_homotopic
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {a b : Y} (p : Path a b)
    (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin n) :
    Path.Homotopic
      (Path.concat
        (p ∘ pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i)
        (fun s => p.subpath
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.castSucc)
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.succ)))
      (p.subpath
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i 0)
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i
          (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i))))
proof:
:= by
  exact Path.Homotopic.concat_subpath p
    (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.concatDyadicGridSegment_homotopic
statement:
theorem Path.concatDyadicGridSegment_homotopic
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {n : ℕ}
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Y)
    (F : (i : Fin n) → Path (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (i : Fin n) :
    (Path.concatDyadicGridSegment p F k hk i).Homotopic (F i)
proof:
:= by
  let γ := Path.concat p F
  have hblock := Path.concatSegmentMeshSubpaths_homotopic γ n k hk i
  have hsource : p i.castSucc = γ (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i 0) := by
    rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_zero,
      Path.concat_breakpoint_apply p F i.castSucc]
  have htarget : p i.succ = γ
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i
        (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i))) := by
    rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_last,
      Path.concat_breakpoint_apply p F i.succ]
  have hcast := hblock.pathCast hsource htarget
  have hright :
      ((γ.subpath
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i 0)
        (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i
          (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i)))).cast hsource htarget) =
        Path.concatDyadicSegment p F i := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    change γ (Set.Icc.convexComb
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i 0)
      (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i
        (Fin.last (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n k i))) t) =
      γ (Set.Icc.convexComb
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.castSucc)
        (pathConcatBreakpoint n i.succ) t)
    rw [pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_zero, pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint_last]
  have hgrid : Path.concatDyadicGridSegment p F k hk i =
      (Path.concat
        (γ ∘ pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i)
        (fun s => γ.subpath
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.castSucc)
          (pathConcatSegmentMeshPoint n k hk i s.succ))).cast hsource htarget := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    rfl
  rw [hgrid]
  exact hcast.trans (by
    rw [hright]
    exact Path.concatDyadicSegment_homotopic p F i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_pathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_pathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision
    (H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)) {U V : Set X}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hH : ∀ z, H z ∈ U ∨ H z ∈ V) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision H U V n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_binaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision_concat_multiple H hU hV hH n with
    ⟨D, k, hsteps⟩
  have hk : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hk
    subst k
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt D.steps_pos) (by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_zero] using hsteps)
  exact ⟨D, k, hk, hsteps⟩

statement:
theorem segmentGridEdgeIndex_first

    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex ⟨0, hn⟩
        ⟨0, pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n A.factor A.factor_pos ⟨0, hn⟩⟩ =
