name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex_last
statement:
theorem segmentGridEdgeIndex_last
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X} {n : ℕ}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision H U V n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let i : Fin n := ⟨n - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    let L := pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i
    let hL := pathConcatSegmentGridLength_pos n A.factor A.factor_pos i
    A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i (finLastOfPos L hL) =
      ⟨A.subdivision.steps - 1,
        Nat.sub_lt A.subdivision.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  apply Fin.ext
  unfold segmentGridEdgeIndex pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex finLastOfPos
  simp only [Fin.val_cast]
  have hi : (⟨m + 1 - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Fin (m + 1)).succ =
      Fin.last (m + 1) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  unfold pathConcatSegmentGridLength
  rw [hi, pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_last]
  have ha := pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_strictMonoAdjacent (m + 1)
    (⟨m + 1 - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Fin (m + 1))
  rw [hi, pathConcatBreakpointNumerator_last] at ha
  have hsum : pathConcatBreakpointNumerator (m + 1)
        (⟨m + 1 - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Fin (m + 1)).castSucc *
          A.factor +
        (pathConcatDyadicScale (m + 1) -
          pathConcatBreakpointNumerator (m + 1)
            (⟨m + 1 - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Fin (m + 1)).castSucc) *
          A.factor =
      pathConcatDyadicScale (m + 1) * A.factor := by
    rw [← Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt ha)]
  have hpositive : 0 <
      (pathConcatDyadicScale (m + 1) -
        pathConcatBreakpointNumerator (m + 1)
          (⟨m + 1 - 1, Nat.sub_lt hn Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Fin (m + 1)).castSucc) *
        A.factor :=
    Nat.mul_pos (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt ha) A.factor_pos
  rw [A.steps_eq, ← hsum]
  exact (Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (Nat.ne_of_gt hpositive)) _).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc
statement:
theorem segmentGridEdgeIndex_succ_eq_castSucc
    {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X} {n : ℕ}
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision H U V n) (i : Fin n)
    (s t : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength n A.factor i))

  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
  unfold segmentGridEdgeIndex pathConcatSegmentGridEdgeIndex
  simp only [Fin.val_cast]
  have hs := congrArg Fin.val hshared
  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hs
  omega

    {U V : Set X} {x₀ : X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)

      binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1

    (fun _ : Fin (letters.reverse.length + 1) => x₀)
    (fun j : Fin letters.reverse.length =>
      (letters.reverse.get j).ambientLoop hxU hxV)
    A.factor A.factor_pos i
    (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1)
    (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop_segment_mem hxU hxV letters i) s t

          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ) t ∈

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.NormedSpace.norm_triangle
statement:
theorem norm_triangle [_normedLinear : NormedLinearSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) :
    ‖x + y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y‖
proof:
:= by
  exact norm_add_le x y

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.NormedSpace.reverse_triangle
statement:
theorem reverse_triangle [_normedLinear : NormedLinearSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) :
    |‖x‖ - ‖y‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
:= by
  exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.NormedSpace.norm_smul_eq
statement:
theorem norm_smul_eq [_normedLinear : NormedLinearSpace ℝ E] (c : ℝ) (x : E) :
    ‖c • x‖ = ‖c‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  exact norm_smul c x

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.NormedSpace.tendsto_iff_norm_sub
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_norm_sub [_normedLinear : NormedLinearSpace ℝ E]
    {u : ℕ → E} {x : E} :
    Tendsto u atTop (nhds x) ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ‖u n - x‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (Metric.tendsto_atTop (u := u) (a := x))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.NormedSpace.cauchySeq_iff_norm_sub
statement:
theorem cauchySeq_iff_norm_sub [_normedLinear : NormedLinearSpace ℝ E] {u : ℕ → E} :
    CauchySeq u ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ‖u m - u n‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (Metric.cauchySeq_iff (u := u))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.NormedSpace.cauchySeq_tendsto_of_banach
statement:
theorem cauchySeq_tendsto_of_banach [_normedLinear : NormedLinearSpace ℝ E]
    [BanachSpace E]
    {u : ℕ → E} (hu : CauchySeq u) : ∃ x : E, Tendsto u atTop (nhds x)
proof:
:= by
  exact cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hu

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_potential_of_ne
statement:
theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_potential_of_ne
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (hne : A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s) ≠ (letters.reverse.get i).1) :
    let q := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
    let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)
    let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
    let hb := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
      hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
    let hc := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
      hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
    let CB := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hb
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    let CC := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc hne hc
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    let T := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    T.startChange = transitionFromPotentials
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
      ((Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.startChange :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
    dif_neg hne]
  simp [transitionFromPotentials]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_eq_intersectionPotentials
statement:
theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_eq_intersectionPotentials
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hcell : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)) z =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩)
    (hletter : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (letters.reverse.get i).1 z =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩) :
    let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)
    let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
    let wb : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩
    let wc : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
        by
          change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ ∈
              binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1
          simpa using A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
            hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩
    let T := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s
    T.endChange = transitionFromPotentials
      (binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV z b wb
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s) hcell)
      (binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection hxU hxV hUV z c wc
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
          hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s) hletter)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)
  let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
  have hzval : (z : X) =
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
        A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ := by
    have hz := congrArg
      (fun w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)) => (w : X)) hcell
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] using hz
  by_cases heq : b = c
  · rw [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
      dif_pos heq]
    let C := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      heq
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    have hCtarget : C.edgeTarget =
        (⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
          by
            change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
              A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ ∈
                binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
                  (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
                    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s))
            simpa using (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
              hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1)⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b) := by
      exact binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_edgeTarget
        hxU hxV _ _ _ heq _ _ _ _
    have hzC : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V b z = C.edgeTarget := by
      rw [hCtarget]
      exact hcell
    change ((Monoid.PushoutI.of b C.endChange :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) = _
    rw [C.pushout_endChange_inv_eq_vertexPotentials hxU hxV hUV b z hzC]
    apply congrArg₂ transitionFromPotentials
    · apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast_label
        hxU hxV hUV b b rfl z z rfl C.edgeTarget
        ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
          by
            change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
              A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ ∈
                binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
                  (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
                    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s))
            simpa using A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
              hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩
      · exact congrArg
          (fun w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b => (w : X)) hCtarget
      · intro u
        exact coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_leftEnd
          hxU hxV _ _ _ heq _ _ _ _ u
    · apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast_label
        hxU hxV hUV b c heq z z rfl C.edgeTarget
        ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ,
          by
            change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
              A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).succ ∈
                binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1
            simpa using A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
              hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 1⟩
      · exact congrArg
          (fun w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b => (w : X)) hCtarget
      · intro u
        exact coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_rightEnd
          hxU hxV _ _ _ heq _ _ _ _ u
  · rw [A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_end_potential_of_ne
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s heq]
    rw [binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_endPotential_eq,
      binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_endPotential_eq]
    congr 1 <;>
      apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
        hxU hxV hUV <;>
      first
      | apply Subtype.ext
        exact hzval.symm
      | rfl

statement:
theorem leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_eq_intersectionPotentials

    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i))
    (z : ↥(U ∩ V))
    (hcell : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)) z =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 0⟩)
    (hletter : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V
        (letters.reverse.get i).1 z =
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 0⟩) :
    let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)
    let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
    let wb : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b :=
      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
        by simpa using
          A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 0⟩

      ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
          A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
        by

            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc ∈

proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)

  have hzval : (z : X) =
      squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
        A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc := by
    have hz := congrArg
      (fun w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
        (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
          (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)) => (w : X)) hcell
    simpa only [coe_binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece] using hz
  by_cases heq : b = c
  · rw [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
      dif_pos heq]
    let C := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s)
      heq
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
      (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
        hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s)
    have hCsource : C.edgeSource =
        (⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
          by
            change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
              A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc ∈
                binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
                  (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
                    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s))
            simpa using (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
              hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 0)⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b) := by
      exact binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_edgeSource
        hxU hxV _ _ _ heq _ _ _ _
    have hzC : binaryOpenCoverIntersectionToPiece U V b z = C.edgeSource := by
      rw [hCsource]
      exact hcell
    change ((Monoid.PushoutI.of b C.startChange :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)⁻¹) = _
    rw [C.pushout_startChange_inv_eq_vertexPotentials hxU hxV hUV b z hzC]
    apply congrArg₂ transitionFromPotentials
    · apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast_label
        hxU hxV hUV b b rfl z z rfl C.edgeSource
        ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
          by
            change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
              A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc ∈
                binaryOpenCoverPiece U V
                  (A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
                    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s))
            simpa using A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece
              hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 0⟩
      · exact congrArg
          (fun w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b => (w : X)) hCsource
      · intro u
        exact coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_leftStart
          hxU hxV _ _ _ heq _ _ _ _ u
    · apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast_label
        hxU hxV hUV b c heq z z rfl C.edgeSource
        ⟨squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
            A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc,
          by
            change squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) A.subdivision.steps
              A.subdivision.steps_pos 0 (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s).castSucc ∈
                binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (letters.reverse.get i).1
            simpa using A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece
              hxU hxV letters Fhom i s 0⟩
      · exact congrArg
          (fun w : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b => (w : X)) hCsource
      · intro u
        exact coe_binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison_rightStart
          hxU hxV _ _ _ heq _ _ _ _ u
  · rw [A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions_start_potential_of_ne
      hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s heq]
    rw [binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_startPotential_eq,
      binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison_startPotential_eq]
    congr 1 <;>
      apply binaryOpenCoverVertexPotentialFromIntersection_cast
        hxU hxV hUV <;>
      first
      | apply Subtype.ext
        exact hzval.symm
      | rfl

private theorem binaryOpenCoverSamePathComparison_left_pushout_eq
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    {z w : X} {b c : Bool} (q : Path z w)
    (hb : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
    (hc : ∀ t, q t ∈ binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c) (heq : b = c)
    (bStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hb 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b))
    (bEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hb 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b))
    (cStart : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)
      (⟨z, by simpa using hc 0⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c))
    (cEnd : Path (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)
      (⟨w, by simpa using hc 1⟩ : binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c)) :
    let C := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV q hb hc heq
      bStart bEnd cStart cEnd
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of b C.leftElement : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      Monoid.PushoutI.of b
        ((FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
          (x₀ := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b) bStart
          (binaryOpenCoverPathInPiece q hb) bEnd⟧) :
          FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
            (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b))
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c
  · simp [binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison,
      CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftElement]
  · contradiction
  · contradiction
  · simp [binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison,
      CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.leftElement]

theorem PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetter_relation
    {x₀ : X} {U V : Set X} (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (letters : List (BinaryVanKampenLetter U V hxU hxV))
    (Fhom : Path.Homotopy
      (binaryVanKampenLetterConcatLoop hxU hxV letters) (Path.refl x₀))
    (A : PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision (pathHomotopySquare Fhom) U V
      letters.reverse.length)
    (i : Fin letters.reverse.length)
    (s : Fin (pathConcatSegmentGridLength letters.reverse.length A.factor i)) :
    let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
      (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)
    let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
    let T := A.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      letters Fhom i s
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of b
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellElement hxU hxV hU hV
          letters Fhom i s) : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge T.startChange T.endChange
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of c
          (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterElement hxU hxV hU hV
            letters Fhom i s))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let q := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let b := A.subdivision.label ⟨0, A.subdivision.steps_pos⟩
    (A.segmentGridEdgeIndex i s)
  let c := (letters.reverse.get i).1
  let hb := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_cellPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let hc := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdge_mem_letterPiece hxU hxV letters Fhom i s
  let bStart := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellStart
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s
  let bEnd := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellEnd
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s
  let cStart := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterStart
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s
  let cEnd := A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterEnd
    hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s
  by_cases heq : b = c
  · rw [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
      dif_pos heq]
    let C := binaryOpenCoverSamePathConnectorComparison hxU hxV q hb hc heq
      bStart bEnd cStart cEnd
    have h := binaryOpenCoverSamePath_localElements_pushout_rebase
      hxU hxV q hb hc heq bStart bEnd cStart cEnd
    have hL := binaryOpenCoverSamePathComparison_left_pushout_eq
      hxU hxV q hb hc heq bStart bEnd cStart cEnd
    have hR := binaryOpenCoverSamePathComparison_right_pushout_eq
      hxU hxV q hb hc heq bStart bEnd cStart cEnd
    dsimp only at h hL hR
    have hCell : (Monoid.PushoutI.of b
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellElement hxU hxV hU hV
          letters Fhom i s) : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
        Monoid.PushoutI.of b
          ((FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
            (x₀ := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b) bStart
            (binaryOpenCoverPathInPiece q hb) bEnd⟧) :
            FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
              (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b)) := by rfl
    have hLetter : (Monoid.PushoutI.of c
        (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterElement hxU hxV hU hV
          letters Fhom i s) : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
        Monoid.PushoutI.of c
          ((FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.correctedLoop
            (x₀ := binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c) cStart
            (binaryOpenCoverPathInPiece q hc) cEnd⟧) :
            FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V c)
              (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV c)) := by rfl
    rw [hCell, ← hL, h, hR, hLetter]
  · rw [PathConcatAlignedSquareSubdivision.leftBoundaryCellToLetterTransitions,
      dif_neg heq]
    let CB := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc heq hb bStart bEnd
    let CC := binaryOpenCoverDualPathConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV
      q hb hc heq hc cStart cEnd
    have h := binaryOpenCoverDualPath_localElements_pushout_rebase
      hxU hxV hUV q hb hc heq bStart bEnd cStart cEnd
    have hL : (Monoid.PushoutI.of b CB.rightElement :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
        Monoid.PushoutI.of b
          (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellElement hxU hxV hU hV
            letters Fhom i s) := by rfl
    have hR : (Monoid.PushoutI.of c CC.rightElement :
        binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
        Monoid.PushoutI.of c
          (A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterElement hxU hxV hU hV
            letters Fhom i s) := by rfl
    dsimp only at h
    rw [← hL, h, hR]

            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridEdgeInPiece hxU hxV letters
              A.factor A.factor_pos i s)
            (binaryVanKampenLetterBlockGridConnector hxU hxV hU hV letters
              A.factor A.factor_pos i s.succ)⟧))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [← A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeCellElement_eq
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s,
    ← A.leftBoundaryAlignedGridEdgeLetterElement_eq
      hxU hxV hU hV letters Fhom i s]
  exact A.leftBoundaryCellToLetter_relation
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV letters Fhom i s

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.piecewiseC1_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem Path.piecewiseC1_of_contDiffOn {x y : E} (gamma : Path x y)
    (regular : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 gamma.extend (Icc 0 1)) : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma
proof:
:=
  .of_contDiffOn gamma regular

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.piecewiseC1_refl
statement: theorem Path.piecewiseC1_refl (x : E) : Path.PiecewiseC1 (Path.refl x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.piecewiseC1_of_contDiffOn
  apply contDiffOn_const

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.piecewiseC1_segment
statement:
theorem Path.piecewiseC1_segment (a b : E) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 (Path.segment a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.piecewiseC1_of_contDiffOn
  apply (AffineMap.contDiff_lineMap a b).contDiffOn.congr
  intro t ht
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.piecewiseC1_concat
statement:
theorem Path.piecewiseC1_concat
    {n : ℕ} (vertices : Fin (n + 1) → E)
    (pieces : (i : Fin n) → Path (vertices i.castSucc) (vertices i.succ))
    (regular : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (pieces i).extend (Icc 0 1)) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 (Path.concat vertices pieces)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [Path.concat_zero]
      exact Path.piecewiseC1_refl (vertices 0)
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Path.concat_succ]
      exact .trans _ _
        (ih (vertices ∘ Fin.castSucc) (fun i => pieces i.castSucc)
          (fun i => regular i.castSucc))
        (.of_contDiffOn _ (regular (Fin.last n)))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.PiecewiseC1.symm
statement:
theorem Path.PiecewiseC1.symm
    {x y : E} {gamma : Path x y} (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma.symm
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma regular =>
      apply Path.piecewiseC1_of_contDiffOn
      rw [Path.extend_symm]
      exact regular.comp
        ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).contDiffOn)
        (fun t ht => by
          constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2])
  | trans gamma delta _ _ ihgamma ihdelta =>
      rw [Path.trans_symm]
      exact .trans _ _ ihdelta ihgamma
  | cast gamma _ hx hy ih =>
      simpa using Path.PiecewiseC1.cast gamma.symm ih hy hx

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.meshPolygonal_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem Path.meshPolygonal_piecewiseC1
    {x y : E} (p : Path x y) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Path.PiecewiseC1 (Path.meshPolygonal p N hN)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Path.meshPolygonal
  apply Path.PiecewiseC1.cast
  apply Path.piecewiseC1_concat
  intro i
  apply (AffineMap.contDiff_lineMap
    (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.castSucc))
    (p (unitIntervalMeshPoint N hN i.succ))).contDiffOn.congr
  intro t ht
  rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.Path.exists_piecewiseC1_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
statement:
theorem Path.exists_piecewiseC1_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
    {x y : E} (p : Path x y) {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : ∀ t, p t ∈ U) :
    ∃ q : Path x y,
      Set.range q ⊆ U ∧ Path.PiecewiseC1 q ∧
        ∃ K : p.Homotopy q, ∀ t s : unitInterval, K (t, s) ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hrange, K, hK⟩ :=
    Path.exists_meshPolygonal_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin p hU hpU
  exact ⟨Path.meshPolygonal p N hN, hrange,
    Path.meshPolygonal_piecewiseC1 p N hN, K, hK⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.quotient_map_trans
statement:
theorem quotient_map_trans {A B : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    {a b c : A} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a b)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b c) (f : C(A, B)) :
    (p.trans q).map f = (p.map f).trans (q.map f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn p ?_
  intro p
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro q
  exact congrArg Quotient.mk'' (Path.map_trans p q f.continuous)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.quotient_map_symm
statement:
theorem quotient_map_symm {A B : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    {a b : A} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a b) (f : C(A, B)) :
    p.symm.map f = (p.map f).symm
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn p ?_
  intro p
  exact congrArg Quotient.mk'' (Path.map_symm p f.continuous).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.quotient_symm_trans
statement:
theorem quotient_symm_trans {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    {a b c : A} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a b)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b c) :
    (p.trans q).symm = q.symm.trans p.symm
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn p ?_
  intro p
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro q
  exact congrArg Quotient.mk'' (Path.trans_symm p q)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.fixedRelated_refl
statement:
theorem fixedRelated_refl (y : X) (a : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y) :
    FixedRelated H y a a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x0).trans a = a
  exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans a

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.fixedRelated_symm
statement:
theorem fixedRelated_symm (y : X) {a b : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y} :
    FixedRelated H y a b → FixedRelated H y b a
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨h⁻¹, ?_⟩
  change h.1.symm.trans (h.1.trans a) = a
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.fixedRelated_trans
statement:
theorem fixedRelated_trans (y : X) {a b c : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y} :
    FixedRelated H y a b → FixedRelated H y b c → FixedRelated H y a c
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨h * k, ?_⟩
  change (k.1.trans h.1).trans a = k.1.trans (h.1.trans a)
  exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc k.1 h.1 a

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.SmallNeighborhood.localPathClass_trans_localSegmentClass
statement:
theorem localPathClass_trans_localSegmentClass {a b : U.carrier} (delta : Path a b) :
    (U.localPathClass a).trans (U.localSegmentClass delta) = U.localPathClass b
proof:
:= by
  let iUX : C(U.carrier, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let pa : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (⟨y, U.center_mem⟩ : U.carrier) a :=
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (U.localPath a)
  let pd : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a b := Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk delta
  let pb : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (⟨y, U.center_mem⟩ : U.carrier) b :=
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (U.localPath b)
  let loop : FundamentalGroup U.carrier ⟨y, U.center_mem⟩ :=
    FundamentalGroup.fromPath ((pa.trans pd).trans pb.symm)
  have hloop := U.loops_trivial loop
  change (((pa.trans pd).trans pb.symm).map iUX) =
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl y at hloop
  rw [quotient_map_trans, quotient_map_trans, quotient_map_symm] at hloop
  change (pa.map iUX).trans (pd.map iUX) = pb.map iUX
  calc
    (pa.map iUX).trans (pd.map iUX) =
        ((pa.map iUX).trans (pd.map iUX)).trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl (iUX b)) :=
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl _).symm
    _ = ((pa.map iUX).trans (pd.map iUX)).trans
        ((pb.map iUX).symm.trans (pb.map iUX)) := by
      rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans]
    _ = (((pa.map iUX).trans (pd.map iUX)).trans (pb.map iUX).symm).trans
        (pb.map iUX) :=
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl y).trans (pb.map iUX) := by rw [hloop]
    _ = pb.map iUX := Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans _

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.related_append
statement:
theorem related_append {z : X} {a b : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0}
    (hab : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.Related H a b)
    (delta : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a.endpoint z) :
    CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.Related H
      (append a delta)
      (append b
        (delta.cast (CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.endpoint_eq_of_related H hab).symm rfl))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hab
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  unfold append CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.prepend
  congr 1
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast_rfl_rfl]
  exact (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc h.1 a.path delta).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartToRepresentative_prepend
statement:
theorem chartToRepresentative_prepend [PathConnectedSpace X] {y z : X}
    (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (h : H) (alpha : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 z) :
    chartToRepresentative H U z (h.1.trans alpha) =
      chartToRepresentative H U z alpha
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold chartToRepresentative
  by_cases hz : z ∈ U.carrier
  · rw [dif_pos hz, dif_pos hz]
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    apply Quotient.sound
    change FixedRelated H y
      ((h.1.trans alpha).trans (U.localPathClass ⟨z, hz⟩).symm)
      (alpha.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨z, hz⟩).symm)
    refine ⟨h⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change h.1.symm.trans
      ((h.1.trans alpha).trans (U.localPathClass ⟨z, hz⟩).symm) =
      alpha.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨z, hz⟩).symm
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans]
  · rw [dif_neg hz, dif_neg hz]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartToRaw_fst_of_mem
statement:
theorem chartToRaw_fst_of_mem [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (q : CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H)
    (hq : CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q ∈ U.carrier) :
    (chartToRaw H U q).1 = CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_ hq
  intro a ha
  simp only [CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection, Quotient.lift_mk] at ha ⊢
  simp only [chartToRaw, Quotient.lift_mk]
  unfold chartToRepresentative
  rw [dif_pos ha]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTo_fst
statement:
theorem chartTo_fst [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (q : ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier) :
    (chartTo H U q).1.1 = CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartTo
  exact chartToRaw_fst_of_mem H U q.1 q.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartInv_mk
statement:
theorem chartInv_mk {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (z : U.carrier)
    (alpha : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y) :
    chartInv H U (z, Quotient.mk _ alpha) =
      ⟨Quotient.mk _
        ({ endpoint := z.1, path := alpha.trans (U.localPathClass z) } :
          CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0), z.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartToRaw_mk
statement:
theorem chartToRaw_mk [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (a : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0) :
    chartToRaw H U (Quotient.mk _ a) =
      chartToRepresentative H U a.endpoint a.path
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTo_mk
statement:
theorem chartTo_mk [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (a : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0)
    (ha : CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H (Quotient.mk _ a) ∈ U.carrier) :
    chartTo H U ⟨Quotient.mk _ a, ha⟩ =
      (⟨a.endpoint, ha⟩,
        Quotient.mk _
          (a.path.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨a.endpoint, ha⟩).symm))
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : a.endpoint ∈ U.carrier := by exact ha
  unfold chartTo
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact chartToRaw_fst_of_mem H U (Quotient.mk _ a) ha
  · change (chartToRaw H U (Quotient.mk _ a)).2 = _
    rw [chartToRaw_mk]
    unfold chartToRepresentative
    rw [dif_pos ha']

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTo_chartInv_mk
statement:
theorem chartTo_chartInv_mk [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X}
    (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (z : U.carrier)
    (alpha : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y) :
    chartTo H U (chartInv H U (z, Quotient.mk _ alpha)) =
      (z, Quotient.mk _ alpha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartInv_mk]
  let a : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0 :=
    { endpoint := z.1, path := alpha.trans (U.localPathClass z) }
  have ha : CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H
      (Quotient.mk _ a : CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) ∈ U.carrier := z.2
  change chartTo H U
    (⟨(Quotient.mk _ a : CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H), ha⟩ :
      ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier) = (z, Quotient.mk _ alpha)
  unfold chartTo
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact chartToRaw_fst_of_mem H U (Quotient.mk _ a) ha
  · change (chartToRaw H U (Quotient.mk _ a : CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H)).2 = _
    rw [chartToRaw_mk]
    unfold chartToRepresentative
    rw [dif_pos z.2]
    apply Quotient.sound
    change FixedRelated H y
      ((alpha.trans (U.localPathClass z)).trans (U.localPathClass z).symm)
      alpha
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x0).trans
      ((alpha.trans (U.localPathClass z)).trans (U.localPathClass z).symm) = alpha
    rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_symm,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTo_chartInv
statement:
theorem chartTo_chartInv [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (q : U.carrier × FixedPathClass H y) :
    chartTo H U (chartInv H U q) = q
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨z, q⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro alpha
  exact chartTo_chartInv_mk H U z alpha

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartInv_chartTo
statement:
theorem chartInv_chartTo [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (q : ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier) :
    chartInv H U (chartTo H U q) = q
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨q, hq⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_ hq
  intro a ha
  rw [chartTo_mk, chartInv_mk]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Quotient.sound
  change CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.Related H
    ({ endpoint := a.endpoint,
       path := (a.path.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨a.endpoint, ha⟩).symm).trans
         (U.localPathClass ⟨a.endpoint, ha⟩) } : CoveringSubgroupBasedPath x0)
    a
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  unfold CoveringSubgroupBasedPath.prepend
  congr 1
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x0).trans
    ((a.path.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨a.endpoint, ha⟩).symm).trans
      (U.localPathClass ⟨a.endpoint, ha⟩)) = a.path
  rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.projection_chartInv
statement:
theorem projection_chartInv {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y)
    (q : U.carrier × FixedPathClass H y) :
    CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H (chartInv H U q).1 = q.1.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨z, q⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro alpha
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTransition_fst
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  unfold chartTransition
  dsimp only
  rw [chartTo_fst, projection_chartInv]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.continuous_chartTransition_fst
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : Continuous
      (fun q : ChartOverlap H U V => (⟨q.1.1, q.1.2.2⟩ : V.carrier)) :=
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).subtype_mk _
  apply hbase.congr
  intro q
  exact (chartTransition_fst H U V q).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTransitionFiber_mk
statement:
theorem chartTransitionFiber_mk [PathConnectedSpace X] {y z : X}
    (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (V : SmallNeighborhood z)
    (a : BaseOverlap U V) (alpha : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y) :
    chartTransitionFiber H U V
        (a, WithTopology.toTopology ⊥ (Quotient.mk _ alpha)) =
      WithTopology.toTopology ⊥
        (Quotient.mk _
          ((alpha.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩)).trans
            (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm) : FixedPathClass H z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartTransitionFiber chartTransition chartInv chartTo chartToRaw
  dsimp only [WithTopology.ofTopology_toTopology]
  simp only [Quotient.lift_mk]
  unfold chartToRepresentative
  rw [dif_pos a.2.2]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTransitionFiber_mk_eq_of_joined
statement:
theorem chartTransitionFiber_mk_eq_of_joined [PathConnectedSpace X]
    {y z : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (V : SmallNeighborhood z)
    {a b : BaseOverlap U V} (hab : Joined a b)
    (alpha : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 y) :
    chartTransitionFiber H U V
        (a, WithTopology.toTopology ⊥ (Quotient.mk _ alpha)) =
    chartTransitionFiber H U V
        (b, WithTopology.toTopology ⊥ (Quotient.mk _ alpha))
proof:
:= by
  let fU : C(BaseOverlap U V, U.carrier) :=
    ⟨fun s => ⟨s.1, s.2.1⟩, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩
  let fV : C(BaseOverlap U V, V.carrier) :=
    ⟨fun s => ⟨s.1, s.2.2⟩, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩
  let deltaU : Path (⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩ : U.carrier) ⟨b.1, b.2.1⟩ :=
    hab.somePath.map fU.continuous
  let deltaV : Path (⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩ : V.carrier) ⟨b.1, b.2.2⟩ :=
    hab.somePath.map fV.continuous
  have hsegment : U.localSegmentClass deltaU = V.localSegmentClass deltaV := by
    unfold SmallNeighborhood.localSegmentClass deltaU deltaV
    change Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
        ((hab.somePath.map fU.continuous).map continuous_subtype_val) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
        ((hab.somePath.map fV.continuous).map continuous_subtype_val)
    apply congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
    rw [Path.map_map, Path.map_map]
  have hUcoh := U.localPathClass_trans_localSegmentClass deltaU
  have hVcoh := V.localPathClass_trans_localSegmentClass deltaV
  have hmiddle :
      (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩).trans
          (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm =
        (U.localPathClass ⟨b.1, b.2.1⟩).trans
          (V.localPathClass ⟨b.1, b.2.2⟩).symm := by
    rw [← hUcoh, ← hVcoh, ← hsegment, quotient_symm_trans]
    symm
    calc
      ((U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩).trans
          (U.localSegmentClass deltaU)).trans
          ((U.localSegmentClass deltaU).symm.trans
            (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm) =
          (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩).trans
            ((U.localSegmentClass deltaU).trans
              ((U.localSegmentClass deltaU).symm.trans
                (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm)) :=
        Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc _ _ _
      _ = (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩).trans
            (((U.localSegmentClass deltaU).trans
              (U.localSegmentClass deltaU).symm).trans
                (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm) := by
        rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc]
      _ = (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩).trans
            ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl _).trans
              (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm) := by
        rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_symm]
      _ = (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩).trans
            (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm := by
        rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans]
  rw [chartTransitionFiber_mk, chartTransitionFiber_mk]
  have hfull :
      (alpha.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩)).trans
          (V.localPathClass ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩).symm =
        (alpha.trans (U.localPathClass ⟨b.1, b.2.1⟩)).trans
          (V.localPathClass ⟨b.1, b.2.2⟩).symm := by
    rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient y z => alpha.trans p) hmiddle
  have hquot := congrArg
    (fun p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x0 z => Quotient.mk (fixedSetoid H z) p) hfull
  exact congrArg
    (fun q : FixedPathClass H z => WithTopology.toTopology ⊥ q) hquot

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartTransitionFiber_eq_of_joined
statement:
theorem chartTransitionFiber_eq_of_joined [PathConnectedSpace X]
    {y z : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (V : SmallNeighborhood z)
    {a b : BaseOverlap U V} (hab : Joined a b)
    (i : WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y)) :
    chartTransitionFiber H U V (a, i) =
      chartTransitionFiber H U V (b, i)
proof:
:= by
  let qi : FixedPathClass H y := WithTopology.ofTopology i
  have hi : i = WithTopology.toTopology ⊥ qi := by
    exact (WithTopology.toTopology_ofTopology ⊥ i).symm
  rw [hi]
  refine Quotient.inductionOn qi ?_
  intro alpha
  exact chartTransitionFiber_mk_eq_of_joined H U V hab alpha

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartToDiscrete_chartInvDiscrete

proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨z, q⟩
  unfold chartToDiscrete chartInvDiscrete

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chartInvDiscrete_chartToDiscrete

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.continuous_chartToDiscrete
statement:
theorem continuous_chartToDiscrete [PathConnectedSpace X] {y : X}
    (U : SmallNeighborhood y) :
    @Continuous
      (ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier)
      (U.carrier × WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y))
      (@instTopologicalSpaceSubtype
        (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H)
        (fun q => CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q ∈ U.carrier)
        (coveringSubgroupTopology H))
      inferInstance
      (chartToDiscrete H U)
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) := coveringSubgroupTopology H
  rw [continuous_def]
  intro w hw
  rw [isOpen_induced_iff]
  let s : Set (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) :=
    {q | ∃ hq : CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q ∈ U.carrier,
      chartToDiscrete H U ⟨q, hq⟩ ∈ w}
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem
    refine ⟨y, U, w, hw, ?_⟩
    ext q
    simp only [s, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rfl
  · ext q
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, s, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hq, hqw⟩
      simpa only [Subsingleton.elim hq q.2] using hqw
    · intro hqw
      exact ⟨q.2, hqw⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.exists_smallNeighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_smallNeighborhood [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X]
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] (y : X) : Nonempty (SmallNeighborhood y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUopen, hyU, hloops⟩ :=
    (semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_exists_open_loops y).mp
      (SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.semilocallySimplyConnectedAt y)
  let V : Set X := pathComponentIn U y
  have hyV : y ∈ V := mem_pathComponentIn_self hyU
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := hUopen.pathComponentIn y
  have hVpath : IsPathConnected V := isPathConnected_pathComponentIn hyU
  refine ⟨{
    carrier := V
    center_mem := hyV
    isOpen := hVopen
    isPathConnected := hVpath
    loops_trivial := ?_ }⟩
  intro q
  let iVU : C(V, U) := ContinuousMap.inclusion pathComponentIn_subset
  let iUX : C(U, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let iVX : C(V, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hcomp : iUX.comp iVU = iVX := by ext; rfl
  have hqU : FundamentalGroup.map iUX ⟨y, hyU⟩
      (FundamentalGroup.map iVU ⟨y, hyV⟩ q) = 1 :=
    hloops (FundamentalGroup.map iVU ⟨y, hyV⟩ q)
  change FundamentalGroup.map iVX ⟨y, hyV⟩ q = 1
  rw [← hcomp, fundamentalGroup_map_comp]
  exact hqU

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.isLocallyConstant_chartTransitionFiber
statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_chartTransitionFiber
    [PathConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    {y z : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (V : SmallNeighborhood z) :
    IsLocallyConstant (chartTransitionFiber H U V)
proof:
:= by
  let : LocallyPathConnectedSpace (BaseOverlap U V) :=
    (U.isOpen.inter V.isOpen).locallyPathConnectedSpace
  rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open]
  intro q
  refine ⟨pathComponent q.1 ×ˢ {q.2}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (IsOpen.pathComponent q.1).prod (isOpen_discrete _)
  · exact ⟨mem_pathComponent_self q.1, Set.mem_singleton q.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨rbase, rfiber⟩ ⟨hrbase, hrfiber⟩
    have hj : Joined q.1 rbase := mem_pathComponent_iff.mp hrbase
    have hfiber : rfiber = q.2 := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hrfiber
    subst rfiber
    exact (chartTransitionFiber_eq_of_joined H U V hj q.2).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.continuous_chartTransition
statement:
theorem continuous_chartTransition [PathConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    {y z : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) (V : SmallNeighborhood z) :
    Continuous (chartTransition H U V)
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuous_chartTransition_fst H U V).prodMk
    (isLocallyConstant_chartTransitionFiber H U V).continuous

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.continuous_chartInvDiscrete
statement:
theorem continuous_chartInvDiscrete [PathConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) :
    @Continuous
      (U.carrier × WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y))
      (ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier)
      inferInstance
      (@instTopologicalSpaceSubtype
        (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H)
        (fun q => CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q ∈ U.carrier)
        (coveringSubgroupTopology H))
      (chartInvDiscrete H U)
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) := coveringSubgroupTopology H
  rw [continuous_induced_rng]
  change Continuous (fun q => (chartInvDiscrete H U q).1)
  rw [continuous_generateFrom_iff]
  intro s hs
  rcases hs with ⟨z, V, w, hw, rfl⟩
  let overlap : Set
      (U.carrier × WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y)) :=
    {q | q.1.1 ∈ V.carrier}
  have hopen_overlap : IsOpen overlap := by
    exact V.isOpen.preimage
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst : Continuous (fun q :
        U.carrier × WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y) => q.1)))
  let toOverlap : overlap → ChartOverlap H U V := fun q =>
    (⟨q.1.1.1, q.1.1.2, q.2⟩, q.1.2)
  have htoOverlap : Continuous toOverlap := by
    exact ((continuous_subtype_val.comp
      (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val)).subtype_mk _).prodMk
        (continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have htransition : Continuous (fun q : overlap => chartTransition H U V (toOverlap q)) :=
    (continuous_chartTransition H U V).comp htoOverlap
  let t : Set overlap := {q | chartTransition H U V (toOverlap q) ∈ w}
  have htopen : IsOpen t := hw.preimage htransition
  have himage_open : IsOpen (Subtype.val '' t) :=
    (hopen_overlap.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen.mp htopen)
  convert himage_open using 1
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hqV, hqw⟩
    have hqV' : q.1.1 ∈ V.carrier := by
      simpa [chartInvDiscrete, projection_chartInv] using hqV
    let oq : overlap := ⟨q, hqV'⟩
    refine ⟨oq, ?_, rfl⟩
    change chartTransition H U V (toOverlap oq) ∈ w
    simpa [toOverlap, chartTransition, chartInvDiscrete, chartToDiscrete] using hqw
  · rintro ⟨oq, hoqw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have ho : oq.1.1.1 ∈ V.carrier := oq.2
      unfold chartInvDiscrete
      rw [projection_chartInv]
      exact ho
    change chartToDiscrete H V
      ⟨(chartInvDiscrete H U oq.1).1, ?_⟩ ∈ w
    simpa [t, toOverlap, chartTransition, chartInvDiscrete, chartToDiscrete] using hoqw

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.chart_homeomorph
statement:
theorem chart_homeomorph [PathConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) :
    Nonempty
      (@Homeomorph
        (ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier)
        (U.carrier × WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y))
        (@instTopologicalSpaceSubtype
          (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H)
          (fun q => CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q ∈ U.carrier)
          (coveringSubgroupTopology H))
        inferInstance)
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) := coveringSubgroupTopology H
  exact ⟨{
    toEquiv := chartEquivDiscrete H U
    continuous_toFun := continuous_chartToDiscrete H U
    continuous_invFun := continuous_chartInvDiscrete H U }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.isOpen_projection_preimage_smallNeighborhood
statement:
theorem isOpen_projection_preimage_smallNeighborhood [PathConnectedSpace X]
    {y : X} (U : SmallNeighborhood y) :
    @IsOpen
      (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H)
      (coveringSubgroupTopology H)
      ((CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H) ⁻¹' U.carrier)
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem
  refine ⟨y, U, Set.univ, isOpen_univ, ?_⟩
  ext q
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ]
  constructor
  · intro hq
    exact ⟨hq, trivial⟩
  · rintro ⟨hq, -⟩
    exact hq

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CoveringSubgroupCanonicalChart.coveringSubgroupProjection_isCoveringMap
statement:
theorem coveringSubgroupProjection_isCoveringMap [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X]
    [PathConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] :
    @IsCoveringMap
      (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) X
      (coveringSubgroupTopology H) inferInstance
      (CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H)
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (CoveringSubgroupPathClass x0 H) := coveringSubgroupTopology H
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U⟩ := exists_smallNeighborhood y
  have hfixed : IsEvenlyCovered
      (CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H) y
      (WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y)) := by
    let e : (ProjectionPreimage H U.carrier) ≃ₜ
        (U.carrier × WithDiscreteTopology (FixedPathClass H y)) := {
      toEquiv := chartEquivDiscrete H U
      continuous_toFun := continuous_chartToDiscrete H U
      continuous_invFun := continuous_chartInvDiscrete H U }
    refine ⟨inferInstance, U.carrier, U.center_mem, U.isOpen,
      isOpen_projection_preimage_smallNeighborhood H U, e, ?_⟩
    intro q
    change (chartToDiscrete H U q).1.1 =
      CoveringSubgroupPathClass.projection H q.1
    exact chartTo_fst H U q
  exact hfixed.to_isEvenlyCovered_preimage

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_contDiffTwo_approx_eqOn_mapsTo_open
statement:
theorem exists_contDiffTwo_approx_eqOn_mapsTo_open
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → E) (hf : Continuous f) {S V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {U : Set E}
    (hS : IsClosed S) (hV : V ∈ nhdsSet S) (hfV : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f V)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hfU : MapsTo f closedUnitSquare U) :
    ∃ g : ℝ × ℝ → E,
      ContDiff ℝ 2 g ∧ EqOn g f S ∧ MapsTo g closedUnitSquare U
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : IsCompact closedUnitSquare := isCompact_Icc
  have hK : IsCompact (f '' closedUnitSquare) := hQ.image hf
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ :=
    hK.exists_cthickening_subset_open hU (image_subset_iff.mpr hfU)
  obtain ⟨g, hgC2, hgclose, hgS, _⟩ :=
    hf.exists_contDiff_approx_and_eqOn 2 continuous_const (fun _ ↦ hδpos) hS hV hfV
  refine ⟨g, hgC2, hgS, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  apply hδ
  exact Metric.mem_cthickening_of_dist_le (g z) (f z) δ (f '' closedUnitSquare)
    ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ (le_of_lt (hgclose z))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary_standardExtension_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary_standardExtension_contDiffOn
    {x y : E} {p q : Path x y} (F : p.Homotopy q)
    (f g : ℝ × ℝ → E) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g)
    (hfF : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, f (z.1, z.2) = F z)
    (hgf : EqOn g f closedUnitSquareBoundary) :
    let H := pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary F f g hg.continuous hfF hgf
    ContDiffOn ℝ 2
      (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Set.IccExtend zero_le_one (H.toHomotopy.extend xy.1) xy.2)
      (Icc 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  let H := pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary F f g hg.continuous hfF hgf
  apply hg.contDiffOn.congr
  intro xy hxy
  have hx1 : xy.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hxy.1.1, hxy.2.1⟩
  have hx2 : xy.2 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hxy.1.2, hxy.2.2⟩
  rw [Set.IccExtend_of_mem zero_le_one _ hx2]
  rw [H.toHomotopy.extend_apply_of_mem_I hx1]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.exists_contDiffTwo_pathHomotopy_of_boundaryCollar
statement:
theorem exists_contDiffTwo_pathHomotopy_of_boundaryCollar
    {x y : E} {p q : Path x y} (F : p.Homotopy q)
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hfF : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, f (z.1, z.2) = F z)
    {V : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hV : V ∈ nhdsSet closedUnitSquareBoundary)
    (hfV : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f V) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hFU : ∀ s t : unitInterval, F (s, t) ∈ U) :
    ∃ H : p.Homotopy q,
      (∀ s t : unitInterval, H (s, t) ∈ U) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2
        (fun xy : ℝ × ℝ ↦ Set.IccExtend zero_le_one (H.toHomotopy.extend xy.1) xy.2)
        (Icc 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfU : MapsTo f closedUnitSquare U := by
    intro z hz
    let s : unitInterval := ⟨z.1, hz.1.1, hz.2.1⟩
    let t : unitInterval := ⟨z.2, hz.1.2, hz.2.2⟩
    rw [hfF (s, t)]
    exact hFU s t
  obtain ⟨g, hgC2, hgf, hgU⟩ := exists_contDiffTwo_approx_eqOn_mapsTo_open
    f hf isClosed_closedUnitSquareBoundary hV hfV hU hfU
  let H := pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary F f g hgC2.continuous hfF hgf
  refine ⟨H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s t
    exact hgU (x := (s.1, t.1)) ⟨⟨s.2.1, t.2.1⟩, ⟨s.2.2, t.2.2⟩⟩
  · exact pathHomotopyOfEqOnSquareBoundary_standardExtension_contDiffOn
      F f g hgC2 hfF hgf

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.edgeTransitions_gridVertex_square_apply_frame

private theorem edgeTransitions_gridVertex_square_apply_frame
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (horizontalBottom verticalRight verticalLeft horizontalTop : EdgeTransitions G)
    (hSquare : verticalRight.startChange * horizontalBottom.endChange =
      horizontalTop.startChange * verticalLeft.endChange)
    (frame : G) :
    verticalRight.startChange * (horizontalBottom.endChange * frame) =

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralInternalTransitions_apply_frame
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.centralInternalTransitions_apply_frame
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (frame : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    let HB := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal
    let VR := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      k j l hVertical
    let VL := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hVertical
    let HT := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal
    VR.startChange * (HB.endChange * frame) =
      HT.startChange * (VL.endChange * frame)
proof:
:= by
  apply edgeTransitions_gridVertex_square_apply_frame
  exact D.centralInternalTransitions_square hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i k j l hHorizontal hVertical

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.horizontalCellFramesCompatible_liftAcrossVertical
statement:
theorem horizontalCellFramesCompatible_liftAcrossVertical
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (horizontalBottom horizontalTop verticalLeft verticalRight : EdgeTransitions G)
    (leftLower rightLower : CellVertexFrames G)
    (leftUpperTopRight leftUpperTopLeft rightUpperTopRight rightUpperTopLeft : G)
    (hLower : HorizontalCellFramesCompatible horizontalBottom leftLower rightLower)
    (hSquare : verticalRight.startChange * horizontalBottom.endChange =
      horizontalTop.startChange * verticalLeft.endChange)
    (hUpperTop : rightUpperTopLeft =
      horizontalTop.endChange * leftUpperTopRight) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible horizontalTop
      (leftLower.liftAcrossVertical verticalLeft leftUpperTopRight leftUpperTopLeft)
      (rightLower.liftAcrossVertical verticalRight rightUpperTopRight rightUpperTopLeft)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change verticalRight.startChange * rightLower.topLeft =
      horizontalTop.startChange * (verticalLeft.endChange * leftLower.topRight)
    rw [hLower.top]
    exact edgeTransitions_gridVertex_square_apply_frame
      horizontalBottom verticalRight verticalLeft horizontalTop hSquare leftLower.topRight
  · exact hUpperTop

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState_leftEdge
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState_leftEdge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)
    (frames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k)) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      (D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j frames hcompat p hp).leftEdge =
      rebaseEdge (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).bottomLeft
        (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece
            hxU hxV hU hV ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ j 0))
proof:
| 0, _ => rfl
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      change
        (D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          j frames hcompat p hp').leftEdge = _
      exact D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState_leftEdge
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat p hp'

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState_leftEdge
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState_leftEdge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)
    (frames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k)) :
    (D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      j frames hcompat).leftEdge =
      rebaseEdge (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).bottomLeft
        (frames ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩).topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece
            hxU hxV hU hV ⟨0, D.steps_pos⟩ j 0))
proof:
:= by
  exact D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState_leftEdge
    hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat
    (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps)
    (frames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
        (frames i) (frames k)) :
    let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat
    S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus *
        (S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := D.framedHorizontalFullRowState hxU hxV hUV hU hV j frames hcompat
  have h := S.boundary.relation
  rw [S.before_eq] at h
  have hblocks : S.bottomPrefix *
      (S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus * S.boundary.after) = 1 := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using h
  have hrot := mul_eq_one_rotate S.bottomPrefix
    (S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus * S.boundary.after) hblocks
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hrot

  · rfl
