name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j : Fin D.steps) (i k : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hshared)
      (D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j i)
      (D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV j k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨iv, hiv⟩
  rcases k with ⟨kv, hkv⟩
  have hval : iv + 1 = kv := congrArg Fin.val hshared
  change iv + 1 = kv at hval
  subst kv
  constructor
  · rw [D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames_bottomRight]
    simp only [mul_one]
    rfl
  · rw [D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames_topRight]
    simp only [mul_one]
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.liftHorizontalRowFrames_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.liftHorizontalRowFrames_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (j l : Fin D.steps) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (lowerFrames : Fin D.steps → CellVertexFrames
      (binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV))
    (hLower : ∀ (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
        (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k))
    (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
      (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
      (D.liftHorizontalRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j l hVertical lowerFrames i)
      (D.liftHorizontalRowFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j l hVertical lowerFrames k)
proof:
:= by
  apply horizontalCellFramesCompatible_liftAcrossVertical
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k j hHorizontal)
    (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i k l hHorizontal)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV i j l hVertical)
    (D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV k j l hVertical)
    (lowerFrames i) (lowerFrames k)
    ((D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l i).topRight)
    ((D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l i).topLeft)
    ((D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l k).topRight)
    ((D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames hxU hxV hUV hU hV l k).topLeft)
  · exact hLower i k hHorizontal
  · exact D.centralInternalTransitions_square hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical
  · exact (D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      l i k hHorizontal).top

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowFramesAt_compatible
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowFramesAt_compatible
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps)
      (i k : Fin D.steps) (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc),
      HorizontalCellFramesCompatible
        (D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          i k ⟨p, hp⟩ hHorizontal)
        (D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i)
        (D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp k)
proof:
| 0, hp, i, k, hHorizontal =>
      D.canonicalHorizontalCellFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨0, hp⟩ i k hHorizontal
  | p + 1, hp, i, k, hHorizontal => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
      let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
      have hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
      apply D.liftHorizontalRowFrames_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        j l hVertical (D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp')
      · intro i' k' hHorizontal'
        exact D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV
          p hp' i' k' hHorizontal'

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFramedFullRowStateAt_standard_relation
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFramedFullRowStateAt_standard_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps) :
    let S := D.gridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
    S.leftEdge⁻¹ * S.topWord⁻¹ * S.boundary.focus *
        (S.boundary.after * S.bottomPrefix) = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact D.framedHorizontalFullRowState_standard_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    ⟨p, hp⟩ (D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)
    (D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < D.steps) (i : Fin D.steps) :
    let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
    let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
    let lower := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp' i
    let upper := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp i
    rebaseEdge lower.topLeft lower.topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) =
      rebaseEdge upper.bottomLeft upper.bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
proof:
:= by
  let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
  let j : Fin D.steps := ⟨p, hp'⟩
  let l : Fin D.steps := ⟨p + 1, hp⟩
  have hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc := by apply Fin.ext; rfl
  let lowerFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
  have h := D.verticalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i j l hVertical (lowerFrames i).topLeft (lowerFrames i).topRight
  simpa [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowFramesAt,
    BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.liftHorizontalRowFrames,
    CellVertexFrames.liftAcrossVertical, lowerFrames, j, l, hp'] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFramedRowPrefix_topWord_eq_next_bottomWord
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFramedRowPrefix_topWord_eq_next_bottomWord
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < D.steps) :
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : q < D.steps),
    let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let lowerFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
    let upperFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
    let lower := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      ⟨p, hp'⟩ lowerFrames
      (D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp') q hq
    let upper := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ upperFrames
      (D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp) q hq
    lower.topWord = upper.boundary.after * upper.bottomPrefix
proof:
| 0, hq => by
      let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      let i : Fin D.steps := ⟨0, hq⟩
      let lowerFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
      let upperFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
      let lower := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp'⟩ lowerFrames
        (D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp') 0 hq
      let upper := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ upperFrames
        (D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp) 0 hq
      change lower.topWord = upper.boundary.after * upper.bottomPrefix
      rw [upper.after_eq]
      change rebaseEdge (lowerFrames i).topLeft (lowerFrames i).topRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p, hp'⟩)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p, hp'⟩ 1)) =
        rebaseEdge (upperFrames i).bottomLeft (upperFrames i).bottomRight
          (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i ⟨p + 1, hp⟩)
            (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ 0)) * 1
      simpa using D.gridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp i
  | q + 1, hq => by
      have hq' : q < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self q) hq
      let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      let lowerFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
      let upperFrames := D.gridRowFramesAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
      let lowerCompat := D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
      let upperCompat := D.gridRowFramesAt_compatible hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
      let lowerPrev := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp'⟩ lowerFrames lowerCompat q hq'
      let upperPrev := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ upperFrames upperCompat q hq'
      let lowerNext := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p, hp'⟩ lowerFrames lowerCompat (q + 1) hq
      let upperNext := D.framedHorizontalRowPrefixState hxU hxV hUV hU hV
        ⟨p + 1, hp⟩ upperFrames upperCompat (q + 1) hq
      let k : Fin D.steps := ⟨q + 1, hq⟩
      have ih := D.gridFramedRowPrefix_topWord_eq_next_bottomWord
        hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp q hq'
      have hedge := D.gridRowFramesAt_vertical_edge hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp k
      have hLowerTop : lowerNext.topWord =
          rebaseEdge (lowerFrames k).topLeft (lowerFrames k).topRight
            (Monoid.PushoutI.of
              (D.label k ⟨p, hp'⟩)
              (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV
                k ⟨p, hp'⟩ 1)) * lowerPrev.topWord := by
        rfl
      have hUpperPrefix : upperNext.bottomPrefix =
          upperPrev.boundary.after * upperPrev.bottomPrefix := by
        rfl
      change lowerNext.topWord = upperNext.boundary.after * upperNext.bottomPrefix
      change lowerPrev.topWord =
        upperPrev.boundary.after * upperPrev.bottomPrefix at ih
      rw [hLowerTop, upperNext.after_eq, hUpperPrefix]
      rw [hedge, ih]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFramedFullRow_topWord_eq_next_bottomWord
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridFramedFullRow_topWord_eq_next_bottomWord
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p + 1 < D.steps) :
    let hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
    let lower := D.gridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
    let upper := D.gridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
    lower.topWord = upper.boundary.after * upper.bottomPrefix
proof:
:= by
  exact D.gridFramedRowPrefix_topWord_eq_next_bottomWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    p hp (D.steps - 1) (Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.twoRowBoundaries_glue
statement:
private theorem twoRowBoundaries_glue
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (lowerLeft lowerTop lowerRight lowerBottom : G)
    (upperLeft upperTop upperRight upperBottom : G)
    (hLower : lowerLeft⁻¹ * lowerTop⁻¹ * lowerRight * lowerBottom = 1)
    (hUpper : upperLeft⁻¹ * upperTop⁻¹ * upperRight * upperBottom = 1)
    (hshared : upperBottom = lowerTop) :
    lowerLeft⁻¹ * upperLeft⁻¹ * upperTop⁻¹ * upperRight *
        lowerRight * lowerBottom = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hglue := twoCellBoundary_glue
    lowerLeft⁻¹ lowerTop⁻¹ (lowerRight * lowerBottom)
    (upperLeft⁻¹ * upperTop⁻¹ * upperRight) 1
    (by simpa [mul_assoc] using hLower)
    (by rw [inv_inv, ← hshared]; simpa [mul_assoc] using hUpper)
  have hrotate := mul_eq_one_rotate
    ((upperLeft⁻¹ * upperTop⁻¹ * upperRight) * (lowerRight * lowerBottom))
    lowerLeft⁻¹ (by simpa [mul_assoc] using hglue)
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hrotate

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt_leftWord
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt_leftWord
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      (D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp).leftWord =
        D.gridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
proof:
| 0, _ => rfl
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      let upper := D.gridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
      change upper.leftEdge *
          (D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp').leftWord =
        upper.leftEdge * D.gridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
      rw [D.gridRowPrefixStateAt_leftWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp']

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt_rightWord
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt_rightWord
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      (D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp).rightWord =
        D.gridRightBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp
proof:
| 0, _ => rfl
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      let upper := D.gridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV (p + 1) hp
      change upper.boundary.focus *
          (D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp').rightWord =
        upper.boundary.focus * D.gridRightBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'
      rw [D.gridRowPrefixStateAt_rightWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp']

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt_bottomWord
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt_bottomWord
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p < D.steps),
      (D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp).bottomWord =
        D.gridBottomBoundaryWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV
proof:
| 0, hp => by
      simp only [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridRowPrefixStateAt,
        BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridBottomBoundaryWord]
  | p + 1, hp => by
      have hp' : p < D.steps := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp
      change (D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp').bottomWord = _
      exact D.gridRowPrefixStateAt_bottomWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV p hp'

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridPerimeterWords_standard_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridPerimeterWords_standard_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V) :
    let last : ℕ := D.steps - 1
    let hlast : last < D.steps := Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one
    (D.gridLeftBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast)⁻¹ *
        (D.gridTopBoundaryWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV)⁻¹ *
        D.gridRightBoundaryWordAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast *
        D.gridBottomBoundaryWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV = 1
proof:
:= by
  let last : ℕ := D.steps - 1
  let hlast : last < D.steps := Nat.sub_lt D.steps_pos Nat.zero_lt_one
  let S := D.gridRowPrefixStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast
  let top := D.gridFramedFullRowStateAt hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast
  dsimp only
  rw [← D.gridRowPrefixStateAt_leftWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast,
    ← D.gridRowPrefixStateAt_rightWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast,
    ← D.gridRowPrefixStateAt_bottomWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV last hlast]
  exact S.relation

        D.gridBottomBoundaryWord hxU hxV hUV hU hV = 1

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.twoCellBoundary_glue
statement:
theorem twoCellBoundary_glue
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (beforeL shared afterL beforeR afterR : G)
    (hL : beforeL * shared * afterL = 1)
    (hR : beforeR * shared⁻¹ * afterR = 1) :
    beforeR * afterL * beforeL * afterR = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hshared : shared = beforeL⁻¹ * afterL⁻¹ := by
    calc
      shared = beforeL⁻¹ * (beforeL * shared * afterL) * afterL⁻¹ := by
        simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = beforeL⁻¹ * afterL⁻¹ := by rw [hL]; simp
  calc
    beforeR * afterL * beforeL * afterR =
        beforeR * shared⁻¹ * afterR := by rw [hshared]; simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := hR

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_cycle_four

    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (t₀ t₁ t₂ t₃ e₀ e₁ e₂ e₃ : G) :
    rebaseEdge t₃ t₀ e₃ * rebaseEdge t₂ t₃ e₂ *
          rebaseEdge t₁ t₂ e₁ * rebaseEdge t₀ t₁ e₀ =

    (hR : endR⁻¹ * commonR * startR = cellR)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_pushout_rebase
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalSwitchEdge_pushout_rebase
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label k j) :
    let CL := D.horizontalSwitchLeftConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    let CR := D.horizontalSwitchRightConnectorComparison hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.startChange)⁻¹ *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.startChange)
        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j) CR.endChange)⁻¹ *
          Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) CL.endChange)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [D.horizontalSwitchEdge_pushout_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i k j hshared hswitch]
  simp [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_pushout_rebase

      i j l hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)

        ((Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l) CT.startChange)⁻¹ *

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdge_pushout_rebase
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdge_pushout_rebase
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (hlabel : D.label i j = D.label k j) :
    let C := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hshared hlabel
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.startChange)⁻¹
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j) C.endChange)⁻¹
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let C := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
    i k j hshared hlabel
  let f := (Monoid.PushoutI.of
      (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) (D.label i j) :
      FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V (D.label i j))
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV (D.label i j)) →*
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV)
  have h := congrArg f
    (D.horizontalCommonEdge_pieceElements_relation hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hshared hlabel)
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv] at h
  rw [D.pushout_verticalEdgeOfLabel_eq hxU hxV hU hV
    k j 0 (D.label i j) hlabel.symm] at h
  apply eq_rebaseEdge_of_rebaseEdge_eq (f C.startChange) (f C.endChange)
  simpa [rebaseEdge] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdge_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdge_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc) :
    let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =

          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0))

  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_pos hlabel]
    exact D.horizontalCommonEdge_relation_transitions hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hshared hlabel
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_neg hlabel]
    exact D.horizontalSwitchEdge_relation_transitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV

      i j l hshared hlabel
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge T.startChange T.endChange
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
proof:
:= by
  exact D.verticalCommonEdge_pushout_rebase hxU hxV hU hV
    i j l hshared hlabel

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_relation_transitions
statement:
private theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalSwitchEdge_relation_transitions
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hswitch : D.label i j ≠ D.label i l) :
    let T := D.verticalSwitchEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hswitch
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge T.startChange T.endChange
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
proof:
:= by
  exact D.verticalSwitchEdge_pushout_rebase hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i j l hshared hswitch

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdge_relation
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdge_relation
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc) :
    let T := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared
    (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
        (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1) :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) =
      rebaseEdge T.startChange T.endChange
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlabel : D.label i j = D.label i l
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_pos hlabel]
    exact D.verticalCommonEdge_relation_transitions hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hshared hlabel
  · rw [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions,
      dif_neg hlabel]
    exact D.verticalSwitchEdge_relation_transitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared hlabel

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod
statement:
theorem reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (chain : List (G × G)) :
    reverseEdgeChainProduct chain = (chain.map Prod.snd).reverse.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction chain with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head rest ih =>
      rcases head with ⟨endChange, edge⟩
      simp only [reverseEdgeChainProduct, List.map_cons, List.reverse_cons,
        List.prod_append, List.prod_singleton]
      rw [ih]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.reverseEdgeChainProduct_append
statement:
theorem reverseEdgeChainProduct_append
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (first second : List (G × G)) :
    reverseEdgeChainProduct (first ++ second) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct second * reverseEdgeChainProduct first
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod,
    reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod,
    reverseEdgeChainProduct_eq_reverse_map_snd_prod]
  simp [List.prod_append]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.edgeChainEnd_ofFn_succ
statement:
private theorem edgeChainEnd_ofFn_succ
    {G : Type*} (n : ℕ) (startChange : G)
    (endChange edge : Fin (n + 1) → G) :
    edgeChainEnd startChange (List.ofFn fun k => (endChange k, edge k)) =
      endChange (Fin.last n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing startChange with
  | zero => simp [edgeChainEnd, List.ofFn_succ]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, edgeChainEnd]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.finLastOfPos_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem finLastOfPos_succ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n + 1) :
    finLastOfPos (n + 1) hn = Fin.last n
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp [finLastOfPos]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.edgeChainEnd_ofFn_of_pos
statement:
theorem edgeChainEnd_ofFn_of_pos
    {G : Type*} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (startChange : G)
    (endChange edge : Fin n → G) :
    edgeChainEnd startChange (List.ofFn fun k => (endChange k, edge k)) =
      endChange (finLastOfPos n hn)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn).elim
  | succ n =>
      simpa using edgeChainEnd_ofFn_succ n startChange endChange edge

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_rebaseEdge
statement:
theorem rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_rebaseEdge
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (startChange : G) (chain : List (G × G)) :
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct startChange chain =
      rebaseEdge startChange (edgeChainEnd startChange chain)
        (reverseEdgeChainProduct chain)
proof:
:= by
  induction chain generalizing startChange with
  | nil => simp [rebasedEdgeChainProduct, edgeChainEnd,
      reverseEdgeChainProduct, rebaseEdge]
  | cons head rest ih =>
      rcases head with ⟨endChange, edge⟩
      rw [rebasedEdgeChainProduct, ih]
      rw [reverseEdgeChainProduct, edgeChainEnd]
      exact rebaseEdge_mul startChange endChange
        (edgeChainEnd endChange rest) edge (reverseEdgeChainProduct rest)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_conj_of_end_eq
statement:
theorem rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_conj_of_end_eq
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (startChange : G) (chain : List (G × G))
    (hend : edgeChainEnd startChange chain = startChange) :
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct startChange chain =
      startChange⁻¹ * reverseEdgeChainProduct chain * startChange
proof:
:= by
  rw [rebasedEdgeChainProduct_eq_rebaseEdge, hend]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct
statement:
private theorem rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (n : ℕ)
    (startFrame endFrame edge : Fin (n + 1) → G)
    (hadj : ∀ k : Fin n, endFrame k.castSucc = startFrame k.succ) :
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct (startFrame 0)
        (List.ofFn fun k => (endFrame k, edge k)) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (List.ofFn fun k =>
          (endFrame k, rebaseEdge (startFrame k) (endFrame k) (edge k)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [rebasedEdgeChainProduct, reverseEdgeChainProduct]
  | succ n ih =>
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [List.ofFn_succ]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [List.ofFn_succ]
      rw [rebasedEdgeChainProduct, reverseEdgeChainProduct]
      have hfirst : endFrame 0 = startFrame (Fin.succ 0) := hadj 0
      rw [hfirst]
      rw [ih
        (startFrame := fun k => startFrame k.succ)
        (endFrame := fun k => endFrame k.succ)
        (edge := fun k => edge k.succ)
        (hadj := fun k => hadj k.succ)]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct_of_pos
statement:
theorem rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct_of_pos
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (startFrame endFrame edge : Fin n → G)
    (hadj : ∀ (s t : Fin n), s.succ = t.castSucc →
      endFrame s = startFrame t) :
    rebasedEdgeChainProduct (startFrame ⟨0, hn⟩)
        (List.ofFn fun k => (endFrame k, edge k)) =
      reverseEdgeChainProduct
        (List.ofFn fun k =>
          (endFrame k, rebaseEdge (startFrame k) (endFrame k) (edge k)))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn).elim
  | succ n =>
      exact rebasedEdgeChainProduct_ofFn_eq_reverseEdgeChainProduct n
        startFrame endFrame edge
        (fun k => hadj k.castSucc k.succ (Fin.succ_castSucc k))

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod
statement:
theorem reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod
    {G : Type*} [Group G] : ∀ {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → G),
    Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => G) (fun i acc => a i * acc) 1 =
      (List.ofFn a).reverse.prod
proof:
| 0, a => by simp [Fin.dfoldl_zero]
  | n + 1, a => by
      rw [Fin.dfoldl_succ_last]
      rw [List.ofFn_succ']
      change a (Fin.last n) *
          Fin.dfoldl n (fun _ => G) (fun i acc => a i.castSucc * acc) 1 = _
      rw [reverseDfoldl_eq_reverse_ofFn_prod (fun i => a i.castSucc)]
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseCellBoundary
statement:
private theorem rebaseCellBoundary
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topRight topLeft : G)
    (bottom right top left : G) :
    (rebaseEdge bottomLeft topLeft left)⁻¹ *
          (rebaseEdge topLeft topRight top)⁻¹ *
          rebaseEdge bottomRight topRight right *
          rebaseEdge bottomLeft bottomRight bottom =
      bottomLeft⁻¹ * (left⁻¹ * top⁻¹ * right * bottom) * bottomLeft
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rebaseEdge_inv bottomLeft topLeft left,
    ← rebaseEdge_inv topLeft topRight top]
  exact rebaseEdge_cycle_four bottomLeft bottomRight topRight topLeft
    bottom right top⁻¹ left⁻¹

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseCellBoundary_eq_one
statement:
private theorem rebaseCellBoundary_eq_one
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topRight topLeft : G)
    (bottom right top left : G)
    (hcell : left⁻¹ * top⁻¹ * right * bottom = 1) :
    (rebaseEdge bottomLeft topLeft left)⁻¹ *
          (rebaseEdge topLeft topRight top)⁻¹ *
          rebaseEdge bottomRight topRight right *
          rebaseEdge bottomLeft bottomRight bottom = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rebaseCellBoundary, hcell]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_rebase_eq_one
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_rebase_eq_one
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j : Fin D.steps)
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topRight topLeft :
      binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    (rebaseEdge bottomLeft topLeft
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)))⁻¹ *
      (rebaseEdge topLeft topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)))⁻¹ *
      rebaseEdge bottomRight topRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) *
      rebaseEdge bottomLeft bottomRight
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 0)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply rebaseCellBoundary_eq_one
  exact D.gridCellPushoutEdgeWord_eq_one hxU hxV hU hV i j

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_rebase
statement:
private theorem rebaseEdge_rebase
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (outerStart outerEnd innerStart innerEnd edge : G) :
    rebaseEdge outerStart outerEnd
        (rebaseEdge innerStart innerEnd edge) =
      rebaseEdge (innerStart * outerStart) (innerEnd * outerEnd) edge
proof:
:= by
  simp [rebaseEdge, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_relation_in_frame
statement:
theorem rebaseEdge_relation_in_frame
    {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (outerStart outerEnd innerStart innerEnd leftEdge rightEdge : G)
    (h : leftEdge = rebaseEdge innerStart innerEnd rightEdge) :
    rebaseEdge outerStart outerEnd leftEdge =
      rebaseEdge (innerStart * outerStart) (innerEnd * outerEnd) rightEdge
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, rebaseEdge_rebase]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j : Fin D.steps) (hshared : i.succ = k.castSucc)
    (bottomFrame topFrame : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    let T := D.horizontalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i k j hshared
    rebaseEdge bottomFrame topFrame
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) =
      rebaseEdge (T.startChange * bottomFrame) (T.endChange * topFrame)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label k j)
          (D.gridCellBasedVerticalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV k j 0))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  apply rebaseEdge_relation_in_frame
  exact D.horizontalInternalEdge_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i k j hshared

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalInternalEdge_relation_in_frame
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V) (hUV : IsPathConnected (U ∩ V))
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i j l : Fin D.steps) (hshared : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (leftFrame rightFrame : binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV) :
    let T := D.verticalInternalEdgeTransitions hxU hxV hUV hU hV
      i j l hshared
    rebaseEdge leftFrame rightFrame
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i j)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i j 1)) =
      rebaseEdge (T.startChange * leftFrame) (T.endChange * rightFrame)
        (Monoid.PushoutI.of (D.label i l)
          (D.gridCellBasedHorizontalEdgeInPiece hxU hxV hU hV i l 0))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  apply rebaseEdge_relation_in_frame
  exact D.verticalInternalEdge_relation hxU hxV hUV hU hV
    i j l hshared

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.connectorChange_mul
statement:
theorem connectorChange_mul {x₀ z : X}
    (first middle last : Path x₀ z) :
    connectorChange middle last * connectorChange first middle =
      connectorChange first last
proof:
:= by
  unfold connectorChange
  rw [Path.correctedLoop_product first (Path.refl z) middle (Path.refl z) last]
  unfold Path.correctedLoop FundamentalGroup.fromPath FundamentalGroup.fromArrow
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.connectorChange_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem connectorChange_self {x₀ z : X} (q : Path x₀ z) :
    connectorChange q q = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [FundamentalGroup.one_def]
  unfold connectorChange Path.correctedLoop FundamentalGroup.fromPath
    FundamentalGroup.fromArrow
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.connectorChange_reverse
statement:
theorem connectorChange_reverse {x₀ z : X} (p q : Path x₀ z) :
    connectorChange q p = (connectorChange p q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
  rw [connectorChange_mul]
  exact connectorChange_self p

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.fundamentalGroup_map_connectorChange
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroup_map_connectorChange
    {S T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [TopologicalSpace T]
    (f : C(S, T)) {base z : S} (p q : Path base z) :
    FundamentalGroup.map f base (connectorChange p q) =
      connectorChange (p.map f.continuous) (q.map f.continuous)
proof:
:= by
  unfold connectorChange
  rw [fundamentalGroup_map_correctedLoop]
  congr 1

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_connectorChange_mul
statement:
theorem map_connectorChange_mul
    {S G : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [Group G] {base z : S}
    (f : FundamentalGroup S base →* G)
    (first middle last : Path base z) :
    f (connectorChange middle last) * f (connectorChange first middle) =
      f (connectorChange first last)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_mul, connectorChange_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.startChange_eq_connectorChange
statement:
theorem CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.startChange_eq_connectorChange
    {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] {base : S}
    (C : CommonEdgeConnectorComparison S base) :
    C.startChange = connectorChange C.rightStart C.leftStart
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.endChange_eq_connectorChange
statement:
theorem CommonEdgeConnectorComparison.endChange_eq_connectorChange
    {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] {base : S}
    (C : CommonEdgeConnectorComparison S base) :
    C.endChange = connectorChange C.rightEnd C.leftEnd
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.connectorChange_square
statement:
theorem connectorChange_square {x₀ z : X}
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topLeft topRight : Path x₀ z) :
    connectorChange topLeft topRight * connectorChange bottomLeft topLeft =
      connectorChange bottomRight topRight * connectorChange bottomLeft bottomRight
proof:
:= by
  rw [connectorChange_mul, connectorChange_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_connectorChange_square
statement:
private theorem map_connectorChange_square
    {S G : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [Group G] {base z : S}
    (f : FundamentalGroup S base →* G)
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topLeft topRight : Path base z) :
    f (connectorChange topLeft topRight) * f (connectorChange bottomLeft topLeft) =
      f (connectorChange bottomRight topRight) *
        f (connectorChange bottomLeft bottomRight)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, connectorChange_square]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebaseEdge_transitionFromPotentials
statement:
@[simp] theorem rebaseEdge_transitionFromPotentials
    {G : Type*} [Group G] (sourcePotential targetPotential : G) :
    rebaseEdge sourcePotential targetPotential
      (transitionFromPotentials sourcePotential targetPotential) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rebaseEdge, transitionFromPotentials]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.connectorChange_eq_transitionFromPotentials
statement:
theorem connectorChange_eq_transitionFromPotentials
    {x₀ z : X} (reference startConnector endConnector : Path x₀ z) :
    connectorChange startConnector endConnector =
      transitionFromPotentials
        (connectorChange reference startConnector)
        (connectorChange reference endConnector)
proof:
:= by
  unfold transitionFromPotentials
  calc
    connectorChange startConnector endConnector =
        connectorChange startConnector endConnector * 1 := by rw [mul_one]
    _ = connectorChange startConnector endConnector *
          (connectorChange reference startConnector *
            (connectorChange reference startConnector)⁻¹) := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel]
    _ = (connectorChange startConnector endConnector *
          connectorChange reference startConnector) *
            (connectorChange reference startConnector)⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = connectorChange reference endConnector *
          (connectorChange reference startConnector)⁻¹ := by
        congr 1
        exact connectorChange_mul reference startConnector endConnector

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.rebase_correctedLoop_refl_eq_one
statement:
theorem rebase_correctedLoop_refl_eq_one
    {x₀ z : X} (reference startConnector endConnector : Path x₀ z) :
    rebaseEdge
        (connectorChange reference startConnector)
        (connectorChange reference endConnector)
        (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector (Path.refl z) endConnector⟧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change rebaseEdge
      (connectorChange reference startConnector)
      (connectorChange reference endConnector)
      (connectorChange startConnector endConnector) = 1
  have hedge := connectorChange_eq_transitionFromPotentials
    reference startConnector endConnector
  rw [hedge]
  exact rebaseEdge_transitionFromPotentials
    (connectorChange reference startConnector)
    (connectorChange reference endConnector)

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_transitionFromPotentials
statement:
theorem map_transitionFromPotentials
    {G K : Type*} [Group G] [Group K] (f : G →* K) (source target : G) :
    f (transitionFromPotentials source target) =
      transitionFromPotentials (f source) (f target)
proof:
:= by
  simp [transitionFromPotentials]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_rebaseEdge
statement:
theorem map_rebaseEdge
    {G K : Type*} [Group G] [Group K] (f : G →* K)
    (startChange endChange edge : G) :
    f (rebaseEdge startChange endChange edge) =
      rebaseEdge (f startChange) (f endChange) (f edge)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rebaseEdge]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_rebase_correctedLoop_refl_eq_one
statement:
theorem map_rebase_correctedLoop_refl_eq_one
    {x₀ z : X} {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (f : FundamentalGroup X x₀ →* G)
    (reference startConnector endConnector : Path x₀ z) :
    rebaseEdge
        (f (connectorChange reference startConnector))
        (f (connectorChange reference endConnector))
        (f (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector (Path.refl z) endConnector⟧)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_rebaseEdge]
  rw [rebase_correctedLoop_refl_eq_one, map_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_segment_eq_refl
statement:
theorem map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_segment_eq_refl
    {x₀ z : X} {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (f : FundamentalGroup X x₀ →* G)
    (reference startConnector endConnector : Path x₀ z)
    (segment : Path z z) (hsegment : segment = Path.refl z) :
    rebaseEdge
        (f (connectorChange reference startConnector))
        (f (connectorChange reference endConnector))
        (f (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector segment endConnector⟧)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  subst segment
  exact map_rebase_correctedLoop_refl_eq_one
    f reference startConnector endConnector

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_cast_eq_refl
statement:
theorem map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_cast_eq_refl
    {x₀ z w r : X} {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (f : FundamentalGroup X x₀ →* G)
    (reference : Path x₀ r) (startConnector : Path x₀ z)
    (segment : Path z w) (endConnector : Path x₀ w)
    (hz : r = z) (hw : r = w)
    (hsegment : segment.cast hz hw = Path.refl r) :
    rebaseEdge
        (f (connectorChange reference (startConnector.cast rfl hz)))
        (f (connectorChange reference (endConnector.cast rfl hw)))
        (f (FundamentalGroup.fromPath
          ⟦Path.correctedLoop startConnector segment endConnector⟧)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_rebase_correctedLoop_eq_one_of_segment_eq_refl
    f reference (startConnector.cast rfl hz) (endConnector.cast rfl hw)
      (segment.cast hz hw) hsegment
  rw [correctedLoop_cast startConnector segment endConnector hz hw] at h
  exact h

    (sourceStart sourceEnd targetStart targetEnd edge : G) :

        (transitionFromPotentials sourceStart targetStart)

    {G : Type*} [Group G]

    (bottomLeft bottomRight topLeft topRight : G)
    (hHorizontalBottom : horizontalBottom.endChange =
      transitionFromPotentials bottomLeft bottomRight)
    (hVerticalRight : verticalRight.startChange =
      transitionFromPotentials bottomRight topRight)
    (hVerticalLeft : verticalLeft.endChange =
      transitionFromPotentials bottomLeft topLeft)
    (hHorizontalTop : horizontalTop.startChange =
      transitionFromPotentials topLeft topRight) :
    verticalRight.startChange * horizontalBottom.endChange =
      horizontalTop.startChange * verticalLeft.endChange

  rw [hHorizontalBottom, hVerticalRight, hVerticalLeft, hHorizontalTop]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.commonEdgeComparisons_gridVertex_square
statement:
private theorem commonEdgeComparisons_gridVertex_square
    {S G : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [Group G] {base z : S}
    (f : FundamentalGroup S base →* G)
    (horizontalBottom verticalRight verticalLeft horizontalTop :
      CommonEdgeConnectorComparison S base)
    (hHorizontalBottom : z = horizontalBottom.edgeTarget)
    (hVerticalRight : z = verticalRight.edgeSource)
    (hVerticalLeft : z = verticalLeft.edgeTarget)
    (hHorizontalTop : z = horizontalTop.edgeSource)
    (bottomLeft bottomRight topLeft topRight : Path base z)
    (hBottomLeft : horizontalBottom.leftEnd.cast rfl hHorizontalBottom = bottomLeft)
    (hBottomRight : horizontalBottom.rightEnd.cast rfl hHorizontalBottom = bottomRight)
    (hRightBottom : verticalRight.leftStart.cast rfl hVerticalRight = bottomRight)
    (hRightTop : verticalRight.rightStart.cast rfl hVerticalRight = topRight)
    (hLeftBottom : verticalLeft.leftEnd.cast rfl hVerticalLeft = bottomLeft)
    (hLeftTop : verticalLeft.rightEnd.cast rfl hVerticalLeft = topLeft)
    (hTopLeft : horizontalTop.leftStart.cast rfl hHorizontalTop = topLeft)
    (hTopRight : horizontalTop.rightStart.cast rfl hHorizontalTop = topRight) :
    (f verticalRight.startChange)⁻¹ * (f horizontalBottom.endChange)⁻¹ =
      (f horizontalTop.startChange)⁻¹ * (f verticalLeft.endChange)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalRight.map_startChange_inv, horizontalBottom.map_endChange_inv,
    horizontalTop.map_startChange_inv, verticalLeft.map_endChange_inv]
  rw [← connectorChange_cast verticalRight.leftStart verticalRight.rightStart hVerticalRight,
    ← connectorChange_cast horizontalBottom.leftEnd horizontalBottom.rightEnd hHorizontalBottom,
    ← connectorChange_cast horizontalTop.leftStart horizontalTop.rightStart hHorizontalTop,
    ← connectorChange_cast verticalLeft.leftEnd verticalLeft.rightEnd hVerticalLeft]
  rw [hBottomLeft, hBottomRight, hRightBottom, hRightTop,
    hLeftBottom, hLeftTop, hTopLeft, hTopRight]
  exact (map_connectorChange_square f bottomLeft bottomRight topLeft topRight).symm

    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (hBottom : D.label i j = D.label k j)
    (hRight : D.label k j = D.label k l) :
    let HB := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal hBottom
    let VR := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison hxU hxV hU hV
      k j l hVertical hRight
    HB.edgeTarget = hBottom.symm ▸ VR.edgeSource
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [coe_binaryOpenCoverPiece_label_cast]
  · simp [BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison,
      BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparison,
      squareGridVertex, hHorizontal]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.commonCentralTransition_square_of_label
statement:
theorem BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision.commonCentralTransition_square_of_label
    {x₀ : X} {H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, X)} {U V : Set X}
    (D : BinaryOpenCoverSquareSubdivision H U V)
    (hxU : x₀ ∈ U) (hxV : x₀ ∈ V)
    (hU : IsPathConnected U) (hV : IsPathConnected V)
    (i k j l : Fin D.steps)
    (hHorizontal : i.succ = k.castSucc) (hVertical : j.succ = l.castSucc)
    (b : Bool)
    (hBL : D.label i j = b) (hBR : D.label k j = b)
    (hTL : D.label i l = b) (hTR : D.label k l = b) :
    let HB := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j hHorizontal b hBL hBR
    let VR := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      k j l hVertical b hBR hTR
    let VL := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i j l hVertical b hBL hTL
    let HT := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
      i k l hHorizontal b hTL hTR
    let f : FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
        (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b) →* binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
      Monoid.PushoutI.of (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) b
    (f VR.startChange)⁻¹ * (f HB.endChange)⁻¹ =
      (f HT.startChange)⁻¹ * (f VL.endChange)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let HB := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i k j hHorizontal b hBL hBR
  let VR := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    k j l hVertical b hBR hTR
  let VL := D.verticalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i j l hVertical b hBL hTL
  let HT := D.horizontalCommonEdgeConnectorComparisonOfLabel hxU hxV hU hV
    i k l hHorizontal b hTL hTR
  let f : FundamentalGroup (binaryOpenCoverPiece U V b)
      (binaryOpenCoverBasepoint hxU hxV b) →* binaryVanKampenPushout U V hxU hxV :=
    Monoid.PushoutI.of (φ := binaryOpenCoverIntersectionMaps U V hxU hxV) b
  let hright := D.commonCentralVertexOfLabel_horizontalBottom_verticalRight
    hxU hxV hU hV i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTR
  let hleft := D.commonCentralVertexOfLabel_horizontalBottom_verticalLeft
    hxU hxV hU hV i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTL
  let htop := D.commonCentralVertexOfLabel_horizontalBottom_horizontalTop
    hxU hxV hU hV i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTL hTR
  apply commonEdgeComparisons_gridVertex_square f HB VR VL HT rfl hright hleft htop
    HB.leftEnd HB.rightEnd (HT.leftStart.cast rfl htop) (HT.rightStart.cast rfl htop)
  · exact Path.cast_rfl_rfl _
  · exact Path.cast_rfl_rfl _
  · exact D.commonCentralConnectorOfLabel_rightBottom hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTR
  · exact D.commonCentralConnectorOfLabel_rightTop hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTL hTR
  · exact D.commonCentralConnectorOfLabel_leftBottom hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTL
  · exact D.commonCentralConnectorOfLabel_leftTop hxU hxV hU hV
      i k j l hHorizontal hVertical b hBL hBR hTL hTR
  · rfl
  · rfl

theorem curveIntegralFirstKind_comp_of_deriv_nonneg {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ)
    (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ) (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ)
    (hφnonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv φ t) :
    curveIntegralFirstKind f (γ ∘ φ) c d =
      curveIntegralFirstKind f γ (φ c) (φ d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveIntegralFirstKind, curveIntegralFirstKind]
  simp_rw [curveSpeed_comp_of_deriv_nonneg γ φ _ (hγ _) (hφ _) (hφnonneg _)]
  have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv_of_deriv_nonneg
    (a := c) (b := d) (f := φ) (f' := deriv φ)
    (g := fun x ↦ f (γ x) * curveSpeed γ x)
    hφ.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun t _ ↦ (hφ t).hasDerivAt)
    (fun t _ ↦ hφnonneg t)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_assoc] using hsub

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceIntegralFirstKind3_const
statement:
theorem surfaceIntegralFirstKind3_const (c : ℝ)
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    surfaceIntegralFirstKind3 (fun _ ↦ c) σ s = c * surfaceAreaOn3 σ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceIntegralFirstKind3, surfaceAreaOn3]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceIntegralFirstKind3_comp_reparam
statement:
theorem surfaceIntegralFirstKind3_comp_reparam
    (f : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ) (hinj : InjOn φ s)
    (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) :
    surfaceIntegralFirstKind3 f (σ ∘ φ) s =
      surfaceIntegralFirstKind3 f σ (φ '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceIntegralFirstKind3, surfaceIntegralFirstKind3]
  have hchange := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul
    (μ := volume) (f' := fun x ↦ fderiv ℝ φ x) hs
    (fun x _ ↦ (hφ x).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj
    (fun y ↦ f (σ y) * surfaceAreaElement3 σ y)
  rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
  rw [hchange]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun hs
  intro x hx
  change f (σ (φ x)) * surfaceAreaElement3 (σ ∘ φ) x =
    |(fderiv ℝ φ x).det| *
      (f (σ (φ x)) * surfaceAreaElement3 σ (φ x))
  rw [surfaceAreaElement3_comp_reparam σ φ x (hσ (φ x)) (hφ x)]
  rw [det_eq_jacobianDet2]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.rolle
statement:
theorem rolle {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (_hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b)) (hfI : f a = f b) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, deriv f c = 0
proof:
:=
  exists_deriv_eq_zero hab hfc hfI

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.lagrange
statement:
theorem lagrange {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, deriv f c = (f b - f a) / (b - a)
proof:
:=
  exists_deriv_eq_slope f hab hfc hfd

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.lagrange_deriv
statement:
theorem lagrange_deriv {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hff' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f' c = (f b - f a) / (b - a)
proof:
:=
  exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f f' hab hfc hff'

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.monotone_of_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem monotone_of_deriv_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a < b)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b))
    (hf' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, 0 ≤ deriv f x) :
    MonotoneOn f (Set.Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (D := Set.Icc a b)
  · exact convex_Icc a b
  · exact hfc
  · simpa [interior_Icc] using hfd
  · intro x hx
    exact hf' x (by simpa [interior_Icc] using hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.strict_mono_of_deriv_pos
statement:
theorem strict_mono_of_deriv_pos {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a < b)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hf' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, 0 < deriv f x) :
    StrictMonoOn f (Set.Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (D := Set.Icc a b)
  · exact convex_Icc a b
  · exact hfc
  · intro x hx
    exact hf' x (by simpa [interior_Icc] using hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.cauchy_mvt
statement:
theorem cauchy_mvt {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b))
    (hgd : DifferentiableOn ℝ g (Set.Ioo a b)) (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b)) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, (g b - g a) * deriv f c = (f b - f a) * deriv g c
proof:
:=
  exists_ratio_deriv_eq_ratio_slope f hab hfc hfd g hgc hgd

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.taylor_lagrange_remainder
statement:
theorem taylor_lagrange_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n) f (Set.uIcc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Set.uIcc x₀ x)) (Set.uIoo x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ Set.uIoo x₀ x,
      f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Set.uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
        iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.uIcc x₀ x) x' * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / ↑(n + 1).factorial
proof:
:=
  taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange hx hf hf'

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.lhopital_zero_real
statement:
theorem lhopital_zero_real {f g f' g' : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} {l : ℝ}
    (hff' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[≠] a, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hgg' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[≠] a, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x)
    (hg' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[≠] a, g' x ≠ 0)
    (hfa : Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 0)) (hga : Tendsto g (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 0))
    (hdiv : Tendsto (fun x => f' x / g' x) (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 l)) :
    Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 l)
proof:
:=
  HasDerivAt.lhopital_zero_nhdsNE hff' hgg' hg' hfa hga hdiv

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.is_constant_of_deriv_zero
statement:
theorem is_constant_of_deriv_zero {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (h0 : ∀ x, deriv f x = 0) (x y : ℝ) : f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
  · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hxy with hlt | heq
    · have hc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc x y) := hf.continuous.continuousOn
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo x y) := hf.differentiableOn.mono (Set.subset_univ (s := Set.Ioo x y))
      rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope f hlt hc hd with ⟨c, hcI, hcslope⟩
      specialize h0 c
      have hfrac : (f y - f x) / (y - x) = 0 := by rw [← hcslope, h0]
      have hyx : y - x ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have hdiff : f y - f x = 0 := by
        rcases (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hfrac) with h1 | h2
        · exact h1
        · exact False.elim (hyx h2)
      suffices f y = f x by exact this.symm
      apply_fun fun z ↦ z - f x
      · simpa using hdiff
      · intro a b hab
        linarith
    · rw [heq]
  · have hyx : y < x := lt_of_not_ge hxy
    have hc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc y x) := hf.continuous.continuousOn
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo y x) := hf.differentiableOn.mono (Set.subset_univ (s := Set.Ioo y x))
    rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope f hyx hc hd with ⟨c, hcI, hcslope⟩
    have h0c : deriv f c = 0 := h0 c
    have hfrac : (f x - f y) / (x - y) = 0 := by rw [← hcslope, h0c]
    have hxy0 : x - y ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hdiff : f x - f y = 0 := by
      rcases (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hfrac) with h1 | h2
      · exact h1
      · exact False.elim (hxy0 h2)
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.exp_taylor_first_order
statement:
theorem exp_taylor_first_order {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.uIoo 0 x, Real.exp x = 1 + Real.exp c * x
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hlt | hgt
  · have hfc : ContinuousOn Real.exp (Set.Icc x 0) := Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    have hff' : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo x 0, HasDerivAt Real.exp (Real.exp y) y := by
      intro y hy
      exact Real.hasDerivAt_exp y
    rcases exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope Real.exp Real.exp hlt hfc hff' with
      ⟨c, hc, hcs⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Set.uIoo_comm, Set.uIoo_of_lt hlt]
      exact hc
    · have hform : Real.exp c = (Real.exp 0 - Real.exp x) / (0 - x) := hcs
      rw [Real.exp_zero] at hform
      field_simp at hform ⊢
      linarith
  · have hfc : ContinuousOn Real.exp (Set.Icc 0 x) := Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    have hff' : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo 0 x, HasDerivAt Real.exp (Real.exp y) y := by
      intro y hy
      exact Real.hasDerivAt_exp y
    rcases exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope Real.exp Real.exp hgt hfc hff' with
      ⟨c, hc, hcs⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Set.uIoo_of_lt hgt]
      exact hc
    · have hform : Real.exp c = (Real.exp x - Real.exp 0) / (x - 0) := hcs
      rw [Real.exp_zero] at hform
      field_simp at hform ⊢
      linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.sin_taylor_second_order
statement:
theorem sin_taylor_second_order {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.uIoo 0 x, Real.sin x = x - Real.sin c * x ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv (x := x) (x₀ := 0) (n := 1) hx.symm
      (Real.contDiff_sin.contDiffOn) with ⟨c, hc, h⟩
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have hs : 0 ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) x := by simp
  have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) x) := uniqueDiffOn_uIcc hx.symm
  have hd0 : derivWithin Real.sin (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) x) 0 = Real.cos 0 :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).hasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin (hu.uniqueDiffWithinAt hs)
  have h' := h
  simp [taylor_within_apply, iteratedDerivWithin_zero, Real.sin_zero, Real.cos_zero,
    hd0, Real.iteratedDeriv_even_sin] at h'
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MVT.cos_taylor_second_order
statement:
theorem cos_taylor_second_order {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.uIoo 0 x, Real.cos x = 1 - Real.cos c * x ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv (x := x) (x₀ := 0) (n := 1) hx.symm
      (Real.contDiff_cos.contDiffOn) with ⟨c, hc, h⟩
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have hs : 0 ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) x := by simp
  have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) x) := uniqueDiffOn_uIcc hx.symm
  have hd0 : derivWithin Real.cos (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) x) 0 = -Real.sin 0 :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_cos 0).hasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin (hu.uniqueDiffWithinAt hs)
  have h' := h
  simp [taylor_within_apply, iteratedDerivWithin_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero,
    hd0] at h'
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.isPositiveLinearReparametrization_iff_det_pos

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.exteriorDerivative_pullback
statement:
theorem exteriorDerivative_pullback {E : Type u} {F : Type v}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {k : ℕ} {r : WithTop ℕ∞} (f : E → F) (ω : DifferentialForm F k) (x : E)
    (hω : DifferentiableAt ℝ ω (f x)) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ r f x)
    (hr : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ r) :
    exteriorDerivative (formPullback f ω) x =
      formPullback f (exteriorDerivative ω) x
proof:
:= by
  exact extDeriv_pullback hω hf hr

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.exactForm_isClosed
statement:
theorem exactForm_isClosed {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} {ω : DifferentialForm E (k + 1)} (hω : IsExactForm ω) : IsClosedForm ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, hηsmooth, rfl⟩ := hω
  exact exteriorDerivative_squared_zero η hηsmooth (by simp)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.closedForm_pullback
statement:
theorem closedForm_pullback {E : Type u} {F : Type v}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {k : ℕ} {r : WithTop ℕ∞} (f : E → F) (ω : DifferentialForm F k)
    (hωsmooth : ContDiff ℝ r ω) (hf : ContDiff ℝ r f)
    (hr : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ r) (hωclosed : IsClosedForm ω) :
    IsClosedForm (formPullback f ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsClosedForm] at hωclosed ⊢
  funext x
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hr
    simp at hr
  rw [exteriorDerivative_pullback f ω x
    (hωsmooth.differentiable hr0 (f x)) hf.contDiffAt hr]
  simp only [formPullback]
  rw [congrFun hωclosed (f x)]
  ext v
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.exteriorDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem exteriorDerivative_apply {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} {ω : DifferentialForm E k} {x : E} (hω : DifferentiableAt ℝ ω x)
    (v : Fin (k + 1) → E) :
    exteriorDerivative ω x v =
      ∑ i, (-1) ^ i.val • fderiv ℝ (ω · (i.removeNth v)) x (v i)
proof:
:= by
  exact extDeriv_apply hω v

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.alternatingWedge_summand_bound
statement:
theorem alternatingWedge_summand_bound {E : Type u}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {k l : ℕ}
    (a : E [⋀^Fin k]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : E [⋀^Fin l]→L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin k) (Fin l)) (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin l → E) :
    ‖(TensorProduct.lid ℝ ℝ)
        (AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand a.toAlternatingMap b.toAlternatingMap σ w)‖ ≤
      (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) * ∏ i, ‖w i‖
proof:
:= by
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h σ =>
      rw [AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand_mk'']
      rw [_root_.smul_apply]
      rw [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply]
      have hmain :
          ‖(a.toMultilinearMap (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inl i)))) •
              b.toMultilinearMap (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inr i)))‖ ≤
            (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) * ∏ i, ‖w i‖ := by
        have ha := a.le_opNorm (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inl i)))
        have hb := b.le_opNorm (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inr i)))
        have hpσ : ∏ i, ‖w (σ i)‖ = ∏ i, ‖w i‖ :=
          Equiv.prod_comp σ (fun i ↦ ‖w i‖)
        have hsplit := Fintype.prod_sum_type (fun i : Fin k ⊕ Fin l ↦ ‖w (σ i)‖)
        have hprod :
            (∏ i, ‖w (σ (Sum.inl i))‖) * (∏ i, ‖w (σ (Sum.inr i))‖) =
              ∏ i, ‖w i‖ := hsplit.symm.trans hpσ
        calc
          ‖(a (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inl i)))) •
              b (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inr i)))‖ =
              ‖a (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inl i)))‖ *
                ‖b (fun i ↦ w (σ (Sum.inr i)))‖ := norm_smul _ _
          _ ≤ (‖a‖ * ∏ i, ‖w (σ (Sum.inl i))‖) *
                (‖b‖ * ∏ i, ‖w (σ (Sum.inr i))‖) := by
              exact mul_le_mul ha hb (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) *
                ((∏ i, ‖w (σ (Sum.inl i))‖) *
                  ∏ i, ‖w (σ (Sum.inr i))‖) := by ring
          _ = (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) * ∏ i, ‖w i‖ := by rw [hprod]
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) with hs | hs
      · simpa only [hs, one_smul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul] using hmain
      · rw [hs, Units.smul_def]
        change ‖(TensorProduct.lid ℝ ℝ) ((-1 : ℤ) • (_ ⊗ₜ[ℝ] _))‖ ≤ _
        simpa only [neg_one_zsmul, map_neg, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, norm_neg] using hmain

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.alternatingWedge_bound
statement:
theorem alternatingWedge_bound {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {k l : ℕ} (a : E [⋀^Fin k]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : E [⋀^Fin l]→L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (v : Fin (k + l) → E) :
    ‖alternatingWedge a.toAlternatingMap b.toAlternatingMap v‖ ≤
      (shuffleCount k l * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖) * ∏ i, ‖v i‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingWedge, LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply,
    AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply, AlternatingMap.domCoprod_apply]
  calc
    ‖(TensorProduct.lid ℝ ℝ)
        ((∑ σ, AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand a.toAlternatingMap
          b.toAlternatingMap σ) (v ∘ finSumFinEquiv))‖
        ≤ ∑ σ, ‖(TensorProduct.lid ℝ ℝ)
            (AlternatingMap.domCoprod.summand a.toAlternatingMap
              b.toAlternatingMap σ (v ∘ finSumFinEquiv))‖ := by
          rw [_root_.sum_apply, _root_.map_sum]
          exact norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _σ : Equiv.Perm.ModSumCongr (Fin k) (Fin l),
          (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) * ∏ i, ‖(v ∘ finSumFinEquiv) i‖ := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ ↦ alternatingWedge_summand_bound a b σ _
    _ = (shuffleCount k l * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖) * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
          have hp := Fin.prod_univ_add (fun i : Fin (k + l) ↦ ‖v i‖)
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
            nsmul_eq_mul, shuffleCount]
          rw [Fintype.prod_sum_type]
          simp only [finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, finSumFinEquiv_apply_right]
          rw [hp]
          ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.DifferentialForms.alternatingReindex_bound
statement:
theorem alternatingReindex_bound {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {ι : Type v} {ι' : Type w} [Fintype ι] [Fintype ι']
    (σ : ι ≃ ι') (a : E [⋀^ι]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : ι' → E) :
    ‖a.toAlternatingMap.domDomCongr σ x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ∏ i, ‖x i‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖a.toAlternatingMap.domDomCongr σ x‖ = ‖a (x ∘ σ)‖ := by
      rw [AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply]
      rfl
    _ ≤ ‖a‖ * ∏ i, ‖(x ∘ σ) i‖ := a.le_opNorm _
    _ = ‖a‖ * ∏ i, ‖x i‖ := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ ‖a‖ * z) (Equiv.prod_comp σ (fun i ↦ ‖x i‖))

theorem alternatingWedge_smul_left {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {k l : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (a : E [⋀^Fin k]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : E [⋀^Fin l]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    alternatingWedge (c • a) b = c • alternatingWedge a b

proof:

  have h : a.domCoprod (c • b) = c • a.domCoprod b := by
    rw [← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_smul]
    rfl
  simp [alternatingWedge, h]

    f (x + y) = multivariableTaylorPolynomial N f x y +
      (Nat.factorial N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.inverse_function_theorem
statement:
theorem inverse_function_theorem {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {f : E → F} {a : E} {L : E ≃L[ℝ] F}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f a) (hL : HasFDerivAt f (L : E →L[ℝ] F) a) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph E F,
      (e : E → F) = f ∧ a ∈ e.source ∧ f a ∈ e.target ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 e.symm (f a) ∧
      HasFDerivAt e.symm (L.symm : F →L[ℝ] E) (f a)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  let hs := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt' hL hn
  let e := hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph f
  have ha : a ∈ e.source := hs.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hfa : f a ∈ e.target := hs.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
  have he : (e : E → F) = f := hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe
  have heinv : e.symm (f a) = a := by
    rw [← he]
    exact e.left_inv ha
  refine ⟨e, he, ha, hfa, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply e.contDiffAt_symm hfa
    · rw [heinv]
      simpa only [he] using hL
    · rw [heinv]
      simpa only [he] using hf
  · change HasFDerivAt (hs.localInverse f L a) (L.symm : F →L[ℝ] E) (f a)
    exact hs.to_localInverse.hasFDerivAt

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.implicit_function_theorem
statement:
theorem implicit_function_theorem {E₁ E₂ F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : E₁ × E₂ → F} {u : E₁ × E₂}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f u)
    (h₂ : (fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ ψ : E₁ → E₂,
      ψ u.1 = u.2 ∧
      (∀ᶠ x in nhds u.1, f (x, ψ x) = f u) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ u.1 ∧
      HasFDerivAt ψ
        (-(fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂).inverse ∘L
          (fderiv ℝ f u ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E₁ E₂)) u.1
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := hf.implicitFunction (by norm_num) h₂
  refine ⟨ψ, hf.implicitFunction_apply_self (by norm_num) h₂,
    hf.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by norm_num) h₂,
    hf.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) h₂, ?_⟩
  exact (hf.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) h₂).hasFDerivAt

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.full_rank_level_set_normal_form
statement:
theorem full_rank_level_set_normal_form {E₁ E₂ F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FuncLimit.eventually_nhds_within_iff_delta
statement:
lemma eventually_nhds_within_iff_delta (a : ℝ) (p : ℝ → Prop) :
    (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[≠] a, p x) ↔ ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x, |x - a| < δ → x ≠ a → p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.Eventually]
  rw [Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hxne
    exact hball ⟨by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hx, hxne⟩
  · rintro ⟨δ, hδ, hδp⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxne⟩
    exact hδp x (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hx) hxne

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FuncLimit.tendsto_nhds_iff_eps_delta
statement:
lemma tendsto_nhds_iff_eps_delta {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a L : ℝ} :
    Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L) ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x, |x - a| < δ → x ≠ a → |f x - L| < ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    exact (eventually_nhds_within_iff_delta a (fun x => |f x - L| < ε)).mp (h ε hε)
  · intro h ε hε
    exact (eventually_nhds_within_iff_delta a (fun x => |f x - L| < ε)).mpr (h ε hε)

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FuncLimit.heine_forward
statement:
lemma heine_forward {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a L : ℝ}
    (hf : Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L)) :
    ∀ u : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a) → (∀ n, u n ≠ a) →
      Tendsto (f ∘ u) atTop (𝓝 L)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu hua
  have hu' : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝[≠] a) := by
    rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
    exact ⟨hu, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hua n))⟩
  exact hf.comp hu'

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FuncLimit.heine_backward
statement:
lemma heine_backward {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a L : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ u : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a) → (∀ n, u n ≠ a) →
      Tendsto (f ∘ u) atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_nhds_iff_eps_delta]
  by_contra hnot
  push Not at hnot
  rcases hnot with ⟨ε, hεpos, hbad⟩
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Classical.choose (hbad (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) (by positivity))
  have hu : ∀ n, |u n - a| < 1 / (n + 1 : ℝ) ∧ u n ≠ a ∧ ε ≤ |f (u n) - L| := by
    intro n
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hbad (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) (by positivity))
  have hua : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro δ' hδ'
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hcomp : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ↑(n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat (1 : ℕ))
      convert hcomp using 1
      funext n
      simp [Nat.cast_add]
    rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h0 δ' hδ' with ⟨N, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    have hpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hd : dist ((1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) 0 < δ' := hN n hn
    have hlt : (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) < δ' := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos hpos] using hd
    have hbnd : |u n - a| < δ' := lt_trans (hu n).1 hlt
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hbnd
  have hun : ∀ n, u n ≠ a := fun n => (hu n).2.1
  have hlim : Tendsto (f ∘ u) atTop (𝓝 L) := h u hua hun
  have hcontra : ¬ Tendsto (f ∘ u) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    push Not
    refine ⟨ε, hεpos, ?_⟩
    intro N
    refine ⟨N + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    exact (hu (N + 1)).2.2
  exact hcontra hlim

        Tendsto (f ∘ u) atTop (𝓝 L)

lemma tendsto_nhds_atTop_iff {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} :

      ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x, |x - a| < δ → x ≠ a → M ≤ f x
proof:

  constructor
  · intro h
    intro M
    rcases (eventually_nhds_within_iff_delta a (fun x => M ≤ f x)).mp (tendsto_atTop.mp h M) with ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩
    exact ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩
  · intro h
    exact tendsto_atTop.mpr (fun (M : ℝ) => (eventually_nhds_within_iff_delta a (fun x => M ≤ f x)).mpr (h M))
