name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_coordinate_map
statement:
lemma rudin_coordinate_map
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m} {a : Euc n}
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hA : HasFDerivAt F A a)
    (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hP : P.comp P = P)
    (hPrange : P.range = A.range)
    (S : A.range →L[ℝ] Euc n) (hS : ∀ y : A.range, A (S y) = y) :
    ∃ G : Euc n → Euc n,
      (∀ x, G x = x + S ⟨P (F x - A x), by
        rw [← hPrange]
        exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) (F x - A x)⟩) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G E ∧
      HasFDerivAt G (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)) a ∧
      ∀ x ∈ E, A (G x) = P (F x)
proof:
:= by
  let PA : Euc m →L[ℝ] A.range :=
    P.codRestrict A.range (by
      intro y
      rw [← hPrange]
      exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) y)
  let T : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc n := S.comp PA
  let R : Euc n → Euc m := F - A
  let G : Euc n → Euc n := fun x ↦ x + T (R x)
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 R E := hF.sub A.contDiff.contDiffOn
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G E := contDiffOn_id.add
    (T.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hR)
  have hRderiv : HasFDerivAt R (0 : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) a := by
    simpa [R] using hA.sub A.hasFDerivAt
  have hGderiv : HasFDerivAt G (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)) a := by
    have hT : HasFDerivAt (fun x ↦ T (R x)) (0 : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc n) a := by
      have hraw := T.hasFDerivAt.comp a hRderiv
      have hraw0 := hraw.congr_fderiv (ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero T)
      exact hraw0.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl)
    have hid : HasFDerivAt (fun x : Euc n ↦ x)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)) a :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)).hasFDerivAt
    have hadd := (hid.add hT).congr_fderiv (add_zero _)
    exact hadd.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl)
  have hPA : P.comp A = A := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hx : A x ∈ P.range := by
      rw [hPrange]
      exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
    have hp := DFunLike.congr_fun hP y
    change P (P y) = P y at hp
    change P (A x) = A x
    rw [← hy]
    exact hp
  refine ⟨G, ?_, hG, hGderiv, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    change x + T (R x) = x + S _
    congr 1
  · intro x _
    change A (x + T (R x)) = P (F x)
    rw [map_add]
    have hAS : A (T (R x)) = P (R x) := hS (PA (R x))
    rw [hAS]
    change A x + P (F x - A x) = P (F x)
    rw [map_sub, show P (A x) = A x by
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hPA x]
    abel

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_local_diffeomorph_near
statement:
lemma rudin_local_diffeomorph_near
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {G : Euc n → Euc n} {a : Euc n}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (ha : a ∈ E) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G E)
    (hGa : HasFDerivAt G (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)) a) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.target, (fderiv ℝ e.symm x).IsInvertible) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ e.source, e x = G x
proof:
:= by
  let I : Euc n ≃L[ℝ] Euc n := ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Euc n)
  have hGa' : HasFDerivAt G (I : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc n) a := hGa
  have hG_at : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 G a :=
    (hG a ha).contDiffAt (hE.mem_nhds ha)
  let e₀ := hG_at.toOpenPartialHomeomorph G hGa' (by norm_num)
  have ha₀ : a ∈ e₀.source :=
    hG_at.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hGa' (by norm_num)
  have hderiv_cont : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ G) a :=
    hG_at.continuousAt_fderiv (by norm_num)
  have hinv_nhds : {x | ∃ L : Euc n ≃L[ℝ] Euc n,
      (L : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc n) = fderiv ℝ G x} ∈ 𝓝 a := by
    have hI := I.nhds
    rw [show (I : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc n) = fderiv ℝ G a by
      exact hGa'.fderiv.symm] at hI
    exact hderiv_cont.preimage_mem_nhds hI
  obtain ⟨W, hWsub, hWopen, haW⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hinv_nhds
  let D := E ∩ W
  have hDopen : IsOpen D := hE.inter hWopen
  let e₁ := e₀.restrOpen D hDopen
  have ha₁ : a ∈ e₁.source := by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source]
    exact ⟨ha₀, ha, haW⟩
  have hsource₁ : e₁.source ⊆ E := by
    intro x hx
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source] at hx
    exact hx.2.1
  have he₁G : (e₁ : Euc n → Euc n) = G := by simp [e₁, e₀]
  have he₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e₁ e₁.source := by
    simpa only [he₁G] using hG.mono hsource₁
  have he₁inv : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e₁.symm e₁.target := by
    intro y hy
    have hxsource : e₁.symm y ∈ e₁.source := e₁.mapsTo_symm hy
    have hxD : e₁.symm y ∈ D := by
      rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source] at hxsource
      exact hxsource.2
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hWsub hxD.2
    have hGx : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 G (e₁.symm y) :=
      (hG _ hxD.1).contDiffAt (hE.mem_nhds hxD.1)
    have hderiv : HasFDerivAt e₁ (L : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc n) (e₁.symm y) := by
      rw [he₁G, hL]
      exact (hGx.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (e₁.contDiffAt_symm hy hderiv (by simpa only [he₁G] using hGx)).contDiffWithinAt
  have hHinv : ∀ y ∈ e₁.target, (fderiv ℝ e₁.symm y).IsInvertible := by
    intro y hy
    have hxsource : e₁.symm y ∈ e₁.source := e₁.mapsTo_symm hy
    have hxD : e₁.symm y ∈ D := by
      rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source] at hxsource
      exact hxsource.2
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hWsub hxD.2
    have hGx : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 G (e₁.symm y) :=
      (hG _ hxD.1).contDiffAt (hE.mem_nhds hxD.1)
    have hderiv : HasFDerivAt e₁ (L : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc n) (e₁.symm y) := by
      rw [he₁G, hL]
      exact (hGx.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hsymm := e₁.hasFDerivAt_symm hy hderiv
    rw [hsymm.fderiv]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.isInvertible_equiv
  exact ⟨e₁, ha₁, hsource₁, he₁, he₁inv, hHinv,
    fun x hx ↦ by rw [he₁G]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_restrict_target_to_convex_ball
statement:
lemma rudin_restrict_target_to_convex_ball
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {G : Euc n → Euc n} {a : Euc n}
    (e₁ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n))
    (ha : a ∈ e₁.source) (hsource : e₁.source ⊆ E)
    (he : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e₁ e₁.source)
    (heinv : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e₁.symm e₁.target)
    (hHinv : ∀ x ∈ e₁.target, (fderiv ℝ e₁.symm x).IsInvertible)
    (heG : ∀ x ∈ e₁.source, e₁ x = G x) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧ Convex ℝ e.target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.target, (fderiv ℝ e.symm x).IsInvertible) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ e.source, e x = G x
proof:
:= by
  have hmapa : e₁ a ∈ e₁.target := e₁.map_source ha
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp e₁.open_target (e₁ a) hmapa
  let B := Metric.ball (e₁ a) ε
  let e := (e₁.symm.restrOpen B Metric.isOpen_ball).symm
  have htarget : e.target = B := by
    rw [show e.target = e₁.target ∩ B by simp [e]]
    exact inter_eq_right.mpr hball
  have hcoe : (e : Euc n → Euc n) = e₁ := by simp [e]
  have hcoeinv : (e.symm : Euc n → Euc n) = e₁.symm := by simp [e]
  have hae : a ∈ e.source := by
    have hBa : e₁ a ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
    simpa [e, B, ha] using hBa
  have hsource_e1 : e.source ⊆ e₁.source := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ e₁.source ∧ e₁ x ∈ B := by simpa [e] using hx
    exact hx'.1
  refine ⟨e, hae, (fun x hx ↦ hsource (hsource_e1 hx)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [htarget]
    exact convex_ball _ _
  · simpa only [hcoe] using he.mono hsource_e1
  · rw [hcoeinv]
    exact heinv.mono (by rw [htarget]; exact hball)
  · intro x hx
    rw [hcoeinv]
    have hxB : x ∈ B := by rw [← htarget]; exact hx
    exact hHinv x (hball hxB)
  · intro x hx
    rw [hcoe]
    exact heG x (hsource_e1 hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_shrink_local_diffeomorph
statement:
lemma rudin_shrink_local_diffeomorph
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {G : Euc n → Euc n} {a : Euc n}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (ha : a ∈ E) (hG : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G E)
    (hGa : HasFDerivAt G (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euc n)) a) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧ Convex ℝ e.target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.target, (fderiv ℝ e.symm x).IsInvertible) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ e.source, e x = G x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, ha₁, hsource, he, heinv, hHinv, heG⟩ :=
    rudin_local_diffeomorph_near hE ha hG hGa
  exact rudin_restrict_target_to_convex_ball e₁ ha₁ hsource he heinv hHinv heG

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_coordinate_change
statement:
lemma rudin_coordinate_change
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m} {a : Euc n}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (ha : a ∈ E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hA : HasFDerivAt F A a)
    (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hP : P.comp P = P)
    (hPrange : P.range = A.range)
    (S : A.range →L[ℝ] Euc n) (hS : ∀ y : A.range, A (S y) = y) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧ Convex ℝ e.target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.target, (fderiv ℝ e.symm x).IsInvertible) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ e.source,
        e x = x + S ⟨P (F x - A x), by
          rw [← hPrange]
          exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) (F x - A x)⟩) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ e.target, P (F (e.symm x)) = A x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef, hG, hGa, hAG⟩ :=
    rudin_coordinate_map hF A hA P hP hPrange S hS
  obtain ⟨e, hae, hsource, hconv, he, heinv, hHinv, heG⟩ :=
    rudin_shrink_local_diffeomorph hE ha hG hGa
  refine ⟨e, hae, hsource, hconv, he, heinv, hHinv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [heG x hx, hGdef]
  · intro x hx
    have hxsource : e.symm x ∈ e.source := e.mapsTo_symm hx
    have h := hAG (e.symm x) (hsource hxsource)
    rw [← heG (e.symm x) hxsource, e.right_inv hx] at h
    exact h.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.transformed_derivative_vanishes_on_kernel
statement:
lemma transformed_derivative_vanishes_on_kernel
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (L : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (hPrange : P.range = A.range)
    (hrankA : Module.finrank ℝ A.range = r)
    (hrankL : Module.finrank ℝ L.range = r)
    (hcomp : P.comp L = A) :
    ∀ h, A h = 0 → L h = 0
proof:
:= by
  let q : L.range →ₗ[ℝ] A.range :=
    (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m).domRestrict L.range |>.codRestrict A.range (by
      intro z
      rw [← hPrange]
      exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (P : Euc m →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) z)
  have hqsurj : Function.Surjective q := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨⟨L x, LinearMap.mem_range_self (L : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x
    change P (L x) = A x at hx
    exact hx
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.range = Module.finrank ℝ A.range :=
    hrankL.trans hrankA.symm
  have hqinj : Function.Injective q :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).2 hqsurj
  intro h hAh
  apply Subtype.ext_iff.mp (hqinj (a₁ :=
    ⟨L h, LinearMap.mem_range_self (L : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) h⟩) (a₂ := 0) ?_)
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hh := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp h
  change P (L h) = A h at hh
  change P (L h) = P 0
  simpa using hh.trans hAh

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.fiber_path_hasDerivAt_zero
statement:
lemma fiber_path_hasDerivAt_zero
    {V : Set (Euc n)} (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hV : Convex ℝ V)
    {ψ : Euc n → Euc m} (hψ : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ V)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (hker : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ h, A h = 0 → fderiv ℝ ψ x h = 0)
    {x₁ x₂ : Euc n} (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V) (hx₂ : x₂ ∈ V) (hAx : A x₁ = A x₂) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ ψ (AffineMap.lineMap x₁ x₂ s)) 0 t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  have hzt : AffineMap.lineMap x₁ x₂ t ∈ V := hV.lineMap_mem hx₁ hx₂ ht
  have hψt : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (AffineMap.lineMap x₁ x₂ t) :=
    (hψ _ hzt).differentiableAt (hVopen.mem_nhds hzt)
  have hA_sub : A (x₂ - x₁) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hAx, sub_self]
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ ψ (AffineMap.lineMap x₁ x₂ t) (x₂ - x₁) = 0 :=
    hker _ hzt _ hA_sub
  change HasDerivAt (ψ ∘ AffineMap.lineMap x₁ x₂) 0 t
  exact (hψt.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t AffineMap.hasDerivAt_lineMap).congr_deriv hzero

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.interval_endpoints_eq_of_hasDerivAt_zero
statement:
lemma interval_endpoints_eq_of_hasDerivAt_zero
    {g : ℝ → Euc m}
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt g 0 t) :
    g 0 = g 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).is_const_of_fderivWithin_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℝ)
  · intro t ht
    exact (hg t ht).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    rw [(hg t ht).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt.fderivWithin
      ((uniqueDiffOn_Icc zero_lt_one).uniqueDiffWithinAt ht)]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_zero ℝ
  · exact left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one
  · exact right_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.residual_constant_on_fibers
statement:
lemma residual_constant_on_fibers
    {V : Set (Euc n)} (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hV : Convex ℝ V)
    {ψ : Euc n → Euc m} (hψ : DifferentiableOn ℝ ψ V)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (hker : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ h, A h = 0 → fderiv ℝ ψ x h = 0) :
    ∀ ⦃x₁⦄, x₁ ∈ V → ∀ ⦃x₂⦄, x₂ ∈ V → A x₁ = A x₂ → ψ x₁ = ψ x₂
proof:
:= by
  intro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hAx
  have hpath := fiber_path_hasDerivAt_zero hVopen hV hψ A hker hx₁ hx₂ hAx
  have hend := interval_endpoints_eq_of_hasDerivAt_zero hpath
  simpa using hend

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.residual_descends_contDiff
statement:
lemma residual_descends_contDiff
    {V : Set (Euc n)} (hVopen : IsOpen V)
    {ψ : Euc n → Euc m} (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (S : A.range →L[ℝ] Euc n) (hS : ∀ y : A.range, A (S y) = y)
    (hψker : ∀ x ∈ V, P (ψ x) = 0)
    (hfiber : ∀ ⦃x₁⦄, x₁ ∈ V → ∀ ⦃x₂⦄, x₂ ∈ V →
      A x₁ = A x₂ → ψ x₁ = ψ x₂) :
    ∃ φ : A.range → P.ker,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ {y | (y : Euc m) ∈ A '' V} ∧
      ∀ x ∈ V, (φ ⟨A x, LinearMap.mem_range_self (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩ : Euc m) = ψ x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let pick : A.range → Euc n := fun y ↦
    if hy : (y : Euc m) ∈ A '' V then Classical.choose hy else 0
  let φ : A.range → P.ker := fun y ↦ P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto (ψ (pick y))
  have hpick_mem (y : A.range) (hy : (y : Euc m) ∈ A '' V) : pick y ∈ V := by
    simp only [pick, dif_pos hy]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec hy).1
  have hA_pick (y : A.range) (hy : (y : Euc m) ∈ A '' V) : A (pick y) = y := by
    simp only [pick, dif_pos hy]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec hy).2
  have hφeq : ∀ x ∈ V,
      (φ ⟨A x, LinearMap.mem_range_self (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩ : Euc m) = ψ x := by
    intro x hx
    let y : A.range := ⟨A x, LinearMap.mem_range_self (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩
    have hy : (y : Euc m) ∈ A '' V := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hp := hpick_mem y hy
    have hsame : ψ (pick y) = ψ x := hfiber hp hx (by simpa [y] using hA_pick y hy)
    change (P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto (ψ (pick y)) : Euc m) = ψ x
    rw [hsame]
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val
      (P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto_mem_subspace_eq_self ⟨ψ x, hψker x hx⟩)
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, hφeq⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hAx₀⟩ := hy
  let qarg : A.range → Euc n := fun z ↦ x₀ + S (z - y)
  let q : A.range → P.ker := fun z ↦ P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto (ψ (qarg z))
  have hqarg_y : qarg y = x₀ := by simp [qarg]
  have hψ_at : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ x₀ :=
    (hψ x₀ hx₀).contDiffAt (hVopen.mem_nhds hx₀)
  have hqarg : ContDiff ℝ 1 qarg := by fun_prop
  have hψ_qarg : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ (qarg y) := by rwa [hqarg_y]
  have hq_at : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 q y := by
    exact P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y
      (hψ_qarg.comp y hqarg.contDiffAt)
  apply hq_at.contDiffWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  · have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, qarg z ∈ V :=
      hqarg.continuous.continuousAt (by rw [hqarg_y]; exact hVopen.mem_nhds hx₀)
    have hevWithin : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[{y | (y : Euc m) ∈ A '' V}] y, qarg z ∈ V :=
      Filter.Eventually.filter_mono inf_le_left hev
    filter_upwards [hevWithin] with z hz
    have hAz : A (qarg z) = z := by
      simp [qarg, map_add, hS, hAx₀]
    have heq := hφeq (qarg z) hz
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hsub : (⟨A (qarg z), LinearMap.mem_range_self
        (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) (qarg z)⟩ : A.range) = z := Subtype.ext hAz
    rw [hsub] at heq
    change (φ z : Euc m) = (P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto (ψ (qarg z)) : Euc m)
    rw [heq]
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val
      (P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto_mem_subspace_eq_self
        ⟨ψ (qarg z), hψker (qarg z) hz⟩).symm
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hsub : (⟨A x₀, LinearMap.mem_range_self
        (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x₀⟩ : A.range) = y := Subtype.ext hAx₀
    have heq := hφeq x₀ hx₀
    rw [hsub] at heq
    change (φ y : Euc m) = (q y : Euc m)
    rw [heq]
    change ψ x₀ = (P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto (ψ (qarg y)) : Euc m)
    rw [hqarg_y]
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val
      (P.ker.orthogonalProjectionOnto_mem_subspace_eq_self
        ⟨ψ x₀, hψker x₀ hx₀⟩).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.residual_contDiff
statement:
lemma residual_contDiff
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m}
    {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n)}
    (hsource : e.source ⊆ E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (heinv : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ F (e.symm x) - A x) e.target
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ F (e.symm x)) e.target :=
    (hF.mono hsource).comp (fun x hx ↦ heinv x hx) e.mapsTo_symm
  exact hcomp.sub A.contDiff.contDiffOn

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.residual_mem_projection_kernel
statement:
lemma residual_mem_projection_kernel
    {F : Euc n → Euc m} {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n)}
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (hPA : P.comp A = A)
    (hproj : ∀ x ∈ e.target, P (F (e.symm x)) = A x) :
    ∀ x ∈ e.target, P (F (e.symm x) - A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [map_sub, hproj x hx]
  have hPAx := DFunLike.congr_fun hPA x
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hPAx
  rw [hPAx, sub_self]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rudin_residual_derivative_vanishes
statement:
lemma rudin_residual_derivative_vanishes
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m}
    {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n)}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hsource : e.source ⊆ E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (heinv : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target)
    (hHinv : ∀ x ∈ e.target, (fderiv ℝ e.symm x).IsInvertible)
    (A : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m) (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m)
    (hPrange : P.range = A.range)
    (hrankA : Module.finrank ℝ A.range = r)
    (hrank : ∀ x ∈ E, Module.finrank ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x).range = r)
    (hproj : ∀ x ∈ e.target, P (F (e.symm x)) = A x) :
    ∀ x ∈ e.target, ∀ h, A h = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun z ↦ F (e.symm z) - A z) x h = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx h hAh
  have hxsource : e.symm x ∈ e.source := e.mapsTo_symm hx
  have hxE : e.symm x ∈ E := hsource hxsource
  have hHdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ e.symm x :=
    ((heinv.differentiableOn (by norm_num)) x hx).differentiableAt
      (e.open_target.mem_nhds hx)
  have hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (e.symm x) :=
    ((hF.differentiableOn (by norm_num)) _ hxE).differentiableAt
      (hE.mem_nhds hxE)
  let Φ : Euc n → Euc m := fun z ↦ F (e.symm z)
  let L : Euc n →L[ℝ] Euc m := fderiv ℝ Φ x
  have hLcomp : L = (fderiv ℝ F (e.symm x)).comp (fderiv ℝ e.symm x) := by
    exact fderiv_comp x hFdiff hHdiff
  have hrangeL : L.range = (fderiv ℝ F (e.symm x)).range := by
    rw [hLcomp]
    exact LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _
      (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (hHinv x hx).surjective)
  have hrankL : Module.finrank ℝ L.range = r := by
    rw [hrangeL]
    exact hrank _ hxE
  have hΦdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x := hFdiff.comp x hHdiff
  have hlocal : (fun z ↦ P (Φ z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun z ↦ A z :=
    by
      filter_upwards [e.open_target.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      exact hproj z hz
  have hcomp : P.comp L = A := by
    have hd := hlocal.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
    have hleft : fderiv ℝ (fun z ↦ P (Φ z)) x = P.comp L :=
      (P.hasFDerivAt.comp x hΦdiff.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    have hright : fderiv ℝ (fun z ↦ A z) x = A := A.hasFDerivAt.fderiv
    rwa [hleft, hright] at hd
  have hLzero : L h = 0 :=
    transformed_derivative_vanishes_on_kernel A P L hPrange hrankA hrankL hcomp h hAh
  have hres : fderiv ℝ (fun z ↦ Φ z - A z) x = L - A :=
    (hΦdiff.hasFDerivAt.sub A.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (fun z ↦ Φ z - A z) x h = 0
  rw [hres]
  change L h - A h = 0
  rw [hLzero, hAh, sub_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.constant_rank_theorem_rudin_9_32
statement:
theorem constant_rank_theorem_rudin_9_32
    {E : Set (Euc n)} {F : Euc n → Euc m} {a : Euc n}
    (hE : IsOpen E) (ha : a ∈ E) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F E)
    (hrank : ∀ x ∈ E, Module.finrank ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x).range = r)
    (P : Euc m →L[ℝ] Euc m) (hP : P.comp P = P)
    (hPrange : P.range = (fderiv ℝ F a).range) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Euc n) (Euc n),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ E ∧ Convex ℝ e.target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e e.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 e.symm e.target ∧
      ∃ φ : (fderiv ℝ F a).range → P.ker,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ
          {y | (y : Euc m) ∈ (fderiv ℝ F a) '' e.target} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ e.target,
          F (e.symm x) = fderiv ℝ F a x +
            (φ ⟨fderiv ℝ F a x,
              LinearMap.mem_range_self
                (fderiv ℝ F a : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩ : Euc m)
proof:
:= by
  let A := fderiv ℝ F a
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := range_right_inverse A
  have hFa : HasFDerivAt F A a :=
    (((hF.differentiableOn (by norm_num)) a ha).differentiableAt (hE.mem_nhds ha)).hasFDerivAt
  obtain ⟨e, hae, hsource, hconv, he, heinv, hHinv, hG, hproj⟩ :=
    rudin_coordinate_change hE ha hF A hFa P hP hPrange S hS
  let ψ : Euc n → Euc m := fun x ↦ F (e.symm x) - A x
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ e.target :=
    residual_contDiff hsource hF heinv A
  have hPA : P.comp A = A := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hAx : A x ∈ P.range := by
      rw [hPrange]
      exact LinearMap.mem_range_self (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hAx
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ← hy]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hP y
  have hψker : ∀ x ∈ e.target, P (ψ x) = 0 :=
    residual_mem_projection_kernel A P hPA hproj
  have hrankA : Module.finrank ℝ A.range = r := hrank a ha
  have hderivker : ∀ x ∈ e.target, ∀ h, A h = 0 → fderiv ℝ ψ x h = 0 :=
    rudin_residual_derivative_vanishes hE hsource hF heinv hHinv A P hPrange hrankA hrank hproj
  have hfiber : ∀ ⦃x₁⦄, x₁ ∈ e.target → ∀ ⦃x₂⦄, x₂ ∈ e.target →
      A x₁ = A x₂ → ψ x₁ = ψ x₂ :=
    residual_constant_on_fibers e.open_target hconv
      (hψ.differentiableOn (by norm_num)) A hderivker
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφeq⟩ :=
    residual_descends_contDiff e.open_target hψ A P S hS hψker hfiber
  refine ⟨e, hae, hsource, hconv, he, heinv, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have := hφeq x hx
  dsimp [ψ] at this
  change F (e.symm x) = A x +
    (φ ⟨A x, LinearMap.mem_range_self (A : Euc n →ₗ[ℝ] Euc m) x⟩ : Euc m)
  rw [this]
  abel

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rectangleIntegral_eq_iterated

theorem rectangleIntegral_eq_iterated {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b c d : ℝ}

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.rectangleIntegral_one

proof:
:= by

  change (volume.prod volume).real (Icc a b ×ˢ Icc c d) = _

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.mass_nonneg
statement:
theorem mass_nonneg {n : ℕ} {ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ} {D : Set (JordanEuc n)}
    (hnull : NullMeasurableSet D volume) (hρ : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ ρ x) : 0 ≤ mass ρ D
proof:
:= by
  rw [mass]
  have h : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict D, 0 ≤ ρ x := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff'₀ hnull]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => hρ x hx
  exact setIntegral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.isJordanMeasurable_mass_nonneg
proof:
:=
  mass_nonneg hD.nullMeasurableSet hρ

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.mass_add
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.mass_smul
statement:
theorem mass_smul {n : ℕ} (ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ) (D : Set (JordanEuc n)) (c : ℝ) :
    mass (fun x => c * ρ x) D = c * mass ρ D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mass]
  rw [integral_const_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.mass_const
statement:
theorem mass_const {n : ℕ} (D : Set (JordanEuc n)) (c : ℝ) :
    mass (fun _ => c) D = c * volume.real D
proof:
:= by
  rw [mass, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.mass_one_eq_measureReal
statement:
theorem mass_one_eq_measureReal {n : ℕ} (D : Set (JordanEuc n)) :

proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.mass_congr
statement:
theorem mass_congr {n : ℕ} {ρ σ : JordanEuc n → ℝ} {D : Set (JordanEuc n)}
    (hD : MeasurableSet D) (h : ∀ x ∈ D, ρ x = σ x) : mass ρ D = mass σ D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mass]
  exact setIntegral_congr_fun hD h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.firstMoment_smul
statement:
theorem firstMoment_smul {n : ℕ} (ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ) (D : Set (JordanEuc n))
    (i : Fin n) (c : ℝ) :
    firstMoment (fun x => c * ρ x) D i = c * firstMoment ρ D i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstMoment]
  have h : (fun x : JordanEuc n => x i * (c * ρ x)) = fun x => c * (x i * ρ x) := by
    funext x; ring
  rw [h, integral_const_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.centroid_smul
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : mass (fun x => c * ρ x) D ≠ 0 := by
    rw [mass_smul]
    exact mul_ne_zero hc hm
  simp only [centroid, firstMoment_smul, mass_smul]
  rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.secondMoment_smul
statement:
theorem secondMoment_smul {n : ℕ} (ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ) (D : Set (JordanEuc n))
    (i : Fin n) (c : ℝ) :
    secondMoment (fun x => c * ρ x) D i = c * secondMoment ρ D i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [secondMoment]
  have h : (fun x : JordanEuc n => (x i) ^ 2 * (c * ρ x)) =
      fun x => c * ((x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) := by
    funext x; ring
  rw [h, integral_const_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.euclideanNormSq_nonneg
statement: theorem euclideanNormSq_nonneg {n : ℕ} (v : JordanEuc n) : 0 ≤ euclideanNormSq v
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg (v i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.euclideanNormSq_sub
statement:
theorem euclideanNormSq_sub {n : ℕ} (x c : JordanEuc n) :
    euclideanNormSq (x - c) = ∑ i, (x i - c i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [euclideanNormSq, Pi.sub_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.momentOfInertia_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rw [momentOfInertia]
  have h : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict D, 0 ≤ euclideanNormSq (x - c) * ρ x := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff'₀ hnull]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx =>
      mul_nonneg (euclideanNormSq_nonneg _) (hρ x hx)
  exact setIntegral_nonneg_of_ae_restrict h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.isJordanMeasurable_momentOfInertia_nonneg
proof:
:=
  momentOfInertia_nonneg hD.nullMeasurableSet hρ

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.momentOfInertia_smul
statement:
theorem momentOfInertia_smul {n : ℕ} (ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ) (D : Set (JordanEuc n))
    (c : JordanEuc n) (k : ℝ) :
    momentOfInertia (fun x => k * ρ x) D c = k * momentOfInertia ρ D c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [momentOfInertia]
  have h : (fun x : JordanEuc n => euclideanNormSq (x - c) * (k * ρ x)) =
      fun x => k * (euclideanNormSq (x - c) * ρ x) := by
    funext x; ring
  rw [h, integral_const_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.momentOfInertia_zero
statement:
theorem momentOfInertia_zero {n : ℕ} (ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ) (D : Set (JordanEuc n)) :
    momentOfInertia ρ D 0 = ∫ x in D, euclideanNormSq x * ρ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [momentOfInertia, sub_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.integral_sq_sub_center
statement:
theorem integral_sq_sub_center {n : ℕ} {ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ} {D : Set (JordanEuc n)}
    {i : Fin n} {c : ℝ} (hρ : IntegrableOn ρ D volume)
    (h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D)
    (h1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => x i * ρ x) D) :
    (∫ x in D, (x i - c) ^ 2 * ρ x) =
      secondMoment ρ D i - 2 * c * firstMoment ρ D i + c ^ 2 * mass ρ D
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : IntegrableOn (fun x => (2 * c) * (x i * ρ x)) D := h1.const_mul (2 * c)
  have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun x => c ^ 2 * ρ x) D := hρ.const_mul (c ^ 2)
  have h2' : IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x - (2 * c) * (x i * ρ x)) D :=
    h2.sub hcross
  calc ∫ x in D, (x i - c) ^ 2 * ρ x
      = ∫ x in D, ((x i) ^ 2 * ρ x - (2 * c) * (x i * ρ x) + c ^ 2 * ρ x) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with x
        ring
    _ = (∫ x in D, (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) - (∫ x in D, (2 * c) * (x i * ρ x))
          + ∫ x in D, c ^ 2 * ρ x := by
        rw [integral_add h2' hconst, integral_sub h2 hcross]
    _ = secondMoment ρ D i - 2 * c * firstMoment ρ D i + c ^ 2 * mass ρ D := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
        simp only [secondMoment, firstMoment, mass]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.momentOfInertia_expansion
statement:
theorem momentOfInertia_expansion {n : ℕ} {ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ} {D : Set (JordanEuc n)}
    {c : JordanEuc n} (hρ : IntegrableOn ρ D volume)
    (h2 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D)
    (h1 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => x i * ρ x) D) :
    momentOfInertia ρ D c =
      ∑ i, (secondMoment ρ D i - 2 * (c i) * firstMoment ρ D i
        + (c i) ^ 2 * mass ρ D)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i - c i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D := by
    intro i
    have hcross : IntegrableOn (fun x => (2 * c i) * (x i * ρ x)) D :=
      (h1 i).const_mul (2 * c i)
    have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun x => (c i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D := hρ.const_mul ((c i) ^ 2)
    have hfun : (fun x : JordanEuc n => (x i - c i) ^ 2 * ρ x) =
        fun x => ((x i) ^ 2 * ρ x - (2 * c i) * (x i * ρ x) + (c i) ^ 2 * ρ x) := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [hfun]
    exact (h2 i).sub hcross |>.add hconst
  have hpt : (fun x : JordanEuc n => euclideanNormSq (x - c) * ρ x) =
      fun x => ∑ i, (x i - c i) ^ 2 * ρ x := by
    funext x
    rw [euclideanNormSq_sub, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [momentOfInertia, hpt]
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hterm i)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => integral_sq_sub_center hρ (h2 i) (h1 i)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.MassCenter.momentOfInertia_parallel_axis
statement:
theorem momentOfInertia_parallel_axis {n : ℕ} {ρ : JordanEuc n → ℝ}
    {D : Set (JordanEuc n)} {c : JordanEuc n} (hρ : IntegrableOn ρ D volume)
    (h2 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => (x i) ^ 2 * ρ x) D)
    (h1 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun x => x i * ρ x) D) :
    momentOfInertia ρ D c =
      (∑ i, secondMoment ρ D i) - 2 * (∑ i, c i * firstMoment ρ D i)
        + euclideanNormSq c * mass ρ D
proof:
:= by
  have hB : (∑ i, (2 * c i) * firstMoment ρ D i) =
      2 * ∑ i, c i * firstMoment ρ D i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  have hC : (∑ i, (c i) ^ 2 * mass ρ D) = (∑ i, (c i) ^ 2) * mass ρ D := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [momentOfInertia_expansion hρ h2 h1, euclideanNormSq]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hB, hC]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.hasDerivAt_affineLine
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_affineLine {n : ℕ} (p v : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (affineLine p v) v t
proof:
:= by
  change HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ p + s • v) v t
  simpa only [id_eq, one_smul] using
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const v |>.const_add p)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveVelocity_affineLine
statement:
theorem curveVelocity_affineLine {n : ℕ} (p v : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    curveVelocity (affineLine p v) t = v
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasDerivAt_affineLine p v t).deriv

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveSpeed_affineLine
statement:
theorem curveSpeed_affineLine {n : ℕ} (p v : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    curveSpeed (affineLine p v) t = ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveSpeed, curveVelocity_affineLine]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveRegularAt_affineLine_iff
statement:
theorem curveRegularAt_affineLine_iff {n : ℕ} (p v : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    CurveRegularAt (affineLine p v) t ↔ v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [CurveRegularAt, (hasDerivAt_affineLine p v t).differentiableAt,
    curveVelocity_affineLine]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveArcLength_affineLine
statement:
theorem curveArcLength_affineLine {n : ℕ} (p v : Fin n → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    curveArcLength (affineLine p v) a b = (b - a) * ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  simp [curveArcLength, curveSpeed_affineLine, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
    smul_eq_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveVelocity_comp
statement:
theorem curveVelocity_comp {n : ℕ} (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ (φ t)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ t) :
    curveVelocity (γ ∘ φ) t = deriv φ t • curveVelocity γ (φ t)
proof:
:= by
  exact (hγ.hasDerivAt.scomp t hφ.hasDerivAt).deriv

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveSpeed_comp
statement:
theorem curveSpeed_comp {n : ℕ} (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ (φ t)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ t) :
    curveSpeed (γ ∘ φ) t = |deriv φ t| * curveSpeed γ (φ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveSpeed, curveVelocity_comp γ φ t hγ hφ, norm_smul, curveSpeed]
  exact congrArg (fun r ↦ r * ‖curveVelocity γ (φ t)‖) (Real.norm_eq_abs _)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveSpeed_comp_of_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem curveSpeed_comp_of_deriv_nonneg {n : ℕ}
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ (φ t)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ t)
    (hφnonneg : 0 ≤ deriv φ t) :
    curveSpeed (γ ∘ φ) t = curveSpeed γ (φ t) * deriv φ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveSpeed_comp γ φ t hγ hφ, abs_of_nonneg hφnonneg, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveArcLength_comp_of_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem curveArcLength_comp_of_deriv_nonneg {n : ℕ}
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ)
    (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ) (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ)
    (hφnonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv φ t) :
    curveArcLength (γ ∘ φ) c d = curveArcLength γ (φ c) (φ d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveArcLength, curveArcLength]
  simp_rw [curveSpeed_comp_of_deriv_nonneg γ φ _ (hγ _) (hφ _) (hφnonneg _)]
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
    (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv_of_deriv_nonneg
      (a := c) (b := d) (f := φ) (f' := deriv φ) (g := curveSpeed γ)
      hφ.continuous.continuousOn
      (fun t _ ↦ (hφ t).hasDerivAt)
      (fun t _ ↦ hφnonneg t))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.curveArcLength_comp_of_deriv_nonneg_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem curveArcLength_comp_of_deriv_nonneg_of_endpoints {n : ℕ}
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ)
    (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ) (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ)
    (hφnonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv φ t) (hc : φ c = a) (hd : φ d = b) :
    curveArcLength (γ ∘ φ) c d = curveArcLength γ a b
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hc, hd] using curveArcLength_comp_of_deriv_nonneg γ φ c d hγ hφ hφnonneg

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.hasFDerivAt_affinePlane
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_affinePlane {n : ℕ} (p u v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₁_affinePlane

theorem surfaceTangent₁_affinePlane {n : ℕ} (p u v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₂_affinePlane
statement:
theorem surfaceTangent₂_affinePlane {n : ℕ} (p u v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceRegularAt_affinePlane_iff
statement:
theorem surfaceRegularAt_affinePlane_iff {n : ℕ} (p u v : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) :
    SurfaceRegularAt (affinePlane p u v) a ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ ![u, v]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SurfaceRegularAt, (hasFDerivAt_affinePlane p u v a).fderiv]
  simp only [(hasFDerivAt_affinePlane p u v a).differentiableAt, true_and]
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hinj g hg i
    have hpair : (g 0, g 1) = (0, 0) := hinj (by
      ext j
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using congrFun hg j)
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using congrArg (fun z ↦ z.1) hpair
    · simpa using congrArg (fun z ↦ z.2) hpair
  · intro hli x y hxy
    have hcoeff := hli ![x.1 - y.1, x.2 - y.2] (by
      ext j
      have hj := congrFun hxy j
      simp at hj
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      linear_combination hj)
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hcoeff 0)
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hcoeff 1)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.range_affinePlane
statement:
theorem range_affinePlane {n : ℕ} (p u v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Set.range (affinePlane p u v) = affinePlaneSet p u v
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [affinePlaneSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Submodule.mem_span_pair]
    refine ⟨a.1, a.2, ?_⟩
    ext i
    simp [affinePlane]
    ring
  · intro hx
    rw [affinePlaneSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Submodule.mem_span_pair] at hx
    obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨(s, t), ?_⟩
    rw [affinePlane]
    ext i
    have hi := congrFun hst i
    simp at hi ⊢
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.range_affinePlane_eq_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem range_affinePlane_eq_of_span_eq {n : ℕ}
    (p u v u' v' : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ ({u, v} : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) =
      Submodule.span ℝ ({u', v'} : Set (Fin n → ℝ))) :
    Set.range (affinePlane p u v) = Set.range (affinePlane p u' v')
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_affinePlane, range_affinePlane]
  ext x
  simp only [affinePlaneSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hspan]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaElement3_nonneg
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaElement3_nonneg (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ surfaceAreaElement3 σ p
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaElement3_affinePlane
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaElement3_affinePlane
    (p u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) :
    surfaceAreaElement3 (affinePlane p u v) a = ‖u ⨯₃ v‖
proof:
:= by
  simp [surfaceAreaElement3, surfaceTangent₁_affinePlane,
    surfaceTangent₂_affinePlane]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceRegularAt_affinePlane_iff_areaElement_ne_zero
statement:
theorem surfaceRegularAt_affinePlane_iff_areaElement_ne_zero
    (p u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : ℝ × ℝ) :
    SurfaceRegularAt (affinePlane p u v) a ↔
      surfaceAreaElement3 (affinePlane p u v) a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceRegularAt_affinePlane_iff, surfaceAreaElement3_affinePlane]
  simpa only [norm_ne_zero_iff] using
    (crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent (v := u) (w := v)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaOn3_affinePlane_closedRectangle
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaOn3_affinePlane_closedRectangle
    (p u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    surfaceAreaOn3 (affinePlane p u v) (closedRectangle a b c d) =
      (b - a) * (d - c) * ‖u ⨯₃ v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceAreaOn3]
  simp_rw [surfaceAreaElement3_affinePlane]
  rw [setIntegral_const]
  have harea : (volume.prod volume).real (closedRectangle a b c d) =
      (b - a) * (d - c) := by
    simpa [rectangleIntegral] using rectangleIntegral_one hab hcd
  rw [harea]
  simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.det_eq_jacobianDet2
statement:
theorem det_eq_jacobianDet2 (L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) :
    L.det = jacobianDet2 L
proof:
:= by
  unfold ContinuousLinearMap.det
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (Module.Basis.finTwoProd ℝ) L.toLinearMap]
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, jacobianDet2, Module.Basis.coe_finTwoProd_repr]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₁_comp_reparam
statement:
theorem surfaceTangent₁_comp_reparam
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ (φ p)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ p) :
    surfaceTangent₁ (σ ∘ φ) p =
      (fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)).1 • surfaceTangent₁ σ (φ p) +
      (fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)).2 • surfaceTangent₂ σ (φ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := hσ.hasFDerivAt.comp p hφ.hasFDerivAt
  rw [surfaceTangent₁, hcomp.fderiv, surfaceTangent₁, surfaceTangent₂]
  have hw : fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0) =
      (fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)).1 • (1, 0) +
        (fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)).2 • (0, 1) := by
    ext <;> simp
  change fderiv ℝ σ (φ p) (fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)) = _
  calc
    _ = fderiv ℝ σ (φ p)
        ((fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)).1 • (1, 0) +
          (fderiv ℝ φ p (1, 0)).2 • (0, 1)) := congrArg _ hw
    _ = _ := by rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₂_comp_reparam
statement:
theorem surfaceTangent₂_comp_reparam
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ (φ p)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ p) :
    surfaceTangent₂ (σ ∘ φ) p =
      (fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)).1 • surfaceTangent₁ σ (φ p) +
      (fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)).2 • surfaceTangent₂ σ (φ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := hσ.hasFDerivAt.comp p hφ.hasFDerivAt
  rw [surfaceTangent₂, hcomp.fderiv, surfaceTangent₁, surfaceTangent₂]
  have hw : fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1) =
      (fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)).1 • (1, 0) +
        (fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)).2 • (0, 1) := by
    ext <;> simp
  change fderiv ℝ σ (φ p) (fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)) = _
  calc
    _ = fderiv ℝ σ (φ p)
        ((fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)).1 • (1, 0) +
          (fderiv ℝ φ p (0, 1)).2 • (0, 1)) := congrArg _ hw
    _ = _ := by rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.cross_linear_combinations
statement:
theorem cross_linear_combinations
    (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ) :
    (a • u + b • v) ⨯₃ (c • u + d • v) =
      (a * d - b * c) • (u ⨯₃ v)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [cross_apply] <;> ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaElement3_comp_reparam
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaElement3_comp_reparam
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ (φ p)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ p) :
    surfaceAreaElement3 (σ ∘ φ) p =
      |jacobianDet2 (fderiv ℝ φ p)| * surfaceAreaElement3 σ (φ p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceAreaElement3, surfaceAreaElement3,
    surfaceTangent₁_comp_reparam σ φ p hσ hφ,
    surfaceTangent₂_comp_reparam σ φ p hσ hφ,
    cross_linear_combinations]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaOn3_comp_reparam
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaOn3_comp_reparam
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ) (hinj : InjOn φ s)
    (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) :
    surfaceAreaOn3 (σ ∘ φ) s = surfaceAreaOn3 σ (φ '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceAreaOn3, surfaceAreaOn3]
  have hchange := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul
    (μ := volume) (f' := fun x ↦ fderiv ℝ φ x) hs
    (fun x _ ↦ (hφ x).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj (surfaceAreaElement3 σ)
  rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
  rw [hchange]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun hs
  intro x hx
  rw [surfaceAreaElement3_comp_reparam σ φ x (hσ (φ x)) (hφ x)]
  change |jacobianDet2 (fderiv ℝ φ x)| * surfaceAreaElement3 σ (φ x) =
    |(fderiv ℝ φ x).det| * surfaceAreaElement3 σ (φ x)
  rw [det_eq_jacobianDet2]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₁_comp_swap
statement:
theorem surfaceTangent₁_comp_swap (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ p.swap) :
    surfaceTangent₁ (σ ∘ Prod.swap) p = surfaceTangent₂ σ p.swap
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : HasFDerivAt Prod.swap
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)) p := by
    exact hasFDerivAt_snd.prodMk hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hcomp := hσ.hasFDerivAt.comp p hswap
  rw [surfaceTangent₁, hcomp.fderiv, surfaceTangent₂, hσ.hasFDerivAt.fderiv]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceTangent₂_comp_swap
statement:
theorem surfaceTangent₂_comp_swap (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ p.swap) :
    surfaceTangent₂ (σ ∘ Prod.swap) p = surfaceTangent₁ σ p.swap
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : HasFDerivAt Prod.swap
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)) p := by
    exact hasFDerivAt_snd.prodMk hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hcomp := hσ.hasFDerivAt.comp p hswap
  rw [surfaceTangent₂, hcomp.fderiv, surfaceTangent₁, hσ.hasFDerivAt.fderiv]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaElement3_comp_swap
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaElement3_comp_swap (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ p.swap) :
    surfaceAreaElement3 (σ ∘ Prod.swap) p = surfaceAreaElement3 σ p.swap
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceAreaElement3, surfaceAreaElement3,
    surfaceTangent₁_comp_swap σ p hσ, surfaceTangent₂_comp_swap σ p hσ]
  rw [← cross_anticomm]
  exact norm_neg _

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.surfaceAreaOn3_comp_swap_prod
statement:
theorem surfaceAreaOn3_comp_swap_prod (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3)
    (s t : Set ℝ) (hσ : Differentiable ℝ σ) :
    surfaceAreaOn3 (σ ∘ Prod.swap) (t ×ˢ s) = surfaceAreaOn3 σ (s ×ˢ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceAreaOn3, surfaceAreaOn3]
  have hpoint : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
      surfaceAreaElement3 (σ ∘ Prod.swap) p = surfaceAreaElement3 σ p.swap := by
    intro p
    exact surfaceAreaElement3_comp_swap σ p (hσ p.swap)
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  exact setIntegral_prod_swap s t (surfaceAreaElement3 σ)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.polynomial_self
statement:
theorem polynomial_self (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    polynomial f n c c = f c
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomial, Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro k hk hk0
    simp [hk0]
  · simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.taylorWithinEval_eq_polynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [taylor_within_apply]
  simp only [polynomial]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hkord : (k : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hkn
  have hderiv : iteratedDerivWithin k f (uIcc c x) c = iteratedDeriv k f c := by
    simp only [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedFDerivWithin, iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_eq_iteratedFDeriv (n := k) (uniqueDiffOn_uIcc hcx)
      (hf.of_le hkord).contDiffAt (by simp)]
  rw [hderiv]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.lagrange_remainder
statement:
theorem lagrange_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {c x : ℝ}
    (hcx : c ≠ x) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (n + 1) f) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo c x,
      f x = polynomial f n c x +
        iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f ξ * (x - c) ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv hcx hf.contDiffOn with ⟨ξ, hξ, hrem⟩
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  rw [← taylorWithinEval_eq_polynomial hcx hf.of_succ]
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.remainder_abs_le
statement:
theorem remainder_abs_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {c x M : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ (n + 1) f)
    (hM : ∀ y ∈ uIcc c x, |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f y| ≤ M) :
    |f x - polynomial f n c x| ≤
      M * |x - c| ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcx : c = x
  · subst x
    rw [polynomial_self]
    simp
  · rcases lagrange_remainder (n := n) hcx hf with ⟨ξ, hξ, hrem⟩
    have hξI : ξ ∈ uIcc c x := uIoo_subset_uIcc_self hξ
    have hderiv := hM ξ hξI
    have hfac : 0 < ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    rw [hrem]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hfac]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hderiv (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)) hfac.le

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.hasSum_exp
statement: theorem hasSum_exp (x : ℝ) : HasSum (expTerm x) (Real.exp x)
proof:
:= by
  change HasSum (fun n => x ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) (Real.exp x)
  rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ]
  exact NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.hasSum_cos
statement: theorem hasSum_cos (x : ℝ) : HasSum (cosTerm x) (Real.cos x)
proof:
:= by
  change HasSum
    (fun n => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * x ^ (2 * n) / ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ)) (Real.cos x)
  exact Real.hasSum_cos x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.hasSum_sin
statement: theorem hasSum_sin (x : ℝ) : HasSum (sinTerm x) (Real.sin x)
proof:
:= by
  change HasSum
    (fun n => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * x ^ (2 * n + 1) / ((2 * n + 1).factorial : ℝ))
    (Real.sin x)
  exact Real.hasSum_sin x

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.exp_eq_tsum
statement: theorem exp_eq_tsum (x : ℝ) : Real.exp x = ∑' n, expTerm x n
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_exp x).tsum_eq.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.cos_eq_tsum
statement: theorem cos_eq_tsum (x : ℝ) : Real.cos x = ∑' n, cosTerm x n
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_cos x).tsum_eq.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.sin_eq_tsum
statement: theorem sin_eq_tsum (x : ℝ) : Real.sin x = ∑' n, sinTerm x n
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_sin x).tsum_eq.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.exp_lagrange_remainder
statement:
theorem exp_lagrange_remainder {n : ℕ} {c x : ℝ} (hcx : c ≠ x) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo c x,
      Real.exp x = polynomial Real.exp n c x +
        Real.exp ξ * (x - c) ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lagrange_remainder (n := n) hcx Real.contDiff_exp with ⟨ξ, hξ, hrem⟩
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  have hexp : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) Real.exp ξ = Real.exp ξ := by
    have h := congrFun (iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul (n + 1) 1) ξ
    simpa using h
  simpa [hexp] using hrem

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.sin_remainder_abs_le
statement:
theorem sin_remainder_abs_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.sin x - polynomial Real.sin n 0 x| ≤
      |x| ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := remainder_abs_le (f := Real.sin) (n := n) (c := 0) (x := x) (M := 1)
    Real.contDiff_sin (fun y _ => Real.abs_iteratedDeriv_sin_le_one (n + 1) y)
  simpa using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.cos_remainder_abs_le
statement:
theorem cos_remainder_abs_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.cos x - polynomial Real.cos n 0 x| ≤
      |x| ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := remainder_abs_le (f := Real.cos) (n := n) (c := 0) (x := x) (M := 1)
    Real.contDiff_cos (fun y _ => Real.abs_iteratedDeriv_cos_le_one (n + 1) y)
  simpa using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.exp_remainder_abs_le
statement:
theorem exp_remainder_abs_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |Real.exp x - polynomial Real.exp n 0 x| ≤
      Real.exp |x| * |x| ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := remainder_abs_le (f := Real.exp) (n := n) (c := 0) (x := x)
    (M := Real.exp |x|) Real.contDiff_exp (by
      intro y hy
      have hiter : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) Real.exp y = Real.exp y := by
        have hi := congrFun (iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul (n + 1) 1) y
        simpa using hi
      rw [hiter, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos y)]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      rcases le_total 0 x with hx | hx
      · rw [uIcc_of_le hx] at hy
        calc
          y ≤ x := hy.2
          _ = |x| := (abs_of_nonneg hx).symm
      · rw [uIcc_comm, uIcc_of_le hx] at hy
        exact hy.2.trans (abs_nonneg x))
  simpa using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.hasSum_seriesHasSum
statement:
theorem hasSum_seriesHasSum {f : ℕ → ℝ} {s : ℝ} (h : HasSum f s) :

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.seriesHasSum_iff_hasSum_of_summable_abs
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.seriesAbsolutelyConvergent_iff_summable_abs

proof:

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact ⟨s, (hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat_of_nonneg (fun n => abs_nonneg (f n)) s).2 hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact ⟨s, hs.tendsto_sum_nat⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.summable_of_eventually_geometric_bound
proof:
:= by
  have hgeom : Summable (fun n : ℕ => |r| ^ n) := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (x := r)
        (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hr))
  have hmajor : Summable (fun n : ℕ => C * |r| ^ n) := hgeom.mul_left C
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat hmajor
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.root_test_of_eventually_geometric_majorant
proof:
:= by
  rcases hroot with ⟨r, C, hr, hC, hbound⟩
  exact summable_of_eventually_geometric_bound hr hC hbound

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.eventually_geometric_bound_of_root_bound
statement:
theorem eventually_geometric_bound_of_root_bound {f : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (n₀ : ℕ)
    (hroot : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, n₀ ≤ n → |f n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ r) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |f n| ≤ C * r ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, zero_le_one, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hroot, eventually_ge_atTop (max n₀ 1)] with n hn hN
  have hn0 : n₀ ≤ n := (le_max_left n₀ 1).trans hN
  have hnpos : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one
    ((le_max_right n₀ 1).trans hN)
  have hncast : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
  have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow (x := |f n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)))
    (y := r) (z := (n : ℝ)) (by positivity) (hn hn0) hncast.le
  have hleft : (|f n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) ^ (n : ℝ) = |f n| := by
    rw [show (1 / (n : ℝ)) = (n : ℝ)⁻¹ by simp [one_div]]
    simpa [Real.rpow_natCast] using
      (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (abs_nonneg (f n)) (Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos))
  rw [hleft] at hpow
  simpa [Real.rpow_natCast, one_mul] using hpow

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.summable_of_eventually_root_le
statement:
theorem summable_of_eventually_root_le {f : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hroot : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 ≤ n → |f n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ r) :
    Summable f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eventually_geometric_bound_of_root_bound hr0 hr1 1 hroot with
    ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩
  apply summable_of_eventually_geometric_bound (r := r)
    (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hr0] using hr1) hC
  simpa [abs_of_nonneg hr0] using hbound

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.summable_of_root_test
statement:
theorem summable_of_root_test {f : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ}
    (hl : l < 1)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => |f n| ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 l)) :
    Summable f
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := (max l 0 + 1) / 2
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
    dsimp [r]
    positivity
  have hlr : l < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hlmax : l ≤ max l 0 := le_max_left _ _
    linarith
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hmax : max l 0 < 1 := max_lt hl zero_lt_one
    linarith
  apply summable_of_eventually_root_le hr0 hr1
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 hlim).2 r hlr] with n hn
  intro _
  exact hn.le

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.sum_at_center
statement: theorem sum_at_center (a : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : sum a c c = a 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum]
  have hterm : term a c c = fun n => if n = 0 then a 0 else 0 := by
    funext n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      simp [term]
    · simp [term, hn]
  rw [hterm]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.absolutelyConvergesAt_of_lt_of_convergesAt
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨s, hs⟩
  change Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * (x - c) ^ n)
    atTop (𝓝 s) at hs
  have hCauchy : CauchySeq
      (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n * (x - c) ^ n) := hs.cauchySeq
  have hsum : Summable (fun n => a n * (y - c) ^ n) :=
    summable_powerSeries_of_norm_lt hCauchy (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hyx)
  change Summable (fun n => |a n * (y - c) ^ n|)
  exact hsum.abs

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.distance_le_radius_of_convergesAt
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.absolutelyConvergesAt_of_lt_radius
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_sSup_iff.mp hx with ⟨r, ⟨y, hy, hry⟩, hxr⟩
  have hxyE : ENNReal.ofReal |x - c| < ENNReal.ofReal |y - c| := hxr.trans_le hry
  have hypos : 0 < |y - c| := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pos]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt bot_le hxyE
  have hxy : |x - c| < |y - c| :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hypos).mp hxyE
  exact absolutelyConvergesAt_of_lt_of_convergesAt hxy hy

proof:
:= by

:=

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.not_mem_convergenceSet_of_radius_lt

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.abs_le_finiteRadius_of_convergesAt
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.absolutelyConvergesAt_of_abs_lt_finiteRadius
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.not_convergesAt_of_finiteRadius_lt_abs

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.convergesAt_iff_interior_or_endpoints
statement:
theorem convergesAt_iff_interior_or_endpoints {a : ℕ → ℝ} {c x : ℝ}
    (hfin : radius a c ≠ ⊤) :
    ConvergesAt a c x ↔
      |x - c| < finiteRadius a c ∨
      (x = leftEndpoint a c ∧ ConvergesAt a c (leftEndpoint a c)) ∨
      (x = rightEndpoint a c ∧ ConvergesAt a c (rightEndpoint a c))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hle := abs_le_finiteRadius_of_convergesAt hfin hx
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
    · exact Or.inl hlt
    · rcases (abs_eq ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mp heq with hpos | hneg
      · have hxeq : x = rightEndpoint a c := by
          dsimp [rightEndpoint, finiteRadius]
          linarith
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hxeq, hxeq ▸ hx⟩)
      · have hxeq : x = leftEndpoint a c := by
          dsimp [leftEndpoint, finiteRadius]
          linarith
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hxeq, hxeq ▸ hx⟩)
  · rintro (hlt | ⟨rfl, hx⟩ | ⟨rfl, hx⟩)
    · exact absolutelyConvergesAt_imp_convergesAt
        (absolutelyConvergesAt_of_abs_lt_finiteRadius hfin hlt)
    · exact hx
    · exact hx

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.absolutelyConvergesAt_iff_interior_or_endpoints
statement:
theorem absolutelyConvergesAt_iff_interior_or_endpoints {a : ℕ → ℝ} {c x : ℝ}
    (hfin : radius a c ≠ ⊤) :
    AbsolutelyConvergesAt a c x ↔
      |x - c| < finiteRadius a c ∨
      (x = leftEndpoint a c ∧ AbsolutelyConvergesAt a c (leftEndpoint a c)) ∨
      (x = rightEndpoint a c ∧ AbsolutelyConvergesAt a c (rightEndpoint a c))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hconv := absolutelyConvergesAt_imp_convergesAt hx
    have hle := abs_le_finiteRadius_of_convergesAt hfin hconv
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
    · exact Or.inl hlt
    · rcases (abs_eq ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mp heq with hpos | hneg
      · have hxeq : x = rightEndpoint a c := by
          dsimp [rightEndpoint, finiteRadius]
          linarith
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hxeq, hxeq ▸ hx⟩)
      · have hxeq : x = leftEndpoint a c := by
          dsimp [leftEndpoint, finiteRadius]
          linarith
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hxeq, hxeq ▸ hx⟩)
  · rintro (hlt | ⟨rfl, hx⟩ | ⟨rfl, hx⟩)
    · exact absolutelyConvergesAt_of_abs_lt_finiteRadius hfin hlt
    · exact hx
    · exact hx

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.derivativeCoeffs_integralCoeffs
statement:
theorem derivativeCoeffs_integralCoeffs (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    derivativeCoeffs (integralCoeffs a) = a
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  simp only [derivativeCoeffs, integralCoeffs]
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.summable_shiftedMajorant
statement:
theorem summable_shiftedMajorant {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : Summable u) :
    Summable (shiftedMajorant u)
proof:
:= by
  apply (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
  simpa [shiftedMajorant] using hu

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.integralCoeffs_derivative_bound
statement:
theorem integralCoeffs_derivative_bound {a u : ℕ → ℝ} {c R : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ) y, |y - c| < R →
      ‖a n * (y - c) ^ n‖ ≤ u n) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) y, |y - c| < R →
      ‖(n : ℝ) * integralCoeffs a n * (y - c) ^ (n - 1)‖ ≤ shiftedMajorant u n
proof:
:= by
  intro n y hy
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [integralCoeffs, shiftedMajorant]
  | succ n =>
      have hcoeff : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * integralCoeffs a (n + 1) = a n := by
        simp only [integralCoeffs]
        field_simp
        norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        ring
      rw [Nat.succ_sub_one, hcoeff]
      simpa [shiftedMajorant] using hbound n y hy

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.sum_add_of_absolutelyConvergesAt
statement:
theorem sum_add_of_absolutelyConvergesAt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {c x : ℝ}
    (ha : AbsolutelyConvergesAt a c x)
    (hb : AbsolutelyConvergesAt b c x) :
    sum (addCoeffs a b) c x = sum a c x + sum b c x
proof:
:= by
  have haS : Summable (term a c x) := by
    apply Summable.of_norm
    simpa [AbsolutelyConvergesAt, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ha
  have hbS : Summable (term b c x) := by
    apply Summable.of_norm
    simpa [AbsolutelyConvergesAt, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb
  have hterm : term (addCoeffs a b) c x = fun n => term a c x n + term b c x n := by
    funext n
    simp [term, addCoeffs, add_mul]
  simp only [sum, hterm]
  exact haS.tsum_add hbS

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.sum_mul_of_absolutelyConvergesAt
statement:
theorem sum_mul_of_absolutelyConvergesAt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {c x : ℝ}
    (ha : AbsolutelyConvergesAt a c x)
    (hb : AbsolutelyConvergesAt b c x) :
    sum (mulCoeffs a b) c x = sum a c x * sum b c x
proof:
:= by
  let z := x - c
  have hprod := SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.tsum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute ha hb
  have hterm : term (mulCoeffs a b) c x =
      SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct (term a c x) (term b c x) := by
    funext n
    change SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct a b n * z ^ n =
      SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct
        (fun k => a k * z ^ k) (fun k => b k * z ^ k) n
    exact (SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct_mul_pow a b z n).symm
  simpa only [sum, hterm] using hprod

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.hasDerivAt_sum_of_summable_derivative_majorant
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sum_of_summable_derivative_majorant
    {a u : ℕ → ℝ} {c x R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hx : |x - c| < R)
    (hu : Summable u)
    (hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ) y, |y - c| < R →
      ‖(n : ℝ) * a n * (y - c) ^ (n - 1)‖ ≤ u n) :
    HasDerivAt (sum a c) (sum (derivativeCoeffs a) c x) x
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n y => a n * (y - c) ^ n
  let g' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n y => (n : ℝ) * a n * (y - c) ^ (n - 1)
  have hg : ∀ n y, HasDerivAt (g n) (g' n y) y := by
    intro n y
    have hp := ((hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const c).pow n
    simpa [g, g', mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hp.const_mul (a n)
  have hg0 : Summable (fun n => g n c) := by
    apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := {0})
    intro n hn
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by simpa using hn
    simp [g, hn0]
  have hball : x ∈ Metric.ball c R := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hx
  have hraw : HasDerivAt (fun y => ∑' n, g n y) (∑' n, g' n x) x := by
    apply hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball c R).isPreconnected (fun n y _ => hg n y)
    · intro n y hy
      apply hbound n y
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hy
    · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hR
    · exact hg0
    · exact hball
  have hg'S : Summable (fun n => g' n x) := by
    apply Summable.of_norm_bounded hu
    intro n
    exact hbound n x hx
  have hshift : (∑' n, g' n x) = sum (derivativeCoeffs a) c x := by
    have hsplit := hg'S.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
    rw [show (∑ n ∈ Finset.range 1, g' n x) = 0 by simp [g']] at hsplit
    have htail : (fun n => g' (n + 1) x) = term (derivativeCoeffs a) c x := by
      funext n
      simp [g', term, derivativeCoeffs, Nat.cast_add]
    simpa [sum, htail] using hsplit.symm
  change HasDerivAt (sum a c) (∑' n, g' n x) x at hraw
  rw [hshift] at hraw
  exact hraw

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.PowerSeries.hasDerivAt_sum_integralCoeffs_of_summable_majorant
statement:

    {a u : ℕ → ℝ} {c x R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hx : |x - c| < R)

      ‖a n * (y - c) ^ n‖ ≤ u n) :

:= by
  have h := hasDerivAt_sum_of_summable_derivative_majorant
    (a := integralCoeffs a) (u := shiftedMajorant u) (c := c) (x := x) (R := R)
    hR hx (summable_shiftedMajorant hu)
    (integralCoeffs_derivative_bound hbound)
  simpa only [derivativeCoeffs_integralCoeffs] using h

    {ε : Type*} (edges : Finset ε) (localIncidence : Fin 2 → ε → ℤ)
    (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ) (shared : ε)
    (hshared_mem : shared ∈ edges)
    (hshared : localIncidence 0 shared + localIncidence 1 shared = 0)
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges, externalIncidence e = ∑ i : Fin 2, localIncidence i e) :

proof:

  rw [hincidence shared hshared_mem, Fin.sum_univ_two, hshared]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.StokesDomainGluing.twoPatch_sharedEdge_cancellation
statement:
theorem twoPatch_sharedEdge_cancellation
    {ε : Type*} [DecidableEq ε] (edges : Finset ε) (localIncidence : Fin 2 → ε → ℤ)
    (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ) (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ) (shared : ε)
    (hshared_mem : shared ∈ edges)
    (hshared : localIncidence 0 shared + localIncidence 1 shared = 0)
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges, externalIncidence e = localIncidence 0 e + localIncidence 1 e) :
    externalIncidence shared = 0 ∧
      orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
        orientedBoundaryValue (edges.erase shared) externalIncidence edgeIntegral
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : externalIncidence shared = 0 := by
    rw [hincidence shared hshared_mem, hshared]
  refine ⟨hzero, ?_⟩
  have hsum : Finset.sum (edges.erase shared)
        (fun e => externalIncidence e • edgeIntegral e) =
      Finset.sum edges (fun e => externalIncidence e • edgeIntegral e) := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
    intro e he henot
    have heq : e = shared := by
      by_contra h
      exact henot (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h, he⟩)
    rw [heq, hzero, zero_smul]
  calc
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
        Finset.sum (edges.erase shared)
          (fun e => externalIncidence e • edgeIntegral e) := hsum.symm
    _ = orientedBoundaryValue (edges.erase shared) externalIncidence edgeIntegral := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.StokesDomainGluing.stokes_twoPatch_sharedEdge
statement:
theorem stokes_twoPatch_sharedEdge
    {ε : Type*} (edges : Finset ε)
    (parameterDomain : Fin 2 → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (pulledBackDensity : Fin 2 → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : Fin 2 → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ) (shared : ε)
    (hshared_mem : shared ∈ edges)
    (hshared : localIncidence 0 shared + localIncidence 1 shared = 0)
    (hregion : PiecewiseSmoothRegion Finset.univ edges parameterDomain
      pulledBackDensity localIncidence externalIncidence)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ p in parameterDomain i, pulledBackDensity i p ∂(volume.prod volume)) :
    (orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      (∫ p in parameterDomain 0, pulledBackDensity 0 p ∂(volume.prod volume)) +
        ∫ p in parameterDomain 1, pulledBackDensity 1 p ∂(volume.prod volume)) ∧
      externalIncidence shared = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgluing : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      externalIncidence e = localIncidence 0 e + localIncidence 1 e := by
    intro e he
    rw [hregion.gluing e he, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hfun : (fun e => localIncidence 0 e + localIncidence 1 e) =
        (fun e => ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), localIncidence i e) := by
      funext e
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    calc
      orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
          orientedBoundaryValue edges
            (fun e => localIncidence 0 e + localIncidence 1 e) edgeIntegral := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro e he
        rw [hgluing e he]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 2, orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral := by
        rw [hfun, orientedBoundaryValue_sum]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 2,
          ∫ p in parameterDomain i, pulledBackDensity i p ∂(volume.prod volume) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hlocal i)
      _ = (∫ p in parameterDomain 0, pulledBackDensity 0 p ∂(volume.prod volume)) +
          ∫ p in parameterDomain 1, pulledBackDensity 1 p ∂(volume.prod volume) := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  · rw [hgluing shared hshared_mem, hshared]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.StokesDomainGluing.twoPatchRegion_example
statement:
theorem twoPatchRegion_example :
    PiecewiseSmoothRegion (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1))
      twoPatchParameterDomain (fun _ _ => 0) twoPatchLocalIncidence (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i _
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · rw [twoPatchParameterDomain, if_pos hi]
      exact measurableSet_Iio.prod MeasurableSet.univ
    · rw [twoPatchParameterDomain, if_neg hi]
      exact measurableSet_Ici.prod MeasurableSet.univ
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b
    · exact absurd rfl hab
    · change Disjoint (twoPatchParameterDomain 0) (twoPatchParameterDomain 1)
      rw [show twoPatchParameterDomain 0 = Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.univ by
            simp [twoPatchParameterDomain],
          show twoPatchParameterDomain 1 = Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.univ by
            simp [twoPatchParameterDomain]]
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro p hp hp'
      simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_Ici, Set.mem_univ, and_true] at hp hp'
      linarith
    · change Disjoint (twoPatchParameterDomain 1) (twoPatchParameterDomain 0)
      rw [show twoPatchParameterDomain 1 = Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.univ by
            simp [twoPatchParameterDomain],
          show twoPatchParameterDomain 0 = Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.univ by
            simp [twoPatchParameterDomain]]
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro p hp hp'
      simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_Ici, Set.mem_univ, and_true] at hp hp'
      linarith
    · exact absurd rfl hab
  · intro i _
    exact integrableOn_zero
  · intro e _
    simp [twoPatchLocalIncidence, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.StokesDomainGluing.twoPatchRegion_stokes_example
statement:
theorem twoPatchRegion_stokes_example :
    orientedBoundaryValue (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) =
      finiteAtlasSurfaceIntegral (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
        twoPatchParameterDomain (fun _ _ => 0)
proof:
:=
  stokes_piecewiseSmoothRegion _ _ _ _ _ _ _ twoPatchRegion_example (by
    intro i _
    simp [orientedBoundaryValue])

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_rectangle
statement:
theorem green_rectangle
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (P' Q' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hPcont : ContinuousOn P ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hQcont : ContinuousOn Q ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hPderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂), HasFDerivAt P (P' z) z)
    (hQderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂), HasFDerivAt Q (Q' z) z)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1))
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]])) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral P Q a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ =
      ∫ x in a₁..b₁, ∫ y in a₂..b₂,
        Q' (x, y) (1, 0) - P' (x, y) (0, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv := MeasureTheory.integral2_divergence_prod_of_hasFDerivAt
    Q (-P) Q' (-P') a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂
    hQcont hPcont.neg hQderiv
    (fun z hz ↦ (hPderiv z hz).neg)
    (by
      simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, neg_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
        using hint)
  rw [rectangleBoundaryIntegral]
  calc
    _ = (((∫ x in a₁..b₁, (-P) (x, b₂)) -
          ∫ x in a₁..b₁, (-P) (x, a₂)) +
          ∫ y in a₂..b₂, Q (b₁, y)) -
          ∫ y in a₂..b₂, Q (a₁, y) := by
      simp only [Pi.neg_apply, intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
      abel
    _ = _ := hdiv.symm

    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a c b d e : ℝ)

        rectangleBoundaryIntegral P Q c d b e
proof:

    ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hPac hPcb,
