name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_binormal_domain
statement:
theorem green_binormal_domain
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ)
    (lower upper left right : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hleft : Continuous left) (hright : Continuous right)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x ≤ upper x)
    (hlr : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d, left y ≤ right y)
    (hdomains : xNormalDomain a b lower upper =
      yNormalDomain c d left right)
    (hPy : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (hQx : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      (yNormalDomain c d left right) (volume.prod volume))
    (hPdiff : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc (lower x) (upper x),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y)
    (hQdiff : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d, ∀ x ∈ Icc (left y) (right y),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x)
    (hPint : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun y ↦ P (x, y))) volume (lower x) (upper x))
    (hQint : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, y))) volume (left y) (right y)) :
    normalDomainBoundaryIntegral P Q a b c d lower upper left right =
      ∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper,
        (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1 -
          deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2) ∂(volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hPfiber : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      (∫ y in Icc (lower x) (upper x), deriv (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y) =
        P (x, upper x) - P (x, lower x) := by
    intro x hx
    calc
      _ = ∫ y in lower x..upper x, deriv (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (hlu x hx), integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
      _ = _ := intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
        (fun y hy ↦ hPdiff x hx y (by
          simpa [uIcc_of_le (hlu x hx)] using hy)) (hPint x hx)
  have hQfiber : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d,
      (∫ x in Icc (left y) (right y), deriv (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x) =
        Q (right y, y) - Q (left y, y) := by
    intro y hy
    calc
      _ = ∫ x in left y..right y, deriv (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (hlr y hy), integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
      _ = _ := intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
        (fun x hx ↦ hQdiff y hy x (by
          simpa [uIcc_of_le (hlr y hy)] using hx)) (hQint y hy)
  have hPregion :
      (∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper,
        deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2 ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
        ∫ x in Icc a b, P (x, upper x) - P (x, lower x) := by
    rw [integral_xNormalDomain_eq_iterated hlower hupper hPy]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
    intro x hx
    exact hPfiber x hx
  have hQregion :
      (∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper,
        deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1 ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
        ∫ y in Icc c d, Q (right y, y) - Q (left y, y) := by
    rw [hdomains]
    rw [integral_yNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable
      hleft.measurable hright.measurable hQx]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
    intro y hy
    exact hQfiber y hy
  have hQx' : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume) := by
    rw [hdomains]
    exact hQx
  have hPboundary :
      (∫ x in Icc a b, P (x, lower x) - P (x, upper x)) =
        -(∫ x in Icc a b, P (x, upper x) - P (x, lower x)) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
    intro x _
    simp
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub hQx' hPy, hQregion, hPregion,
    normalDomainBoundaryIntegral, hPboundary]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_finite_decomposition
statement:
theorem green_finite_decomposition
    {ι : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι)
    (cell : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (curlDensity : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localBoundary : ι → ℝ) (externalBoundary : ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GreenFiniteDecomposition pieces cell curlDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces, localBoundary i =
      ∫ z in cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hcancel : externalBoundary = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localBoundary i) :
    externalBoundary =
      ∫ z in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hcancel]
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ pieces, localBoundary i =
        ∑ i ∈ pieces, ∫ z in cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact hlocal i hi
    _ = _ := (MeasureTheory.integral_biUnion_finset pieces hdecomp.measurable
      hdecomp.pairwiseDisjoint hdecomp.integrable).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.orientedBoundaryValue_sum
statement:
theorem orientedBoundaryValue_sum {ι ε : Type*}
    (pieces : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (incidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges (fun e ↦ ∑ i ∈ pieces, incidence i e) edgeIntegral =
      ∑ i ∈ pieces, orientedBoundaryValue edges (incidence i) edgeIntegral
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [orientedBoundaryValue]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  rw [Finset.sum_smul]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.orientedBoundaryValue_add_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem orientedBoundaryValue_add_neg {ε : Type*} (edges : Finset ε)
    (incidence : ε → ℤ) (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges (fun e ↦ incidence e + -incidence e) edgeIntegral = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [orientedBoundaryValue]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.green_finite_decomposition_of_edge_incidence
statement:
theorem green_finite_decomposition_of_edge_incidence
    {ι ε : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (cell : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (curlDensity : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GreenFiniteDecomposition pieces cell curlDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ z in cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      externalIncidence e = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i e) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      ∫ z in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, curlDensity z ∂(volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  apply green_finite_decomposition pieces cell curlDensity
    (fun i ↦ orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral)
    (orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral) hdecomp hlocal
  calc
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
        orientedBoundaryValue edges (fun e ↦ ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i e)
          edgeIntegral := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e he
      rw [hincidence e he]
    _ = _ := orientedBoundaryValue_sum pieces edges localIncidence edgeIntegral

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.gauss_box3
statement:
theorem gauss_box3 (a b : Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (F : (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ) → (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ))
    (F' : (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ) →
      (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (2 + 1) → ℝ))
    (hFcont : ContinuousOn F (Icc a b))
    (hFderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ Ioo (a i) (b i)),
      HasFDerivAt F (F' x) x)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (divergence3 F') (Icc a b)) :
    boxBoundaryFlux3 F a b = ∫ x in Icc a b, divergence3 F' x
proof:
:= by
  have h := MeasureTheory.integral_divergence_of_hasFDerivAt_off_countable
    (n := 2) (a := a) (b := b) hab F F' ∅ Set.countable_empty hFcont
    (fun x hx ↦ hFderiv x hx.1)
    (by
      change IntegrableOn (divergence3 F') (Icc a b)
      exact hint)
  simpa only [boxBoundaryFlux3, divergence3] using h.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.gauss_finite_decomposition
statement:
theorem gauss_finite_decomposition
    {ι : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι)
    (cell : ι → Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (divDensity : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (localFlux : ι → ℝ) (externalFlux : ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GaussFiniteDecomposition pieces cell divDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces, localFlux i = ∫ x in cell i, divDensity x)
    (hcancel : externalFlux = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localFlux i) :
    externalFlux = ∫ x in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, divDensity x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hcancel]
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ pieces, localFlux i =
        ∑ i ∈ pieces, ∫ x in cell i, divDensity x := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact hlocal i hi
    _ = _ := (MeasureTheory.integral_biUnion_finset pieces hdecomp.measurable
      hdecomp.pairwiseDisjoint hdecomp.integrable).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.gauss_finite_decomposition_of_face_incidence
statement:
theorem gauss_finite_decomposition_of_face_incidence
    {ι φ : Type*} (pieces : Finset ι) (faces : Finset φ)
    (cell : ι → Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (divDensity : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → φ → ℤ) (externalIncidence : φ → ℤ)
    (faceFlux : φ → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GaussFiniteDecomposition pieces cell divDensity)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ pieces,
      orientedBoundaryValue faces (localIncidence i) faceFlux =
        ∫ x in cell i, divDensity x)
    (hincidence : ∀ f ∈ faces,
      externalIncidence f = ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i f) :
    orientedBoundaryValue faces externalIncidence faceFlux =
      ∫ x in ⋃ i ∈ pieces, cell i, divDensity x
proof:
:= by
  apply gauss_finite_decomposition pieces cell divDensity
    (fun i ↦ orientedBoundaryValue faces (localIncidence i) faceFlux)
    (orientedBoundaryValue faces externalIncidence faceFlux) hdecomp hlocal
  calc
    orientedBoundaryValue faces externalIncidence faceFlux =
        orientedBoundaryValue faces
          (fun f ↦ ∑ i ∈ pieces, localIncidence i f) faceFlux := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f hf
      rw [hincidence f hf]
    _ = _ := orientedBoundaryValue_sum pieces faces localIncidence faceFlux

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_parametrized_rectangle
statement:
theorem stokes_parametrized_rectangle
    (A : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3)
    (P' Q' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hPcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hQcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hPderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ) (P' z) z)
    (hQderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) (Q' z) z)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1))
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]])) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
        (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ =
      ∫ u in a₁..b₁, ∫ v in a₂..b₂,
        Q' (u, v) (1, 0) - P' (u, v) (0, 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact green_rectangle
    (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ) (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ)
    P' Q' a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ hPcont hQcont hPderiv hQderiv hint

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.curlMatrix3_dot_cross
statement:
theorem curlMatrix3_dot_cross (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    curlMatrix3 J ⬝ᵥ (u ⨯₃ v) =
      (J *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ v - (J *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [curlMatrix3, cross_apply, mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  dsimp only [Matrix.cons_val, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.pullback_curl_density_eq_dot_cross
statement:
theorem pullback_curl_density_eq_dot_cross
    (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (Puv Quv : ℝ)
    (hP : Puv = (J *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ u)
    (hQ : Quv = (J *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ v) :
    Quv - Puv = curlMatrix3 J ⬝ᵥ (u ⨯₃ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP, hQ, curlMatrix3_dot_cross]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_parametrized_rectangle_curl
statement:
theorem stokes_parametrized_rectangle_curl
    (A : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (σ : ParametrizedSurface 3)
    (P' Q' : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (J : ℝ × ℝ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ)
    (hPcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hQcont : ContinuousOn (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ)
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hPderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ) (P' z) z)
    (hQderiv : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (min a₁ b₁) (max a₁ b₁) ×ˢ
        Ioo (min a₂ b₂) (max a₂ b₂),
      HasFDerivAt (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) (Q' z) z)
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1))
      ([[a₁, b₁]] ×ˢ [[a₂, b₂]]))
    (hcurl : ∀ z, Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1) =
      curlMatrix3 (J z) ⬝ᵥ
        (surfaceTangent₁ σ z ⨯₃ surfaceTangent₂ σ z)) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ A σ)
        (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ A σ) a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ =
      ∫ u in a₁..b₁, ∫ v in a₂..b₂,
        curlMatrix3 (J (u, v)) ⬝ᵥ
          (surfaceTangent₁ σ (u, v) ⨯₃ surfaceTangent₂ σ (u, v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stokes_parametrized_rectangle A σ P' Q' a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂
    hPcont hQcont hPderiv hQderiv hint]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro u _
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro v _
  exact hcurl (u, v)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_finite_patches_of_edge_incidence
statement:
theorem stokes_finite_patches_of_edge_incidence
    {ι ε : Type*} (patches : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (parameterCell : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (pulledBackExteriorDerivative : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : GreenFiniteDecomposition patches parameterCell
      pulledBackExteriorDerivative)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ patches,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ p in parameterCell i,
          pulledBackExteriorDerivative p ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      externalIncidence e = ∑ i ∈ patches, localIncidence i e) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      ∫ p in ⋃ i ∈ patches, parameterCell i,
        pulledBackExteriorDerivative p ∂(volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  exact green_finite_decomposition_of_edge_incidence patches edges parameterCell
    pulledBackExteriorDerivative localIncidence externalIncidence edgeIntegral
    hdecomp hlocal hincidence

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_finite_atlas_of_edge_incidence
statement:
theorem stokes_finite_atlas_of_edge_incidence
    {ι ε : Type*} (patches : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (parameterDomain : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (pulledBackExteriorDerivative : ι → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ patches,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ p in parameterDomain i,
          pulledBackExteriorDerivative i p ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      externalIncidence e = ∑ i ∈ patches, localIncidence i e) :
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
      finiteAtlasSurfaceIntegral patches parameterDomain
        pulledBackExteriorDerivative
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral =
        orientedBoundaryValue edges
          (fun e ↦ ∑ i ∈ patches, localIncidence i e) edgeIntegral := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e he
      rw [hincidence e he]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ patches,
        orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral :=
      orientedBoundaryValue_sum patches edges localIncidence edgeIntegral
    _ = finiteAtlasSurfaceIntegral patches parameterDomain
        pulledBackExteriorDerivative := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact hlocal i hi

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.GreenGaussStokes.stokes_closed_finite_atlas
statement:
theorem stokes_closed_finite_atlas
    {ι ε : Type*} (patches : Finset ι) (edges : Finset ε)
    (parameterDomain : ι → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (pulledBackExteriorDerivative : ι → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (localIncidence : ι → ε → ℤ) (externalIncidence : ε → ℤ)
    (edgeIntegral : ε → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ i ∈ patches,
      orientedBoundaryValue edges (localIncidence i) edgeIntegral =
        ∫ p in parameterDomain i,
          pulledBackExteriorDerivative i p ∂(volume.prod volume))
    (hincidence : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      externalIncidence e = ∑ i ∈ patches, localIncidence i e)
    (hclosed : ∀ e ∈ edges, externalIncidence e = 0) :
    finiteAtlasSurfaceIntegral patches parameterDomain
      pulledBackExteriorDerivative = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hstokes := stokes_finite_atlas_of_edge_incidence patches edges
    parameterDomain pulledBackExteriorDerivative localIncidence externalIncidence
    edgeIntegral hlocal hincidence
  have hboundary : orientedBoundaryValue edges externalIncidence edgeIntegral = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro e he
    rw [hclosed e he]
    simp
  rw [hboundary] at hstokes
  exact hstokes.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceConvergesTo_iff_epsilon_N
statement:
theorem sequenceConvergesTo_iff_epsilon_N {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} :
    SequenceConvergesTo u l ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |u n - l| < ε
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.tendsto_iff_epsilon_N
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_epsilon_N {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} :
    Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |u n - l| < ε
proof:
:= by
  
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using Metric.tendsto_atTop (u := u) (a := l)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto
statement:
theorem sequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} :
    SequenceConvergesTo u l ↔ Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SequenceConvergesTo] using (tendsto_iff_epsilon_N (u := u) (l := l)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceConvergent_iff_exists_tendsto
statement:
theorem sequenceConvergent_iff_exists_tendsto {u : ℕ → ℝ} :
    SequenceConvergent u ↔ ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SequenceConvergent, sequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceIsCauchy_iff_epsilon_N
statement:
theorem sequenceIsCauchy_iff_epsilon_N {u : ℕ → ℝ} :
    SequenceIsCauchy u ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, |u m - u n| < ε
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceIsCauchy_iff_cauchySeq
statement:
theorem sequenceIsCauchy_iff_cauchySeq {u : ℕ → ℝ} :
    SequenceIsCauchy u ↔ CauchySeq u
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SequenceIsCauchy, Real.dist_eq] using (Metric.cauchySeq_iff (u := u)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceConvergesTo_unique
statement:
theorem sequenceConvergesTo_unique {u : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : SequenceConvergesTo u a) (hb : SequenceConvergesTo u b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (sequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto.mp ha)
    (sequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto.mp hb)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.sequenceConvergesTo_sequenceIsCauchy
statement:
theorem sequenceConvergesTo_sequenceIsCauchy {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ}
    (h : SequenceConvergesTo u l) : SequenceIsCauchy u
proof:
:= by
  exact sequenceIsCauchy_iff_cauchySeq.mpr
    (Filter.Tendsto.cauchy_map (sequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto.mp h))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.seq_limit_unique
statement:
theorem seq_limit_unique {u : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a)) (hb : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 b)) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (f := u) ha hb

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.convergent_bddAbove
statement:
theorem convergent_bddAbove {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} (h : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)) :
    BddAbove (Set.range u)
proof:
:= by
  have hε : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |u n - l| < ε := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h
  rcases hε 1 zero_lt_one with ⟨N, hN⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, u n ≤ l + 1 := by
    rw [eventually_atTop]
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    have hpos : u n - l < 1 := (abs_lt.mp (hN n hn)).2
    linarith
  exact (isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (f := atTop) (u := u) (a := l + 1) hev).bddAbove_range

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.convergent_bddBelow
statement:
theorem convergent_bddBelow {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} (h : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)) :
    BddBelow (Set.range u)
proof:
:= by
  have hε : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |u n - l| < ε := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h
  rcases hε 1 zero_lt_one with ⟨N, hN⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, l - 1 ≤ u n := by
    rw [eventually_atTop]
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    have hneg : -(1) < u n - l := (abs_lt.mp (hN n hn)).1
    linarith
  exact (isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_ge (f := atTop) (u := u) (a := l - 1) hev).bddBelow_range

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.convergent_bounded
statement:
theorem convergent_bounded {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} (h : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)) :
    BddAbove (Set.range u) ∧ BddBelow (Set.range u)
proof:

proof:
:= by
  rcases hb with ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩
  rcases hbdl with ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩
  let M : ℝ := max |a₀| |b₀|
  refine ⟨-M, M, ?_⟩
  intro n
  constructor
  · dsimp [M]
    calc
      -max |a₀| |b₀| ≤ -|a₀| := neg_le_neg (le_max_left |a₀| |b₀|)
      _ ≤ a₀ := neg_abs_le a₀
      _ ≤ u n := ha₀ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  · dsimp [M]
    calc
      u n ≤ b₀ := hb₀ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      _ ≤ |b₀| := le_abs_self b₀
      _ ≤ max |a₀| |b₀| := le_max_right |a₀| |b₀|

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Sequence.convergent_is_cauchy
statement: theorem convergent_is_cauchy {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ} (h : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)) : CauchySeq u
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h (ε / 2) hε2 with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro m hm n hn
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  have htri : |u m - u n| ≤ |u m - l| + |u n - l| := by
    calc
      |u m - u n| = |(u m - l) + (l - u n)| := by
        rw [show (u m - l) + (l - u n) = u m - u n by ring]
      _ ≤ |u m - l| + |l - u n| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |u m - l| + |u n - l| := by rw [abs_sub_comm l (u n)]
  linarith [htri,
    (show |u m - l| < ε / 2 by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN m hm),
    (show |u n - l| < ε / 2 by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN n hn)]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.integral_remainder
statement:
theorem integral_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {c x : ℝ}
    (hcx : c < x) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (n + 1) f) :
    f x = polynomial f n c x +
      riemannIntegral
        (fun t => (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t) c x
proof:
:= by
  have hmath := taylor_integral_remainder (f := f) (x := x) (x₀ := c) (n := n)
    hf.contDiffOn
  have hpoly : taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc c x) c x = polynomial f n c x := by
    exact taylorWithinEval_eq_polynomial hcx.ne (hf.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
  have hs : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (uIcc c x) := uniqueDiffOn_uIcc hcx.ne
  have hinter :
      (∫ t in c..x,
        ((x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) *
          iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc c x) t) =
      ∫ t in c..x,
        ((x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_uIoo
    intro t ht
    change (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) *
        iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (uIcc c x) t =
      (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hs hf.contDiffAt
      (uIoo_subset_uIcc_self ht)]
  have hderivCont : Continuous (iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f) :=
    hf.continuous_iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (by norm_cast)
  have hintCont : Continuous
      (fun t => (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t) :=
    (((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).pow n).div_const _).mul hderivCont
  have hbridge : riemannIntegral
      (fun t => (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t) c x =
      ∫ t in c..x,
        ((x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t := by
    rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hcx hintCont.continuousOn,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hcx.le]
  rw [hpoly] at hmath
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hmath
  rw [hinter, ← hbridge] at hmath
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.TaylorSeries.exp_integral_remainder
statement:
theorem exp_integral_remainder {n : ℕ} {c x : ℝ} (hcx : c < x) :
    Real.exp x = polynomial Real.exp n c x +
      riemannIntegral
        (fun t => (x - t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp t) c x
proof:
:= by
  have hiter : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) Real.exp = Real.exp := by
    funext t
    have ht := congrFun (iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul (n + 1) 1) t
    simpa using ht
  simpa [hiter] using integral_remainder (f := Real.exp) (n := n) hcx Real.contDiff_exp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Derivative.deriv_inverse_of_eventually_left_inverse
statement:
theorem deriv_inverse_of_eventually_left_inverse
    {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {x f' g' : ℝ}
    (hf : HasDerivAt f f' x) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' (f x))
    (hinv : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, g (f y) = y) (hf' : f' ≠ 0) :
    g' = 1 / f'
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (g ∘ f) (g' * f') x := hg.comp x hf
  have hinv' : id =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g ∘ f := by
    filter_upwards [hinv] with y hy
    exact hy.symm
  have hid : HasDerivAt id (g' * f') x := by
    exact hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq hinv'
  have hprod : g' * f' = 1 := hid.unique (hasDerivAt_id x)
  field_simp
  exact hprod

    ((∀ k : ℤ, x ≠ (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / 2) ∧
      ∀ l : ℤ, y ≠ (2 * (l : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / 2) ∨
      ((∃ k : ℤ, x = (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / 2) ∧
        ∃ l : ℤ, y = (2 * (l : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / 2)) :
    Real.tan (x - y) = (Real.tan x - Real.tan y) /
      (1 + Real.tan x * Real.tan y)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.tan_sub h

proof:
:= by

proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.abs_sin_half x
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith) (by linarith))] at h

proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_cos_half x
  rw [abs_of_nonneg] at h
  · exact h
  · apply Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
    constructor <;> linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.ClassicalLimits.tendsto_sin_div_id
statement:
theorem tendsto_sin_div_id :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin x / x) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, Real.cos_zero] using
    (Real.hasDerivAt_sin 0).tendsto_slope_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.ClassicalLimits.tendsto_one_sub_cos_div_sq
statement:
theorem tendsto_one_sub_cos_div_sq :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (1 - Real.cos x) / x ^ 2) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x / 2) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝[≠] 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff (a := (0 : ℝ)) (s := {0}ᶜ)]
    constructor
    · simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
        (tendsto_id'.2 (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)).const_mul
          (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
      exact Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (by
        intro h
        apply (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hx)
        linarith)
  have hs : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (x / 2) / (x / 2))
      (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 1) := tendsto_sin_div_id.comp hhalf
  have hs_sq : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sin (x / 2) / (x / 2)) ^ 2)
      (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 1) := by simpa using hs.pow 2
  have hlim := hs_sq.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hfun : (fun x : ℝ => (1 - Real.cos x) / x ^ 2) =
      (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.sin (x / 2) / (x / 2)) ^ 2) := by
    funext x
    have htrig : 1 - Real.cos x = 2 * Real.sin (x / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h := Real.cos_two_mul_eq_one_sub (x / 2)
      rw [show 2 * (x / 2) = x by ring] at h
      nlinarith
    rw [htrig]
    field_simp
  rw [hfun]
  simpa using hlim

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.ClassicalLimits.tendsto_log_one_add_div

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Constants.factorial_mul_partial_sum_is_int
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.factorial / k.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ), ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_natCast]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
  have hdvd : k.factorial ∣ n.factorial := Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial hkn
  rw [Nat.cast_div hdvd (by positivity)]
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Constants.factorial_mul_rational_is_int
statement:
private lemma factorial_mul_rational_is_int (q : ℚ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (q.den.factorial : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.dvd_factorial q.pos (le_refl q.den)
  refine ⟨q.num * c, ?_⟩
  rw [Rat.cast_def, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [hc]
  field_simp
  push_cast
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Constants.exp_one_partial_sum_lt
statement:
private lemma exp_one_partial_sum_lt (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial) < Real.exp 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial) <
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial) +
          1 / ↑(n + 1).factorial :=
      lt_add_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial := by
      simpa only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm] using
        (Finset.sum_range_succ (f := fun k => (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial) (n + 1)).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
      simpa using Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (x := (1 : ℝ)) zero_le_one (n + 2)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Constants.factorial_mul_exp_one_sub_partial_sum_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  have hb := Real.exp_bound (x := (1 : ℝ)) (n := n + 1) (by simp) (by omega)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 -
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    simpa only [one_pow] using
      Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (x := (1 : ℝ)) zero_le_one (n + 1)
  have hb' : Real.exp 1 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial ≤
      (n + 1).succ / (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [one_pow, abs_one, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] using hb
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < n.factorial := by positivity
  calc
    (n.factorial : ℝ) *
        (Real.exp 1 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) / k.factorial)
        ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) *
          ((n + 1).succ / (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb' hfac.le
    _ < 1 := by
      have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Constants.e_irrational
statement: theorem e_irrational : Irrational e
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_eq_exp_one]
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  let n := q.den
  have hn : 0 < n := q.pos
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := factorial_mul_rational_is_int q
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := factorial_mul_partial_sum_is_int n
  have hq' : (q : ℝ) = Real.exp 1 := hq
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (u - v : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.cast_sub, ← hu, ← hv, hq']
    rw [← mul_sub]
    exact mul_pos (by positivity) (sub_pos.mpr (exp_one_partial_sum_lt n))
  have hlt : ((u - v : ℤ) : ℝ) < 1 := by
    rw [Int.cast_sub, ← hu, ← hv, hq', ← mul_sub]
    exact factorial_mul_exp_one_sub_partial_sum_lt_one n hn
  have hpos' : (0 : ℤ) < u - v := by exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hlt' : u - v < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hlt
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.intermediate_value
statement:
theorem intermediate_value {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) {y : ℝ} (h : y ∈ Set.Icc (f a) (f b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Set.Icc (f a) (f b) ⊆ f '' Set.Icc a b := intermediate_value_Icc hab hf
  have hyimg : y ∈ f '' Set.Icc a b := hsub h
  rcases hyimg with ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.exists_isGreatest_on_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_isGreatest_on_Icc {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, f y ≤ f x
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℝ := Set.Icc a b
  have hIcc : IsCompact s := CompactIccSpace.isCompact_Icc
  have hne : s.Nonempty := ⟨a, by simp [s, hab]⟩
  have himg : IsCompact (f '' s) := IsCompact.image_of_continuousOn hIcc hf
  have hneimg : (f '' s).Nonempty := hne.image f
  rcases himg.exists_isGreatest hneimg with ⟨M, hM⟩
  rcases hM.1 with ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hyin : f y ∈ f '' s := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [hfx]
  exact hM.2 hyin

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.exists_isLeast_on_Icc

theorem exists_isLeast_on_Icc {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ f y
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℝ := Set.Icc a b
  have hIcc : IsCompact s := CompactIccSpace.isCompact_Icc
  have hne : s.Nonempty := ⟨a, by simp [s, hab]⟩
  have himg : IsCompact (f '' s) := IsCompact.image_of_continuousOn hIcc hf
  have hneimg : (f '' s).Nonempty := hne.image f
  rcases himg.exists_isLeast hneimg with ⟨m, hm⟩
  rcases hm.1 with ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hyin : f y ∈ f '' s := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [hfx]
  exact hm.2 hyin

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.uniformContinuous_iff_eps_delta
statement:
theorem uniformContinuous_iff_eps_delta {f : ℝ → ℝ} :
    UniformContinuous f ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x y, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    rcases h ε hε with ⟨δ, hδ, hδδ⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hδδ hxy
  · intro h ε hε
    rcases h ε hε with ⟨δ, hδ, hδδ⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hδδ a b hab

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.continuous_of_uniformContinuous
statement:
theorem continuous_of_uniformContinuous {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : UniformContinuous f) :
    Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
  intro ε hε
  rcases (uniformContinuous_iff_eps_delta.mp hf) ε hε with ⟨δ, hδ, hδδ⟩
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have : |f y - f x| < ε := hδδ y x (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hy)
  simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using this

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_apply
statement:
lemma mono_inv_apply {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) (y : ↑(Set.range f)) :
    f (mono_inv hf y) = y.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold mono_inv
  have hz := OrderIso.apply_symm_apply (StrictMono.orderIso f hf) y
  change ⟨f ((StrictMono.orderIso f hf).symm y), _⟩ = y at hz
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hz

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_lt_iff
statement:
lemma mono_inv_lt_iff {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) (y1 y2 : ↑(Set.range f)) :
    mono_inv hf y1 < mono_inv hf y2 ↔ y1 < y2
proof:
:= by
  unfold mono_inv
  exact OrderIso.lt_iff_lt (StrictMono.orderIso f hf).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.mono_inv_sub_apply
statement:
lemma mono_inv_sub_apply {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) (t : ℝ) :
    mono_inv hf ⟨f t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩ = t
proof:
:= by
  unfold mono_inv
  exact OrderIso.symm_apply_apply (StrictMono.orderIso f hf) t

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.inverse_continuous
statement: theorem inverse_continuous {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : StrictMono f) : Continuous (mono_inv hf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
  intro y₀ ε hε
  let x₀ := mono_inv hf y₀
  have hfx0 : f x₀ = y₀.val := by dsimp [x₀]; exact mono_inv_apply hf y₀
  have hlt_left : f (x₀ - ε) < y₀.val := by
    have : f (x₀ - ε) < f x₀ := hf (by linarith)
    rwa [hfx0] at this
  have hlt_right : y₀.val < f (x₀ + ε) := by
    have : f x₀ < f (x₀ + ε) := hf (by linarith)
    rwa [hfx0] at this
  let δ := min (y₀.val - f (x₀ - ε)) (f (x₀ + ε) - y₀.val)
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]; exact lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hlt_left) (sub_pos.mpr hlt_right)
  refine ⟨δ, hδpos, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hdy : |y.val - y₀.val| < δ := by
    simpa [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq] using hy
  have hgl : x₀ - ε < mono_inv hf y := by
    have hyv : f (x₀ - ε) < y.val := by
      have hd_le : |y.val - y₀.val| < y₀.val - f (x₀ - ε) := by
        have : δ ≤ y₀.val - f (x₀ - ε) := by dsimp [δ]; exact min_le_left (y₀.val - f (x₀ - ε)) (f (x₀ + ε) - y₀.val)
        linarith
      have habs := abs_lt.mp hd_le
      linarith
    have hyl := mono_inv_lt_iff hf (y1 := (⟨f (x₀ - ε), ⟨x₀ - ε, rfl⟩⟩ : ↑(Set.range f))) (y2 := y)
    have : mono_inv hf ⟨f (x₀ - ε), ⟨x₀ - ε, rfl⟩⟩ < mono_inv hf y := (hyl).mpr hyv
    simpa [mono_inv_sub_apply hf (x₀ - ε)] using this
  have hgr : mono_inv hf y < x₀ + ε := by
    have hyv : y.val < f (x₀ + ε) := by
      have hd_le : |y.val - y₀.val| < f (x₀ + ε) - y₀.val := by
        have : δ ≤ f (x₀ + ε) - y₀.val := by dsimp [δ]; exact min_le_right (y₀.val - f (x₀ - ε)) (f (x₀ + ε) - y₀.val)
        linarith
      have habs := abs_lt.mp hd_le
      linarith
    have hyr := mono_inv_lt_iff hf (y1 := y) (y2 := (⟨f (x₀ + ε), ⟨x₀ + ε, rfl⟩⟩ : ↑(Set.range f)))
    have : mono_inv hf y < mono_inv hf ⟨f (x₀ + ε), ⟨x₀ + ε, rfl⟩⟩ := (hyr).mpr hyv
    simpa [mono_inv_sub_apply hf (x₀ + ε)] using this
  have : |mono_inv hf y - x₀| < ε := by
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
  simpa [Real.dist_eq]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.hpt_theorem
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact Metric.continuousOn_iff.mp hf x hx (ε / 2) (by positivity)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.cover_theorem
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
  have hδ : 0 < (hpt x hx).choose := (hpt x hx).choose_spec.1
  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
  rw [dist_self]
  exact div_pos hδ (by norm_num)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hpt := hpt_theorem hf hε
  have hcov : s ⊆ ⋃ x : s, Metric.ball x.1 ((hpt x.1 x.2).choose / 2) := cover_theorem hpt
  have hUo : ∀ x : s, IsOpen (Metric.ball x.1 ((hpt x.1 x.2).choose / 2)) := by
    intro x; exact Metric.isOpen_ball
  rcases hs.elim_finite_subcover (fun x : s => Metric.ball x.1 ((hpt x.1 x.2).choose / 2)) hUo hcov with ⟨t, ht⟩
  have htne : t.Nonempty := by
    rcases hsne with ⟨x0, hx0⟩
    
    have hmem : ∃ x : s, x ∈ t ∧ x0 ∈ Metric.ball x.1 ((hpt x.1 x.2).choose / 2) := by
      simpa [Set.mem_iUnion] using ht hx0
    rcases hmem with ⟨x, hx_t, _⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx_t⟩
  let img := t.image fun x : s => (hpt x.1 x.2).choose / 2
  have himgne : img.Nonempty := t.image_nonempty.mpr htne
  let δ := img.min' himgne
  have hall_pos : ∀ d ∈ img, 0 < d := by
    intro d hd
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hd with ⟨x, hx_t, rfl⟩
    exact div_pos (hpt x.1 x.2).choose_spec.1 (by norm_num)
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact hall_pos _ (Finset.min'_mem img himgne)
  refine ⟨δ, hδpos, ?_⟩
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have hmem : ∃ x : s, x ∈ t ∧ a ∈ Metric.ball x.1 ((hpt x.1 x.2).choose / 2) := by
    simpa [Set.mem_iUnion] using ht ha
  rcases hmem with ⟨x0, hx0t, hx0a⟩
  have hx0_im : (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose / 2 ∈ img := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x0, hx0t, rfl⟩
  have hδ_le : δ ≤ (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose / 2 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hx0_im
  have hxa : dist a x0.1 < (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose / 2 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hx0a
  have hyb : dist b x0.1 < (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose := by
    
    have htri : dist b x0.1 ≤ dist b a + dist a x0.1 := dist_triangle b a x0.1
    have hba : dist b a = dist a b := dist_comm b a
    nlinarith [htri, hba, hab, hδ_le, hxa]
  have hδx0pos : 0 < (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose := (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose_spec.1
  have hxa_strong : dist a x0.1 < (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose :=
    lt_trans hxa (half_lt_self hδx0pos)
  have hyb_strong : dist b x0.1 < (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose := hyb
  have hfa : |f a - f x0.1| < ε / 2 := (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose_spec.2 a ha hxa_strong
  have hfb : |f b - f x0.1| < ε / 2 := (hpt x0.1 x0.2).choose_spec.2 b hb hyb_strong
  have : |f b - f a| < ε := by
    
    have hsplit : |f b - f a| ≤ |f b - f x0.1| + |f x0.1 - f a| := by
      rw [show f b - f a = (f b - f x0.1) + (f x0.1 - f a) by ring]
      exact abs_add_le _ _
    have hfa' : |f x0.1 - f a| < ε / 2 := by rwa [abs_sub_comm]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hsplit (by nlinarith)
  simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using this

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.young
statement:
theorem young (a b : ℝ) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    a * b ≤ |a| ^ p / p + |b| ^ q / q
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.young_inequality a b hpq

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.holder
statement:
theorem holder (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {p q : ℝ}
    (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, |f i * g i| ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) * (∑ i ∈ s, |g i| ^ q) ^ (1 / q)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [abs_mul] using
    (Real.inner_le_Lp_mul_Lq s (fun i => |f i|) (fun i => |g i|) hpq)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.cauchy_schwarz_sq
statement:
theorem cauchy_schwarz_sq (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq s f g

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FiniteInequalities.minkowski
statement:
theorem minkowski (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, |f i + g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p) +
        (∑ i ∈ s, |g i| ^ p) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.Lp_add_le s f g hp

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral_of_aeContinuous
statement:
theorem hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral_of_aeContinuous {n : ℕ}
    {s : Set (JordanEuc n)} {f : JordanEuc n → ℝ}
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s volume) (I : RiemannBox n)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Box.Icc I, ‖s.indicator f x‖ ≤ C)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ContinuousAt (s.indicator f) x)
    (hsub : s ⊆ (I : Set (JordanEuc n))) :
    HasRiemannBoxIntegral (s.indicator f) I (∫ x in s, f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hbox := MeasureTheory.AEContinuous.hasBoxIntegral volume hb hc
    IntegrationParams.Riemann
  have hI_meas : MeasurableSet (I : Set (JordanEuc n)) := I.measurableSet_coe
  have heq : (∫ x in (I : Set (JordanEuc n)), s.indicator f x) = ∫ x in s, f x := by
    calc
      (∫ x in (I : Set (JordanEuc n)), s.indicator f x) =
          ∫ x, s.indicator f x := by
            rw [← integral_indicator hI_meas]
            congr 1
            funext x
            by_cases hx : x ∈ s
            · simp [hx, hsub hx]
            · simp [hx]
      _ = ∫ x in s, f x := integral_indicator₀ hs
  rw [← heq]
  exact hbox

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.jordan_indicator_ae_continuous
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr hs.2] with x hx
  exact hf.continuousOn.continuousAt_indicator hx

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.jordan_indicator_bounded_on_box
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := I.isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max 0 C₀, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Set.indicator]
  split_ifs
  · exact le_max_of_le_right (hC₀ x hx)
  · exact norm_zero.trans_le (le_max_left 0 C₀)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral
statement:
theorem hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral {n : ℕ}
    {s : Set (JordanEuc n)} {f : JordanEuc n → ℝ} (hs : IsJordanMeasurable s)
    (hf : Continuous f) (I : RiemannBox n) (hsub : s ⊆ (I : Set (JordanEuc n))) :
    HasRiemannBoxIntegral (s.indicator f) I (∫ x in s, f x)
proof:
:= by
  exact hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral_of_aeContinuous
    hs.nullMeasurableSet I (jordan_indicator_bounded_on_box hf I)
      (jordan_indicator_ae_continuous hs hf) hsub

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.exists_box_hasRiemannIntegral_jordan
statement:
theorem exists_box_hasRiemannIntegral_jordan {n : ℕ} {s : Set (JordanEuc n)}
    {f : JordanEuc n → ℝ} (hs : IsJordanMeasurable s) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ∃ I : RiemannBox n, s ⊆ (I : Set (JordanEuc n)) ∧
      HasRiemannBoxIntegral (s.indicator f) I (∫ x in s, f x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, hsub⟩ := BoxIntegral.le_hasIntegralVertices_of_isBounded hs.1
  exact ⟨I, hsub, hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral hs hf I hsub⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.riemannIntegral_jordan_independent_of_box
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_jordan_independent_of_box {n : ℕ}
    {s : Set (JordanEuc n)} {f : JordanEuc n → ℝ} (hs : IsJordanMeasurable s)
    (hf : Continuous f) (I J : RiemannBox n)
    (hI : s ⊆ (I : Set (JordanEuc n))) (hJ : s ⊆ (J : Set (JordanEuc n))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral (s.indicator f) I = riemannBoxIntegral (s.indicator f) J
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral hs hf I hI).integral_eq,
    (hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral hs hf J hJ).integral_eq]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.ext_iff
statement: theorem ext_iff (z w : ℂ) : z = w ↔ z.re = w.re ∧ z.im = w.im
proof:
:= by
  exact _root_.Complex.ext_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.existsUnique_real_imag
statement:
theorem existsUnique_real_imag (z : ℂ) :
    ∃! p : ℝ × ℝ, z = mk p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(z.re, z.im), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Complex.ext <;> rfl
  · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ h
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact congrArg Complex.re h |>.symm
    · exact congrArg Complex.im h |>.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.mk_re
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_re (x y : ℝ) : (mk x y).re = x
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.mk_im
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_im (x y : ℝ) : (mk x y).im = y
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.mk_add
statement: theorem mk_add (x y u v : ℝ) : mk x y + mk u v = mk (x + u) (y + v)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mk]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.mk_mul
statement:
theorem mk_mul (x y u v : ℝ) :
    mk x y * mk u v = mk (x * u - y * v) (x * v + y * u)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mk]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.I_eq_mk
statement: theorem I_eq_mk : Complex.I = mk 0 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mk]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.I_sq
statement: theorem I_sq : Complex.I ^ 2 = -1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [pow_two]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.conj_mk
statement: theorem conj_mk (x y : ℝ) : star (mk x y) = mk x (-y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mk]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.mul_conj
statement:
theorem mul_conj (x y : ℝ) :
    mk x y * star (mk x y) = mk (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [conj_mk, mk_mul]
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [mk] <;> ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.norm_sq
statement: theorem norm_sq (x y : ℝ) : ‖mk x y‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Complex.sq_norm, _root_.Complex.normSq_apply]
  simp [mk]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.nested_intervals_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℝ := Set.range a
  have hnonempty : s.Nonempty := Set.range_nonempty a
  have hsup_bdd : BddAbove s := by
    refine ⟨b 0, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    calc
      a k ≤ b k := hle k
      _ ≤ b 0 := hanti_B (by norm_num : 0 ≤ k)
  let x : ℝ := sSup s
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have hlub : IsLUB s x := Real.isLUB_sSup hnonempty hsup_bdd
  constructor
  · exact hlub.1 (Set.mem_range_self n)
  · refine hlub.2 ?_
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
    · calc
        a k ≤ a n := hmono_A hkn
        _ ≤ b n := hle n
    · have hn : n ≤ k := le_of_not_ge hkn
      calc
        a k ≤ b k := hle k
        _ ≤ b n := hanti_B hn

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.nested_intervals_singleton
statement:
theorem nested_intervals_singleton {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hmono_A : Monotone a) (hanti_B : Antitone b) (hle : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n)
    (hshr : Tendsto (fun n ↦ b n - a n) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃! x : ℝ, ∀ n, x ∈ Set.Icc (a n) (b n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases nested_intervals_nonempty hmono_A hanti_B hle with ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hbnd : ∀ n, |x - y| ≤ b n - a n := by
    intro n
    have hx₁ : a n ≤ x := (hx n).1
    have hx₂ : x ≤ b n := (hx n).2
    have hy₁ : a n ≤ y := (hy n).1
    have hy₂ : y ≤ b n := (hy n).2
    have hle : x - y ≤ b n - a n := by nlinarith
    have hge : -(b n - a n) ≤ x - y := by nlinarith
    rw [abs_le]
    exact ⟨hge, hle⟩
  have hle_zero : |x - y| ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hpos : 0 < |x - y| := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hshr (|x - y|) hpos with ⟨N, hN⟩
    have hN' : |b N - a N| < |x - y| := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN N (by rfl)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ b N - a N := sub_nonneg.mpr ((hx N).1.trans (hx N).2)
    have hlen : |x - y| ≤ b N - a N := hbnd N
    have habs : |b N - a N| = b N - a N := abs_of_nonneg hnonneg
    linarith
  have habs : |x - y| = 0 := le_antisymm hle_zero (abs_nonneg (x - y))
  rw [abs_eq_zero] at habs
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.finite_cover_principle
statement:
theorem finite_cover_principle {a b : ℝ} {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set ℝ)
    (hUo : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcover : Set.Icc a b ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ t : Finset ι, Set.Icc a b ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, U i
proof:
:=
  (CompactIccSpace.isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc a b)).elim_finite_subcover U hUo hcover

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.accumulation_point_of_infinite_bounded
proof:
:= by
  have hnonempty : s.Nonempty := hs.nonempty
  have hsub : s ⊆ Set.Icc (sInf s) (sSup s) := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · exact (isGLB_csInf hnonempty hbdl).1 hx
    · exact (Real.isLUB_sSup hnonempty hb).1 hx
  have hIcc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (sInf s) (sSup s)) := CompactIccSpace.isCompact_Icc
  rcases hs.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact hIcc hsub with ⟨x, _, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.monotone_convergence_of_sup
statement: theorem monotone_convergence_of_sup (h : SupProperty) : MonotoneConvergenceProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu hb
  rcases h (Set.range u) (Set.range_nonempty u) hb with ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  have ht : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 (⨆ i : ℕ, u i)) := tendsto_atTop_ciSup hu hb
  simpa [hx.ciSup_eq] using ht

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.monotone_le_limit
statement:
lemma monotone_le_limit {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : Monotone u) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 L)) (n : ℕ) : u n ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 < u n - L := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
  rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hL (u n - L) hpos with ⟨N, hN⟩
  let m := max n N
  have htem : |u m - L| < u n - L := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN m (le_max_right n N)
  have hue : u n ≤ u m := hu (le_max_left n N)
  have hum : L < u m := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_not_ge h) hue
  have hposm : 0 ≤ u m - L := le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hum)
  have hbig : u n - L ≤ |u m - L| := by
    calc
      u n - L ≤ u m - L := sub_le_sub_right hue L
      _ = |u m - L| := (abs_of_nonneg hposm).symm
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.antitone_limit_le
statement:
lemma antitone_limit_le {v : ℕ → ℝ} (hv : Antitone v) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 L)) (n : ℕ) : L ≤ v n
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Monotone (fun m : ℕ => -v m) := by
    intro m k hmk
    exact neg_le_neg (hv hmk)
  have hcl : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => -v m) atTop (𝓝 (-L)) := hL.neg
  have hlt : -(v n) ≤ -L := monotone_le_limit hc hcl n
  nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.nested_intervals_of_monotone_convergence
statement:
theorem nested_intervals_of_monotone_convergence
    (h : MonotoneConvergenceProperty) : NestedIntervalsProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hma hnb hle
  have hba : BddAbove (Set.range a) := by
    refine ⟨b 0, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    calc
      a k ≤ b k := hle k
      _ ≤ b 0 := hnb (by norm_num : 0 ≤ k)
  rcases h a hma hba with ⟨x, hxa⟩
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => -b n
  have hmc : Monotone c := by
    intro m k hmk
    dsimp [c]
    exact neg_le_neg (hnb hmk)
  have hbc : BddAbove (Set.range c) := by
    refine ⟨-a 0, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    dsimp [c]
    calc
      -b k ≤ -a k := neg_le_neg (hle k)
      _ ≤ -a 0 := neg_le_neg (hma (by norm_num : 0 ≤ k))
  rcases h c hmc hbc with ⟨y, hyc⟩
  have hxb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 (-y)) := by
    simpa [c] using hyc.neg
  have hxy : x ≤ -y := by
    by_contra hgt
    have hlt : -y < x := lt_of_not_ge hgt
    let e : ℝ := (x + y) / 2
    have he : 0 < e := by
      dsimp [e]
      have hpos : 0 < x + y := by linarith
      exact div_pos hpos (by norm_num)
    rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hxa e he with ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩
    rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hxb e he with ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩
    let N := max N₁ N₂
    have hN1 : N₁ ≤ N := le_max_left N₁ N₂
    have hN2 : N₂ ≤ N := le_max_right N₁ N₂
    have haN : |a N - x| < e := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN₁ N hN1
    have hbN : |b N - (-y)| < e := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN₂ N hN2
    have haL : x - e < a N := by
      have h₁ : -(e) < a N - x := (abs_lt.mp haN).1
      linarith
    have hbR : b N < -y + e := by
      have h₂ : b N - (-y) < e := (abs_lt.mp hbN).2
      linarith
    have hmid : x - e = -y + e := by
      dsimp [e]
      ring
    have hgtN : b N < a N := by
      dsimp [e] at *
      nlinarith
    exact (lt_irrefl (a N)) (lt_of_le_of_lt (hle N) hgtN)
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro n
  constructor
  · exact monotone_le_limit hma hxa n
  · exact le_trans hxy (antitone_limit_le hnb hxb n)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.finite_cover_halves
statement:
lemma finite_cover_halves (U : ι → Set ℝ) {l m r : ℝ} (_hlm : l ≤ m) (_hmr : m ≤ r)
    (hc₁ : ∃ t : Finset ι, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc l m, ∃ i ∈ t, x ∈ U i)
    (hc₂ : ∃ t : Finset ι, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc m r, ∃ i ∈ t, x ∈ U i) :
    ∃ t : Finset ι, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc l r, ∃ i ∈ t, x ∈ U i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hc₁ with ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩
  rcases hc₂ with ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩
  refine ⟨t₁ ∪ t₂, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxm : x ≤ m
  · rcases ht₁ x ⟨hx.1, hxm⟩ with ⟨i, hit, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨i, ⟨Finset.mem_union_left t₂ hit, hxi⟩⟩
  · have hmx : m ≤ x := le_of_not_ge hxm
    rcases ht₂ x ⟨hmx, hx.2⟩ with ⟨i, hit, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨i, ⟨Finset.mem_union_right t₁ hit, hxi⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.right_half_no_finite_cover
statement:
lemma right_half_no_finite_cover (U : ι → Set ℝ) {l m r : ℝ} (hlm : l ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r)
    (hnc : NoFiniteCover U l r) (hnl : ¬ NoFiniteCover U l m) : NoFiniteCover U m r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h
  rcases (Classical.not_not.mp hnl) with ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩
  rcases h with ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩
  exact hnc (finite_cover_halves U hlm hmr ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.halfbiseq_length_step
statement:
lemma halfbiseq_length_step (U : ι → Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (halfbiseq U a b (n + 1)).2 - (halfbiseq U a b (n + 1)).1
      = ((halfbiseq U a b n).2 - (halfbiseq U a b n).1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : NoFiniteCover U (halfbiseq U a b n).1 (((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2)
  · simp only [halfbiseq]
    rw [dif_pos h]
    ring
  · simp only [halfbiseq]
    rw [dif_neg h]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.halfbiseq_length
statement:
lemma halfbiseq_length (U : ι → Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    ∀ n, (halfbiseq U a b n).2 - (halfbiseq U a b n).1 = (b - a) / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [halfbiseq]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [halfbiseq_length_step]
      rw [ih]
      field_simp
      ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.halfbiseq_le
statement:
lemma halfbiseq_le (U : ι → Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∀ n, (halfbiseq U a b n).1 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b n).2
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [halfbiseq] using hab
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases h : NoFiniteCover U (halfbiseq U a b n).1 (((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2)
      · simp only [halfbiseq]
        rw [dif_pos h]
        nlinarith
      · simp only [halfbiseq]
        rw [dif_neg h]
        nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.halfbiseq_left_mono_step
statement:
lemma halfbiseq_left_mono_step (U : ι → Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    (halfbiseq U a b n).1 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b (n + 1)).1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : NoFiniteCover U (halfbiseq U a b n).1 (((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2)
  · simp only [halfbiseq]
    rw [dif_pos h]
  · simp only [halfbiseq]
    rw [dif_neg h]
    have hle : (halfbiseq U a b n).1 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b n).2 := halfbiseq_le U a b hab n
    nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.halfbiseq_right_antitone_step
statement:
lemma halfbiseq_right_antitone_step (U : ι → Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    (halfbiseq U a b (n + 1)).2 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b n).2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : NoFiniteCover U (halfbiseq U a b n).1 (((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2)
  · simp only [halfbiseq]
    rw [dif_pos h]
    have hle : (halfbiseq U a b n).1 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b n).2 := halfbiseq_le U a b hab n
    nlinarith
  · simp only [halfbiseq]
    rw [dif_neg h]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.halfbiseq_nofinite_cover
statement:
lemma halfbiseq_nofinite_cover (U : ι → Set ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hnc : NoFiniteCover U a b) :
    ∀ n, NoFiniteCover U (halfbiseq U a b n).1 (halfbiseq U a b n).2
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [halfbiseq] using hnc
  | succ n ih =>
      have hlr : (halfbiseq U a b n).1 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b n).2 := halfbiseq_le U a b hab n
      have hlm : (halfbiseq U a b n).1 ≤ ((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2 := by
        nlinarith
      have hmr : ((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2 ≤ (halfbiseq U a b n).2 := by
        nlinarith
      by_cases h : NoFiniteCover U (halfbiseq U a b n).1 (((halfbiseq U a b n).1 + (halfbiseq U a b n).2) / 2)
      · simp only [halfbiseq]
        rw [dif_pos h]
        exact h
      · simp only [halfbiseq]
        rw [dif_neg h]
        exact right_half_no_finite_cover U hlm hmr ih h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.finite_cover_of_nested_intervals
statement: theorem finite_cover_of_nested_intervals (h : NestedIntervalsProperty) : FiniteCoverProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro a b ι U hUo hcover
  by_cases hab : a ≤ b
  · by_contra hnoc
    have hnf : NoFiniteCover U a b := hnoc
    let A : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (halfbiseq U a b n).1
    let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (halfbiseq U a b n).2
    have hmonoA : Monotone A := by
      refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ ?_
      intro n
      simpa [A] using halfbiseq_left_mono_step U a b hab n
    have hantiB : Antitone B := by
      refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le ?_
      intro n
      simpa [B] using halfbiseq_right_antitone_step U a b hab n
    have hleAB : ∀ n, A n ≤ B n := by
      intro n
      simpa [A, B] using halfbiseq_le U a b hab n
    rcases h A B hmonoA hantiB hleAB with ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hxab : x ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      have h0 := hx 0
      simpa [A, B, halfbiseq] using h0
    rcases (Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcover hxab)) with ⟨i₀, hxi₀⟩
    rcases (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hUo i₀)) x hxi₀ with ⟨ε, hεpos, hε⟩
    have hlen_tendsto : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => B n - A n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hpow : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ)‖ < 1)
      have hscaled : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa using hpow.const_mul (b - a)
      have heq : (fun n : ℕ => B n - A n) = (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
        funext n
        have hlen : B n - A n = (b - a) / 2 ^ n := by
          simpa [A, B] using halfbiseq_length U a b n
        rw [hlen]
        rw [one_div_pow]
        field_simp
      simpa [heq] using hscaled
    rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlen_tendsto ε hεpos with ⟨N, hN⟩
    have hN' : |B N - A N| < ε := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN N (le_refl N)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ B N - A N := sub_nonneg.mpr (hleAB N)
    have hlenN : B N - A N < ε := by
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] at hN'
    have hsub : Set.Icc (A N) (B N) ⊆ U i₀ := by
      intro y hy
      have hxN : x ∈ Set.Icc (A N) (B N) := hx N
      have hdx : dist y x ≤ B N - A N := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_le]
        constructor <;> nlinarith [hy.1, hy.2, hxN.1, hxN.2]
      exact hε (lt_of_le_of_lt hdx hlenN)
    have hnfN : NoFiniteCover U (A N) (B N) := by
      simpa [A, B] using (halfbiseq_nofinite_cover U hab hnf) N
    have hcover_single : ∃ t : Finset ι, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (A N) (B N), ∃ i ∈ t, y ∈ U i := by
      refine ⟨{i₀}, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨i₀, by simp, hsub hy⟩
    exact hnfN hcover_single
  · refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hab' : a ≤ b := le_trans hx.1 hx.2
    exact absurd hab' hab

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.not_accPt_iff_exists_nhds
statement:
lemma not_accPt_iff_exists_nhds {s : Set ℝ} {x : ℝ} :
    ¬ AccPt x (𝓟 s) ↔ ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, U ∩ s ⊆ {x}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [accPt_iff_nhds] at h
    push Not at h
    rcases h with ⟨U, hU, hsub⟩
    refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (hsub y hy)
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨U, hU, hsub⟩
    rw [accPt_iff_nhds]
    push Not
    refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hsub hy)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.accumulation_point_of_finite_cover
statement: theorem accumulation_point_of_finite_cover (h : FiniteCoverProperty) : AccumulationPointProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs_inf hb_above hb_below
  have hnonempty : s.Nonempty := hs_inf.nonempty
  have hsub : s ⊆ Set.Icc (sInf s) (sSup s) := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · exact (isGLB_csInf hnonempty hb_below).1 hx
    · exact (Real.isLUB_sSup hnonempty hb_above).1 hx
  by_contra hno
  push Not at hno
  have hnbhd : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ∩ s ⊆ {x} := by
    intro x
    rcases (not_accPt_iff_exists_nhds.mp (hno x)) with ⟨U, hU, hsubU⟩
    rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU with ⟨ε, hεpos, hball⟩
    refine ⟨Metric.ball x ε, Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hεpos, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact hsubU ⟨hball hy.1, hy.2⟩
  choose U hUo hUx hUsub using hnbhd
  have hcover' : Set.Icc (sInf s) (sSup s) ⊆ ⋃ x, U x := by
    intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, hUx x⟩
  rcases h (sInf s) (sSup s) ℝ U hUo hcover' with ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hsub_fin : s ⊆ (t : Set ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    have hycc : y ∈ Set.Icc (sInf s) (sSup s) := hsub hy
    rcases ht y hycc with ⟨i, hit, hyi⟩
    have hy_eq_i : y = i := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hUsub i ⟨hyi, hy⟩)
    simpa [hy_eq_i] using hit
  have hfin : s.Finite := (Finset.finite_toSet t).subset hsub_fin
  exact hs_inf.not_finite hfin

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.cauchy_seq_bounded
statement:
lemma cauchy_seq_bounded {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : CauchySeq u) :
    BddAbove (Set.range u) ∧ BddBelow (Set.range u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases cauchySeq_bdd hu with ⟨R, _hR, hbd⟩
  have hbd0 : ∀ n, |u n - u 0| < R := by
    intro n
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hbd n 0
  constructor
  · refine ⟨u 0 + R, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    have hle : u n - u 0 ≤ R := (abs_le.mp (le_of_lt (hbd0 n))).2
    linarith
  · refine ⟨u 0 - R, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    have hle : -R ≤ u n - u 0 := (abs_le.mp (le_of_lt (hbd0 n))).1
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.mapClusterPt_of_accPt_range
statement:
lemma mapClusterPt_of_accPt_range {u : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}
    (h : AccPt x (𝓟 (Set.range u))) : MapClusterPt x atTop u
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapClusterPt_iff_frequently]
  intro s hs
  rw [Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite]
  by_contra hfin
  have hpre : Set.Finite {n : ℕ | u n ∈ s} := by
    classical
    exact not_not.mp hfin
  have hfinite_inter : (s ∩ Set.range u).Finite := by
    have himg : s ∩ Set.range u ⊆ (fun n : ℕ => u n) '' {n : ℕ | u n ∈ s} := by
      intro y hy
      rcases hy.2 with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨n, hy.1, rfl⟩
    exact Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.image (fun n : ℕ => u n) hpre) himg
  have hfinite_sdiff : (s ∩ (Set.range u \ {x})).Finite := by
    exact Set.Finite.subset hfinite_inter (by intro y hy; exact ⟨hy.1, hy.2.1⟩)
  have hacc : ClusterPt x (𝓟 (Set.range u \ {x})) := accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt.mp h
  have hclosed : IsClosed (s ∩ (Set.range u \ {x})) := hfinite_sdiff.isClosed
  have hx_notin : x ∉ s ∩ (Set.range u \ {x}) := by
    intro hx'
    exact hx'.2.2 rfl
  have hcompl_nhds : (s ∩ (Set.range u \ {x}))ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
    IsOpen.mem_nhds hclosed.isOpen_compl hx_notin
  have hs' : s ∩ (s ∩ (Set.range u \ {x}))ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x := Filter.inter_mem hs hcompl_nhds
  have hnonempty := (clusterPt_principal_iff.mp hacc) (s ∩ (s ∩ (Set.range u \ {x}))ᶜ) hs'
  rcases hnonempty with ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact hy.1.2 ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.tendsto_of_cauchySeq_of_accPt_range
statement:
lemma tendsto_of_cauchySeq_of_accPt_range {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : CauchySeq u) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : AccPt x (𝓟 (Set.range u))) : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : MapClusterPt x atTop u := mapClusterPt_of_accPt_range hx
  rcases MapClusterPt.tendsto_subseq hmap with ⟨φ, hφ, hsub⟩
  exact tendsto_nhds_of_cauchySeq_of_subseq hu hφ.tendsto_atTop hsub

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.cauchySeq_tendsto_of_finite_range
statement:
lemma cauchySeq_tendsto_of_finite_range {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : CauchySeq u)
    (hfin : (Set.range u).Finite) : ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)
proof:
:= by
  have hinf_fiber : ∃ c ∈ Set.range u, Set.Infinite {m : ℕ | u m = c} := by
    by_contra hno
    have hall : ∀ c ∈ Set.range u, Set.Finite {m : ℕ | u m = c} := by
      intro c hc
      exact not_not.mp (by intro hinf; exact hno ⟨c, hc, hinf⟩)
    have hfinite_union : (⋃ c ∈ Set.range u, {m : ℕ | u m = c}).Finite :=
      Set.Finite.biUnion hfin hall
    have hcov : (Set.univ : Set ℕ) ⊆ ⋃ c ∈ Set.range u, {m : ℕ | u m = c} := by
      intro n _
      exact Set.mem_biUnion ⟨n, rfl⟩ rfl
    have hfin_nat : (Set.univ : Set ℕ).Finite := hfinite_union.subset hcov
    exact Set.infinite_univ.not_finite hfin_nat
  rcases hinf_fiber with ⟨c, _hc, hinf⟩
  rcases Nat.exists_strictMono_subsequence (P := fun n => u n = c) (by
    intro N
    rcases Set.Infinite.exists_gt hinf (N + 1) with ⟨n, hnc, hn⟩
    exact ⟨n, by omega, hnc⟩) with ⟨φ, hφ, hφc⟩
  have hsub : Tendsto (u ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro n _hn
    simpa [hφc n, Real.dist_eq] using hε
  exact ⟨c, tendsto_nhds_of_cauchySeq_of_subseq hu hφ.tendsto_atTop hsub⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.cauchy_convergence_of_accumulation_point
statement:
theorem cauchy_convergence_of_accumulation_point (h : AccumulationPointProperty) :
    CauchyConvergenceProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  by_cases hfin : (Set.range u).Finite
  · exact cauchySeq_tendsto_of_finite_range hu hfin
  · have hb := cauchy_seq_bounded hu
    have hinf : (Set.range u).Infinite := hfin
    rcases h (Set.range u) hinf hb.1 hb.2 with ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, tendsto_of_cauchySeq_of_accPt_range hu hx⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_le
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_le (s : Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∀ n, (bisect_upper s a b n).1 ≤ (bisect_upper s a b n).2
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [bisect_upper] using hab
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases h : ((bisect_upper s a b n).1 + (bisect_upper s a b n).2) / 2 ∈ upperBounds s
      · simp only [bisect_upper]
        rw [dif_pos h]
        nlinarith
      · simp only [bisect_upper]
        rw [dif_neg h]
        nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_left_mono_step
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_left_mono_step (s : Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    (bisect_upper s a b n).1 ≤ (bisect_upper s a b (n + 1)).1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ((bisect_upper s a b n).1 + (bisect_upper s a b n).2) / 2 ∈ upperBounds s
  · simp only [bisect_upper]
    rw [dif_pos h]
  · simp only [bisect_upper]
    rw [dif_neg h]
    have hle : (bisect_upper s a b n).1 ≤ (bisect_upper s a b n).2 := bisect_upper_le s a b hab n
    nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_right_antitone_step
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_right_antitone_step (s : Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    (bisect_upper s a b (n + 1)).2 ≤ (bisect_upper s a b n).2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ((bisect_upper s a b n).1 + (bisect_upper s a b n).2) / 2 ∈ upperBounds s
  · simp only [bisect_upper]
    rw [dif_pos h]
    have hle : (bisect_upper s a b n).1 ≤ (bisect_upper s a b n).2 := bisect_upper_le s a b hab n
    nlinarith
  · simp only [bisect_upper]
    rw [dif_neg h]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_length_step
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_length_step (s : Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (bisect_upper s a b (n + 1)).2 - (bisect_upper s a b (n + 1)).1
      = ((bisect_upper s a b n).2 - (bisect_upper s a b n).1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ((bisect_upper s a b n).1 + (bisect_upper s a b n).2) / 2 ∈ upperBounds s
  · simp only [bisect_upper]
    rw [dif_pos h]
    ring
  · simp only [bisect_upper]
    rw [dif_neg h]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_length
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_length (s : Set ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    ∀ n, (bisect_upper s a b n).2 - (bisect_upper s a b n).1 = (b - a) / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [bisect_upper]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [bisect_upper_length_step]
      rw [ih]
      field_simp
      ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_right_upper
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_right_upper (s : Set ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (hb : b ∈ upperBounds s) :
    ∀ n, (bisect_upper s a b n).2 ∈ upperBounds s
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [bisect_upper] using hb
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases h : ((bisect_upper s a b n).1 + (bisect_upper s a b n).2) / 2 ∈ upperBounds s
      · simp only [bisect_upper]
        rw [dif_pos h]
        exact h
      · simp only [bisect_upper]
        rw [dif_neg h]
        exact ih

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_left_not_upper
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_left_not_upper (s : Set ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∉ upperBounds s) :
    ∀ n, (bisect_upper s a b n).1 ∉ upperBounds s
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [bisect_upper] using ha
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases h : ((bisect_upper s a b n).1 + (bisect_upper s a b n).2) / 2 ∈ upperBounds s
      · simp only [bisect_upper]
        rw [dif_pos h]
        exact ih
      · simp only [bisect_upper]
        rw [dif_neg h]
        exact h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_left_cauchy
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_left_cauchy (s : Set ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    CauchySeq (fun n => (bisect_upper s a b n).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have htend : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) / 2 ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hpow : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ)‖ < 1)
    have hscaled : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hpow.const_mul (b - a)
    have heq : (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) / 2 ^ n) = (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
      funext n
      rw [one_div_pow]
      field_simp
    simpa [heq] using hscaled
  rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp htend ε hε with ⟨N, hN⟩
  have hlen_lt : (b - a) / 2 ^ N < ε := by
    have hN0 : |b - a| / 2 ^ N < ε := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN N (le_refl N)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.mpr hab
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] using hN0
  let l : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (bisect_upper s a b n).1
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (bisect_upper s a b n).2
  have hmono_l : Monotone l := by
    refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ ?_
    intro n
    simpa [l] using bisect_upper_left_mono_step s a b hab n
  have hanti_r : Antitone r := by
    refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le ?_
    intro n
    simpa [r] using bisect_upper_right_antitone_step s a b hab n
  have hle_lr : ∀ n, l n ≤ r n := by
    intro n
    simpa [l, r] using bisect_upper_le s a b hab n
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro m hm n hn
  have hle_diam : |l m - l n| ≤ r N - l N := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [hmono_l hm, le_trans (hle_lr m) (hanti_r hm),
      hmono_l hn, le_trans (hle_lr n) (hanti_r hn), hmono_l (le_refl N)]
  have hdiam : r N - l N = (b - a) / 2 ^ N := by
    simpa [l, r] using bisect_upper_length s a b N
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.bisect_upper_right_cauchy
statement:
lemma bisect_upper_right_cauchy (s : Set ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    CauchySeq (fun n => (bisect_upper s a b n).2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have htend : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) / 2 ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hpow : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ)‖ < 1)
    have hscaled : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hpow.const_mul (b - a)
    have heq : (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) / 2 ^ n) = (fun n : ℕ => (b - a) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
      funext n
      rw [one_div_pow]
      field_simp
    simpa [heq] using hscaled
  rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp htend ε hε with ⟨N, hN⟩
  have hlen_lt : (b - a) / 2 ^ N < ε := by
    have hN0 : |b - a| / 2 ^ N < ε := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN N (le_refl N)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.mpr hab
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] using hN0
  let l : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (bisect_upper s a b n).1
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (bisect_upper s a b n).2
  have hmono_l : Monotone l := by
    refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ ?_
    intro n
    simpa [l] using bisect_upper_left_mono_step s a b hab n
  have hanti_r : Antitone r := by
    refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le ?_
    intro n
    simpa [r] using bisect_upper_right_antitone_step s a b hab n
  have hle_lr : ∀ n, l n ≤ r n := by
    intro n
    simpa [l, r] using bisect_upper_le s a b hab n
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro m hm n hn
  have hle_diam : |r m - r n| ≤ r N - l N := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [hanti_r hm, hanti_r hn,
      le_trans (hmono_l hm) (hle_lr m), le_trans (hmono_l hn) (hle_lr n)]
  have hdiam : r N - l N = (b - a) / 2 ^ N := by
    simpa [l, r] using bisect_upper_length s a b N
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.tendsto_div_two_pow
statement: lemma tendsto_div_two_pow {c : ℝ} : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => c / 2 ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num : ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ)‖ < 1)
  have hscaled : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => c * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using hpow.const_mul c
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ => c / 2 ^ n) = (fun n : ℕ => c * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
    funext n
    rw [one_div_pow]
    field_simp
  simpa [heq] using hscaled

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Completeness.sup_of_cauchy_convergence
statement: theorem sup_of_cauchy_convergence (h : CauchyConvergenceProperty) : SupProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs_nonempty hbdd
  rcases hs_nonempty with ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
  rcases hbdd with ⟨M, hM⟩
  by_cases hx₀_upper : x₀ ∈ upperBounds s
  · refine ⟨x₀, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨hx₀_upper, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact (mem_upperBounds.mp hy) x₀ hx₀
  · have hxM : x₀ ≤ M := (mem_upperBounds.mp hM) x₀ hx₀
    let l : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (bisect_upper s x₀ M n).1
    let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (bisect_upper s x₀ M n).2
    have hmono_l : Monotone l := by
      refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ ?_
      intro n
      simpa [l] using bisect_upper_left_mono_step s x₀ M hxM n
    have hl_cauchy : CauchySeq l := by
      simpa [l] using bisect_upper_left_cauchy s hxM
    have hr_cauchy : CauchySeq r := by
      simpa [r] using bisect_upper_right_cauchy s hxM
    rcases h l hl_cauchy with ⟨x, hx_tend⟩
    rcases h r hr_cauchy with ⟨y, hy_tend⟩
    have hlen_tend : Tendsto (fun n => r n - l n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have heq : (fun n => r n - l n) = (fun n => (M - x₀) / 2 ^ n) := by
        funext n
        simpa [l, r] using bisect_upper_length s x₀ M n
      simpa [heq] using tendsto_div_two_pow (c := M - x₀)
    have hsub_tend : Tendsto (fun n => r n - l n) atTop (𝓝 (y - x)) :=
      Tendsto.sub hy_tend hx_tend
    have hyx : y = x := by
      have hxy : y - x = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hsub_tend hlen_tend
      linarith
    have hx_upper : ∀ z ∈ s, z ≤ x := by
      intro z hz
      have hr_upper : ∀ n, r n ∈ upperBounds s := by
        intro n
        simpa [r] using bisect_upper_right_upper s hM n
      have hz_le_r : ∀ n, z ≤ r n := by
        intro n
        exact (mem_upperBounds.mp (hr_upper n)) z hz
      have hz_le_y : z ≤ y := ge_of_tendsto hy_tend (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hz_le_r)
      simpa [hyx] using hz_le_y
    have hx_least : ∀ z ∈ upperBounds s, x ≤ z := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra hnot
      have hzx : z < x := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hpos : 0 < x - z := sub_pos.mpr hzx
      rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hx_tend (x - z) hpos with ⟨N, hN⟩
      have hlN_le_x : l N ≤ x := monotone_le_limit hmono_l hx_tend N
      have hlN_gt_z : z < l N := by
        have hdist : |l N - x| < x - z := by
          simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN N (le_refl N)
        have habs : |l N - x| = x - l N := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hlN_le_x)]
          ring
        nlinarith
      have hlN_not_upper : l N ∉ upperBounds s := by
        simpa [l] using bisect_upper_left_not_upper s hx₀_upper N
      have hw_exists : ∃ w ∈ s, l N < w := by
        rw [mem_upperBounds] at hlN_not_upper
        push Not at hlN_not_upper
        simpa using hlN_not_upper
      rcases hw_exists with ⟨w, hws, hlw⟩
      have hz_not_upper : ¬ z ∈ upperBounds s := by
        rw [mem_upperBounds]
        push Not
        refine ⟨w, hws, ?_⟩
        exact lt_trans hlN_gt_z hlw
      exact hz_not_upper hz
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      exact hx_upper z hz
    · intro z hz
      exact hx_least z hz
