name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.coordinateForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateForm_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin 1 → Fin n → ℝ) :
    coordinateForm i x v = v 0 i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateForm, ContinuousAlternatingMap.ofSubsingletonLIE_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.ofSubsingleton_apply_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.alternatingWedge_one_apply
statement:
theorem alternatingWedge_one_apply {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (a b : E [⋀^Fin 1]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → E) :
    alternatingWedge a b v =
      a (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 0) * b (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 1) -
        a (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 1) * b (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingWedge, LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, AlternatingMap.domDomCongr_apply]
  have hcond : (a.domCoprod b) = MultilinearMap.alternatization (MultilinearMap.domCoprod a b) := by
    have h := MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization_eq (a := a) (b := b)
    simpa using h.symm
  rw [hcond, MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply]
  let sw : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) := Equiv.swap (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inr 0)
  let e : Fin 2 → Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) := fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else sw
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1)) = 2 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_sum]
    simp
  have hne : (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1)) ≠ sw := by
    intro h
    have h2 := congrArg (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) => σ (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 1))) h
    simp [sw] at h2
  have hinj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro t1 t2 h
    fin_cases t1 <;> fin_cases t2 <;> simp_all [e]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective e := by
    rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
    exact ⟨hinj, by rw [hcard]; simp⟩
  let F : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) → ℝ ⊗[ℝ] ℝ :=
    fun σ => Equiv.Perm.sign σ •
      (MultilinearMap.domDomCongr σ (MultilinearMap.domCoprod a b)) (v ∘ finSumFinEquiv)
  have hsum : (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1), F σ) = F (e 0) + F (e 1) := by
    rw [← Fintype.sum_bijective e hbij (fun t => F (e t)) F (fun t => rfl), Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hF1 : F 1 = (a (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 0)) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (b (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 1)) := by
    have hf1 : ∀ i : Fin 1,
        v (finSumFinEquiv ((1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1)) (Sum.inl i))) = v 0 := by
      intro i; fin_cases i; rfl
    have hf2 : ∀ i : Fin 1,
        v (finSumFinEquiv ((1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1)) (Sum.inr i))) = v 1 := by
      intro i; fin_cases i; rfl
    simp only [F, Equiv.Perm.sign_one, one_smul, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply,
      MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply, Function.comp_apply, hf1, hf2]
    rfl
  have hFsw : F (Equiv.swap (Sum.inl (0:Fin 1)) (Sum.inr (0:Fin 1))) =
      -((a (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 1)) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (b (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 0))) := by
    have hg1 : ∀ i : Fin 1,
        v (finSumFinEquiv
          ((Equiv.swap (Sum.inl (0:Fin 1)) (Sum.inr (0:Fin 1))) (Sum.inl i))) = v 1 := by
      intro i; fin_cases i; simp; rfl
    have hg2 : ∀ i : Fin 1,
        v (finSumFinEquiv
          ((Equiv.swap (Sum.inl (0:Fin 1)) (Sum.inr (0:Fin 1))) (Sum.inr i))) = v 0 := by
      intro i; fin_cases i; simp; rfl
    simp only [F, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply]
    rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by simp : Sum.inl (0:Fin 1) ≠ Sum.inr (0:Fin 1))]
    rw [Units.smul_def, show ((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) = -1 by simp, neg_one_zsmul]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hg1, hg2]
    rfl
  change (TensorProduct.lid ℝ ℝ) (∑ σ, F σ) =
      a (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 0) * b (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 1) -
        a (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 1) * b (fun _ : Fin 1 => v 0)
  rw [hsum, map_add, show F (e 0) = F 1 by simp [e],
    show F (e 1) = F (Equiv.swap (Sum.inl (0:Fin 1)) (Sum.inr (0:Fin 1))) by simp [e, sw],
    hF1, hFsw, map_neg, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.coordinateTwoForm_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateTwoForm_apply {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → Fin n → ℝ) :
    coordinateTwoForm i j x v = v 0 i * v 1 j - v 1 i * v 0 j
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateTwoForm, formWedge_apply, alternatingWedge_one_apply]
  simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, coordinateForm_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.oneForm_coordinate_expansion
statement:
theorem oneForm_coordinate_expansion {n : ℕ} (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin n → ℝ) 1)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ω x = ∑ i, (ω x ![Pi.single i 1]) • coordinateForm i x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMap_injective
  apply Module.Basis.ext_alternating (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))
  intro v hv
  have hvec : (fun i : Fin 1 => (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)) (v i)) =
      ![Pi.single (v 0) (1:ℝ)] := by
    funext i; fin_cases i; simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rw [hvec]
  simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
    ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateForm_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (v 0)]
  · simp [Pi.single_eq_same]
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hb, smul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.twoForm_coordinate_expansion_plane
statement:
theorem twoForm_coordinate_expansion_plane (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin 2 → ℝ) 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    ω x = (ω x ![Pi.single 0 1, Pi.single 1 1]) • coordinateTwoForm 0 1 x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMap_injective
  apply Module.Basis.ext_alternating (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 2))
  intro v hv
  have hvec : (fun i : Fin 2 => (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 2)) (v i)) =
      ![Pi.single (v 0) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (v 1) (1:ℝ)] := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rw [hvec]
  have hclass : v = ![0, 1] ∨ v = ![1, 0] := by
    have h0 : v 0 = 0 ∨ v 0 = 1 := by
      generalize hv0 : v 0 = x
      fin_cases x <;> simp
    have h1 : v 1 ≠ v 0 := fun h => (by decide : (1:Fin 2) ≠ 0) (hv h)
    rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    · left
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · have : v 1 = 1 := by
          generalize hv1 : v 1 = y
          fin_cases y <;> simp_all
        simp [this]
    · right
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · have : v 1 = 0 := by
          generalize hv1 : v 1 = y
          fin_cases y <;> simp_all
        simp [this]
  rcases hclass with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply]
    rw [coordinateTwoForm_apply]
    simp
  · rw [h]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    rw [show (![Pi.single (1:Fin 2) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (0:Fin 2) (1:ℝ)] : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) =
        ![Pi.single (0:Fin 2) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (1:Fin 2) (1:ℝ)] ∘ Equiv.swap (0:Fin 2) 1 by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp]
    rw [AlternatingMap.map_swap]
    · simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply]
      rw [coordinateTwoForm_apply]
      simp
    · decide

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.fin_two_three_classification
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : v 0 = 0 ∨ v 0 = 1 ∨ v 0 = 2 := by
    generalize h : v 0 = x; fin_cases x <;> simp
  have h1 : v 1 = 0 ∨ v 1 = 1 ∨ v 1 = 2 := by
    generalize h : v 1 = x; fin_cases x <;> simp
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;> rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · exact absurd (hv (h0.trans h1.symm)) (by decide)
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩))
  · exact absurd (hv (h0.trans h1.symm)) (by decide)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h0, h1⟩))))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h0, h1⟩))))
  · exact absurd (hv (h0.trans h1.symm)) (by decide)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.twoForm_coordinate_expansion_space
statement:
theorem twoForm_coordinate_expansion_space (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin 3 → ℝ) 2)
    (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ω x = ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 3 × Fin 3 => p.1 < p.2)),
      (ω x ![Pi.single p.1 1, Pi.single p.2 1]) • coordinateTwoForm p.1 p.2 x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMap_injective
  apply Module.Basis.ext_alternating (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3))
  intro v hv
  have hvec : (fun i : Fin 2 => (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)) (v i)) =
      ![Pi.single (v 0) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (v 1) (1:ℝ)] := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rw [hvec]
  have hfilter : (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 3 × Fin 3 => p.1 < p.2)) =
      ({((0:Fin 3),(1:Fin 3)), ((0:Fin 3),(2:Fin 3)), ((1:Fin 3),(2:Fin 3))} :
        Finset (Fin 3 × Fin 3)) := by
    ext p
    rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> decide
  rw [hfilter]
  have hclass := fin_two_three_classification v hv
  rcases hclass with ⟨h0,h1⟩ | ⟨h0,h1⟩ | ⟨h0,h1⟩ | ⟨h0,h1⟩ | ⟨h0,h1⟩ | ⟨h0,h1⟩
  · rw [h0, h1]
    simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateTwoForm_apply]
    simp
  · rw [h0, h1]
    simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateTwoForm_apply]
    simp
  · rw [h0, h1]
    conv_lhs => rw [show
      (![Pi.single (1:Fin 3) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)] : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) =
        ![Pi.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (1:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)] ∘ Equiv.swap (0:Fin 2) 1 by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp]
    rw [AlternatingMap.map_swap]
    · simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateTwoForm_apply]
      simp
    · decide
  · rw [h0, h1]
    simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateTwoForm_apply]
    simp
  · rw [h0, h1]
    conv_lhs => rw [show
      (![Pi.single (2:Fin 3) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)] : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) =
        ![Pi.single (0:Fin 3) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (2:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)] ∘ Equiv.swap (0:Fin 2) 1 by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp]
    rw [AlternatingMap.map_swap]
    · simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateTwoForm_apply]
      simp
    · decide
  · rw [h0, h1]
    conv_lhs => rw [show
      (![Pi.single (2:Fin 3) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (1:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)] : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) =
        ![Pi.single (1:Fin 3) (1:ℝ), Pi.single (2:Fin 3) (1:ℝ)] ∘ Equiv.swap (0:Fin 2) 1 by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp]
    rw [AlternatingMap.map_swap]
    · simp only [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap, ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, coordinateTwoForm_apply]
      simp
    · decide

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.basis_det_norm_bound
statement:
private theorem basis_det_norm_bound (v : Fin 3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) :
    ‖(Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)).det v‖ ≤ 6 * ∏ i, ‖v i‖
proof:
:= by
  have hmat : (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)).toMatrix v = Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin 3 => v j i) := by
    ext i j
    rw [Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basisFun_repr]
    rfl
  rw [Module.Basis.det_apply, hmat, Matrix.det_apply]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ‖Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ i, v i (σ i)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro σ _
        rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) with h | h
        · rw [h, Units.smul_def]
          simp only [Units.val_one, one_smul, norm_prod]
          exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (fun i _ => norm_le_pi_norm (v i) (σ i))
        · rw [h, Units.smul_def]
          rw [show ((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) = -1 by simp, neg_one_zsmul, norm_neg, norm_prod]
          exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (fun i _ => norm_le_pi_norm (v i) (σ i))
    _ = 6 * ∏ i, ‖v i‖ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
        norm_num

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.FormCoordinateExpression.threeForm_coordinate_expansion_space
statement:
theorem threeForm_coordinate_expansion_space (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin 3 → ℝ) 3)
    (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ω x = (ω x ![Pi.single 0 1, Pi.single 1 1, Pi.single 2 1]) • coordinateThreeForm x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMap_injective
  rw [ContinuousAlternatingMap.toAlternatingMap_smul]
  have h := AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)) (ω x).toAlternatingMap
  rw [h]
  have hscalar : (ω x).toAlternatingMap (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin 3)) =
      ω x ![Pi.single 0 1, Pi.single 1 1, Pi.single 2 1] := by
    rw [ContinuousAlternatingMap.coe_toAlternatingMap]
    congr 1
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rw [hscalar]
  congr 1

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.curveFormIntegrand_comp
statement:
theorem curveFormIntegrand_comp {n : ℕ} (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin n → ℝ) 1)
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ (φ t)) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ t) :
    curveFormIntegrand ω (γ ∘ φ) t =
      curveFormIntegrand ω γ (φ t) * deriv φ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveFormIntegrand, curveVelocity_comp γ φ t hγ hφ]
  have h := AlternatingMap.map_smul_univ
    (ω (γ (φ t))).toAlternatingMap (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ deriv φ t)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ curveVelocity γ (φ t))
  simpa [curveFormIntegrand, Function.comp_apply, mul_comm] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.secondKindCurveIntegral_comp_of_deriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem secondKindCurveIntegral_comp_of_deriv_nonneg {n : ℕ}
    (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin n → ℝ) 1) (γ : ParametrizedCurve n)
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ)
    (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ) (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ)
    (hφnonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv φ t) :
    secondKindCurveIntegral ω (γ ∘ φ) c d =
      secondKindCurveIntegral ω γ (φ c) (φ d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondKindCurveIntegral, secondKindCurveIntegral]
  simp_rw [curveFormIntegrand_comp ω γ φ _ (hγ _) (hφ _)]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv_of_deriv_nonneg
    (f := φ) (f' := deriv φ) (g := curveFormIntegrand ω γ) (a := c) (b := d)
    hφ.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun t _ ↦ (hφ t).hasDerivAt)
    (fun t _ ↦ hφnonneg t)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.exactOneForm_curveFormIntegrand
statement:
theorem exactOneForm_curveFormIntegrand {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (t : ℝ)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (γ t)) (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ t) :
    curveFormIntegrand (exteriorDerivative (functionAsZeroForm f)) γ t =
      deriv (f ∘ γ) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveFormIntegrand, exteriorDerivative_zeroForm]
  have hcomp := hf.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ.hasDerivAt
  rw [hcomp.deriv]
  simp [curveVelocity]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.secondKindCurveIntegral_exact
statement:
theorem secondKindCurveIntegral_exact {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (a b : ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable (deriv (f ∘ γ)) volume a b) :
    secondKindCurveIntegral (exteriorDerivative (functionAsZeroForm f)) γ a b =
      f (γ b) - f (γ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondKindCurveIntegral]
  simp_rw [exactOneForm_curveFormIntegrand f γ _ (hf _) (hγ _)]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
    (fun t _ ↦ (hf (γ t)).comp t (hγ t)) hint

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.secondKindCurveIntegral_add
statement:
theorem secondKindCurveIntegral_add {n : ℕ}
    (ω η : DifferentialForm (Fin n → ℝ) 1) (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (a b : ℝ)
    (hω : IntervalIntegrable (curveFormIntegrand ω γ) volume a b)
    (hη : IntervalIntegrable (curveFormIntegrand η γ) volume a b) :
    secondKindCurveIntegral (ω + η) γ a b =
      secondKindCurveIntegral ω γ a b + secondKindCurveIntegral η γ a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondKindCurveIntegral, secondKindCurveIntegral, secondKindCurveIntegral]
  simp only [curveFormIntegrand, Pi.add_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.add_apply]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_add hω hη

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.secondKindSurfaceIntegral_add
statement:
theorem secondKindSurfaceIntegral_add {n : ℕ}
    (ω η : DifferentialForm (Fin n → ℝ) 2) (σ : ParametrizedSurface n)
    (a b c d : ℝ)
    (hω : IntegrableOn (surfaceFormIntegrand ω σ) (closedRectangle a b c d)
      (volume.prod volume))
    (hη : IntegrableOn (surfaceFormIntegrand η σ) (closedRectangle a b c d)
      (volume.prod volume)) :
    secondKindSurfaceIntegral (ω + η) σ a b c d =
      secondKindSurfaceIntegral ω σ a b c d +
        secondKindSurfaceIntegral η σ a b c d
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondKindSurfaceIntegral, secondKindSurfaceIntegral, secondKindSurfaceIntegral]
  simp only [surfaceFormIntegrand, Pi.add_apply, ContinuousAlternatingMap.add_apply,
    rectangleIntegral]
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_add hω hη

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.curveFormIntegrand_covectorField
statement:
theorem curveFormIntegrand_covectorField {n : ℕ}
    (A : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (t : ℝ) :
    curveFormIntegrand (covectorFieldAsOneForm A) γ t =
      A (γ t) (curveVelocity γ t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [curveFormIntegrand, covectorFieldAsOneForm]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.secondKindCurveIntegral_reverse
statement:
theorem secondKindCurveIntegral_reverse {n : ℕ}
    (ω : DifferentialForm (Fin n → ℝ) 1) (γ : ParametrizedCurve n)
    (a b : ℝ) (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ) :
    secondKindCurveIntegral ω (reverseCurve γ a b) a b =
      -secondKindCurveIntegral ω γ a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [reverseCurve, secondKindCurveIntegral, secondKindCurveIntegral]
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ a + b - t
  change (∫ t in a..b, curveFormIntegrand ω (γ ∘ φ) t) = _
  have hφ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt φ (-1) t := fun t ↦
    (hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub (a + b)
  simp_rw [curveFormIntegrand_comp ω γ φ _ (hγ _) (hφ _).differentiableAt]
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ φ := fun t ↦ (hφ t).differentiableAt
  have hderiv : deriv φ = fun _ ↦ (-1 : ℝ) := by
    funext t
    exact (hφ t).deriv
  rw [hderiv]
  have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv_of_deriv_nonpos
    (f := φ) (f' := fun _ ↦ (-1 : ℝ))
    (g := curveFormIntegrand ω γ) (a := a) (b := b)
    hdiff.continuous.continuousOn
    (fun t _ ↦ hφ t)
    (fun _ _ ↦ by norm_num)
  calc
    _ = ∫ u in φ a..φ b, curveFormIntegrand ω γ u := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hsub
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [φ]
      rw [show a + b - a = b by ring, show a + b - b = a by ring,
        intervalIntegral.integral_symm]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.SecondKindIntegrals.secondKindCurveIntegral_exact_closed
statement:
theorem secondKindCurveIntegral_exact_closed {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (γ : ParametrizedCurve n) (a b : ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hγ : Differentiable ℝ γ)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable (deriv (f ∘ γ)) volume a b)
    (hclosed : γ b = γ a) :
    secondKindCurveIntegral (exteriorDerivative (functionAsZeroForm f)) γ a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondKindCurveIntegral_exact f γ a b hf hγ hint, hclosed, sub_self]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_plane_eq_polar
statement:
theorem integral_plane_eq_polar (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ z, f z) =
      ∫ p in Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π, p.1 * f (polarMap p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [polarMap, smul_eq_mul, polarCoord_target] using
    (integral_comp_polarCoord_symm f).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_plane_eq_iterated_polar
statement:
theorem integral_plane_eq_iterated_polar (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : IntegrableOn (fun p ↦ p.1 * f (polarMap p))
      (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) (volume.prod volume)) :
    (∫ z, f z) =
      ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π,
        r * f (r * cos θ, r * sin θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_plane_eq_polar]
  change (∫ p in Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π,
      p.1 * f (polarMap p) ∂(volume.prod volume)) = _
  simpa [polarMap] using MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod
    (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p.1 * f (polarMap p)) hf

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_space_eq_iterated_cylindrical
statement:
theorem integral_space_eq_iterated_cylindrical (f : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Integrable f ((volume.prod volume).prod volume))
    (hcyl : IntegrableOn (fun p ↦ p.1.1 * f (cylindricalMap p))
      ((Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
      ((volume.prod volume).prod volume)) :
    (∫ q, f q ∂((volume.prod volume).prod volume)) =
      ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, ∫ z : ℝ,
        r * f ((r * cos θ, r * sin θ), z)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull :
      (∫ q, f q ∂((volume.prod volume).prod volume)) =
        ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, f (p, z) :=
    integral_prod f hf
  rw [hfull, integral_plane_eq_polar]
  have htarget : MeasurableSet (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) :=
    measurableSet_Ioi.prod measurableSet_Ioo
  have hcylIndicator : Integrable
      (((Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)).indicator
        (fun p ↦ p.1.1 * f (cylindricalMap p)))
      ((volume.prod volume).prod volume) :=
    hcyl.integrable_indicator (htarget.prod MeasurableSet.univ)
  have houter : IntegrableOn
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∫ z : ℝ, p.1 * f (cylindricalMap (p, z)))
      (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π) (volume.prod volume) := by
    rw [← integrable_indicator_iff htarget]
    refine hcylIndicator.integral_prod_left.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p ↦ ?_)
    by_cases hp : p ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π <;> simp [hp]
  calc
    (∫ p in Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π,
        p.1 * ∫ z : ℝ, f (polarMap p, z)) =
      ∫ p in Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π,
        ∫ z : ℝ, p.1 * f (cylindricalMap (p, z)) := by
          apply setIntegral_congr_fun htarget
          intro p _
          dsimp
          rw [integral_const_mul]
          rfl
    _ = ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, ∫ z : ℝ,
        r * f ((r * cos θ, r * sin θ), z) := by
      change (∫ p in Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioo (-π) π,
        (∫ z : ℝ, p.1 * f (cylindricalMap (p, z))) ∂(volume.prod volume)) = _
      simpa [cylindricalMap, polarMap] using
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∫ z : ℝ, p.1 * f (cylindricalMap (p, z))) houter

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.hasFDerivAt_sphericalMap
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_sphericalMap (p : Euclidean3) :
    HasFDerivAt sphericalMap (sphericalDerivative p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : HasFDerivAt (fun q : Euclidean3 ↦ q 0)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) 0) p := by fun_prop
  have hθ : HasFDerivAt (fun q : Euclidean3 ↦ q 1)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) 1) p := by fun_prop
  have hφ : HasFDerivAt (fun q : Euclidean3 ↦ q 2)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) 2) p := by fun_prop
  have hsθ := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (p 1)).hasFDerivAt.comp p hθ
  have hcθ := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (p 1)).hasFDerivAt.comp p hθ
  have hsφ := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (p 2)).hasFDerivAt.comp p hφ
  have hcφ := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (p 2)).hasFDerivAt.comp p hφ
  let e0 : Euclidean3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0
  let e1 : Euclidean3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1
  let e2 : Euclidean3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.proj 2
  let d0 := (p 0 * sin (p 2)) •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (-sin (p 1)) ∘SL e1) +
    cos (p 1) • (p 0 •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (cos (p 2)) ∘SL e2) +
      sin (p 2) • e0)
  let d1 := (p 0 * sin (p 2)) •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (cos (p 1)) ∘SL e1) +
    sin (p 1) • (p 0 •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (cos (p 2)) ∘SL e2) +
      sin (p 2) • e0)
  let d2 := p 0 •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (-sin (p 2)) ∘SL e2) +
    cos (p 2) • e0
  have h0 := (hρ.mul hsφ).mul hcθ
  have h1 := (hρ.mul hsφ).mul hsθ
  have h2 := hρ.mul hcφ
  let D : Fin 3 → (Euclidean3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := ![d0, d1, d2]
  have hD : HasFDerivAt sphericalMap (ContinuousLinearMap.pi D) p := by
    rw [hasFDerivAt_pi]
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change HasFDerivAt
        (((fun q : Euclidean3 ↦ q 0) * (fun q ↦ sin (q 2))) *
          (fun q ↦ cos (q 1))) _ p
      simpa [D, d0, e0, e1, e2, Function.comp_def] using h0
    · change HasFDerivAt
        (((fun q : Euclidean3 ↦ q 0) * (fun q ↦ sin (q 2))) *
          (fun q ↦ sin (q 1))) _ p
      simpa [D, d1, e0, e1, e2, Function.comp_def] using h1
    · change HasFDerivAt
        ((fun q : Euclidean3 ↦ q 0) * (fun q ↦ cos (q 2))) _ p
      simpa [D, d2, e0, e1, e2, Function.comp_def] using h2
  have heq : sphericalDerivative p = ContinuousLinearMap.pi D := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [sphericalDerivative, sphericalDerivativeMatrix, Matrix.toLin'_apply,
        Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, D, d0, d1, d2, e0, e1, e2] <;> ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hD

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.det_sphericalDerivativeMatrix
statement:
theorem det_sphericalDerivativeMatrix (p : Euclidean3) :
    (sphericalDerivativeMatrix p).det = -((p 0) ^ 2 * sin (p 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
  simp [sphericalDerivativeMatrix]
  have hθ := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (p 1)
  have hφ := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (p 2)
  calc
    _ = -((p 0) ^ 2 * sin (p 2) *
        ((sin (p 1)) ^ 2 + (cos (p 1)) ^ 2) *
        ((sin (p 2)) ^ 2 + (cos (p 2)) ^ 2)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hθ, hφ]; ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.det_fderiv_sphericalMap
statement:
theorem det_fderiv_sphericalMap (p : Euclidean3) :
    (fderiv ℝ sphericalMap p).det = -((p 0) ^ 2 * sin (p 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_sphericalMap p).fderiv]
  simpa [sphericalDerivative, ContinuousLinearMap.det,

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.injOn_sphericalMap
statement: theorem injOn_sphericalMap : InjOn sphericalMap sphericalSource
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  have h0 := congrFun hpq (0 : Fin 3)
  have h1 := congrFun hpq (1 : Fin 3)
  have h2 := congrFun hpq (2 : Fin 3)
  simp only [sphericalMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [sphericalMap_apply_one] at h1
  simp only [sphericalMap_apply_two] at h2
  have pnorm :
      (sphericalMap p 0) ^ 2 + (sphericalMap p 1) ^ 2 +
        (sphericalMap p 2) ^ 2 = (p 0) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sphericalMap_apply_zero, sphericalMap_apply_one,
      sphericalMap_apply_two]
    calc
      _ = (p 0) ^ 2 * ((sin (p 2)) ^ 2 *
          ((cos (p 1)) ^ 2 + (sin (p 1)) ^ 2) + (cos (p 2)) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [add_comm ((cos (p 1)) ^ 2), sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one,
          sin_sq_add_cos_sq]
        ring
  have qnorm :
      (sphericalMap q 0) ^ 2 + (sphericalMap q 1) ^ 2 +
        (sphericalMap q 2) ^ 2 = (q 0) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sphericalMap_apply_zero, sphericalMap_apply_one,
      sphericalMap_apply_two]
    calc
      _ = (q 0) ^ 2 * ((sin (q 2)) ^ 2 *
          ((cos (q 1)) ^ 2 + (sin (q 1)) ^ 2) + (cos (q 2)) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [add_comm ((cos (q 1)) ^ 2), sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one,
          sin_sq_add_cos_sq]
        ring
  have hrho_sq : (p 0) ^ 2 = (q 0) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pnorm, ← qnorm, hpq]
  have hrho : p 0 = q 0 := by
    rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp hrho_sq with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hpos : 0 < p 0 + q 0 := add_pos hp.1 hq.1
      rw [h] at hpos
      linarith
  have hcos_phi : cos (p 2) = cos (q 2) := by
    rw [hrho] at h2
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hq.1) h2
  have hphi : p 2 = q 2 := by
    apply Real.strictAntiOn_cos.injOn
    · exact ⟨le_of_lt hp.2.2.1, le_of_lt hp.2.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨le_of_lt hq.2.2.1, le_of_lt hq.2.2.2⟩
    · exact hcos_phi
  rw [hrho, hphi] at h0 h1
  have hcoeff : q 0 * sin (q 2) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero
    (ne_of_gt hq.1) (ne_of_gt (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hq.2.2.1 hq.2.2.2))
  have hcos_theta : cos (p 1) = cos (q 1) := mul_left_cancel₀ hcoeff h0
  have hsin_theta : sin (p 1) = sin (q 1) := mul_left_cancel₀ hcoeff h1
  have hangle : (p 1 : Real.Angle) = (q 1 : Real.Angle) :=
    Real.Angle.cos_sin_inj hcos_theta hsin_theta
  have htheta := congrArg Real.Angle.toReal hangle
  rw [Real.Angle.toReal_coe_eq_self_iff.2
      ⟨hp.2.1.1, le_of_lt hp.2.1.2⟩,
    Real.Angle.toReal_coe_eq_self_iff.2
      ⟨hq.2.1.1, le_of_lt hq.2.1.2⟩] at htheta
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hrho
  · exact htheta
  · exact hphi

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.absJacobianWithin_sphericalMap
statement:
theorem absJacobianWithin_sphericalMap (p : Euclidean3) (hp : p ∈ sphericalSource) :
    absJacobianWithin sphericalMap sphericalSource p = (p 0) ^ 2 * sin (p 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold absJacobianWithin
  rw [fderivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_sphericalSource hp,
    det_fderiv_sphericalMap, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg]
  exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt
    (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_spherical_image
statement:
theorem integral_spherical_image (f : Euclidean3 → ℝ) :
    (∫ x in sphericalMap '' sphericalSource, f x) =
      ∫ p in sphericalSource, (p 0) ^ 2 * sin (p 2) * f (sphericalMap p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_image_eq_integral_absJacobian_mul
    measurableSet_sphericalSource differentiableOn_sphericalMap injOn_sphericalMap]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_sphericalSource
  intro p hp
  dsimp only
  rw [absJacobianWithin_sphericalMap p hp]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.mem_spherical_image_of_coord_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_spherical_image_of_coord_one_ne_zero (x : Euclidean3) (hx : x 1 ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ sphericalMap '' sphericalSource
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ × ℝ := polarCoord (x 0, x 1)
  have hha : (x 0, x 1) ∈ polarCoord.source := Or.inr hx
  have ha : a ∈ polarCoord.target := polarCoord.map_source hha
  have hainv : polarCoord.symm a = (x 0, x 1) := polarCoord.left_inv hha
  let b : ℝ × ℝ := polarCoord (x 2, a.1)
  have hva : 0 < a.1 := ha.1
  have hvb : (x 2, a.1) ∈ polarCoord.source := Or.inr (ne_of_gt hva)
  have hb : b ∈ polarCoord.target := polarCoord.map_source hvb
  have hbinv : polarCoord.symm b = (x 2, a.1) := polarCoord.left_inv hvb
  have hsin : 0 < sin b.2 := by
    have hprod : 0 < b.1 * sin b.2 := by
      rw [show b.1 * sin b.2 = a.1 by exact congrArg Prod.snd hbinv]
      exact hva
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_right hprod (le_of_lt hb.1)
  have hphi0 : 0 < b.2 := by
    by_contra h
    have hnonpos : sin b.2 ≤ 0 :=
      sin_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_neg_pi_le (le_of_not_gt h) (le_of_lt hb.2.1)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hnonpos) hsin
  refine ⟨![b.1, a.2, b.2], ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨hb.1, ha.2, hphi0, hb.2.2⟩
  · funext i
    fin_cases i
    · change b.1 * sin b.2 * cos a.2 = x 0
      rw [show b.1 * sin b.2 = a.1 by exact congrArg Prod.snd hbinv]
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hainv
    · change b.1 * sin b.2 * sin a.2 = x 1
      rw [show b.1 * sin b.2 = a.1 by exact congrArg Prod.snd hbinv]
      exact congrArg Prod.snd hainv
    · change b.1 * cos b.2 = x 2
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hbinv

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.spherical_image_compl_subset_hyperplane

        p.1 * cos p.2.2]
proof:
:= by
  simp [sphericalMap, sphericalParamsEquiv_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_space_eq_iterated_spherical
statement:
theorem integral_space_eq_iterated_spherical (f : Euclidean3 → ℝ)
    (hf : IntegrableOn
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦
        p.1 ^ 2 * sin p.2.2 * f (sphericalMap (sphericalParamsEquiv p)))
      (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioo (-π) π ×ˢ Ioo (0 : ℝ) π))
      (volume.prod (volume.prod volume))) :
    (∫ x, f x) =
      ∫ ρ in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, ∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π,
        ρ ^ 2 * sin φ * f ![ρ * sin φ * cos θ,
          ρ * sin φ * sin θ, ρ * cos φ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_space_eq_spherical]
  have hchange :
      (∫ p in sphericalSource, p 0 ^ 2 * sin (p 2) * f (sphericalMap p)) =
        ∫ p in Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (Ioo (-π) π ×ˢ Ioo (0 : ℝ) π),
          p.1 ^ 2 * sin p.2.2 * f (sphericalMap (sphericalParamsEquiv p))
          ∂(volume.prod (volume.prod volume)) := by
    rw [← measurePreserving_sphericalParamsEquiv.map_eq,
      setIntegral_map_equiv, sphericalParamsEquiv_preimage_source]
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ (ℝ × ℝ), Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ]
    simp [sphericalParamsEquiv_apply, sphericalMap]
  have hsec : ∀ᵐ ρ ∂volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)), IntegrableOn
      (fun a : ℝ × ℝ ↦
        ρ ^ 2 * sin a.2 * f (sphericalMap (sphericalParamsEquiv (ρ, a))))
      (Ioo (-π) π ×ˢ Ioo (0 : ℝ) π) (volume.prod volume) := by
    have hf' := hf
    rw [IntegrableOn, ← Measure.prod_restrict] at hf'
    exact hf'.prod_right_ae
  rw [hchange, setIntegral_prod _ hf]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hsec] with ρ hρ
  rw [setIntegral_prod _ hρ]
  simp [sphericalParamsEquiv_apply, sphericalMap]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.indicator_xNormalDomain_section
statement:
lemma indicator_xNormalDomain_section (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (lower upper : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (fun y ↦ (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f (x, y)) =
      (Icc a b).indicator
        (fun x ↦ (Icc (lower x) (upper x)).indicator (fun y ↦ f (x, y))) x
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc a b
  · by_cases hy : y ∈ Icc (lower x) (upper x)
    · simp only [mem_Icc] at hx hy
      simp [Set.indicator, xNormalDomain, hx, hy]
    · simp only [mem_Icc] at hx hy
      simp [Set.indicator, xNormalDomain, hx, hy]
  · simp only [mem_Icc] at hx
    simp [Set.indicator, xNormalDomain, hx]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_xNormalDomain_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem integral_xNormalDomain_eq_iterated {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ} (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume)) :
    (∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f z ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
      ∫ x in Icc a b, ∫ y in Icc (lower x) (upper x), f (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := measurableSet_xNormalDomain (a := a) (b := b) hlower hupper
  have hfi : Integrable ((xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f)
      (volume.prod volume) := hf.integrable_indicator hD
  calc
    (∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f z ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
        ∫ z, (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f z ∂(volume.prod volume) :=
      (integral_indicator hD).symm
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ y, (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f (x, y) :=
      integral_prod _ hfi
    _ = ∫ x, (Icc a b).indicator
        (fun x ↦ ∫ y, (Icc (lower x) (upper x)).indicator (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) y) x := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [indicator_xNormalDomain_section]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc a b <;> simp [hx]
    _ = ∫ x in Icc a b, ∫ y in Icc (lower x) (upper x), f (x, y) := by
      simp_rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_xNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable
statement:
theorem integral_xNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlower : Measurable lower) (hupper : Measurable upper)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume)) :
    (∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f z ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
      ∫ x in Icc a b, ∫ y in Icc (lower x) (upper x), f (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := measurableSet_xNormalDomain_of_measurable
    (a := a) (b := b) hlower hupper
  have hfi : Integrable ((xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f)
      (volume.prod volume) := hf.integrable_indicator hD
  calc
    (∫ z in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f z ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
        ∫ z, (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f z ∂(volume.prod volume) :=
      (integral_indicator hD).symm
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ y, (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f (x, y) :=
      integral_prod _ hfi
    _ = ∫ x, (Icc a b).indicator
        (fun x ↦ ∫ y, (Icc (lower x) (upper x)).indicator (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) y) x := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [indicator_xNormalDomain_section]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc a b <;> simp [hx]
    _ = ∫ x in Icc a b, ∫ y in Icc (lower x) (upper x), f (x, y) := by
      simp_rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_xNormalDomainFin_eq_prod
statement:
lemma integral_xNormalDomainFin_eq_prod
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (lower upper : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper) :
    (∫ v in xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper,
        f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v)) =
      ∫ p in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f p
proof:
:= by
  let e : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ × ℝ := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow
  let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f
  have he : MeasurePreserving e volume (volume.prod volume) :=
    volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding e := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurableEmbedding
  have hD : MeasurableSet (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) :=
    measurableSet_xNormalDomain hlower hupper
  have hDFin : MeasurableSet (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper) := by
    exact hD.preimage MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurable
  calc
    (∫ v in xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper,
        f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v)) =
        ∫ v, (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v)) v :=
      (integral_indicator hDFin).symm
    _ = ∫ v, g (e v) := by rfl
    _ = ∫ p, g p ∂(volume.prod volume) := he.integral_comp hemb g
    _ = ∫ p in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f p := integral_indicator hD

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann_of_aeContinuous
statement:
theorem riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann_of_aeContinuous
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlower : Measurable lower) (hupper : Measurable upper)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x < upper x)
    (hsection : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b,
      ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (Icc (lower x) (upper x)))
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (I : RiemannBox 2)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ v ∈ Box.Icc I,
      ‖(xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
        (fun w ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow w)) v‖ ≤ C)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, ContinuousAt
      ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
        (fun w ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow w))) v)
    (hsub : xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      ∫ x in Icc a b, riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : MeasurableSet (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) :=
    measurableSet_xNormalDomain_of_measurable hlower hupper
  have hDFin : MeasurableSet (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper) :=
    hD.preimage MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurable
  calc
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
        ∫ v in xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper,
          f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v) :=
      (hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral_of_aeContinuous
        hDFin.nullMeasurableSet I hb hc hsub).integral_eq
    _ = ∫ p in xNormalDomain a b lower upper, f p := by
      let e : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ × ℝ := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow
      let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := (xNormalDomain a b lower upper).indicator f
      have he : MeasurePreserving e volume (volume.prod volume) :=
        volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ
      have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding e := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurableEmbedding
      calc
        _ = ∫ v, (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
            (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v)) v :=
          (integral_indicator hDFin).symm
        _ = ∫ v, g (e v) := by rfl
        _ = ∫ p, g p ∂(volume.prod volume) := he.integral_comp hemb g
        _ = _ := integral_indicator hD
    _ = ∫ x in Icc a b, ∫ y in Icc (lower x) (upper x), f (x, y) :=
      integral_xNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable hlower hupper hfi
    _ = ∫ x in Icc a b,
        riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x) := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
      intro x hx
      dsimp
      rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval (hlu x hx) (hsection x hx)]
      exact integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann
statement:
theorem riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x < upper x) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (hs : IsJordanMeasurable (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper))
    (I : RiemannBox 2) (hsub : xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      ∫ x in Icc a b, riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)
proof:
:= by
  have hecont : Continuous (fun v : Fin 2 → ℝ ↦ MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v) := by
    simpa [MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow_apply] using
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.finTwoArrow ℝ ℝ).continuous
  have hfFin : Continuous (fun v : Fin 2 → ℝ ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v)) :=
    hf.comp hecont
  exact riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann_of_aeContinuous
    hlower.measurable hupper.measurable hlu
    (fun _ _ ↦ (hf.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).continuousOn)
    hfi I (jordan_indicator_bounded_on_box hfFin I)
    (jordan_indicator_ae_continuous hs hfFin) hsub

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_iteratedRiemann
statement:
theorem riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_iteratedRiemann
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {lower upper : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hlower : Continuous lower) (hupper : Continuous upper)
    (hlu : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, lower x < upper x) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (xNormalDomain a b lower upper) (volume.prod volume))
    (hs : IsJordanMeasurable (xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper))
    (houter : ContinuousOn
      (fun x ↦ riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)) (Icc a b))
    (I : RiemannBox 2) (hsub : xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((xNormalDomainFin a b lower upper).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      riemannIntegral
        (fun x ↦ riemannIntegral (fun y ↦ f (x, y)) (lower x) (upper x)) a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannBoxIntegral_xNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann
    hlower hupper hlu hf hfi hs I hsub]
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab houter]
  exact integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.indicator_yNormalDomain_section
statement:
lemma indicator_yNormalDomain_section (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ)
    (left right : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ) :
    (fun x ↦ (yNormalDomain c d left right).indicator f (x, y)) =
      (Icc c d).indicator
        (fun y ↦ (Icc (left y) (right y)).indicator (fun x ↦ f (x, y))) y
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Icc c d
  · by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc (left y) (right y)
    · simp only [mem_Icc] at hy hx
      simp [Set.indicator, yNormalDomain, hy, hx]
    · simp only [mem_Icc] at hy hx
      simp [Set.indicator, yNormalDomain, hy, hx]
  · simp only [mem_Icc] at hy
    simp [Set.indicator, yNormalDomain, hy]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.integral_yNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable
statement:
theorem integral_yNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {c d : ℝ} {left right : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hleft : Measurable left) (hright : Measurable right)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (yNormalDomain c d left right) (volume.prod volume)) :
    (∫ z in yNormalDomain c d left right, f z ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
      ∫ y in Icc c d, ∫ x in Icc (left y) (right y), f (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := measurableSet_yNormalDomain_of_measurable
    (c := c) (d := d) hleft hright
  have hfi : Integrable ((yNormalDomain c d left right).indicator f)
      (volume.prod volume) := hf.integrable_indicator hD
  calc
    (∫ z in yNormalDomain c d left right, f z ∂(volume.prod volume)) =
        ∫ z, (yNormalDomain c d left right).indicator f z ∂(volume.prod volume) :=
      (integral_indicator hD).symm
    _ = ∫ y, ∫ x, (yNormalDomain c d left right).indicator f (x, y) :=
      integral_prod_symm _ hfi
    _ = ∫ y, (Icc c d).indicator
        (fun y ↦ ∫ x, (Icc (left y) (right y)).indicator (fun x ↦ f (x, y)) x) y := by
      congr 1
      funext y
      rw [indicator_yNormalDomain_section]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ Icc c d <;> simp [hy]
    _ = ∫ y in Icc c d, ∫ x in Icc (left y) (right y), f (x, y) := by
      simp_rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Multivariable.riemannBoxIntegral_yNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann_of_aeContinuous
statement:
theorem riemannBoxIntegral_yNormalDomain_eq_integral_riemann_of_aeContinuous
    {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {c d : ℝ} {left right : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hleft : Measurable left) (hright : Measurable right)
    (hlr : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d, left y < right y)
    (hsection : ∀ y ∈ Icc c d,
      ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ f (x, y)) (Icc (left y) (right y)))
    (hfi : IntegrableOn f (yNormalDomain c d left right) (volume.prod volume))
    (I : RiemannBox 2)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ v ∈ Box.Icc I,
      ‖(yNormalDomainFin c d left right).indicator
        (fun w ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow w)) v‖ ≤ C)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, ContinuousAt
      ((yNormalDomainFin c d left right).indicator
        (fun w ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow w))) v)
    (hsub : yNormalDomainFin c d left right ⊆ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((yNormalDomainFin c d left right).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
      ∫ y in Icc c d, riemannIntegral (fun x ↦ f (x, y)) (left y) (right y)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := measurableSet_yNormalDomain_of_measurable
    (c := c) (d := d) hleft hright
  have hDFin : MeasurableSet (yNormalDomainFin c d left right) :=
    hD.preimage MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurable
  calc
    riemannBoxIntegral
        ((yNormalDomainFin c d left right).indicator
          (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v))) I =
        ∫ v in yNormalDomainFin c d left right,
          f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v) :=
      (hasRiemannBoxIntegral_indicator_eq_setIntegral_of_aeContinuous
        hDFin.nullMeasurableSet I hb hc hsub).integral_eq
    _ = ∫ p in yNormalDomain c d left right, f p := by
      let e : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ × ℝ := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow
      let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := (yNormalDomain c d left right).indicator f
      have he : MeasurePreserving e volume (volume.prod volume) :=
        volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ
      have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding e := MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurableEmbedding
      calc
        _ = ∫ v, (yNormalDomainFin c d left right).indicator
            (fun v ↦ f (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow v)) v :=
          (integral_indicator hDFin).symm
        _ = ∫ v, g (e v) := by rfl
        _ = ∫ p, g p ∂(volume.prod volume) := he.integral_comp hemb g
        _ = _ := integral_indicator hD
    _ = ∫ y in Icc c d, ∫ x in Icc (left y) (right y), f (x, y) :=
      integral_yNormalDomain_eq_iterated_of_measurable hleft hright hfi
    _ = ∫ y in Icc c d,
        riemannIntegral (fun x ↦ f (x, y)) (left y) (right y) := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
      intro y hy
      dsimp
      rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval (hlr y hy) (hsection y hy)]
      exact integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc

proof:

  intro ε hε

  intro j hj

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Real.cau_equiv_trans
statement:
theorem cau_equiv_trans {f g h : CauSeq ℚ (abs : ℚ → ℚ)}
    (hfg : f ≈ g) (hgh : g ≈ h) : f ≈ h
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  rcases hfg (ε / 2) (half_pos hε) with ⟨i, hi⟩
  rcases hgh (ε / 2) (half_pos hε) with ⟨j, hj⟩
  refine ⟨max i j, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have h1 : abs (f k - g k) < ε / 2 := by
    simpa using hi k (le_trans (le_max_left i j) hk)
  have h2 : abs (g k - h k) < ε / 2 := by
    simpa using hj k (le_trans (le_max_right i j) hk)
  calc
    abs (f k - h k) = abs ((f k - g k) + (g k - h k)) := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ abs (f k - g k) + abs (g k - h k) := abs_add_le _ _
    _ < ε := by linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.markov_inequality
statement:
theorem markov_inequality
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (haTop : a ≠ ⊤) :
    μ {ω | a ≤ X ω} ≤ (∫⁻ ω, X ω ∂μ) / a
proof:
:=
  meas_ge_le_lintegral_div hX ha0 haTop

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.chebyshev_inequality
statement:
theorem chebyshev_inequality
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    μ {ω | c ≤ |X ω - ∫ x, X x ∂μ|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Var[X; μ] / c ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq hX hc

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.jensen_inequality
statement:
theorem jensen_inequality
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {s : Set E} {X : Ω → E} {g : E → ℝ}
    (hg : ConvexOn ℝ s g) (hgc : ContinuousOn g s) (hsc : IsClosed s)
    (hXs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ∈ s) (hX : Integrable X μ)
    (hgX : Integrable (g ∘ X) μ) :
    g (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, g (X ω) ∂μ
proof:
:=
  hg.map_integral_le hgc hsc hXs hX hgX

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.integrable_iff_memLp_one

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.adapted_measurable_later
statement:
theorem adapted_measurable_later
    {Ω ι : Type*} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} [Preorder ι]

    {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {X : (i : ι) → Ω → β i}
    (hX : Adapted 𝓕 X) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≤ j) :

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.adapted_measurable

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_eq_integral
statement:
theorem realCharFun_eq_integral
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (t : ℝ) :
    charFun (μ.map X) t = ∫ ω, Complex.exp ((t * X ω : ℝ) * Complex.I) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply_real, integral_map hX]
  · congr with ω

  · fun_prop

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_continuous

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.norm_realCharFun_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_realCharFun_le_one

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_neg
statement:
theorem realCharFun_neg

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_scale
statement:
theorem realCharFun_scale
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (r t : ℝ) :

proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_translate
statement:
theorem realCharFun_translate
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (a t : ℝ) :
    charFun (μ.map (fun ω ↦ X ω + a)) t =
      charFun (μ.map X) t * Complex.exp ((a * t : ℝ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun ω ↦ X ω + a) = (fun x ↦ x + a) ∘ X from rfl,
    ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable]
  · simpa [mul_comm] using charFun_map_add_const (μ := μ.map X) a t
  · fun_prop
  · exact hX

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.realCharFun_independent_add
statement:
theorem realCharFun_independent_add

    (hXY : X ⟂ᵢ[μ] Y) :
    charFun (μ.map (fun ω ↦ X ω + Y ω)) =
      charFun (μ.map X) * charFun (μ.map Y)
proof:
:= by
  exact hXY.charFun_map_fun_add_eq_mul hX hY

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.identDistrib_iff_realCharFun_eq
statement:
theorem identDistrib_iff_realCharFun_eq
    {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ν : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {Y : Ω' → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y ν) :
    IdentDistrib X Y μ ν ↔ charFun (μ.map X) = charFun (ν.map Y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ congrArg charFun h.map_eq
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hX, hY, Measure.ext_of_charFun h⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.strongLaw_of_pairwise_independent_integrable
statement:
theorem strongLaw_of_pairwise_independent_integrable
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

    (hindep : Pairwise (Function.onFun (fun f g ↦ f ⟂ᵢ[μ] g) X))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω)
        atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using strong_law_ae_real X hint hindep hident

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.strongLaw_of_iid_integrable

    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) :

proof:
:= by
  exact strongLaw_of_pairwise_independent_integrable X hint

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.conditionalExpectation_eq_expectation_of_indep
statement:
theorem conditionalExpectation_eq_expectation_of_indep

    (hX : StronglyMeasurable[mX] X) (hIndep : Indep mX mC μ) :

proof:

  condExp_indep_eq hmX hmC hX hIndep

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.conditionalExpectation_comap_eq_expectation_of_indepFun
statement:
theorem conditionalExpectation_comap_eq_expectation_of_indepFun
    {Ω E S : Type*} [m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace S] {μ : @Measure Ω m₀} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → E} {Y : Ω → S} (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hXY : IndepFun X Y μ) :
    μ[X | MeasurableSpace.comap Y inferInstance] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  exact conditionalExpectation_eq_expectation_of_indep hX.comap_le hY.comap_le
    (comap_measurable X).stronglyMeasurable hXY

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_memLp_of_memLp_zero
statement:
theorem iid_memLp_of_memLp_zero
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) (i : ℕ) :
    MemLp (X i) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (hident i).memLp_iff.mpr hX

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_sum_memLp
statement:
theorem iid_sum_memLp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  convert! memLp_finsetSum' (range n)
    (fun i _ ↦ iid_memLp_of_memLp_zero X hX hident i) using 1
  ext ω
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_sum_variance
statement:
theorem iid_sum_variance
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) (n : ℕ) :
    Var[fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω; μ] = n * Var[X 0; μ]
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) = ∑ i ∈ range n, X i := by
    ext ω
    simp
  rw [heq, IndepFun.variance_sum]
  · simp_rw [(hident _).variance_eq]
    simp
  · intro i hi
    exact iid_memLp_of_memLp_zero X hX hident i
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    exact hindep.indepFun hij

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_sampleMean_memLp
statement:
theorem iid_sampleMean_memLp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (iid_sum_memLp X hX hident n).const_mul _

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_sum_integral
statement:
theorem iid_sum_integral
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω) ∂μ = n * ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · simp_rw [(hident _).integral_eq]
    simp
  · intro i hi
    exact (iid_memLp_of_memLp_zero X hX hident i).integrable (by norm_num)

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_sampleMean_integral
statement:
theorem iid_sampleMean_integral
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∫ ω, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_const_mul, iid_sum_integral X hX hident]
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_sampleMean_variance
statement:
theorem iid_sampleMean_variance
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Var[fun ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω; μ] = Var[X 0; μ] / n
proof:
:= by
  rw [variance_const_mul, iid_sum_variance X hX hindep hident]
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.weakLaw_of_iid_finiteVariance
statement:
theorem weakLaw_of_iid_finiteVariance
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 μ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) :
    TendstoInMeasure μ
      (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ range n, X i ω)
      atTop (fun _ ↦ ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convergesInProbability_iff_measureReal_dist]
  intro ε hε
  let C : ℝ := Var[X 0; μ] / ε ^ 2
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := div_nonneg (variance_nonneg _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hupper_tendsto : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ C * (n : ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hinv
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hupper_tendsto
  · filter_upwards with n
    exact measureReal_nonneg
  · filter_upwards [eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun n hn ↦ hn⟩] with n hn
    have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn
    have hcheb := chebyshev_inequality (iid_sampleMean_memLp X hX hident n) hε
    rw [iid_sampleMean_integral X hX hident hnpos,
      iid_sampleMean_variance X hX hindep hident hnpos] at hcheb
    rw [Measure.real_def]
    have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp) hcheb
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (div_nonneg (div_nonneg (variance_nonneg _ _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _))] at hreal
    simpa [Real.dist_eq, C, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hreal

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.almostSurelyConverges_iff_ae_tendsto
statement:
theorem almostSurelyConverges_iff_ae_tendsto
    {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (X : ℕ → Ω → E) (Z : Ω → E) :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n ↦ X n ω) atTop (𝓝 (Z ω))) ↔
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n ↦ X n ω) atTop (𝓝 (Z ω))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.convergesInProbability_iff_measureReal_dist
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_centeredScaled_clt
statement:
theorem iid_centeredScaled_clt
    (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P)
    (hXmem : MemLp (X 0) 2 P)
    (hmean : P[X 0] = μ) (hvar : variance (X 0) P = σ ^ 2)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ centeredScaledSumLaw X (fun i ↦ (hident i).aemeasurable_fst) μ σ n)
      atTop (𝓝 (⟨gaussianReal 0 1, inferInstance⟩ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hint : Integrable (X 0) P := hXmem.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hvarInt : P[fun ω ↦ (X 0 ω - μ) ^ 2] = σ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hmean, ← variance_eq_integral hXmem.aemeasurable, hvar]
  have hbase := normalizedSum_probabilityMeasure_tendsto_standardGaussian
    (P := P) (X := fun k ω ↦ (X k ω - μ) / σ)
    (iIndepFun_centeredScaled hindep μ σ)
    (identDistrib_centeredScaled hident μ σ)
    (integral_centeredScaled_eq_zero hint hmean)
    (integral_sq_centeredScaled_eq_one hvarInt hσ.ne')
  exact hbase.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
    centeredScaledSumLaw_eq_normalizedSumLaw hident μ σ n)

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.iid_centeredScaled_clt_tendstoInDistribution

    (hindep : iIndepFun X P)

    (hXmem : MemLp (X 0) 2 P)
    (hmean : P[X 0] = μ) (hvar : variance (X 0) P = σ ^ 2)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (σ * √n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - μ))
      atTop Z (fun _ ↦ P) P'
proof:
:=
  tendstoInDistribution_of_tendsto_law_gaussian
    (Y := fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (σ * √n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - μ))
    (fun n ↦ (Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _ fun i _ ↦
      (hident i).aemeasurable_fst.sub_const μ).const_mul (σ * √n)⁻¹)
    hZ hZlaw
    (by simpa [lawProbabilityMeasure, centeredScaledSumLaw] using
      iid_centeredScaled_clt hindep hident hXmem hmean hvar hσ)

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.degenerateVariance_centeredSum_tendsto
statement:
theorem degenerateVariance_centeredSum_tendsto
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P)
    (hXmem : MemLp (X 0) 2 P) (hmean : P[X 0] = μ)
    (hvar : variance (X 0) P = 0) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ lawProbabilityMeasure
        (fun ω ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - μ))
        ((Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _ fun i _ ↦
          (hident i).aemeasurable_fst.sub_const μ).const_mul (√n)⁻¹))
      atTop (𝓝 (⟨gaussianReal 0 0, inferInstance⟩ : ProbabilityMeasure ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hconst0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X 0 ω = μ := by
    have h := ae_eq_integral_of_variance_eq_zero hXmem hvar
    filter_upwards [h] with ω hω
    rwa [hmean] at hω
  have hconst : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X k ω = μ := fun k ↦
    (hident k).symm.ae_snd (measurableSet_singleton μ) hconst0
  have hmap : ∀ n : ℕ, P.map (fun ω ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - μ)) =
      Measure.dirac 0 := by
    intro n
    have hae : (fun ω ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - μ)) =ᵐ[P] fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [(Finset.eventually_all (Finset.range n)).2 (fun k _ ↦ hconst k)] with ω hω
      have hzero : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - μ)) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk ↦ ?_
        rw [hω k hk, sub_self]
      rw [hzero, mul_zero]
    rw [Measure.map_congr hae, Measure.map_const]
    simp
  refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ?_)
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [lawProbabilityMeasure]
  rw [gaussianReal_zero_var, hmap n]

  have mX n := (hident n).aemeasurable_fst

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.centeredVarianceOne_charFun_pow_tendsto
statement:
theorem centeredVarianceOne_charFun_pow_tendsto
    {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hZ : AEMeasurable Z P)
    (h0 : P[Z] = 0) (h1 : P[Z ^ 2] = 1) (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (charFun (P.map Z) ((√n)⁻¹ * t)) ^ n)
      atTop (𝓝 (Complex.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)))
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_pow_exp_of_isLittleO_sub_add_div
  suffices (fun n : ℕ ↦ charFun (P.map Z) ((√n)⁻¹ * t) -
      (1 + (-(((√n)⁻¹ * t) ^ 2 / 2) : ℂ))) =o[atTop]
        fun n ↦ ((√n)⁻¹ * t) ^ 2 by
    have aux : (fun n : ℕ ↦ ‖(1 / n : ℂ)‖) = fun n : ℕ ↦ ‖(1 / n : ℝ)‖ := by simp
    rw [← Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_right, aux, Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_right]
    refine .of_const_mul_right (c := t ^ 2) ?_
    convert! this using 4 with n <;> norm_cast <;> simp [field]
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [← zero_mul t]
    exact .mul_const t (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp <| Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp <|
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  convert! (taylor_charFun_two hZ h0 h1).comp_tendsto ht using 2
  simp
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Probability.normalizedSum_probabilityMeasure_tendsto_standardGaussian
statement:
theorem normalizedSum_probabilityMeasure_tendsto_standardGaussian
    (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P)
    (h0 : P[X 0] = 0) (h1 : P[X 0 ^ 2] = 1) :

  simpa [normalizedSumLaw, normalizedSum_charFun_eq_pow hindep hident,
    charFun_gaussianReal, neg_div] using

        (hident 0).aemeasurable_fst h0 h1 t

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b)
    (hmem : MapsTo gamma.extend (uIcc 0 1) U)
    (hdiff : ∀ t ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ gamma.extend t)
    (hint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv gamma.extend t * f (gamma.extend t)) volume 0 1)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = g b - g a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral, curveIntegral_eq_intervalIntegral_deriv]
  change (∫ t : ℝ in 0..1, deriv gamma.extend t * f (gamma.extend t)) = g b - g a
  have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ g (gamma.extend t))
    (f' := fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv gamma.extend t * f (gamma.extend t)) (by
      intro t ht
      have houter := hg _ (hmem ht)
      have hinner := (hdiff t ht).hasDerivAt
      simpa [Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
        (houter.comp_hasFDerivAt t hinner.hasFDerivAt).hasDerivAt) hint
  simpa using hftc

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_homotopyInvariant_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_homotopyInvariant_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma delta : Path a b}
    (_homotopy : (gamma : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ℂ)).Homotopy delta)
    (hgammaMem : MapsTo gamma.extend (uIcc 0 1) U)
    (hdeltaMem : MapsTo delta.extend (uIcc 0 1) U)
    (hgammaDiff : ∀ t ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ gamma.extend t)
    (hdeltaDiff : ∀ t ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ delta.extend t)
    (hgammaInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv gamma.extend t * f (gamma.extend t)) volume 0 1)
    (hdeltaInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv delta.extend t * f (delta.extend t)) volume 0 1)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive gamma hgammaMem hgammaDiff hgammaInt hg,
    pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive delta hdeltaMem hdeltaDiff hdeltaInt hg]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ}
    (hseg : [a -[ℝ] b] ⊆ U) (hf : ContinuousOn f U)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f (.segment a b) = g b - g a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_segment]
  have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ g (lineMap a b t))
    (f' := fun t : ℝ ↦ (b - a) * f (lineMap a b t)) (by
      intro t ht
      rw [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      have hline : lineMap a b t ∈ [a -[ℝ] b] := lineMap_mem_segment ℝ a b ht
      have houter := hg _ (hseg hline)
      have hinner := (hasDerivAt_lineMap (a := a) (b := b) (x := t)).hasFDerivAt
      simpa [Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
        (houter.comp_hasFDerivAt t hinner).hasDerivAt) (by
      exact (((hf.mono hseg).comp lineMap_continuous.continuousOn
        (fun t ht ↦ lineMap_mem_segment ℝ a b (by simpa [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using ht)))
          |>.const_mul (b - a)).intervalIntegrable)
  simpa using hftc

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b c : ℂ}
    (hab : [a -[ℝ] b] ⊆ U) (hbc : [b -[ℝ] c] ⊆ U) (hca : [c -[ℝ] a] ⊆ U)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f (.segment a b) + pathIntegral f (.segment b c) +
      pathIntegral f (.segment c a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitive hab hf hg,
    pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitive hbc hf hg,
    pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitive hca hf hg]
  abel

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_holomorphicOnTextbook_ball
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_holomorphicOnTextbook_ball
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {center a b c : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f (ball center r))
    (ha : a ∈ ball center r) (hb : b ∈ ball center r) (hc : c ∈ ball center r) :
    pathIntegral f (.segment a b) + pathIntegral f (.segment b c) +
      pathIntegral f (.segment c a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball center r) :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_ball).mp hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hdiff.isExactOn_ball
  exact pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_primitive
    ((convex_ball center r).segment_subset ha hb)
    ((convex_ball center r).segment_subset hb hc)
    ((convex_ball center r).segment_subset hc ha) hdiff.continuousOn hg

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.homotopicWithin_iff
statement:
theorem homotopicWithin_iff {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma delta : Path a b) :
    HomotopicWithin U gamma delta ↔
      ∃ F : gamma.Homotopy delta, ∀ s t : unitInterval, F (s, t) ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact ⟨F, fun s t => hF (s, t)⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact ⟨F, fun z => hF z.1 z.2⟩

theorem AdmissiblePath.piecewiseC1 {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma : Path a b}
    (h : AdmissiblePath f U gamma) : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma

:= by

  | of_contDiffOn gamma _ _ hregular => exact .of_contDiffOn gamma hregular
  | trans _ _ ihgamma ihdelta => exact .trans _ _ ihgamma ihdelta

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.homotopicWithin_of_isSimplyConnected
statement:
theorem homotopicWithin_of_isSimplyConnected {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsSimplyConnected U)
    {a b : ℂ} (ha : a ∈ U) (hb : b ∈ U) (gamma delta : Path a b)
    (hgamma : ∀ t, gamma t ∈ U) (hdelta : ∀ t, delta t ∈ U) :
    HomotopicWithin U gamma delta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let lift : (p : Path a b) → (∀ t, p t ∈ U) → Path (⟨a, ha⟩ : U) (⟨b, hb⟩ : U) :=
    fun p hp =>
      { toFun := fun t => ⟨p t, hp t⟩
        continuous_toFun := p.continuous.subtype_mk hp
        source' := Subtype.ext p.source
        target' := Subtype.ext p.target }
  have hsc : SimplyConnectedSpace U := hU
  obtain ⟨F'⟩ := SimplyConnectedSpace.paths_homotopic (lift gamma hgamma) (lift delta hdelta)
  refine ⟨F'.map ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩, ?_⟩
  intro z
  exact (F' z).2

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_of_homotopicWithin
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_of_homotopicWithin {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ}
    {gamma delta : Path a b} (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma) (hdelta : Path.PiecewiseC1 delta)
    (hhom : HomotopicWithin U gamma delta) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hhom
  exact pathIntegral_eq_of_piecewiseC1_homotopyWithin hU hf hgamma hdelta F hF

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_of_isSimplyConnected
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_of_isSimplyConnected {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ}
    {gamma delta : Path a b} (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hconn : IsSimplyConnected U) (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma)
    (hdelta : Path.PiecewiseC1 delta) (himg : ∀ t, gamma t ∈ U)
    (hdimg : ∀ t, delta t ∈ U) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∈ U := gamma.source ▸ himg 0
  have hb : b ∈ U := delta.target ▸ hdimg 1
  exact pathIntegral_eq_of_homotopicWithin hU hf hgamma hdelta
    (homotopicWithin_of_isSimplyConnected hconn ha hb gamma delta himg hdimg)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegralIndependentOn_of_isSimplyConnected
proof:
:= by
  intro a b gamma delta hgamma hdelta
  have hrg : range gamma ⊆ U := hgamma.range_subset
  have hrd : range delta ⊆ U := hdelta.range_subset
  have ha : a ∈ U := hrg ⟨0, gamma.source⟩
  have hb : b ∈ U := hrd ⟨1, delta.target⟩
  exact pathIntegral_eq_of_homotopicWithin hU hf hgamma.piecewiseC1 hdelta.piecewiseC1
    (homotopicWithin_of_isSimplyConnected hconn ha hb gamma delta
      (fun t => hrg ⟨t, rfl⟩) (fun t => hrd ⟨t, rfl⟩))

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_isSimplyConnected

theorem pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_isSimplyConnected {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a : ℂ}

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cauchy_integral_formula_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem cauchy_integral_formula_iteratedDeriv {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f (closedBall c R)) (hR : 0 < R) (n : ℕ) :

      (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n.factorial) * iteratedDeriv n f c

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cauchy_estimate
statement:
theorem cauchy_estimate {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R C : ℝ}

    (hC : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ C) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv n f c‖ ≤ n.factorial * C / R ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R) := by
    intro z hz

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.complexPowerSeries_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem complexPowerSeries_eq_tsum (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c z : ℂ) :
    complexPowerSeries a c z = ∑' n : ℕ, a n * (z - c) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  simp [mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.termwiseDerivativePowerSeries_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem termwiseDerivativePowerSeries_eq_tsum (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c z : ℂ)
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.eball c (powerSeriesRadius a)) :
    termwiseDerivativePowerSeries a c z =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (n + 1 : ℂ) * a (n + 1) * (z - c) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a
  have hinside : ‖z - c‖ₑ < (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).radius := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_eball, edist_eq_enorm_sub, powerSeriesRadius] using hz
  have hR : 0 < p.radius := by
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ‖z - c‖ₑ := zero_le
    simpa only [p] using (lt_of_le_of_lt h0 hinside)
  have hy : z - c ∈ Metric.eball 0 p.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_eball, edist_eq_enorm_sub, sub_zero]
    simpa only [p] using hinside
  have hs : Summable (fun n ↦ p.derivSeries n fun _ ↦ z - c) :=
    ((p.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall hR).fderiv.hasSum hy).summable
  rw [termwiseDerivativePowerSeries, FormalMultilinearSeries.sum]
  change (∑' n, p.derivSeries n (fun _ ↦ z - c)) 1 = _
  change ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ) 1) (∑' n, p.derivSeries n (fun _ ↦ z - c)) = _
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_tsum _ hs]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  rw [FormalMultilinearSeries.apply_eq_pow_smul_coeff]
  simp [p, FormalMultilinearSeries.derivSeries_coeff_one, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.powerSeries_holomorphicOn_convergenceDisc
statement:
theorem powerSeries_holomorphicOn_convergenceDisc (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c : ℂ)
    (hR : 0 < powerSeriesRadius a) :
    HolomorphicOnTextbook (complexPowerSeries a c)
      (Metric.eball c (powerSeriesRadius a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_eball]
  let p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a
  have hp : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (fun z ↦ p.sum (z - c)) p c p.radius := by
    have hp₀ := p.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall (by simpa [p, powerSeriesRadius] using hR)
    simpa only [zero_add] using hp₀.comp_sub c
  change DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z ↦ p.sum (z - c)) (Metric.eball c p.radius)
  exact hp.differentiableOn

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.powerSeries_hasDerivAt_termwise
proof:
:= by
  let p := FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a
  have hinside : ‖z - c‖ₑ < p.radius := by
    simpa only [p, Metric.mem_eball, edist_eq_enorm_sub, powerSeriesRadius] using hz
  have hbase : HasDerivAt p.sum (p.derivSeries.sum (z - c) 1) (z - c) :=
    (p.hasFDerivAt_sum hinside).hasDerivAt
  have hcomp := hbase.comp z ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const c)
  convert hcomp using 1
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext w
    rfl
  · simp [termwiseDerivativePowerSeries, p]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.hasLaurentExpansionOnAnnulus_const

theorem hasLaurentExpansionOnAnnulus_const (c center : ℂ) (inner outer : ℝ) :

      (fun n ↦ if n = 0 then c else 0)
