name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.hasLaurentExpansionOnAnnulus_inv_sub
statement:
theorem hasLaurentExpansionOnAnnulus_inv_sub (center : ℂ) {inner outer : ℝ}
    (hinner : 0 ≤ inner) :
    HasLaurentExpansionOnAnnulus (fun z ↦ (z - center)⁻¹) center inner outer
      (fun n ↦ if n = -1 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hne : z - center ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by
    intro h
    subst z
    simpa [ComplexAnnulus] using lt_of_le_of_lt hinner hz.1)
  convert hasSum_ite_eq (-1 : ℤ) ((z - center)⁻¹) using 1
  ext n
  split_ifs with hn
  · subst n; simp
  · simp [hn]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.mem_support_or
statement:
theorem mem_support_or {γ δ : Cycle} {c : ClosedPath} (hc : c ∈ (γ + δ).support) :
    c ∈ γ.support ∨ c ∈ δ.support
proof:
:= by
  have hne : γ c + δ c ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hc
  rcases eq_or_ne (γ c) 0 with h | h
  · right
    refine Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr fun h2 => hne ?_
    rw [h, h2, zero_add]
  · exact Or.inl (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_apply
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_apply {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Cycle) :
    cycleIntegral f γ = γ.sum (fun c n => n • banachPathIntegral f c.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cycleIntegral_zero {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) : cycleIntegral f (0 : Cycle) = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (cycleIntegral f)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cycleIntegral_single {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (c : ClosedPath) (n : ℤ) :
    cycleIntegral f (Finsupp.single c n) = n • banachPathIntegral f c.2
proof:
:= by
  show Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ (fun c : ClosedPath => banachPathIntegral f c.2)
      (Finsupp.single c n) = n • banachPathIntegral f c.2
  exact Finsupp.linearCombination_single (v := fun c : ClosedPath => banachPathIntegral f c.2) ℤ n c

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_add
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_add {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (γ δ : Cycle) :
    cycleIntegral f (γ + δ) = cycleIntegral f γ + cycleIntegral f δ
proof:
:=
  map_add (cycleIntegral f) γ δ

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_smul
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_smul {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (n : ℤ) (γ : Cycle) :
    cycleIntegral f (n • γ) = n • cycleIntegral f γ
proof:
:=
  map_smul (cycleIntegral f) n γ

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_neg
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_neg {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Cycle) :
    cycleIntegral f (-γ) = -cycleIntegral f γ
proof:
:=
  map_neg (cycleIntegral f) γ

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_sub {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (γ δ : Cycle) :
    cycleIntegral f (γ - δ) = cycleIntegral f γ - cycleIntegral f δ
proof:
:=
  map_sub (cycleIntegral f) γ δ

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_add_integrand
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_add_integrand (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : Cycle)
    (hf : γ.Integrable f) (hg : γ.Integrable g) :
    cycleIntegral (fun z => f z + g z) γ = cycleIntegral f γ + cycleIntegral g γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleIntegral_apply, cycleIntegral_apply, cycleIntegral_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset γ (Finset.Subset.refl _)
      (fun c n => n • banachPathIntegral (fun z => f z + g z) c.2) (fun i _ => by simp),
    Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset γ (Finset.Subset.refl _)
      (fun c n => n • banachPathIntegral f c.2) (fun i _ => by simp),
    Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset γ (Finset.Subset.refl _)
      (fun c n => n • banachPathIntegral g c.2) (fun i _ => by simp),
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c hc => ?_
  rw [banachPathIntegral_add (hf c (by simpa using hc)) (hg c (by simpa using hc)), smul_add]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Cycle.PiecewiseC1.add
statement:
theorem Cycle.PiecewiseC1.add {γ δ : Cycle} (hγ : γ.PiecewiseC1) (hδ : δ.PiecewiseC1) :
    (γ + δ).PiecewiseC1
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  rcases mem_support_or hc with h | h
  · exact hγ c h
  · exact hδ c h

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Cycle.SupportedIn.add
statement:
theorem Cycle.SupportedIn.add {γ δ : Cycle} {U : Set ℂ}

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Cycle.Integrable.add
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Cycle.mem_trace
statement:
theorem Cycle.mem_trace {γ : Cycle} {w : ℂ} :
    w ∈ γ.trace ↔ ∃ c ∈ γ.support, w ∈ Set.range c.2
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Cycle.trace_add_subset
statement: theorem Cycle.trace_add_subset {γ δ : Cycle} : (γ + δ).trace ⊆ γ.trace ∪ δ.trace
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rcases (Cycle.mem_trace.mp hw) with ⟨c, hc, hrange⟩
  rcases mem_support_or hc with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Cycle.mem_trace.mpr ⟨c, h, hrange⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Cycle.mem_trace.mpr ⟨c, h, hrange⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_piece_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_piece_eq_zero
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Cycle)
    (h : ∀ c ∈ γ.support, banachPathIntegral f c.2 = 0) :
    cycleIntegral f γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleIntegral_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset γ (Finset.Subset.refl _)
      (fun c n => n • banachPathIntegral f c.2) (fun i _ => by simp)]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c hc => by rw [h c (by simpa using hc), smul_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_primitive
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_primitive
    {U : Set ℂ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ} (γ : Cycle)
    (hC1 : γ.PiecewiseC1) (hUγ : γ.SupportedIn U)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) (hf : ContinuousOn f U) :
    cycleIntegral f γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_piece_eq_zero
  intro c hc
  have hadm : AdmissiblePath f U c.2 :=
    admissiblePath_of_piecewiseC1 (hC1 c hc) (hUγ c hc) hf
  rw [banachPathIntegral_complex_eq_pathIntegral,
    pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive_of_admissiblePath hadm hg, sub_self]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.admissiblePath_of_piecewiseC1
statement:
theorem admissiblePath_of_piecewiseC1
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma : Path a b}
    (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma)
    (hrange : Set.range gamma ⊆ U) (hf : ContinuousOn f U) :
    AdmissiblePath f U gamma
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma regular =>
      apply AdmissiblePath.of_contDiffOn gamma hrange _ regular
      have hform : ContinuousOn (scalarOneForm f) U :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ ℂ ℂ
          (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)).continuous.comp_continuousOn hf
      exact hform.curveIntegrable_of_contDiffOn regular (fun t ↦ hrange ⟨t, rfl⟩)
  | trans gamma delta hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      apply AdmissiblePath.trans
      · apply ihgamma
        intro z hz
        apply hrange
        rw [Path.trans_range]
        exact Set.mem_union_left _ hz
      · apply ihdelta
        intro z hz
        apply hrange
        rw [Path.trans_range]
        exact Set.mem_union_right _ hz
  | cast gamma hgamma hx hy ih =>
      subst hx
      subst hy
      simpa using ih (by
        intro z hz
        apply hrange
        simpa only [Path.cast_coe] using hz)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Path.subpath_zero_midpoint_subpath_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.subpath_zero_midpoint_subpath_apply
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {a b : X} (gamma : Path a b)
    (s t u : unitInterval) :
    (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).subpath s t u =
      gamma.subpath (unitIntervalLeftHalf s) (unitIntervalLeftHalf t) u
proof:
:= by
  change gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb 0 unitIntervalMidpoint
      (Set.Icc.convexComb s t u)) =
    gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalLeftHalf s) (unitIntervalLeftHalf t) u)
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [unitIntervalMidpoint, unitIntervalLeftHalf]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Path.subpath_midpoint_one_subpath_apply
statement:
private theorem Path.subpath_midpoint_one_subpath_apply
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {a b : X} (gamma : Path a b)
    (s t u : unitInterval) :
    (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1).subpath s t u =
      gamma.subpath (unitIntervalRightHalf s) (unitIntervalRightHalf t) u
proof:
:= by
  change gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb unitIntervalMidpoint 1
      (Set.Icc.convexComb s t u)) =
    gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb (unitIntervalRightHalf s) (unitIntervalRightHalf t) u)
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [unitIntervalMidpoint, unitIntervalRightHalf]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.PathIntegrable.leftHalf_subpath
statement:
private theorem PathIntegrable.leftHalf_subpath
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b) (s t : unitInterval)
    (h : PathIntegrable f
      (gamma.subpath (unitIntervalLeftHalf s) (unitIntervalLeftHalf t))) :
    PathIntegrable f ((gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).subpath s t)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource :
      (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint) s = gamma (unitIntervalLeftHalf s) := by
    simpa using Path.subpath_zero_midpoint_subpath_apply gamma s t 0
  have htarget :
      (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint) t = gamma (unitIntervalLeftHalf t) := by
    simpa using Path.subpath_zero_midpoint_subpath_apply gamma s t 1
  have heq :
      (((gamma.subpath (unitIntervalLeftHalf s) (unitIntervalLeftHalf t)).cast
        hsource htarget) : Path _ _) =
        (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).subpath s t := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext u
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact (Path.subpath_zero_midpoint_subpath_apply gamma s t u).symm
  rw [← heq]
  exact h.cast hsource htarget

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.PathIntegrable.rightHalf_subpath
statement:
private theorem PathIntegrable.rightHalf_subpath
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b) (s t : unitInterval)

  have htarget :

  have heq :
      (((gamma.subpath (unitIntervalRightHalf s) (unitIntervalRightHalf t)).cast

    apply Path.ext
    funext u
    rw [Path.cast_coe]
    exact (Path.subpath_midpoint_one_subpath_apply gamma s t u).symm
  rw [← heq]
  exact h.cast hsource htarget

statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.sum_dyadic_succ_split
statement:
private theorem sum_dyadic_succ_split
    {G : Type*} [AddCommMonoid G] (n : ℕ)
    (value : Fin (2 ^ (n + 1)) → G) :
    (∑ k, value k) =
      (∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), value (integralDyadicLeftSegmentIndex n i)) +
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), value (integralDyadicRightSegmentIndex n i)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (2 ^ n + 2 ^ n) ≃ Fin (2 ^ (n + 1)) :=
    finCongr (by simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two])
  have hsplit := Fin.sum_univ_add (fun k : Fin (2 ^ n + 2 ^ n) ↦ value (e k))
  calc
    (∑ k, value k) = ∑ k : Fin (2 ^ n + 2 ^ n), value (e k) :=
      (e.sum_comp value).symm
    _ = (∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), value (e (Fin.castAdd (2 ^ n) i))) +
        ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), value (e (Fin.natAdd (2 ^ n) i)) := hsplit
    _ = (∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), value (integralDyadicLeftSegmentIndex n i)) +
        ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), value (integralDyadicRightSegmentIndex n i) := by
      apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        congr 1

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] private theorem integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_castSucc
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    integralDyadicMeshPoint (n + 1)
        (integralDyadicLeftSegmentIndex n i).castSucc =
      unitIntervalLeftHalf (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [integralDyadicMeshPoint, integralDyadicLeftSegmentIndex,
    unitIntervalMeshPoint, unitIntervalLeftHalf]
  push_cast
  simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
  change (i.val : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) =
    ((i.val : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) / 2
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_succ

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.Path.midpointSubpaths_trans
statement:
private theorem Path.midpointSubpaths_trans
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {a b : X} (gamma : Path a b) :
    (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).trans
        (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1) =
      gamma.cast gamma.source gamma.target
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  rw [Path.cast_coe, Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with ht
  · change gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb 0 unitIntervalMidpoint
        ⟨2 * (t : ℝ), by constructor <;> nlinarith [t.2.1, ht]⟩) = gamma t
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalMidpoint]
    ring
  · change gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb unitIntervalMidpoint 1
        ⟨2 * (t : ℝ) - 1, by
          constructor <;> nlinarith [not_le.1 ht, t.2.2]⟩) = gamma t
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [unitIntervalMidpoint]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_midpointSubpaths_add
statement:
private theorem pathIntegral_eq_midpointSubpaths_add
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b)
    (hleft : PathIntegrable f (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint))
    (hright : PathIntegrable f (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1)) :
    pathIntegral f gamma =
      pathIntegral f (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint) +
        pathIntegral f (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pathIntegral_trans f _ _ hleft hright,
    Path.midpointSubpaths_trans]
  simp [pathIntegral]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegrable_of_dyadicSubpaths
statement:
private theorem pathIntegrable_of_dyadicSubpaths :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b),
      (∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
        (gamma.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
          (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ))) →
      PathIntegrable f gamma
proof:
| 0, f, a, b, gamma, h => by
      have h0 := h (0 : Fin 1)
      have hstart : integralDyadicMeshPoint 0 (Fin.castSucc (0 : Fin 1)) = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        norm_num [integralDyadicMeshPoint, unitIntervalMeshPoint]
      have hend : integralDyadicMeshPoint 0 (Fin.succ (0 : Fin 1)) = 1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        norm_num [integralDyadicMeshPoint, unitIntervalMeshPoint]
      rw [hstart, hend, Path.subpath_zero_one] at h0
      simpa [PathIntegrable] using h0
  | n + 1, f, a, b, gamma, h => by
      have hleftLeaves : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
          ((gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).subpath
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
        intro i
        apply PathIntegrable.leftHalf_subpath gamma
        have hi := h (integralDyadicLeftSegmentIndex n i)
        rw [integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_castSucc,
          integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_succ] at hi
        exact hi
      have hrightLeaves : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
          ((gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1).subpath
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
        intro i
        apply PathIntegrable.rightHalf_subpath gamma
        have hi := h (integralDyadicRightSegmentIndex n i)
        rw [integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_castSucc,
          integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_succ] at hi
        exact hi
      have hleft := pathIntegrable_of_dyadicSubpaths n
        (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint) hleftLeaves
      have hright := pathIntegrable_of_dyadicSubpaths n
        (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1) hrightLeaves
      have htrans := hleft.trans hright
      rw [Path.midpointSubpaths_trans] at htrans
      simpa [PathIntegrable] using htrans

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_sum_dyadicSubpaths
statement:
private theorem pathIntegral_eq_sum_dyadicSubpaths :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma : Path a b)
      (_hleaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
        (gamma.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
          (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ))),
      pathIntegral f gamma =
        ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), pathIntegral f
          (gamma.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ))
proof:
| 0, f, a, b, gamma, _hleaf => by
      have hstart : integralDyadicMeshPoint 0 (0 : Fin 2) = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        norm_num [integralDyadicMeshPoint, unitIntervalMeshPoint]
      have hend : integralDyadicMeshPoint 0 (1 : Fin 2) = 1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        norm_num [integralDyadicMeshPoint, unitIntervalMeshPoint]
      let value : Fin (2 ^ 0) → ℂ := fun i ↦ pathIntegral f
        (gamma.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint 0 i.castSucc)
          (integralDyadicMeshPoint 0 i.succ))
      have hsum : (∑ i, value i) = value (0 : Fin 1) := by
        exact Fin.sum_univ_one value
      change pathIntegral f gamma = ∑ i, value i
      rw [hsum]
      dsimp [value]
      rw [hstart, hend, Path.subpath_zero_one]
      simp [pathIntegral]
  | n + 1, f, a, b, gamma, hleaf => by
      have hleftLeaves : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
          ((gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint).subpath
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
        intro i
        apply PathIntegrable.leftHalf_subpath gamma
        have hi := hleaf (integralDyadicLeftSegmentIndex n i)
        rw [integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_castSucc,
          integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_succ] at hi
        exact hi
      have hrightLeaves : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
          ((gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1).subpath
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
            (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
        intro i
        apply PathIntegrable.rightHalf_subpath gamma
        have hi := hleaf (integralDyadicRightSegmentIndex n i)
        rw [integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_castSucc,
          integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_succ] at hi
        exact hi
      have hleftIntegrable := pathIntegrable_of_dyadicSubpaths n
        (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint) hleftLeaves
      have hrightIntegrable := pathIntegrable_of_dyadicSubpaths n
        (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1) hrightLeaves
      rw [pathIntegral_eq_midpointSubpaths_add gamma hleftIntegrable hrightIntegrable,
        pathIntegral_eq_sum_dyadicSubpaths n
          (gamma.subpath 0 unitIntervalMidpoint) hleftLeaves,
        pathIntegral_eq_sum_dyadicSubpaths n
          (gamma.subpath unitIntervalMidpoint 1) hrightLeaves,
        sum_dyadic_succ_split]
      apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_castSucc,
          integralDyadicMeshPoint_left_succ]
        exact pathIntegral_leftHalf_subpath gamma _ _
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_castSucc,
          integralDyadicMeshPoint_right_succ]
        exact pathIntegral_rightHalf_subpath gamma _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_of_dyadicOuterBoundary
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_of_dyadicOuterBoundary
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} (gamma delta : Path a b) (n : ℕ)
    (hgammaLeaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (gamma.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (hdeltaLeaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (delta.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (bottom top left right : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℂ)
    (hbottom : ∀ i, bottom i = 0) (htop : ∀ i, top i = 0)
    (hleft : ∀ i, left i = pathIntegral f
      (gamma.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (hright : ∀ i, right i = pathIntegral f
      (delta.subpath (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
        (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)))
    (houter : (∑ i, (bottom i - top i)) + ∑ i, (right i - left i) = 0) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta
proof:
:= by
  have hgammaLeaf' : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (gamma.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
        (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
    simpa [integralDyadicMeshPoint] using hgammaLeaf
  have hdeltaLeaf' : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (delta.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
        (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
    simpa [integralDyadicMeshPoint] using hdeltaLeaf
  have hleft' : ∀ i, left i = pathIntegral f
      (gamma.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
        (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
    simpa [integralDyadicMeshPoint] using hleft
  have hright' : ∀ i, right i = pathIntegral f
      (delta.subpath (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.castSucc)
        (integralDyadicMeshPoint n i.succ)) := by
    simpa [integralDyadicMeshPoint] using hright
  simp only [hbottom, htop, sub_self, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add,
    hright', hleft', Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at houter
  rw [← pathIntegral_eq_sum_dyadicSubpaths n delta hdeltaLeaf',
    ← pathIntegral_eq_sum_dyadicSubpaths n gamma hgammaLeaf'] at houter
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp houter |>.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.AdmissiblePath.range_subset
statement:
theorem range_subset {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma : Path a b}
    (hgamma : AdmissiblePath f U gamma) : range gamma ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn _ hrange _ _ => exact hrange
  | trans hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      rw [Path.trans_range]
      exact union_subset ihgamma ihdelta

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.AdmissiblePath.pathIntegrable
statement:
theorem pathIntegrable {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma : Path a b}
    (hgamma : AdmissiblePath f U gamma) : PathIntegrable f gamma
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn _ _ hintegrable _ => exact hintegrable
  | trans hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta => exact ihgamma.trans ihdelta

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive_of_admissiblePath
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive_of_admissiblePath
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma : Path a b}
    (hgamma : AdmissiblePath f U gamma) (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = g b - g a
proof:
:= by
  induction hgamma with
  | of_contDiffOn gamma hrange hintegrable hregular =>
      rw [pathIntegral, curveIntegral_def]
      have hmaps : MapsTo gamma.extend (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) U := by
        intro t ht
        exact hrange ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, by rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]⟩
      have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (gamma.extend t)) (Icc 0 1) := by
        exact ContinuousOn.comp
          (fun z hz ↦ (hg z hz).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
          hregular.continuousOn hmaps
      have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (gamma.extend t))
            (curveIntegralFun (scalarOneForm f) gamma t) t := by
        intro t ht
        have hinner : DifferentiableAt ℝ gamma.extend t :=
          ((hregular.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).mono Ioo_subset_Icc_self t ht).differentiableAt
            (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
        have houter := hg _ (hmaps ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩)
        have hInhds : I ∈ nhds t := by
          exact mem_of_superset (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2) Ioo_subset_Icc_self
        simpa [curveIntegralFun_def, derivWithin_of_mem_nhds hInhds,
          scalarOneForm, Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
          (houter.comp_hasFDerivAt t hinner.hasFDerivAt).hasDerivAt
      simpa using intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le
        zero_le_one hcont hderiv hintegrable
  | trans hgamma hdelta ihgamma ihdelta =>
      rw [pathIntegral_trans f _ _ hgamma.pathIntegrable hdelta.pathIntegrable,
        ihgamma, ihdelta]
      abel

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegralIndependentOn_of_primitive
statement:
theorem pathIntegralIndependentOn_of_primitive
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} (hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z) :
    PathIntegralIndependentOn f U
proof:
:= by
  intro a b gamma delta hgamma hdelta
  rw [pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive_of_admissiblePath hgamma hg,
    pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive_of_admissiblePath hdelta hg]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.exists_primitive_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hpaths : ∀ z ∈ U, ∃ gamma : Path c z, AdmissiblePath f U gamma)
    (hind : PathIntegralIndependentOn f U) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : ∀ z : U, {gamma : Path c z.1 // AdmissiblePath f U gamma} := fun z ↦
    ⟨Classical.choose (hpaths z z.property), Classical.choose_spec (hpaths z z.property)⟩
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦ if hz : z ∈ U then pathIntegral f (P ⟨z, hz⟩).1 else 0
  refine ⟨g, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU z hz
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn hU).mp hf
  have hωball : ContinuousOn (scalarOneForm f) (ball z r) := by
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ ℂ ℂ
      (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)).continuous.comp_continuousOn (hdiff.continuousOn.mono hball)
  have hsegDeriv : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ pathIntegral f (.segment z w)) (f z) z := by
    have hF := HasFDerivWithinAt.curveIntegral_segment_source
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (convex_ball z r) hωball (mem_ball_self hr)
    have hFA := hF.hasFDerivAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_self hr))
    simpa [pathIntegral, scalarOneForm] using hFA.hasDerivAt
  have heq : g =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w ↦ g z + pathIntegral f (.segment z w) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z hr] with w hw
    have hwU : w ∈ U := hball hw
    have hsegRange : range (Path.segment z w) ⊆ U := by
      rintro q ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact hball ((convex_ball z r).lineMap_mem (mem_ball_self hr) hw t.2)
    have hsegInt : PathIntegrable f (.segment z w) := by
      rw [PathIntegrable, curveIntegrable_segment]
      have hline : MapsTo (lineMap z w) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ball z r) :=
        fun _ ht ↦ (convex_ball z r).lineMap_mem (mem_ball_self hr) hw ht
      have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w - z) * f (lineMap z w t)) (Icc 0 1) := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          ((hdiff.continuousOn.mono hball).comp lineMap_continuous.continuousOn hline).const_mul
            (w - z)
      have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w - z) * f (lineMap z w t)) volume 0 1 :=
        (show ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w - z) * f (lineMap z w t)) [[0, 1]] by
          simpa [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using hcont).intervalIntegrable
      simpa [scalarOneForm] using hi
    have hsegRegular : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Path.segment z w).extend (Icc 0 1) := by
      apply (AffineMap.contDiff_lineMap z w).contDiffOn.congr
      intro t ht
      rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
      rfl
    have hPz := (P ⟨z, hz⟩).property
    have hPw := (P ⟨w, hwU⟩).property
    have hseg : AdmissiblePath f U (.segment z w) :=
      .of_contDiffOn _ hsegRange hsegInt hsegRegular
    have htrans : AdmissiblePath f U ((P ⟨z, hz⟩).1.trans (.segment z w)) :=
      .trans hPz hseg
    have hi := hind (P ⟨w, hwU⟩).1 ((P ⟨z, hz⟩).1.trans (.segment z w)) hPw htrans
    rw [pathIntegral_trans f _ _ hPz.pathIntegrable hsegInt] at hi
    simpa [g, hz, hwU] using hi
  exact (hsegDeriv.const_add (g z)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.isolatedSingularity_classification
statement:
theorem isolatedSingularity_classification
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ} (h : IsolatedSingularityAtTextbook f a) :
    RemovableSingularityAtTextbook f a ∨ PoleAtTextbook f a ∨
      EssentialSingularityAtTextbook f a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr : RemovableSingularityAtTextbook f a
  · exact Or.inl hr
  by_cases hp : PoleAtTextbook f a
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hp)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h, hr, hp⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.removableSingularityAtTextbook_iff_order_nonneg
statement:
theorem removableSingularityAtTextbook_iff_order_nonneg
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ} (hiso : IsolatedSingularityAtTextbook f a)
    (hf : MeromorphicAt f a) :
    RemovableSingularityAtTextbook f a ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [RemovableSingularityAtTextbook, and_iff_right hiso]
  exact tendsto_nhds_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg hf

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.poleAtTextbook_iff_order_neg
statement:
theorem poleAtTextbook_iff_order_neg
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ} (hiso : IsolatedSingularityAtTextbook f a)
    (hf : MeromorphicAt f a) :
    PoleAtTextbook f a ↔ meromorphicOrderAt f a < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [PoleAtTextbook, and_iff_right hiso]
  exact tendsto_cobounded_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_neg hf

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.meromorphicAt_not_essential
statement:
theorem meromorphicAt_not_essential
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ} (hf : MeromorphicAt f a) :
    ¬ EssentialSingularityAtTextbook f a
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hiso, hr, hp⟩
  rcases lt_or_ge (meromorphicOrderAt f a) 0 with ho | ho
  · exact hp ((poleAtTextbook_iff_order_neg hiso hf).2 ho)
  · exact hr ((removableSingularityAtTextbook_iff_order_nonneg hiso hf).2 ho)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cauchyRiemann_iff_realFDeriv_map_I
statement:
theorem cauchyRiemann_iff_realFDeriv_map_I (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    SatisfiesCauchyRiemannAt f z ↔
      fderiv ℝ f z I = I * fderiv ℝ f z 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨huxvy, huyvx⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa [realPartPartialY, imaginaryPartPartialX] using huyvx
    · simpa [realPartPartialX, imaginaryPartPartialY] using huxvy.symm
  · intro h
    constructor
    · have him := congrArg Complex.im h
      simpa [realPartPartialX, imaginaryPartPartialY] using him.symm
    · have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      simpa [realPartPartialY, imaginaryPartPartialX] using hre

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.complexDifferentiableAt_cauchyRiemann
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : DifferentiableAt ℂ f z :=
    complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp hf
  obtain ⟨hreal, hmap⟩ := differentiableAt_complex_iff_differentiableAt_real.mp hf'
  refine ⟨hreal, (cauchyRiemann_iff_realFDeriv_map_I f z).mpr ?_⟩
  simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hmap

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.complexDifferentiableAt_of_realDifferentiableAt_cauchyRiemann
statement:
theorem complexDifferentiableAt_of_realDifferentiableAt_cauchyRiemann
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hreal : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z)
    (hcr : SatisfiesCauchyRiemannAt f z) :
    ComplexDifferentiableAtTextbook f z
proof:
:= by
  apply complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mpr
  apply differentiableAt_complex_iff_differentiableAt_real.mpr
  exact ⟨hreal, by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (cauchyRiemann_iff_realFDeriv_map_I f z).mp hcr⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.hasComplexDerivAt_of_realDifferentiableAt_cauchyRiemann
statement:
theorem hasComplexDerivAt_of_realDifferentiableAt_cauchyRiemann
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hreal : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z)
    (hcr : SatisfiesCauchyRiemannAt f z) :
    HasDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f z 1) z
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : fderiv ℝ f z I = I • fderiv ℝ f z 1 := by
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (cauchyRiemann_iff_realFDeriv_map_I f z).mp hcr
  simpa using complexOfReal_hasDerivAt hreal hmap

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.admissiblePath_segment_of_ball
statement:
private theorem admissiblePath_segment_of_ball
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {center z w : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hball : ball center r ⊆ U)
    (hz : z ∈ ball center r) (hw : w ∈ ball center r) :
    AdmissiblePath f U (.segment z w)
proof:
:= by
  have hline : MapsTo (lineMap z w) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ball center r) :=
    fun _ ht ↦ (convex_ball center r).lineMap_mem hz hw ht
  apply AdmissiblePath.of_contDiffOn
  · rintro q ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact hball (hline t.2)
  · rw [PathIntegrable, curveIntegrable_segment]
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w - z) * f (lineMap z w t)) (Icc 0 1) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        ((hf.mono hball).comp lineMap_continuous.continuousOn hline).const_mul (w - z)
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w - z) * f (lineMap z w t)) volume 0 1 :=
      (show ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w - z) * f (lineMap z w t)) [[0, 1]] by
        simpa [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using hcont).intervalIntegrable
    simpa [scalarOneForm] using hi
  · apply (AffineMap.contDiff_lineMap z w).contDiffOn.congr
    intro t ht
    rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.exists_admissiblePath_of_isPreconnected
statement:
theorem exists_admissiblePath_of_isPreconnected
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hc : c ∈ U)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected U) :
    ∀ z ∈ U, ∃ gamma : Path c z, AdmissiblePath f U gamma
proof:
:= by
  let R : Set ℂ := {z | ∃ gamma : Path c z, AdmissiblePath f U gamma}
  have hcR : c ∈ R := by
    refine ⟨.refl c, ?_⟩
    apply AdmissiblePath.of_contDiffOn
    · simpa using hc
    · simp [PathIntegrable]
    · apply (show ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun _ : ℝ ↦ c) (Icc 0 1) by fun_prop).congr
      intro t ht
      rw [Path.extend_apply _ ht]
      rfl
  have hRU : R ⊆ U := by
    rintro z ⟨gamma, hgamma⟩
    exact hgamma.range_subset ⟨1, gamma.target⟩
  have hRopen : IsOpen R := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    rintro z ⟨gamma, hgamma⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU z (hRU ⟨gamma, hgamma⟩)
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
    have hseg := admissiblePath_segment_of_ball hf hball (mem_ball_self hr) hw
    refine ⟨gamma.trans (.segment z w), ?_⟩
    exact hgamma.trans hseg
  let V : Set ℂ := U \ R
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    rintro z ⟨hzU, hzR⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU z hzU
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun w hw ↦ ⟨hball hw, ?_⟩⟩
    intro hwR
    rcases hwR with ⟨gamma, hgamma⟩
    have hseg := admissiblePath_segment_of_ball hf hball hw (mem_ball_self hr)
    apply hzR
    refine ⟨gamma.trans (.segment w z), ?_⟩
    exact hgamma.trans hseg
  have hUR : U ⊆ R := by
    apply hconn.subset_left_of_subset_union hRopen hVopen
    · exact disjoint_sdiff_right
    · intro z hz
      by_cases hzR : z ∈ R
      · exact Or.inl hzR
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hz, hzR⟩
    · exact ⟨c, hc, hcR⟩
  intro z hz
  exact hUR hz

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.exists_primitive_of_isPreconnected_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_of_isPreconnected_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {c : ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U) (hc : c ∈ U)
    (hconn : IsPreconnected U) (hind : PathIntegralIndependentOn f U) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn hU).mp hf
  exact exists_primitive_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn hU hf
    (exists_admissiblePath_of_isPreconnected hU hdiff.continuousOn hc hconn) hind

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.exists_primitive_of_isSimplyConnected_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_of_isSimplyConnected_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hconn : IsSimplyConnected U) (hind : PathIntegralIndependentOn f U) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hconn.nonempty
  exact exists_primitive_of_isPreconnected_of_pathIntegralIndependentOn
    hU hf hc hconn.isPathConnected.isConnected.isPreconnected hind

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_add
statement:
theorem windingNumber_add (γ δ : Cycle) (w : ℂ) :
    windingNumber (γ + δ) w = windingNumber γ w + windingNumber δ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [windingNumber, cycleIntegral_add, mul_add]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_smul
statement:
theorem windingNumber_smul (n : ℤ) (γ : Cycle) (w : ℂ) :
    windingNumber (n • γ) w = n • windingNumber γ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [windingNumber, map_smul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_neg
statement: theorem windingNumber_neg (γ : Cycle) (w : ℂ) : windingNumber (-γ) w = -windingNumber γ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [windingNumber, map_neg]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_zero
statement: theorem windingNumber_zero (w : ℂ) : windingNumber (0 : Cycle) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [windingNumber]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_sub
statement:
theorem windingNumber_sub (γ δ : Cycle) (w : ℂ) :
    windingNumber (γ - δ) w = windingNumber γ w - windingNumber δ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [windingNumber, map_sub, mul_sub]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem windingNumber_single (c : ClosedPath) (n : ℤ) (w : ℂ) :
    windingNumber (Finsupp.single c n) w =
      n • ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ * pathIntegral (fun z => (z - w)⁻¹) c.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [windingNumber, cycleIntegral_single, banachPathIntegral_complex_eq_pathIntegral,
    zsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.isNullHomologousIn_iff
statement:
theorem isNullHomologousIn_iff (γ : Cycle) (U : Set ℂ) :
    IsNullHomologousIn γ U ↔ γ.SupportedIn U ∧ ∀ w, w ∉ U → windingNumber γ w = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.isNullHomologousIn_zero
statement: theorem isNullHomologousIn_zero (U : Set ℂ) : IsNullHomologousIn (0 : Cycle) U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c hc
    rw [Finsupp.support_zero] at hc
    exact absurd hc (Finset.notMem_empty c)
  · intro w _
    exact windingNumber_zero w

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.isNullHomologousIn_add
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hγ.1.add hδ.1, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  rw [windingNumber_add, hγ.2 w hw, hδ.2 w hw, add_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.isHomologousIn_iff_windingNumber_eq
statement:
theorem isHomologousIn_iff_windingNumber_eq (γ₁ γ₂ : Cycle) (U : Set ℂ) :
    IsHomologousIn γ₁ γ₂ U ↔
      γ₁.SupportedIn U ∧ γ₂.SupportedIn U ∧
        ∀ w : ℂ, w ∉ U → windingNumber γ₁ w = windingNumber γ₂ w
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_inv_sub
statement:
theorem holomorphicOnTextbook_inv_sub {U : Set ℂ} {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∉ U) :
    HolomorphicOnTextbook (fun z : ℂ => (z - w)⁻¹) U
proof:
:= by
  rw [holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_forall_differentiableAt]
  intro z hz
  have hzw : z - w ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hw (h ▸ hz))
  exact (differentiableAt_id.sub_const w).inv hzw

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic
    {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (γ : Cycle) (hC1 : γ.PiecewiseC1)
    (hnull : ∀ c ∈ γ.support, ∃ F : c.2.Homotopy (Path.refl c.1),
      ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, pathHomotopySquare F z ∈ U) :
    cycleIntegral f γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_piece_eq_zero
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hnull c hc
  rw [banachPathIntegral_complex_eq_pathIntegral]
  exact pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopyWithin hU hf (hC1 c hc) F hF

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.windingNumber_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem windingNumber_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic
    {U : Set ℂ} {w : ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hw : w ∉ U)
    (γ : Cycle) (hC1 : γ.PiecewiseC1)
    (hnull : ∀ c ∈ γ.support, ∃ F : c.2.Homotopy (Path.refl c.1),
      ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, pathHomotopySquare F z ∈ U) :
    windingNumber γ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := cycleIntegral_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic hU
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_inv_sub hw) γ hC1 hnull
  rw [windingNumber, hzero, mul_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.isNullHomologousIn_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem isNullHomologousIn_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (γ : Cycle) (hC1 : γ.PiecewiseC1) (hUγ : γ.SupportedIn U)
    (hnull : ∀ c ∈ γ.support, ∃ F : c.2.Homotopy (Path.refl c.1),
      ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, pathHomotopySquare F z ∈ U) :
    IsNullHomologousIn γ U
proof:
:=
  ⟨hUγ, fun _ hw => windingNumber_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopic hU hw γ hC1 hnull⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt
statement:
theorem complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} :
    ComplexDifferentiableAtTextbook f z ↔ DifferentiableAt ℂ f z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    have hfun : (fun w ↦ (f w - f z) / (w - z)) = slope f z :=
      funext fun w ↦ (slope_def_field f z w).symm
    rw [hfun] at hL
    exact (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mpr hL).differentiableAt
  · intro hf
    have hfun : (fun w ↦ (f w - f z) / (w - z)) = slope f z :=
      funext fun w ↦ (slope_def_field f z w).symm
    refine ⟨deriv f z, ?_⟩
    rw [hfun]
    exact hf.hasDerivAt.tendsto_slope

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_forall_differentiableAt
statement:
theorem holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_forall_differentiableAt {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} :
    HolomorphicOnTextbook f U ↔ ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf z hz
    exact complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hf z hz)
  · intro hf z hz
    exact complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mpr (hf z hz)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U ↔ DifferentiableOn ℂ f U
proof:
:= by
  rw [holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_forall_differentiableAt]
  constructor
  · intro hf z hz
    exact (hf z hz).differentiableWithinAt
  · intro hf z hz
    exact (hf z hz).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_add
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mpr
  exact (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hf z hz)).add
    (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hg z hz))

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mpr
  exact (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hf z hz)).mul
    (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hg z hz))

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_div
statement:
theorem holomorphicOnTextbook_div {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U) (hg : HolomorphicOnTextbook g U)
    (hg0 : ∀ z ∈ U, g z ≠ 0) :
    HolomorphicOnTextbook (fun z ↦ f z / g z) U
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mpr
  exact (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hf z hz)).div
    (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hg z hz)) (hg0 z hz)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.holomorphicOnTextbook_comp
statement:
theorem holomorphicOnTextbook_comp {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {U V : Set ℂ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f V) (hg : HolomorphicOnTextbook g U)
    (hmap : MapsTo g U V) :
    HolomorphicOnTextbook (f ∘ g) U
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mpr
  exact (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hf (g z) (hmap hz))).comp z
    (complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hg z hz))

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball
proof:
:= by
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mp hf
  simpa [taylorCoefficient, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
    Complex.hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball hd hz

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.taylorExpansion_eq_on_ball
proof:
:= by
  rw [taylorExpansion, complexPowerSeries_eq_tsum]
  exact (hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball hf hz).tsum_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.taylorCoefficient_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem taylorCoefficient_eq_circleIntegral {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f (Metric.closedBall c R)) (hR : 0 < R) (n : ℕ) :
    taylorCoefficient f c n =
      (∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)) / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cauchy_integral_formula_iteratedDeriv hf hR n]
  simp only [taylorCoefficient]
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.powerSeriesCoefficients_unique
statement:
theorem powerSeriesCoefficients_unique {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {a b : ℕ → ℂ}
    (ha : HasFPowerSeriesAt f (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a) c)
    (hb : HasFPowerSeriesAt f (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ b) c) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hseries := ha.eq_formalMultilinearSeries hb
  funext n
  have hn := congrArg (fun p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ ↦ p.coeff n) hseries
  simpa using hn

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.logDeriv_sub_const
statement:
theorem logDeriv_sub_const (c z : ℂ) :
    logDeriv (fun w : ℂ => w - c) z = (z - c)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [logDeriv]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.argumentPrinciple_linear
statement:
theorem argumentPrinciple_linear (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0) :
    circleArgumentIntegral (fun z => z - c) c R = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleArgumentIntegral]
  simp_rw [logDeriv_sub_const]
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_sub_center_inv c hR]
  field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.rouche_linear_constant
statement:
theorem rouche_linear_constant {c b : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hb : ‖b‖ < R) :
    (∀ z ∈ sphere c R, ‖b‖ < ‖z - c‖) ∧
      (c - b ∈ ball c R) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, (z - c) + b = 0 ↔ z = c - b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    simpa [mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz] using hb
  constructor
  · simpa [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_neg] using hb
  · intro z
    constructor <;> intro h
    · linear_combination h
    · rw [h]
      ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_of_piecewiseC1_homotopyWithin
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_of_piecewiseC1_homotopyWithin
    {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma delta : Path a b}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma) (hdelta : Path.PiecewiseC1 delta)
    (F : gamma.Homotopy delta)
    (hF : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, pathHomotopySquare F z ∈ U) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn hU).mp hf
  obtain ⟨ngamma, hgammaDepth⟩ := hgamma.exists_dyadicC1AtDepth
  obtain ⟨ndelta, hdeltaDepth⟩ := hdelta.exists_dyadicC1AtDepth
  let minimumDepth := max ngamma ndelta
  have hr : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, ∃ ε > 0,
      Metric.ball (pathHomotopySquare F z) ε ⊆ U := by
    intro z
    exact Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hU.mem_nhds (hF z))
  let radius : unitInterval × unitInterval → ℝ :=
    fun z ↦ Classical.choose (hr z)
  have hradius_pos : ∀ z, 0 < radius z :=
    fun z ↦ (Classical.choose_spec (hr z)).1
  have hradius_sub : ∀ z,
      Metric.ball (pathHomotopySquare F z) (radius z) ⊆ U :=
    fun z ↦ (Classical.choose_spec (hr z)).2
  let W : (unitInterval × unitInterval) → Set ℂ :=
    fun z ↦ Metric.ball (pathHomotopySquare F z) (radius z)
  have hWopen : ∀ z, IsOpen (W z) := fun z ↦ Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hWcover : ∀ z, ∃ k, pathHomotopySquare F z ∈ W k := by
    intro z
    exact ⟨z, Metric.mem_ball_self (hradius_pos z)⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hminimum, label, hcell⟩ :=
    exists_indexedOpenCoverSquareSubdivisionData_atLeastDepth
      (pathHomotopySquare F) W hWopen hWcover minimumDepth
  have hgammaDepthN : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth gamma n :=
    hgammaDepth.mono (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hminimum)
  have hdeltaDepthN : Path.DyadicC1AtDepth delta n :=
    hdeltaDepth.mono (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hminimum)
  let R : FiniteRawOpenPathGrid ℂ :=
    finiteRawOpenPathGrid_of_squareSubdivisionData
      (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n) (by positivity) W label hWopen hcell
      (pathHomotopySquare_horizontal_zero_piecewiseC1 F (2 ^ n) (by positivity))
      (pathHomotopySquare_horizontal_last_piecewiseC1 F (2 ^ n) (by positivity))
      (hgammaDepthN.pathHomotopySquare_vertical_zero_piecewiseC1 F)
      (hdeltaDepthN.pathHomotopySquare_vertical_last_piecewiseC1 F)
  have hexact : ∀ i j, Complex.IsExactOn f (R.cellSet i j) := by
    intro i j
    exact (hdiff.mono (hradius_sub (label i j))).isExactOn_ball
  have houter := finiteRawOpenPathGrid_outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero R hexact
  let mesh := fun (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) ↦
    unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i
  have hgammaLeaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (gamma.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)) := by
    intro i
    have hpiece : Path.PiecewiseC1
        (gamma.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)) := by
      exact hgammaDepthN.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1 i
    apply (admissiblePath_of_piecewiseC1 hpiece _ hdiff.continuousOn).pathIntegrable
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz
    simpa [mesh, Path.subpath] using hF ((0 : unitInterval),
      Set.Icc.convexComb (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ) t)
  have hdeltaLeaf : ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ n), PathIntegrable f
      (delta.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)) := by
    intro i
    have hpiece : Path.PiecewiseC1
        (delta.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)) := by
      exact hdeltaDepthN.dyadicSegment_piecewiseC1 i
    apply (admissiblePath_of_piecewiseC1 hpiece _ hdiff.continuousOn).pathIntegrable
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz
    simpa [mesh, Path.subpath] using hF ((1 : unitInterval),
      Set.Icc.convexComb (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ) t)
  let bottom : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℂ := fun i ↦
    pathIntegral f (squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
      (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i 0)
  let top : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℂ := fun i ↦
    pathIntegral f (squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
      (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i (Fin.last (2 ^ n)))
  let left : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℂ := fun i ↦
    pathIntegral f (squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
      (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i)
  let right : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℂ := fun i ↦
    pathIntegral f (squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
      (2 ^ n) (by positivity) (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i)
  apply pathIntegral_eq_of_dyadicOuterBoundary gamma delta n hgammaLeaf hdeltaLeaf
      bottom top left right
  · intro i
    have hsource : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) i.castSucc 0 = a := by simp [squareGridVertex]
    have htarget : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) i.succ 0 = a := by simp [squareGridVertex]
    have heq : ((Path.refl a).cast hsource htarget) =
        squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
          (by positivity) i 0 := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      rw [Path.cast_coe]
      exact (squareGridHorizontalEdge_pathHomotopySquare_bottom F
        (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i t).symm
    dsimp [bottom]
    calc
      pathIntegral f (squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
          (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i 0) =
          pathIntegral f ((Path.refl a).cast hsource htarget) :=
        congrArg (pathIntegral f) heq.symm
      _ = 0 := by simp [pathIntegral]
  · intro i
    have hsource : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) i.castSucc (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) = b := by
      simp [squareGridVertex]
    have htarget : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) i.succ (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) = b := by
      simp [squareGridVertex]
    have heq : ((Path.refl b).cast hsource htarget) =
        squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
          (by positivity) i (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      rw [Path.cast_coe]
      exact (squareGridHorizontalEdge_pathHomotopySquare_top F
        (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i t).symm
    dsimp [top]
    calc
      pathIntegral f (squareGridHorizontalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
          (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i (Fin.last (2 ^ n))) =
          pathIntegral f ((Path.refl b).cast hsource htarget) :=
        congrArg (pathIntegral f) heq.symm
      _ = 0 := by simp [pathIntegral]
  · intro i
    have hsource : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) 0 i.castSucc = gamma (mesh i.castSucc) := by
      simp [squareGridVertex, mesh]
    have htarget : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) 0 i.succ = gamma (mesh i.succ) := by
      simp [squareGridVertex, mesh]
    have heq : ((gamma.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)).cast
        hsource htarget) = squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
          (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      rw [Path.cast_coe]
      exact (squareGridVerticalEdge_pathHomotopySquare_left F
        (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i t).symm
    dsimp [left]
    calc
      pathIntegral f (squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
          (2 ^ n) (by positivity) 0 i) =
          pathIntegral f ((gamma.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)).cast
            hsource htarget) := congrArg (pathIntegral f) heq.symm
      _ = pathIntegral f (gamma.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)) := by
        simp [pathIntegral]
      _ = pathIntegral f (gamma.subpath
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)) := by
        rfl
  · intro i
    have hsource : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i.castSucc = delta (mesh i.castSucc) := by
      simp [squareGridVertex, mesh]
    have htarget : squareGridVertex (pathHomotopySquare F) (2 ^ n)
        (by positivity) (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i.succ = delta (mesh i.succ) := by
      simp [squareGridVertex, mesh]
    have heq : ((delta.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)).cast
        hsource htarget) = squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
          (2 ^ n) (by positivity) (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      rw [Path.cast_coe]
      exact (squareGridVerticalEdge_pathHomotopySquare_right F
        (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i t).symm
    dsimp [right]
    calc
      pathIntegral f (squareGridVerticalEdge (pathHomotopySquare F)
          (2 ^ n) (by positivity) (Fin.last (2 ^ n)) i) =
          pathIntegral f ((delta.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)).cast
            hsource htarget) := congrArg (pathIntegral f) heq.symm
      _ = pathIntegral f (delta.subpath (mesh i.castSucc) (mesh i.succ)) := by
        simp [pathIntegral]
      _ = pathIntegral f (delta.subpath
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.castSucc)
          (unitIntervalMeshPoint (2 ^ n) (by positivity) i.succ)) := by
        rfl
  · dsimp only [bottom, top, left, right]
    dsimp only [R, finiteRawOpenPathGrid_of_squareSubdivisionData] at houter
    exact houter

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopyWithin
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_piecewiseC1_nullHomotopyWithin
    {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a : ℂ} {gamma : Path a a}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma) (F : gamma.Homotopy (Path.refl a))
    (hF : ∀ z : unitInterval × unitInterval, pathHomotopySquare F z ∈ U) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_eq_of_piecewiseC1_homotopyWithin hU hf hgamma
    (Path.piecewiseC1_refl a) F hF]
  simp [pathIntegral]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.liouville
statement:
theorem liouville {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f Set.univ)
    (hbounded : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ C) :
    ∃ b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, f z = b
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℂ f := by
    intro z
    exact complexDifferentiableAtTextbook_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hf z (Set.mem_univ z))
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbounded
  apply hd.exists_const_forall_eq_of_bounded
  rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
  exact ⟨C, by rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩; exact hC z⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.liouville_eq
statement:
theorem liouville_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f Set.univ)
    (hbounded : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖f z‖ ≤ C) (z w : ℂ) :
    f z = f w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := liouville hf hbounded
  rw [hb z, hb w]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.hasFDerivAt_smoothHomotopyOneForm
proof:
:= by
  simpa [smoothHomotopyOneForm, scalarOneFormFDeriv] using
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ ℂ ℂ
      (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)).hasFDerivAt.comp z hf.hasDerivAt.hasFDerivAt).restrictScalars ℝ

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.scalarOneFormFDeriv_symmetric
statement:
private theorem scalarOneFormFDeriv_symmetric (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z u v : ℂ) :
    scalarOneFormFDeriv f z u v = scalarOneFormFDeriv f z v u
proof:
:= by
  change v * (u * deriv f z) = u * (v * deriv f z)
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_of_C2HomotopicWithin
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_of_C2HomotopicWithin
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma delta : Path a b}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hhom : C2HomotopicWithin U gamma delta) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = pathIntegral f delta
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hFU, hF⟩ := hhom
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn hU).mp hf
  let T : Set ℂ := range F
  have hTU : T ⊆ U := by
    rintro x ⟨⟨s, t⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hFU s t
  have hω : ∀ x ∈ T,
      HasFDerivWithinAt (smoothHomotopyOneForm f) (scalarOneFormFDeriv f x) T x :=
    fun x hx ↦ (hasFDerivAt_smoothHomotopyOneForm
      (hdiff.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hTU hx)))).hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hTclosed : IsClosed T := (isCompact_range F.continuous).isClosed
  have hωc : ContinuousOn (smoothHomotopyOneForm f) (closure T) := by
    rw [hTclosed.closure_eq]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ ℂ ℂ (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      (hdiff.continuousOn.mono hTU)
  have hmain := F.toHomotopy.curveIntegral_add_curveIntegral_eq_of_hasFDerivWithinAt
    (t := T) (dω := scalarOneFormFDeriv f)
    (fun s _ t _ ↦ mem_range_self (s, t)) hω hωc
    (fun x _ u _ v _ ↦ scalarOneFormFDeriv_symmetric f x u v) hF
  have hside0 : F.toHomotopy.evalAt 0 =
      (Path.refl a).cast gamma.source delta.source := by
    ext t
    exact F.source t
  have hside1 : F.toHomotopy.evalAt 1 =
      (Path.refl b).cast gamma.target delta.target := by
    ext t
    exact F.target t
  rw [hside0, hside1, curveIntegral_cast, curveIntegral_cast, curveIntegral_refl,
    curveIntegral_refl, add_zero] at hmain
  simpa [pathIntegral, scalarOneForm, smoothHomotopyOneForm] using hmain

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_C2NullHomotopicWithin
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_eq_zero_of_C2NullHomotopicWithin
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a : ℂ} {gamma : Path a a}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (hhom : C2HomotopicWithin U gamma (.refl a)) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_eq_of_C2HomotopicWithin hU hf hhom]
  simp [pathIntegral]

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachOneForm_apply
statement:

theorem banachOneForm_apply (f : ℂ → F) (z v : ℂ) : banachOneForm f z v = v • f z
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_complex_eq_pathIntegral
statement:
@[simp]
theorem banachPathIntegral_complex_eq_pathIntegral (f : ℂ → ℂ) {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) :
    banachPathIntegral (F := ℂ) f γ = pathIntegral f γ
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_zero
statement:
theorem banachPathIntegral_zero {a b : ℂ} (γ : Path a b) :
    banachPathIntegral (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : F)) γ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : banachOneForm (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : F)) = 0 := by
    funext z
    ext
    simp [banachOneForm]
  show curveIntegral (banachOneForm (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : F))) γ = 0
  rw [h]
  exact curveIntegral_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_add
statement:
theorem banachPathIntegral_add {a b : ℂ} {f g : ℂ → F} {γ : Path a b}
    (hf : BanachPathIntegrable f γ) (hg : BanachPathIntegrable g γ) :
    banachPathIntegral (fun z => f z + g z) γ =
      banachPathIntegral f γ + banachPathIntegral g γ
proof:
:= by
  have h : banachOneForm (fun z => f z + g z) = banachOneForm f + banachOneForm g := by
    funext z
    ext
    simp [banachOneForm, smul_add]
  have hf' : CurveIntegrable (banachOneForm f) γ := hf
  have hg' : CurveIntegrable (banachOneForm g) γ := hg
  show curveIntegral (banachOneForm (fun z => f z + g z)) γ =
    curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) γ + curveIntegral (banachOneForm g) γ
  rw [h]
  exact curveIntegral_add hf' hg'

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_smul
statement:
theorem banachPathIntegral_smul {a b : ℂ} (c : ℂ) (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Path a b) :
    banachPathIntegral (fun z => c • f z) γ = c • banachPathIntegral f γ
proof:
:= by
  have h : banachOneForm (fun z => c • f z) = c • banachOneForm f := by
    funext z
    ext
    simp [banachOneForm, smul_comm]
  show curveIntegral (banachOneForm (fun z => c • f z)) γ =
    c • curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) γ
  rw [h]
  exact curveIntegral_smul (𝕝 := ℂ)

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_neg
statement:
theorem banachPathIntegral_neg {a b : ℂ} (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Path a b) :
    banachPathIntegral (fun z => -f z) γ = -banachPathIntegral f γ
proof:
:= by
  have h : banachOneForm (fun z => -f z) = -banachOneForm f := by
    funext z
    ext
    simp [banachOneForm]
  show curveIntegral (banachOneForm (fun z => -f z)) γ = -curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) γ
  rw [h]
  exact curveIntegral_neg

protected theorem BanachPathIntegrable.symm {a b : ℂ} {f : ℂ → F} {γ : Path a b}

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.BanachPathIntegrable.trans

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_trans
statement:
theorem banachPathIntegral_trans {a b c : ℂ} (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Path a b) (δ : Path b c)
    (hγ : BanachPathIntegrable f γ) (hδ : BanachPathIntegrable f δ) :
    banachPathIntegral f (γ.trans δ) = banachPathIntegral f γ + banachPathIntegral f δ
proof:
:= by
  have hγ' : CurveIntegrable (banachOneForm f) γ := hγ
  have hδ' : CurveIntegrable (banachOneForm f) δ := hδ
  show curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) (γ.trans δ) =
    curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) γ + curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) δ
  exact curveIntegral_trans hγ' hδ'

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.banachPathIntegral_cast
statement:
theorem banachPathIntegral_cast {a b c d : ℂ} (f : ℂ → F) (γ : Path a b) (hc : c = a)
    (hd : d = b) :
    banachPathIntegral f (γ.cast hc hd) = banachPathIntegral f γ
proof:
:= by
  show curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) (γ.cast hc hd) = curveIntegral (banachOneForm f) γ
  exact curveIntegral_cast (banachOneForm f) γ hc hd

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitiveWithin_convex
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitiveWithin_convex
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {T : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ}
    (hT : Convex ℝ T) (ha : a ∈ T) (hb : b ∈ T)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f T)
    (hg : ∀ z ∈ T, HasDerivWithinAt g (f z) T z) :
    pathIntegral f (.segment a b) = g b - g a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_segment]
  have hline : MapsTo (lineMap a b) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) T :=
    fun _ ht ↦ hT.lineMap_mem ha hb ht
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (lineMap a b t)) (Icc 0 1) := by
    exact ContinuousOn.comp
      (fun z hz ↦ (hg z hz).continuousWithinAt) lineMap_continuous.continuousOn hline
  have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ g (lineMap a b t)) ((b - a) * f (lineMap a b t)) t := by
    intro t ht
    have htT : lineMap a b t ∈ T := hline ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩
    have hevent : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in nhds t, lineMap a b s ∈ T := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with s hs
      exact hline ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
    simpa [Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
      (hg _ htT).comp_hasDerivAt t hasDerivAt_lineMap hevent
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ (b - a) * f (lineMap a b t)) volume 0 1 := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (b - a) * f (lineMap a b t)) (Icc 0 1) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        (ContinuousOn.comp hf lineMap_continuous.continuousOn hline).const_mul (b - a)
    exact (show ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ (b - a) * f (lineMap a b t)) [[0, 1]] by
      simpa [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] using hc).intervalIntegrable
  simpa using intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le zero_le_one hcont hderiv hint

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_holomorphicOnTextbook
statement:
theorem pathIntegral_triangle_eq_zero_of_holomorphicOnTextbook
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b c : ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : HolomorphicOnTextbook f U)
    (htriangle : convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ) ⊆ U) :
    pathIntegral f (.segment a b) + pathIntegral f (.segment b c) +
      pathIntegral f (.segment c a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let T : Set ℂ := convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ)
  have hT : Convex ℝ T := convex_convexHull ℝ _
  have ha : a ∈ T := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    simp
  have hb : b ∈ T := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    simp
  have hc : c ∈ T := by
    apply subset_convexHull ℝ
    simp
  have hdiffU : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U :=
    (holomorphicOnTextbook_iff_differentiableOn hU).mp hf
  have hdiffT : DifferentiableOn ℂ f T := hdiffU.mono htriangle
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hT.exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt hdiffT
  rw [pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitiveWithin_convex hT ha hb hdiffT.continuousOn hg,
    pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitiveWithin_convex hT hb hc hdiffT.continuousOn hg,
    pathIntegral_segment_eq_sub_of_primitiveWithin_convex hT hc ha hdiffT.continuousOn hg]
  abel
