name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.fin_sum_adjacent_sub
statement:
private theorem fin_sum_adjacent_sub {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {n : ℕ}
    (value : Fin (n + 1) → G) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, (value i.castSucc - value i.succ)) =
      value 0 - value (Fin.last n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have hfirst := ih (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦ value j.castSucc)
      rw [show (∑ i : Fin n,
          (value i.castSucc.castSucc - value i.castSucc.succ)) =
          value 0 - value (Fin.last n).castSucc by
        simpa only [Fin.succ_castSucc, Fin.castSucc_zero] using hfirst]
      simp only [Fin.succ_last]
      abel

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.fin_sum_adjacent_sub_rev
statement:
private theorem fin_sum_adjacent_sub_rev {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {n : ℕ}
    (value : Fin (n + 1) → G) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, (value i.succ - value i.castSucc)) =
      value (Fin.last n) - value 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin n, (value i.succ - value i.castSucc)) =
        -(∑ i : Fin n, (value i.castSucc - value i.succ)) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          abel
    _ = -(value 0 - value (Fin.last n)) := by
      rw [fin_sum_adjacent_sub]
    _ = value (Fin.last n) - value 0 := by abel

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.sum_finSquareCellBoundaries_eq_outerBoundary
statement:
private theorem sum_finSquareCellBoundaries_eq_outerBoundary
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (n : ℕ)
    (horizontal : Fin n → Fin (n + 1) → G)
    (vertical : Fin (n + 1) → Fin n → G) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
      ((horizontal i j.castSucc - horizontal i j.succ) +
        (vertical i.succ j - vertical i.castSucc j))) =
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        (horizontal i 0 - horizontal i (Fin.last n))) +
      ∑ j : Fin n,
        (vertical (Fin.last n) j - vertical 0 j)
proof:
:= by
  have hhorizontal :
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
        (horizontal i j.castSucc - horizontal i j.succ)) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (horizontal i 0 - horizontal i (Fin.last n)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact fin_sum_adjacent_sub (horizontal i)
  have hvertical :
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
        (vertical i.succ j - vertical i.castSucc j)) =
      ∑ j : Fin n, (vertical (Fin.last n) j - vertical 0 j) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact fin_sum_adjacent_sub_rev (fun i ↦ vertical i j)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi ↦ Finset.sum_add_distrib),
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, hhorizontal, hvertical]

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.FiniteRawOpenPathGrid.horizontalReplacementExists
statement:
private theorem FiniteRawOpenPathGrid.horizontalReplacementExists
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (R : FiniteRawOpenPathGrid E) : FiniteHorizontalReplacementExists R
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    refine ⟨R.horizontalRaw i 0, R.horizontal_zero_piecewiseC1 i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      rw [hk]
      exact R.bottom_mem i k
    · intro k hk
      exfalso
      have : (0 : ℕ) = k.val + 1 := congrArg Fin.val hk
      omega
    · intro hboundary
      rfl
  · by_cases hjlast : j = Fin.last R.steps
    · subst j
      refine ⟨R.horizontalRaw i (Fin.last R.steps),
        R.horizontal_last_piecewiseC1 i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        exfalso
        have hval : R.steps = k.val := congrArg Fin.val hk
        omega
      · intro k hk
        rw [hk]
        exact R.top_mem i k
      · intro hboundary
        rfl
    · have hjpos : 0 < j.val := by
        have : j.val ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply hj0
          apply Fin.ext
          simpa using h
        omega
      have hjlt : j.val < R.steps := by
        have hjle : j.val ≤ R.steps := Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt
        have hjne : j.val ≠ R.steps := by
          intro h
          apply hjlast
          apply Fin.ext
          simpa using h
        omega
      let below : Fin R.steps := ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩
      let above : Fin R.steps := ⟨j.val, hjlt⟩
      have hbelow : below.succ = j := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [below]
        omega
      have habove : above.castSucc = j := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rfl
      have hraw : Set.range (R.horizontalRaw i j) ⊆
          R.cellSet i below ∩ R.cellSet i above := by
        intro z hz
        constructor
        · rw [← hbelow] at hz
          exact R.top_mem i below hz
        · rw [← habove] at hz
          exact R.bottom_mem i above hz
      obtain ⟨q, hqrange, hqpiece, K, hK⟩ :=
        Path.exists_piecewiseC1_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
          (R.horizontalRaw i j)
          ((R.cellSet_open i below).inter (R.cellSet_open i above))
          (fun t ↦ hraw (Set.mem_range_self t))
      refine ⟨q, hqpiece, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        have : k = above := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have := congrArg Fin.val (hk.symm.trans habove.symm)
          simpa [above] using this
        subst k
        exact fun z hz ↦ (hqrange hz).2
      · intro k hk
        have : k = below := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have := congrArg Fin.val (hk.symm.trans hbelow.symm)
          simp [below] at this ⊢
          omega
        subst k
        exact fun z hz ↦ (hqrange hz).1
      · intro hboundary
        rcases hboundary with hjzero | hjlast'
        · exact (hj0 hjzero).elim
        · exact (hjlast hjlast').elim

name: SandronesLibrary.Topology.FiniteRawOpenPathGrid.verticalReplacementExists
statement:
private theorem FiniteRawOpenPathGrid.verticalReplacementExists
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (R : FiniteRawOpenPathGrid E) : FiniteVerticalReplacementExists R
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    refine ⟨R.verticalRaw 0 j, R.vertical_zero_piecewiseC1 j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      rw [hk]
      exact R.left_mem k j
    · intro k hk
      exfalso
      have : (0 : ℕ) = k.val + 1 := congrArg Fin.val hk
      omega
    · intro hboundary
      rfl
  · by_cases hilast : i = Fin.last R.steps
    · subst i
      refine ⟨R.verticalRaw (Fin.last R.steps) j,
        R.vertical_last_piecewiseC1 j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        exfalso
        have hval : R.steps = k.val := congrArg Fin.val hk
        omega
      · intro k hk
        rw [hk]
        exact R.right_mem k j
      · intro hboundary
        rfl
    · have hipos : 0 < i.val := by
        have : i.val ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply hi0
          apply Fin.ext
          simpa using h
        omega
      have hilt : i.val < R.steps := by
        have hile : i.val ≤ R.steps := Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt
        have hine : i.val ≠ R.steps := by
          intro h
          apply hilast
          apply Fin.ext
          simpa using h
        omega
      let left : Fin R.steps := ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩
      let right : Fin R.steps := ⟨i.val, hilt⟩
      have hleft : left.succ = i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [left]
        omega
      have hright : right.castSucc = i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rfl
      have hraw : Set.range (R.verticalRaw i j) ⊆
          R.cellSet left j ∩ R.cellSet right j := by
        intro z hz
        constructor
        · rw [← hleft] at hz
          exact R.right_mem left j hz
        · rw [← hright] at hz
          exact R.left_mem right j hz
      obtain ⟨q, hqrange, hqpiece, K, hK⟩ :=
        Path.exists_piecewiseC1_range_subset_open_and_homotopyWithin
          (R.verticalRaw i j)
          ((R.cellSet_open left j).inter (R.cellSet_open right j))
          (fun t ↦ hraw (Set.mem_range_self t))
      refine ⟨q, hqpiece, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        have : k = right := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have := congrArg Fin.val (hk.symm.trans hright.symm)
          simpa [right] using this
        subst k
        exact fun z hz ↦ (hqrange hz).2
      · intro k hk
        have : k = left := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have := congrArg Fin.val (hk.symm.trans hleft.symm)
          simp [left] at this ⊢
          omega
        subst k
        exact fun z hz ↦ (hqrange hz).1
      · intro hboundary
        rcases hboundary with hizero | hilast'
        · exact (hi0 hizero).elim
        · exact (hilast hilast').elim

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_isExactOn_of_piecewiseC1
statement:
private theorem pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_isExactOn_of_piecewiseC1
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b : ℂ} {gamma : Path a b}
    (hexact : Complex.IsExactOn f U) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hgamma : Path.PiecewiseC1 gamma) (hrange : Set.range gamma ⊆ U) :
    pathIntegral f gamma = Classical.choose hexact b - Classical.choose hexact a
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := Classical.choose hexact
  have hg : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g (f z) z := Classical.choose_spec hexact
  have hf : ContinuousOn f U := by
    exact (hexact.differentiableOn hU).continuousOn
  exact pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_primitive_of_admissiblePath
    (admissiblePath_of_piecewiseC1 hgamma hrange hf) hg

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.pathIntegral_fourEdgeBoundary_eq_zero_of_isExactOn
statement:
private theorem pathIntegral_fourEdgeBoundary_eq_zero_of_isExactOn
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {a b c d : ℂ}
    (bottom : Path a b) (right : Path b c)
    (top : Path c d) (left : Path d a)
    (hexact : Complex.IsExactOn f U) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hbottom : Path.PiecewiseC1 bottom) (hright : Path.PiecewiseC1 right)
    (htop : Path.PiecewiseC1 top) (hleft : Path.PiecewiseC1 left)
    (bottom_mem : Set.range bottom ⊆ U) (right_mem : Set.range right ⊆ U)
    (top_mem : Set.range top ⊆ U) (left_mem : Set.range left ⊆ U) :
    pathIntegral f bottom + pathIntegral f right +
        pathIntegral f top + pathIntegral f left = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_isExactOn_of_piecewiseC1
      hexact hU hbottom bottom_mem,
    pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_isExactOn_of_piecewiseC1
      hexact hU hright right_mem,
    pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_isExactOn_of_piecewiseC1
      hexact hU htop top_mem,
    pathIntegral_eq_sub_of_isExactOn_of_piecewiseC1
      hexact hU hleft left_mem]
  abel

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.FiniteLocalPrimitivePathGrid.outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem FiniteLocalPrimitivePathGrid.outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (G : FiniteLocalPrimitivePathGrid f) :
    (∑ i : Fin G.steps,
        (pathIntegral f (G.horizontal i 0) -
          pathIntegral f (G.horizontal i (Fin.last G.steps)))) +
      ∑ j : Fin G.steps,
        (pathIntegral f (G.vertical (Fin.last G.steps) j) -
          pathIntegral f (G.vertical 0 j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let horizontalIntegral := fun i j ↦ pathIntegral f (G.horizontal i j)
  let verticalIntegral := fun i j ↦ pathIntegral f (G.vertical i j)
  have hcell : ∀ i j,
      (horizontalIntegral i j.castSucc - horizontalIntegral i j.succ) +
        (verticalIntegral i.succ j - verticalIntegral i.castSucc j) = 0 := by
    intro i j
    have hboundary := pathIntegral_fourEdgeBoundary_eq_zero_of_isExactOn
      (G.horizontal i j.castSucc) (G.vertical i.succ j)
      (G.horizontal i j.succ).symm (G.vertical i.castSucc j).symm
      (G.cell_exact i j) (G.cellSet_open i j)
      (G.horizontal_piecewiseC1 i j.castSucc)
      (G.vertical_piecewiseC1 i.succ j)
      (G.horizontal_piecewiseC1 i j.succ).symm
      (G.vertical_piecewiseC1 i.castSucc j).symm
      (G.bottom_mem i j) (G.right_mem i j)
      (by simpa only [Path.symm_range] using G.top_mem i j)
      (by simpa only [Path.symm_range] using G.left_mem i j)
    simp only [pathIntegral_symm] at hboundary
    dsimp [horizontalIntegral, verticalIntegral]
    calc
      _ = pathIntegral f (G.horizontal i j.castSucc) +
          pathIntegral f (G.vertical i.succ j) +
          -pathIntegral f (G.horizontal i j.succ) +
          -pathIntegral f (G.vertical i.castSucc j) := by abel
      _ = 0 := hboundary
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin G.steps, ∑ j : Fin G.steps,
        ((horizontalIntegral i j.castSucc - horizontalIntegral i j.succ) +
          (verticalIntegral i.succ j - verticalIntegral i.castSucc j))) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    exact hcell i j
  rw [sum_finSquareCellBoundaries_eq_outerBoundary] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: SandronesLibrary.ComplexAnalysis.finiteRawOpenPathGrid_outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteRawOpenPathGrid_outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (R : FiniteRawOpenPathGrid ℂ)
    (hexact : ∀ i j, Complex.IsExactOn f (R.cellSet i j)) :
    (∑ i : Fin R.steps,
        (pathIntegral f (R.horizontalRaw i 0) -
          pathIntegral f (R.horizontalRaw i (Fin.last R.steps)))) +
      ∑ j : Fin R.steps,
        (pathIntegral f (R.verticalRaw (Fin.last R.steps) j) -
          pathIntegral f (R.verticalRaw 0 j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let horizontal := fun i j ↦
    Classical.choose (R.horizontalReplacementExists i j)
  have horizontal_spec := fun i j ↦
    Classical.choose_spec (R.horizontalReplacementExists i j)
  let vertical := fun i j ↦
    Classical.choose (R.verticalReplacementExists i j)
  have vertical_spec := fun i j ↦
    Classical.choose_spec (R.verticalReplacementExists i j)
  let G : FiniteLocalPrimitivePathGrid f := {
    steps := R.steps
    vertex := R.vertex
    horizontal := horizontal
    vertical := vertical
    horizontal_piecewiseC1 := fun i j ↦ (horizontal_spec i j).1
    vertical_piecewiseC1 := fun i j ↦ (vertical_spec i j).1
    cellSet := R.cellSet
    cellSet_open := R.cellSet_open
    cell_exact := hexact
    bottom_mem := fun i j ↦ (horizontal_spec i j.castSucc).2.1 j rfl
    right_mem := fun i j ↦ (vertical_spec i.succ j).2.2.1 i rfl
    top_mem := fun i j ↦ (horizontal_spec i j.succ).2.2.1 j rfl
    left_mem := fun i j ↦ (vertical_spec i.castSucc j).2.1 i rfl }
  have houter := G.outerBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero
  have horizontal_zero : ∀ i, horizontal i 0 = R.horizontalRaw i 0 :=
    fun i ↦ (horizontal_spec i 0).2.2.2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have horizontal_last : ∀ i,
      horizontal i (Fin.last R.steps) =
        R.horizontalRaw i (Fin.last R.steps) :=
    fun i ↦ (horizontal_spec i (Fin.last R.steps)).2.2.2 (Or.inr rfl)
  have vertical_zero : ∀ j, vertical 0 j = R.verticalRaw 0 j :=
    fun j ↦ (vertical_spec 0 j).2.2.2 (Or.inl rfl)
  have vertical_last : ∀ j,
      vertical (Fin.last R.steps) j =
        R.verticalRaw (Fin.last R.steps) j :=
    fun j ↦ (vertical_spec (Fin.last R.steps) j).2.2.2 (Or.inr rfl)
  dsimp only [G] at houter
  simp_rw [horizontal_zero, horizontal_last, vertical_zero, vertical_last] at houter
  exact houter

proof:
:= by

  refine ⟨u * v, ?_, mul_assoc a u v⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.associateElements_implies_mutual_divisibility
statement:
theorem associateElements_implies_mutual_divisibility
    {R : Type*} [CommMonoid R] {a b : R} (h : AssociateElements a b) :
    DividesElement a b ∧ DividesElement b a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hbu⟩ := h
  constructor
  · exact ⟨u, hbu⟩
  · have hs := associateElements_symm (show AssociateElements a b from ⟨u, hu, hbu⟩)
    obtain ⟨v, _hv, hav⟩ := hs
    exact ⟨v, hav⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.mutual_divisibility_implies_associateElements
statement:
theorem mutual_divisibility_implies_associateElements
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) {a b : R}
    (hab : DividesElement a b) (hba : DividesElement b a) :
    AssociateElements a b
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp hR
  obtain ⟨x, hbx⟩ := hab
  obtain ⟨y, hay⟩ := hba
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · have hb0 : b = 0 := by rw [hbx, ha0, zero_mul]
    rw [ha0, hb0]
    exact associateElements_refl (0 : R)
  · have hxy : x * y = 1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha0
      calc
        a * (x * y) = (a * x) * y := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = b * y := by rw [← hbx]
        _ = a := hay.symm
        _ = a * 1 := (mul_one a).symm
    exact ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy, by simpa [mul_comm] using hxy⟩, hbx⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.associateElements_iff_associated
statement:
theorem associateElements_iff_associated
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) {a b : R} :
    AssociateElements a b ↔ Associated a b
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp hR
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hab, hba⟩ := associateElements_implies_mutual_divisibility h
    exact associated_of_dvd_dvd
      (dividesElement_iff_dvd.mp hab) (dividesElement_iff_dvd.mp hba)
  · intro h
    have hm : a ∣ b ∧ b ∣ a := dvd_dvd_iff_associated.mpr h
    exact mutual_divisibility_implies_associateElements hR
      (dividesElement_iff_dvd.mpr hm.1) (dividesElement_iff_dvd.mpr hm.2)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.primeElement_implies_irreducibleElement
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp hR
  refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  have hpab : DividesElement p (a * b) := ⟨1, by rw [← hab, mul_one]⟩
  rcases hp.2.2 a b hpab with hpa | hpb
  · obtain ⟨c, hac⟩ := hpa
    have hpc : p = p * (c * b) := by
      calc
        p = a * b := hab
        _ = (p * c) * b := by rw [← hac]
        _ = p * (c * b) := mul_assoc _ _ _
    have hcb : c * b = 1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp.1
      simpa using hpc.symm
    exact Or.inr ⟨c, by simpa [mul_comm] using hcb, hcb⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hbc⟩ := hpb
    have hac : a * c = 1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp.1
      calc
        p * (a * c) = (a * (p * c)) := by ac_rfl
        _ = a * b := by rw [← hbc]
        _ = p := hab.symm
        _ = p * 1 := (mul_one p).symm
    exact Or.inl ⟨c, hac, by simpa [mul_comm] using hac⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.irreducibleElement_iff_irreducible
statement:
theorem irreducibleElement_iff_irreducible
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) {p : R} :
    IrreducibleElement p ↔ Irreducible p
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp hR
  rw [irreducible_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_hp0, hpunit, hfac⟩
    exact ⟨fun hp ↦ hpunit ((unitElement_iff_isUnit p).mpr hp), fun a b hab ↦
      (hfac a b hab).imp
        (fun ha ↦ (unitElement_iff_isUnit a).mp ha)
        (fun hb ↦ (unitElement_iff_isUnit b).mp hb)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpunit, hfac⟩
    have hpIrr : Irreducible p := irreducible_iff.mpr ⟨hpunit, hfac⟩
    exact ⟨hpIrr.ne_zero, fun hp ↦ hpunit ((unitElement_iff_isUnit p).mp hp),
      fun a b hab ↦ (hfac hab).imp
        (fun ha ↦ (unitElement_iff_isUnit a).mpr ha)
        (fun hb ↦ (unitElement_iff_isUnit b).mpr hb)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.primeElement_iff_prime
statement:
theorem primeElement_iff_prime
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {p : R} :
    PrimeElement p ↔ Prime p
proof:
:= by
  unfold PrimeElement Prime
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp0, hpunit, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hp0, fun h ↦ hpunit ((unitElement_iff_isUnit p).mpr h), fun a b hab ↦
      (hp a b (dividesElement_iff_dvd.mpr hab)).imp
        dividesElement_iff_dvd.mp dividesElement_iff_dvd.mp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp0, hpunit, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hp0, fun h ↦ hpunit ((unitElement_iff_isUnit p).mp h), fun a b hab ↦
      (hp a b (dividesElement_iff_dvd.mp hab)).imp
        dividesElement_iff_dvd.mpr dividesElement_iff_dvd.mpr⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.greatestCommonDivisor_unique_up_to_associates
statement:
theorem greatestCommonDivisor_unique_up_to_associates
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) {d e a b : R}
    (hd : GreatestCommonDivisor d a b) (he : GreatestCommonDivisor e a b) :
    AssociateElements d e
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp hR
  have hde : DividesElement d e := he.2.2 d hd.1 hd.2.1
  have hed : DividesElement e d := hd.2.2 e he.1 he.2.1
  obtain ⟨x, hex⟩ := hde
  obtain ⟨y, hdy⟩ := hed
  by_cases hd0 : d = 0
  · have he0 : e = 0 := by rw [hex, hd0, zero_mul]
    rw [hd0, he0]
    exact associateElements_refl (0 : R)
  · have hxy : x * y = 1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd0
      calc
        d * (x * y) = (d * x) * y := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = e * y := by rw [← hex]
        _ = d := hdy.symm
        _ = d * 1 := (mul_one d).symm
    refine ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy, ?_⟩, hex⟩
    simpa [mul_comm] using hxy

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.zeroIdeal_principal
statement:
theorem zeroIdeal_principal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    PrincipalIdealSet ({0} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change x = 0 at hx
    subst x
    exact ⟨0, (mul_zero 0).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    change x = 0
    rw [hc, zero_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanDomain_implies_principalIdealDomain
statement:
theorem euclideanDomain_implies_principalIdealDomain
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) :
    PrincipalIdealDomainAxioms R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨E.domain, ?_⟩
  intro I hI
  by_cases hzero : ∀ x : R, x ∈ I → x = 0
  · have hEq : I = ({0} : Set R) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx; exact hzero x hx
      · intro hx
        change x = 0 at hx
        subst x
        exact hI.1.1
    rw [hEq]
    exact zeroIdeal_principal
  · push Not at hzero
    obtain ⟨a, haI, ha0⟩ := hzero
    let measures : Set ℕ := {n | ∃ x : R, x ∈ I ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ E.measure x = n}
    have hmeasures : measures.Nonempty := ⟨E.measure a, a, haI, ha0, rfl⟩
    let n := sInf measures
    have hnmem : n ∈ measures := Nat.sInf_mem hmeasures
    obtain ⟨d, hdI, hd0, hdmeasure⟩ := hnmem
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hxI
      let q := E.quotient x d
      let r := E.remainder x d
      have hrI : r ∈ I := by
        have hxsub : x - d * q ∈ I := by
          have hdq : d * q ∈ I := by
            simpa [mul_comm] using hI.1.2.2.2 q hdI
          simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hI.1.2.1 hxI (hI.1.2.2.1 hdq)
        have hdiv := E.division x d hd0
        have hr : r = x - d * q := by
          calc
            r = (d * q + r) - d * q := by ring
            _ = x - d * q := by rw [← hdiv]
        rw [hr]
        exact hxsub
      have hr0 : r = 0 := by
        by_contra hr0
        have hrmem : E.measure r ∈ measures := ⟨r, hrI, hr0, rfl⟩
        have hmin : n ≤ E.measure r := Nat.sInf_le hrmem
        have hlt : E.measure r < n := by simpa [n, hdmeasure] using E.remainder_lt x d hd0
        exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hmin) hlt
      exact ⟨q, by
        have hdiv := E.division x d hd0
        simpa [q, r, hr0] using hdiv⟩
    · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      simpa [mul_comm] using hI.1.2.2.2 q hdI

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.principalIdealDomain_implies_uniqueFactorizationDomain
statement:
theorem principalIdealDomain_implies_uniqueFactorizationDomain
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (P : PrincipalIdealDomainAxioms R) :
    UniqueFactorizationDomainAxioms R
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp P.domain
  letI : IsPrincipalIdealRing R := by
    constructor
    intro I
    have hI : TwoSidedIdealSet (I : Set R) := by
      constructor
      · refine ⟨I.zero_mem, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro x y hx hy; exact I.add_mem hx hy
        · intro x hx; exact I.neg_mem hx
        · intro r x hx; exact I.mul_mem_left r hx
      · refine ⟨I.zero_mem, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro x y hx hy; exact I.add_mem hx hy
        · intro x hx; exact I.neg_mem hx
        · intro r x hx; exact I.mul_mem_right r hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := P.principal I hI
    constructor
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    ext x
    change x ∈ (I : Set R) ↔ _
    rw [ha x]
    change DividesElement a x ↔ x ∈ Ideal.span ({a} : Set R)
    rw [dividesElement_iff_dvd, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  letI : UniqueFactorizationMonoid R :=
    PrincipalIdealRing.to_uniqueFactorizationMonoid
  refine ⟨P.domain, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha0 _haunit
    obtain ⟨f, hfIrr, hfAssoc⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_factors a ha0
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hfAssoc
    refine ⟨(u : R), (unitElement_iff_isUnit (u : R)).mpr u.isUnit, f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      exact (irreducibleElement_iff_irreducible P.domain).mpr (hfIrr p hp)
    · simpa [mul_comm] using hu.symm
  · intro p hp
    exact (primeElement_iff_prime).mpr
      ((irreducibleElement_iff_irreducible P.domain).mp hp).prime

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanDomain_implies_uniqueFactorizationDomain
statement:
theorem euclideanDomain_implies_uniqueFactorizationDomain
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) :
    UniqueFactorizationDomainAxioms R
proof:
:= by
  exact principalIdealDomain_implies_uniqueFactorizationDomain
    (euclideanDomain_implies_principalIdealDomain E)

proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra e.toRingHom

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.aeval_eq_evaluateOver
statement:
private theorem aeval_eq_evaluateOver {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) (x : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Polynomial.aeval x p = evaluateOver e p x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, algebraMap_eq_embedding]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral
statement:
private theorem algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (x : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    AlgebraicElement e x ↔ IsIntegral K x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hev⟩
    apply IsAlgebraic.isIntegral
    refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
    rwa [aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]
  · rintro ⟨p, hpmonic, hev⟩
    refine ⟨p, hpmonic.ne_zero, ?_⟩
    rwa [← aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly
statement:
private theorem minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (x : L)
    (ha : AlgebraicElement e x) (p : Polynomial K) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    MinimalPolynomialOf e x p ↔ p = minpoly K x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hxint : IsIntegral K x := (algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mp ha
  have hmin : MinimalPolynomialOf e x (minpoly K x) := by
    refine ⟨minpoly.monic hxint, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]
      exact minpoly.aeval K x
    · intro q hq
      apply minpoly.dvd K x
      rwa [aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact minimalPolynomialOf_unique e hp hmin
  · rintro rfl
    exact hmin

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p : Polynomial K) : SeparablePolynomial p ↔ p.Separable
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SeparablePolynomial] using (Polynomial.separable_def' p).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separableElement_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem separableElement_iff_mathlib {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (x : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    SeparableElement e x ↔ IsSeparable K x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hpmin, hpsep⟩
    have ha : AlgebraicElement e x :=
      ⟨p, hpmin.1.ne_zero, hpmin.2.1⟩
    have hp_eq : p = minpoly K x :=
      (minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly e x ha p).mp hpmin
    rw [IsSeparable, ← hp_eq]
    exact (separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib p).mp hpsep
  · intro hx
    have ha : AlgebraicElement e x :=
      (algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mpr hx.isIntegral
    refine ⟨minpoly K x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly e x ha (minpoly K x)).mpr rfl
    · exact (separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib (minpoly K x)).mpr hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separableExtension_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem separableExtension_iff_mathlib {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    SeparableExtension e ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable K L
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun x => (separableElement_iff_mathlib e x).mp (h x)⟩
  · intro h x
    exact (separableElement_iff_mathlib e x).mpr (h.isSeparable' x)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.normalExtension_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem normalExtension_iff_mathlib {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    NormalExtension e ↔ Normal K L
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨halg, hsplits⟩
    apply normal_iff.mpr
    intro x
    have ha : AlgebraicElement e x := halg x
    have hxint : IsIntegral K x :=
      (algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mp ha
    refine ⟨hxint, ?_⟩
    have hmin : MinimalPolynomialOf e x (minpoly K x) :=
      (minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly e x ha (minpoly K x)).mpr rfl
    simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding e] using
      hsplits x (minpoly K x) hmin
  · intro hn
    have hn' := normal_iff.mp hn
    constructor
    · intro x
      exact (algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mpr (hn' x).1
    · intro x p hp
      have ha : AlgebraicElement e x :=
        (algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mpr (hn' x).1
      have hp_eq : p = minpoly K x :=
        (minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly e x ha p).mp hp
      subst p
      simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding e] using (hn' x).2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separableExtension_iff_mathlibIsSeparable
statement:
theorem separableExtension_iff_mathlibIsSeparable {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    SeparableExtension e ↔ Algebra.IsSeparable K L
proof:
:=
  separableExtension_iff_mathlib e

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.normalExtension_iff_mathlibNormal
statement:
theorem normalExtension_iff_mathlibNormal {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    NormalExtension e ↔ Normal K L
proof:
:=
  normalExtension_iff_mathlib e

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.finiteFieldExtension_to_finiteDimensional
statement:
private theorem finiteFieldExtension_to_finiteDimensional {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FiniteFieldExtension e → FiniteDimensional K L
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rintro ⟨n, b, hb⟩
  have hcomb (c : Fin n → K) :
      fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = ∑ i, c i • b i := by
    simp [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap_eq_embedding e]
    rfl
  have hli : LinearIndependent K b := by
    apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
    intro c hc i
    apply hb.1 c
    rw [hcomb]
    exact hc
  have hsp : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range b) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb.2 x
    rw [← hc, hcomb]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i hi
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin n) K L := Module.Basis.mk hli hsp
  exact Module.Finite.of_basis B

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    SplittingFieldFor e p ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hroot : PolynomialRootSetIn e p = p.rootSet L := by
    ext x
    rw [Polynomial.mem_rootSet]
    simp only [PolynomialRootSetIn, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, aeval_eq_evaluateOver]
  have hgenerated (S : Set L) :
      generatedIntermediateFieldSet e S =
        ((IntermediateField.adjoin K S : IntermediateField K L) : Set L) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      apply hx (IntermediateField.adjoin K S : Set L)
      · refine ⟨⟨⟨IntermediateField.zero_mem _, IntermediateField.one_mem _,
            ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · exact fun _ _ ha hb => IntermediateField.add_mem _ ha hb
        · exact fun _ _ ha hb => IntermediateField.mul_mem _ ha hb
        · exact fun _ ha => IntermediateField.neg_mem _ ha
        · exact fun _ hx _ => IntermediateField.inv_mem _ hx
        · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
          change algebraMap K L a ∈ (IntermediateField.adjoin K S)
          exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ a
      · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K S
    · intro hx T hT hST
      let U : IntermediateField K L :=
        { carrier := T
          mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => hT.1.1.2.2.2.1 ha hb
          add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => hT.1.1.2.2.1 ha hb
          algebraMap_mem' := fun a => by
            rw [algebraMap_eq_embedding e]
            exact hT.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩
          inv_mem' := fun x hx => by
            by_cases hzero : x = 0
            · simpa [hzero] using hT.1.1.1
            · exact hT.1.2 hx hzero }
      have hSU : S ⊆ (U : Set L) := by
        intro y hy
        exact hST hy
      exact (IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr hSU :
        IntermediateField.adjoin K S ≤ U) hx
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hsplits, hgen⟩
    refine ⟨hp, isSplittingField_iff_intermediateField.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding e] using hsplits
    · rw [← hroot]
      apply SetLike.coe_injective
      rw [← hgenerated]
      exact hgen
  · rintro ⟨hp, hsf⟩
    obtain ⟨hsplits, hadjoin⟩ :=
      isSplittingField_iff_intermediateField.mp hsf
    refine ⟨hp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding e] using hsplits
    · rw [hroot, hgenerated]
      exact congrArg (fun F : IntermediateField K L => (F : Set L)) hadjoin

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.normal_finite_exists_nonzero_isSplittingField
statement:
private theorem normal_finite_exists_nonzero_isSplittingField {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Normal K L → FiniteDimensional K L →
      ∃ p : Polynomial K, p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro hn hfd
  letI : Normal K L := hn
  letI : FiniteDimensional K L := hfd
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Normal.exists_isSplittingField K L
  by_cases hpzero : p = 0
  · subst p
    letI : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L (0 : Polynomial K) := hp
    have hadjoin :=
      Polynomial.IsSplittingField.adjoin_rootSet L (0 : Polynomial K)
    rw [Polynomial.rootSet_zero, Algebra.adjoin_empty] at hadjoin
    have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap K L) :=
      Algebra.bijective_algebraMap_iff.mpr hadjoin.symm
    let f : K ≃ₐ[K] L := AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId K L) hbij
    haveI : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K K (Polynomial.C (1 : K)) :=
      Polynomial.isSplittingField_C 1
    have hconstant :
        Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L (Polynomial.C (1 : K)) :=
      Polynomial.IsSplittingField.of_algEquiv L (Polynomial.C (1 : K)) f
    exact ⟨Polynomial.C 1, by simp, hconstant⟩
  · exact ⟨p, hpzero, hp⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separable_root_derivative_ne_zero_bridge
statement:
private theorem separable_root_derivative_ne_zero_bridge {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) (x : L) :
    SeparablePolynomial p → evaluateOver e p x = 0 →
      evaluateOver e p.derivative x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hp hx
  have hsep : p.Separable := (separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib p).mp hp
  exact hsep.eval₂_derivative_ne_zero e.toRingHom hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.finite_base_finite_extension_separable_bridge
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have halg : AlgebraicExtension e :=
    finiteFieldExtension_isAlgebraic e hfin
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L :=
    ⟨fun x => ((algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mp (halg x)).isAlgebraic⟩
  letI : PerfectField K := PerfectField.ofFinite
  have hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable K L := inferInstance
  exact (separableExtension_iff_mathlib e).mpr hsep

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separablePolynomial_iff_bezout_derivative

theorem separablePolynomial_iff_bezout_derivative {K : Type*} [Field K]

      ∃ a b : Polynomial K, a * p + b * p.derivative = 1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separablePolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem separablePolynomial_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Field K]
    {p : Polynomial K} (hp : SeparablePolynomial p) : p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib p).mp hp |>.ne_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separablePolynomial_map_iff
statement:
theorem separablePolynomial_map_iff {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) :
    SeparablePolynomial (p.map e.toRingHom) ↔ SeparablePolynomial p
proof:
:= by
  rw [separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib, separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib]
  exact Polynomial.separable_map e.toRingHom

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.irreducible_separablePolynomial_iff_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem irreducible_separablePolynomial_iff_derivative_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : Irreducible p) :
    SeparablePolynomial p ↔ p.derivative ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib]
  exact Polynomial.separable_iff_derivative_ne_zero hp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separablePolynomial_root_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem separablePolynomial_root_derivative_ne_zero {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) (x : L)
    (hp : SeparablePolynomial p) (hx : evaluateOver e p x = 0) :
    evaluateOver e p.derivative x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact separable_root_derivative_ne_zero_bridge e p x hp hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separableElement_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem separableElement_isAlgebraic {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {x : L} (hx : SeparableElement e x) :
    AlgebraicElement e x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  apply (algebraicElement_iff_isIntegral e x).mpr
  exact ((separableElement_iff_mathlib e x).mp hx).isIntegral

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separableElement_iff_minimalPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hpeq : p = minpoly K x :=
    (minimalPolynomialOf_iff_minpoly e x ha p).mp hp
  rw [separableElement_iff_mathlib, IsSeparable, ← hpeq,
    ← separablePolynomial_iff_mathlib]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separableExtension_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem separableExtension_isAlgebraic {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hsep : SeparableExtension e) :

theorem finite_normalExtension_iff_exists_splittingFieldFor {K L : Type*}

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.subring_of_closed
statement:
theorem subring_of_closed {R : Type*} [Ring R] (S : Set R)
    (h0 : 0 ∈ S) (h1 : 1 ∈ S)
    (hadd : ∀ {x y : R}, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → x + y ∈ S)
    (hmul : ∀ {x y : R}, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → x * y ∈ S)
    (hneg : ∀ {x : R}, x ∈ S → -x ∈ S) :
    ∃ T : Subring R, ∀ x : R, x ∈ T ↔ x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  let ssg : Subsemigroup R := ⟨S, hmul⟩
  let sm : Submonoid R := ⟨ssg, h1⟩
  let ssr : Subsemiring R := ⟨sm, hadd, h0⟩
  let T : Subring R := ⟨ssr, hneg⟩
  refine ⟨T, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor <;> intro hx <;> exact hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.subringSet_iff_exists_subring
statement:
theorem subringSet_iff_exists_subring {R : Type*} [Ring R] (S : Set R) :
    SubringSet S ↔ ∃ T : Subring R, (T : Set R) = S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, hadd, hmul, hneg⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := subring_of_closed S h0 h1
      (fun ha hb => hadd ha hb) (fun ha hb => hmul ha hb) (fun ha => hneg ha)
    exact ⟨T, Set.ext hT⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨T.zero_mem, T.one_mem, fun _ _ => T.add_mem, fun _ _ => T.mul_mem,
      fun _ => T.neg_mem⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.generatedTwoSidedIdeal_is_ideal
statement:
theorem generatedTwoSidedIdeal_is_ideal {R : Type*} [Ring R] (S : Set R) :
    TwoSidedIdealSet (generatedTwoSidedIdeal S)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro I hI hSI; exact hI.1.1
    · intro x y hx hy I hI hSI; exact hI.1.2.1 (hx I hI hSI) (hy I hI hSI)
    · intro x hx I hI hSI; exact hI.1.2.2.1 (hx I hI hSI)
    · intro r x hx I hI hSI; exact hI.1.2.2.2 r (hx I hI hSI)
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro I hI hSI; exact hI.2.1
    · intro x y hx hy I hI hSI; exact hI.2.2.1 (hx I hI hSI) (hy I hI hSI)
    · intro x hx I hI hSI; exact hI.2.2.2.1 (hx I hI hSI)
    · intro r x hx I hI hSI; exact hI.2.2.2.2 r (hx I hI hSI)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealSetSum_is_ideal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨⟨0, hI.1.1, 0, hJ.1.1, add_zero 0⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro a b ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x + u, hI.1.2.1 hx hu, y + v, hJ.1.2.1 hy hv, by abel⟩
    · rintro a ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨-x, hI.1.2.2.1 hx, -y, hJ.1.2.2.1 hy, by abel⟩
    · rintro r a ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨r * x, hI.1.2.2.2 r hx, r * y, hJ.1.2.2.2 r hy, by noncomm_ring⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨0, hI.2.1, 0, hJ.2.1, add_zero 0⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro a b ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x + u, hI.2.2.1 hx hu, y + v, hJ.2.2.1 hy hv, by abel⟩
    · rintro a ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨-x, hI.2.2.2.1 hx, -y, hJ.2.2.2.1 hy, by abel⟩
    · rintro r a ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x * r, hI.2.2.2.2 r hx, y * r, hJ.2.2.2.2 r hy, by noncomm_ring⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal
statement:
theorem twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Set R) :
    TwoSidedIdealSet I ↔ ∃ J : Ideal R, (J : Set R) = I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hI
    let asg : AddSubsemigroup R := ⟨I, fun hx hy => hI.1.2.1 hx hy⟩
    let asm : AddSubmonoid R := ⟨asg, hI.1.1⟩
    let J : Ideal R := ⟨asm, fun r x hx => hI.1.2.2.2 r hx⟩
    exact ⟨J, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨J, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · exact ⟨J.zero_mem, (fun {_ _} hx hy => J.add_mem hx hy),
        (fun {_} hx => J.neg_mem hx), fun r {_} hx => J.mul_mem_left r hx⟩
    · refine ⟨J.zero_mem, (fun {_ _} hx hy => J.add_mem hx hy),
        (fun {_} hx => J.neg_mem hx), ?_⟩
      intro r x hx
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact J.mul_mem_left r hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealSetProduct_eq_mathlib_mul
statement:
theorem idealSetProduct_eq_mathlib_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R) :
    idealSetProduct (I : Set R) (J : Set R) = ((I * J : Ideal R) : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    apply hz (I * J : Ideal R)
    · exact (twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal ((I * J : Ideal R) : Set R)).2 ⟨I * J, rfl⟩
    · rintro w ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hy
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ :=
      (twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal (generatedTwoSidedIdeal
        {w | ∃ x ∈ (I : Set R), ∃ y ∈ (J : Set R), x * y = w})).1
        (generatedTwoSidedIdeal_is_ideal _)
    have hmul : I * J ≤ K := Ideal.mul_le.mpr (by
      intro x hx y hy
      change x * y ∈ (K : Set R)
      rw [hK]
      exact subset_generatedTwoSidedIdeal _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩)
    change z ∈ generatedTwoSidedIdeal
      {w | ∃ x ∈ (I : Set R), ∃ y ∈ (J : Set R), x * y = w}
    rw [← hK]
    exact hmul hz

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ideal_of_closed
statement:

    (h0 : 0 ∈ I)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.noZeroDivisorsAxiom_iff_no_zero_divisor
statement:
theorem noZeroDivisorsAxiom_iff_no_zero_divisor {R : Type*} [Zero R] [Mul R] :

proof:
:= by

theorem field_nonzero_unit {R : Type*} [Zero R] [One R] [Add R] [Mul R] [Neg R]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fieldAxioms_implies_integralDomainAxioms
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hR.commutativeRing, hR.zero_ne_one, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · exact Or.inl ha
  · right
    obtain ⟨c, hac, hca⟩ := hR.nonzero_unit a ha
    let A := hR.commutativeRing.1
    have add_left_cancel : ∀ x y z : R, x + y = x + z → y = z := by
      intro x y z hxyz
      calc
        y = 0 + y := (A.zero_add y).symm
        _ = (-x + x) + y := by rw [A.add_left_neg x]
        _ = -x + (x + y) := A.add_assoc (-x) x y
        _ = -x + (x + z) := by rw [hxyz]
        _ = (-x + x) + z := (A.add_assoc (-x) x z).symm
        _ = 0 + z := by rw [A.add_left_neg x]
        _ = z := A.zero_add z
    have zero_mul (x : R) : 0 * x = 0 := by
      have h : 0 * x = 0 * x + 0 * x := by
        calc
          0 * x = (0 + 0) * x := by rw [A.zero_add 0]
          _ = 0 * x + 0 * x := A.right_distrib 0 0 x
      exact (add_left_cancel (0 * x) 0 (0 * x) (by
        rw [A.add_zero]
        exact h)).symm
    have mul_zero (x : R) : x * 0 = 0 := by
      have h : x * 0 = x * 0 + x * 0 := by
        calc
          x * 0 = x * (0 + 0) := by rw [A.zero_add 0]
          _ = x * 0 + x * 0 := A.left_distrib x 0 0
      exact (add_left_cancel (x * 0) 0 (x * 0) (by
        rw [A.add_zero]
        exact h)).symm
    have hcb : c * (a * b) = 0 := by rw [hab, mul_zero]
    calc
      b = 1 * b := (A.one_mul b).symm
      _ = (c * a) * b := by rw [hca]
      _ = c * (a * b) := A.mul_assoc c a b
      _ = 0 := hcb

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.noZeroDivisorsAxiom_iff_mathlib
statement:
theorem noZeroDivisorsAxiom_iff_mathlib {R : Type*} [Zero R] [Mul R] :
    NoZeroDivisorsAxiom R ↔ NoZeroDivisors R
proof:
:= by
  exact (noZeroDivisors_iff R).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain
statement:
theorem integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    IntegralDomainAxioms R ↔ IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    letI : Nontrivial R := ⟨⟨0, 1, h.zero_ne_one⟩⟩
    letI : NoZeroDivisors R :=
      noZeroDivisorsAxiom_iff_mathlib.mp h.noZeroDivisors
    letI : IsCancelMulZero R := NoZeroDivisors.to_isCancelMulZero R
    exact ⟨⟩
  · intro h
    letI := h
    exact ⟨commRing_has_commutativeRingAxioms R, zero_ne_one,
      noZeroDivisorsAxiom_iff_mathlib.mpr (inferInstance : NoZeroDivisors R)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fieldAxioms_iff_isField
statement:
theorem fieldAxioms_iff_isField {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    FieldAxioms R ↔ IsField R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨⟨0, 1, h.zero_ne_one⟩, mul_comm, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hab, hba⟩ := h.nonzero_unit a ha
    exact ⟨b, hab⟩
  · intro h
    refine ⟨commRing_has_commutativeRingAxioms R, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro h01
      obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := h.exists_pair_ne
      exact hxy (by
        calc
          x = x * 1 := (mul_one x).symm
          _ = x * 0 := by rw [← h01]
          _ = 0 := mul_zero x
          _ = 0 * y := (zero_mul y).symm
          _ = 1 * y := by rw [h01]
          _ = y := one_mul y)
    · intro a ha
      obtain ⟨b, hab⟩ := h.mul_inv_cancel ha
      exact ⟨b, hab, by simpa [mul_comm] using hab⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.is_domain_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem is_domain_mul_eq_zero {R : Type*} [Ring R] [IsDomain R] {a b : R}

proof:
