name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.primeIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal_isPrime
statement:
theorem primeIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal_isPrime {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Set R) :
    PrimeIdealSet I ↔ ∃ J : Ideal R, (J : Set R) = I ∧ J.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨J, hJI⟩ := (twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal I).mp h.1
    refine ⟨J, hJI, (is_prime_iff J).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro htop
      apply h.2.1
      rw [← hJI, htop]
      rfl
    · intro x y hxy
      have hxyI : x * y ∈ I := by
        change x * y ∈ (J : Set R) at hxy
        rw [hJI] at hxy
        exact hxy
      rcases h.2.2 x y hxyI with hx | hy
      · left
        change x ∈ (J : Set R)
        rw [hJI]
        exact hx
      · right
        change y ∈ (J : Set R)
        rw [hJI]
        exact hy
  · rintro ⟨J, hJI, hJ⟩
    refine ⟨(twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal I).mpr ⟨J, hJI⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro htop
      apply (is_prime_iff J).mp hJ |>.1
      ext x
      change x ∈ (J : Set R) ↔ x ∈ (⊤ : Ideal R)
      rw [hJI, htop]
      simp
    · intro x y hxy
      have hxy' : x * y ∈ J := by
        change x * y ∈ (J : Set R)
        rw [hJI]
        exact hxy
      rcases (is_prime_iff J).mp hJ |>.2 hxy' with hx | hy
      · left
        rw [← hJI]
        exact hx
      · right
        rw [← hJI]
        exact hy

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.maximalIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem maximalIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal_isMaximal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Set R) :
    MaximalIdealSet I ↔ ∃ J : Ideal R, (J : Set R) = I ∧ J.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨J, hJI⟩ := (twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal I).mp h.1
    refine ⟨J, hJI, Ideal.isMaximal_def.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro htop
      apply h.2.1
      rw [← hJI, htop]
      rfl
    · intro K hJK
      have hsubset : I ⊆ (K : Set R) := by
        intro x hx
        apply hJK.le
        change x ∈ (J : Set R)
        rw [hJI]
        exact hx
      rcases h.2.2 (K : Set R)
          ((twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal (K : Set R)).mpr ⟨K, rfl⟩) hsubset with hKI | hKtop
      · exfalso
        apply hJK.ne
        ext x
        change x ∈ (J : Set R) ↔ x ∈ (K : Set R)
        rw [hJI, hKI]
      · ext x
        change x ∈ (K : Set R) ↔ x ∈ (⊤ : Ideal R)
        rw [hKtop]
        simp
  · rintro ⟨J, hJI, hJ⟩
    refine ⟨(twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal I).mpr ⟨J, hJI⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro htop
      apply hJ.ne_top
      ext x
      change x ∈ (J : Set R) ↔ x ∈ (⊤ : Ideal R)
      rw [hJI, htop]
      simp
    · intro K hK hsubset
      obtain ⟨L, hLK⟩ := (twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal K).mp hK
      have hJL : J ≤ L := by
        intro x hx
        change x ∈ (L : Set R)
        rw [hLK]
        apply hsubset
        change x ∈ (J : Set R) at hx
        rwa [hJI] at hx
      by_cases hLtop : L = ⊤
      · right
        rw [← hLK, hLtop]
        rfl
      · left
        have hJL_eq : J = L := hJ.eq_of_le hLtop hJL
        rw [← hJI, ← hLK, hJL_eq]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.maximalIdealSet_is_prime
statement:
theorem maximalIdealSet_is_prime {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I : Set R}
    (hI : MaximalIdealSet I) : PrimeIdealSet I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJI, hJ⟩ := (maximalIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal_isMaximal I).mp hI
  exact (primeIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal_isPrime I).mpr
    ⟨J, hJI, is_maximal_implies_is_prime J hJ⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  simpa [quotientZero_eq_projection, idealCongruent] using
    quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI x 0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSet_zero_ne_one_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h01 htop
    apply h01
    rw [quotientZero_eq_projection, quotientOne_eq_projection,
      quotientRingProjection_eq_iff]
    change (0 : R) - 1 ∈ I
    rw [htop]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  · intro hproper h01
    apply hproper
    rw [Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
    intro x
    let A := quotientRingSet_ringAxioms I hI
    have hx0 : quotientRingProjection I hI x = 0 := by
      calc
        quotientRingProjection I hI x = quotientRingProjection I hI x * 1 :=
          (A.mul_one (quotientRingProjection I hI x)).symm
        _ = quotientRingProjection I hI x * 0 := by rw [h01]
        _ = quotientRingProjection I hI (x * 0) := quotientMul_projection I hI x 0
        _ = quotientRingProjection I hI 0 := by rw [mul_zero]
        _ = 0 := (quotientZero_eq_projection I hI).symm
    exact quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI x |>.mp hx0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSet_mul_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientMul_projection, quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSet_projection_unit_iff
statement:
theorem quotientRingSet_projection_unit_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I : Set R}
    (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (a : R) :
    UnitElement (quotientRingProjection I hI a) ↔
      ∃ b : R, a * b - 1 ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, haq, _⟩
    revert haq
    refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
    intro b haq
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    have heq : quotientRingProjection I hI (a * b) =
        quotientRingProjection I hI 1 := by
      change quotientRingProjection I hI a * quotientRingProjection I hI b = 1 at haq
      rw [quotientMul_projection, quotientOne_eq_projection] at haq
      exact haq
    simpa [idealCongruent] using (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI (a * b) 1).mp heq
  · rintro ⟨b, hab⟩
    refine ⟨quotientRingProjection I hI b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [quotientMul_projection, quotientOne_eq_projection]
      apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI (a * b) 1).mpr
      simpa [idealCongruent] using hab
    · rw [quotientMul_projection, quotientOne_eq_projection]
      apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI (b * a) 1).mpr
      simpa [idealCongruent, mul_comm] using hab

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSet_commutativeRingAxioms
statement:
theorem quotientRingSet_commutativeRingAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) :
    CommutativeRingAxioms (quotientRingSet I hI)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨quotientRingSet_ringAxioms I hI, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  intro a b
  change quotientRingProjection I hI (a * b) = quotientRingProjection I hI (b * a)
  rw [mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.primeIdealSet_iff_quotient_integralDomainAxioms
statement:
theorem primeIdealSet_iff_quotient_integralDomainAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) :
    PrimeIdealSet I ↔ IntegralDomainAxioms (quotientRingSet I hI)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hprime
    refine ⟨quotientRingSet_commutativeRingAxioms I hI,
      (quotientRingSet_zero_ne_one_iff hI).mpr hprime.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_ hxy
    intro a b hab
    have habI : a * b ∈ I :=
      (quotientRingSet_mul_eq_zero_iff hI a b).mp hab
    rcases hprime.2.2 a b habI with ha | hb
    · left
      exact (quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI a).mpr ha
    · right
      exact (quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI b).mpr hb
  · intro hdomain
    refine ⟨hI, (quotientRingSet_zero_ne_one_iff hI).mp hdomain.zero_ne_one, ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    have hmul : quotientRingProjection I hI a * quotientRingProjection I hI b = 0 :=
      (quotientRingSet_mul_eq_zero_iff hI a b).mpr hab
    rcases hdomain.noZeroDivisors _ _ hmul with ha | hb
    · left
      exact (quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI a).mp ha
    · right
      exact (quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI b).mp hb

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.maximalIdealSet_iff_quotient_fieldAxioms
statement:
theorem maximalIdealSet_iff_quotient_fieldAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) :
    MaximalIdealSet I ↔ FieldAxioms (quotientRingSet I hI)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmax
    refine ⟨quotientRingSet_commutativeRingAxioms I hI,
      (quotientRingSet_zero_ne_one_iff hI).mpr hmax.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_ hq
    intro a ha
    have haI : a ∉ I := by
      intro haI
      exact ha ((quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI a).mpr haI)
    let K : Set R := {x | ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ r : R, x = i + r * a}
    have hKleft : LeftIdealSet K := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨0, hI.1.1, 0, by simp⟩
      · rintro x y ⟨i, hi, r, rfl⟩ ⟨j, hj, s, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨i + j, hI.1.2.1 hi hj, r + s, ?_⟩
        ring
      · rintro x ⟨i, hi, r, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨-i, hI.1.2.2.1 hi, -r, ?_⟩
        ring
      · rintro c x ⟨i, hi, r, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨c * i, hI.1.2.2.2 c hi, c * r, ?_⟩
        ring
    have hK : TwoSidedIdealSet K := by
      refine ⟨hKleft, hKleft.1, hKleft.2.1, hKleft.2.2.1, ?_⟩
      intro c x hx
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact hKleft.2.2.2 c hx
    have hIK : I ⊆ K := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨x, hx, 0, by simp⟩
    have haK : a ∈ K := ⟨0, hI.1.1, 1, by simp⟩
    have hKne : K ≠ I := by
      intro hKI
      exact haI (hKI ▸ haK)
    have hKtop : K = Set.univ :=
      (hmax.2.2 K hK hIK).resolve_left hKne
    have hOneK : (1 : R) ∈ K := hKtop.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ 1
    obtain ⟨i, hi, r, hir⟩ := hOneK
    apply (quotientRingSet_projection_unit_iff hI a).mpr
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    have hneg := hI.1.2.2.1 hi
    have heq : a * r - 1 = -i := by
      calc
        a * r - 1 = r * a - 1 := by rw [mul_comm a r]
        _ = r * a - (i + r * a) := by rw [← hir]
        _ = -i := by ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hneg
  · intro hfield
    refine ⟨hI, (quotientRingSet_zero_ne_one_iff hI).mp hfield.zero_ne_one, ?_⟩
    intro J hJ hIJ
    by_cases hJI : J = I
    · exact Or.inl hJI
    · right
      rw [Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
      obtain ⟨a, haJ, haI⟩ : ∃ a, a ∈ J ∧ a ∉ I := by
        by_contra hnone
        apply hJI
        apply Set.Subset.antisymm _ hIJ
        intro x hxJ
        by_contra hxI
        exact hnone ⟨x, hxJ, hxI⟩
      have hpa : quotientRingProjection I hI a ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        exact haI ((quotientRingProjection_eq_zero_iff hI a).mp hzero)
      obtain ⟨b, hab⟩ :=
        (quotientRingSet_projection_unit_iff hI a).mp
          (hfield.nonzero_unit (quotientRingProjection I hI a) hpa)
      have habJ : a * b - 1 ∈ J := hIJ hab
      have habmulJ : a * b ∈ J := hJ.2.2.2.2 b haJ
      have hnegJ : -(a * b - 1) ∈ J := hJ.1.2.2.1 habJ
      have honeJ : (1 : R) ∈ J := by
        have := hJ.1.2.1 habmulJ hnegJ
        convert this using 1
        ring
      intro x
      have hxmul : x * 1 ∈ J := hJ.1.2.2.2 x honeJ
      simpa using hxmul

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.fixedField_mathlib_alignment_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_mathlib_alignment_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ (φ : FieldAutomorphismOver e ≃* (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) (E : IntermediateField K L),
      (∀ σ, σ ∈ H ↔ φ σ ∈ G) ∧
        (E : Set L) = FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) ∧
        E = IntermediateField.fixedField G
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let φ := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_mulEquiv e
  let G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L) := H.map φ.toMonoidHom
  let E : IntermediateField K L := IntermediateField.fixedField G
  refine ⟨φ, G, E, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · intro σ
    constructor
    · intro hσ
      exact ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨τ, hτ, hτσ⟩
      have : τ = σ := φ.injective hτσ
      rwa [← this]
  · ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx σ hσ
      have hφσ : φ σ ∈ G := ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
      change x ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField G at hx
      exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff G x).mp hx (φ σ) hφσ
    · intro hx
      change x ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField G
      apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff G x).mpr
      intro g hg
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩ := hg
      exact hx σ hσ

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.subgroup_normal_alignment_bridge
statement:
private theorem subgroup_normal_alignment_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (φ : FieldAutomorphismOver e ≃* (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L)),
      (∀ σ, σ ∈ H ↔ φ σ ∈ G) → (H.Normal ↔ G.Normal)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro φ G hHG
  have hmap : H.map φ.toMonoidHom = G := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
      exact (hHG σ).mp hσ
    · intro hg
      refine ⟨φ.symm g, (hHG (φ.symm g)).mpr ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using hg
      · exact φ.apply_symm_apply g
  rw [← hmap]
  exact (MulEquiv.normal_map_iff (f := φ) (H := H)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.fixedField_galois_alignment_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_galois_alignment_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (E : IntermediateField K L),
      (E : Set L) = FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) →
      (GaloisExtension
          (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)) ↔
        IsGalois K E)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro E hE
  let F := fixedFieldIntermediateField e H
  have hEF : (E : Set L) = F.carrier := hE.trans (by rfl)
  change GaloisExtension (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) ↔ IsGalois K E
  let _ : Algebra K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hbackend :
      GaloisExtension (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) ↔
        IsGalois K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) := by
    rw [GaloisExtension, isGalois_iff,
      separableExtension_iff_mathlibIsSeparable,
      normalExtension_iff_mathlibNormal]
  let ψ := fixedFieldCarrierAlgEquivMathlib F E hEF
    (RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra e.toRingHom)
  exact hbackend.trans ψ.transfer_galois

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.mathlib_normal_iff_fixedField_isGalois_bridge
statement:
private theorem mathlib_normal_iff_fixedField_isGalois_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :
    G.Normal ↔ IsGalois K (IntermediateField.fixedField G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hnormal
    let _ : G.Normal := hnormal
    exact IsGalois.of_fixedField_normal_subgroup G
  · intro hgalois
    let _ : IsGalois K (IntermediateField.fixedField G) := hgalois
    have hnormal :
        (IntermediateField.fixedField G).fixingSubgroup.Normal :=
      IsGalois.fixingSubgroup_normal_of_isGalois
        (IntermediateField.fixedField G)
    rw [IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_fixedField G] at hnormal
    exact hnormal

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.fixedField_separableExtension_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_separableExtension_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    SeparableExtension
      (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨⟨hfd⟩, ⟨hmg⟩⟩ := finiteGalois_mathlibBackend e hfin hgal
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L := hfd
  let _ : IsGalois K L := hmg
  obtain ⟨φ, G, E, _hHG, hE, hfixed⟩ :=
    fixedField_mathlib_alignment_bridge e H
  let F := fixedFieldIntermediateField e H
  have hEF : (E : Set L) = F.carrier := hE.trans (by rfl)
  have hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable K E := by
    rw [hfixed]
    exact Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable
      K (IntermediateField.fixedField G) L
  let _ : Algebra K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let ψ := fixedFieldCarrierAlgEquivMathlib F E hEF
    (RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra e.toRingHom)
  have hsepCarrier : Algebra.IsSeparable K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    Algebra.IsSeparable.of_algHom K E ψ
  exact (separableExtension_iff_mathlibIsSeparable
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F)).mpr hsepCarrier

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_galoisExtension
statement:
theorem subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_galoisExtension
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    H.Normal ↔
      GaloisExtension
        (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨⟨hfd⟩, ⟨hmg⟩⟩ := finiteGalois_mathlibBackend e hfin hgal
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L := hfd
  let _ : IsGalois K L := hmg
  obtain ⟨φ, G, E, hHG, hE, hfixed⟩ :=
    fixedField_mathlib_alignment_bridge e H
  rw [subgroup_normal_alignment_bridge e H φ G hHG]
  rw [fixedField_galois_alignment_bridge e H E hE]
  rw [hfixed]
  exact mathlib_normal_iff_fixedField_isGalois_bridge G

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesNormality.subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_normalExtension
statement:
theorem subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_normalExtension
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    H.Normal ↔
      NormalExtension
        (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hH
    exact (subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_galoisExtension
      e hfin hgal H).mp hH |>.isNormal
  · intro hn
    apply (subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_galoisExtension e hfin hgal H).mpr
    exact ⟨fixedField_separableExtension_bridge e hfin hgal H, hn⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fractionPairEquivalent_equivalence
statement:
theorem fractionPairEquivalent_equivalence {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) : Equivalence (fractionPairEquivalent S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p
    exact ⟨1, S.one_mem, by simp⟩
  · intro p q
    rintro ⟨u, huS, hu⟩
    refine ⟨u, huS, ?_⟩
    calc
      u * (q.numerator * p.denominator - p.numerator * q.denominator) =
          -(u * (p.numerator * q.denominator - q.numerator * p.denominator)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hu]; simp
  · intro p q r
    rintro ⟨u, huS, hu⟩ ⟨v, hvS, hv⟩
    refine ⟨u * v * q.denominator,
      S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem huS hvS) q.denominator_mem, ?_⟩
    calc
      (u * v * q.denominator) *
          (p.numerator * r.denominator - r.numerator * p.denominator) =
        v * r.denominator *
            (u * (p.numerator * q.denominator - q.numerator * p.denominator)) +
          u * p.denominator *
            (v * (q.numerator * r.denominator - r.numerator * q.denominator)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hu, hv]; ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationFraction_eq_iff
statement:
theorem localizationFraction_eq_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (a b c d : R)
    (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) (hd : d ∈ S.carrier) :
    localizationFraction S a b hb = localizationFraction S c d hd ↔
      ∃ u : R, u ∈ S.carrier ∧ u * (a * d - c * b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Quotient.eq

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fractionPairEquivalent_add
statement:
private theorem fractionPairEquivalent_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) {p p' q q' : FractionPair S}
    (hp : fractionPairEquivalent S p p') (hq : fractionPairEquivalent S q q') :
    fractionPairEquivalent S (fractionPairAdd S p q) (fractionPairAdd S p' q')
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨u, huS, hu⟩
  rcases hq with ⟨v, hvS, hv⟩
  refine ⟨u * v, S.mul_mem huS hvS, ?_⟩
  calc
    (u * v) *
        ((fractionPairAdd S p q).numerator * (fractionPairAdd S p' q').denominator -
          (fractionPairAdd S p' q').numerator * (fractionPairAdd S p q).denominator) =
      v * q.denominator * q'.denominator *
          (u * (p.numerator * p'.denominator - p'.numerator * p.denominator)) +
        u * p.denominator * p'.denominator *
          (v * (q.numerator * q'.denominator - q'.numerator * q.denominator)) := by
            simp only [fractionPairAdd]
            ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hu, hv]; ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fractionPairEquivalent_mul
statement:
private theorem fractionPairEquivalent_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) {p p' q q' : FractionPair S}
    (hp : fractionPairEquivalent S p p') (hq : fractionPairEquivalent S q q') :
    fractionPairEquivalent S (fractionPairMul S p q) (fractionPairMul S p' q')
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨u, huS, hu⟩
  rcases hq with ⟨v, hvS, hv⟩
  refine ⟨u * v, S.mul_mem huS hvS, ?_⟩
  calc
    (u * v) *
        ((fractionPairMul S p q).numerator * (fractionPairMul S p' q').denominator -
          (fractionPairMul S p' q').numerator * (fractionPairMul S p q).denominator) =
      v * q.numerator * q'.denominator *
          (u * (p.numerator * p'.denominator - p'.numerator * p.denominator)) +
        u * p'.numerator * p.denominator *
          (v * (q.numerator * q'.denominator - q'.numerator * q.denominator)) := by
            simp only [fractionPairMul]
            ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hu, hv]; ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fractionPairEquivalent_neg
statement:
private theorem fractionPairEquivalent_neg {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) {p q : FractionPair S}
    (hp : fractionPairEquivalent S p q) :
    fractionPairEquivalent S (fractionPairNeg S p) (fractionPairNeg S q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨u, huS, hu⟩
  refine ⟨u, huS, ?_⟩
  calc
    u * ((fractionPairNeg S p).numerator * (fractionPairNeg S q).denominator -
      (fractionPairNeg S q).numerator * (fractionPairNeg S p).denominator) =
        -(u * (p.numerator * q.denominator - q.numerator * p.denominator)) := by
          simp only [fractionPairNeg]
          ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hu]; simp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationFraction_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizationFraction_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (a b c d : R)
    (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) (hd : d ∈ S.carrier) :
    localizationFraction S a b hb + localizationFraction S c d hd =
      localizationFraction S (a * d + c * b) (b * d) (S.mul_mem hb hd)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationFraction_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizationFraction_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (a b c d : R)
    (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) (hd : d ∈ S.carrier) :
    localizationFraction S a b hb * localizationFraction S c d hd =
      localizationFraction S (a * c) (b * d) (S.mul_mem hb hd)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationFraction_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizationFraction_neg {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (a b : R) (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) :
    -(localizationFraction S a b hb) = localizationFraction S (-a) b hb
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
statement:
private theorem localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (a b c d : R)
    (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) (hd : d ∈ S.carrier) (h : a * d = c * b) :
    localizationFraction S a b hb = localizationFraction S c d hd
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizationFraction_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨1, S.one_mem, by simp [h]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationRing_ringAxioms
statement:
theorem localizationRing_ringAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (S : MultiplicativeSet R) :
    RingAxioms (LocalizationRing S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩ ⟨e, f, hf⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    simp only [fractionPairAdd]
    ring
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    simp only [fractionPairNeg]
    ring
  · intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩ ⟨e, f, hf⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    simp only [fractionPairMul]
    ring
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩ ⟨e, f, hf⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    simp only [fractionPairAdd, fractionPairMul]
    ring
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩ ⟨e, f, hf⟩
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    simp only [fractionPairAdd, fractionPairMul]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationRing_mul_comm
statement:
private theorem localizationRing_mul_comm {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (x y : LocalizationRing S) : x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
  rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩
  apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationMap_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem localizationMap_is_ringHomomorphism {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) : RingHomomorphism (localizationMap S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · intro a b
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro a b
    apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · intro a
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationMap_denominator_is_unit
statement:
theorem localizationMap_denominator_is_unit {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) {s : R} (hs : s ∈ S.carrier) :
    UnitElement (localizationMap S s)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨localizationFraction S 1 s hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring
  · apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationRing_every_element_is_fraction
statement:
theorem localizationRing_every_element_is_fraction {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (x : LocalizationRing S) :
    ∃ a b : R, ∃ _hb : b ∈ S.carrier,
      x * localizationMap S b = localizationMap S a
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
  refine ⟨a, b, hb, ?_⟩
  apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chosenUnitInverse_right
statement:
private theorem chosenUnitInverse_right {T : Type*} [CommRing T]
    {a : T} (ha : UnitElement a) : a * chosenUnitInverse ha = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec ha).1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chosenUnitInverse_left
statement:
private theorem chosenUnitInverse_left {T : Type*} [CommRing T]
    {a : T} (ha : UnitElement a) : chosenUnitInverse ha * a = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec ha).2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fractionPairEvaluate_eq
statement:
private theorem fractionPairEvaluate_eq {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (f : R → T) (hf : RingHomomorphism f)
    (hunit : ∀ s : R, s ∈ S.carrier → UnitElement (f s))
    {p q : FractionPair S} (hpq : fractionPairEquivalent S p q) :
    fractionPairEvaluate S f hunit p = fractionPairEvaluate S f hunit q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := ringHomomorphism_exists_ringHom f hf
  subst f
  rcases hpq with ⟨u, huS, hu⟩
  have hmapped := congrArg F hu
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_zero] at hmapped
  have hcross :
      F p.numerator * F q.denominator - F q.numerator * F p.denominator = 0 := by
    calc
      F p.numerator * F q.denominator - F q.numerator * F p.denominator =
          1 * (F p.numerator * F q.denominator - F q.numerator * F p.denominator) := by
            rw [one_mul]
      _ = (chosenUnitInverse (hunit u huS) * F u) *
          (F p.numerator * F q.denominator - F q.numerator * F p.denominator) := by
            rw [chosenUnitInverse_left]
      _ = chosenUnitInverse (hunit u huS) *
          (F u * (F p.numerator * F q.denominator - F q.numerator * F p.denominator)) := by
            ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hmapped]; ring
  have hcross' : F p.numerator * F q.denominator = F q.numerator * F p.denominator :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp hcross
  unfold fractionPairEvaluate
  calc
    F p.numerator * chosenUnitInverse (hunit p.denominator p.denominator_mem) =
        F p.numerator * chosenUnitInverse (hunit p.denominator p.denominator_mem) *
          (F q.denominator * chosenUnitInverse (hunit q.denominator q.denominator_mem)) := by
            rw [chosenUnitInverse_right, mul_one]
    _ = (F p.numerator * F q.denominator) *
          chosenUnitInverse (hunit p.denominator p.denominator_mem) *
          chosenUnitInverse (hunit q.denominator q.denominator_mem) := by ring
    _ = (F q.numerator * F p.denominator) *
          chosenUnitInverse (hunit p.denominator p.denominator_mem) *
          chosenUnitInverse (hunit q.denominator q.denominator_mem) := by rw [hcross']
    _ = F q.numerator * chosenUnitInverse (hunit q.denominator q.denominator_mem) *
          (F p.denominator * chosenUnitInverse (hunit p.denominator p.denominator_mem)) := by ring
    _ = F q.numerator * chosenUnitInverse (hunit q.denominator q.denominator_mem) := by
          rw [chosenUnitInverse_right, mul_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationLift_fraction
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizationLift_fraction {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (f : R → T) (hf : RingHomomorphism f)
    (hunit : ∀ s : R, s ∈ S.carrier → UnitElement (f s))
    (a b : R) (hb : b ∈ S.carrier) :
    localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b = f a
proof:
:= by
  change (f a * chosenUnitInverse (hunit b hb)) * f b = f a
  rw [mul_assoc, chosenUnitInverse_left, mul_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit
statement:
private theorem eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit {T : Type*} [CommRing T]
    {x y u : T} (hu : UnitElement u) (h : x * u = y * u) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hu with ⟨v, huv, _⟩
  calc
    x = x * 1 := (mul_one x).symm
    _ = x * (u * v) := by rw [huv]
    _ = (x * u) * v := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = (y * u) * v := by rw [h]
    _ = y * (u * v) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = y := by rw [huv, mul_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationLift_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem localizationLift_is_ringHomomorphism {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (f : R → T) (hf : RingHomomorphism f)
    (hunit : ∀ s : R, s ∈ S.carrier → UnitElement (f s)) :
    RingHomomorphism (localizationLift S f hf hunit)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S 0 1 S.one_mem) = 0
    apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit (hunit 1 S.one_mem)
    simpa [hf.1, hf.2.1] using localizationLift_fraction S f hf hunit 0 1 S.one_mem
  · change localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S 1 1 S.one_mem) = 1
    apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit (hunit 1 S.one_mem)
    simpa [hf.2.1] using localizationLift_fraction S f hf hunit 1 1 S.one_mem
  · intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩
    change localizationLift S f hf hunit
        (localizationFraction S a b hb + localizationFraction S c d hd) =
      localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) +
        localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S c d hd)
    apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit (hunit (b * d) (S.mul_mem hb hd))
    rw [localizationFraction_add]
    rw [localizationLift_fraction]
    symm
    simp only [hf.2.2.1, hf.2.2.2.1]
    calc
      (localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) +
          localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S c d hd)) *
          (f b * f d) =
        (localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b) * f d +
          (localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S c d hd) * f d) * f b := by ring
      _ = f a * f d + f c * f b := by rw [localizationLift_fraction, localizationLift_fraction]
  · intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ ⟨c, d, hd⟩
    change localizationLift S f hf hunit
        (localizationFraction S a b hb * localizationFraction S c d hd) =
      localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) *
        localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S c d hd)
    apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit (hunit (b * d) (S.mul_mem hb hd))
    rw [localizationFraction_mul]
    rw [localizationLift_fraction]
    symm
    simp only [hf.2.2.2.1]
    calc
      (localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) *
          localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S c d hd)) *
          (f b * f d) =
        (localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b) *
          (localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S c d hd) * f d) := by ring
      _ = f a * f c := by rw [localizationLift_fraction, localizationLift_fraction]
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
    change localizationLift S f hf hunit (-(localizationFraction S a b hb)) =
      -localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb)
    apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit (hunit b hb)
    rw [localizationFraction_neg]
    rw [localizationLift_fraction]
    symm
    rw [hf.2.2.2.2]
    calc
      -localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b =
          -(localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b) := by ring
      _ = -f a := by rw [localizationLift_fraction]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationLift_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizationLift_map {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (f : R → T) (hf : RingHomomorphism f)
    (hunit : ∀ s : R, s ∈ S.carrier → UnitElement (f s)) (a : R) :
    localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationMap S a) = f a
proof:
:= by
  change localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a 1 S.one_mem) = f a
  simpa [hf.2.1] using localizationLift_fraction S f hf hunit a 1 S.one_mem

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationLift_unique
statement:
theorem localizationLift_unique {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (f : R → T) (hf : RingHomomorphism f)
    (hunit : ∀ s : R, s ∈ S.carrier → UnitElement (f s))
    (g : LocalizationRing S → T) (hg : RingHomomorphism g)
    (htriangle : ∀ a : R, g (localizationMap S a) = f a) :
    g = localizationLift S f hf hunit
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩
  change g (localizationFraction S a b hb) =
    localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb)
  apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_of_unit (hunit b hb)
  calc
    g (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b =
        g (localizationFraction S a b hb) * g (localizationMap S b) := by
          rw [htriangle]
    _ =
        g (localizationFraction S a b hb * localizationMap S b) :=
          (hg.2.2.2.1 _ _).symm
    _ = g (localizationMap S a) := by
      congr 1
      apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
      ring
    _ = f a := htriangle a
    _ = localizationLift S f hf hunit (localizationFraction S a b hb) * f b :=
      (localizationLift_fraction S f hf hunit a b hb).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.localizationRing_universal_property
statement:
theorem localizationRing_universal_property {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (S : MultiplicativeSet R) (f : R → T) (hf : RingHomomorphism f)
    (hunit : ∀ s : R, s ∈ S.carrier → UnitElement (f s)) :
    ∃! g : LocalizationRing S → T,
      RingHomomorphism g ∧ ∀ a : R, g (localizationMap S a) = f a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨localizationLift S f hf hunit, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨localizationLift_is_ringHomomorphism S f hf hunit,
      localizationLift_map S f hf hunit⟩
  · intro g hg
    exact localizationLift_unique S f hf hunit g hg.1 hg.2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.fractionField_fieldAxioms
statement:
theorem fractionField_fieldAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) :
    FieldAxioms (LocalizationRing (nonzeroMultiplicativeSet hR))
proof:
:= by
  let S := nonzeroMultiplicativeSet hR
  refine ⟨commRing_has_commutativeRingAxioms (LocalizationRing S), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h01
    have heq : localizationFraction S 0 1 S.one_mem =
        localizationFraction S 1 1 S.one_mem := h01
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hzero⟩ := (localizationFraction_eq_iff S 0 1 1 1
      S.one_mem S.one_mem).mp heq
    apply hu
    simpa using hzero
  · intro x hx
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_ hx
    rintro ⟨a, b, hb⟩ hfrac
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha0
      apply hfrac
      change localizationFraction S a b hb = localizationFraction S 0 1 S.one_mem
      apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
      simp [ha0]
    refine ⟨localizationFraction S b a ha, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
      ring
    · apply localizationFraction_eq_of_cross_mul
      ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.generatedSubgroupSet_is_subgroup
statement:
theorem generatedSubgroupSet_is_subgroup {G : Type*} [Group G] (S : Set G) :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro H hH hSH
    exact hH.1
  · intro x y hx hy H hH hSH
    exact hH.2.1 (hx H hH hSH) (hy H hH hSH)
  · intro x hx H hH hSH
    exact hH.2.2 (hx H hH hSH)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.generatedSubgroupSet_eq_mathlib_closure
statement:
theorem generatedSubgroupSet_eq_mathlib_closure {G : Type*} [Group G] (S : Set G) :
    generatedSubgroupSet S = ((Subgroup.closure S : Subgroup G) : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    apply hx ((Subgroup.closure S : Subgroup G) : Set G)
    · exact (subgroupSet_iff_exists_subgroup _).2 ⟨Subgroup.closure S, rfl⟩
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure
  · intro hx H hH hSH
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := (subgroupSet_iff_exists_subgroup H).1 hH
    change x ∈ Subgroup.closure S at hx
    rw [← hK]
    exact (Subgroup.closure_le K |>.mpr (by simpa [hK] using hSH)) hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.subgroup_of_closed
statement:
theorem subgroup_of_closed {G : Type*} [Group G] (S : Set G)
    (h1 : 1 ∈ S) (hmul : ∀ {x y : G}, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → x * y ∈ S)
    (hinv : ∀ {x : G}, x ∈ S → x⁻¹ ∈ S) :
    ∃ H : Subgroup G, ∀ x : G, x ∈ H ↔ x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  let ssm : Subsemigroup G := ⟨S, hmul⟩
  let sm : Submonoid G := ⟨ssm, h1⟩
  let H : Subgroup G := ⟨sm, hinv⟩
  refine ⟨H, ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor <;> intro hx <;> exact hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.right_coset_eq_iff

theorem right_coset_eq_iff {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (a b : G) :

proof:
:= by
  exact _root_.rightCoset_eq_iff H

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.right_coset_mem_self
statement:
theorem right_coset_mem_self {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (a : G) :
    a ∈ MulOpposite.op a • (H : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  exact mem_own_rightCoset H.toSubmonoid a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.left_coset_inter_nonempty_iff_eq
statement:
theorem left_coset_inter_nonempty_iff_eq {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (H : Subgroup G) (a b : G) :
    (a • (H : Set G) ∩ b • (H : Set G)).Nonempty ↔
      a • (H : Set G) = b • (H : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hxa, hxb⟩
    apply (_root_.leftCoset_eq_iff H).2
    have ha : a⁻¹ * x ∈ H := (left_coset_mem_iff H a x).1 hxa
    have hb : b⁻¹ * x ∈ H := (left_coset_mem_iff H b x).1 hxb
    have hid : a⁻¹ * b = (a⁻¹ * x) * (b⁻¹ * x)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [hid]
    exact H.mul_mem ha (H.inv_mem hb)
  · intro hab
    exact ⟨a, left_coset_mem_self H a, hab ▸ left_coset_mem_self H a⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.left_cosets_eq_or_disjoint
statement:
theorem left_cosets_eq_or_disjoint {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (H : Subgroup G) (a b : G) :
    a • (H : Set G) = b • (H : Set G) ∨
      Disjoint (a • (H : Set G)) (b • (H : Set G))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a • (H : Set G) = b • (H : Set G)
  · exact Or.inl hab
  · right
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxa hxb
    exact hab ((left_coset_inter_nonempty_iff_eq H a b).1 ⟨x, hxa, hxb⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.leftCoset_card_eq

theorem leftCoset_card_eq {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (a : G) :

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.lagrange

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.normal_inf
statement:
theorem normal_inf {G : Type*} [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G)

proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.Normal.mk ?_
  intro n hn g
  rw [Subgroup.mem_inf] at hn ⊢
  exact ⟨hH.conj_mem n hn.1 g, hK.conj_mem n hn.2 g⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.normal_mem_comm
statement:
theorem normal_mem_comm {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (nH : H.Normal)
    {a b : G} (h : a * b ∈ H) : b * a ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  
  have h2 := nH.conj_mem (a * b) h b
  have : b * (a * b) * b⁻¹ = b * a := by
    group
  rwa [this] at h2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.normal_bot
statement: theorem normal_bot {G : Type*} [Group G] : (⊥ : Subgroup G).Normal
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.Normal.mk ?_
  intro n hn g
  have hn1 : n = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp hn
  rw [hn1, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
  exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.normal_top
statement: theorem normal_top {G : Type*} [Group G] : (⊤ : Subgroup G).Normal
proof:
:= by

  intro n hn g
  exact Subgroup.mem_top (g * n * g⁻¹)

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.quotientLift_unique
statement:
theorem quotientLift_unique {G N : Type*} [Group G] [Group N]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (f : G →* N) (hker : H ≤ f.ker)
    (q : G ⧸ H →* N) (hq : q.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' H) = f) :
    q = quotientLift H f hker
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H x
  have hqg := DFunLike.congr_fun hq g
  change q (QuotientGroup.mk' H g) = f g at hqg
  rw [hqg, quotientLift_mk]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisDefinitions.fieldEmbedding_ext_bridge
statement:
private theorem fieldEmbedding_ext_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    {f g : FieldEmbedding K L} (h : ∀ x : K, f x = g x) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  cases f with
  | mk ff fh fi =>
    cases g with
    | mk gf gh gi =>
      dsimp at h
      have hfun : ff = gf := funext h
      cases hfun
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisDefinitions.fieldAutomorphismOver_ext_bridge
proof:
:= by
  have hforward : σ.forward = τ.forward := fieldEmbedding_ext_bridge h
  have hinverse : FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ =
      FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse τ := by
    apply fieldEmbedding_ext_bridge
    intro y
    apply τ.forward.injective
    rw [τ.right_inverse]
    rw [← hforward, σ.right_inverse]
  cases σ with
  | mk sf si sli sri sfix =>
    cases τ with
    | mk tf ti tli tri tfix =>
      dsimp at hforward hinverse
      cases hforward
      cases hinverse
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisDefinitions.fieldAutomorphismOver_mul_assoc_bridge
proof:
:= by
  apply fieldAutomorphismOver_ext_bridge
  intro x
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisDefinitions.fixedFieldSet_isSubfield_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedFieldSet_isSubfield_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    SubfieldSet (FixedFieldSet e H)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro σ hσ; exact σ.forward.map_isRingHomomorphism.1
  · intro σ hσ; exact σ.forward.map_isRingHomomorphism.2.1
  · intro x y hx hy σ hσ
    rw [σ.forward.map_isRingHomomorphism.2.2.1, hx σ hσ, hy σ hσ]
  · intro x y hx hy σ hσ
    rw [σ.forward.map_isRingHomomorphism.2.2.2.1, hx σ hσ, hy σ hσ]
  · intro x hx σ hσ
    rw [σ.forward.map_isRingHomomorphism.2.2.2.2, hx σ hσ]
  · intro x hx hne σ hσ
    rw [FieldEmbedding.map_inv, hx σ hσ]

    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    GaloisExtension e ↔
      SeparableExtension e ∧ AlgebraicExtension e ∧
        ∀ p : Polynomial K,
          Irreducible p →

              PolynomialSplitsIn e p

  rw [GaloisExtension, normalExtension_iff_irreducible_with_root_splits]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.RingIsomorphism.toRingEquiv_ofRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem RingIsomorphism.toRingEquiv_ofRingEquiv
    {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S] (e : R ≃+* S) :
    (RingIsomorphism.ofRingEquiv e).toRingEquiv = e
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.RingIsomorphism.ofRingEquiv_toRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem RingIsomorphism.ofRingEquiv_toRingEquiv
    {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S] (e : RingIsomorphism R S) :
    RingIsomorphism.ofRingEquiv e.toRingEquiv = e
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    (I.toTwoSidedIdeal : Set R) = I.carrier
proof:
:= by
  unfold TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal
  apply TwoSidedIdeal.coe_mk'

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) :
    (TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal I).toTwoSidedIdeal = I
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoSidedIdeal.ext
  intro x
  simp [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal,
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal, TwoSidedIdeal.mem_mk']

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal_toTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal_toTwoSidedIdeal
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal I.toTwoSidedIdeal = I
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  ext x
  simp [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal,
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringHomKernelSet_isTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
theorem ringHomKernelSet_isTwoSidedIdeal {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) :
    TwoSidedIdealSet (ringHomKernelSet f)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : (0 : R) ∈ ringHomKernelSet f := hf.1
  have hadd : ∀ ⦃x y : R⦄, x ∈ ringHomKernelSet f → y ∈ ringHomKernelSet f →
      x + y ∈ ringHomKernelSet f := by
    intro x y hx hy
    change f (x + y) = 0
    rw [hf.2.2.1, hx, hy, add_zero]
  have hneg : ∀ ⦃x : R⦄, x ∈ ringHomKernelSet f → -x ∈ ringHomKernelSet f := by
    intro x hx
    change f (-x) = 0
    rw [hf.2.2.2.2, hx, neg_zero]
  exact ⟨⟨hzero, hadd, hneg, by
    intro r x hx
    change f (r * x) = 0
    rw [hf.2.2.2.1, hx, mul_zero]⟩,
    ⟨hzero, hadd, hneg, by
      intro r x hx
      change f (x * r) = 0
      rw [hf.2.2.2.1, hx, zero_mul]⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringHomKernel_toTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringHomKernel_toTwoSidedIdeal {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) :
    (ringHomKernel f hf).toTwoSidedIdeal =
      TwoSidedIdeal.ker (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism f hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringHomRangeMap_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem ringHomRangeMap_is_ringHomomorphism {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) :
    RingHomomorphism (ringHomRangeMap f hf)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Subtype.ext hf.1, Subtype.ext hf.2.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y; exact Subtype.ext (hf.2.2.1 x y)
  · intro x y; exact Subtype.ext (hf.2.2.2.1 x y)
  · intro x; exact Subtype.ext (hf.2.2.2.2 x)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringFirstEquiv_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringFirstEquiv_projection {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (x : R) :
    ringFirstEquiv f hf
      (quotientRingProjection (ringHomKernelSet f)
        (ringHomKernelSet_isTwoSidedIdeal f hf) x) =
      ringHomRangeMap f hf x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ringFirstEquiv
  dsimp only
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringFirstIsomorphism_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringFirstIsomorphism_projection {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (x : R) :
    ringFirstIsomorphism f hf
      (quotientRingProjection (ringHomKernelSet f)
        (ringHomKernelSet_isTwoSidedIdeal f hf) x) =
      ringHomRangeMap f hf x
proof:
:= by
  exact ringFirstEquiv_projection f hf x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealComap_toTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem idealComap_toTwoSidedIdeal {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (J : TwoSidedIdealCarrier S) :
    (idealComap f hf J).toTwoSidedIdeal =
      TwoSidedIdeal.comap (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism f hf) J.toTwoSidedIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.mem_idealComap_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_idealComap_iff {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (J : TwoSidedIdealCarrier S) (x : R) :
    x ∈ idealComap f hf J ↔ f x ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (TwoSidedIdeal.comap (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism f hf)
    J.toTwoSidedIdeal) ↔ f x ∈ J
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_comap]
  change f x ∈ (J.toTwoSidedIdeal : Set S) ↔ f x ∈ (J : Set S)
  rw [J.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealMapDirect_toTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
private theorem idealMapDirect_toTwoSidedIdeal
    {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f)
    (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    (idealMapDirectOfSurjective f hf hsurj I).toTwoSidedIdeal =
      TwoSidedIdeal.map (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism f hf) I.toTwoSidedIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    have hyCarrier : y ∈ (idealMapDirectOfSurjective f hf hsurj I).carrier := by
      change y ∈ ((idealMapDirectOfSurjective f hf hsurj I).toTwoSidedIdeal : Set S) at hy
      rw [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal] at hy
      exact hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hyCarrier
    apply TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span
    exact ⟨x, by
      rw [I.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
      exact hx, rfl⟩
  · apply (TwoSidedIdeal.span_le).2
    rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hxCarrier : x ∈ I.carrier := by
      change x ∈ (I.toTwoSidedIdeal : Set R) at hx
      rw [I.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal] at hx
      exact hx
    change f x ∈ ((idealMapDirectOfSurjective f hf hsurj I).toTwoSidedIdeal : Set S)
    rw [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
    exact ⟨x, hxCarrier, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealMapOfSurjective_toTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem idealMapOfSurjective_toTwoSidedIdeal
    {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f)
    (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    (idealMapOfSurjective f hf hsurj I).toTwoSidedIdeal =
      TwoSidedIdeal.map (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism f hf) I.toTwoSidedIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.mem_idealMapOfSurjective_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_idealMapOfSurjective_iff {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f)
    (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (y : S) :
    y ∈ idealMapOfSurjective f hf hsurj I ↔ ∃ x : R, x ∈ I ∧ f x = y
proof:
:= by
  change y ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.map (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism f hf)
    I.toTwoSidedIdeal ↔ ∃ x : R, x ∈ I ∧ f x = y
  rw [← idealMapDirect_toTwoSidedIdeal f hf hsurj I]
  change y ∈ ((idealMapDirectOfSurjective f hf hsurj I).toTwoSidedIdeal : Set S) ↔ _
  rw [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealComap_mono
statement:
theorem idealComap_mono {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) :
    Monotone (idealComap f hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro I J hIJ x hx
  exact hIJ hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealMapOfSurjective_mono
statement:
theorem idealMapOfSurjective_mono {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    (f : R → S) (hf : RingHomomorphism f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) :
    Monotone (idealMapOfSurjective f hf hsurj)
proof:
:= by
  intro I J hIJ y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ :=
    (mem_idealMapOfSurjective_iff f hf hsurj I y).1 hy
  exact (mem_idealMapOfSurjective_iff f hf hsurj J (f x)).2
    ⟨x, hIJ hx, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingProjection_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientRingProjection_surjective {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) :
    Function.Surjective (quotientRingProjection I hI)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro x
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientIdealComapMap_membership
statement:
theorem quotientIdealComapMap_membership {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (K I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (hKI : K ≤ I) (x : R) :
    x ∈ idealComap (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided) I) ↔ x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealComap_iff, mem_idealMapOfSurjective_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
    have hdiff : y - x ∈ K :=
      (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff K.isTwoSided y x).1 hyx
    have hneg : -(y - x) ∈ I := I.isTwoSided.1.2.2.1 (hKI hdiff)
    have hadd : -(y - x) + y ∈ I := I.isTwoSided.1.2.1 hneg hy
    convert hadd using 1
    noncomm_ring
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientIdealMapComap_membership
statement:
theorem quotientIdealMapComap_membership {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (K : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R)
    (J : TwoSidedIdealCarrier (quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided))
    (q : quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided) :
    q ∈ idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (idealComap (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided) J) ↔ q ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealMapOfSurjective_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_idealComap_iff _ _ _ _).mp hx
  · intro hq
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided q
    exact ⟨x, (mem_idealComap_iff _ _ _ _).2 hq, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientTwoSidedIdeal_comap_map_membership
statement:
private theorem quotientTwoSidedIdeal_comap_map_membership
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (K : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R)
    (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) (hKI : K.toTwoSidedIdeal ≤ I) (x : R) :
    x ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.comap
        (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism
          (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided))
        (TwoSidedIdeal.map
          (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism
            (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
            (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)) I) ↔
      x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  let Iold := TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal I
  have hKIold : K ≤ Iold := by
    intro y hy
    apply hKI
    change y ∈ (K.toTwoSidedIdeal : Set R)
    rw [K.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
    exact hy
  have hIold : Iold.toTwoSidedIdeal = I :=
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal I
  rw [← hIold]
  rw [← idealMapOfSurjective_toTwoSidedIdeal
    (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
    (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
    (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided) Iold]
  rw [← idealComap_toTwoSidedIdeal
    (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
    (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)]
  change x ∈ ((idealComap
      (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (idealMapOfSurjective
        (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided) Iold)).toTwoSidedIdeal : Set R) ↔
    x ∈ (Iold.toTwoSidedIdeal : Set R)
  rw [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal,
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
  exact quotientIdealComapMap_membership K Iold hKIold x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientTwoSidedIdeal_map_comap_membership
statement:
private theorem quotientTwoSidedIdeal_map_comap_membership
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (K : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R)
    (J : TwoSidedIdeal (quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided))
    (q : quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided) :
    q ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.map
        (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism
          (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided))
        (TwoSidedIdeal.comap
          (ringHomOfRingHomomorphism
            (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
            (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)) J) ↔
      q ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  let Jold := TwoSidedIdealCarrier.ofTwoSidedIdeal J
  have hJold : Jold.toTwoSidedIdeal = J :=
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.toTwoSidedIdeal_ofTwoSidedIdeal J
  rw [← hJold]
  rw [← idealComap_toTwoSidedIdeal
    (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
    (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided) Jold]
  rw [← idealMapOfSurjective_toTwoSidedIdeal
    (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
    (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
    (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided)]
  change q ∈ ((idealMapOfSurjective
      (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (quotientRingProjection_surjective K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
      (idealComap
        (quotientRingProjection K.carrier K.isTwoSided)
        (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism K.carrier K.isTwoSided) Jold)).toTwoSidedIdeal :
      Set (quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided)) ↔
    q ∈ (Jold.toTwoSidedIdeal : Set (quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided))
  rw [TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal,
    TwoSidedIdealCarrier.coe_toTwoSidedIdeal]
  exact quotientIdealMapComap_membership K Jold q

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence.toOrderIso_ofOrderIso
statement:
@[simp] theorem QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence.toOrderIso_ofOrderIso
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] {K : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R}
    (e : {I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R // K ≤ I} ≃o
      TwoSidedIdealCarrier (quotientRingSet K.carrier K.isTwoSided)) :
    (QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence.ofOrderIso e).toOrderIso = e
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderIso.ext
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence.ofOrderIso_toOrderIso
statement:
@[simp] theorem QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence.ofOrderIso_toOrderIso
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] {K : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R}
    (e : QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence R K) :
    QuotientIdealOrderEquivalence.ofOrderIso e.toOrderIso = e

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringThirdEquiv_projection_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringThirdEquiv_projection_projection
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I J : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (hIJ : I ≤ J) (x : R) :
    ringThirdEquiv I J hIJ
      (quotientRingProjection
        (idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_surjective I.carrier I.isTwoSided) J).carrier
        (idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_surjective I.carrier I.isTwoSided) J).isTwoSided
        (quotientRingProjection I.carrier I.isTwoSided x)) =
      quotientRingProjection J.carrier J.isTwoSided x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ringThirdEquiv
  dsimp only
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringThirdIsomorphism_projection_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringThirdIsomorphism_projection_projection
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I J : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (hIJ : I ≤ J) (x : R) :
    ringThirdIsomorphism I J hIJ
      (quotientRingProjection
        (idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_surjective I.carrier I.isTwoSided) J).carrier
        (idealMapOfSurjective (quotientRingProjection I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism I.carrier I.isTwoSided)
          (quotientRingProjection_surjective I.carrier I.isTwoSided) J).isTwoSided
        (quotientRingProjection I.carrier I.isTwoSided x)) =
      quotientRingProjection J.carrier J.isTwoSided x
proof:
:= by
  exact ringThirdEquiv_projection_projection I J hIJ x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.mem_subringIdealIntersection_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_subringIdealIntersection_iff {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (A : SubringCarrier R) (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (a : A) :
    a ∈ subringIdealIntersection A I ↔ a.1 ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.mem_subringIdealSum_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_subringIdealSum_iff {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (A : SubringCarrier R) (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (x : R) :
    x ∈ subringIdealSum A I ↔ ∃ a : R, a ∈ A ∧ ∃ i : R, i ∈ I ∧ a + i = x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap_is_ringHomomorphism {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (A : SubringCarrier R) (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    RingHomomorphism (secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap A I)
proof:
:= by
  let L := subringIdealInSum A I
  let ι := subringIdealSumInclusion A I
  have hι : RingHomomorphism ι := by
    refine ⟨Subtype.ext rfl, Subtype.ext rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b; exact Subtype.ext rfl
    · intro a b; exact Subtype.ext rfl
    · intro a; exact Subtype.ext rfl
  exact ⟨by
      change quotientRingProjection L.carrier L.isTwoSided (ι 0) = 0
      rw [hι.1]
      exact (quotientZero_eq_projection L.carrier L.isTwoSided).symm,
    by
      change quotientRingProjection L.carrier L.isTwoSided (ι 1) = 1
      rw [hι.2.1]
      exact (quotientOne_eq_projection L.carrier L.isTwoSided).symm,
    fun a b ↦ by
      change quotientRingProjection L.carrier L.isTwoSided (ι (a + b)) = _
      rw [hι.2.2.1]
      exact (quotientAdd_projection L.carrier L.isTwoSided _ _).symm,
    fun a b ↦ by
      change quotientRingProjection L.carrier L.isTwoSided (ι (a * b)) = _
      rw [hι.2.2.2.1]
      exact (quotientMul_projection L.carrier L.isTwoSided _ _).symm,
    fun a ↦ by
      change quotientRingProjection L.carrier L.isTwoSided (ι (-a)) = _
      rw [hι.2.2.2.2]
      exact (quotientNeg_projection L.carrier L.isTwoSided _).symm⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap_surjective
statement:
theorem secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap_surjective {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (A : SubringCarrier R) (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    Function.Surjective (secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap A I)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro s
  obtain ⟨a, ha, i, hi, hai⟩ := s.2
  let aA : A := ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨aA, ?_⟩
  apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff (subringIdealInSum A I).isTwoSided
    (subringIdealSumInclusion A I aA) s).2
  unfold idealCongruent
  unfold subringIdealSumInclusion
  change ((⟨a, a, ha, 0, I.isTwoSided.1.1, add_zero a⟩ : subringIdealSum A I) - s).1 ∈ I
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  change a + -s.1 ∈ I
  have hneg : -i ∈ I := I.isTwoSided.1.2.2.1 hi
  convert hneg using 1
  rw [← hai]
  abel

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap_kernel
statement:
theorem secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap_kernel {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (A : SubringCarrier R) (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) :
    ringHomKernelSet (secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap A I) =
      (subringIdealIntersection A I).carrier
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  change secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap A I a = 0 ↔ a.1 ∈ I
  unfold secondIsomorphismCanonicalMap
  rw [quotientZero_eq_projection]
  rw [quotientRingProjection_eq_iff]
  unfold idealCongruent
  change ((subringIdealSumInclusion A I a - 0 : subringIdealSum A I)).1 ∈ I ↔ _
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  change (subringIdealSumInclusion A I a).1 + -(0 : subringIdealSum A I).1 ∈ I ↔ _
  change a.1 + -(0 : R) ∈ I ↔ a.1 ∈ I
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingEquivOfEqualIdeals_projection
statement:
private theorem quotientRingEquivOfEqualIdeals_projection
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I)
    (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J) (hEq : I = J) (x : R) :
    quotientRingEquivOfEqualIdeals I J hI hJ hEq
      (quotientRingProjection I hI x) = quotientRingProjection J hJ x
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  have hp : hJ = hI := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hJ
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingIsomorphismOfEqualIdeals_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientRingIsomorphismOfEqualIdeals_projection
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I)
    (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J) (hEq : I = J) (x : R) :
    quotientRingIsomorphismOfEqualIdeals I J hI hJ hEq
      (quotientRingProjection I hI x) = quotientRingProjection J hJ x
proof:
:= by
  exact quotientRingEquivOfEqualIdeals_projection I J hI hJ hEq x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringSecondEquiv_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringSecondEquiv_projection {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (A : SubringCarrier R) (I : TwoSidedIdealCarrier R) (a : A) :
    ringSecondEquiv A I
      (quotientRingProjection (subringIdealIntersection A I).carrier
        (subringIdealIntersection A I).isTwoSided a) =
      quotientRingProjection (subringIdealInSum A I).carrier
        (subringIdealInSum A I).isTwoSided
        (subringIdealSumInclusion A I a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ringSecondEquiv
  dsimp only
  simp only [RingEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [quotientRingEquivOfEqualIdeals_projection, ringFirstEquiv_projection]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.ringSecondIsomorphism_projection
statement:

    ringSecondIsomorphism A I
      (quotientRingProjection (subringIdealIntersection A I).carrier
        (subringIdealIntersection A I).isTwoSided a) =
      quotientRingProjection (subringIdealInSum A I).carrier
        (subringIdealInSum A I).isTwoSided
        (subringIdealSumInclusion A I a)
proof:
:= by
  exact ringSecondEquiv_projection A I a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fixing_preservesIntermediateField_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixing_preservesIntermediateField_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hfix : σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier) :
    PreservesIntermediateField σ F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    rw [hfix x hx]
    exact hx
  · intro x hx
    have hinverse :
        SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ x =
          x := by
      apply σ.forward.injective
      rw [σ.right_inverse, hfix x hx]
    rw [hinverse]
    exact hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fixing_iff_restrictAutomorphism_eq_identity_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixing_iff_restrictAutomorphism_eq_identity_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hσ : PreservesIntermediateField σ F) :
    σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier ↔
      restrictAutomorphism F σ hσ =
        (1 : FieldAutomorphismOver (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hfix
    apply FieldAutomorphismOver.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [restrictAutomorphism_apply, hfix x.val x.property,
      fieldAutomorphismOver_identity_apply]
  · intro heq x hx
    let y : IntermediateFieldCarrier F := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hpoint := congrArg (fun τ => τ.forward y) heq
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hpoint
    rw [restrictAutomorphism_apply, fieldAutomorphismOver_identity_apply] at hval
    exact hval

    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (hσ : PreservesIntermediateField σ F) :
    σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier ↔
      restrictAutomorphism F σ hσ =
        (1 : FieldAutomorphismOver (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F))
proof:
:=
  fixing_iff_restrictAutomorphism_eq_identity_bridge F σ hσ

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_bridge
statement:
private theorem fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (FieldAutomorphismOver e ≃ (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact ⟨fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_equiv e⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.intermediateFieldSet_mathlibIntermediateField_bridge
statement:
private theorem intermediateFieldSet_mathlibIntermediateField_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (E : Set L) (hE : IntermediateFieldSet e E) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ F : IntermediateField K L, (F : Set L) = E
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  refine ⟨{
    carrier := E
    zero_mem' := hE.1.1.1
    one_mem' := hE.1.1.2.1
    add_mem' := fun {a b} hx hy => hE.1.1.2.2.1 hx hy
    mul_mem' := fun {a b} hx hy => hE.1.1.2.2.2.1 hx hy
    algebraMap_mem' := ?_
    inv_mem' := fun x hx => ?_ }, rfl⟩
  · intro x
    apply hE.2
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · by_cases hx0 : x = 0
    · simpa [hx0] using hE.1.1.1
    · exact hE.1.2 hx hx0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.subgroup_mathlibSubgroup_bridge
statement:
private theorem subgroup_mathlibSubgroup_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L),
      ∃ φ : FieldAutomorphismOver e ≃ (L ≃ₐ[K] L),
        φ '' (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) =
            (G : Set (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) ∧
          ∀ σ x, φ σ x = σ.forward x
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let φ := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_equiv e
  let G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L) :=
    { carrier := φ '' (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
      one_mem' := by
        refine ⟨1, H.one_mem, ?_⟩
        apply AlgEquiv.ext
        intro x
        rfl
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro _ _ ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩ ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨σ * τ, H.mul_mem hσ hτ, ?_⟩
        apply AlgEquiv.ext
        intro x
        rfl
      inv_mem' := by
        rintro _ ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨σ⁻¹, H.inv_mem hσ, ?_⟩
        apply AlgEquiv.ext
        intro x
        rfl }
  refine ⟨G, φ, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro σ x
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteFieldExtension_mathlibFiniteDimensional_bridge
statement:
private theorem finiteFieldExtension_mathlibFiniteDimensional_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FiniteFieldExtension e → Nonempty (FiniteDimensional K L)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rintro ⟨n, b, hb⟩
  have hsum (c : Fin n → K) :
      fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = ∑ i, c i • b i := by
    simp only [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, FieldEmbedding.toRingHom]
    rfl
  have hli : LinearIndependent K b := by
    apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
    intro c hc i
    apply hb.1 c
    rw [hsum]
    exact hc
  have hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range b) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb.2 x
    apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mpr
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rw [← hsum]
    exact hc
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin n) K L := Module.Basis.mk hli hspan.ge
  exact ⟨Module.Finite.of_basis B⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.galoisExtension_mathlibIsGalois_bridge
statement:
private theorem galoisExtension_mathlibIsGalois_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    GaloisExtension e → Nonempty (IsGalois K L)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rintro ⟨hsep, hnormal⟩
  exact ⟨isGalois_iff.mpr
    ⟨(separableExtension_iff_mathlibIsSeparable e).mp hsep,
      (normalExtension_iff_mathlibNormal e).mp hnormal⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_mathlibBackend
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_mathlibBackend
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e) (hgal : GaloisExtension e) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (FiniteDimensional K L) ∧ Nonempty (IsGalois K L)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact ⟨finiteFieldExtension_mathlibFiniteDimensional_bridge e hfin,
    galoisExtension_mathlibIsGalois_bridge e hgal⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fixedField_fixing_carrier_alignment_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_fixing_carrier_alignment_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (E : Set L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)),
      IntermediateFieldSet e E →
      (E ⊆ FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) ↔
        (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) ⊆
          FixingAutomorphismSet e E)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact fun E H (_ : IntermediateFieldSet e E) =>
    intermediate_subset_fixedFieldSet_iff E
      (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fixing_eq_fixingClosure_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixing_eq_fixingClosure_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier =
      FixingAutomorphismSet e
        (fixingClosureExplicitIntermediate_bridge F).carrier
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact subset_fixingAutomorphismSet_fixedFieldSet e
      (FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier)
  · apply fixingAutomorphismSet_antitone
    exact subset_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.relativeAutomorphism_mathlibAlgEquiv_bridge
statement:
private theorem relativeAutomorphism_mathlibAlgEquiv_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    letI : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
      (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ φ : FieldAutomorphismOver (intermediateFieldInclusion F) ≃
        (L ≃ₐ[IntermediateFieldCarrier F] L),
      ∀ σ x, φ σ x = σ.forward x
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let φ := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_equiv
    (intermediateFieldInclusion F)
  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
  intro σ x
