name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.relative_finiteDimensional_isGalois_bridge
statement:
private theorem relative_finiteDimensional_isGalois_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    letI : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
      (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (FiniteDimensional (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L) ∧
      Nonempty (IsGalois (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : IsScalarTower K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    exact intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding_apply F x
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    Classical.choice (finiteFieldExtension_mathlibFiniteDimensional_bridge e hfin)
  let _ : IsGalois K L :=
    Classical.choice (galoisExtension_mathlibIsGalois_bridge e hgal)
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    FiniteDimensional.right K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L
  have hgalois : IsGalois (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    IsGalois.tower_top_of_isGalois K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L
  exact ⟨⟨hfd⟩, ⟨hgalois⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.relative_hasExtensionDegree_iff_finrank_bridge
statement:
private theorem relative_hasExtensionDegree_iff_finrank_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (n : ℕ) :
    letI : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
      (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L →
      (HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n ↔
        Module.finrank (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L = n)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro hfd
  let _ : FiniteDimensional (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L := hfd
  let j := intermediateFieldInclusion F
  have hsum (v : Fin n → L) (c : Fin n → IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :
      fieldLinearCombination j Finset.univ c v = ∑ i, c i • v i := by
    simp only [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, FieldEmbedding.toRingHom]
    rfl
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    have hli : LinearIndependent (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) v := by
      apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
      intro c hc i
      apply hv.1 c
      rw [hsum]
      exact hc
    have hspan : Submodule.span (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
      apply top_unique
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv.2 x
      apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
        (IntermediateFieldCarrier F)).mpr
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      rw [← hsum]
      exact hc
    let B : Module.Basis (Fin n) (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
      Module.Basis.mk hli hspan.ge
    simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B
  · intro hrank
    let B : Module.Basis (Fin n) (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
      Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L hrank
    refine ⟨fun i => B i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c hc i
      apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp B.linearIndependent c
      rw [← hsum]
      exact hc
    · intro x
      have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (IntermediateFieldCarrier F)
          (Set.range fun i => B i) := by
        rw [B.span_eq]
        trivial
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
        (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
          (IntermediateFieldCarrier F)).mp hx
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      rw [hsum]
      exact hc

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n ∧
        Nat.card {σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e //
          σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier} = n
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨hfd, hgalois⟩ :=
    relative_finiteDimensional_isGalois_bridge e hfin hgal F
  let _ : FiniteDimensional (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    Classical.choice hfd
  let _ : IsGalois (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    Classical.choice hgalois
  let n := Module.finrank (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L
  have hdegree : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n :=
    (relative_hasExtensionDegree_iff_finrank_bridge F n
      (inferInstance : FiniteDimensional (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L)).mpr rfl
  let ψ := fixingAutomorphism_relative_equiv_bridge F
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := relativeAutomorphism_mathlibAlgEquiv_bridge F
  have hcardψ : Nat.card {σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e //
      σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier} =
      Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver (intermediateFieldInclusion F)) :=
    Nat.card_congr ψ
  have hcardφ : Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver (intermediateFieldInclusion F)) =
      Nat.card (L ≃ₐ[IntermediateFieldCarrier F] L) :=
    Nat.card_congr φ
  have hcardMathlib : Nat.card (L ≃ₐ[IntermediateFieldCarrier F] L) = n :=
    IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L
  exact ⟨n, hdegree, hcardψ.trans (hcardφ.trans hcardMathlib)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.intermediate_and_fixingClosure_sameDegree_bridge
statement:
private theorem intermediate_and_fixingClosure_sameDegree_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n ∧
        HasExtensionDegree
          (intermediateFieldInclusion
            (fixingClosureExplicitIntermediate_bridge F)) n
proof:
:= by
  let G := fixingClosureExplicitIntermediate_bridge F
  obtain ⟨n, hdegreeF, hcardF⟩ :=
    fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree_bridge e hfin hgal F
  obtain ⟨m, hdegreeG, hcardG⟩ :=
    fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree_bridge e hfin hgal G
  have hfixing : FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier =
      FixingAutomorphismSet e G.carrier :=
    fixing_eq_fixingClosure_bridge F
  have hnm : n = m := by
    rw [hfixing] at hcardF
    exact hcardF.symm.trans hcardG
  have hdegreeG' : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion G) n :=
    hnm.symm ▸ hdegreeG
  exact ⟨n, hdegreeF, by simpa [G] using hdegreeG'⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge
statement:
private theorem hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge
    {A B : Type*} [Field A] [Field B] (j : FieldEmbedding A B)
    (n : ℕ) (h : HasExtensionDegree j n) :
    letI : Algebra A B := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) A B)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra A B := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
  have hsum (c : Fin n → A) :
      fieldLinearCombination j Finset.univ c v = ∑ i, c i • v i := by
    simp only [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, FieldEmbedding.toRingHom]
    rfl
  have hli : LinearIndependent A v := by
    apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
    intro c hc i
    apply hv.1 c
    rw [hsum]
    exact hc
  have hspan : Submodule.span A (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv.2 x
    apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun A).mpr
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rw [← hsum]
    exact hc
  exact ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli hspan.ge⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.intermediate_carrier_eq_of_subset_sameDegree_bridge
statement:
private theorem intermediate_carrier_eq_of_subset_sameDegree_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F G : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (hFG : F.carrier ⊆ G.carrier)
    (n : ℕ) (hF : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n)
    (hG : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion G) n) :
    F.carrier = G.carrier
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let MF : IntermediateField K L :=
    { carrier := F.carrier
      zero_mem' := F.isIntermediate.1.1.1
      one_mem' := F.isIntermediate.1.1.2.1
      add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => F.isIntermediate.1.1.2.2.1 ha hb
      mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => F.isIntermediate.1.1.2.2.2.1 ha hb
      algebraMap_mem' := fun x => F.isIntermediate.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩
      inv_mem' := fun x hx => by
        by_cases hx0 : x = 0
        · simpa [hx0] using F.isIntermediate.1.1.1
        · exact F.isIntermediate.1.2 hx hx0 }
  let MG : IntermediateField K L :=
    { carrier := G.carrier
      zero_mem' := G.isIntermediate.1.1.1
      one_mem' := G.isIntermediate.1.1.2.1
      add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => G.isIntermediate.1.1.2.2.1 ha hb
      mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => G.isIntermediate.1.1.2.2.2.1 ha hb
      algebraMap_mem' := fun x => G.isIntermediate.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩
      inv_mem' := fun x hx => by
        by_cases hx0 : x = 0
        · simpa [hx0] using G.isIntermediate.1.1.1
        · exact G.isIntermediate.1.2 hx hx0 }
  have hle : MF ≤ MG := hFG
  let _ : Field MF := intermediateFieldCarrierField F
  let _ : Field MG := intermediateFieldCarrierField G
  let _ : Algebra MF L := (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra MG L := (intermediateFieldInclusion G).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let BF : Module.Basis (Fin n) MF L := Classical.choice
    (hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge
      (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n hF)
  let BG : Module.Basis (Fin n) MG L := Classical.choice
    (hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge
      (intermediateFieldInclusion G) n hG)
  let _ : FiniteDimensional MF L := Module.Finite.of_basis BF
  have hfinrankF : Module.finrank MF L = n := by
    simpa [BF] using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis BF
  have hfinrankG : Module.finrank MG L = n := by
    simpa [BG] using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis BG
  have hfields : MF = MG :=
    IntermediateField.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq' hle
      (hfinrankF.trans hfinrankG.symm)
  exact congrArg (fun P : IntermediateField K L => (P : Set L)) hfields

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.mathlib_subgroup_fixingFixed_card_eq_bridge
statement:
private theorem mathlib_subgroup_fixingFixed_card_eq_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (G : Subgroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) (hfinite : Finite G) :
    Nat.card G =
      Nat.card (IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup
        (IntermediateField.fixedField G))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite G := hfinite
  apply Nat.card_congr
  refine (FixedPoints.toAlgHomEquiv G L).trans ?_
  refine (algEquivEquivAlgHom (IntermediateField.fixedField G) L).toEquiv.symm.trans ?_
  exact (IntermediateField.fixingSubgroupEquiv
    (IntermediateField.fixedField G)).toEquiv.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.transport_subtype_card_eq_bridge
statement:
private theorem transport_subtype_card_eq_bridge
    {A B C D : Type*} (eAC : A ≃ C) (eBD : B ≃ D)
    (hCD : Nat.card C = Nat.card D) : Nat.card A = Nat.card B
proof:
:= by
  exact (Nat.card_congr eAC).trans (hCD.trans (Nat.card_congr eBD).symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed_bridge
statement:
private theorem subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    Nat.card H =
      Nat.card (fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
        (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨G, φ, hG, hφ⟩ := subgroup_mathlibSubgroup_bridge e H
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    Classical.choice (finiteFieldExtension_mathlibFiniteDimensional_bridge e hfin)
  let _ : Fintype (L ≃ₐ[K] L) := AlgEquiv.fintype K L
  let hfiniteG : Finite G := inferInstance
  let eHG := subgroupSubtype_mathlibSubgroup_equiv_bridge e H G φ hG
  let eFix := fixingFixedSubtype_mathlib_equiv_bridge e H G φ hG hφ
  exact transport_subtype_card_eq_bridge eHG eFix
    (mathlib_subgroup_fixingFixed_card_eq_bridge G hfiniteG)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.subgroup_and_fixingFixed_finite_bridge
statement:
private theorem subgroup_and_fixingFixed_finite_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    Finite H ∧
      Finite (fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
        (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    Classical.choice (finiteFieldExtension_mathlibFiniteDimensional_bridge e hfin)
  let _ : Fintype (L ≃ₐ[K] L) := AlgEquiv.fintype K L
  let φ := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_equiv e
  let _ : Finite (FieldAutomorphismOver e) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (L ≃ₐ[K] L) φ.symm
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finite_set_eq_of_subset_card_eq_bridge
statement:
private theorem finite_set_eq_of_subset_card_eq_bridge
    {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (hA : Finite {x : α // x ∈ A}) (hB : Finite {x : α // x ∈ B})
    (hcard : Nat.card {x : α // x ∈ A} = Nat.card {x : α // x ∈ B}) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite {x : α // x ∈ A} := hA
  let _ : Finite {x : α // x ∈ B} := hB
  have hBfinite : B.Finite :=
    Set.finite_def.mpr ⟨Fintype.ofFinite {x : α // x ∈ B}⟩
  exact hBfinite.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (le_of_eq hcard.symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.fixingAutomorphismSet_eq_fixingClosure
statement:
theorem fixingAutomorphismSet_eq_fixingClosure
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier =
      FixingAutomorphismSet e (fixingClosureIntermediateField F).carrier
proof:
:=
  fixing_eq_fixingClosure_bridge F

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n ∧
        Nat.card {σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e //
          σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier} = n
proof:
:=
  fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree_bridge e hfin hgal F

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_automorphism_card_eq_degree
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_automorphism_card_eq_degree
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hgal : GaloisExtension e) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : HasExtensionDegree e d) :
    Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver e) = d
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin d) K L :=
    Classical.choice (hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge e d hd)
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L := Module.Finite.of_basis B
  let _ : IsGalois K L :=
    Classical.choice (galoisExtension_mathlibIsGalois_bridge e hgal)
  let φ := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_equiv e
  calc
    Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver e) = Nat.card (L ≃ₐ[K] L) :=
      Nat.card_congr φ
    _ = Module.finrank K L := IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L
    _ = d := by simpa [B] using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_intermediate_fixingClosure_sameDegree
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_intermediate_fixingClosure_sameDegree
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n ∧
        HasExtensionDegree
          (intermediateFieldInclusion (fixingClosureIntermediateField F)) n
proof:
:= by
  let G := fixingClosureIntermediateField F
  obtain ⟨n, hdegreeF, hcardF⟩ :=
    finiteGalois_fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree e hfin hgal F
  obtain ⟨m, hdegreeG, hcardG⟩ :=
    finiteGalois_fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree e hfin hgal G
  have hfixing : FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier =
      FixingAutomorphismSet e G.carrier :=
    fixingAutomorphismSet_eq_fixingClosure F
  have hnm : n = m := by
    rw [hfixing] at hcardF
    exact hcardF.symm.trans hcardG
  have hdegreeG' : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion G) n :=
    hnm.symm ▸ hdegreeG
  exact ⟨n, hdegreeF, by simpa [G] using hdegreeG'⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.intermediateFieldCarrier_eq_of_subset_sameDegree
statement:
theorem intermediateFieldCarrier_eq_of_subset_sameDegree
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] {e : FieldEmbedding K L}
    (F G : ExplicitIntermediateField e) (hFG : F.carrier ⊆ G.carrier)
    (n : ℕ) (hF : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n)
    (hG : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion G) n) :
    F.carrier = G.carrier
proof:
:=
  intermediate_carrier_eq_of_subset_sameDegree_bridge F G hFG n hF hG

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteExtension_subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed
statement:
theorem finiteExtension_subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) (hH : SubgroupSet H) :
    Nat.card {σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e // σ ∈ H} =
      Nat.card {σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e //
        σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e (FixedFieldSet e H)}
proof:
:= by
  let H' : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e) := hH.toSubgroup H
  change Nat.card H' =
    Nat.card (fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
      (FixedFieldSet e (H' : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))))
  exact subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed_bridge e hfin H'

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteExtension_subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed_subgroup
statement:
theorem finiteExtension_subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed_subgroup
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    Nat.card H =
      Nat.card (fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
        (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))))
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet_bridge
statement:
private theorem finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e) (hgal : GaloisExtension e)
    (E : Set L) (hE : IntermediateFieldSet e E) :
    FixedFieldSet e (FixingAutomorphismSet e E) = E
proof:
:= by
  let F : ExplicitIntermediateField e := ⟨E, hE⟩
  let G := fixingClosureIntermediateField F
  obtain ⟨n, hdegreeF, hdegreeG⟩ :=
    finiteGalois_intermediate_fixingClosure_sameDegree e hfin hgal F
  have hFG : F.carrier ⊆ G.carrier := by
    exact subset_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet e E
  have heq : F.carrier = G.carrier :=
    intermediateFieldCarrier_eq_of_subset_sameDegree
      F G hFG n hdegreeF hdegreeG
  exact heq.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet_bridge
statement:
private theorem finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
      (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))) = H
proof:
:= by
  let B := fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
    (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)))
  have hHB : (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) ⊆
      (B : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) := by
    intro σ hσ
    change σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e
      (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)))
    exact subset_fixingAutomorphismSet_fixedFieldSet e
      (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) hσ
  have hcard : Nat.card H = Nat.card B :=
    subgroup_card_eq_fixingFixed_bridge e hfin H
  obtain ⟨hfiniteH, hfiniteB⟩ :=
    subgroup_and_fixingFixed_finite_bridge e hfin H
  have hsets : (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) =
      (B : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :=
    finite_set_eq_of_subset_card_eq_bridge
      (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
      (B : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
      hHB hfiniteH hfiniteB hcard
  exact Subgroup.ext (Set.ext_iff.mp hsets.symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e) (hgal : GaloisExtension e)
    (E : Set L) (hE : IntermediateFieldSet e E) :
    FixedFieldSet e (FixingAutomorphismSet e E) = E

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSet_fixedFieldSet
statement:
theorem finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSet_fixedFieldSet
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) (hH : SubgroupSet H) :
    FixingAutomorphismSet e (FixedFieldSet e H) = H
proof:
:= by
  let H' : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e) := hH.toSubgroup H
  have hrecover :=
    finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet_bridge
      e hfin H'
  have hcarrier := congrArg
    (fun P : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e) =>
      (P : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))) hrecover
  rw [fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_carrier,
    SubgroupSet.coe_toSubgroup H hH] at hcarrier
  exact hcarrier

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet
statement:
theorem finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
      (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))) = H

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e) (hgal : GaloisExtension e)
    (E : Set L) (hE : IntermediateFieldSet e E) :
    FixedFieldSet e
      (fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e E :
        Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) = E

    finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet
      e hfin hgal E hE

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_fundamental_correspondence
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fundamental_correspondence
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e) (hgal : GaloisExtension e) :
    (∀ E : Set L, IntermediateFieldSet e E →
      FixedFieldSet e (FixingAutomorphismSet e E) = E) ∧
    (∀ H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e), SubgroupSet H →
      FixingAutomorphismSet e (FixedFieldSet e H) = H)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro E hE
    exact finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSet e hfin hgal E hE
  · intro H hH
    exact finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSet_fixedFieldSet e hfin H hH

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldGaloisCorrespondence.finiteGalois_fundamental_correspondence_subgroup
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fundamental_correspondence_subgroup
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e) (hgal : GaloisExtension e) :
    (∀ E : Set L, IntermediateFieldSet e E →
      FixedFieldSet e
        (fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e E :
          Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) = E) ∧
    (∀ H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e),
      fixingAutomorphismSubgroup e
        (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))) = H)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro E hE
    exact finiteGalois_fixedFieldSet_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup
      e hfin hgal E hE
  · intro H
    exact finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet
      e hfin H

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedField_preserves_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_preserves_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e) :
    PreservesIntermediateField σ (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx τ hτ
    have hconj : σ⁻¹ * τ * σ ∈ H := hH.conj_mem' τ hτ σ
    have hfixed := hx (σ⁻¹ * τ * σ) hconj
    have happly := congrArg σ.forward hfixed
    change
      σ.forward
          (SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ
            (τ.forward (σ.forward x))) = σ.forward x at happly
    rwa [σ.right_inverse] at happly
  · intro x hx τ hτ
    have hconj : σ * τ * σ⁻¹ ∈ H := by
      simpa using hH.conj_mem' τ hτ σ⁻¹
    have hfixed := hx (σ * τ * σ⁻¹) hconj
    have happly := congrArg
      (SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ)
      hfixed
    change
      SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ
          (σ.forward (τ.forward
            (SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ
              x))) =
        SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.FieldIsomorphismOver.inverse σ x at happly
    rwa [σ.left_inverse] at happly

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedField_restriction_laws_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_restriction_laws_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) :
    (restrictAutomorphism (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H) 1
        (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH 1) = 1) ∧
      ∀ σ τ : FieldAutomorphismOver e,
        restrictAutomorphism (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H) (σ * τ)
            (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH (σ * τ)) =
          restrictAutomorphism (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H) σ
              (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH σ) *
            restrictAutomorphism (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H) τ
              (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH τ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply FieldAutomorphismOver.ext
    intro x
    exact restrictAutomorphism_identity_apply (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H) x
  · intro σ τ
    apply FieldAutomorphismOver.ext
    intro x
    exact restrictAutomorphism_comp_apply
      (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H) σ τ
      (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH σ)
      (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH τ) x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldRestrictionHom_apply
statement:
theorem fixedFieldRestrictionHom_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e)
    (x : IntermediateFieldCarrier (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)) :
    ((fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH σ).forward x).val = σ.forward x.val
proof:
:= by
  exact restrictAutomorphism_apply _ _ _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldRestrictionHom_ker_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedFieldRestrictionHom_ker_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) (hH : H.Normal) :
    (fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH).ker = H
proof:
:= by
  let F := fixedFieldIntermediateField e H
  have hrecover :
      FixingAutomorphismSet e (FixedFieldSet e (H : Set _)) = (H : Set _) :=
    congrArg
      (fun S : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e) =>
        (S : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)))
      (finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet e hfin H)
  ext σ
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
  change
    restrictAutomorphism F σ (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH σ) = 1 ↔
      σ ∈ H
  have hmem :
      σ ∈ FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier ↔ σ ∈ H := by
    simpa [F, fixedFieldIntermediateField] using
      (Set.ext_iff.mp hrecover σ)
  exact (fixing_iff_restrictAutomorphism_eq_identity F σ
    (fixedField_preserves_bridge e H hH σ)).symm.trans hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldRestrictionHom_ker
statement:
theorem fixedFieldRestrictionHom_ker
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]

    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) (hH : H.Normal) :
    (fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH).ker = H
proof:
:=
  fixedFieldRestrictionHom_ker_bridge e hfin H hH

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) : Function.Surjective (fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH)
proof:
:= by
  let F := fixedFieldIntermediateField e H
  let _ : Algebra K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L :=
    (intermediateFieldInclusion F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : IsScalarTower K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) L := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    exact intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding_apply F x
  obtain ⟨⟨hfd⟩, ⟨hmg⟩⟩ := finiteGalois_mathlibBackend e hfin hgal
  let _ : FiniteDimensional K L := hfd
  let _ : IsGalois K L := hmg
  have hn : NormalExtension (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) := by
    exact (subgroup_normal_iff_fixedField_normalExtension
      e hfin hgal H).mp hH
  let _ : Normal K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    (normalExtension_iff_mathlibNormal
      (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F)).mp hn
  let φ := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_mulEquiv e
  let φF := fieldAutomorphismOver_mathlibAlgEquiv_mulEquiv
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F)
  intro y
  change FieldAutomorphismOver (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) at y
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
    AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective
      (F := K) (K₁ := IntermediateFieldCarrier F) (E := L) (φF y)
  let σ := φ.symm g
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  apply φF.injective
  rw [← hg]
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    ((fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH σ).forward x).val =
      ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (IntermediateFieldCarrier F)) g x).val
  rw [fixedFieldRestrictionHom_apply]
  have hφσ : φ σ = g := φ.apply_symm_apply g
  have hpoint := congrArg (fun q : L ≃ₐ[K] L => q x.val) hφσ
  have hrestrict := AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes
    g (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) x
  exact hpoint.trans hrestrict.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective
statement:
theorem fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) : Function.Surjective (fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH)
proof:
:=
  fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective_bridge e hfin hgal H hH

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldRestrictionHom_range
statement:
theorem fixedFieldRestrictionHom_range
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) : (fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH).range = ⊤

:=
  MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr
    (fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective e hfin hgal H hH)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldQuotientEquiv_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedFieldQuotientEquiv_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) :
    letI : H.Normal := hH
    ∃ q : FieldAutomorphismOver e ⧸ H ≃*
        FieldAutomorphismOver
          (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)),
      ∀ σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e,
        q (QuotientGroup.mk σ) = fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH σ
proof:
:= by
  let _ : H.Normal := hH
  let f := fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH
  have hker : f.ker = H := fixedFieldRestrictionHom_ker e hfin H hH
  let qker : FieldAutomorphismOver e ⧸ f.ker ≃*
      FieldAutomorphismOver
        (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)) :=
    QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective f
      (fixedFieldRestrictionHom_surjective e hfin hgal H hH)
  let qchange : FieldAutomorphismOver e ⧸ H ≃*
      FieldAutomorphismOver e ⧸ f.ker :=
    QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq hker.symm
  refine ⟨qchange.trans qker, ?_⟩
  intro σ
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesRestriction.fixedFieldQuotientEquiv_mk_apply
statement:
theorem fixedFieldQuotientEquiv_mk_apply
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e) (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e))
    (hH : H.Normal) (σ : FieldAutomorphismOver e) :
    letI : H.Normal := hH
    fixedFieldQuotientEquiv e hfin hgal H hH (QuotientGroup.mk σ) =
      fixedFieldRestrictionHom e H hH σ
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (fixedFieldQuotientEquiv_bridge e hfin hgal H hH) σ

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Poly.irreducible_mul_iff
statement:
theorem irreducible_mul_iff {M : Type*} [Monoid M] {p : M} (hp : Irreducible p)
    {a b : M} (hab : p = a * b) : IsUnit a ∨ IsUnit b
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealCongruent_equivalence
statement:
theorem idealCongruent_equivalence {R : Type*} [Ring R] {I : Set R}
    (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) : Equivalence (idealCongruent I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    simpa [idealCongruent] using hI.1.1
  · intro x y hxy
    have hneg : -(x - y) ∈ I := hI.1.2.2.1 hxy
    simpa [idealCongruent] using hneg
  · intro x y z hxy hyz
    have hadd : (x - y) + (y - z) ∈ I := hI.1.2.1 hxy hyz
    simpa [idealCongruent] using hadd

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingProjection_eq_iff
proof:
:= by
  exact Quotient.eq

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealCongruent_add
proof:
:= by
  have hadd : (a - a') + (b - b') ∈ I := hI.1.2.1 ha hb
  change a + b - (a' + b') ∈ I
  convert hadd using 1
  all_goals noncomm_ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealCongruent_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hright : (a - a') * b ∈ I := hI.2.2.2.2 b ha
  have hleft : a' * (b - b') ∈ I := hI.1.2.2.2 a' hb
  have hadd := hI.1.2.1 hright hleft
  change a * b - a' * b' ∈ I
  convert hadd using 1
  all_goals noncomm_ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealCongruent_neg
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : -(a - b) ∈ I := hI.1.2.2.1 hab
  change -a - -b ∈ I
  convert hneg using 1
  all_goals noncomm_ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientAdd_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAdd_projection (a b : R) :
    quotientRingProjection I hI a + quotientRingProjection I hI b =
      quotientRingProjection I hI (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  change quotientAdd I hI (Quotient.mk _ a) (Quotient.mk _ b) = Quotient.mk _ (a + b)
  unfold quotientAdd
  apply Quotient.map₂_mk

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientMul_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientMul_projection (a b : R) :
    quotientRingProjection I hI a * quotientRingProjection I hI b =
      quotientRingProjection I hI (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  change quotientMul I hI (Quotient.mk _ a) (Quotient.mk _ b) = Quotient.mk _ (a * b)
  unfold quotientMul
  apply Quotient.map₂_mk

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientNeg_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientNeg_projection (a : R) :
    -(quotientRingProjection I hI a) = quotientRingProjection I hI (-a)
proof:
:= by
  change quotientNeg I hI (Quotient.mk _ a) = Quotient.mk _ (-a)
  unfold quotientNeg
  apply Quotient.map_mk

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientZero_eq_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientZero_eq_projection :
    (0 : quotientRingSet I hI) = quotientRingProjection I hI 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientOne_eq_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientOne_eq_projection :
    (1 : quotientRingSet I hI) = quotientRingProjection I hI 1
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSet_ringAxioms
statement: theorem quotientRingSet_ringAxioms : RingAxioms (quotientRingSet I hI)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    intro a b c
    change quotientRingProjection I hI ((a + b) + c) =
      quotientRingProjection I hI (a + (b + c))
    rw [add_assoc]
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro a
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (0 + a) = quotientRingProjection I hI a
    rw [zero_add]
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro a
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (a + 0) = quotientRingProjection I hI a
    rw [add_zero]
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro a
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (-a + a) = quotientRingProjection I hI 0
    rw [neg_add_cancel]
  · intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    intro a b
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (a + b) = quotientRingProjection I hI (b + a)
    rw [add_comm]
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    intro a b c
    change quotientRingProjection I hI ((a * b) * c) =
      quotientRingProjection I hI (a * (b * c))
    rw [mul_assoc]
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro a
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (1 * a) = quotientRingProjection I hI a
    rw [one_mul]
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro a
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (a * 1) = quotientRingProjection I hI a
    rw [mul_one]
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    intro a b c
    change quotientRingProjection I hI (a * (b + c)) =
      quotientRingProjection I hI (a * b + a * c)
    rw [mul_add]
  · intro x y z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₃ x y z ?_
    intro a b c
    change quotientRingProjection I hI ((a + b) * c) =
      quotientRingProjection I hI (a * c + b * c)
    rw [add_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism :
    RingHomomorphism (quotientRingProjection I hI)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨(quotientZero_eq_projection I hI).symm,
    (quotientOne_eq_projection I hI).symm,
    fun x y => (quotientAdd_projection I hI x y).symm,
    fun x y => (quotientMul_projection I hI x y).symm,
    fun x => (quotientNeg_projection I hI x).symm⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingProjection_kernel
statement:
theorem quotientRingProjection_kernel :
    {x : R | quotientRingProjection I hI x = 0} = I
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [quotientZero_eq_projection]
  simpa [idealCongruent] using quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI x 0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSetLift_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientRingSetLift_projection (x : R) :
    quotientRingSetLift I hI f hf hker (quotientRingProjection I hI x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold quotientRingSetLift quotientRingProjection
  apply Quotient.lift_mk

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSetLift_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem quotientRingSetLift_is_ringHomomorphism :
    RingHomomorphism (quotientRingSetLift I hI f hf hker)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change f 0 = 0
    exact hf.1
  · change f 1 = 1
    exact hf.2.1
  · intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    intro a b
    change f (a + b) = f a + f b
    exact hf.2.2.1 a b
  · intro x y
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
    intro a b
    change f (a * b) = f a * f b
    exact hf.2.2.2.1 a b
  · intro x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
    intro a
    change f (-a) = -(f a)
    exact hf.2.2.2.2 a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSetLift_pointwise_unique
statement:
theorem quotientRingSetLift_pointwise_unique (g : quotientRingSet I hI → S)
    (htriangle : ∀ x : R, g (quotientRingProjection I hI x) = f x) :
    g = quotientRingSetLift I hI f hf hker
proof:
:= by
  funext q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
  intro x
  exact htriangle x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSetLift_unique
statement:
theorem quotientRingSetLift_unique (g : quotientRingSet I hI → S)
    (_hg : RingHomomorphism g)
    (htriangle : ∀ x : R, g (quotientRingProjection I hI x) = f x) :
    g = quotientRingSetLift I hI f hf hker
proof:
:= by
  exact quotientRingSetLift_pointwise_unique I hI f hf hker g htriangle

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.quotientRingSet_universal_property
statement:
theorem quotientRingSet_universal_property :
    ∃! g : quotientRingSet I hI → S,
      RingHomomorphism g ∧
        ∀ x : R, g (quotientRingProjection I hI x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨quotientRingSetLift I hI f hf hker, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨quotientRingSetLift_is_ringHomomorphism I hI f hf hker,
      quotientRingSetLift_projection I hI f hf hker⟩
  · intro g hg
    exact quotientRingSetLift_unique I hI f hf hker g hg.1 hg.2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.idealSetIntersection_is_ideal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨⟨hI.1.1, hJ.1.1⟩,
      (by intro x y hx hy; exact ⟨hI.1.2.1 hx.1 hy.1, hJ.1.2.1 hx.2 hy.2⟩),
      (by intro x hx; exact ⟨hI.1.2.2.1 hx.1, hJ.1.2.2.1 hx.2⟩),
      by intro r x hx; exact ⟨hI.1.2.2.2 r hx.1, hJ.1.2.2.2 r hx.2⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨hI.2.1, hJ.2.1⟩,
      (by intro x y hx hy; exact ⟨hI.2.2.1 hx.1 hy.1, hJ.2.2.1 hx.2 hy.2⟩),
      (by intro x hx; exact ⟨hI.2.2.2.1 hx.1, hJ.2.2.2.1 hx.2⟩),
      by intro r x hx; exact ⟨hI.2.2.2.2 r hx.1, hJ.2.2.2.2 r hx.2⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.comaximalIdealSets_iff_exists_add_eq_one
statement:
theorem comaximalIdealSets_iff_exists_add_eq_one {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    {I J : Set R} (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J) :
    ComaximalIdealSets I J ↔ ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, i + j = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hone : (1 : R) ∈ idealSetSum I J := by rw [h]; trivial
    exact hone
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij⟩
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro x
    refine ⟨x * i, ?_, x * j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hI.1.2.2.2 x hi
    · exact hJ.1.2.2.2 x hj
    · rw [← mul_add, hij, mul_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chineseRemainderMap_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem chineseRemainderMap_is_ringHomomorphism {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J) :
    RingHomomorphism (chineseRemainderMap I J hI hJ)
proof:
:= by
  let hπI := quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism I hI
  let hπJ := quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism J hJ
  exact ⟨Prod.ext hπI.1 hπJ.1, Prod.ext hπI.2.1 hπJ.2.1,
    (fun x y ↦ Prod.ext (hπI.2.2.1 x y) (hπJ.2.2.1 x y)),
    (fun x y ↦ Prod.ext (hπI.2.2.2.1 x y) (hπJ.2.2.2.1 x y)),
    fun x ↦ Prod.ext (hπI.2.2.2.2 x) (hπJ.2.2.2.2 x)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chineseRemainderMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem chineseRemainderMap_eq_zero_iff {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J)
    (x : R) :
    chineseRemainderMap I J hI hJ x = 0 ↔ x ∈ I ∩ J
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    constructor
    · rw [← quotientRingProjection_kernel I hI]
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hx
    · rw [← quotientRingProjection_kernel J hJ]
      exact congrArg Prod.snd hx
  · intro hx
    apply Prod.ext
    · change quotientRingProjection I hI x = 0
      rw [quotientZero_eq_projection]
      apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI _ _).2
      simpa [idealCongruent] using hx.1
    · change quotientRingProjection J hJ x = 0
      rw [quotientZero_eq_projection]
      apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hJ _ _).2
      simpa [idealCongruent] using hx.2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chineseRemainderMap_surjective
statement:
theorem chineseRemainderMap_surjective {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J)
    (hcomax : ComaximalIdealSets I J) :
    Function.Surjective (chineseRemainderMap I J hI hJ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij⟩ :=
    (comaximalIdealSets_iff_exists_add_eq_one hI hJ).1 hcomax
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ a b ?_
  intro x y
  refine ⟨x * j + y * i, ?_⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hI _ _).2
    change x * j + y * i - x ∈ I
    have hmem : (y - x) * i ∈ I := hI.1.2.2.2 (y - x) hi
    convert hmem using 1
    calc
      x * j + y * i - x = x * j + y * i - x * (i + j) := by rw [hij, mul_one]
      _ = (y - x) * i := by ring
  · apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff hJ _ _).2
    change x * j + y * i - y ∈ J
    have hmem : (x - y) * j ∈ J := hJ.1.2.2.2 (x - y) hj
    convert hmem using 1
    calc
      x * j + y * i - y = x * j + y * i - y * (i + j) := by rw [hij, mul_one]
      _ = (x - y) * j := by ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chineseRemainderQuotientMap_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem chineseRemainderQuotientMap_projection {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J)
    (x : R) :
    chineseRemainderQuotientMap I J hI hJ
      (quotientRingProjection (I ∩ J) (idealSetIntersection_is_ideal hI hJ) x) =
      chineseRemainderMap I J hI hJ x
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientRingSetLift_projection

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chineseRemainderEquiv_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem chineseRemainderEquiv_projection {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J)
    (hcomax : ComaximalIdealSets I J) (x : R) :
    chineseRemainderEquiv I J hI hJ hcomax
      (quotientRingProjection (I ∩ J) (idealSetIntersection_is_ideal hI hJ) x) =
      chineseRemainderMap I J hI hJ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold chineseRemainderEquiv
  dsimp only
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.chineseRemainderIsomorphism_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem chineseRemainderIsomorphism_projection {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I J : Set R) (hI : TwoSidedIdealSet I) (hJ : TwoSidedIdealSet J)
    (hcomax : ComaximalIdealSets I J) (x : R) :
    chineseRemainderIsomorphism I J hI hJ hcomax
      (quotientRingProjection (I ∩ J) (idealSetIntersection_is_ideal hI hJ) x) =
      chineseRemainderMap I J hI hJ x
proof:
:= by
  exact chineseRemainderEquiv_projection I J hI hJ hcomax x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteIdealIntersection_is_ideal
statement:
theorem finiteIdealIntersection_is_ideal {R ι : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I : ι → Set R) (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i)) :
    TwoSidedIdealSet (finiteIdealIntersection I)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨(fun i ↦ (hI i).1.1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y hx hy i
      exact (hI i).1.2.1 (hx i) (hy i)
    · intro x hx i
      exact (hI i).1.2.2.1 (hx i)
    · intro r x hx i
      exact (hI i).1.2.2.2 r (hx i)
  · refine ⟨(fun i ↦ (hI i).2.1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y hx hy i
      exact (hI i).2.2.1 (hx i) (hy i)
    · intro x hx i
      exact (hI i).2.2.2.1 (hx i)
    · intro r x hx i
      exact (hI i).2.2.2.2 r (hx i)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteChineseRemainderMap_is_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem finiteChineseRemainderMap_is_ringHomomorphism {R ι : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I : ι → Set R) (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i)) :
    RingHomomorphism (finiteChineseRemainderMap I hI)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨funext (fun i ↦ (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism (I i) (hI i)).1),
    funext (fun i ↦ (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism (I i) (hI i)).2.1),
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    funext i
    exact (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism (I i) (hI i)).2.2.1 x y
  · intro x y
    funext i
    exact (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism (I i) (hI i)).2.2.2.1 x y
  · intro x
    funext i
    exact (quotientRingProjection_is_ringHomomorphism (I i) (hI i)).2.2.2.2 x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteChineseRemainderMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteChineseRemainderMap_eq_zero_iff {R ι : Type*} [Ring R]
    (I : ι → Set R) (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i)) (x : R) :
    finiteChineseRemainderMap I hI x = 0 ↔ x ∈ finiteIdealIntersection I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx i
    rw [← quotientRingProjection_kernel (I i) (hI i)]
    exact congrFun hx i
  · intro hx
    funext i
    change quotientRingProjection (I i) (hI i) x = 0
    rw [quotientZero_eq_projection]
    apply (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff (hI i) _ _).2
    simpa [idealCongruent] using hx i

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteChineseRemainderMap_surjective
statement:
theorem finiteChineseRemainderMap_surjective {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [Finite ι]
    (I : ι → Set R) (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i))
    (hpairwise : PairwiseComaximalIdealSets I) :
    Function.Surjective (finiteChineseRemainderMap I hI)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let A : ι → Ideal R := fun i ↦
    ((twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal (I i)).1 (hI i)).choose
  have hA : ∀ i, ((A i : Ideal R) : Set R) = I i := fun i ↦
    ((twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_ideal (I i)).1 (hI i)).choose_spec
  have hAcoprime : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime A) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Ideal.isCoprime_iff_exists.2
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ :=
      (comaximalIdealSets_iff_exists_add_eq_one (hI i) (hI j)).1
        (hpairwise i j hij)
    exact ⟨a, by change a ∈ (A i : Set R); rw [hA i]; exact ha,
      b, by change b ∈ (A j : Set R); rw [hA j]; exact hb, hab⟩
  intro q
  let representative : ι → R := fun i ↦ Quotient.out (q i)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.exists_forall_sub_mem_ideal hAcoprime representative
  refine ⟨r, funext ?_⟩
  intro i
  calc
    quotientRingProjection (I i) (hI i) r =
        quotientRingProjection (I i) (hI i) (representative i) :=
      (quotientRingProjection_eq_iff (hI i) _ _).2 (by
        change r - representative i ∈ I i
        rw [← hA i]
        exact hr i)
    _ = q i := Quotient.out_eq (q i)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteChineseRemainderQuotientMap_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteChineseRemainderQuotientMap_projection
    {R ι : Type*} [Ring R] (I : ι → Set R)
    (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i)) (x : R) :
    finiteChineseRemainderQuotientMap I hI
      (quotientRingProjection (finiteIdealIntersection I)
        (finiteIdealIntersection_is_ideal I hI) x) =
      finiteChineseRemainderMap I hI x
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientRingSetLift_projection

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteChineseRemainderEquiv_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteChineseRemainderEquiv_projection
    {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Finite ι]
    (I : ι → Set R) (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i))
    (hpairwise : PairwiseComaximalIdealSets I) (x : R) :
    finiteChineseRemainderEquiv I hI hpairwise
      (quotientRingProjection (finiteIdealIntersection I)
        (finiteIdealIntersection_is_ideal I hI) x) =
      finiteChineseRemainderMap I hI x
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteChineseRemainderEquiv
  dsimp only
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.finiteChineseRemainderIsomorphism_projection
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteChineseRemainderIsomorphism_projection
    {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [Finite ι]
    (I : ι → Set R) (hI : ∀ i, TwoSidedIdealSet (I i))
    (hpairwise : PairwiseComaximalIdealSets I) (x : R) :

      (quotientRingProjection (finiteIdealIntersection I)
        (finiteIdealIntersection_is_ideal I hI) x) =
      finiteChineseRemainderMap I hI x
proof:
:= by
  exact finiteChineseRemainderEquiv_projection I hI hpairwise x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.isPrimePowerGroup_iff_mathlib
statement:
theorem isPrimePowerGroup_iff_mathlib {p : ℕ} {G : Type*} [Group G] :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.IsSylowSubgroup.isPGroup
statement:
theorem isPGroup {G : Type*} [Group G] {p : ℕ} {P : Subgroup G}

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.IsSylowSubgroup.maximal
statement:
theorem maximal {G : Type*} [Group G] {p : ℕ} {P Q : Subgroup G}

proof:
:=

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.cauchy_theorem
statement:
theorem cauchy_theorem {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ∣ Nat.card G) :
    ∃ g : G, orderOf g = p
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' p hp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_exists
statement:
theorem sylow_exists (G : Type*) [Group G] (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (SylowSubgroup p G)
proof:
:= by
  exact Nonempty.map (sylowEquivMathlib p G).symm Sylow.nonempty

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.pSubgroup_le_sylow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hHP⟩ := (isPrimePowerGroup_iff_mathlib.mp hH).exists_le_sylow
  exact ⟨fromMathlibSylow P, hHP⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_card
statement:
theorem sylow_card {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G]
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (P : SylowSubgroup p G) :
    Nat.card P.1 = p ^ (Nat.card G).factorization p
proof:
:= by
  exact (toMathlibSylow P).card_eq_multiplicity

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_conjugate
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite (Sylow p G) := (sylowEquivMathlib p G).finite_iff.mp inferInstance
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G (toMathlibSylow P) (toMathlibSylow Q)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have hsub := congrArg Sylow.toSubgroup hg
  rw [Sylow.coe_subgroup_smul] at hsub
  change MulAut.conj g • P.1 = Q.1
  simpa [toMathlibSylow] using hsub

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_number_mod_prime
statement:
theorem sylow_number_mod_prime {G : Type*} [Group G] (p : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (SylowSubgroup p G)] :
    Nat.card (SylowSubgroup p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite (Sylow p G) := (sylowEquivMathlib p G).finite_iff.mp inferInstance
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sylowEquivMathlib p G)]
  exact card_sylow_modEq_one p G

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_number_dvd_index
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite (Sylow p G) := (sylowEquivMathlib p G).finite_iff.mp inferInstance
  rw [Nat.card_congr (sylowEquivMathlib p G)]
  exact (toMathlibSylow P).card_dvd_index

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_normal_of_unique
statement:
theorem sylow_normal_of_unique {G : Type*} [Group G] {p : ℕ}
    (P : SylowSubgroup p G) (hP : ∀ Q : SylowSubgroup p G, Q = P) : P.1.Normal
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Subsingleton (SylowSubgroup p G) := ⟨fun Q R => (hP Q).trans (hP R).symm⟩
  let _ : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) := Equiv.subsingleton (sylowEquivMathlib p G).symm
  exact (toMathlibSylow P).normal_of_subsingleton

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.sylow_unique_of_normal
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite (Sylow p G) := (sylowEquivMathlib p G).finite_iff.mp inferInstance
  let _ := (toMathlibSylow P).unique_of_normal hP
  intro Q
  apply (sylowEquivMathlib p G).injective
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.prime_square_group_commutative

theorem prime_square_group_commutative {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.directProduct_factors_commute
statement:
theorem directProduct_factors_commute {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H]
    (g : G) (h : H) :
    Commute (MonoidHom.inl G H g) (MonoidHom.inr G H h)
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.internalDirectProductEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem internalDirectProductEquiv_apply {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (H K : Subgroup G)
    (hcomm : ∀ h : H, ∀ k : K, Commute (h : G) (k : G))
    (hcompl : H.IsComplement' K) (x : H × K) :
    internalDirectProductEquiv H K hcomm hcompl x = (x.1 : G) * (x.2 : G)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.semidirectProduct_mul
statement:
theorem semidirectProduct_mul {N G : Type*} [Group N] [Group G]
    (φ : G →* MulAut N) (x y : N ⋊[φ] G) :
    x * y = ⟨x.left * φ x.right y.left, x.right * y.right⟩
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.semidirectProduct_decomposition
statement:
theorem semidirectProduct_decomposition {N G : Type*} [Group N] [Group G]
    (φ : G →* MulAut N) (x : N ⋊[φ] G) :
    SemidirectProduct.inl x.left * SemidirectProduct.inr x.right = x
proof:
:= by
  exact SemidirectProduct.inl_left_mul_inr_right x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.internalSemidirectProductEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem internalSemidirectProductEquiv_apply {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (H K : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (h : H.IsComplement' K)
    (x : H ⋊[(H.normalizerMonoidHom).comp
      (Subgroup.inclusion (H.normalizer_eq_top ▸ le_top))] K) :
    internalSemidirectProductEquiv H K h x = (x.left : G) * (x.right : G)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.mem_coefficientSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coefficientSupport_iff {R : Type*} [Zero R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ coefficientSupport p ↔ coefficient p n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientSupport, coefficient]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {R : Type*} [Zero R] {p q : PolynomialSequence R}
    (h : ∀ n, coefficient p n = coefficient q n) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | mk pc pf =>
    cases q with
    | mk qc qf =>
      simp only [coefficient] at h
      have : pc = qc := funext h
      subst qc
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial
statement:
theorem coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    (toMathlibPolynomial p).coeff n = coefficient p n
proof:
:= by
  simp [toMathlibPolynomial, coefficientFinsupp, coefficient]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_fromMathlibPolynomial
statement:
theorem coefficient_fromMathlibPolynomial {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient (fromMathlibPolynomial p) n = p.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficientSupport_eq_mathlib_support
statement:
theorem coefficientSupport_eq_mathlib_support {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    coefficientSupport p = (toMathlibPolynomial p).support
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [mem_coefficientSupport_iff, Polynomial.mem_support_iff,
    coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (p : Polynomial R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (fromMathlibPolynomial p) = p
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, coefficient_fromMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.fromMathlibPolynomial_toMathlibPolynomial
statement:
theorem fromMathlibPolynomial_toMathlibPolynomial {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    fromMathlibPolynomial (toMathlibPolynomial p) = p
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_zero
statement:
theorem toMathlib_zero {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    toMathlibPolynomial (0 : PolynomialSequence R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial 0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_one
statement:
theorem toMathlib_one {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    toMathlibPolynomial (1 : PolynomialSequence R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial 1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_add
statement:
theorem toMathlib_add {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p q : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (p + q) = toMathlibPolynomial p + toMathlibPolynomial q
proof:
:= by
  exact toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial _

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_mul
statement:
theorem toMathlib_mul {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p q : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (p * q) = toMathlibPolynomial p * toMathlibPolynomial q
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_neg
statement:
theorem toMathlib_neg {R : Type*} [Ring R] (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (-p) = -toMathlibPolynomial p
proof:
:= by
  exact toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial _

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.toMathlib_injective
statement:
theorem toMathlib_injective {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    Function.Injective (toMathlibPolynomial : PolynomialSequence R → Polynomial R)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  rw [← fromMathlibPolynomial_toMathlibPolynomial p,
    ← fromMathlibPolynomial_toMathlibPolynomial q, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_eq_coefficientSupport_sum
statement:
theorem evaluate_eq_coefficientSupport_sum {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (a : R) (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    evaluate a p = ∑ n ∈ coefficientSupport p, coefficient p n * a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [evaluate]
  change (toMathlibPolynomial p).eval a = _
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def, coefficientSupport_eq_mathlib_support]
  simp only [coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_eq_mathlib_eval
statement:
theorem evaluate_eq_mathlib_eval {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (a : R) (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    evaluate a p = (toMathlibPolynomial p).eval a
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.isRoot_iff_coefficientSupport_sum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isRoot_iff_coefficientSupport_sum_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (a : R) :
    IsRoot p a ↔ (∑ n ∈ coefficientSupport p, coefficient p n * a ^ n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRoot, evaluate_eq_coefficientSupport_sum]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.isRoot_iff_mathlib_isRoot
statement:
theorem isRoot_iff_mathlib_isRoot {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (a : R) :
    IsRoot p a ↔ (toMathlibPolynomial p).IsRoot a
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRoot, Polynomial.IsRoot, evaluate_eq_mathlib_eval]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient (0 : PolynomialSequence R) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, toMathlib_zero]
  exact Polynomial.coeff_zero n

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_one_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_one_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    coefficient (1 : PolynomialSequence R) 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, toMathlib_one]
  exact Polynomial.coeff_one_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_one_succ
statement:
theorem coefficient_one_succ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient (1 : PolynomialSequence R) (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, toMathlib_one]
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_one]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_add
statement:
theorem coefficient_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p q : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient (p + q) n = coefficient p n + coefficient q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, toMathlib_add, Polynomial.coeff_add,
    coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_neg
statement:
theorem coefficient_neg {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient (-p) n = -coefficient p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, toMathlib_neg, Polynomial.coeff_neg,
    coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_mul
statement:
theorem coefficient_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p q : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient (p * q) n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      coefficient p k * coefficient q (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, toMathlib_mul, Polynomial.coeff_mul,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  simp only [coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_constant_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_constant_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) :
    coefficient (constant a) 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficient, constant, transportedConstant, fromMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_constant_succ
statement:
theorem coefficient_constant_succ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) (n : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficient, constant, transportedConstant, fromMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_X_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_X_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    coefficient (X : PolynomialSequence R) 0 = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_X_one
statement:
theorem coefficient_X_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    coefficient (X : PolynomialSequence R) 1 = 1
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.degree_zero
statement:
theorem degree_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    degree (0 : PolynomialSequence R) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree, transportedDegree, toMathlib_zero, Polynomial.degree_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.degree_eq_mathlib_degree
statement:
theorem degree_eq_mathlib_degree {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    degree p = (toMathlibPolynomial p).degree
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.degree_eq_bot_iff_coefficients_zero
statement:
theorem degree_eq_bot_iff_coefficients_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    degree p = ⊥ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, coefficient p n = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n
    rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
    apply Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    rw [← degree_eq_mathlib_degree]
    exact h ▸ WithBot.bot_lt_coe n
  · intro h
    have hp : p = 0 := ext h
    exact hp ▸ degree_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem coefficient_eq_zero_of_degree_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ)
    (h : degree p < (n : WithBot ℕ)) :
    coefficient p n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    (degree_eq_mathlib_degree p ▸ h)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.coefficient_ne_zero_of_degree_eq
statement:
theorem coefficient_ne_zero_of_degree_eq {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ)
    (h : degree p = (n : WithBot ℕ)) :
    coefficient p n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
  exact Polynomial.coeff_ne_zero_of_eq_degree
    (degree_eq_mathlib_degree p ▸ h)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.degree_eq_nat_iff
statement:
theorem degree_eq_nat_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (n : ℕ) :
    degree p = (n : WithBot ℕ) ↔
      coefficient p n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, n < m → coefficient p m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_mathlib_degree]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
      exact Polynomial.coeff_ne_zero_of_eq_degree h
    · intro m hnm
      rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
      exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (h ▸ WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hnm)
  · rintro ⟨hn, habove⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (Polynomial.degree_le_iff_coeff_zero _ _).2 fun m hnm => by
        rw [coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
        exact habove m (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp hnm)
    · apply Polynomial.le_degree_of_ne_zero
      rwa [coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.degree_index_unique
statement:
theorem degree_index_unique {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : coefficient p m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, m < k → coefficient p k = 0)
    (hn : coefficient p n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, n < k → coefficient p k = 0) :
    m = n
proof:
:= by
  have hdm := (degree_eq_nat_iff p m).2 hm
  have hdn := (degree_eq_nat_iff p n).2 hn
  exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp (hdm.symm.trans hdn)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_zero
statement:
theorem evaluate_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_one
statement:
theorem evaluate_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) :

theorem evaluate_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) (p q : PolynomialSequence R) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_neg
statement:
theorem evaluate_neg {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) (p : PolynomialSequence R) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_mul
statement:
theorem evaluate_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) (p q : PolynomialSequence R) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.evaluate_ringHomomorphism
statement:
theorem evaluate_ringHomomorphism {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a : R) :
