proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨evaluate_zero a, evaluate_one a, evaluate_add a, evaluate_mul a, evaluate_neg a⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.divides_X_sub_constant_iff_root
statement:
theorem divides_X_sub_constant_iff_root {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) (a : R) :
    DividesElement (X - constant a) p ↔ IsRoot p a
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : toMathlibPolynomial (X - constant a) =
      Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a := by
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, toMathlib_add, toMathlib_neg, X, constant,
      transportedX, transportedConstant,
      toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hm := congrArg toMathlibPolynomial hq
    rw [toMathlib_mul, hfactor] at hm
    have hdvd : Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ toMathlibPolynomial p := ⟨_, hm⟩
    have hr := (Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot (p := toMathlibPolynomial p) (a := a)).mp hdvd
    exact (isRoot_iff_mathlib_isRoot p a).2 hr
  · intro hr
    have hr' := (isRoot_iff_mathlib_isRoot p a).1 hr
    have hdvd : Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ toMathlibPolynomial p :=
      (Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot (p := toMathlibPolynomial p) (a := a)).mpr hr'
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdvd
    refine ⟨fromMathlibPolynomial q, ?_⟩
    apply toMathlib_injective
    rw [toMathlib_mul, hfactor, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
    exact hq

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDefinition.polynomial_integralDomainAxioms
statement:
theorem polynomial_integralDomainAxioms {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (hR : IntegralDomainAxioms R) : IntegralDomainAxioms (PolynomialSequence R)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := (integralDomainAxioms_iff_isDomain (R := R)).mp hR
  refine ⟨commRing_has_commutativeRingAxioms (PolynomialSequence R), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hm := congrArg toMathlibPolynomial h
    rw [toMathlib_zero, toMathlib_one] at hm
    exact zero_ne_one hm
  · intro p q hpq
    have hm := congrArg toMathlibPolynomial hpq
    rw [toMathlib_mul, toMathlib_zero] at hm
    rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero hm with hp | hq
    · exact Or.inl (toMathlib_injective (hp.trans toMathlib_zero.symm))
    · exact Or.inr (toMathlib_injective (hq.trans toMathlib_zero.symm))

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.EuclideanDomainAxioms.division
statement:
theorem EuclideanDomainAxioms.division {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a = b * E.quotient a b + E.remainder a b
proof:
:=
  (E.divisionWithRemainder a b hb).1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.EuclideanDomainAxioms.remainder_lt
statement:
theorem EuclideanDomainAxioms.remainder_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    E.measure (E.remainder a b) < E.measure b
proof:
:=
  (E.divisionWithRemainder a b hb).2

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanGCD_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem euclideanGCD_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a : R) : euclideanGCD E a 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [euclideanGCD]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanGCD_nonzero
statement:
theorem euclideanGCD_nonzero {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    euclideanGCD E a b = euclideanGCD E b (E.remainder a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [euclideanGCD]
  simp [hb]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.extendedEuclidean_gcd
statement:
theorem extendedEuclidean_gcd {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    (extendedEuclidean E a b).1 = euclideanGCD E a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendedEuclidean, euclideanGCD]
  split
  · rfl
  · dsimp only
    exact extendedEuclidean_gcd E b (E.remainder a b)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.extendedEuclidean_bezout
statement:
theorem extendedEuclidean_bezout {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    (extendedEuclidean E a b).1 =
      (extendedEuclidean E a b).2.1 * a +
      (extendedEuclidean E a b).2.2 * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendedEuclidean]
  split
  · simp
  · dsimp only
    rw [extendedEuclidean_bezout E b (E.remainder a b)]
    have hr : E.remainder a b = a - b * E.quotient a b := by
      have hd := E.division a b ‹b ≠ 0›
      calc
        E.remainder a b =
            (b * E.quotient a b + E.remainder a b) - b * E.quotient a b := by ring
        _ = a - b * E.quotient a b := by rw [← hd]
    rw [hr]
    ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor
statement:
theorem euclideanGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    GreatestCommonDivisor (euclideanGCD E a b) a b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · subst b
    rw [euclideanGCD_zero]
    refine ⟨dividesElement_refl a, ⟨0, by rw [mul_zero]⟩, ?_⟩
    intro c hca _hc0
    exact hca
  · rw [euclideanGCD_nonzero E a b hb]
    let r := E.remainder a b
    let q := E.quotient a b
    have ih := euclideanGCD_isGreatestCommonDivisor E b r
    refine ⟨?_, ih.1, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hbx⟩ := ih.1
      obtain ⟨y, hry⟩ := ih.2.1
      refine ⟨x * q + y, ?_⟩
      have hd := E.division a b hb
      calc
        a = b * q + r := hd
        _ = (euclideanGCD E b r * x) * q +
            euclideanGCD E b r * y := by rw [← hbx, ← hry]
        _ = euclideanGCD E b r * (x * q + y) := by ring
    · intro c hca hcb
      apply ih.2.2 c hcb
      obtain ⟨x, hax⟩ := hca
      obtain ⟨y, hby⟩ := hcb
      refine ⟨x - y * q, ?_⟩
      have hd := E.division a b hb
      calc
        r = a - b * q := by
          calc
            r = (b * q + r) - b * q := by ring
            _ = a - b * q := by rw [← hd]
        _ = c * x - (c * y) * q := by rw [← hax, ← hby]
        _ = c * (x - y * q) := by ring

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Ring.euclideanDomain_bezout_for_gcd
statement:
theorem euclideanDomain_bezout_for_gcd {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (E : EuclideanDomainAxioms R) (a b : R) :
    ∃ s t : R, euclideanGCD E a b = s * a + t * b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(extendedEuclidean E a b).2.1, (extendedEuclidean E a b).2.2, ?_⟩
  rw [← extendedEuclidean_gcd E a b]
  exact extendedEuclidean_bezout E a b

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq
proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra e.toRingHom

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.algebra_smul_eq_embedding_mul
statement:
private theorem algebra_smul_eq_embedding_mul {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (c : K) (x : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    c • x = e c * x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib
statement:
private theorem fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib {K L ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → K) (v : ι → L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    fieldLinearCombination e s c v = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • v i
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact algebra_smul_eq_embedding_mul e (c i) (v i) |>.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.fieldLinearlyIndependent_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem fieldLinearlyIndependent_iff_mathlib {K L ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (v : ι → L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FieldLinearlyIndependent e v ↔ LinearIndependent K v
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  constructor
  · intro h s c hsum i hi
    apply h s c
    · rw [fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
      exact hsum
    · exact hi
  · intro h s c hsum i hi
    apply h s c
    · rw [← fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
      exact hsum
    · exact hi

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.fieldSpans_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem fieldSpans_iff_mathlib {K L ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (v : ι → L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FieldSpans e v ↔ Submodule.span K (Set.range v) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · intro hspan
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨s, c, hc⟩ := hspan x
    rw [← hc, fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i hi
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · intro hspan x
    have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range v) := by
      rw [hspan]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hx
    refine ⟨c.support, fun i => c i, ?_⟩
    rw [fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
    exact hc

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.fieldBasis_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem fieldBasis_iff_mathlib {K L ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (v : ι → L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FieldBasis e v ↔ ∃ b : Module.Basis ι K L, ⇑b = v
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hli, hspan⟩
    have hli' : LinearIndependent K v :=
      (fieldLinearlyIndependent_iff_mathlib e v).mp hli
    have hspan' : Submodule.span K (Set.range v) = ⊤ :=
      (fieldSpans_iff_mathlib e v).mp hspan
    let b : Module.Basis ι K L := Module.Basis.mk hli' hspan'.ge
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    simp [b]
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(fieldLinearlyIndependent_iff_mathlib e _).mpr b.linearIndependent,
      (fieldSpans_iff_mathlib e _).mpr b.span_eq⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.mathlibBasis_to_fieldBasis
statement:
private theorem mathlibBasis_to_fieldBasis {K L ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ b : Module.Basis ι K L, FieldBasis e (fun i => b i)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro b
  apply (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e _).mpr
  exact ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hli, hspan⟩
    constructor
    · apply (fieldLinearlyIndependent_iff_mathlib e v).mpr
      apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
      intro c hc i
      apply hli c
      rw [fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
      exact hc
    · intro x
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan x
      exact ⟨Finset.univ, c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨hli, hspan⟩
    constructor
    · have hli' : LinearIndependent K v :=
        (fieldLinearlyIndependent_iff_mathlib e v).mp hli
      intro c hc i
      apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli' c
      rw [← fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
      exact hc
    · intro x
      have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range v) := by
        rw [(fieldSpans_iff_mathlib e v).mp hspan]
        trivial
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mp hx
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      rw [fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
      exact hc

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_coordinates_package
statement:
private theorem finFieldBasis_coordinates_package {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {n : ℕ} {b : Fin n → L}
    (hb : FinFieldBasis e b) :
    (∀ x : L, ∃ c : Fin n → K,
      fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = x) ∧
    (∀ x : L, ∀ c d : Fin n → K,
      fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = x →
      fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ d b = x → c = d)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · exact hb.2
  · intro x c d hc hd
    have hrel : fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ (fun i => c i - d i) b = 0 := by
      rw [fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
      simp_rw [sub_smul]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have hc' : (∑ i, c i • b i) = x := by
        rw [← fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
        exact hc
      have hd' : (∑ i, d i • b i) = x := by
        rw [← fieldLinearCombination_eq_mathlib e]
        exact hd
      rw [hc', hd', sub_self]
    have hz : ∀ i, c i - d i = 0 := hb.1 (fun i => c i - d i) hrel
    funext i
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hz i)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_card_eq_bridge
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e b).mp
    ((finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge e b).mp hb)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e c).mp
    ((finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge e c).mp hc)
  have hm : Module.finrank K L = m := by
    simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B
  have hn : Module.finrank K L = n := by
    simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis C
  exact hm.symm.trans hn

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.extensionDegree_basic_package
statement:
private theorem extensionDegree_basic_package {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    ¬HasExtensionDegree e 0 ∧
      (∀ n, HasExtensionDegree e n → 0 < n) ∧
      (∀ m n, HasExtensionDegree e m → HasExtensionDegree e n → m = n)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ¬HasExtensionDegree e 0 := by
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb.2 (1 : L)
    have hempty : fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = 0 := by
      simp [fieldLinearCombination]
    rw [hempty] at hc
    exact zero_ne_one hc
  refine ⟨hzero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun hn0 => hzero (hn0 ▸ hn))
  · intro m n hm hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hm
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hn
    exact finFieldBasis_card_eq_bridge e hb hc

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.identity_degree_package
statement:
private theorem identity_degree_package (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    FinFieldBasis (FieldEmbedding.id K) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : K)) ∧
      HasExtensionDegree (FieldEmbedding.id K) 1 ∧
      (∀ n, HasExtensionDegree (FieldEmbedding.id K) n ↔ n = 1)
proof:
:= by
  let e := FieldEmbedding.id K
  let b : Fin 1 → K := fun _ => 1
  have hb : FinFieldBasis e b := by
    constructor
    · intro c hc i
      have hc0 : c 0 = 0 := by
        simpa [fieldLinearCombination, e, b, FieldEmbedding.id] using hc
      simpa [Fin.eq_zero i] using hc0
    · intro x
      refine ⟨fun _ => x, ?_⟩
      simp [fieldLinearCombination, e, b, FieldEmbedding.id]
  have hdegree : HasExtensionDegree e 1 := ⟨b, hb⟩
  refine ⟨hb, hdegree, ?_⟩
  intro n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    exact (extensionDegree_basic_package e).2.2 n 1 hn hdegree
  · intro hn
    subst n
    exact hdegree

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.mathlib_isAlgebraic_to_algebraicElement
statement:
private theorem mathlib_isAlgebraic_to_algebraicElement {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (a : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    IsAlgebraic K a → AlgebraicElement e a
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hev⟩
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq] at hev
  exact hev

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finite_extension_isAlgebraic_bridge
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb⟩ := hfin
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e b).mp
    ((finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge e b).mp hb)
  letI : Module.Finite K L := Module.Finite.of_basis B
  intro a
  exact mathlib_isAlgebraic_to_algebraicElement e a (IsAlgebraic.of_finite K a)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.embedding_scalarTower
statement:
private theorem embedding_scalarTower {K L M : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (f : FieldEmbedding L M) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra L M := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K M := (f.comp e).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    IsScalarTower K L M
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra L M := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K M := (f.comp e).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  rw [toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq, toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq,
    toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.towerBasisFamily_fieldBasis_bridge
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra L M := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K M := (f.comp e).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower K L M := embedding_scalarTower e f
  obtain ⟨bKL, hbKL⟩ := (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e b).mp
    ((finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge e b).mp hb)
  obtain ⟨bLM, hbLM⟩ := (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib f c).mp
    ((finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge f c).mp hc)
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin m × Fin n) K M := bKL.smulTower bLM
  have hB : (fun ij => B ij) = (fun ij : Fin m × Fin n => f (b ij.1) * c ij.2) := by
    funext ij
    rw [show B ij = bKL ij.1 • bLM ij.2 by
      exact Module.Basis.smulTower_apply bKL bLM ij]
    rw [algebra_smul_eq_embedding_mul f, hbKL, hbLM]
  rw [← hB]
  exact mathlibBasis_to_fieldBasis (f.comp e) B

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.fieldBasis_reindex_bridge
statement:
private theorem fieldBasis_reindex_bridge {K L ι κ : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    (v : ι → L) (h : ι ≃ κ) (hv : FieldBasis e v) :
    FieldBasis e (fun j : κ => v (h.symm j))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e v).mp hv
  apply (fieldBasis_iff_mathlib e _).mpr
  refine ⟨b.reindex h, ?_⟩
  funext j
  rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply, hb]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis
statement:
theorem finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → L) :
    FinFieldBasis e v ↔ FieldBasis e v
proof:
:= by
  exact finFieldBasis_iff_fieldBasis_bridge e v

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_coordinates_exists
statement:
theorem finFieldBasis_coordinates_exists {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {n : ℕ} {b : Fin n → L}
    (hb : FinFieldBasis e b) (x : L) :
    ∃ c : Fin n → K, fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = x
proof:
:= by
  exact (finFieldBasis_coordinates_package e hb).1 x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_coordinates_unique
proof:
:= by
  exact (finFieldBasis_coordinates_package e hb).2 x c d hc hd

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_coordinates_exists_unique
statement:
theorem finFieldBasis_coordinates_exists_unique {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L)
    {n : ℕ} {b : Fin n → L} (hb : FinFieldBasis e b) (x : L) :
    ∃! c : Fin n → K, fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (finFieldBasis_coordinates_package e hb).1 x
  exact ⟨c, hc, fun d hd => (finFieldBasis_coordinates_package e hb).2 x d c hd hc⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.fieldExtensionBasis_card_eq
proof:
:= by
  exact finFieldBasis_card_eq_bridge e hb hc

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.extensionDegree_unique
proof:
:= by
  exact (extensionDegree_basic_package e).2.2 m n hm hn

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.not_hasExtensionDegree_zero
statement:
theorem not_hasExtensionDegree_zero {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) : ¬HasExtensionDegree e 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (extensionDegree_basic_package e).1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.extensionDegree_pos
statement:
theorem extensionDegree_pos {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {n : ℕ} (hn : HasExtensionDegree e n) : 0 < n
proof:
:= by
  exact (extensionDegree_basic_package e).2.1 n hn

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldDegree.finFieldBasis_id_one
statement:
theorem finFieldBasis_id_one (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    FinFieldBasis (FieldEmbedding.id K) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : K))

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlib_monic_quotient_remainder_unique
statement:
theorem mathlib_monic_quotient_remainder_unique
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d q r : Polynomial R) (hd : d.Monic)
    (hidentity : p = d * q + r) (hdegree : r.degree < d.degree) :
    q = p.divByMonic d ∧ r = p.modByMonic d
proof:
:= by
  have hidentity' : r + d * q = p := by
    rw [hidentity, add_comm]
  have hu := Polynomial.div_modByMonic_unique q r hd ⟨hidentity', hdegree⟩
  exact ⟨hu.1.symm, hu.2.symm⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure_lt_of_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure_lt_of_degree_lt
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {r d : Polynomial K} (hdegree : r.degree < d.degree) :
    mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure r < mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure d
proof:
:= by
  cases hr : r.degree with
  | bot =>
      cases hd : d.degree with
      | bot => simp [hr, hd] at hdegree
      | coe n => simp [mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure, hr, hd]
  | coe m =>
      cases hd : d.degree with
      | bot => simp [hr, hd] at hdegree
      | coe n =>
          have hmn : m < n := by simpa [hr, hd] using hdegree
          simp only [mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure, hr, hd]
          omega

statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_iff_mathlib_monic
statement:
theorem monic_iff_mathlib_monic {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p : PolynomialSequence R) :
    Monic p ↔ (toMathlibPolynomial p).Monic
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with
  | inl hR =>
      letI : Subsingleton R := hR
      constructor
      · intro _
        rw [Polynomial.Monic.def]
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      · intro _
        exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  | inr hR =>
      letI : Nontrivial R := hR
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨n, hn, habove⟩
        have hcn : coefficient p n ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hn]
          exact one_ne_zero
        have hd : degree p = (n : WithBot ℕ) :=
          (degree_eq_nat_iff p n).2 ⟨hcn, habove⟩
        have hdm : (toMathlibPolynomial p).degree = (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
          simpa only [← degree_eq_mathlib_degree] using hd
        have hnat : (toMathlibPolynomial p).natDegree = n :=
          Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some hdm
        rw [Polynomial.Monic.def, Polynomial.leadingCoeff, hnat,
          coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
        exact hn
      · intro hp
        refine ⟨(toMathlibPolynomial p).natDegree, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree,
            hp.leadingCoeff]
        · intro m hm
          rw [← coefficient_toMathlibPolynomial]
          exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_monicQuotient
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_monicQuotient {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (monicQuotient p d) =
      (toMathlibPolynomial p).divByMonic (toMathlibPolynomial d)
proof:
:= by
  exact toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial _

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_monicRemainder
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_monicRemainder {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) :
    toMathlibPolynomial (monicRemainder p d) =
      (toMathlibPolynomial p).modByMonic (toMathlibPolynomial d)
proof:
:= by
  exact toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial _

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_division_identity
statement:
theorem monic_division_identity {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) (_hd : Monic d) :
    p = d * monicQuotient p d + monicRemainder p d
proof:
:= by
  apply toMathlib_injective
  rw [toMathlib_add, toMathlib_mul]
  simp only [monicQuotient, monicRemainder,
    toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
  rw [add_comm, Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_remainder_degree_lt
statement:
theorem monic_remainder_degree_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) (hd : Monic d) :
    degree (monicRemainder p d) < degree d
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_mathlib_degree, degree_eq_mathlib_degree]
  simp only [monicRemainder, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
  exact Polynomial.degree_modByMonic_lt _ ((monic_iff_mathlib_monic d).1 hd)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_remainder_eq_zero_iff_dividesElement
statement:
theorem monic_remainder_eq_zero_iff_dividesElement {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence R) (hd : Monic d) :
    monicRemainder p d = 0 ↔ DividesElement d p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toMathlib_injective.eq_iff, toMathlib_zero]
  simp only [monicRemainder, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
  rw [Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd ((monic_iff_mathlib_monic d).1 hd)]
  exact (dividesElement_iff_dvd).symm.trans (by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      refine ⟨fromMathlibPolynomial q, ?_⟩
      apply toMathlib_injective
      rw [toMathlib_mul, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
      exact hq
    · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      exact ⟨toMathlibPolynomial q, by
        rw [← toMathlib_mul]
        exact congrArg toMathlibPolynomial hq⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.monic_quotient_remainder_unique
statement:
theorem monic_quotient_remainder_unique {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (p d q r : PolynomialSequence R) (hd : Monic d)
    (hidentity : p = d * q + r) (hdegree : degree r < degree d) :
    q = monicQuotient p d ∧ r = monicRemainder p d
proof:
:= by
  have hmathIdentity :
      toMathlibPolynomial r + toMathlibPolynomial d * toMathlibPolynomial q =
        toMathlibPolynomial p := by
    calc
      toMathlibPolynomial r + toMathlibPolynomial d * toMathlibPolynomial q =
          toMathlibPolynomial (r + d * q) := by
            rw [toMathlib_add, toMathlib_mul]
      _ = toMathlibPolynomial p := by rw [add_comm, ← hidentity]
  have hmathDegree :
      (toMathlibPolynomial r).degree < (toMathlibPolynomial d).degree := by
    simpa only [← degree_eq_mathlib_degree] using hdegree
  have hu := Polynomial.div_modByMonic_unique
    (toMathlibPolynomial q) (toMathlibPolynomial r)
    ((monic_iff_mathlib_monic d).1 hd) ⟨hmathIdentity, hmathDegree⟩
  constructor
  · apply toMathlib_injective
    simpa only [monicQuotient, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial] using hu.1.symm
  · apply toMathlib_injective
    simpa only [monicRemainder, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial] using hu.2.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialQuotient
statement:
theorem toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialQuotient {K : Type*} [Field K]

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.toMathlibPolynomial_polynomialRemainder

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomialDegreeMeasure_eq_mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure
statement:
theorem polynomialDegreeMeasure_eq_mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (p : PolynomialSequence K) :
    polynomialDegreeMeasure p =
      mathlibPolynomialDegreeMeasure (toMathlibPolynomial p)
proof:

    degree_eq_mathlib_degree]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomialDegreeMeasure_lt_of_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem polynomialDegreeMeasure_lt_of_degree_lt {K : Type*} [Field K]
    {r d : PolynomialSequence K} (hdegree : degree r < degree d) :
    polynomialDegreeMeasure r < polynomialDegreeMeasure d
proof:
:= by
  cases hr : degree r with
  | bot =>
      cases hd : degree d with
      | bot => simp [hr, hd] at hdegree
      | coe n => simp [polynomialDegreeMeasure, hr, hd]
  | coe m =>
      cases hd : degree d with
      | bot => simp [hr, hd] at hdegree
      | coe n =>
          have hmn : m < n := by simpa [hr, hd] using hdegree
          simp only [polynomialDegreeMeasure, hr, hd]
          omega

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomial_division_identity
statement:
theorem polynomial_division_identity {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence K) (_hd : d ≠ 0) :
    p = d * polynomialQuotient p d + polynomialRemainder p d
proof:
:= by
  apply toMathlib_injective
  rw [toMathlib_add, toMathlib_mul]
  simp only [polynomialQuotient, polynomialRemainder,
    toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
  rw [add_comm, EuclideanDomain.mod_add_div]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialDivision.polynomial_remainder_measure_lt
statement:
theorem polynomial_remainder_measure_lt {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p d : PolynomialSequence K) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    polynomialDegreeMeasure (polynomialRemainder p d) < polynomialDegreeMeasure d
proof:
:= by
  apply polynomialDegreeMeasure_lt_of_degree_lt
  rw [degree_eq_mathlib_degree, degree_eq_mathlib_degree]
  simp only [polynomialRemainder, toMathlibPolynomial_fromMathlibPolynomial]
  apply Polynomial.degree_mod_lt
  intro hzero
  apply hd
  apply toMathlib_injective
  rw [hzero, toMathlib_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.subfieldSet_iInter
statement:
theorem subfieldSet_iInter {L ι : Type*} [Field L] {F : ι → Set L}
    (hF : ∀ i, SubfieldSet (F i)) : SubfieldSet (⋂ i, F i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    exact fun i => (hF i).1.1
  · simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    exact fun i => (hF i).1.2.1
  · intro a b ha hb
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at ha hb ⊢
    exact fun i => (hF i).1.2.2.1 (ha i) (hb i)
  · intro a b ha hb
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at ha hb ⊢
    exact fun i => (hF i).1.2.2.2.1 (ha i) (hb i)
  · intro a ha
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at ha ⊢
    exact fun i => (hF i).1.2.2.2.2 (ha i)
  · intro x hx hne
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hx ⊢
    exact fun i => (hF i).2 (hx i) hne

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.intermediateFieldSet_iInter
statement:
theorem intermediateFieldSet_iInter {K L ι : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {F : ι → Set L}
    (hF : ∀ i, IntermediateFieldSet e (F i)) :
    IntermediateFieldSet e (⋂ i, F i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨subfieldSet_iInter (fun i => (hF i).1), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
  exact fun i => (hF i).2 hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.generatedIntermediateFieldSet_isIntermediateField
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro T hT hST
    exact hT.1.1.1
  · intro T hT hST
    exact hT.1.1.2.1
  · intro a b ha hb T hT hST
    exact hT.1.1.2.2.1 (ha T hT hST) (hb T hT hST)
  · intro a b ha hb T hT hST
    exact hT.1.1.2.2.2.1 (ha T hT hST) (hb T hT hST)
  · intro a ha T hT hST
    exact hT.1.1.2.2.2.2 (ha T hT hST)
  · intro x hx hne T hT hST
    exact hT.1.2 (hx T hT hST) hne
  · intro x hx T hT hST
    exact hT.2 hx

statement:
theorem subset_generatedIntermediateFieldSet {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (S : Set L) :

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx T hT hST

statement:
theorem generatedIntermediateFieldSet_least {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {S T : Set L}
    (hT : IntermediateFieldSet e T) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    generatedIntermediateFieldSet e S ⊆ T
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.generatedIntermediateFieldSet_mono
statement:
theorem generatedIntermediateFieldSet_mono {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {S T : Set L} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    generatedIntermediateFieldSet e S ⊆ generatedIntermediateFieldSet e T
proof:
:= by
  apply generatedIntermediateFieldSet_least e
  · exact generatedIntermediateFieldSet_isIntermediateField e T
  · exact hST.trans (subset_generatedIntermediateFieldSet e T)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.evaluateOver_C
statement:
theorem evaluateOver_C {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (c : K) (a : L) :
    evaluateOver e (C c) a = e c
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_C e.toRingHom a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.evaluateOver_X
statement:
theorem evaluateOver_X {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (a : L) : evaluateOver e X a = a
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_X e.toRingHom a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.evaluateOver_add
statement:
theorem evaluateOver_add {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p q : Polynomial K) (a : L) :
    evaluateOver e (p + q) a = evaluateOver e p a + evaluateOver e q a
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_add (p := p) (q := q) e.toRingHom a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.evaluateOver_mul
statement:
theorem evaluateOver_mul {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p q : Polynomial K) (a : L) :
    evaluateOver e (p * q) a = evaluateOver e p a * evaluateOver e q a
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_mul (p := p) (q := q) e.toRingHom a

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.base_image_algebraic
statement:
theorem base_image_algebraic {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (x : K) : AlgebraicElement e (e x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨X - C x, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero x, ?_⟩
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, evaluateOver_add, evaluateOver_X]
  have hnegC : -(C x) = C (-x) := by simp
  rw [hnegC, evaluateOver_C]
  have hneg : e.toFun (-x) = -e.toFun x := e.toRingHom.map_neg x
  rw [hneg]
  exact add_neg_cancel (e x)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.transcendentalElement_iff
statement:
theorem transcendentalElement_iff {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (a : L) :
    TranscendentalElement e a ↔
      ∀ p : Polynomial K, p ≠ 0 → evaluateOver e p a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p hp hev
    exact h ⟨p, hp, hev⟩
  · intro h halg
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hev⟩ := halg
    exact h p hp hev

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq
proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra e.toRingHom

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.aeval_eq_evaluateOver
statement:
private theorem aeval_eq_evaluateOver {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) (a : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Polynomial.aeval a p = evaluateOver e p a
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, toAlgebra_algebraMap_eq]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.algebraicElement_isIntegral
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  apply IsAlgebraic.isIntegral
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hev⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  rwa [aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.minpoly_isMinimalPolynomialOf
statement:
private theorem minpoly_isMinimalPolynomialOf {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {a : L} (ha : AlgebraicElement e a) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    MinimalPolynomialOf e a (minpoly K a)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have haIntegral : IsIntegral K a := algebraicElement_isIntegral e ha
  refine ⟨minpoly.monic haIntegral, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]
    exact minpoly.aeval K a
  · intro q hq
    apply minpoly.dvd K a
    rwa [aeval_eq_evaluateOver e]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.minimalPolynomialOf_exists
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomialOf_exists {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {a : L} (ha : AlgebraicElement e a) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial K, MinimalPolynomialOf e a p
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact ⟨minpoly K a, minpoly_isMinimalPolynomialOf e ha⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.minimalPolynomialOf_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : p ∣ q := hp.2.2 q hq.2.1
  have hqp : q ∣ p := hq.2.2 p hp.2.1
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le_of_leadingCoeff hpq
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hqp hp.1.ne_zero
  · rw [hp.1.leadingCoeff, hq.1.leadingCoeff]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.minimalPolynomialOf_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  exact hp.1.ne_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.minimalPolynomialOf_irreducible
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomialOf_irreducible {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {a : L} {p : Polynomial K}
    (ha : AlgebraicElement e a) (hp : MinimalPolynomialOf e a p) :
    Irreducible p
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hmin : MinimalPolynomialOf e a (minpoly K a) :=
    minpoly_isMinimalPolynomialOf e ha
  have hp_eq : p = minpoly K a := minimalPolynomialOf_unique e hp hmin
  rw [hp_eq]
  exact minpoly.irreducible (algebraicElement_isIntegral e ha)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.simpleExtension_iff
statement:
theorem simpleExtension_iff {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (a : L) :
    SimpleExtension e a ↔ generatedIntermediateFieldSet e ({a} : Set L) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldExtension.generator_mem_generatedIntermediateFieldSet
proof:
:= by
  exact subset_generatedIntermediateFieldSet e ({a} : Set L) (Set.mem_singleton a)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.action_one
statement:
theorem action_one {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x : X) :
    (1 : G) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  exact one_smul G x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.action_mul
statement:
theorem action_mul {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (g h : G) (x : X) : (g * h) • x = g • h • x
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_smul g h x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.orbit_mem_iff
statement:
theorem orbit_mem_iff {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x y : X) :
    y ∈ MulAction.orbit G x ↔ ∃ g : G, g • x = y
proof:
:= by
  exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.stabilizer_mem_iff
statement:
theorem stabilizer_mem_iff {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (x : X) (g : G) :
    g ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G x ↔ g • x = x
proof:
:= by
  exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.orbit_eq_iff_mem
statement:
theorem orbit_eq_iff_mem {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x y : X) :
    MulAction.orbit G x = MulAction.orbit G y ↔ x ∈ MulAction.orbit G y
proof:
:= by
  exact MulAction.orbit_eq_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.orbit_stabilizer_card
statement:
theorem orbit_stabilizer_card {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x : X) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.orbit G x) *
      Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer G x) = Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_prod]
  exact Nat.card_congr (MulAction.orbitProdStabilizerEquivGroup G x)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.pretransitive_iff_orbit_eq_univ
statement:
theorem pretransitive_iff_orbit_eq_univ {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (x : X) :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive G X ↔ MulAction.orbit G x = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  exact MulAction.isPretransitive_iff_orbit_eq_univ (G := G) x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.finite_group_class_equation
statement:
theorem finite_group_class_equation (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] :
    Nat.card (Subgroup.center G) +
      ∑ᶠ C ∈ ConjClasses.noncenter G, Nat.card C.carrier = Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  exact Group.nat_card_center_add_sum_card_noncenter_eq_card G

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.algebraMap_eq_embedding
proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra e.toRingHom

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.aeval_eq_evaluateOver
statement:
private theorem aeval_eq_evaluateOver {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) (a : L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Polynomial.aeval a p = evaluateOver e p a
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, algebraMap_eq_embedding]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.rootSet_eq_mathlib
statement:
private theorem rootSet_eq_mathlib {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    PolynomialRootSetIn e p = p.rootSet L
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  ext a
  rw [Polynomial.mem_rootSet]
  simp only [PolynomialRootSetIn, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, aeval_eq_evaluateOver]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.generated_eq_adjoin
statement:
private theorem generated_eq_adjoin {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (S : Set L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    generatedIntermediateFieldSet e S =
      ((IntermediateField.adjoin K S : IntermediateField K L) : Set L)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    apply hx (IntermediateField.adjoin K S : Set L)
    · refine ⟨⟨⟨IntermediateField.zero_mem _, IntermediateField.one_mem _,
          ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact fun _ _ ha hb => IntermediateField.add_mem _ ha hb
      · exact fun _ _ ha hb => IntermediateField.mul_mem _ ha hb
      · exact fun _ ha => IntermediateField.neg_mem _ ha
      · exact fun _ hx _ => IntermediateField.inv_mem _ hx
      · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
        change algebraMap K L a ∈ (IntermediateField.adjoin K S)
        exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ a
    · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K S
  · intro hx T hT hST
    let U : IntermediateField K L :=
      { carrier := T
        mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => hT.1.1.2.2.2.1 ha hb
        add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => hT.1.1.2.2.1 ha hb
        algebraMap_mem' := fun a => by
          rw [algebraMap_eq_embedding e]
          exact hT.2 ⟨a, rfl⟩
        inv_mem' := fun x hx => by
          by_cases hzero : x = 0
          · simpa [hzero] using hT.1.1.1
          · exact hT.1.2 hx hzero }
    have hSU : S ⊆ (U : Set L) := by
      intro y hy
      exact hST hy
    exact (IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr hSU :
      IntermediateField.adjoin K S ≤ U) hx

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    SplittingFieldFor e p ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hsplits, hgen⟩
    refine ⟨hp, isSplittingField_iff_intermediateField.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding e] using hsplits
    · rw [← rootSet_eq_mathlib e p]
      apply SetLike.coe_injective
      rw [← generated_eq_adjoin e]
      exact hgen
  · rintro ⟨hp, hsf⟩
    obtain ⟨hsplits, hadjoin⟩ :=
      isSplittingField_iff_intermediateField.mp hsf
    refine ⟨hp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding e] using hsplits
    · rw [rootSet_eq_mathlib e p, generated_eq_adjoin e]
      exact congrArg (fun F : IntermediateField K L => (F : Set L)) hadjoin

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.splits_multiset_bridge
statement:
private theorem splits_multiset_bridge {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) :
    PolynomialSplitsIn e p ↔
      ∃ roots : Multiset L,
        p.map e.toRingHom = Polynomial.C (p.map e.toRingHom).leadingCoeff *
          (roots.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)).prod
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.splits_iff_exists_multiset

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.elementary_splits_bridge
statement:
private theorem elementary_splits_bridge {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    PolynomialSplitsIn e (0 : Polynomial K) ∧
      (∀ c : K, PolynomialSplitsIn e (Polynomial.C c)) ∧
      (∀ p : Polynomial K, p.degree = 1 → PolynomialSplitsIn e p) ∧
      (∀ p q : Polynomial K, p ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 →
        (PolynomialSplitsIn e (p * q) ↔
          PolynomialSplitsIn e p ∧ PolynomialSplitsIn e q))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [PolynomialSplitsIn]
  · intro c
    simp [PolynomialSplitsIn]
  · intro p hp
    unfold PolynomialSplitsIn
    apply Polynomial.Splits.of_degree_eq_one
    rw [Polynomial.degree_map_eq_of_injective e.injective]
    exact hp
  · intro p q hp hq
    unfold PolynomialSplitsIn
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul]
    exact Polynomial.splits_mul
      ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff e.injective).mpr hp)
      ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff e.injective).mpr hq)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.algHom_to_embedding_bridge
statement:
private theorem algHom_to_embedding_bridge {K L M : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    (eL : FieldEmbedding K L) (eM : FieldEmbedding K M) :
    letI : Algebra K L := eL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K M := eM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ φ : L →ₐ[K] M,
      ∃ g : FieldEmbedding L M,
        g.toFun = φ ∧ ExtendsFieldEmbedding eL eM g
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := eL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K M := eM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro φ
  let g : FieldEmbedding L M :=
    { toFun := φ
      map_isRingHomomorphism :=
        ⟨φ.map_zero, φ.map_one, φ.map_add, φ.map_mul, φ.map_neg⟩
      injective := φ.injective }
  refine ⟨g, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change φ (eL x) = eM x
  have hL : eL x = algebraMap K L x := by
    change eL.toRingHom x = algebraMap K L x
    rw [algebraMap_eq_embedding eL]
  have hM : algebraMap K M x = eM x := by
    change algebraMap K M x = eM.toRingHom x
    rw [algebraMap_eq_embedding eM]
  exact (congrArg φ hL).trans ((φ.commutes x).trans hM)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.algEquiv_to_isomorphism_bridge
statement:
private theorem algEquiv_to_isomorphism_bridge {K L M : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    (eL : FieldEmbedding K L) (eM : FieldEmbedding K M) :
    letI : Algebra K L := eL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K M := eM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ φ : L ≃ₐ[K] M,
      ∃ h : FieldIsomorphismOver eL eM, h.forward.toFun = φ
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := eL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K M := eM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨forward, hforward, hfix⟩ :=
    algHom_to_embedding_bridge eL eM φ.toAlgHom
  obtain ⟨inverse, hinverse, hinverseFix⟩ :=
    algHom_to_embedding_bridge eM eL φ.symm.toAlgHom
  refine ⟨{
    forward := forward
    inverse := inverse
    left_inverse := ?_
    right_inverse := ?_
    fixes_base := hfix }, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [hforward, hinverse]
    exact φ.symm_apply_apply x
  · intro x
    rw [hforward, hinverse]
    exact φ.apply_symm_apply x
  · exact hforward

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.finiteDimensional_to_finiteFieldExtension
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensional_to_finiteFieldExtension {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional K L → FiniteFieldExtension e
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro hfinite
  letI : FiniteDimensional K L := hfinite
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (Module.finrank K L)) K L := Module.finBasis K L
  have hcomb (c : Fin (Module.finrank K L) → K) :
      fieldLinearCombination e Finset.univ c b = ∑ i, c i • b i := by
    simp [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap_eq_embedding e]
    rfl
  refine ⟨Module.finrank K L, ⟨b, ?_⟩⟩
  constructor
  · intro c hc i
    apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp b.linearIndependent c
    rw [← hcomb]
    exact hc
  · intro x
    refine ⟨fun i => b.repr x i, ?_⟩
    rw [hcomb]
    exact b.sum_repr x

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.splittingField_finite_bridge
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hsf : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p :=
    (splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib e p).mp h |>.2
  letI : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p := hsf
  exact finiteDimensional_to_finiteFieldExtension e
    (Polynomial.IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional L p)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.splittingField_embedding_bridge
statement:
private theorem splittingField_embedding_bridge {K L M : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    (eL : FieldEmbedding K L) (eM : FieldEmbedding K M) (p : Polynomial K)
    (hL : SplittingFieldFor eL p) (hM : PolynomialSplitsIn eM p) :
    ∃ g : FieldEmbedding L M, ExtendsFieldEmbedding eL eM g
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := eL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K M := eM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hsf : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p :=
    (splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib eL p).mp hL |>.2
  letI : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p := hsf
  have hsplits : (p.map (algebraMap K M)).Splits := by
    simpa [PolynomialSplitsIn, algebraMap_eq_embedding eM] using hM
  let φ : L →ₐ[K] M := Polynomial.IsSplittingField.lift L p hsplits
  obtain ⟨g, hfun, hextends⟩ := algHom_to_embedding_bridge eL eM φ
  exact ⟨g, hextends⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.splittingFields_isomorphic_bridge
statement:
private theorem splittingFields_isomorphic_bridge {K L M : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    (eL : FieldEmbedding K L) (eM : FieldEmbedding K M) (p : Polynomial K)
    (hL : SplittingFieldFor eL p) (hM : SplittingFieldFor eM p) :
    Nonempty (FieldIsomorphismOver eL eM)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := eL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K M := eM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hsfL : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p :=
    (splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib eL p).mp hL |>.2
  have hsfM : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K M p :=
    (splittingFieldFor_iff_mathlib eM p).mp hM |>.2
  letI : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K L p := hsfL
  letI : Polynomial.IsSplittingField K M p := hsfM
  let φ : L ≃ₐ[K] M :=
    (Polynomial.IsSplittingField.algEquiv L p).trans
      (Polynomial.IsSplittingField.algEquiv M p).symm
  obtain ⟨h, hforward⟩ := algEquiv_to_isomorphism_bridge eL eM φ
  exact ⟨h⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.mem_polynomialRootSetIn_iff
statement:
theorem mem_polynomialRootSetIn_iff {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) (a : L) :
    a ∈ PolynomialRootSetIn e p ↔ p ≠ 0 ∧ evaluateOver e p a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.polynomialRootSetIn_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialRootSetIn_zero {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    PolynomialRootSetIn e (0 : Polynomial K) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp [PolynomialRootSetIn]

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.polynomialSplitsIn_iff_exists_multiset
statement:
theorem polynomialSplitsIn_iff_exists_multiset {K L : Type*}
    [Field K] [Field L] (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (p : Polynomial K) :
    PolynomialSplitsIn e p ↔
      ∃ roots : Multiset L,
        p.map e.toRingHom = Polynomial.C (p.map e.toRingHom).leadingCoeff *
          (roots.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)).prod
proof:
:= by
  exact splits_multiset_bridge e p

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.polynomialSplitsIn_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialSplitsIn_zero {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) : PolynomialSplitsIn e (0 : Polynomial K)
proof:
:= by
  exact (elementary_splits_bridge e).1

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.polynomialSplitsIn_C
statement:
theorem polynomialSplitsIn_C {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (c : K) : PolynomialSplitsIn e (Polynomial.C c)
proof:
:= by
  exact (elementary_splits_bridge e).2.1 c

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.polynomialSplitsIn_of_degree_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  exact (elementary_splits_bridge e).2.2.1 p hp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSplitting.polynomialSplitsIn_mul_iff
statement:
theorem polynomialSplitsIn_mul_iff {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]

statement:
private theorem mapped_rootMultiplicity_le_one_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {p : Polynomial K}
    (hp : SeparablePolynomial p) (x : L) :
    (p.map e.toRingHom).rootMultiplicity x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_le_one_of_separable
  rw [Polynomial.separable_def']
  exact (separablePolynomial_map_iff e p).mpr hp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.separable_iff_mapped_rootMultiplicity_le_one_bridge
statement:
private theorem separable_iff_mapped_rootMultiplicity_le_one_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) {p : Polynomial K}
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hs : PolynomialSplitsIn e p) :
    SeparablePolynomial p ↔
      ∀ x : L, (p.map e.toRingHom).rootMultiplicity x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsep x
    exact mapped_rootMultiplicity_le_one_bridge e hsep x
  · intro hmult
    have hmap0 : p.map e.toRingHom ≠ 0 := Polynomial.map_ne_zero hp
    have hnodup : (p.map e.toRingHom).roots.Nodup := by
      classical
      rw [Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one]
      intro x
      rw [Polynomial.count_roots]
      exact hmult x
    have hsepMap : (p.map e.toRingHom).Separable :=
      (Polynomial.nodup_roots_iff_of_splits hmap0 hs).mp hnodup
    have hsep : p.Separable :=
      (Polynomial.separable_map e.toRingHom).mp hsepMap
    rw [Polynomial.separable_def'] at hsep
    exact hsep

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.FieldSeparableNormal.normalExtension_irreducible_root_bridge
statement:
private theorem normalExtension_irreducible_root_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) :
    NormalExtension e ↔
      AlgebraicExtension e ∧
        ∀ p : Polynomial K,
          Irreducible p →
            (∃ x : L, evaluateOver e p x = 0) →
              PolynomialSplitsIn e p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨halg, hminSplits⟩
    refine ⟨halg, ?_⟩
    intro p hp ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hxalg : AlgebraicElement e x := halg x
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := minimalPolynomialOf_exists e hxalg
    have hqirr : Irreducible q :=
      minimalPolynomialOf_irreducible e hxalg hq
    have hq_dvd_p : q ∣ p := hq.2.2 p hx
    have hp_dvd_q : p ∣ q := hqirr.dvd_symm hp hq_dvd_p
    have hqSplits : PolynomialSplitsIn e q := hminSplits x q hq
    apply Polynomial.Splits.of_dvd hqSplits
    · exact Polynomial.map_ne_zero (minimalPolynomialOf_ne_zero e hq)
    · exact Polynomial.map_dvd e.toRingHom hp_dvd_q
  · rintro ⟨halg, hirrSplits⟩
    refine ⟨halg, ?_⟩
    intro x p hp
    apply hirrSplits p (minimalPolynomialOf_irreducible e (halg x) hp)
    exact ⟨x, hp.2.1⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.finiteGalois_fixedField_relativeDegree_eq_card
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fixedField_relativeDegree_eq_card
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    HasExtensionDegree
      (intermediateFieldInclusion (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H))
      (Nat.card H)
proof:
:= by
  let F := fixedFieldIntermediateField e H
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hcard⟩ :=
    finiteGalois_fixing_card_eq_relativeDegree e hfin hgal F
  have hfix :
      FixingAutomorphismSet e F.carrier =
        (H : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) := by
    have hrecover :=
      finiteExtension_fixingAutomorphismSubgroup_fixedFieldSet e hfin H
    have hcarrier := congrArg
      (fun S : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e) =>
        (S : Set (FieldAutomorphismOver e))) hrecover
    simpa [F, fixedFieldIntermediateField] using hcarrier
  have hcardH : Nat.card H = n := by
    rw [hfix] at hcard
    simpa using hcard
  exact hcardH.symm ▸ hn

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge
statement:
private theorem hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge
    {A B : Type*} [Field A] [Field B] (j : FieldEmbedding A B)
    (n : ℕ) (h : HasExtensionDegree j n) :
    letI : Algebra A B := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) A B)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra A B := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
  have hsum (c : Fin n → A) :
      fieldLinearCombination j Finset.univ c v = ∑ i, c i • v i := by
    simp only [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, FieldEmbedding.toRingHom]
    rfl
  have hli : LinearIndependent A v := by
    apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
    intro c hc i
    apply hv.1 c
    rw [hsum]
    exact hc
  have hspan : Submodule.span A (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv.2 x
    apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun A).mpr
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rw [← hsum]
    exact hc
  exact ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli hspan.ge⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.hasExtensionDegree_of_finrank_bridge
statement:
private theorem hasExtensionDegree_of_finrank_bridge
    {A B : Type*} [Field A] [Field B] (j : FieldEmbedding A B)
    (n : ℕ) :
    letI : Algebra A B := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional A B → Module.finrank A B = n →
      HasExtensionDegree j n
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra A B := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro hfd hrank
  let _ : FiniteDimensional A B := hfd
  let B₀ : Module.Basis (Fin n) A B := Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq A B hrank
  have hsum (c : Fin n → A) :
      fieldLinearCombination j Finset.univ c B₀ = ∑ i, c i • B₀ i := by
    simp only [fieldLinearCombination, Algebra.smul_def,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, FieldEmbedding.toRingHom]
    rfl
  refine ⟨fun i => B₀ i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c hc i
    apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp B₀.linearIndependent c
    rw [← hsum]
    exact hc
  · intro x
    have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range fun i => B₀ i) := by
      rw [B₀.span_eq]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun A).mp hx
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rw [hsum]
    exact hc

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.intermediateField_baseDegree_exists_bridge
statement:
private theorem intermediateField_baseDegree_exists_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) m
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra K L := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hfin
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin d) K L :=
    Classical.choice (hasExtensionDegree_mathlibBasis_bridge e d hd)
  letI : FiniteDimensional K L := Module.Finite.of_basis B
  letI algKF : Algebra K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI moduleKF : Module K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) :=
    @Algebra.toModule K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) _ _ algKF
  let ι : IntermediateFieldCarrier F →ₗ[K] L :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        change (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F c).val * x.val = e c * x.val
        exact congrArg (fun z => z * x.val)
          (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding_apply F c) }
  let finiteKF : @Module.Finite K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) _ _ moduleKF :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective ι Subtype.val_injective
  letI : @Module.Finite K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) _ _ moduleKF := finiteKF
  let hfd : @FiniteDimensional K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F) _ _ moduleKF :=
    finiteKF
  let m := Module.finrank K (IntermediateFieldCarrier F)
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  exact hasExtensionDegree_of_finrank_bridge
    (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) m hfd rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.fixedField_baseDegree_exists_bridge
statement:
private theorem fixedField_baseDegree_exists_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      HasExtensionDegree
        (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)) m
proof:
:=
  intermediateField_baseDegree_exists_bridge e hfin
    (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H)

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.fieldEmbedding_ext
statement:
private theorem fieldEmbedding_ext
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    {e f : FieldEmbedding K L} (h : ∀ x, e x = f x) : e = f
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | mk et eh ei =>
    cases f with
    | mk ft fh fi =>
      change ∀ x, et x = ft x at h
      have heft : et = ft := funext h
      subst ft
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.intermediate_extensionDegree_tower_bridge
statement:
private theorem intermediate_extensionDegree_tower_bridge
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (F : ExplicitIntermediateField e)
    {m n : ℕ}
    (hm : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) m)
    (hn : HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) n) :
    HasExtensionDegree e (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  have htower :=
    extensionDegree_tower
      (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F)
      (intermediateFieldInclusion F) hm hn
  have hcomp :
      (intermediateFieldInclusion F).comp
          (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding F) = e := by
    apply fieldEmbedding_ext
    intro x
    exact intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding_apply F x
  exact hcomp ▸ htower

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.GaloisConsequencesDegreeIndex.finiteGalois_fixedField_degree_eq_index
statement:
theorem finiteGalois_fixedField_degree_eq_index
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (e : FieldEmbedding K L) (hfin : FiniteFieldExtension e)
    (hgal : GaloisExtension e)
    (H : Subgroup (FieldAutomorphismOver e)) :
    HasExtensionDegree
      (intermediateFieldBaseEmbedding (fixedFieldIntermediateField e H))
      H.index
proof:
:= by
  let F := fixedFieldIntermediateField e H
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := fixedField_baseDegree_exists_bridge e hfin H
  have hrelative :
      HasExtensionDegree (intermediateFieldInclusion F) (Nat.card H) := by
    simpa [F] using
      finiteGalois_fixedField_relativeDegree_eq_card e hfin hgal H
  have htower : HasExtensionDegree e (m * Nat.card H) :=
    intermediate_extensionDegree_tower_bridge e F hm hrelative
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hfin
  have hproduct :
      m * Nat.card H = Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver e) := by
    exact (extensionDegree_unique e htower hd).trans
      (finiteGalois_automorphism_card_eq_degree e hgal hd).symm
  have hlagrange :
      Nat.card H * H.index = Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver e) :=
    lagrange H
  have hcancel : Nat.card H * m = Nat.card H * H.index := by
    calc
      Nat.card H * m = m * Nat.card H := Nat.mul_comm _ _
      _ = Nat.card (FieldAutomorphismOver e) := hproduct
      _ = Nat.card H * H.index := hlagrange.symm
  have hcardPositive : 0 < Nat.card H :=
    extensionDegree_pos (intermediateFieldInclusion F) hrelative
  have hmindex : m = H.index :=
    Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hcardPositive hcancel
  exact hmindex ▸ hm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.normalizedFactor_monic_irreducible
statement:
theorem normalizedFactor_monic_irreducible
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    {p q : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ∈ normalizedFactors p) :

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.monic_irreducible_factorization_unique
statement:
theorem monic_irreducible_factorization_unique
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {s t : Multiset (Polynomial K)}
    (hsM : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Monic) (htM : ∀ q ∈ t, q.Monic)
    (hsI : ∀ q ∈ s, Irreducible q) (htI : ∀ q ∈ t, Irreducible q)
    (hprod : s.prod = t.prod) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsNorm : s.map normalize = s := by
    calc
      s.map normalize = s.map id :=
        Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun q hq => (hsM q hq).normalize_eq_self)
      _ = s := Multiset.map_id s
  have htNorm : t.map normalize = t := by
    calc
      t.map normalize = t.map id :=
        Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun q hq => (htM q hq).normalize_eq_self)
      _ = t := Multiset.map_id t
  have hsFactors := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_prod_eq s hsI
  have htFactors := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_prod_eq t htI
  rw [hsNorm] at hsFactors
  rw [htNorm] at htFactors
  calc
    s = normalizedFactors s.prod := hsFactors.symm
    _ = normalizedFactors t.prod := by rw [hprod]
    _ = t := htFactors

theorem rootMultiplicity_pos_iff_isRoot
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {a : K} :
    0 < p.rootMultiplicity a ↔ p.IsRoot a
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_pos hp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.pow_X_sub_C_dvd_iff_le_rootMultiplicity
statement:
theorem pow_X_sub_C_dvd_iff_le_rootMultiplicity
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {a : K} {n : ℕ} :
    (X - C a) ^ n ∣ p ↔ n ≤ p.rootMultiplicity a
proof:
:= by
  exact (Polynomial.le_rootMultiplicity_iff hp).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.rootMultiplicity_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_eq_iff
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {a : K} {n : ℕ} :
    p.rootMultiplicity a = n ↔
      (X - C a) ^ n ∣ p ∧ ¬(X - C a) ^ (n + 1) ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · apply (Polynomial.le_rootMultiplicity_iff hp).mp
      omega
    · apply (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_le_iff hp a n).mp
      omega
  · rintro ⟨hn, hsucc⟩
    have hnle : n ≤ p.rootMultiplicity a :=
      (Polynomial.le_rootMultiplicity_iff hp).mpr hn
    have hle : p.rootMultiplicity a ≤ n :=
      (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_le_iff hp a n).mpr hsucc
    exact le_antisymm hle hnle

statement:

proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot_derivative
statement:
theorem one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot_derivative
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0) {a : K} :
    1 < p.rootMultiplicity a ↔ p.IsRoot a ∧ p.derivative.IsRoot a
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot hp

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.PolynomialFactorization.simpleRoot_iff_derivative_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem simpleRoot_iff_derivative_eval_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : Polynomial K} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    {a : K} (ha : p.IsRoot a) :
    SimpleRoot p a ↔ p.derivative.eval a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleRoot, and_iff_right ha, ne_eq, ← Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
  constructor
  · intro hm hder
    have hlt := (Polynomial.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot hp).mpr ⟨ha, hder⟩
    omega
  · intro hnot
    have hpos : 0 < p.rootMultiplicity a := (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_pos hp).mpr ha
    have hle : p.rootMultiplicity a ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra h
      have hlt : 1 < p.rootMultiplicity a := Nat.lt_of_not_ge h
      exact hnot ((Polynomial.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot hp).mp hlt).2
    omega

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.finitely_generated_abelian_structure
statement:
theorem finitely_generated_abelian_structure (G : Type*) [CommGroup G]
    (hG : IsFinitelyGeneratedGroup G) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (p : ι → ℕ)
      (_ : ∀ i, Nat.Prime (p i)) (e : ι → ℕ),
      Nonempty (G ≃* (Fin r → Multiplicative ℤ) ×
        ((i : ι) → Multiplicative (ZMod (p i ^ e i))))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Group.FG G := isFinitelyGeneratedGroup_iff_mathlib.mp hG
  obtain ⟨ι, j, hι, hj, p, hp, e, h⟩ :=
    CommGroup.equiv_free_prod_prod_multiplicative_zmod G
  let r := Fintype.card j
  let jr : j ≃ Fin r := Fintype.equivFin j
  refine ⟨r, ι, hι, p, hp, e, ?_⟩
  exact Nonempty.map (fun equiv => equiv.trans
    ((MulEquiv.arrowCongr jr (MulEquiv.refl _)).prodCongr (MulEquiv.refl _))) h

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.finite_abelian_prime_power_structure
statement:
theorem finite_abelian_prime_power_structure (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] [Finite G] :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (p : ι → ℕ)
      (_ : ∀ i, Nat.Prime (p i)) (e : ι → ℕ),
      Nonempty (G ≃* ((i : ι) → Multiplicative (ZMod (p i ^ e i))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, p, hp, e, ⟨equiv⟩⟩ :=
    AddCommGroup.equiv_directSum_zmod_of_finite (Additive G)
  refine ⟨ι, hι, p, hp, e, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨MulEquiv.toAdditive.symm <| equiv.trans <|
    (DirectSum.addEquivProd _).trans (MulEquiv.piMultiplicative _).toAdditiveRight⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.finite_abelian_cyclic_structure
statement:
theorem finite_abelian_cyclic_structure (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] [Finite G] :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (n : ι → ℕ),
      (∀ i, 1 < n i) ∧
      Nonempty (G ≃* ((i : ι) → Multiplicative (ZMod (n i))))
proof:
:= by
  exact CommGroup.equiv_prod_multiplicative_zmod_of_finite G

name: SandronesLibrary.AbstractAlgebra.Group.finite_abelian_iff_cyclic_product
statement:
theorem finite_abelian_iff_cyclic_product (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] :
    Finite G ↔
      ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (n : ι → ℕ),
        (∀ i, 1 < n i) ∧
        Nonempty (G ≃* ((i : ι) → Multiplicative (ZMod (n i))))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hG
    let _ : Finite G := hG
    exact finite_abelian_cyclic_structure G
  · rintro ⟨ι, hι, n, hn, ⟨equiv⟩⟩
    let _ : ∀ i, NeZero (n i) := fun i =>
      ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (hn i))⟩
    let _ : ∀ i, Finite (Multiplicative (ZMod (n i))) := fun _ => inferInstance
    let _ : Finite ((i : ι) → Multiplicative (ZMod (n i))) := inferInstance
    exact Finite.of_equiv _ equiv.symm.toEquiv

        δ * ((ρ * sin φ * cos θ) * (ρ ^ 2 * sin φ))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hphi (ρ θ : ℝ) :
      (∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π,
        δ * ((ρ * sin φ * cos θ) * (ρ ^ 2 * sin φ))) =
          δ * ρ ^ 3 * cos θ * (π / 2) := by
    have heq : (∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π,
        δ * ((ρ * sin φ * cos θ) * (ρ ^ 2 * sin φ))) =
        ∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π, (δ * ρ ^ 3 * cos θ) * sin φ ^ 2 := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo
      intro φ _
      ring
    rw [heq]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioo_sin_sq_zero_pi]
  simp_rw [hphi]
  have htheta (ρ : ℝ) :
      (∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, δ * ρ ^ 3 * cos θ * (π / 2)) = 0 := by
    have heq : (∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, δ * ρ ^ 3 * cos θ * (π / 2)) =
        ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, (δ * ρ ^ 3 * (π / 2)) * cos θ := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo
      intro θ _
      ring
    rw [heq]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioo_cos_neg_pi_pi, mul_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GaussStokes.gauss_unitCube_identity
statement:
theorem gauss_unitCube_identity :
    boxBoundaryFlux3 (fun x : Fin 3 → ℝ ↦ x) unitCubeLower unitCubeUpper = 3
proof:
:= by
  let F' : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
    fun _ ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 3 → ℝ)
  have hab : unitCubeLower ≤ unitCubeUpper := by
    intro i
    simp [unitCubeLower, unitCubeUpper]
  have hdiv : ∀ x, divergence3 F' x = 3 := by
    intro x
    simp [divergence3, F']
  have hint : IntegrableOn (divergence3 F') (Icc unitCubeLower unitCubeUpper) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
      (integrableOn_const (C := (3 : ℝ)) (measure_Icc_lt_top.ne)) ?_
      measurableSet_Icc
    intro x _
    exact (hdiv x).symm
  rw [gauss_box3 unitCubeLower unitCubeUpper hab (fun x ↦ x) F'
    continuous_id.continuousOn (fun x _ ↦ by unfold F'; fun_prop) hint]
  simp_rw [hdiv]
  rw [setIntegral_const]
  change (volume (Icc unitCubeLower unitCubeUpper)).toReal * 3 = 3
  rw [Real.volume_Icc_pi_toReal hab]
  simp [unitCubeLower, unitCubeUpper]

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GaussStokes.stokes_horizontalUnitSquare_xDy
statement:
theorem stokes_horizontalUnitSquare_xDy :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral
      (surfacePullbackCoeff₁ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquare)
      (surfacePullbackCoeff₂ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquare) 0 0 1 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hP : surfacePullbackCoeff₁ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquare = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
    funext z
    simp [surfacePullbackCoeff₁, xDyForm, horizontalUnitSquare,
      surfaceTangent₁_affinePlane]
  have hQ : surfacePullbackCoeff₂ xDyForm horizontalUnitSquare = fun z ↦ z.1 := by
    funext z
    simp [surfacePullbackCoeff₂, xDyForm, horizontalUnitSquare, affinePlane,
      surfaceTangent₂_affinePlane]
  let P' : ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fun _ ↦ 0
  let Q' : ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    fun _ ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ
  have hstokes := stokes_parametrized_rectangle xDyForm horizontalUnitSquare
    P' Q' 0 0 1 1
    (by rw [hP]; fun_prop)
    (by rw [hQ]; fun_prop)
    (by intro z hz; rw [hP]; unfold P'; fun_prop)
    (by intro z hz; rw [hQ]; unfold Q'; fun_prop)
    (by
      have heq : (fun z ↦ Q' z (1, 0) - P' z (0, 1)) = fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ) := by

        simp [P', Q']

  simp [P', Q']
