name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.green_standardRightTriangle
statement:
theorem green_standardRightTriangle
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hPy : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      standardRightTriangle (volume.prod volume))
    (hQx : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      standardRightTriangle (volume.prod volume))
    (hPdiff : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 (1 - x),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y)
    (hQdiff : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 (1 - y),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x)
    (hPint : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun y ↦ P (x, y))) volume 0 (1 - x))
    (hQint : ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, y))) volume 0 (1 - y)) :
    standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral P Q =
      ∫ z in standardRightTriangle,
        (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1 -
          deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2) ∂(volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hdomains : xNormalDomain 0 1 (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun x ↦ 1 - x) =
      yNormalDomain 0 1 (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun y ↦ 1 - y) :=
    standardRightTriangle_eq_xNormal.symm.trans standardRightTriangle_eq_yNormal
  have hPy' : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      (xNormalDomain 0 1 (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun x ↦ 1 - x))
      (volume.prod volume) := by
    simpa [← standardRightTriangle_eq_xNormal] using hPy
  have hQx' : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      (yNormalDomain 0 1 (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun y ↦ 1 - y))
      (volume.prod volume) := by
    simpa [← standardRightTriangle_eq_yNormal] using hQx
  have h := green_binormal_domain P Q 0 1 0 1
    (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun x ↦ 1 - x) (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun y ↦ 1 - y)
    continuous_const (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    continuous_const (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    (fun x hx ↦ by linarith [hx.2]) (fun y hy ↦ by linarith [hy.2])
    hdomains hPy' hQx' hPdiff hQdiff hPint hQint
  simpa [standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral, normalDomainBoundaryIntegral,
    ← standardRightTriangle_eq_xNormal] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral_zero_fst
statement:
theorem standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral_zero_fst :
    standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun z ↦ z.1) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have honeSub : (∫ y in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 1 - y) = 1 / 2 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..1, 1 - y := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num), integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub]
        · norm_num [integral_id]
        · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 1
        · exact continuous_id.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  rw [standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral]
  simp only [sub_self, MeasureTheory.integral_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
  rw [honeSub]

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.unitDisk_eq_xNormal
statement:
lemma unitDisk_eq_xNormal : unitDisk =
    xNormalDomain (-1) 1 (fun x ↦ -√(1 - x ^ 2)) (fun x ↦ √(1 - x ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [unitDisk, xNormalDomain, mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hxSq : z.1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.2]
    have hxabs : |z.1| ≤ 1 := by simpa using Real.abs_le_sqrt hxSq
    have hyabs : |z.2| ≤ √(1 - z.1 ^ 2) := Real.abs_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
    exact ⟨abs_le.mp hxabs, abs_le.mp hyabs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hyl, hyu⟩
    have hxabs : |z.1| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr hx
    have hxSq : z.1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      simpa [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg z.1) (by norm_num)).2 hxabs
    have hA : 0 ≤ 1 - z.1 ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hyabs : |z.2| ≤ √(1 - z.1 ^ 2) := abs_le.mpr ⟨hyl, hyu⟩
    have hySq : z.2 ^ 2 ≤ (√(1 - z.1 ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      simpa using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg z.2) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).2 hyabs
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hA] at hySq
    nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.unitDisk_eq_yNormal
statement:
lemma unitDisk_eq_yNormal : unitDisk =
    yNormalDomain (-1) 1 (fun y ↦ -√(1 - y ^ 2)) (fun y ↦ √(1 - y ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [unitDisk, yNormalDomain, mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hySq : z.2 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.1]
    have hyabs : |z.2| ≤ 1 := by simpa using Real.abs_le_sqrt hySq
    have hxabs : |z.1| ≤ √(1 - z.2 ^ 2) := Real.abs_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
    exact ⟨abs_le.mp hyabs, abs_le.mp hxabs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hy, hxl, hxu⟩
    have hyabs : |z.2| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr hy
    have hySq : z.2 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      simpa [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg z.2) (by norm_num)).2 hyabs
    have hB : 0 ≤ 1 - z.2 ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hxabs : |z.1| ≤ √(1 - z.2 ^ 2) := abs_le.mpr ⟨hxl, hxu⟩
    have hxSq : z.1 ^ 2 ≤ (√(1 - z.2 ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      simpa using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg z.1) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).2 hxabs
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hB] at hxSq
    nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.green_unitDisk
statement:
theorem green_unitDisk
    (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (hPy : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      unitDisk (volume.prod volume))
    (hQx : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      unitDisk (volume.prod volume))
    (hPdiff : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ y ∈ Icc (-√(1 - x ^ 2)) (√(1 - x ^ 2)),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ P (x, t)) y)
    (hQdiff : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ x ∈ Icc (-√(1 - y ^ 2)) (√(1 - y ^ 2)),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t ↦ Q (t, y)) x)
    (hPint : ∀ x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun y ↦ P (x, y))) volume
        (-√(1 - x ^ 2)) (√(1 - x ^ 2)))
    (hQint : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
      IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, y))) volume
        (-√(1 - y ^ 2)) (√(1 - y ^ 2))) :
    unitDiskBoundaryIntegral P Q =
      ∫ z in unitDisk,
        (deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1 -
          deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2) ∂(volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Continuous (fun x : ℝ ↦ √(1 - x ^ 2)) :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.pow 2))
  have hdomains :
      xNormalDomain (-1) 1 (fun x ↦ -√(1 - x ^ 2)) (fun x ↦ √(1 - x ^ 2)) =
        yNormalDomain (-1) 1 (fun y ↦ -√(1 - y ^ 2)) (fun y ↦ √(1 - y ^ 2)) :=
    unitDisk_eq_xNormal.symm.trans unitDisk_eq_yNormal
  have hPy' : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun y ↦ P (z.1, y)) z.2)
      (xNormalDomain (-1) 1 (fun x ↦ -√(1 - x ^ 2)) (fun x ↦ √(1 - x ^ 2)))
      (volume.prod volume) := by
    simpa [← unitDisk_eq_xNormal] using hPy
  have hQx' : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ deriv (fun x ↦ Q (x, z.2)) z.1)
      (yNormalDomain (-1) 1 (fun y ↦ -√(1 - y ^ 2)) (fun y ↦ √(1 - y ^ 2)))
      (volume.prod volume) := by
    simpa [← unitDisk_eq_yNormal] using hQx
  have h := green_binormal_domain P Q (-1) 1 (-1) 1
    (fun x ↦ -√(1 - x ^ 2)) (fun x ↦ √(1 - x ^ 2))
    (fun y ↦ -√(1 - y ^ 2)) (fun y ↦ √(1 - y ^ 2))
    hsqrt.neg hsqrt hsqrt.neg hsqrt
    (fun x _ ↦ by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - x ^ 2)])
    (fun y _ ↦ by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - y ^ 2)])
    hdomains hPy' hQx' hPdiff hQdiff hPint hQint
  simpa [unitDiskBoundaryIntegral, normalDomainBoundaryIntegral,
    ← unitDisk_eq_xNormal] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegralRev_eq_neg
statement:
theorem standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegralRev_eq_neg (P Q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) :
    standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegralRev P Q =
      -standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral P Q
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (∫ x in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, P (x, 1 - x) - P (x, 0)) =
      -(∫ x in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, P (x, 0) - P (x, 1 - x)) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
    intro x _
    ring
  have h2 : (∫ y in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Q (0, y) - Q (1 - y, y)) =
      -(∫ y in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Q (1 - y, y) - Q (0, y)) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
    intro y _
    ring
  rw [standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegralRev, standardRightTriangleBoundaryIntegral,
    h1, h2]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.GreenRegions.unitDiskBoundaryIntegralRev_eq_neg

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.CoordinateIntegrals.spherical_ball_jacobian_integral
statement:
theorem spherical_ball_jacobian_integral {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (∫ ρ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) R, ∫ _θ in Ioo (-π) π,
      ∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π, ρ ^ 2 * sin φ) =
        4 * π * R ^ 3 / 3
proof:
:= by
  have hphi (ρ : ℝ) :
      (∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π, ρ ^ 2 * sin φ) = ρ ^ 2 * 2 := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioo_sin_zero_pi]
  simp_rw [hphi]
  have htheta (ρ : ℝ) :
      (∫ _θ in Ioo (-π) π, ρ ^ 2 * 2) = 4 * π * ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [setIntegral_const]
    simp [pi_pos.le]
    ring
  simp_rw [htheta]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioo_sq_zero_radius hR]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.CoordinateIntegrals.uniform_ball_mass_jacobian_integral
statement:
theorem uniform_ball_mass_jacobian_integral (δ : ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (∫ ρ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) R, ∫ _θ in Ioo (-π) π,
      ∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π, δ * (ρ ^ 2 * sin φ)) =
        4 * π * δ * R ^ 3 / 3
proof:
:= by
  have hphi (ρ : ℝ) :
      (∫ φ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) π, δ * (ρ ^ 2 * sin φ)) =
        δ * (ρ ^ 2 * 2) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
      integral_Ioo_sin_zero_pi]
    ring
  simp_rw [hphi]
  have htheta (ρ : ℝ) :
      (∫ _θ in Ioo (-π) π, δ * (ρ ^ 2 * 2)) =
        4 * π * δ * ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [setIntegral_const]
    simp [pi_pos.le]
    ring
  simp_rw [htheta]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioo_sq_zero_radius hR]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Lp.memLp_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_nonneg
statement: theorem maximalFunction_nonneg (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ maximalFunction f x
proof:

  zero_le

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_mono
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_mono {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (h : ∀ y, |f y| ≤ |g y|) :
    maximalFunction f ≤ maximalFunction g
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine iSup_le fun I => iSup_le fun hx => ?_
  refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_right (lintegral_mono fun y => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (h y)) _) ?_
  exact le_iSup_of_le I (le_iSup_of_le hx le_rfl)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_mono_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_mono_of_nonneg {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : 0 ≤ f) (h : f ≤ g) :
    maximalFunction f ≤ maximalFunction g
proof:
:=
  maximalFunction_mono fun y => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hf y)]
    exact le_trans (h y) (le_abs_self (g y))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.volume_toSet_ne_zero
statement: private theorem volume_toSet_ne_zero (I : OpenInterval) : volume I.toSet ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OpenInterval.toSet, Real.volume_Ioo]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.2 (by linarith [I.lt])

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.volume_toSet_ne_top
statement: private theorem volume_toSet_ne_top (I : OpenInterval) : volume I.toSet ≠ ∞
proof:

  rw [OpenInterval.toSet, Real.volume_Ioo]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.inv_mul_lintegral_const
statement:
private theorem inv_mul_lintegral_const (I : OpenInterval) (a : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (volume I.toSet)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ _y in I.toSet, a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, ← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul,
    ENNReal.div_mul_cancel (volume_toSet_ne_zero I) (volume_toSet_ne_top I)]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_const
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_const (a x : ℝ) :
    maximalFunction (fun _ => a) x = ENNReal.ofReal |a|
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine iSup_le fun I => iSup_le fun _ => ?_
    rw [inv_mul_lintegral_const]
  · refine le_iSup_of_le ⟨x - 1, x + 1, by linarith⟩ ?_
    refine le_iSup_of_le (show x ∈ (⟨x - 1, x + 1, by linarith⟩ : OpenInterval).toSet from
      ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩) ?_
    rw [inv_mul_lintegral_const]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.lintegral_abs_congr_ae
statement:
theorem lintegral_abs_congr_ae {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) (I : OpenInterval) :
    ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| = ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |g y|
proof:
:= by
  refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [h.filter_mono (ae_mono (Measure.restrict_le_self (s := I.toSet)))] with y hy
  rw [hy]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_congr_of_ae_eq
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_congr_of_ae_eq {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) :
    maximalFunction f = maximalFunction g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [maximalFunction]
  refine iSup_congr fun I => iSup_congr fun _ => ?_
  rw [lintegral_abs_congr_ae h I]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_congr_ae
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_congr_ae {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) :
    maximalFunction f =ᵐ[volume] maximalFunction g
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalFunction_congr_of_ae_eq h]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.isOpen_lt_maximalFunction
statement:
theorem isOpen_lt_maximalFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    IsOpen {x : ℝ | c < maximalFunction f x}
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {x : ℝ | c < maximalFunction f x} =
      ⋃ (I : OpenInterval)
        (_ : c < (volume I.toSet)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|), I.toSet := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      simp only [maximalFunction, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
      obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.1 hx
      obtain ⟨hxI, hlt⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.1 hI
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨I, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hlt, hxI⟩⟩
    · intro hx
      simp only [mem_iUnion] at hx
      obtain ⟨I, hlt, hxI⟩ := hx
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (le_iSup_of_le I (le_iSup_of_le hxI le_rfl))
  rw [hset]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun I => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => OpenInterval.isOpen_toSet I

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.measurableSet_lt_maximalFunction
statement:
theorem measurableSet_lt_maximalFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    MeasurableSet {x : ℝ | c < maximalFunction f x}
proof:
:=
  (isOpen_lt_maximalFunction f c).measurableSet

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.lowerSemicontinuous_maximalFunction
statement:
theorem lowerSemicontinuous_maximalFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    LowerSemicontinuous (maximalFunction f)
proof:
:=
  lowerSemicontinuous_iff_isOpen_preimage.2 fun c =>
    isOpen_lt_maximalFunction f c

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.measurable_maximalFunction
statement: theorem measurable_maximalFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Measurable (maximalFunction f)
proof:
:=
  measurable_of_Ioi (f := maximalFunction f) fun c => measurableSet_lt_maximalFunction f c

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.aemeasurable_maximalFunction
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_maximalFunction (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    AEMeasurable (maximalFunction f) volume
proof:
:=
  (measurable_maximalFunction f).aemeasurable

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.volume_le_inv_mul_lintegral_of_lt_average
statement:
theorem volume_le_inv_mul_lintegral_of_lt_average {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (hc : 0 < c)
    {I : OpenInterval}
    (havg : (c : ℝ≥0∞) < (volume I.toSet)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|) :
    volume I.toSet ≤ (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : (c : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ne_eq, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero] using ne_of_gt hc
  have hct : (c : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  have hmain : (c : ℝ≥0∞) * volume I.toSet < ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    rw [← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul] at havg
    exact (ENNReal.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (Or.inl (volume_toSet_ne_zero I))
      (Or.inl (volume_toSet_ne_top I))).1 havg
  have h : (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ((c : ℝ≥0∞) * volume I.toSet) <
      (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| :=
    ENNReal.mul_lt_mul_right (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.2 hct) (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hc0) hmain
  calc
    volume I.toSet = (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ((c : ℝ≥0∞) * volume I.toSet) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hc0 hct, one_mul]
    _ ≤ (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := le_of_lt h

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.radius_le_of_lt_average
statement:
theorem radius_le_of_lt_average {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f volume) {c : ℝ≥0} (hc : 0 < c)
    {I : OpenInterval}
    (havg : (c : ℝ≥0∞) < (volume I.toSet)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|) :
    I.radius ≤ (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|).toReal / (2 * (c : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have htop : ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| ≠ ∞ := ne_of_lt (by simpa using hf.abs.lintegral_lt_top)
  have hc0 : (c : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ne_eq, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero] using ne_of_gt hc
  have hct : (c : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  have hmain : (c : ℝ≥0∞) * volume I.toSet < ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    rw [← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul] at havg
    exact (ENNReal.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (Or.inl (volume_toSet_ne_zero I))
      (Or.inl (volume_toSet_ne_top I))).1 havg
  have hle : ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| ≤ ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    simpa using lintegral_mono_set (subset_univ I.toSet)
  have hlt : (c : ℝ≥0∞) * volume I.toSet < ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hmain hle
  have hltR : (c : ℝ) * (I.u - I.l) < (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|).toReal := by
    have h1 := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (ENNReal.mul_ne_top hct (volume_toSet_ne_top I))
      htop).2 hlt
    have h2 : ((c : ℝ≥0∞) * volume I.toSet).toReal = (c : ℝ) * (I.u - I.l) := by
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.coe_toReal, OpenInterval.toSet, Real.volume_Ioo,
        ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by linarith [I.lt])]
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hcpos : (0 : ℝ) < c := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have h2c : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * c := by linarith
  have hdiv : (c * (I.u - I.l)) / (2 * c) <
      (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|).toReal / (2 * c) :=
    div_lt_div_of_pos_right hltR h2c
  have heq : (c * (I.u - I.l)) / (2 * c) = (I.u - I.l) / 2 := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt h2c) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    ring
  calc
    I.radius = (I.u - I.l) / 2 := rfl
    _ = (c * (I.u - I.l)) / (2 * c) := heq.symm
    _ ≤ (∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|).toReal / (2 * (c : ℝ)) := le_of_lt hdiv

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_weak_type
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_weak_type (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f volume)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : 0 < c) :
    volume {x : ℝ | (c : ℝ≥0∞) < maximalFunction f x} ≤
      4 * (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set E : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | (c : ℝ≥0∞) < maximalFunction f x} with hE
  have hEexists : ∀ x ∈ E, ∃ I : OpenInterval, x ∈ I.toSet ∧
      (c : ℝ≥0∞) < (volume I.toSet)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in I.toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hE] at hx
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, maximalFunction] at hx
    obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.1 hx
    obtain ⟨hxI, hlt⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.1 hI
    exact ⟨I, hxI, hlt⟩
  let sel : ℝ → OpenInterval := fun x =>
    if h : x ∈ E then (hEexists x h).choose else ⟨0, 1, by norm_num⟩
  have hsel_mem : ∀ x ∈ E, x ∈ (sel x).toSet := by
    intro x hx
    dsimp only [sel]
    rw [dif_pos hx]
    exact (hEexists x hx).choose_spec.1
  have hsel_lt : ∀ x ∈ E, (c : ℝ≥0∞) <
      (volume (sel x).toSet)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in (sel x).toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    intro x hx
    dsimp only [sel]
    rw [dif_pos hx]
    exact (hEexists x hx).choose_spec.2
  obtain ⟨u, huE, hdisj, hcov⟩ :=
    exists_disjoint_interval_subfamily_covering_enlargement E sel
      ((∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|).toReal / (2 * (c : ℝ)))
      (fun x hx => radius_le_of_lt_average hf hc (hsel_lt x hx)) (τ := 4) (by norm_num)
  have hcount : Countable u := (hdisj.countable_of_nonempty_interior fun i _ => by
    rw [(OpenInterval.isOpen_toSet (sel i)).interior_eq]
    exact ⟨(sel i).center, OpenInterval.center_mem_toSet (sel i)⟩).to_subtype
  have hterm : ∀ b : u, volume ((sel b).toSet) ≤
      (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in (sel b).toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| :=
    fun b => volume_le_inv_mul_lintegral_of_lt_average hc (hsel_lt b.1 (huE b.2))
  have hleall : ∫⁻ y in ⋃ b : u, (sel b).toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| ≤
      ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    have hsub : (⋃ b : u, (sel b).toSet) ⊆ Set.univ := subset_univ _
    simpa using lintegral_mono_set hsub
  have hdisj' : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun b : u => (sel b).toSet) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact hdisj a.2 b.2 fun h => hab (Subtype.ext h)
  have htsum : ∑' b : u, volume ((sel b).toSet) ≤
      (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
    calc
      ∑' b : u, volume ((sel b).toSet)
          ≤ ∑' b : u, (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in (sel b).toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| :=
            ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hterm
      _ = (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∑' b : u, ∫⁻ y in (sel b).toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| :=
            ENNReal.tsum_mul_left
      _ = (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in ⋃ b : u, (sel b).toSet, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
            congr 1
            exact (lintegral_iUnion (s := fun b : u => (sel b).toSet)
              (fun b => OpenInterval.measurableSet_toSet (sel b)) hdisj'
              (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal |f y|)).symm
      _ ≤ (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| :=
            mul_le_mul_right hleall _
  have hcover : volume E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 4 * ∑' b : u, volume ((sel b).toSet) := by
    refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_)
      (volume_iUnion_le_mul_tsum E sel u huE hdisj hcov (by norm_num))
    intro x hx
    exact mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨x, hx, hsel_mem x hx⟩
  calc
    volume E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 4 * ∑' b : u, volume ((sel b).toSet) := hcover
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 4 * ((c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y|) :=
          mul_le_mul_right htsum _
    _ = 4 * (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y| := by
          rw [show ENNReal.ofReal 4 = (4 : ℝ≥0∞) by norm_num, mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MaximalFunction.maximalFunction_weak_type_sub
statement:
theorem maximalFunction_weak_type_sub {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (h : Integrable (fun y => f y - g y) volume) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : 0 < c) :
    volume {x : ℝ | (c : ℝ≥0∞) < maximalFunction (fun y => f y - g y) x} ≤
      4 * (c : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal |f y - g y|
proof:
:=
  maximalFunction_weak_type (fun y => f y - g y) h c hc

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegrable_const_lt
statement:
theorem riemannIntegrable_const_lt {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    RiemannIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => c) a b
proof:
:= by
  exact continuous_on_riemannIntegrable_lt hab continuousOn_const

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_const
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_const {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    riemannIntegral (fun _ : ℝ => c) a b = c * (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab continuousOn_const]
  rw [integral_const]
  simp [hab.le, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_add
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_add {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => f x + g x) a b =
      riemannIntegral f a b + riemannIntegral g a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval (f := fun x => f x + g x) hab (hf.add hg),
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf, riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hg]
  have hfi := continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hf
  have hgi := continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hg
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le] using
    intervalIntegral.integral_add hfi hgi

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_sub {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => f x - g x) a b =
      riemannIntegral f a b - riemannIntegral g a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval (f := fun x => f x - g x) hab (hf.sub hg),
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf, riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hg]
  have hfi := continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hf
  have hgi := continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hg
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le] using
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub hfi hgi

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_const_mul
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_const_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => c * f x) a b = c * riemannIntegral f a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval (f := fun x => c * f x) hab (continuousOn_const.mul hf),
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf]
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le] using
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul c f (a := a) (b := b) (μ := volume)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_nonneg
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_nonneg {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (h0 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ riemannIntegral f a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab.le h0

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_mono
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_mono {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfg : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ g x) :
    riemannIntegral f a b ≤ riemannIntegral g a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf, riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hg,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab.le
    (continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hf) (continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hg) hfg

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.abs_riemannIntegral_le_riemannIntegral_abs
statement:
theorem abs_riemannIntegral_le_riemannIntegral_abs {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
proof:
|riemannIntegral f a b| ≤ riemannIntegral (fun x => |f x|) a b := by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf,
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf.abs,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
  exact intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hab.le

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_add_adjacent
proof:
:= by
  have hac : a < c := hab.trans hbc
  have hfab : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) :=
    hf.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hbc.le)
  have hfbc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc b c) :=
    hf.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_left hab.le)
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hfab, riemannIntegral_eq_interval hbc hfbc,
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval hac hf,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hbc.le,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hac.le]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (continuous_intervalIntegrable hab.le hfab) (continuous_intervalIntegrable hbc.le hfbc)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_mean_value
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_mean_value {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Set.Icc a b, riemannIntegral f a b = f ξ * (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xm, hxm, hm⟩ :=
    SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.exists_isLeast_on_Icc hab.le hf
  obtain ⟨xM, hxM, hM⟩ :=
    SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Continuity.exists_isGreatest_on_Icc hab.le hf
  have hlower : f xm * (b - a) ≤ riemannIntegral f a b := by
    rw [← riemannIntegral_const (a := a) (b := b) (c := f xm) hab]
    exact riemannIntegral_mono hab continuousOn_const hf hm
  have hupper : riemannIntegral f a b ≤ f xM * (b - a) := by
    rw [← riemannIntegral_const (a := a) (b := b) (c := f xM) hab]
    exact riemannIntegral_mono hab hf continuousOn_const hM
  let A := riemannIntegral f a b / (b - a)
  have hA_lower : f xm ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hab)).mpr hlower
  have hA_upper : A ≤ f xM := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hab)).mpr hupper
  have hxmM : f xm ≤ f xM := hm xM hxM
  have hsub : Set.uIcc xm xM ⊆ Set.Icc a b := Set.uIcc_subset_Icc hxm hxM
  have hA_mem : A ∈ Set.uIcc (f xm) (f xM) := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hxmM]
    exact ⟨hA_lower, hA_upper⟩
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξA⟩ := intermediate_value_uIcc (hf.mono hsub) hA_mem
  refine ⟨ξ, hsub hξ, ?_⟩
  rw [hξA]
  dsimp [A]
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab))]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_periodic_one_period

    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right hT.le),

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.integrableOn_Ioc_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound
proof:
:= by
  have hc := riemannIntegrableWithBound_ae_continuousOn hab h
  obtain ⟨N, hNmeas, hbad, hNnull⟩ := ae_continuity_exceptional_measurable_hull hc
  let G := Set.Icc a b \ N
  have hGmeas : MeasurableSet G := measurableSet_Icc.diff hNmeas
  have hfG : ContinuousOn f G := by
    intro x hx
    have hxcont : ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Icc a b) x := by
      by_contra hxnot
      exact hx.2 (hbad ⟨hx.1, hxnot⟩)
    exact hxcont.mono Set.sdiff_subset
  have hmeasG : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict G) :=
    hfG.aestronglyMeasurable hGmeas
  have haeN : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∉ N := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    simpa using hNnull
  have hae : Set.Icc a b =ᵐ[volume] G := by
    filter_upwards [haeN] with x hx
    apply propext
    change x ∈ Set.Icc a b ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧ x ∉ N
    exact ⟨fun hmem => ⟨hmem, hx⟩, fun hmem => hmem.1⟩
  have hmeasIcc : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)) := by
    rw [Measure.restrict_congr_set hae]
    exact hmeasG
  have hmeasIoc : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)) :=
    hmeasIcc.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h.1
  have hfinite : (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)) Set.univ ≠ ∞ := by
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, Set.univ_inter, Real.volume_Ioc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)).restrict Set.univ, ‖f x‖ ≤ C := by
    rw [Measure.restrict_univ]
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with x hx
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC x (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hx)
  simpa [IntegrableOn] using
    Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b))
      (s := Set.univ) hfinite hmeasIoc hbound

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.lowerSum_le_integral_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound
proof:
:= by
  let sP : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
    (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
      (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t
  have hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1) := by
    intro i hi
    exact (P.strict i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).le
  have hsub := partition_subinterval_sub hab.le P hstep
  have hsP : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP t = sP t := by
    intro t
    exact step_indicator_identity
      (c := fun i => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hsub t
  have hsP_le : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b, sP t ≤ f t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases partition_cover P.x0 P.xN P.strict ht with ⟨i, hi, hti, hti1⟩
    have hdisj : ∀ j, j < P.n → j ≠ i →
        t ∉ Set.Ioc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)) := by
      intro j hj hji
      exact partition_disjoint P.strict hi hj hji.symm ⟨hti, hti1⟩
    have heval : sP t = sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
      exact step_eval_at hi ⟨hti, hti1⟩ hdisj
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h.1
    have hbdd : BddBelow (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
      refine ⟨-C, ?_⟩
      rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hxi := partition_point_mem hab.le P.x0 P.xN P.strict (le_of_lt hi)
      have hxi1 := partition_point_mem hab.le P.x0 P.xN P.strict (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
      have hxab : x ∈ Set.Icc a b :=
        Set.Icc_subset_Icc hxi.1 hxi1.2 ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩
      exact (abs_le.mp (hC x hxab)).1
    rw [heval]
    exact csInf_le hbdd ⟨t, ⟨le_of_lt hti, hti1⟩, rfl⟩
  have hmono : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP t ≤
      (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b
    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_mem ht] using hsP_le t ht
    · simp [Set.indicator, ht]
  have hisP : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP) volume := by
    have hsP_int : Integrable sP volume := by
      apply integrable_finsetSum
      intro i hi
      rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
      have hfin : volume (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) ≠ ∞ := by
        rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      exact integrableOn_const (μ := volume) (s := Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))
        (C := sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) (hs := hfin)
    have hident : (Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP = sP := funext hsP
    rwa [hident]
  have hif : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f) volume := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
    exact integrableOn_Ioc_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound hab.le h
  have hmain := lower_sum_le_interval (f := f) (sP := sP) (s := Set.Ioc a b)
    (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hsP := hsP) (hf_mono := hmono)
    (hisP := hisP) (hif := hif)
  calc
    lowerSum f P = ∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume := (step_integral_eq_lowerSum P hstep).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume := hmain

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.integral_le_upperSum_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound
proof:
:= by
  let uP : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
    (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
      (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t
  have hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1) := by
    intro i hi
    exact (P.strict i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).le
  have hsub := partition_subinterval_sub hab.le P hstep
  have huP : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t = uP t := by
    intro t
    exact step_indicator_identity
      (c := fun i => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hsub t
  have hf_le : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b, f t ≤ uP t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases partition_cover P.x0 P.xN P.strict ht with ⟨i, hi, hti, hti1⟩
    have hdisj : ∀ j, j < P.n → j ≠ i →
        t ∉ Set.Ioc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)) := by
      intro j hj hji
      exact partition_disjoint P.strict hi hj hji.symm ⟨hti, hti1⟩
    have heval : uP t = sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
      exact step_eval_at hi ⟨hti, hti1⟩ hdisj
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h.1
    have hbdd : BddAbove (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
      refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
      rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hxi := partition_point_mem hab.le P.x0 P.xN P.strict (le_of_lt hi)
      have hxi1 := partition_point_mem hab.le P.x0 P.xN P.strict (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
      have hxab : x ∈ Set.Icc a b :=
        Set.Icc_subset_Icc hxi.1 hxi1.2 ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩
      exact (abs_le.mp (hC x hxab)).2
    rw [heval]
    exact le_csSup hbdd ⟨t, ⟨le_of_lt hti, hti1⟩, rfl⟩
  have hmono : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ≤
      (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b
    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_mem ht] using hf_le t ht
    · simp [Set.indicator, ht]
  have hif : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f) volume := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
    exact integrableOn_Ioc_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound hab.le h
  have hiuP : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP) volume := by
    have huP_int : Integrable uP volume := by
      apply integrable_finsetSum
      intro i hi
      rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
      have hfin : volume (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) ≠ ∞ := by
        rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      exact integrableOn_const (μ := volume) (s := Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))
        (C := sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) (hs := hfin)
    have hident : (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP = uP := funext huP
    rwa [hident]
  calc
    (∫ x in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) =
        ∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ∂volume :=
      (integral_indicator (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t ∂volume :=
      integral_mono hif hiuP hmono
    _ = ∫ t : ℝ, uP t ∂volume := by rw [funext huP]
    _ = upperSum f P := step_sup_integral_eq_upperSum P hstep

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_eq_interval_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold riemannIntegral
    apply csSup_le
    · exact ⟨lowerSum f (uniformPartition a b 1 hab (by norm_num)),
        ⟨uniformPartition a b 1 hab (by norm_num), rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro y ⟨P, rfl⟩
      exact lowerSum_le_integral_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound hab h P
  · unfold riemannIntegral
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨P, hgap⟩ := h.2 ε hε
    have hU := integral_le_upperSum_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound hab h P
    have hL : lowerSum f P ≤
        sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ Q : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f Q} := by
      apply le_csSup
      · refine ⟨∫ x in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume, ?_⟩
        rintro y ⟨Q, rfl⟩
        exact lowerSum_le_integral_of_riemannIntegrableWithBound hab h Q
      · exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt {a b : ℝ} {F f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt F (f x) x) :
    riemannIntegral f a b = F b - F a
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hab hf,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
  apply RealAnalysis.Calculus.ftc_2
  · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hderiv
  · have hf' : ContinuousOn f [[a, b]] := by
      simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hf
    exact hf'.intervalIntegrable

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.hasDerivAt_riemannIntegral_right
proof:
:= by
  have hFTC : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ∫ t in a..u, f t) (f x) x :=
    (RealAnalysis.Calculus.ftc_1_right (hf.intervalIntegrable a x)
      (hf.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 x)) hf.continuousAt).hasDerivAt
  apply hFTC.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hax] with u hau
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval hau hf.continuousOn,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hau.le]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul {a b : ℝ}
    {u v u' v' : ℝ → ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc a b)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Set.Icc a b))
    (hu' : ContinuousOn u' (Set.Icc a b)) (hv' : ContinuousOn v' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hdu : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt u (u' x) x)
    (hdv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt v (v' x) x) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => u x * v' x) a b =
      u b * v b - u a * v a - riemannIntegral (fun x => u' x * v x) a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval (f := fun x => u x * v' x) hab (hu.mul hv'),
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval (f := fun x => u' x * v x) hab (hu'.mul hv),
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
  · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hdu
  · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hdv
  · have hu'' : ContinuousOn u' [[a, b]] := by
      simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hu'
    exact hu''.intervalIntegrable
  · have hv'' : ContinuousOn v' [[a, b]] := by
      simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hv'
    exact hv''.intervalIntegrable

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_comp_mul_deriv
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_comp_mul_deriv {a b : ℝ} {φ φ' g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hφab : φ a < φ b)
    (hφ : ContinuousOn φ (Set.Icc a b))
    (hφ' : ContinuousOn φ' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hdφ : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x)
    (hg : Continuous g) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => (g ∘ φ) x * φ' x) a b =
      riemannIntegral g (φ a) (φ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ContinuousOn (g ∘ φ) (Set.Icc a b) := hg.comp_continuousOn hφ
  rw [riemannIntegral_eq_interval
      (f := fun x => (g ∘ φ) x * φ' x) hab (hcomp.mul hφ'),
    riemannIntegral_eq_interval hφab hg.continuousOn,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hφab.le]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv
  · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hdφ
  · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le] using hφ'
  · exact hg

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_id_mul_exp
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_id_mul_exp {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => x * Real.exp x) a b =
      b * Real.exp b - a * Real.exp a - (Real.exp b - Real.exp a)
proof:
:= by
  have hparts := riemannIntegral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
    (u := fun x : ℝ => x) (v := Real.exp)
    (u' := fun _ : ℝ => 1) (v' := Real.exp) hab
    continuousOn_id Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    continuousOn_const Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_id x) (fun x _ => Real.hasDerivAt_exp x)
  have hexp : riemannIntegral Real.exp a b = Real.exp b - Real.exp a :=
    riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hab Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
      (fun x _ => Real.hasDerivAt_exp x)
  simp only [one_mul] at hparts
  rw [hexp] at hparts
  simpa using hparts

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_const_mul_exp_affine
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_const_mul_exp_affine {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => Real.exp (c * x + d) * c) a b =
      Real.exp (c * b + d) - Real.exp (c * a + d)
proof:
:= by
  have hφab : c * a + d < c * b + d := by
    simpa [add_comm] using add_lt_add_right (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab hc) d
  have hsubst := riemannIntegral_comp_mul_deriv
    (φ := fun x : ℝ => c * x + d) (φ' := fun _ : ℝ => c)
    (g := Real.exp) hab hφab
    ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).add continuousOn_const)
    continuousOn_const
    (fun x _ => by simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul c).add_const d)
    Real.continuous_exp
  have hexp : riemannIntegral Real.exp (c * a + d) (c * b + d) =
      Real.exp (c * b + d) - Real.exp (c * a + d) :=
    riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hφab Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
      (fun x _ => Real.hasDerivAt_exp x)
  rw [hexp] at hsubst
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using hsubst

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_pow
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_pow {a b : ℝ} (n : ℕ) (hab : a < b) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) a b =
      b ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1) - a ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hab (continuousOn_pow n)
  intro x hx
  have hn : (n + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel, hn] using
    (hasDerivAt_pow (n + 1) x).div_const (n + 1 : ℝ)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_exp
statement:

    riemannIntegral Real.exp a b = Real.exp b - Real.exp a
proof:

  exact riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hab Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_cos

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_sin
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_sin {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    riemannIntegral Real.sin a b = Real.cos a - Real.cos b
proof:
:= by
  have h := riemannIntegral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (F := fun x => -Real.cos x) hab Real.continuous_sin.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_cos x).neg.congr_deriv (neg_neg _))
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_const_mul_cos_affine
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_const_mul_cos_affine {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    riemannIntegral (fun x => Real.cos (c * x + d) * c) a b =
      Real.sin (c * b + d) - Real.sin (c * a + d)
proof:
:= by
  have hφab : c * a + d < c * b + d := by
    simpa [add_comm] using add_lt_add_right (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab hc) d
  have hsubst := riemannIntegral_comp_mul_deriv
    (φ := fun x : ℝ => c * x + d) (φ' := fun _ : ℝ => c)
    (g := Real.cos) hab hφab
    ((continuousOn_const.mul continuousOn_id).add continuousOn_const)
    continuousOn_const
    (fun x _ => by simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul c).add_const d)
    Real.continuous_cos
  rw [riemannIntegral_cos hφab] at hsubst
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using hsubst

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MonotoneFunction.leftLim_stieltjesFunction
statement:
theorem leftLim_stieltjesFunction {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Monotone f) (a : ℝ) :
    Function.leftLim (hf.stieltjesFunction : ℝ → ℝ) a = Function.leftLim f a
proof:
:= by
  change Function.leftLim (Function.rightLim f) a = Function.leftLim f a
  rw [Monotone.leftLim_eq_sSup hf.rightLim, hf.leftLim_eq_sSup]
  refine le_antisymm (csSup_le ?_ ?_) (csSup_le ?_ ?_)
  · exact ⟨Function.rightLim f (a - 1), a - 1, by simp, rfl⟩
  · rintro b ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hyz, hza⟩ := exists_between (show y < a from hy)
    exact (hf.rightLim_le hyz).trans
      (le_csSup ⟨f a, by rintro b ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩; exact hf (le_of_lt hw)⟩ ⟨z, hza, rfl⟩)
  · exact ⟨f (a - 1), a - 1, by simp, rfl⟩
  · rintro b ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (hf.le_rightLim le_rfl).trans
      (le_csSup ⟨Function.rightLim f a, by rintro b ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩; exact hf.rightLim (le_of_lt hw)⟩
        ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.MonotoneFunction.stieltjesFunction_measure_singleton
statement:

    hf.stieltjesFunction.measure {a} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Function.rightLim f a - Function.leftLim f a)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.SignedMeasure.IsPositiveSet.iUnion
statement:
theorem IsPositiveSet.iUnion {s : SignedMeasure α} {f : ℕ → Set α}
    (hf : ∀ n, IsPositiveSet s (f n)) : IsPositiveSet s (⋃ n, f n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => (hf n).1, ?_⟩
  intro k hk hkU
  have hbase : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (k ∩ f n) := fun n => hk.inter (hf n).1
  have hkUnion : (⋃ n, (k ∩ f n)) = k := by
    rw [← Set.inter_iUnion, Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hkU]
  set g : ℕ → Set α := disjointed (fun n => k ∩ f n) with hg_def
  have hgmeas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (g n) := fun n => MeasurableSet.disjointed hbase n
  have hgdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on g) := disjoint_disjointed _
  have hgunion : (⋃ n, g n) = k := by
    rw [hg_def, iUnion_disjointed]; exact hkUnion
  have hsum : HasSum (fun n => s (g n)) (s k) := by
    have := s.hasSum_of_disjoint_iUnion hgmeas hgdisj
    rwa [hgunion] at this
  rw [← hsum.tsum_eq]
  exact tsum_nonneg (fun n => (hf n).2 (hgmeas n)
    ((disjointed_subset (fun n => k ∩ f n) n).trans Set.inter_subset_right))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.SignedMeasure.IsNegativeSet.iUnion
statement:
theorem IsNegativeSet.iUnion {s : SignedMeasure α} {f : ℕ → Set α}
    (hf : ∀ n, IsNegativeSet s (f n)) : IsNegativeSet s (⋃ n, f n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => (hf n).1, ?_⟩
  intro k hk hkU
  have hbase : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (k ∩ f n) := fun n => hk.inter (hf n).1
  have hkUnion : (⋃ n, (k ∩ f n)) = k := by
    rw [← Set.inter_iUnion, Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hkU]
  set g : ℕ → Set α := disjointed (fun n => k ∩ f n) with hg_def
  have hgmeas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (g n) := fun n => MeasurableSet.disjointed hbase n
  have hgdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on g) := disjoint_disjointed _
  have hgunion : (⋃ n, g n) = k := by
    rw [hg_def, iUnion_disjointed]; exact hkUnion
  have hsum : HasSum (fun n => s (g n)) (s k) := by
    have := s.hasSum_of_disjoint_iUnion hgmeas hgdisj
    rwa [hgunion] at this
  rw [← hsum.tsum_eq]
  exact tsum_nonpos (fun n => (hf n).2 (hgmeas n)
    ((disjointed_subset (fun n => k ∩ f n) n).trans Set.inter_subset_right))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.boundedOn_image_isBounded
proof:
:= by
  rcases hb with ⟨C, hC⟩
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have ha := hC a ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩
    exact le_trans (abs_nonneg (f a)) ha
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff]
  refine ⟨2 * C, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  rw [abs_le]
  have hx' := (abs_le.mp (hC x hx)).2
  have hx'' := (abs_le.mp (hC x hx)).1
  have hy' := (abs_le.mp (hC y hy)).2
  have hy'' := (abs_le.mp (hC y hy)).1
  constructor <;> linarith [hC0]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.oscillationWithin_lt_top_of_boundedOn
proof:
:= by
  have hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded (f '' Set.Icc a b) :=
    boundedOn_image_isBounded hab hb
  have hmem : f '' Set.Icc a b ∈
      (nhdsWithin x (Set.Icc a b)).map f := by
    rw [Filter.mem_map]
    apply Filter.mem_of_superset self_mem_nhdsWithin
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have hle : oscillationWithin f (Set.Icc a b) x ≤
      Metric.ediam (f '' Set.Icc a b) := by
    rw [oscillationWithin]
    exact iInf_le_of_le (f '' Set.Icc a b) (iInf_le_of_le hmem le_rfl)
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hbounded.ediam_ne_top)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.positive_threshold_exists
statement:
theorem positive_threshold_exists {r : ENNReal} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrt : r < ⊤) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (n + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hr0' : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr0
  have hrt' : r ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt hrt
  have htr : 0 < r.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hr0' hrt'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / r.toReal)
  have hn0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < (1 / r.toReal) := by positivity
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (le_of_lt hn)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hrt']
  calc
    1 / (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hn0
      linarith
    _ ≤ r.toReal := by
      have hmul := (div_lt_iff₀ htr).mp hn
      have hstrict : 1 / (n : ℝ) < r.toReal := by
        apply (div_lt_iff₀ hn0).2
        simpa [mul_comm] using hmul
      exact hstrict.le

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.finite_partition_points_null

theorem finite_partition_points_null {a b : ℝ} (P : DarbouxPartition a b) :

proof:
:= by

    rcases hx with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i, Set.mem_Iic.mpr hi, rfl⟩
  exact hfinite.measure_zero volume
