name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.uniformPartition_step
statement:
theorem uniformPartition_step {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hpos : 0 < n)
    (i : ℕ) (_hi : i < n) :
    (uniformPartition a b n hab hpos).x (i + 1) - (uniformPartition a b n hab hpos).x i =
      (b - a) / (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [uniformPartition]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_sum
statement:
lemma step_sum {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (_hab : a < b) (hpos : 0 < n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) = b - a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_const]
  
  have hcard : (Finset.range n).card = n := Finset.card_range n
  rw [hcard]
  
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hpos)
  
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [hn]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.uniform_x_mem
statement:
lemma uniform_x_mem {a b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hpos : 0 < n)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    a + (i : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    have hd : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (n : ℝ) := by
      exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hab)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    nlinarith
  · 
    have hd : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (n : ℝ) := by
      exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hab)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    have hile : (i : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hi
    have : a + (i : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) ≤ a + (n : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith
    have : a + (n : ℝ) * ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) = b := by
      have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hpos)
      field_simp [hn]
      ring
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.interval_width
statement:
lemma interval_width {p q x y : ℝ} (_hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc p q) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc p q) :
    |x - y| ≤ q - p
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have : p - q ≤ x - y := by linarith [hx.1, hy.2]
    simpa using this
  · have : x - y ≤ q - p := by linarith [hx.2, hy.1]
    exact this

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.b3_osc
statement:
lemma b3_osc {f : ℝ → ℝ} {I : Set ℝ} (hI : I.Nonempty)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hosc : ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ I, |f x - f y| ≤ ε) :
    sSup (f '' I) ≤ sInf (f '' I) + 2 * ε
proof:
:= by
  have hinf_approx : ∀ δ > 0, ∃ y ∈ I, f y < sInf (f '' I) + δ := by
    intro δ hδ
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : sInf (f '' I) + δ ≤ sInf (f '' I) := by
      apply le_csInf
      · exact Set.image_nonempty.mpr hI
      · intro w hw
        rcases hw with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact h y hy
    nlinarith
  apply csSup_le
  · exact Set.image_nonempty.mpr hI
  · intro m hm
    rcases hm with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rcases hinf_approx (ε / 2) (by positivity) with ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩
    have hzy : |f z - f y| ≤ ε := hosc z hz y hy
    have hfzy : f z ≤ f y + ε := by linarith [abs_le.mp hzy]
    nlinarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.C2_subinterval
statement:
lemma C2_subinterval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {ε δ : ℝ}
    (huni : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hq : q ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hwidth : |p - q| < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    sSup (f '' Set.Icc p q) - sInf (f '' Set.Icc p q) ≤ 2 * ε
proof:
:= by
  have hosc : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc p q, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc p q, |f x - f y| ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hxy : |x - y| ≤ q - p := interval_width hpq hx hy
    
    have hqp : q - p ≤ |p - q| := by
      simpa [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hpq)]
    have hxy_lt : |x - y| < δ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans hxy hqp) hwidth
    have hx_ab : x ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Icc_subset_Icc hp.1 hq.2 hx
    have hy_ab : y ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Icc_subset_Icc hp.1 hq.2 hy
    exact le_of_lt (huni x hx_ab y hy_ab hxy_lt)
  have hI : (Set.Icc p q).Nonempty := ⟨p, ⟨le_rfl, hpq⟩⟩
  have hB3 := b3_osc hI (by linarith) hosc
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.continuous_on_riemannIntegrable_lt
statement:
theorem continuous_on_riemannIntegrable_lt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) : RiemannIntegrable f a b
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  
  let ε' := ε / (4 * (b - a))
  have hε' : 0 < ε' := by
    unfold ε'
    positivity
  
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc a b) := isCompact_Icc
  have hne : (Set.Icc a b).Nonempty := ⟨a, ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt hab⟩⟩
  have huni := continuousOn_compact_uniformContinuousOn (s := Set.Icc a b) hK hne hf
  rcases Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huni ε' hε' with ⟨δ, hδ, hδδ⟩
  
  rcases exists_nat_gt ((b - a) / δ) with ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by
    have hpos : 0 < (b - a) / δ := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hab) hδ
    have hcast : 0 < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (le_of_lt hn)
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  have hstep_lt : (b - a) / (n : ℝ) < δ := by
    have hcast : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos
    have h1 : b - a < (n : ℝ) * δ := by
      rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hδ] at hn
    exact (div_lt_iff₀' hcast).mpr h1
  let P := uniformPartition a b n hab hn_pos
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  
  have hdiff : upperSum f P - lowerSum f P =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
        (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) - sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)))) := by
    unfold upperSum lowerSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
        (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) - sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1)))) ≤
      (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * ε') := by
    intro i hi
    have hi_lt : i < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hxi : P.x i ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      have := uniform_x_mem hab hn_pos i (le_of_lt hi_lt)
      simpa [P, uniformPartition] using this
    have hxi1 : P.x (i + 1) ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      have := uniform_x_mem hab hn_pos (i + 1) (by omega)
      simpa [P, uniformPartition] using this
    have hwidth_abs : |P.x (i + 1) - P.x i| < δ := by
      have hstep : P.x (i + 1) - P.x i = (b - a) / (n : ℝ) := uniformPartition_step hab hn_pos i hi_lt
      rw [hstep]
      have hnon : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (n : ℝ) := by
        exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hab)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hnon]
      exact hstep_lt
    have hwidth : |P.x i - P.x (i + 1)| < δ := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm]
      exact hwidth_abs
    have hosc0 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε' := hδδ
    have hC2 := C2_subinterval (a := a) (b := b) (ε := ε') (δ := δ)
      (huni := hosc0) (hpq := (P.strict i hi_lt).le) (hp := hxi) (hq := hxi1)
      (hwidth := hwidth) (hε := hε')
    have hosc_bound : sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) -
        sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) ≤ 2 * ε' := hC2
    have hstep_nonneg : 0 ≤ P.x (i + 1) - P.x i := sub_nonneg.mpr (P.strict i hi_lt).le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hosc_bound hstep_nonneg
  
  have hsum_step : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) : ℝ) = b - a := by
    have hcong : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        ((P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) : ℝ)) =
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((b - a) / (n : ℝ)) : ℝ) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro i hi
      exact uniformPartition_step hab hn_pos i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    exact hcong.trans (step_sum hab hn_pos)
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * ε')) = 2 * ε' * (b - a) := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * ε')) =
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i)) * (2 * ε') := by
            exact (Finset.sum_mul _ _ (2 * ε')).symm
      _ = (b - a) * (2 * ε') := by rw [hsum_step]
      _ = 2 * ε' * (b - a) := by ring
  have hsum_val : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * ε')) = ε / 2 := by
    rw [hsum]
    unfold ε'
    have hba_ne : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hab).symm
    field_simp [hba_ne]
    ring
  
  rw [hdiff]
  have hle : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
      (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) - sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))))) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * ε')) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
  have : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) *
      (sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))) - sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i + 1))))) < ε := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (P.x (i + 1) - P.x i) * (2 * ε')) := hle
      _ = ε / 2 := hsum_val
      _ < ε := by linarith
  exact this

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.continuous_intervalIntegrable
statement:
theorem continuous_intervalIntegrable {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : ContinuousOn f (Set.uIcc a b) := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
    exact hf
  exact ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) hf'

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.integral_indicator_const_Ioc
statement:
theorem integral_indicator_const_Ioc {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c) x ∂volume) = c * (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_indicator (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
  
  rw [integral_const]
  
  have hrestr : (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)).real Set.univ = b - a := by
    rw [measureReal_def, Measure.restrict_apply (s := Set.Ioc a b) (t := Set.univ) (ht := MeasurableSet.univ)]
    
    rw [Set.univ_inter]
    rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
    
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
  
  rw [hrestr]
  
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.integral_sum_indicator_Ioc
statement:
theorem integral_sum_indicator_Ioc {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, x i ≤ x (i+1)) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) ∂volume) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * (x (i+1) - x i)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, Integrable
      (fun t : ℝ => (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) volume := by
    intro i hi
    
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
    have hfin : volume (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))) ≠ ∞ := by
      rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    exact integrableOn_const (μ := volume) (s := Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))) (C := c i) (hs := hfin)
  
  have hsum_integral : (∫ t : ℝ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) ∂volume) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ t : ℝ,
        (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t ∂volume) := by
    exact integral_finsetSum (s := Finset.range n) (f := fun i => fun t : ℝ =>
      (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) (μ := volume) hf
  
  calc
    (∫ t : ℝ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) ∂volume)
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ t : ℝ,
            (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t ∂volume) := hsum_integral
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * (x (i+1) - x i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      
      exact integral_indicator_const_Ioc (c := c i) (hstep i hi)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_le_f_pointwise
statement:
lemma step_le_f_pointwise {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc p q)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc p q) :
    sInf (f '' Set.Icc p q) ≤ f t
proof:
:= by
  have htm : f t ∈ f '' Set.Icc p q := by
    refine ⟨t, ⟨le_of_lt ht.1, ht.2⟩, rfl⟩
  have hK : IsCompact (f '' Set.Icc p q) := IsCompact.image_of_continuousOn isCompact_Icc hf
  exact csInf_le (IsCompact.bddBelow hK) htm

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.restricted_integral_const_Ioc
statement:
theorem restricted_integral_const_Ioc {p q c : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc p q, c ∂volume) = c * (q - p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_const]
  
  have hres : (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc p q)).real Set.univ = volume.real (Set.Ioc p q) := by
    rw [measureReal_def, Measure.restrict_apply (s := Set.Ioc p q) (t := Set.univ) (ht := MeasurableSet.univ)]
    rw [Set.univ_inter]
    rw [measureReal_def]
  have hvol : volume.real (Set.Ioc p q) = q - p := by
    rw [measureReal_def, Real.volume_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hpq)]
  rw [hres, hvol]
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_indicator_identity
statement:
theorem step_indicator_identity {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator
        (fun u => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) u) t
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b
  · simp [Set.indicator, ht]
  · have hsP : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        (Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c i) t) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      have hsubi := hsub i hi
      have htnot : t ∉ Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1)) := fun hti => ht (hsubi hti)
      exact Set.indicator_of_notMem htnot (fun _ : ℝ => c i)
    simpa [Set.indicator, ht] using hsP.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.lower_sum_le_interval
statement:
theorem lower_sum_le_interval {f sP : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hsP : ∀ t, s.indicator sP t = sP t)
    (hf_mono : ∀ t, s.indicator sP t ≤ s.indicator f t)
    (hisP : Integrable (s.indicator sP) volume)
    (hif : Integrable (s.indicator f) volume) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume) ≤ (∫ t : ℝ in s, f t ∂volume)
proof:
:= by
  have h1ae : sP =ᵐ[volume] (s.indicator sP) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_of_all volume hsP] with t ht
    exact ht.symm
  have h1 : (∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume) = (∫ t : ℝ, s.indicator sP t ∂volume) :=
    integral_congr_ae h1ae
  have h2 : (∫ t : ℝ, s.indicator sP t ∂volume) ≤ (∫ t : ℝ, s.indicator f t ∂volume) :=
    integral_mono hisP hif hf_mono
  have h3 : (∫ t : ℝ, s.indicator f t ∂volume) = (∫ t : ℝ in s, f t ∂volume) :=
    integral_indicator hs
  calc
    (∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume) = (∫ t : ℝ, s.indicator sP t ∂volume) := h1
    _ ≤ (∫ t : ℝ, s.indicator f t ∂volume) := h2
    _ = (∫ t : ℝ in s, f t ∂volume) := h3

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.continuous_indicator_integrable
statement:
theorem continuous_indicator_integrable {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f) volume
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
  
  have hcc : IntegrableOn f (Set.Icc a b) volume := ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc hf
  
  exact hcc.mono_set (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_cover
statement:
lemma partition_cover {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (x0 : x 0 = a) (xN : x n = b) (hx : ∀ i, i < n → x i < x (i+1))
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∃ i, i < n ∧ x i < t ∧ t ≤ x (i+1)
proof:
:= by
  
  let p : ℕ → Prop := fun i => t ≤ x i
  have hex : ∃ i, p i := by
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    change t ≤ x n
    rw [xN]
    exact ht.2
  let j := Nat.find hex
  have hpj : p j := Nat.find_spec hex
  
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hj
    have h0 : p 0 := by simpa [hj, j] using hpj
    change t ≤ x 0 at h0
    have : t ≤ a := by simpa [x0] using h0
    linarith [this, ht.1]
  
  have hjn : j ≤ n := Nat.find_min' hex (by
    change t ≤ x n
    rw [xN]
    exact ht.2)
  
  let i := j - 1
  have hi_lt : i < n := by
    dsimp [i]
    omega
  
  have hxi : x i < t := by
    dsimp [i]
    have hnj : i < j := by dsimp [i]; omega
    have hnotp : ¬p i := Nat.find_min hex hnj
    
    exact lt_of_not_ge hnotp
  
  have hxj : t ≤ x (i+1) := by
    have : i + 1 = j := by dsimp [i]; omega
    simpa [this] using hpj
  refine ⟨i, hi_lt, hxi, hxj⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_eval_at
statement:
theorem step_eval_at {n i : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℕ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hi : i < n)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc (x i) (x (i+1)))
    (hdisj : ∀ j, j < n → j ≠ i → t ∉ Set.Ioc (x j) (x (j+1))) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
      (Set.Ioc (x j) (x (j+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => c j) t) = c i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single]
  · 
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
  · 
    intro j hj hji
    have hnot : t ∉ Set.Ioc (x j) (x (j+1)) := hdisj j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj) hji
    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hnot (fun _ : ℝ => c j)
  · 
    intro hi_not
    exact False.elim (hi_not (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.fin_strict_mono_le
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hchain : ∀ k, i + 1 ≤ k → k ≤ j → x (i+1) ≤ x k := by
    
    have hbase : i + 1 ≤ j → x (i+1) ≤ x (i+1) := by
      intro _
      rfl
    have hstep : ∀ k, i + 1 ≤ k → (k ≤ j → x (i+1) ≤ x k) → (k+1 ≤ j → x (i+1) ≤ x (k+1)) := by
      intro k hik hfk hkj
      
      have hkn : k < n := by omega
      have hle_k : x (i+1) ≤ x k := hfk (le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hkj)
      have hk1 : x k ≤ x (k+1) := le_of_lt (hx k hkn)
      exact le_trans hle_k hk1
    intro k hik hkj
    exact Nat.le_induction (m := i + 1) hbase (fun n hmn hfn => hstep n hmn hfn) k hik hkj
  exact hchain j hij le_rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · 
    intro htj
    have hle : x (i+1) ≤ x j := fin_strict_mono_le hx (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt) hj
    have htx : t ≤ x j := le_trans hti.2 hle
    have hxj : x j < t := htj.1
    linarith
  · 
    intro hti2
    have hle : x (j+1) ≤ x i := fin_strict_mono_le hx (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgt) hi
    have htj : t ≤ x i := le_trans hti2.2 hle
    have hxi : x i < t := hti.1
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.mono_x_le
proof:
:= by
  
  have hchain : ∀ k, m ≤ k → k ≤ j → x m ≤ x k := by
    have hbase : m ≤ j → x m ≤ x m := by
      intro _
      rfl
    have hstep : ∀ k, m ≤ k → (k ≤ j → x m ≤ x k) → (k+1 ≤ j → x m ≤ x (k+1)) := by
      intro k hk hfk hkj
      have hkn : k < n := by omega
      have hle_k : x m ≤ x k := hfk (le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hkj)
      have hk1 : x k ≤ x (k+1) := le_of_lt (hx k hkn)
      exact le_trans hle_k hk1
    intro k hk hkj
    exact Nat.le_induction (m := m) hbase (fun n hmn hfn => hstep n hmn hfn) k hk hkj
  exact hchain j hmj le_rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.mono_x_le_le
proof:
:= by
  
  have hchain : ∀ k, m ≤ k → k ≤ j → x m ≤ x k := by
    have hbase : m ≤ j → x m ≤ x m := by intro _; rfl
    have hstep : ∀ k, m ≤ k → (k ≤ j → x m ≤ x k) → (k+1 ≤ j → x m ≤ x (k+1)) := by
      intro k hk hfk hkj
      have hkn : k < n := by omega  
      have hle_k : x m ≤ x k := hfk (le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hkj)
      have hk1 : x k ≤ x (k+1) := le_of_lt (hx k hkn)
      exact le_trans hle_k hk1
    intro k hk hkj
    exact Nat.le_induction (m := m) hbase (fun n hmn hfn => hstep n hmn hfn) k hk hkj
  exact hchain j hmj le_rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_point_mem
statement:
lemma partition_point_mem {n i : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (x0 : x 0 = a) (xN : x n = b) (hx : ∀ k, k < n → x k < x (k+1))
    (hi : i ≤ n) :
    x i ∈ Set.Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hle : x 0 ≤ x i := mono_x_le_le hx (Nat.zero_le i) hi
    simpa [x0] using hle
  · have hle : x i ≤ x n := mono_x_le_le hx hi (le_rfl)
    simpa [xN] using hle

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_le_f_upper
statement:
lemma step_le_f_upper {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) ≤ f t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  
  rcases partition_cover P.x0 P.xN P.strict ht with ⟨i, hi_lt, hxi, hxi1⟩
  
  have hdisj_all : ∀ j, j < P.n → j ≠ i → t ∉ Set.Ioc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)) := by
    intro j hj ji
    exact partition_disjoint P.strict hi_lt hj ji.symm ⟨hxi, hxi1⟩
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range P.n,
      (Set.Ioc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1))).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)))) t) =
      sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
    exact step_eval_at hi_lt ⟨hxi, hxi1⟩ hdisj_all
  
  have hle : sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) ≤ f t := by
    
    have hxi_ab : P.x i ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      exact partition_point_mem hab P.x0 P.xN P.strict (le_of_lt hi_lt)
    have hxi1_ab : P.x (i+1) ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      exact partition_point_mem hab P.x0 P.xN P.strict (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi_lt)
    have hf_sub : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
      exact hf.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc hxi_ab.1 hxi1_ab.2)
    exact step_le_f_pointwise (P.strict i hi_lt).le hf_sub ⟨hxi, hxi1⟩
  
  rw [hsum]
  exact hle

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_integral_eq_lowerSum
statement:
lemma step_integral_eq_lowerSum {f : ℝ → ℝ} (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1)) :
    (∫ t : ℝ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) ∂volume) =
      lowerSum f P
proof:
:= by
  
  have hD3b := integral_sum_indicator_Ioc (x := P.x)
    (c := fun i => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hstep
  rw [hD3b]
  
  unfold lowerSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.darboux_lower_le_interval
statement:
theorem darboux_lower_le_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1))
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    lowerSum f P ≤ (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume)
proof:
:= by
  let sP : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
    (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t
  
  have hsP : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP t = sP t := by
    intro t
    exact step_indicator_identity (c := fun i => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hsub t
  
  have hf_mono : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP t ≤ (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b
    · 
      have hsP_le : sP t ≤ f t := step_le_f_upper hab hf P hsub t ht
      
      simpa [Set.indicator, ht] using hsP_le
    · 
      simp [Set.indicator, ht]
  
  have hisP : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP) volume := by
    
    have hsP_int : Integrable sP volume := by
      have hin : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Integrable
          ((Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ => sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))))) volume := by
        intro i hi
        rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
        have hfin : volume (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) ≠ ∞ := by
          rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
        exact integrableOn_const (μ := volume) (s := Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))
          (C := sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) (hs := hfin)
      exact integrable_finsetSum (s := Finset.range P.n) hin
    have hident : (Set.Ioc a b).indicator sP = sP := by
      funext t
      exact hsP t
    rw [hident]
    exact hsP_int
  have hif : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f) volume := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
    have hcc : IntegrableOn f (Set.Icc a b) volume := ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc hf
    exact hcc.mono_set (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
  
  have h_main := lower_sum_le_interval (f := f) (sP := sP) (s := Set.Ioc a b)
    (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hsP := hsP) (hf_mono := hf_mono) (hisP := hisP) (hif := hif)
  
  have h_int : (∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume) = lowerSum f P :=
    step_integral_eq_lowerSum P hstep
  
  calc
    lowerSum f P = (∫ t : ℝ, sP t ∂volume) := h_int.symm
    _ ≤ (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) := h_main

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.partition_subinterval_sub
statement:
lemma partition_subinterval_sub {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (_hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1)) :
    ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  intro t ht
  
  constructor
  · 
    have hxi_ab : P.x i ∈ Set.Icc a b := partition_point_mem hab P.x0 P.xN P.strict (le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    have : a ≤ P.x i := hxi_ab.1
    have : P.x i < t := ht.1
    linarith
  · 
    have hxi1_ab : P.x (i+1) ∈ Set.Icc a b := partition_point_mem hab P.x0 P.xN P.strict (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    have : t ≤ P.x (i+1) := ht.2
    have : P.x (i+1) ≤ b := hxi1_ab.2
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_le_interval
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_le_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral f a b ≤ (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume)
proof:
:= by
  unfold riemannIntegral
  apply csSup_le
  · 
    exact ⟨lowerSum f (uniformPartition a b 1 hab (by norm_num)), ⟨uniformPartition a b 1 hab (by norm_num), rfl⟩⟩
  · 
    intro m hm
    rcases hm with ⟨P, rfl⟩
    
    have hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1) := by
      intro i hi
      exact (P.strict i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).le
    have hsub := partition_subinterval_sub (le_of_lt hab) P hstep
    exact darboux_lower_le_interval (le_of_lt hab) hf P hstep hsub

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.f_le_step_sup_pointwise
statement:
lemma f_le_step_sup_pointwise {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc p q)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc p q) :
    f t ≤ sSup (f '' Set.Icc p q)
proof:
:= by
  
  have htm : f t ∈ f '' Set.Icc p q := by
    refine ⟨t, ⟨le_of_lt ht.1, ht.2⟩, rfl⟩
  
  exact le_csSup (IsCompact.bddAbove (IsCompact.image_of_continuousOn isCompact_Icc hf)) htm

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_ge_f_upper
statement:
lemma step_ge_f_upper {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc a b,
      f t ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rcases partition_cover P.x0 P.xN P.strict ht with ⟨i, hi_lt, hxi, hxi1⟩
  have hdisj_all : ∀ j, j < P.n → j ≠ i → t ∉ Set.Ioc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)) := by
    intro j hj ji
    exact partition_disjoint P.strict hi_lt hj ji.symm ⟨hxi, hxi1⟩
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range P.n,
      (Set.Ioc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1))).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)))) t) =
      sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
    exact step_eval_at (c := fun j => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x j) (P.x (j+1)))) hi_lt ⟨hxi, hxi1⟩ hdisj_all
  have hle : f t ≤ sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
    have hxi_ab : P.x i ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      exact partition_point_mem hab P.x0 P.xN P.strict (le_of_lt hi_lt)
    have hxi1_ab : P.x (i+1) ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
      exact partition_point_mem hab P.x0 P.xN P.strict (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi_lt)
    have hf_sub : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) := by
      exact hf.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc hxi_ab.1 hxi1_ab.2)
    exact f_le_step_sup_pointwise (P.strict i hi_lt).le hf_sub ⟨hxi, hxi1⟩
  rw [hsum]
  exact hle

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.indicator_f_le_indicator_uP
statement:
lemma indicator_f_le_indicator_uP {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ≤
      (Set.Ioc a b).indicator
        (fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
          (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc a b
  · 
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    
    exact step_ge_f_upper hab hf P hsub t ht
  · 
    simp [Set.indicator, ht]

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.step_sup_integral_eq_upperSum
statement:
lemma step_sup_integral_eq_upperSum {f : ℝ → ℝ} (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1)) :
    (∫ t : ℝ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
        (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) ∂volume) =
      upperSum f P
proof:
:= by
  have hD3b := integral_sum_indicator_Ioc (x := P.x)
    (c := fun i => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hstep
  rw [hD3b]
  unfold upperSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.darboux_upper_ge_interval
statement:
theorem darboux_upper_ge_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (P : DarbouxPartition a b)
    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1))
    (hsub : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)) ⊆ Set.Ioc a b) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤ upperSum f P
proof:
:= by
  let uP : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
    (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t
  
  
  
  have hf_uP : ∀ t, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ≤ (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t := by
    intro t
    
    simpa [uP] using indicator_f_le_indicator_uP hab hf P hsub t  
  have hf_int : (∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ∂volume) ≤
      (∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t ∂volume) := by
    have hif : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f) volume := by
      rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
      have hcc : IntegrableOn f (Set.Icc a b) volume := ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc hf
      exact hcc.mono_set (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
    have hiuP : Integrable ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP) volume := by
      
      have huP_int : Integrable uP volume := by
        have hin : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, Integrable
            ((Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
              (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))))) volume := by
          intro i hi
          rw [integrable_indicator_iff (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)]
          have hfin : volume (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))) ≠ ∞ := by
            rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
            exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
          exact integrableOn_const (μ := volume) (s := Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))
            (C := sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) (hs := hfin)
        exact integrable_finsetSum (s := Finset.range P.n) hin
      have hident : (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP = uP := by
        funext t
        exact step_indicator_identity (c := fun i => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hsub t
      rw [hident]
      exact huP_int
    exact integral_mono hif hiuP hf_uP
  
  have h3 : (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) = (∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ∂volume) :=
    (integral_indicator (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)).symm
  
  have h4 : (∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t ∂volume) = upperSum f P := by
    
    have hident : (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP = uP := by
      funext t
      exact step_indicator_identity (c := fun i => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) hsub t
    
    have hUP_sum : (∫ t : ℝ, uP t ∂volume) = upperSum f P := by
      rw [show uP = (fun t => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range P.n,
          (Set.Ioc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1))).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ => sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i) (P.x (i+1)))) t) by rfl]
      exact step_sup_integral_eq_upperSum P hstep
    rw [hident]
    exact hUP_sum
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) = (∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator f t ∂volume) := h3
    _ ≤ (∫ t : ℝ, (Set.Ioc a b).indicator uP t ∂volume) := hf_int
    _ = upperSum f P := h4

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.interval_le_sSup_lowerSum_add
statement:
theorem interval_le_sSup_lowerSum_add {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤
      sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f P} + ε
proof:
:= by
  have hR := continuous_on_riemannIntegrable_lt hab hf ε hε
  rcases hR with ⟨P, hPd⟩
  have hstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1) := by
    intro i hi
    exact (P.strict i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).le
  have hsub := partition_subinterval_sub (le_of_lt hab) P hstep
  have hU : (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤ upperSum f P :=
    darboux_upper_ge_interval (le_of_lt hab) hf P hstep hsub
  have hUs : upperSum f P < lowerSum f P + ε := by linarith
  have hL : lowerSum f P ≤ sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f P} := by
    have hmem : lowerSum f P ∈ {x : ℝ | ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f P} := ⟨P, rfl⟩
    have hbdd : BddAbove {x : ℝ | ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f P} := by
      refine ⟨(∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume), ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      rcases hy with ⟨P, rfl⟩
      have hstep' : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range P.n, P.x i ≤ P.x (i+1) := by
        intro i hi
        exact (P.strict i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).le
      have hsub' := partition_subinterval_sub (le_of_lt hab) P hstep'
      exact darboux_lower_le_interval (le_of_lt hab) hf P hstep' hsub'
    exact le_csSup hbdd hmem
  exact le_of_lt (calc
    (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤ upperSum f P := hU
    _ < lowerSum f P + ε := hUs
    _ ≤ sSup {x : ℝ | ∃ P : DarbouxPartition a b, x = lowerSum f P} + ε := by linarith)

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Riemann.riemannIntegral_eq_interval
statement:
theorem riemannIntegral_eq_interval {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    riemannIntegral f a b = (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hle1 : riemannIntegral f a b ≤ (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) :=
    riemannIntegral_le_interval hab hf
  
  have hle2 : (∫ x : ℝ in Set.Ioc a b, f x ∂volume) ≤ riemannIntegral f a b := by
    
    unfold riemannIntegral
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    exact interval_le_sSup_lowerSum_add hab hf ε hε
  exact le_antisymm hle1 hle2

statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_interval_subfamily_covering_enlargement
    (t : Set ι) (I : ι → OpenInterval) (R : ℝ) (hR : ∀ a ∈ t, (I a).radius ≤ R)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 3 < τ) :
    ∃ u ⊆ t, u.PairwiseDisjoint (fun a => (I a).toSet) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ t, ∃ b ∈ u, (I a).toSet ⊆ ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hut, hdisj, hcov⟩ :=
    Vitali.exists_disjoint_subfamily_covering_enlargement_ball t
      (fun a => (I a).center) (fun a => (I a).radius) R hR τ hτ
  refine ⟨u, hut, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [OpenInterval.ball_center_radius] using hdisj
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hsub⟩ := hcov a ha
    exact ⟨b, hb, by simpa only [OpenInterval.ball_center_radius] using hsub⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Covering.volume_iUnion_le_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem volume_iUnion_le_mul_tsum
    (t : Set ι) (I : ι → OpenInterval) (u : Set ι) (_hut : u ⊆ t)
    (hdisj : u.PairwiseDisjoint fun a => (I a).toSet)
    (hcov : ∀ a ∈ t, ∃ b ∈ u, (I a).toSet ⊆ ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius))
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    volume (⋃ a ∈ t, (I a).toSet) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal τ * ∑' b : u, volume ((I b).toSet)
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : u.Countable :=
    hdisj.countable_of_nonempty_interior fun i _ => by
      rw [(OpenInterval.isOpen_toSet (I i)).interior_eq]
      exact ⟨(I i).center, OpenInterval.center_mem_toSet (I i)⟩
  have hcount' : Countable u := hcount.to_subtype
  calc
    volume (⋃ a ∈ t, (I a).toSet)
        ≤ volume (⋃ b ∈ u, ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius)) := by
          apply measure_mono
          intro x hx
          obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
          obtain ⟨b, hb, hsub⟩ := hcov a ha
          exact mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨b, hb, hsub hxa⟩
    _ = volume (⋃ b : u, ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius)) := by
          rw [Set.iUnion_subtype]
    _ ≤ ∑' b : u, volume (ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius)) :=
          measure_iUnion_le _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal τ * ∑' b : u, volume ((I b).toSet) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
          apply tsum_congr
          intro b
          rw [Real.volume_ball, ← OpenInterval.ball_center_radius, Real.volume_ball,
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hτ]
          congr 1
          ring

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.Lp.minkowski_nonneg
statement:
theorem minkowski_nonneg {p : ℝ} {f g : α → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫⁻ x, (f + g) x ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤

          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2))

name: SandronesLibrary.RealAnalysis.AbsoluteContinuityFunction.lipschitzOnWith_comp_absolutelyContinuousOnInterval
statement:
theorem lipschitzOnWith_comp_absolutelyContinuousOnInterval {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b) (hg : LipschitzOnWith K g (uIcc a b))
    (hmaps : MapsTo f (uIcc a b) (uIcc a b)) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (g ∘ f) a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_iff] at hf ⊢
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hf (ε / (K + 1)) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun E hE hlen => ?_⟩
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (g (f (E.2 i).1)) (g (f (E.2 i).2))
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, (K : ℝ) * dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
        exact hg.dist_le_mul (f (E.2 i).1) (hmaps (hE.1 i hi).1) (f (E.2 i).2)
          (hmaps (hE.1 i hi).2)
    _ = (K : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range E.1, dist (f (E.2 i).1) (f (E.2 i).2) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (ε / (K + 1)) := by
        gcongr
        exact (h E hE hlen).le
    _ < ((K : ℝ) + 1) * (ε / (K + 1)) := by
        gcongr
        linarith
    _ = ε := by
        field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.exists_jordan_normal_basis
statement:
theorem exists_jordan_normal_basis [IsAlgClosed K] [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    ∃ d : JordanFormData K, HasJordanNormalBasis T d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Module.End K V := T
  let E := {μ : K // F.maxGenEigenspace μ ≠ ⊥}
  have hEfinite : Set.Finite {μ : K | F.maxGenEigenspace μ ≠ ⊥} :=
    WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep F.independent_maxGenEigenspace
  letI : Fintype E := hEfinite.fintype
  let S : E → Submodule K V := fun e => F.maxGenEigenspace e.1
  letI : ∀ e : E, LinearSpace K (S e) := fun _ => ⟨inferInstance⟩
  have hIndependent : iSupIndep S := by
    exact F.independent_maxGenEigenspace.comp Subtype.val_injective
  have hSup : ⨆ e, S e = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← F.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top]
    refine iSup_le fun μ => ?_
    by_cases hμ : F.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊥
    · rw [hμ]
      exact bot_le
    · exact le_iSup S (⟨μ, hμ⟩ : E)
  have hInternal : DirectSum.IsInternal S :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top hIndependent hSup
  let N (e : E) : S e →ₗ[K] S e :=
    (F - algebraMap K (Module.End K V) e.1).restrict
      (F.mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm
        (Algebra.mul_sub_algebraMap_commutes F e.1) e.1)
  have hNil (e : E) : IsNilpotent (N e) := by
    simpa [N, S] using
      (F.isNilpotent_restrict_maxGenEigenspace_sub_algebraMap e.1)
  let decomposition (e : E) :=
    nilpotent_exists_jordanBasisFamily (K := K) (V := S e) (N e) (hNil e)
  let r (e : E) : ℕ := (decomposition e).choose
  let length (e : E) : Fin (r e) → ℕ := (decomposition e).choose_spec.choose
  let chain (e : E) : (i : Fin (r e)) → Fin (length e i + 1) → S e :=
    (decomposition e).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose
  have hchain (e : E) :
      IsJordanBasisFamily (N e) (r e) (fun _ => 0) (length e) (chain e) :=
    (decomposition e).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec
  have hNcoe (e : E) (x : S e) :
      ((N e x : S e) : V) = T (x : V) - e.1 • (x : V) := by
    rfl
  let localIndex (e : E) := Σ i : Fin (r e), Fin (length e i + 1)
  let localBasis (e : E) : Module.Basis (localIndex e) K (S e) :=
    Module.Basis.mk (hchain e).1.1 (by simpa [(hchain e).1.2])
  let Block := Σ e : E, Fin (r e)
  let blockLength : Block → ℕ := fun q => length q.1 q.2
  let blockEigenvalue : Block → K := fun q => q.1.1
  let b : (q : Block) → Fin (blockLength q + 1) → V :=
    fun q j => ((chain q.1 q.2 j : S q.1) : V)
  have hbChain (q : Block) : IsJordanChain T (blockEigenvalue q) (b q) := by
    rcases q with ⟨e, i⟩
    have hc := (hchain e).2 i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hz
      apply hc.1
      exact Subtype.ext hz
    · have hz := congrArg Subtype.val hc.2.1
      simp only [zero_smul] at hz
      rw [hNcoe] at hz
      have hz' : T (chain e i 0 : V) - e.1 • (chain e i 0 : V) = 0 := by
        simpa [N, F, LinearMap.sub_apply] using hz
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz'
    · intro j
      have hs := congrArg Subtype.val (hc.2.2 j)
      simp only [zero_smul, zero_add] at hs
      rw [hNcoe] at hs
      have hs' : T (chain e i j.succ : V) - e.1 • (chain e i j.succ : V) =
          (chain e i j.castSucc : V) := by
        simpa [N, F, LinearMap.sub_apply] using hs
      change T (chain e i j.succ : V) =
        e.1 • (chain e i j.succ : V) + (chain e i j.castSucc : V)
      calc
        T (chain e i j.succ : V) =
            (chain e i j.castSucc : V) + e.1 • (chain e i j.succ : V) :=
          sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hs'
        _ = e.1 • (chain e i j.succ : V) + (chain e i j.castSucc : V) :=
          add_comm _ _
  let collected := hInternal.collectedBasis localBasis
  let assoc : (Σ q : Block, Fin (blockLength q + 1)) ≃
      (Σ e : E, localIndex e) := Equiv.sigmaAssoc
        (fun e (i : Fin (r e)) => Fin (length e i + 1))
  let globalBasis : Module.Basis (Σ q : Block, Fin (blockLength q + 1)) K V :=
    collected.reindex assoc.symm
  have hGlobalBasisCoe :
      (globalBasis : (Σ q : Block, Fin (blockLength q + 1)) → V) =
        fun p => b p.1 p.2 := by
    funext p
    rcases p with ⟨⟨e, i⟩, j⟩
    change globalBasis ⟨⟨e, i⟩, j⟩ = (chain e i j : V)
    rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply]
    change collected ⟨e, ⟨i, j⟩⟩ = (chain e i j : V)
    rw [DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedBasis_coe]
    simp [localBasis]
  have hbBasis : IsBasis K (fun p : Σ q : Block, Fin (blockLength q + 1) =>
      b p.1 p.2) := by
    rw [← hGlobalBasisCoe]
    exact ⟨globalBasis.linearIndependent, by
      simpa using globalBasis.span_eq⟩
  letI : DecidableEq Block := Classical.decEq Block
  let d : JordanFormData K :=
    { Block := Block
      blockFintype := inferInstance
      eigenvalue := blockEigenvalue
      length := blockLength }
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  dsimp [HasJordanNormalBasis]
  letI := d.blockFintype
  refine ⟨fun p => b p.1 p.2, hbBasis, ?_⟩
  simpa [d, jordanNormalMatrix] using
    (operatorMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordan T blockEigenvalue blockLength b
      ⟨hbBasis, hbChain⟩)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.operatorMatrix_reindex_basis
statement:
private theorem operatorMatrix_reindex_basis
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (b : ι → V) (hb : IsBasis K b)
    (hb' : IsBasis K (fun k => b (e.symm k))) (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    operatorMatrix (fun k => b (e.symm k)) hb' T =
      Matrix.reindex e e (operatorMatrix b hb T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Module.Basis ι K V := Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  let B' : Module.Basis κ K V := B.reindex e
  have hB (i : ι) : B i = b i := by simp [B]
  have hB' (k : κ) : B' k = b (e.symm k) := by
    simp [B', hB]
  change LinearMap.toMatrix
      (Module.Basis.mk hb'.1 (by simpa [hb'.2]))
      (Module.Basis.mk hb'.1 (by simpa [hb'.2])) T =
    Matrix.reindex e e
      (LinearMap.toMatrix (Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2]))
        (Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])) T)
  have hmk : Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2]) = B := by
    ext i
    simp [B]
  have hmk' : Module.Basis.mk hb'.1 (by simpa [hb'.2]) = B' := by
    ext k
    simp [hB']
  rw [hmk, hmk']
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, B', Matrix.reindex_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.matrix_is_similar_to_jordan
statement:
theorem matrix_is_similar_to_jordan [IsAlgClosed K] {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) :
    ∃ (d : JordanFormData K)
      (e : (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) ≃ Fin n),
      MatricesAreSimilar A (Matrix.reindex e e (jordanNormalMatrix d))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] (Fin n → K) := Matrix.toLin' A
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_jordan_normal_basis T
  letI := d.blockFintype
  change ∃ (b : (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) → (Fin n → K))
    (hb : IsBasis K b), operatorMatrix b hb T = jordanNormalMatrix d at hd
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hmatrix⟩ := hd
  let I := Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)
  let B : Module.Basis I K (Fin n → K) :=
    Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  have hcard : Fintype.card I = n := by
    have h := Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B
    simpa [I] using h.symm
  let e : I ≃ Fin n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simpa using hcard)
  let b' : Fin n → (Fin n → K) := fun i => b (e.symm i)
  let B' : Module.Basis (Fin n) K (Fin n → K) := B.reindex e
  have hB' (i : Fin n) : B' i = b' i := by
    simp [B', B, b', e]
  have hB'fun : (B' : Fin n → (Fin n → K)) = b' := funext hB'
  have hb' : IsBasis K b' := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hB'fun]
      exact B'.linearIndependent
    · rw [← hB'fun]
      simpa using B'.span_eq
  have hJordan : operatorMatrix b' hb' T =
      Matrix.reindex e e (jordanNormalMatrix d) := by
    rw [operatorMatrix_reindex_basis e b hb hb' T, hmatrix]
  let std : Fin n → (Fin n → K) := fun i => Pi.single i 1
  have hstd : IsBasis K std := by
    let Std := Pi.basisFun K (Fin n)
    have hStd (i : Fin n) : Std i = std i := by
      ext j
      simp [Std, std, Pi.basisFun_apply]
    have hStdFun : (Std : Fin n → (Fin n → K)) = std := funext hStd
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hStdFun]
      exact Std.linearIndependent
    · rw [← hStdFun]
      simpa using Std.span_eq
  have hstandardMatrix : operatorMatrix std hstd T = A := by
    change LinearMap.toMatrix (Module.Basis.mk hstd.1 (by simpa [hstd.2]))
      (Module.Basis.mk hstd.1 (by simpa [hstd.2])) T = A
    have hBasisEq : Module.Basis.mk hstd.1 (by simpa [hstd.2]) =
        Pi.basisFun K (Fin n) := by
      ext i j
      simp [std, Pi.basisFun_apply]
    rw [hBasisEq, LinearMap.toMatrix_eq_toMatrix']
    exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin' A
  let P := transitionMatrix std b' hstd hb'
  let Q := transitionMatrix b' std hb' hstd
  refine ⟨d, e, P, Q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact transitionMatrix_mul_reverse std b' hstd hb'
  · exact reverse_mul_transitionMatrix std b' hstd hb'
  · rw [← hJordan, operatorMatrix_change_basis std b' hstd hb' T,
      hstandardMatrix]

statement:
theorem complex_matrix_is_similar_to_jordan {n : ℕ}

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedEigenspace_isSubspace
statement:
theorem generalizedEigenspace_isSubspace (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    IsSubspace K (generalizedEigenspace T μ k)
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  refine ⟨⟨0, by simp [generalizedEigenspace, A]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    change (A ^ k) x = 0 at hx
    change (A ^ k) y = 0 at hy
    change (A ^ k) (x + y) = 0
    rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · intro c x hx
    change (A ^ k) x = 0 at hx
    change (A ^ k) (c • x) = 0
    rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedEigenspace_mono
statement:
theorem generalizedEigenspace_mono (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) {k l : ℕ}
    (hkl : k ≤ l) : generalizedEigenspace T μ k ⊆ generalizedEigenspace T μ l
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hkl
  change (A ^ k) x = 0 at hx
  change (A ^ (k + d)) x = 0
  rw [add_comm k d, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hx, map_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedEigenspace_stabilizes
statement:
theorem generalizedEigenspace_stabilizes [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) {k : ℕ} (hk : dim K V ≤ k) :
    generalizedEigenspace T μ k = generalizedEigenspace T μ (dim K V)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Module.End.genEigenspace_eq_genEigenspace_finrank_of_le T μ hk
  ext x
  have hx := SetLike.ext_iff.mp h x
  simpa [generalizedEigenspace, Module.End.mem_genEigenspace_nat, dim,
    Module.End.one_eq_id] using hx

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.span_generalizedEigenvectors_eq_univ
statement:
theorem span_generalizedEigenvectors_eq_univ [IsFiniteDimensional K V] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    span K {x : V | ∃ μ : K, x ∈ generalizedEigenspace T μ (dim K V)} =
      Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  let G : Set V := {x : V | ∃ μ : K, x ∈ generalizedEigenspace T μ (dim K V)}
  let P : Submodule K V := Submodule.span K G
  have hmax (μ : K) : Module.End.maxGenEigenspace T μ ≤ P := by
    intro x hx
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨μ, ?_⟩
    have hfin := Module.End.maxGenEigenspace_eq_genEigenspace_finrank T μ
    have hxfin : x ∈ Module.End.genEigenspace T μ (Module.finrank K V) := by
      rw [← hfin]
      exact hx
    simpa [generalizedEigenspace, Module.End.mem_genEigenspace_nat, dim,
      Module.End.one_eq_id] using hxfin
  have hall : (⊤ : Submodule K V) ≤ P := by
    rw [← Module.End.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top T]
    exact iSup_le hmax
  have hP : P = ⊤ := top_unique hall
  unfold span
  change (↑P : Set V) = Set.univ
  rw [hP]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_isUpperTriangular (μ : K) (m : ℕ) :
    (jordanBlock μ m).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hji
  change j.val < i.val at hji
  simp only [jordanBlock]
  split
  · next hij => subst i; exact (lt_irrefl _ hji).elim
  · split
    · next hsucc => omega
    · rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.charpoly_jordanBlock
statement:
theorem charpoly_jordanBlock (μ : K) (m : ℕ) :
    (jordanBlock μ m).charpoly =
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ) ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_of_isUpperTriangular _ (jordanBlock_isUpperTriangular μ m)]
  simp [jordanBlock]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.operatorMatrix_eq_jordanBlock
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := Module.Basis.mk hb.1.1 (by simpa [hb.1.2])
  have hB (j : Fin (m + 1)) : B j = b j := by simp [B]
  change LinearMap.toMatrix B B T = jordanBlock μ m
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun q => ?_) j
  · rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    rw [show T (B 0) = μ • B 0 by simpa [hB] using hb.2.1]
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [jordanBlock]
    · simp [jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
  · rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    rw [show T (B q.succ) = μ • B q.succ + B q.castSucc by
      simpa [hB] using hb.2.2 q]
    by_cases hsucc : i = q.succ
    · subst i
      simp [jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
    · by_cases hprev : i = q.castSucc
      · subst i
        simp [jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
      · have hval : i.val ≠ q.val := by
          intro h
          apply hprev
          exact Fin.ext h
        simp [jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, hsucc, hprev, hval]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.characteristicPolynomial_eq_pow_of_jordanChainBasis
statement:
theorem characteristicPolynomial_eq_pow_of_jordanChainBasis
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) {m : ℕ}
    (b : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hb : IsJordanChainBasis T μ b) :
    Diagonalization.characteristicPolynomial T =
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ) ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := Module.Basis.mk hb.1.1 (by simpa [hb.1.2])
  calc
    Diagonalization.characteristicPolynomial T =
        (Coordinates.operatorMatrix b hb.1 T).charpoly := by
      symm
      simpa [Diagonalization.characteristicPolynomial, Coordinates.operatorMatrix, B] using
        (LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix T B)
    _ = (jordanBlock μ m).charpoly := by
      rw [operatorMatrix_eq_jordanBlock T μ b hb]
    _ = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ) ^ (m + 1) := charpoly_jordanBlock μ m

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_power_annihilates
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  have hzero : A (b 0) = 0 := by
    simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.1]
  have hshift (q : Fin m) : A (b q.succ) = b q.castSucc := by
    simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.2 q]
  refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun q ih => ?_) j
  · simpa [A] using hzero
  · change (A ^ (q.val + 1 + 1)) (b q.succ) = 0
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hshift q]
    exact ih

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_power_annihilates_general
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  have hzero : A (b 0) = 0 := by
    simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.1]
  have hshift (q : Fin m) : A (b q.succ) = b q.castSucc := by
    simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.2 q]
  refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun q ih => ?_) j
  · simpa [A] using hzero
  · change (A ^ (q.val + 1 + 1)) (b q.succ) = 0
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hshift q]
    exact ih

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_init
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hb.1
  · simpa using hb.2.1
  · intro j
    simpa [Fin.ext_iff] using hb.2.2 j.castSucc

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsLinearIndependent
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
      intro c hsum i
      have hi : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
      subst i
      have hsmul : c 0 • b 0 = 0 := by simpa using hsum
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hsmul).resolve_right hb.1
  | succ m ih =>
      let binit : Fin (m + 1) → V := fun i => b i.castSucc
      have hbinit : IsJordanChain T μ binit := jordanChain_init T μ b hb
      have hli : LinearIndependent K binit := ih binit hbinit
      rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
      intro c hsum
      let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
      have hzero : A (b 0) = 0 := by
        simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.1]
      have hshift (j : Fin (m + 1)) : A (b j.succ) = b j.castSucc := by
        simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.2 j]
      have hshift0 : A (b 1) = b 0 := by simpa using hshift 0
      have hA := congrArg A hsum
      have htail : ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), c j.succ • binit j = 0 := by
        simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, map_sum, map_smul, hzero, hshift, hshift0, binit] using hA
      have hcoeff : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), c j.succ = 0 :=
        (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli) (fun j => c j.succ) htail
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => hcoeff j) i
      have hfirst : c 0 • b 0 = 0 := by
        simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, hcoeff] using hsum
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hfirst).resolve_right hb.1

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_power_top_eq_first
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      let binit : Fin (m + 1) → V := fun i => b i.castSucc
      have hbinit : IsJordanChain T μ binit := jordanChain_init T μ b hb
      have hshift : A (b (Fin.last (m + 1))) = b (Fin.last m).castSucc := by
        have h := hb.2.2 (Fin.last m)
        have hlast : (Fin.last m).succ = Fin.last (m + 1) := Fin.ext rfl
        change T (b (Fin.last (m + 1))) - μ • b (Fin.last (m + 1)) = _
        rw [← hlast, h]
        abel
      change (A ^ (m + 1)) (b (Fin.last (m + 1))) = b 0
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hshift]
      simpa [binit] using ih binit hbinit

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_shifted_power_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have happ := congrArg (fun A : V →ₗ[K] V => A (b (Fin.last m))) hzero
  rw [jordanChain_power_top_eq_first T μ b hb] at happ
  exact hb.1 (by simpa using happ)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChainBasis_shifted_power_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  classical
  let B := Module.Basis.mk hb.1.1 (by simpa [hb.1.2])
  have hB (j : Fin (m + 1)) : B j = b j := by simp [B]
  apply B.ext
  intro j
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, hB]
  have hj := jordanChain_power_annihilates T μ b hb j
  have hle : j.val + 1 ≤ m + 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
  change (A ^ (m + 1)) (b j) = 0
  rw [hd, add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hj, map_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_of_chainBasis
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨LinearIndependent.ne_zero 0 hb.1.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChainBasis_linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  exact hb.1.1

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChainBasis_spans
proof:
:= by
  unfold span
  rw [hb.1.2]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChainBasis_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hb
    exact ⟨hb.1, jordanChain_of_chainBasis T μ b hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, _hzero, hfirst, hsucc⟩
    exact ⟨hb, hfirst, hsucc⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_power_top_eq_rev
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  have hzero : A (b 0) = 0 := by
    simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.1]
  have hshift (q : Fin m) : A (b q.succ) = b q.castSucc := by
    simp [A, LinearMap.sub_apply, hb.2.2 q]
  refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun q ih => ?_) i
  · simp
  · change (A ^ (q.val + 1)) (b (Fin.last m)) = b q.succ.rev
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    have ihA : (A ^ q.val) (b (Fin.last m)) = b q.castSucc.rev := by
      simpa [A] using ih
    rw [ihA]
    have hleft : q.castSucc.rev = q.rev.succ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [Fin.rev]
      omega
    have hright : q.succ.rev = q.rev.castSucc := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [Fin.rev]
    rw [hleft, hshift q.rev, hright]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_shifted_powers_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem jordanChain_shifted_powers_linearIndependent
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) {m : ℕ}
    (b : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hb : IsJordanChain T μ b) :
    LinearIndependent K
      (fun i : Fin (m + 1) ↦
        (T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)) ^ i.val)
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  have hli : LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin (m + 1) ↦ b i.rev) :=
    (jordanChain_linearIndependent T μ b hb).comp _ Fin.rev_injective
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hc
  have happ := congrArg (fun F : V →ₗ[K] V => F (b (Fin.last m))) hc
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), c i • b i.rev = 0 := by
    simpa [A, map_sum, jordanChain_power_top_eq_rev T μ b hb] using happ
  exact (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli) c hsum

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.minimalPolynomial_shifted_eq_pow
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomial_shifted_eq_pow [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) {m : ℕ}
    (b : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hb : IsJordanChainBasis T μ b) :
    Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial (T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)) =
      Polynomial.X ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  unfold Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial
  exact minpoly.eq_of_linearIndependent K A (Polynomial.monic_X_pow _)
    (by simpa [A] using jordanChainBasis_shifted_power_eq_zero T μ b hb)
    (m + 1) (by simp)
    (jordanChain_shifted_powers_linearIndependent T μ b
      (jordanChain_of_chainBasis T μ b hb))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.minimalPolynomial_add_scalar_identity
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomial_add_scalar_identity [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] V) (a : K) :
    Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial
        (A + a • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)) =
      (Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial A).comp
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial
  have hscalar : a • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V) =
      algebraMap K (V →ₗ[K] V) a := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hscalar]
  have hA : IsIntegral K A := IsIntegral.of_finite K A
  refine (minpoly.unique K _ ((minpoly.monic hA).comp_X_sub_C a) ?_ fun q qmo hq => ?_).symm
  · simp [Polynomial.aeval_comp]
  · have hqA : Polynomial.aeval A (q.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a)) = 0 := by
      simpa [Polynomial.aeval_comp] using hq
    have hmin := minpoly.min K A (qmo.comp_X_add_C a) hqA
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree qmo.ne_zero,
      Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree ((minpoly.monic hA).comp_X_sub_C a).ne_zero,
      Polynomial.natDegree_comp, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
    rwa [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (minpoly.ne_zero hA),
      Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (qmo.comp_X_add_C a).ne_zero,
      Polynomial.natDegree_comp, Polynomial.natDegree_X_add_C, mul_one] at hmin

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.minimalPolynomial_eq_pow_of_jordanChainBasis
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomial_eq_pow_of_jordanChainBasis
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) {m : ℕ}
    (b : Fin (m + 1) → V) (hb : IsJordanChainBasis T μ b) :
    Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial T =
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C μ) ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let A := T - μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V)
  have htranslate := minimalPolynomial_add_scalar_identity A μ
  have hA := minimalPolynomial_shifted_eq_pow T μ b hb
  have hAT : A + μ • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V) = T := by
    simp [A]
  rw [hAT, hA] at htranslate
  simpa using htranslate

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_power_dim_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nilpotent_power_dim_eq_zero [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) : N ^ (dim K V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hN
  have hker_n : LinearMap.ker (N ^ n) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hn]
    simp
  have hle := Module.End.ker_pow_le_ker_pow_finrank N n
  rw [hker_n] at hle
  have hker_dim : LinearMap.ker (N ^ (dim K V)) = ⊤ := top_unique hle
  exact LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp hker_dim

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_exists_nonzero_kernel_vector
statement:
theorem nilpotent_exists_nonzero_kernel_vector
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] [Nontrivial V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) : ∃ v : V, v ≠ 0 ∧ N v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hinj : Function.Injective N := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
    ext x
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_bot]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_contra hx0
      exact (h x hx0) hx
    · intro hx
      simp [hx]
  have hinj_pow : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Injective (N ^ n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro x y hxy
        simpa using hxy
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, Module.End.coe_mul]
        exact ih.comp hinj
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_ne (0 : V)
  have hzero := nilpotent_power_dim_eq_zero N hN
  apply hv
  apply hinj_pow (dim K V)
  rw [hzero]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_exact_index_exists
statement:
theorem nilpotent_exact_index_exists [Nontrivial V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, N ^ (m + 1) = 0 ∧ N ^ m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let k := Nat.find hN
  have hkzero : N ^ k = 0 := Nat.find_spec hN
  have hkne : k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hk
    have hone : (1 : V →ₗ[K] V) = 0 := by
      simpa [hk] using hkzero
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hkne
  let m := k - 1
  have hmk : m + 1 = k := by
    simp [m, Nat.sub_add_cancel hkpos]
  refine ⟨m, hmk ▸ hkzero, ?_⟩
  exact Nat.find_min hN (by omega)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanChain_exists_of_exact_nilpotency_index
statement:
theorem jordanChain_exists_of_exact_nilpotency_index
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) {m : ℕ}
    (hzero : N ^ (m + 1) = 0) (hne : N ^ m ≠ 0) :
    ∃ b : Fin (m + 1) → V, IsJordanChain N 0 b
proof:
:= by
  rw [DFunLike.ne_iff] at hne
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hne
  have hv' : (N ^ m) v ≠ 0 := by simpa using hv
  let b : Fin (m + 1) → V := fun i => (N ^ (m - i.val)) v
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [b] using hv'
  · have hz := congrArg (fun F : V →ₗ[K] V => F v) hzero
    simpa [b, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply] using hz
  · intro j
    have harith : m - j.val = (m - (j.val + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    change N ((N ^ (m - (j.val + 1))) v) =
      0 • (N ^ (m - (j.val + 1))) v + (N ^ (m - j.val)) v
    rw [zero_smul, zero_add, harith, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_exists_maximal_jordanChain
statement:
theorem nilpotent_exists_maximal_jordanChain [Nontrivial V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin (m + 1) → V),
      IsJordanChain N 0 b ∧ N ^ (m + 1) = 0 ∧ N ^ m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hzero, hne⟩ := nilpotent_exact_index_exists N hN
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := jordanChain_exists_of_exact_nilpotency_index N hzero hne
  exact ⟨m, b, hb, hzero, hne⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotency_index_le_dim
statement:
theorem nilpotency_index_le_dim [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) {m : ℕ}
    (hzero : N ^ (m + 1) = 0) (hne : N ^ m ≠ 0) :
    m + 1 ≤ dim K V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := jordanChain_exists_of_exact_nilpotency_index N hzero hne
  have hli := jordanChain_linearIndependent N 0 b hb
  simpa using card_le_dim_of_linearIndependent hli

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.isSymmetric_iff_entries
statement:
theorem isSymmetric_iff_entries {n R : Type*} {A : Matrix n n R} :
    IsSymmetric A ↔ ∀ i j, A i j = A j i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j
    have hij := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
  · intro h
    ext i j
    exact h j i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.isSymmetric_iff_mathlib
statement:
theorem isSymmetric_iff_mathlib {n R : Type*} {A : Matrix n n R} :
    IsSymmetric A ↔ A.IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.isSkewSymmetric_iff_entries
statement:
theorem isSkewSymmetric_iff_entries {n R : Type*} [AddGroup R] {A : Matrix n n R} :
    IsSkewSymmetric A ↔ ∀ i j, A i j = -A j i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j
    have hij := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
  · intro h
    ext i j
    simpa using h j i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.isSymmetric_add
statement:
theorem isSymmetric_add {n R : Type*} [Add R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
    (hA : IsSymmetric A) (hB : IsSymmetric B) : IsSymmetric (A + B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSymmetric, Matrix.transpose_add, hA, hB]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.isSkewSymmetric_add
statement:
theorem isSkewSymmetric_add {n R : Type*} [AddCommGroup R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
    (hA : IsSkewSymmetric A) (hB : IsSkewSymmetric B) : IsSkewSymmetric (A + B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSkewSymmetric, Matrix.transpose_add, hA, hB, neg_add_rev]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.isSkewSymmetric_diagonal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isSkewSymmetric_diagonal_eq_zero {n K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {A : Matrix n n K} (hA : IsSkewSymmetric A) (i : n) : A i i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hii : A i i = -A i i := (isSkewSymmetric_iff_entries.mp hA) i i
  have htwo : (2 : K) * A i i = 0 := by
    calc
      (2 : K) * A i i = A i i + A i i := two_mul _
      _ = -A i i + A i i := congrArg (fun z ↦ z + A i i) hii
      _ = 0 := neg_add_cancel _
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.symmetricPart_isSymmetric
statement:
theorem symmetricPart_isSymmetric {n K : Type*} [Field K] (A : Matrix n n K) :
    IsSymmetric (symmetricPart A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSymmetric_iff_entries]
  intro i j
  simp [symmetricPart, add_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.skewSymmetricPart_isSkewSymmetric
statement:
theorem skewSymmetricPart_isSkewSymmetric {n K : Type*} [Field K]
    (A : Matrix n n K) : IsSkewSymmetric (skewSymmetricPart A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSkewSymmetric_iff_entries]
  intro i j
  simp [skewSymmetricPart]
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.symmetricPart_add_skewSymmetricPart
statement:
theorem symmetricPart_add_skewSymmetricPart {n K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (A : Matrix n n K) : symmetricPart A + skewSymmetricPart A = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [symmetricPart, skewSymmetricPart]
  field_simp
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.operatorMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordan
statement:
theorem operatorMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordan
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : ι → K) (length : ι → ℕ)
    (b : (i : ι) → Fin (length i + 1) → V)
    (hb : IsBasis K (fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∀ i, IsJordanChain T (μ i) (b i)) :
    operatorMatrix (fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2) hb.1 T =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => jordanBlock (μ i) (length i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let flat := fun p : Σ i : ι, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2
  let B := Module.Basis.mk hb.1.1 (by simpa [hb.1.2])
  have hB (p : Σ i : ι, Fin (length i + 1)) : B p = flat p := by
    simp only [B, Module.Basis.coe_mk]
    rfl
  change LinearMap.toMatrix B B T =
    Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => jordanBlock (μ i) (length i))
  ext p q
  rcases p with ⟨i, k⟩
  rcases q with ⟨j, l⟩
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun s => ?_) l
  · rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    have hchain := (hb.2 j).2.1
    rw [show T (B ⟨j, 0⟩) = μ j • B ⟨j, 0⟩ by
      simpa [hB, flat] using hchain]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst k
        simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock]
      · simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, hk,
          Ne.symm hk]
    · simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, hij]
  · rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    have hchain := (hb.2 j).2.2 s
    rw [show T (B ⟨j, s.succ⟩) = μ j • B ⟨j, s.succ⟩ + B ⟨j, s.castSucc⟩ by
      simpa [hB, flat] using hchain]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases hsucc : k = s.succ
      · subst k
        simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply,
          Fin.ext_iff]
      · by_cases hprev : k = s.castSucc
        · subst k
          simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply,
            Fin.ext_iff]
        · have hvalSucc : k.val ≠ s.val + 1 := by
            intro h
            apply hsucc
            exact Fin.ext h
          have hvalPrev : k.val ≠ s.val := by
            intro h
            apply hprev
            exact Fin.ext h
          simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply,
            hsucc, hprev, hvalSucc, hvalPrev]
    · simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock, Finsupp.single_apply, hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_operator_has_jordan_matrix
statement:
theorem nilpotent_operator_has_jordan_matrix [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V)
      (hb : IsJordanBasisFamily N r (fun _ => 0) length b),
      operatorMatrix (fun p : Σ i : Fin r, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2)
          hb.1 N = Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => jordanBlock 0 (length i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, length, b, hb⟩ := nilpotent_exists_jordanBasisFamily N hN
  exact ⟨r, length, b, hb,
    operatorMatrix_eq_blockDiagonal_jordan N (fun _ => 0) length b hb⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Eigenvalue.similar_det
statement:
theorem similar_det {K : Type*} [Field K] {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A D P : Matrix n n K) (h : P⁻¹ * A * P = D) (hP : IsUnit P.det) :
    ∀ c : K, (c • (1 : Matrix n n K) - A).det = (c • (1 : Matrix n n K) - D).det
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  have hne : P.det ≠ 0 := (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hP)
  have hdet_conj : ∀ N : Matrix n n K, (P⁻¹ * N * P).det = N.det := by
    intro N
    calc
      (P⁻¹ * N * P).det = (P⁻¹ * (N * P)).det := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = P⁻¹.det * (N * P).det := by rw [Matrix.det_mul]
      _ = P⁻¹.det * (N.det * P.det) := by rw [Matrix.det_mul]
      _ = (P⁻¹.det * P.det) * N.det := by ring
      _ = 1 * N.det := by
        rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv]
        simp [hne]
      _ = N.det := by simp
  calc
    (c • 1 - A).det = (P⁻¹ * (c • 1 - A) * P).det := by
      exact (hdet_conj (c • 1 - A)).symm
    _ = (c • 1 - P⁻¹ * A * P).det := by
      congr 1
      have hcomm : P⁻¹ * (c • (1 : Matrix n n K)) * P = c • (1 : Matrix n n K) := by
        calc
          P⁻¹ * (c • 1) * P = P⁻¹ * (c • 1 * P) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          _ = P⁻¹ * (P * (c • 1)) := by congr 1; exact (by
            rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, mul_one, one_mul])
          _ = (P⁻¹ * P) * (c • 1) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          _ = 1 * (c • 1) := by rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul P hP]
          _ = c • 1 := by simp
      calc
        P⁻¹ * (c • 1 - A) * P = (P⁻¹ * (c • 1) - P⁻¹ * A) * P := by rw [Matrix.mul_sub]
        _ = P⁻¹ * (c • 1) * P - P⁻¹ * A * P := by rw [sub_mul]
        _ = c • 1 - P⁻¹ * A * P := by rw [hcomm]
    _ = (c • 1 - D).det := by rw [h]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Eigenvalue.matrixHasEigenvalue_iff_mathlib
statement:
private theorem matrixHasEigenvalue_iff_mathlib {K : Type*} [Field K]
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n K) (μ : K) :
    MatrixHasEigenvalue A μ ↔ Module.End.HasEigenvalue A.toLin' μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx0, hx⟩
    rw [Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff]
    intro hbot
    have hxmem : x ∈ Module.End.eigenspace A.toLin' μ :=
      Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (by simpa using hx)
    rw [hbot] at hxmem
    exact hx0 (by simpa using hxmem)
  · intro h
    rw [Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot h
    exact ⟨x, hx0, by simpa using Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanFormData_equivalent_of_fiber_card_eq
statement:
theorem jordanFormData_equivalent_of_fiber_card_eq
    (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)
    (h : ∀ c : K × ℕ,
      Nat.card {i : d₁.Block // d₁.blockLabel i = c} =
        Nat.card {i : d₂.Block // d₂.blockLabel i = c}) :
    d₁.Equivalent d₂
proof:
:= by
  letI := d₁.blockFintype
  letI := d₂.blockFintype
  classical
  let fiberEquiv (c : K × ℕ) :
      {i : d₁.Block // d₁.blockLabel i = c} ≃
        {i : d₂.Block // d₂.blockLabel i = c} :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card] using h c)
  let e : d₁.Block ≃ d₂.Block := Equiv.ofFiberEquiv fiberEquiv
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact Equiv.ofFiberEquiv_map fiberEquiv i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockTailCount_eq_multiplicity_add_succ
statement:
theorem blockTailCount_eq_multiplicity_add_succ
    (d : JordanFormData K) (μ : K) (m : ℕ) :
    d.blockTailCount μ m =
      d.blockMultiplicity μ m + d.blockTailCount μ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI := d.blockFintype
  classical
  let A := Finset.univ.filter fun i : d.Block =>
    d.eigenvalue i = μ ∧ m < d.length i + 1
  let B := Finset.univ.filter fun i : d.Block =>
    d.eigenvalue i = μ ∧ d.length i = m
  let C := Finset.univ.filter fun i : d.Block =>
    d.eigenvalue i = μ ∧ m + 1 < d.length i + 1
  have hA : A = B ∪ C := by
    ext i
    simp only [A, B, C, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_union]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hμ, hm⟩
      have hor : d.length i = m ∨ m + 1 < d.length i + 1 := by omega
      rcases hor with heq | hgt
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hμ, heq⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hμ, hgt⟩
    · rintro (⟨hμ, rfl⟩ | ⟨hμ, hm⟩)
      · exact ⟨hμ, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨hμ, by omega⟩
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint B C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i hiB hiC
    simp only [B, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hiB
    simp only [C, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hiC
    omega
  change A.card = B.card + C.card
  rw [hA]
  exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockMultiplicity_eq_of_tailCount_eq
statement:
theorem blockMultiplicity_eq_of_tailCount_eq
    (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)
    (h : ∀ μ k, d₁.blockTailCount μ k = d₂.blockTailCount μ k) :
    ∀ μ m, d₁.blockMultiplicity μ m = d₂.blockMultiplicity μ m
proof:
:= by
  intro μ m
  have h₁ := blockTailCount_eq_multiplicity_add_succ d₁ μ m
  have h₂ := blockTailCount_eq_multiplicity_add_succ d₂ μ m
  rw [h μ m, h μ (m + 1)] at h₁
  omega

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanFormData_equivalent_of_tailCount_eq
statement:
theorem jordanFormData_equivalent_of_tailCount_eq
    (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)
