name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.kernelProfile_succ_sub_eq_blockTailCount
statement:
theorem kernelProfile_succ_sub_eq_blockTailCount
    (d : JordanFormData K) (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    d.kernelProfile μ (k + 1) - d.kernelProfile μ k =
      d.blockTailCount μ k
proof:
:= by
  letI := d.blockFintype
  classical
  change
    (∑ i : d.Block,
      if d.eigenvalue i = μ then min (k + 1) (d.length i + 1) else 0) -
        (∑ i : d.Block,
          if d.eigenvalue i = μ then min k (d.length i + 1) else 0) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i : d.Block =>
        d.eigenvalue i = μ ∧ k < d.length i + 1).card
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : d.Block,
        if d.eigenvalue i = μ then min (k + 1) (d.length i + 1) else 0) =
        (∑ i : d.Block,
          if d.eigenvalue i = μ then min k (d.length i + 1) else 0) +
        (Finset.univ.filter fun i : d.Block =>
          d.eigenvalue i = μ ∧ k < d.length i + 1).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    by_cases hμ : d.eigenvalue i = μ
    · by_cases hk : k < d.length i + 1
      · have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ d.length i + 1 := by omega
        have hk0 : k ≤ d.length i + 1 := by omega
        simp [hμ, hk, min_eq_left hk1, min_eq_left hk0]
      · have hle : d.length i + 1 ≤ k := by omega
        have hle1 : d.length i + 1 ≤ k + 1 := by omega
        simp [hμ, hk, min_eq_right hle, min_eq_right hle1]
    · simp [hμ]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedKernelDimension_eq_matrix
statement:
theorem generalizedKernelDimension_eq_matrix
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (b : ι → V) (hb : IsBasis K b)
    (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    generalizedKernelDimension T μ k =
      matrixGeneralizedKernelDimension (operatorMatrix b hb T) μ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Module.Basis ι K V := Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  let F : V →ₗ[K] V := (T - μ • LinearMap.id) ^ k
  have hscalar :
      LinearMap.toMatrix B B (μ • LinearMap.id) = Matrix.scalar ι μ := by
    rw [← Module.algebraMap_end_eq_smul_id,
      LinearMap.toMatrix_algebraMap]
  have hmatrix :
      (operatorMatrix b hb T - Matrix.scalar ι μ) ^ k =
        LinearMap.toMatrix B B F := by
    change
      (LinearMap.toMatrix B B T - Matrix.scalar ι μ) ^ k =
        LinearMap.toMatrix B B F
    rw [← hscalar, ← map_sub, LinearMap.toMatrix_pow]
  have hrank :
      Matrix.rank ((operatorMatrix b hb T - Matrix.scalar ι μ) ^ k) =
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range F) := by
    rw [hmatrix, Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin _ B B,
      Matrix.toLin_toMatrix]
  have hdim : Module.finrank K V = Fintype.card ι := by
    simpa [B] using (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B)
  have hnullity := F.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  simp only [generalizedKernelDimension, matrixGeneralizedKernelDimension]
  rw [hrank]
  change Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker F) =
    Fintype.card ι - Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range F)
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanNormalMatrix_shift_pow_eq_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem jordanNormalMatrix_shift_pow_eq_blockDiagonal
    [Field K] (d : JordanFormData K) [Fintype d.Block] [DecidableEq d.Block]
    (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    (jordanNormalMatrix d -
        Matrix.scalar (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ) ^ k =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i =>
        (jordanBlock (d.eigenvalue i) (d.length i) -
          Matrix.scalar (Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ) ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :
      jordanNormalMatrix d -
          Matrix.scalar (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ =
        Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i =>
          jordanBlock (d.eigenvalue i) (d.length i) -
            Matrix.scalar (Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ) := by
    ext ⟨i, a⟩ ⟨j, b⟩
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst b
        simp [jordanNormalMatrix, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply]
      · have hsigma : (⟨i, a⟩ : Σ i, Fin (d.length i + 1)) ≠ ⟨i, b⟩ := by
          intro h
          exact hab (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).2)
        simp [jordanNormalMatrix, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, hab, hsigma]
    · simp [jordanNormalMatrix, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, hij]
  calc
    _ = (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i =>
        jordanBlock (d.eigenvalue i) (d.length i) -
          Matrix.scalar (Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ)) ^ k := congrArg (· ^ k) hbase
    _ = _ := (Matrix.blockDiagonal'_pow _ k).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank_of_ne
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank_of_ne
    [Field K] (lam μ : K) (m k : ℕ) (h : lam ≠ μ) :
    Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock lam m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) =
      m + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := jordanBlock lam m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ
  have hupper : A.IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hji
    change j.val < i.val at hji
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      intro heq
      subst j
      omega
    have hsucc : i.val + 1 ≠ j.val := by omega
    simp [A, jordanBlock, hij, hsucc, Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne]
  have hdet : A.det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hupper]
    simp [A, jordanBlock]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have hdetpow : (A ^ k).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_pow]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ hdet
  simpa [A] using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdetpow

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_apply
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_apply
    [Field K] (μ : K) (m k : ℕ) (i j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ((jordanBlock μ m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) i j =
      if i.val + k = j.val then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hN (a b : Fin (m + 1)) :
      (jordanBlock μ m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) a b =
        if a.val + 1 = b.val then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b
      simp [jordanBlock]
    · simp [jordanBlock, hab]
  induction k generalizing i j with
  | zero =>
      simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp_rw [ih, hN]
      by_cases hik : i.val + k < m + 1
      · let a : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨i.val + k, hik⟩
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a]
        · simp [a, Nat.add_assoc]
        · intro b _hb hba
          have hne : i.val + k ≠ b.val := by
            intro heq
            apply hba
            exact Fin.ext heq.symm
          simp [hne]
        · simp
      · have hzero : ∀ a : Fin (m + 1), i.val + k ≠ a.val := by
          intro a heq
          omega
        have hsucczero : i.val + (k + 1) ≠ j.val := by omega
        simp [hzero, hsucczero]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.rank_eq_card_sub_min_of_shift_entries
statement:
theorem rank_eq_card_sub_min_of_shift_entries
    [Field K] {n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = if i.val + k = j.val then 1 else 0) :
    Matrix.rank A = n - min k n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := {i : Fin n // i.val + k < n}
  let target : I → Fin n := fun i => ⟨i.1.val + k, i.2⟩
  have htarget : Function.Injective target := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Fin.ext
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hij
    change i.1.val + k = j.1.val + k at hv
    omega
  let rows : I → (Fin n → K) := fun i => Pi.single (target i) 1
  have hrows : LinearIndependent K rows := by
    exact (Pi.linearIndependent_single_one (R := K) (ι := Fin n)).comp
      target htarget
  have hrow_valid (i : I) : A.row i.1 = rows i := by
    ext j
    simp [Matrix.row, rows, target, hA, Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff, eq_comm]
  have hrow_invalid (i : Fin n) (hi : ¬i.val + k < n) : A.row i = 0 := by
    ext j
    change A i j = 0
    rw [hA]
    simp only [ite_eq_right_iff]
    intro heq
    omega
  have hspan :
      Submodule.span K (Set.range A.row) =
        Submodule.span K (Set.range rows) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hv
      by_cases hi : i.val + k < n
      · have heq : A.row i = rows (⟨i, hi⟩ : I) := hrow_valid ⟨i, hi⟩
        rw [heq]
        exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self _)
      · rw [hrow_invalid i hi]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hv
      rw [← hrow_valid i]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self _)
  have hrank : Matrix.rank A = Fintype.card I := by
    rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row, hspan]
    exact (linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.mp hrows).symm
  let e : I ≃ Fin (n - k) :=
    { toFun := fun i => ⟨i.1.val, Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt i.2⟩
      invFun := fun i => by
        have hp : i.val + k < n := Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub i.isLt
        exact ⟨⟨i.val, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hp⟩, hp⟩
      left_inv := by intro i; rfl
      right_inv := by intro i; rfl }
  have hcard : Fintype.card I = n - k := by
    rw [Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [hrank, hcard]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_rank
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_rank
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (μ : K) (m k : ℕ) :
    Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock μ m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) =
      (m + 1) - min k (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply rank_eq_card_sub_min_of_shift_entries
  exact jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_apply μ m k

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank
statement:
theorem jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (lam μ : K) (m k : ℕ) :
    Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock lam m - Matrix.scalar (Fin (m + 1)) μ) ^ k) =
      if lam = μ then (m + 1) - min k (m + 1) else m + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : lam = μ
  · subst lam
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact jordanBlock_nilpotent_shift_pow_rank μ m k
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank_of_ne lam μ m k h

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockDiagonal_toLin_apply
statement:
theorem blockDiagonal_toLin_apply
    [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {n : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (n i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (n i)]
    (A : ∀ i, Matrix (n i) (n i) K)
    (x : (Σ i, n i) → K) (i : ι) (j : n i) :
    Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.blockDiagonal' A) x ⟨i, j⟩ =
      Matrix.toLin' (A i) (fun q => x ⟨i, q⟩) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    ← Finset.univ_sigma_univ, Finset.sum_sigma]
  simp [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.rank_blockDiagonal'
statement:
theorem rank_blockDiagonal'
    [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {n : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (n i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (n i)]
    (A : ∀ i, Matrix (n i) (n i) K) :
    Matrix.rank (Matrix.blockDiagonal' A) = ∑ i, Matrix.rank (A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G : ((Σ i, n i) → K) →ₗ[K] ((Σ i, n i) → K) :=
    Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.blockDiagonal' A)
  let f (i : ι) : (n i → K) →ₗ[K] (n i → K) := Matrix.toLin' (A i)
  let E : LinearMap.range G ≃ₗ[K] ∀ i, LinearMap.range (f i) :=
    { toFun := fun y i => by
        refine ⟨fun j => y.1 ⟨i, j⟩, ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := y.2
        refine ⟨fun q => x ⟨i, q⟩, ?_⟩
        ext j
        change Matrix.toLin' (A i) (fun q => x ⟨i, q⟩) j = y.1 ⟨i, j⟩
        rw [← blockDiagonal_toLin_apply A x i j, hx]
      invFun := fun y => by
        let pre (i : ι) : n i → K := (y i).2.choose
        let x : (Σ i, n i) → K := fun q => pre q.1 q.2
        refine ⟨fun q => (y q.1).1 q.2, ?_⟩
        refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
        ext ⟨i, j⟩
        rw [blockDiagonal_toLin_apply A x i j]
        exact congrFun (y i).2.choose_spec j
      left_inv := by
        intro y
        ext ⟨i, j⟩
        rfl
      right_inv := by
        intro y
        ext i j
        rfl
      map_add' := by
        intro y z
        ext i j
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c y
        ext i j
        rfl }
  change Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range G) =
    ∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (f i))
  rw [E.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_pi_fintype]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanNormalMatrix_generalizedKernelDimension
statement:
theorem jordanNormalMatrix_generalizedKernelDimension
    [Field K] (d : JordanFormData K) [Fintype d.Block] [DecidableEq d.Block]
    (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    matrixGeneralizedKernelDimension (jordanNormalMatrix d) μ k =
      d.kernelProfile μ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold matrixGeneralizedKernelDimension
  rw [jordanNormalMatrix_shift_pow_eq_blockDiagonal,
    rank_blockDiagonal']
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) =
        ∑ i : d.Block, (d.length i + 1) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [hcard]
  have hranks : (∑ i : d.Block,
      Matrix.rank ((jordanBlock (d.eigenvalue i) (d.length i) -
        Matrix.scalar (Fin (d.length i + 1)) μ) ^ k)) =
      ∑ i : d.Block, if d.eigenvalue i = μ then
        (d.length i + 1) - min k (d.length i + 1) else d.length i + 1 := by
    apply Fintype.sum_congr
    intro i
    exact jordanBlock_shift_pow_rank _ _ _ _
  rw [hranks]
  unfold JordanFormData.kernelProfile
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : d.Block, (d.length i + 1)) =
        (∑ i : d.Block,
          if d.eigenvalue i = μ then
            (d.length i + 1) - min k (d.length i + 1)
          else d.length i + 1) +
        ∑ i : d.Block,
          if d.eigenvalue i = μ then min k (d.length i + 1) else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : d.Block,
          ((if d.eigenvalue i = μ then
              (d.length i + 1) - min k (d.length i + 1)
            else d.length i + 1) +
            if d.eigenvalue i = μ then min k (d.length i + 1) else 0) := by
          apply Fintype.sum_congr
          intro i
          by_cases hμ : d.eigenvalue i = μ
          · simp [hμ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (min_le_right k (d.length i + 1))]
          · simp [hμ]
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_add_distrib
  rw [hsum, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hF : (inferInstance : Fintype d.Block) = d.blockFintype :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hF
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.generalizedKernelDimension_eq_kernelProfile
statement:
theorem generalizedKernelDimension_eq_kernelProfile
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (d : JordanFormData K)
    (hd : HasJordanNormalBasis T d) (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    generalizedKernelDimension T μ k = d.kernelProfile μ k
proof:
:= by
  letI := d.blockFintype
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hmatrix⟩ := hd
  rw [generalizedKernelDimension_eq_matrix T b hb μ k, hmatrix]
  exact jordanNormalMatrix_generalizedKernelDimension d μ k

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockTailCount_eq_generalizedKernelDimension_sub
statement:
theorem blockTailCount_eq_generalizedKernelDimension_sub
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (d : JordanFormData K)
    (hd : HasJordanNormalBasis T d) (μ : K) (k : ℕ) :
    d.blockTailCount μ k =
      generalizedKernelDimension T μ (k + 1) -
        generalizedKernelDimension T μ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [generalizedKernelDimension_eq_kernelProfile T d hd μ (k + 1),
    generalizedKernelDimension_eq_kernelProfile T d hd μ k,
    kernelProfile_succ_sub_eq_blockTailCount]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.blockTailCount_eq_of_hasJordanNormalBasis
statement:
theorem blockTailCount_eq_of_hasJordanNormalBasis
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)
    (h₁ : HasJordanNormalBasis T d₁)
    (h₂ : HasJordanNormalBasis T d₂) :
    ∀ μ k, d₁.blockTailCount μ k = d₂.blockTailCount μ k
proof:
:= by
  intro μ k
  rw [blockTailCount_eq_generalizedKernelDimension_sub T d₁ h₁ μ k,
    blockTailCount_eq_generalizedKernelDimension_sub T d₂ h₂ μ k]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordan_normal_basis_unique
statement:
theorem jordan_normal_basis_unique
    {V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (d₁ d₂ : JordanFormData K)
    (h₁ : HasJordanNormalBasis T d₁)
    (h₂ : HasJordanNormalBasis T d₂) :
    d₁.Equivalent d₂
proof:
:= by
  apply jordanFormData_equivalent_of_tailCount_eq
  exact blockTailCount_eq_of_hasJordanNormalBasis T d₁ d₂ h₁ h₂

statement:
theorem hermitianPart_isHermitian (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :

:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.NormalMatrix.hermitian_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem hermitian_unitary_diagonalization {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsHermitianMatrix A) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (μ : n → ℝ),
      IsUnitaryMatrix U ∧
        A = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (μ i : ℂ)) * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  have h : A.IsHermitian := hA
  let U := h.eigenvectorUnitary
  refine ⟨U, h.eigenvalues, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (U : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * U = 1
    simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using U.property.1
  · change A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) *
      Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ h.eigenvalues) *
        (star U : Matrix n n ℂ)
    exact h.spectral_theorem

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem operatorNorm_nonneg (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) : 0 ≤ operatorNorm T
proof:
:= by
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.norm_apply_le_operatorNorm_mul_norm
statement:
theorem norm_apply_le_operatorNorm_mul_norm (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (x : E) :
    ‖T x‖ ≤ operatorNorm T * ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  exact T.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm x

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem operatorNorm_eq_zero_iff (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) : operatorNorm T = 0 ↔ T = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [operatorNorm, norm_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  · intro h
    subst T
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_comp_le
statement:
theorem operatorNorm_comp_le
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
    (S : F →ₗ[𝕜] G) (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    operatorNorm (S.comp T) ≤ operatorNorm S * operatorNorm T
proof:
:= by
  change ‖(S.comp T).toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤
    ‖S.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖T.toContinuousLinearMap‖
  have hcomp : (S.comp T).toContinuousLinearMap =
      S.toContinuousLinearMap.comp T.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    ext x
    rfl
  rw [hcomp]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.first_eigenvalue_le_operatorNorm
statement:
theorem first_eigenvalue_le_operatorNorm
    (S : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) (hS : S.IsPositive)
    (hE : 0 < finrank 𝕜 E) :
    hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl ⟨0, hE⟩ ≤ operatorNorm S
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) := ⟨0, hE⟩
  let v := hS.isSymmetric.eigenvectorBasis rfl i
  have hbound := norm_apply_le_operatorNorm_mul_norm S v
  rw [hS.isSymmetric.apply_eigenvectorBasis rfl i,
    norm_smul, OrthonormalBasis.norm_eq_one, mul_one, mul_one] at hbound
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hS.nonneg_eigenvalues rfl i)] using hbound

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_le_first_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem operatorNorm_le_first_eigenvalue
    (S : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) (hS : S.IsPositive)
    (hE : 0 < finrank 𝕜 E) :
    operatorNorm S ≤ hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl ⟨0, hE⟩
proof:
:= by
  let i0 : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) := ⟨0, hE⟩
  let b := hS.isSymmetric.eigenvectorBasis rfl
  let μ := hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i0
  have hμ : 0 ≤ μ := hS.nonneg_eigenvalues rfl i0
  change ‖S.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ≤ μ
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hμ fun x => ?_
  rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hμ (norm_nonneg _))]
  change ‖S x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (μ * ‖x‖) ^ 2
  rw [← b.repr.norm_map (S x), ← b.repr.norm_map x, mul_pow,
    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hi0 : i0 ≤ i := by
    exact Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (Nat.zero_le _)
  have hμi : hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i ≤ μ :=
    hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues_antitone rfl hi0
  have hμi0 : 0 ≤ hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl i :=
    hS.nonneg_eigenvalues rfl i
  rw [hS.isSymmetric.eigenvectorBasis_apply_self_apply rfl x i,
    norm_mul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg hμi0]
  change (_ * ‖b.repr x i‖) ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 2 * ‖b.repr x i‖ ^ 2
  rw [mul_pow]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    ((sq_le_sq₀ hμi0 hμ).mpr hμi) (sq_nonneg ‖b.repr x i‖)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_positive_eq_first_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem operatorNorm_positive_eq_first_eigenvalue
    (S : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) (hS : S.IsPositive)
    (hE : 0 < finrank 𝕜 E) :
    operatorNorm S = hS.isSymmetric.eigenvalues rfl ⟨0, hE⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (operatorNorm_le_first_eigenvalue S hS hE)
    (first_eigenvalue_le_operatorNorm S hS hE)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_eq_first_singularValue_of_pos_finrank
statement:
theorem operatorNorm_eq_first_singularValue_of_pos_finrank (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (hE : 0 < finrank 𝕜 E) :
    operatorNorm T = T.singularValues 0
proof:
:= by
  have hself := operatorNorm_positive_eq_first_eigenvalue
    (T.adjoint.comp T) T.isPositive_adjoint_comp_self hE
  have hnormsq : operatorNorm (T.adjoint.comp T) = operatorNorm T * operatorNorm T := by
    letI := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 E
    letI := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 F
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_adjoint_comp_self T.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hσsq : T.singularValues 0 ^ 2 =
      T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvalues rfl ⟨0, hE⟩ :=
    T.sq_singularValues_of_lt rfl hE
  apply sq_eq_sq₀ (operatorNorm_nonneg T) (T.singularValues_nonneg 0) |>.mp
  rw [sq]
  exact hnormsq.symm.trans (hself.trans hσsq.symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorNorm_eq_first_singularValue
statement:
theorem operatorNorm_eq_first_singularValue (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    operatorNorm T = T.singularValues 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hE : 0 < finrank 𝕜 E
  · exact operatorNorm_eq_first_singularValue_of_pos_finrank T hE
  · have hzero : finrank 𝕜 E = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hE
    letI : Subsingleton E := Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp hzero
    have hT : T = 0 := by
      ext x
      have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst x
      simp
    subst T
    have hop : operatorNorm (0 : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) = 0 :=
      (operatorNorm_eq_zero_iff _).mpr rfl
    rw [hop, LinearMap.singularValues_zero]
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector
statement:
theorem map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range)) :
    T (rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i)) =
      (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) • leftSingularVector T i
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : T.singularValues i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt <|
    T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr i.isLt
  simp [leftSingularVector, smul_smul, hσ]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.orthonormal_leftSingularVector
statement:
theorem orthonormal_leftSingularVector (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    Orthonormal 𝕜 (leftSingularVector T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  let ii : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) := Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i
  let jj : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) := Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) j
  let v := rightSingularBasis T
  have heig := T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.apply_eigenvectorBasis rfl jj
  have heig' : T.adjoint (T (v jj)) =
      (T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvalues rfl jj : 𝕜) • v jj := by
    change T.adjoint (T
      (T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvectorBasis rfl jj)) = _ at heig
    change T.adjoint (T
      (T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvectorBasis rfl jj)) = _
    exact heig
  have hsq : T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvalues rfl jj =
      T.singularValues j ^ 2 := by
    rw [← T.sq_singularValues_fin rfl jj]
    rfl
  have hvinner : inner 𝕜 (v ii) (v jj) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    simpa [ii, jj] using (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp v.orthonormal ii jj)
  have hinner : inner 𝕜 (T (v ii)) (T (v jj)) =
      (T.singularValues j : 𝕜) ^ 2 * (if i = j then 1 else 0) := by
    calc
      _ = inner 𝕜 (v ii) (T.adjoint (T (v jj))) :=
        (T.adjoint_inner_right (v ii) (T (v jj))).symm
      _ = inner 𝕜 (v ii)
          ((T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvalues rfl jj : 𝕜) • v jj) := by
        rw [heig']
      _ = _ := by rw [inner_smul_right, hsq, hvinner]; norm_cast
  have hσi : T.singularValues i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt <|
    T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr i.isLt
  have hσj : T.singularValues j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt <|
    T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr j.isLt
  simp only [leftSingularVector, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
  rw [hinner]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [if_pos]
    have hσiK : (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hσi
    have hstar : (starRingEnd 𝕜) (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) =
        (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) := by simp
    rw [map_inv₀, hstar]
    field_simp
  · simp [hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_leftSingularBasis
statement:
theorem exists_leftSingularBasis (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F,
      ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := finrank 𝕜 T.range
  let m := finrank 𝕜 F
  let s : Set (Fin m) := {i | i.val < r}
  let w : Fin m → F := fun i => if h : i.val < r then
    leftSingularVector T ⟨i.val, h⟩ else 0
  have hw : Orthonormal 𝕜 (s.domRestrict w) := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro i j
    have hi : i.val.val < r := i.property
    have hj : j.val.val < r := j.property
    have horth := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (orthonormal_leftSingularVector T)
      (⟨i.val.val, hi⟩ : Fin r) (⟨j.val.val, hj⟩ : Fin r)
    simpa [Set.domRestrict, w, hi, hj, Fin.ext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff] using horth
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hw.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq (by simp [m])
  refine ⟨b, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hi : (rangeIndexEmbedding T i).val < r := i.isLt
  rw [hb (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) hi]
  change (if h : i.val < r then leftSingularVector T ⟨i.val, h⟩ else 0) = _
  rw [dif_pos i.isLt]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.map_rightSingularBasis_eq_zero_of_finrank_range_le
statement:
theorem map_rightSingularBasis_eq_zero_of_finrank_range_le
    (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E))
    (hi : finrank 𝕜 T.range ≤ i.val) :
    T (rightSingularBasis T i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : T.singularValues i = 0 :=
    T.singularValues_eq_zero_iff_le_finrank_range.mpr hi
  have heig := T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.apply_eigenvectorBasis rfl i
  have hsq := T.sq_singularValues_fin rfl i
  have hcomp : (T.adjoint ∘ₗ T) (rightSingularBasis T i) = 0 := by
    change (T.adjoint ∘ₗ T)
      (T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.eigenvectorBasis rfl i) = 0
    rw [heig, ← hsq, hσ]
    simp
  have hmem : rightSingularBasis T i ∈ (T.adjoint ∘ₗ T).ker :=
    LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hcomp
  rw [T.ker_adjoint_comp_self] at hmem
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_singularValueDecomposition
statement:
theorem exists_singularValueDecomposition (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    Nonempty (SingularValueDecomposition T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_leftSingularBasis T
  refine ⟨{
    rightBasis := rightSingularBasis T
    leftBasis := u
    map_right := fun i => ?_ }⟩
  split_ifs with hi
  · let k : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
    have hmap := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector T k
    rw [← hu k] at hmap
    exact hmap
  · exact map_rightSingularBasis_eq_zero_of_finrank_range_le T i (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.SingularValueDecomposition.toMatrix_eq_singularDiagonal
statement:
theorem SingularValueDecomposition.toMatrix_eq_singularDiagonal
    {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F} (d : SingularValueDecomposition T) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix d.rightBasis.toBasis d.leftBasis.toBasis T =
      singularDiagonal T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  by_cases hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · have hmap := d.map_right j
    rw [dif_pos hj] at hmap
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change (d.leftBasis.toBasis.repr (T (d.rightBasis j))) i = _
    rw [hmap]
    simp [singularDiagonal, hj, rangeIndexEmbedding, Fin.ext_iff, Algebra.smul_def]
  · have hmap := d.map_right j
    rw [dif_neg hj] at hmap
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change (d.leftBasis.toBasis.repr (T (d.rightBasis j))) i = _
    rw [hmap]
    simp [singularDiagonal, hj]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.SingularValueDecomposition.standardMatrix_eq_mul_singularDiagonal_mul_conjTranspose

theorem SingularValueDecomposition.standardMatrix_eq_mul_singularDiagonal_mul_conjTranspose

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.inner_gramSchmidtNormed_input
statement:
theorem inner_gramSchmidtNormed_input {n : ℕ}
    (f : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hf : LinearIndependent ℝ f) (i : Fin n) :
    inner ℝ (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i) (f i) =
      ‖InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f i‖
proof:
:= by
  let g := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f i
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hf
  have hinner : inner ℝ g (f i) = ‖g‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ f i, inner_add_right]
    rw [inner_sum]
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, add_eq_left]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_Iio] at hx
    rw [inner_smul_right]
    have horth : inner ℝ g (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f x) = 0 := by
      dsimp only [g]
      exact InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ f (ne_of_gt hx)
    rw [horth]
    simp
  rw [InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed, inner_smul_left, hinner]
  dsimp only [g] at hg ⊢
  rw [pow_two]
  exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hg) _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.qrR_diagonal_pos_of_det_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hf : LinearIndependent ℝ (qrColumns A) :=
    qrColumns_linearIndependent_of_det_ne_zero A hA
  have hg : InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ (qrColumns A) i ≠ 0 :=
    InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hf
  have hgn : InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (qrColumns A) i ≠ 0 := by
    simp [InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed, hg]
  rw [qrR, Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply]
  rw [(qrBasis A).coe_toBasis_repr_apply, (qrBasis A).repr_apply_apply]
  rw [qrBasis, InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis_apply
    finrank_euclideanSpace hgn]
  rw [inner_gramSchmidtNormed_input (qrColumns A) hf i]
  exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hg

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.qr_cross_orthogonal
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsOrthogonalMatrix
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q₁ Q₁ᵀ Q₂, orthogonal_mul_transpose hQ₁,
    Matrix.one_mul, hQ₂]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero
statement:
theorem mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero {n : ℕ}
    (S R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n)
    (hR : R.IsUpperTriangular) (hprev : ∀ k, k < j → S i k = 0) :
    (S * R) i j = S i j * R j j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
  · intro k _ hkj
    rcases lt_trichotomy k j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · rw [hprev k hlt, zero_mul]
    · exact (hkj heq).elim
    · have hz : R k j = 0 := by
        apply hR
        change j < k
        exact hgt
      rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.upper_left_factor_of_mul
statement:
theorem upper_left_factor_of_mul {n : ℕ}
    (S R₁ R₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hR₁ : R₁.IsUpperTriangular) (hR₂ : R₂.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hdR₂ : ∀ i, R₂ i i ≠ 0) (hmul : S * R₂ = R₁) :
    S.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  change j < i at hij
  revert hij
  apply wellFounded_lt.induction j
  intro j ih hij
  have hprev : ∀ k, k < j → S i k = 0 := by
    intro k hkj
    exact ih k hkj (hkj.trans hij)
  have heq : S i j * R₂ j j = 0 := by
    rw [← mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero S R₂ i j hR₂ hprev]
    rw [hmul]
    apply hR₁
    change j < i
    exact hij
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp heq).resolve_right (hdR₂ j)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.upper_left_factor_diagonal_pos
statement:
theorem upper_left_factor_diagonal_pos {n : ℕ}
    (S R₁ R₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hS : S.IsUpperTriangular) (hR₂ : R₂.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hdR₁ : ∀ i, 0 < R₁ i i) (hdR₂ : ∀ i, 0 < R₂ i i)
    (hmul : S * R₂ = R₁) : ∀ i, 0 < S i i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hprev : ∀ k, k < i → S i k = 0 := by
    intro k hki
    apply hS
    change k < i
    exact hki
  have heq : S i i * R₂ i i = R₁ i i := by
    rw [← mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero S R₂ i i hR₂ hprev, hmul]
  have hp : 0 < S i i * R₂ i i := heq.symm ▸ hdR₁ i
  rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hp with h | h
  · exact h.1
  · linarith [h.2, hdR₂ i]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.orthogonal_upper_pos_eq_one
statement:
theorem orthogonal_upper_pos_eq_one {n : ℕ} (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hSorth : IsOrthogonalMatrix S) (hSup : S.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hSpos : ∀ i, 0 < S i i) : S = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
    exact if_neg (by
      intro hji
      subst j
      exact lt_irrefl _ hij)
  have hSTup : Sᵀ.IsUpperTriangular :=
    upper_left_factor_of_mul Sᵀ 1 S hone hSup
      (fun i => ne_of_gt (hSpos i)) hSorth
  have hdiag : ∀ i, S i i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have hprev : ∀ k, k < i → Sᵀ i k = 0 := by
      intro k hki
      apply hSTup
      change k < i
      exact hki
    have heq := mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero Sᵀ S i i hSup hprev
    rw [hSorth] at heq
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply, if_pos, Matrix.transpose_apply] at heq
    nlinarith [hSpos i]
  ext i j
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | hij | hij
  · have hz : Sᵀ j i = 0 := by
      apply hSTup
      change i < j
      exact hij
    simpa [Matrix.one_apply, ne_of_lt hij] using hz
  · subst j
    simp [hdiag]
  · have hz : S i j = 0 := by
      apply hSup
      change j < i
      exact hij
    simpa [Matrix.one_apply, ne_of_gt hij] using hz

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.positive_qr_unique
proof:
:= by
  let S := fac₁.orthogonalᵀ * fac₂.orthogonal
  have hcross : S * fac₂.upper = fac₁.upper := by
    calc
      S * fac₂.upper = fac₁.orthogonalᵀ *
          (fac₂.orthogonal * fac₂.upper) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = fac₁.orthogonalᵀ * A := congrArg _ fac₂.eq_mul.symm
      _ = fac₁.orthogonalᵀ *
          (fac₁.orthogonal * fac₁.upper) := congrArg _ fac₁.eq_mul
      _ = (fac₁.orthogonalᵀ * fac₁.orthogonal) * fac₁.upper :=
        (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = fac₁.upper := by rw [fac₁.orthogonal_matrix, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hSorth : IsOrthogonalMatrix S :=
    qr_cross_orthogonal fac₁.orthogonal_matrix fac₂.orthogonal_matrix
  have hSup : S.IsUpperTriangular :=
    upper_left_factor_of_mul S fac₁.upper fac₂.upper
      fac₁.upper_triangular fac₂.upper_triangular
      (fun i => ne_of_gt (fac₂.upper_diagonal_pos i)) hcross
  have hSpos : ∀ i, 0 < S i i :=
    upper_left_factor_diagonal_pos S fac₁.upper fac₂.upper hSup
      fac₂.upper_triangular fac₁.upper_diagonal_pos fac₂.upper_diagonal_pos hcross
  have hSone : S = 1 := orthogonal_upper_pos_eq_one S hSorth hSup hSpos
  have hQ : fac₁.orthogonal = fac₂.orthogonal := by
    calc
      fac₁.orthogonal = fac₁.orthogonal * 1 := (Matrix.mul_one _).symm
      _ = fac₁.orthogonal * S := congrArg (fac₁.orthogonal * ·) hSone.symm
      _ = fac₂.orthogonal := by
        dsimp only [S]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
        have hleft : fac₁.orthogonal * fac₁.orthogonalᵀ = 1 :=
          orthogonal_mul_transpose fac₁.orthogonal_matrix
        rw [hleft, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨hQ, ?_⟩
  have hprod : fac₂.orthogonal * fac₁.upper =
      fac₂.orthogonal * fac₂.upper := by
    calc
      _ = fac₁.orthogonal * fac₁.upper := congrArg (· * fac₁.upper) hQ.symm
      _ = A := fac₁.eq_mul.symm
      _ = fac₂.orthogonal * fac₂.upper := fac₂.eq_mul
  have hcancel := congrArg (fun M => fac₂.orthogonalᵀ * M) hprod
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, fac₂.orthogonal_matrix, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, fac₂.orthogonal_matrix, Matrix.one_mul] at hcancel
  exact hcancel

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.inner_thin_gramSchmidtNormed_input
statement:
theorem inner_thin_gramSchmidtNormed_input {m n : ℕ}
    (f : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hf : LinearIndependent ℝ f) (i : Fin n) :
    inner ℝ (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i) (f i) =
      ‖InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f i‖
proof:
:= by
  let g := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f i
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hf
  have hinner : inner ℝ g (f i) = ‖g‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ f i, inner_add_right]
    rw [inner_sum]
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, add_eq_left]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_Iio] at hx
    rw [inner_smul_right]
    have horth : inner ℝ g (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ f x) = 0 := by
      dsimp only [g]
      exact InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ f (ne_of_gt hx)
    rw [horth]
    simp
  rw [InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed, inner_smul_left, hinner]
  dsimp only [g] at hg ⊢
  rw [pow_two]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.thinQ_orthonormal
statement:
theorem thinQ_orthonormal {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (thinQRColumns A)) :
    (thinQ A)ᵀ * thinQ A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Orthonormal ℝ (thinQRVectors A) :=
    InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hA
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  change (∑ k, thinQRVectors A i k * thinQRVectors A j k) = _
  rw [show (∑ k, thinQRVectors A i k * thinQRVectors A j k) =
      inner ℝ (thinQRVectors A i) (thinQRVectors A j) by
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]]
  simpa [Matrix.one_apply] using (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hq i j)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.thinR_upper_and_pos
statement:
theorem thinR_upper_and_pos {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (thinQRColumns A)) :
    (thinR A).IsUpperTriangular ∧ ∀ i, 0 < thinR A i i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    change j < i at hij
    rw [thinR, thinQRVectors, InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed,
      inner_smul_left]
    rw [InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_inv_triangular ℝ (thinQRColumns A) hij]
    simp
  · intro i
    rw [thinR, thinQRVectors]
    rw [inner_thin_gramSchmidtNormed_input (thinQRColumns A) hA i]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hA)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.gramSchmidtNormed_reconstruction
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_reconstruction {m n : ℕ}
    (f : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hf : LinearIndependent ℝ f) (j : Fin n) :
    ∑ i, inner ℝ (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i) (f j) •
      InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i = f j
proof:
:= by
  let q := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f
  have hq : Orthonormal ℝ q :=
    InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hf
  have hmem : f j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range q) := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [InnerProductSpace.span_gramSchmidtNormed_range,
      InnerProductSpace.span_gramSchmidt]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
  have hci : ∀ i, c i = inner ℝ (q i) (f j) := by
    intro i
    calc
      c i = inner ℝ (q i) (∑ k, c k • q k) :=
        (hq.inner_right_fintype c i).symm
      _ = inner ℝ (q i) (f j) := congrArg (inner ℝ (q i)) hc
  calc
    ∑ i, inner ℝ (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i) (f j) •
        InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ f i =
        ∑ i, c i • q i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [hci]
    _ = f j := hc

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.thinQR_mul
statement:
theorem thinQR_mul {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (thinQRColumns A)) :
    thinQ A * thinR A = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) => x i)
    (gramSchmidtNormed_reconstruction (thinQRColumns A) hA j)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, thinQ, thinR, thinQRVectors, thinQRColumns,
    mul_comm] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_thin_qr
statement:
theorem exists_thin_qr {m n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : LinearIndependent ℝ (thinQRColumns A)) :
    Nonempty (ThinQRFactorization A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hup, hpos⟩ := thinR_upper_and_pos A hA
  exact ⟨{
    orthogonalColumns := thinQ A
    upper := thinR A
    columns_orthonormal := thinQ_orthonormal A hA
    upper_triangular := hup
    upper_diagonal_pos := hpos
    eq_mul := (thinQR_mul A hA).symm }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.linearMap_range_lifts_kernel_isBasis
statement:
private theorem linearMap_range_lifts_kernel_isBasis
    (D : A →ₗ[K] B) (b : I → LinearMap.range D) (c : I → A)
    (k : J → LinearMap.ker D)
    (hb : LinearIndependent K b ∧ Submodule.span K (Set.range b) = ⊤)
    (hk : LinearIndependent K k ∧ Submodule.span K (Set.range k) = ⊤)
    (hc : ∀ i, D (c i) = b i) :
    LinearIndependent K (Sum.elim c (fun j => (k j : A))) ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (Sum.elim c (fun j => (k j : A)))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let family : I ⊕ J → A := Sum.elim c (fun j => (k j : A))
  have hli : LinearIndependent K family := by
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro a ha
    have hDa := congrArg D ha
    have hbrel : ∑ i : I, a (Sum.inl i) • b i = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [family, Fintype.sum_sum_type, map_sum, map_smul, hc] using hDa
    have hi : ∀ i : I, a (Sum.inl i) = 0 :=
      (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hb.1) _ hbrel
    have hkrel : ∑ j : J, a (Sum.inr j) • k j = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [family, Fintype.sum_sum_type, hi] using ha
    have hj : ∀ j : J, a (Sum.inr j) = 0 :=
      (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hk.1) _ hkrel
    intro p
    cases p with
    | inl i => exact hi i
    | inr j => exact hj j
  refine ⟨hli, ?_⟩
  let bBasis : Module.Basis I K (LinearMap.range D) :=
    Module.Basis.mk hb.1 hb.2.ge
  let kBasis : Module.Basis J K (LinearMap.ker D) :=
    Module.Basis.mk hk.1 hk.2.ge
  have hI : Fintype.card I = Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range D) := by
    simpa using (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis bBasis).symm
  have hJ : Fintype.card J = Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker D) := by
    simpa using (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis kBasis).symm
  have hrank := D.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hcard : Fintype.card (I ⊕ J) = Module.finrank K A := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, hI, hJ, hrank]
  exact hli.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' hcard

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.basis_sumExtend_apply_inl
statement:
private theorem basis_sumExtend_apply_inl {W ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    {v : ι → W} (hs : LinearIndependent K v) (i : ι) :
    Module.Basis.sumExtend hs (Sum.inl i) = v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold Module.Basis.sumExtend Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex
  rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply]
  change Module.Basis.extend hs.linearIndepOn_id
    (((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.ofInjective v hs.injective) (Equiv.refl _)).trans
      (Equiv.Set.sumDiffSubset (hs.linearIndepOn_id.subset_extend _))) (Sum.inl i)) = v i
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCongr_apply]
  exact Module.Basis.extend_apply_self hs.linearIndepOn_id _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.invariantRestriction_coe_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
      change N (((invariantRestriction N S hS) ^ n) x) = N ((N ^ n) x)
      rw [ih]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.image_invariant
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨⟨N x, hS x x.property⟩, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.image_restriction_nilpotent
statement:
private theorem image_restriction_nilpotent (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (S : Submodule K V)
    (hS : IsInvariantSubspace N S)
    (hNil : IsNilpotent (invariantRestriction N S hS)) :
    IsNilpotent
      (invariantRestriction N (LinearMap.range (N.domRestrict S)) (image_invariant N S hS))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hNil
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  ext x
  have hxS : (x : V) ∈ S := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := x.property
    rw [← hy]
    exact hS y y.property
  have hz := congrArg
    (fun F : S →ₗ[K] S => F ⟨(x : V), hxS⟩) hn
  rw [invariantRestriction_coe_pow]
  simpa [invariantRestriction_coe_pow] using congrArg Subtype.val hz

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.image_finrank_lt_of_nilpotent
statement:
private theorem image_finrank_lt_of_nilpotent [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (S : Submodule K V) (hS : IsInvariantSubspace N S)
    (hNontrivial : Nontrivial S)
    (hNil : IsNilpotent (invariantRestriction N S hS)) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (N.domRestrict S)) < Module.finrank K S
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nontrivial S := hNontrivial
  letI : LinearSpace K S := ⟨inferInstance⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hNx⟩ :=
    nilpotent_exists_nonzero_kernel_vector (invariantRestriction N S hS) hNil
  have hxker : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S) := by
    change N x = 0
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hNx
  haveI : Nontrivial (LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S)) := by
    refine ⟨⟨⟨x, hxker⟩, 0, ?_⟩⟩
    intro h
    apply hx
    exact congrArg (fun y : LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S) => (y : S)) h
  have hker : 0 < Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S)) :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance
  have hrank := (N.domRestrict S).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBasisFamilyForSubspace_mem
statement:
private theorem jordanBasisFamilyForSubspace_mem
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (S : Submodule K V) {r : ℕ} {length : Fin r → ℕ}
    (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V)
    (hb : IsJordanBasisFamilyForSubspace N S r length b)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (length i + 1)) : b i j ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : b i j ∈ Submodule.span K
      (Set.range fun p : Σ i : Fin r, Fin (length i + 1) => b p.1 p.2) := by
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hb.2.1] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.jordanBasisFamily_chainFirsts_kernel_linearIndependent
statement:
private theorem jordanBasisFamily_chainFirsts_kernel_linearIndependent
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (S : Submodule K V) {r : ℕ} {length : Fin r → ℕ}
    (hInv : IsInvariantSubspace N S)
    (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V)
    (hb : IsJordanBasisFamilyForSubspace N (LinearMap.range (N.domRestrict S)) r length b) :
    ∃ f : Fin r → LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S),
      (∀ i, ((f i : S) : V) = b i 0) ∧ LinearIndependent K f
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin r → LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S) := fun i =>
    ⟨⟨b i 0, by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := jordanBasisFamilyForSubspace_mem N _ b hb i 0
        rw [← hx]
        exact hInv x x.property⟩,
      by
        change N (b i 0) = 0
        simpa using (hb.2.2 i).2.1⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin r =>
      (⟨i, (0 : Fin (length i + 1))⟩ : Σ i, Fin (length i + 1))) := by
    intro i j h
    exact congrArg Sigma.fst h
  have hliV : LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin r => b i 0) :=
    hb.1.comp _ hinj
  have hliF : LinearIndependent K f := by
    apply LinearIndependent.of_comp
      (S.subtype.comp (LinearMap.ker (N.domRestrict S)).subtype)
    simpa [Function.comp_def, f] using hliV
  exact ⟨f, fun i => rfl, hliF⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.invariantSubspace_decomposition_step_framework
statement:
private theorem invariantSubspace_decomposition_step_framework
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (S : Submodule K V)
    (hInv : IsInvariantSubspace N S) (hNontrivial : Nontrivial S)
    (ih : ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V),
      IsJordanBasisFamilyForSubspace N (LinearMap.range (N.domRestrict S)) r length b) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V),
      IsJordanBasisFamilyForSubspace N S r length b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, length, b, hb⟩ := ih
  obtain ⟨first, hfirst, hfirstLI⟩ :=
    jordanBasisFamily_chainFirsts_kernel_linearIndependent N S hInv b hb
  let kernelBasis := Module.Basis.sumExtend hfirstLI
  let extra := Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hfirstLI
  letI : Finite (Fin r ⊕ extra) := kernelBasis.linearIndependent.finite
  letI : Finite extra := Finite.of_injective
    (fun x : extra => (Sum.inr x : Fin r ⊕ extra)) Sum.inr_injective
  letI : Fintype extra := Fintype.ofFinite extra
  have hkernelFirst (i : Fin r) : kernelBasis (Sum.inl i) = first i := by
    exact basis_sumExtend_apply_inl hfirstLI i
  let P := Σ i : Fin r, Fin (length i + 1)
  let D : S →ₗ[K] V := N.domRestrict S
  let rangeVec : P → LinearMap.range D := fun p =>
    ⟨b p.1 p.2, jordanBasisFamilyForSubspace_mem N _ b hb p.1 p.2⟩
  have hRangeLI : LinearIndependent K rangeVec := by
    apply LinearIndependent.of_comp (LinearMap.range D).subtype
    simpa [Function.comp_def, rangeVec, P, D] using hb.1
  have hRangeCard : Fintype.card P = Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range D) := by
    have hspanCard := finrank_span_eq_card hb.1
    rw [hb.2.1] at hspanCard
    simpa [P, D] using hspanCard.symm
  have hRangeBasis :
      LinearIndependent K rangeVec ∧ Submodule.span K (Set.range rangeVec) = ⊤ := by
    exact ⟨hRangeLI, hRangeLI.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' hRangeCard⟩
  have hbS (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (length i + 1)) : b i j ∈ S := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := jordanBasisFamilyForSubspace_mem N _ b hb i j
    rw [← hx]
    exact hInv x x.property
  let topLift (i : Fin r) : S :=
    Classical.choose (rangeVec ⟨i, Fin.last (length i)⟩).property
  have htopLift (i : Fin r) :
      D (topLift i) = rangeVec ⟨i, Fin.last (length i)⟩ :=
    Classical.choose_spec (rangeVec ⟨i, Fin.last (length i)⟩).property
  let liftVec : P → S := fun p =>
    Fin.lastCases (topLift p.1)
      (fun j : Fin (length p.1) => ⟨b p.1 j.succ, hbS p.1 j.succ⟩) p.2
  have hLift (p : P) : D (liftVec p) = rangeVec p := by
    rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun q => ?_) j
    · simpa [liftVec] using htopLift i
    · have hchain := (hb.2.2 i).2.2 q
      simp only [liftVec, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
      change N (b i q.succ) = b i q.castSucc
      simpa using hchain
  have hKernelBasis :
      LinearIndependent K kernelBasis ∧
        Submodule.span K (Set.range kernelBasis) = ⊤ := by
    exact ⟨kernelBasis.linearIndependent, kernelBasis.span_eq⟩
  have hDomainBasis := linearMap_range_lifts_kernel_isBasis
    D rangeVec liftVec kernelBasis hRangeBasis hKernelBasis hLift
  let extendedChain (i : Fin r) : Fin (length i + 2) → V :=
    Fin.cases ((first i : LinearMap.ker D) : S)
      (fun j : Fin (length i + 1) => (liftVec ⟨i, j⟩ : S))
  have hExtendedChain (i : Fin r) : IsJordanChain N 0 (extendedChain i) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (((first i : LinearMap.ker D) : S) : V) ≠ 0
      intro hz
      have hzS : ((first i : LinearMap.ker D) : S) = 0 := Subtype.ext hz
      have hzK : first i = 0 := Subtype.ext hzS
      exact (LinearIndependent.ne_zero i hfirstLI) hzK
    · simp only [extendedChain, Fin.cases_zero, zero_smul]
      change N ((((first i : LinearMap.ker D) : S) : V)) = 0
      exact (first i).property
    · intro j
      change N ((liftVec ⟨i, j⟩ : S) : V) =
        0 • ((liftVec ⟨i, j⟩ : S) : V) + extendedChain i j.castSucc
      rw [zero_smul, zero_add]
      have hmap : N ((liftVec ⟨i, j⟩ : S) : V) = b i j := by
        simpa [D, rangeVec] using hLift ⟨i, j⟩
      rw [hmap]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun q => ?_) j
      · simpa [extendedChain] using (hfirst i).symm
      · have hidx : (Fin.succ q).castSucc = q.castSucc.succ := Fin.ext rfl
        rw [hidx]
        simp only [extendedChain, Fin.cases_succ]
        simp [liftVec]
  let extraChain (e : extra) : Fin 1 → V := fun _ =>
    ((((kernelBasis (Sum.inr e) : LinearMap.ker D) : S)) : V)
  have hExtraChain (e : extra) : IsJordanChain N 0 (extraChain e) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (((kernelBasis (Sum.inr e) : LinearMap.ker D) : S) : V) ≠ 0
      intro hz
      have hzS : ((kernelBasis (Sum.inr e) : LinearMap.ker D) : S) = 0 :=
        Subtype.ext hz
      have hzK : (kernelBasis (Sum.inr e) : LinearMap.ker D) = 0 :=
        Subtype.ext hzS
      exact (LinearIndependent.ne_zero (Sum.inr e) kernelBasis.linearIndependent) hzK
    · simp only [extraChain, zero_smul]
      change N (((kernelBasis (Sum.inr e) : LinearMap.ker D) : S) : V) = 0
      exact (kernelBasis (Sum.inr e)).property
    · intro j
      exact Fin.elim0 j
  let Q := Fin r ⊕ extra
  let rawLength : Q → ℕ := Sum.elim (fun i => length i + 1) (fun _ => 0)
  let rawChain : (q : Q) → Fin (rawLength q + 1) → V := fun q =>
    match q with
    | Sum.inl i => extendedChain i
    | Sum.inr e => extraChain e
  have hRawChain (q : Q) : IsJordanChain N 0 (rawChain q) := by
    cases q with
    | inl i => simpa [rawChain, rawLength, Q] using hExtendedChain i
    | inr e => simpa [rawChain, rawLength, Q] using hExtraChain e
  let chainEquiv : Q ≃ Fin (Fintype.card Q) := Fintype.equivFin Q
  let finalLength : Fin (Fintype.card Q) → ℕ := fun i => rawLength (chainEquiv.symm i)
  let finalChain : (i : Fin (Fintype.card Q)) → Fin (finalLength i + 1) → V :=
    fun i => rawChain (chainEquiv.symm i)
  have hFinalChain (i : Fin (Fintype.card Q)) :
      IsJordanChain N 0 (finalChain i) := hRawChain (chainEquiv.symm i)
  let rawIndex := Σ q : Q, Fin (rawLength q + 1)
  let domainIndex := P ⊕ (Fin r ⊕ extra)
  let rawToDomain : rawIndex → domainIndex := fun x =>
    match x with
    | ⟨Sum.inl i, j⟩ =>
        Fin.cases (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))
          (fun k => Sum.inl ⟨i, k⟩) j
    | ⟨Sum.inr e, _⟩ => Sum.inr (Sum.inr e)
  let domainToRaw : domainIndex → rawIndex := fun x =>
    match x with
    | Sum.inl ⟨i, j⟩ => ⟨Sum.inl i, j.succ⟩
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => ⟨Sum.inl i, 0⟩
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr e) => ⟨Sum.inr e, 0⟩
  have hRawLeft : Function.LeftInverse domainToRaw rawToDomain := by
    rintro ⟨q, j⟩
    cases q with
    | inl i =>
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
        · rfl
        · rfl
    | inr e =>
        change Fin 1 at j
        have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
        subst j
        rfl
  have hRawRight : Function.RightInverse domainToRaw rawToDomain := by
    intro x
    cases x with
    | inl p => rfl
    | inr q =>
        cases q <;> rfl
  let rawEquivDomain : rawIndex ≃ domainIndex :=
    ⟨rawToDomain, domainToRaw, hRawLeft, hRawRight⟩
  let finalIndex := Σ i : Fin (Fintype.card Q), Fin (finalLength i + 1)
  let finalEquivRaw : finalIndex ≃ rawIndex :=
    Equiv.sigmaCongr chainEquiv.symm (fun _ => Equiv.refl _)
  let finalEquivDomain : finalIndex ≃ domainIndex :=
    finalEquivRaw.trans rawEquivDomain
  let domainFamily : domainIndex → V := fun x =>
    ((Sum.elim liftVec (fun j => (kernelBasis j : S)) x : S) : V)
  have hRawReindex (x : rawIndex) :
      rawChain x.1 x.2 = domainFamily (rawEquivDomain x) := by
    rcases x with ⟨q, j⟩
    cases q with
    | inl i =>
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
        · change (((first i : LinearMap.ker D) : S) : V) =
            (((kernelBasis (Sum.inl i) : LinearMap.ker D) : S) : V)
          rw [hkernelFirst]
        · rfl
    | inr e =>
        change Fin 1 at j
        have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
        subst j
        rfl
  have hFinalReindex (x : finalIndex) :
      finalChain x.1 x.2 = domainFamily (finalEquivDomain x) := by
    rcases x with ⟨i, j⟩
    exact hRawReindex ⟨chainEquiv.symm i, j⟩
  have hDomainLI : LinearIndependent K domainFamily := by
    have hli := hDomainBasis.1.map' S.subtype S.ker_subtype
    simpa [domainFamily, Function.comp_def] using hli
  have hFinalLI : LinearIndependent K
      (fun x : finalIndex => finalChain x.1 x.2) := by
    have hli := hDomainLI.comp finalEquivDomain finalEquivDomain.injective
    simpa [Function.comp_def, hFinalReindex] using hli
  have hDomainSpanLe :
      Submodule.span K (Set.range domainFamily) ≤ S := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro x ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact (Sum.elim liftVec (fun j => (kernelBasis j : S)) p).property
  have hDomainCard : Fintype.card domainIndex = Module.finrank K S := by
    have hcard := finrank_span_eq_card hDomainBasis.1
    rw [hDomainBasis.2] at hcard
    simpa [domainIndex] using hcard.symm
  have hDomainSpan : Submodule.span K (Set.range domainFamily) = S := by
    apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hDomainSpanLe
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hDomainLI, hDomainCard]
  have hRangeEq :
      Set.range (fun x : finalIndex => finalChain x.1 x.2) =
        Set.range domainFamily := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨finalEquivDomain p, (hFinalReindex p).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨finalEquivDomain.symm p, ?_⟩
      change finalChain _ _ = domainFamily p
      rw [hFinalReindex]
      simp
  refine ⟨Fintype.card Q, finalLength, finalChain, hFinalLI, ?_, hFinalChain⟩
  rw [hRangeEq, hDomainSpan]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_invariantSubspace_decomposition_framework
statement:
private theorem nilpotent_invariantSubspace_decomposition_framework
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (S : Submodule K V)
    (hInv : IsInvariantSubspace N S)
    (hNil : IsNilpotent (invariantRestriction N S hInv)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V),
      IsJordanBasisFamilyForSubspace N S r length b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hSnon : Nontrivial S
  · let Snext : Submodule K V := LinearMap.range (N.domRestrict S)
    have hNextInv : IsInvariantSubspace N Snext := image_invariant N S hInv
    have hNextNil : IsNilpotent (invariantRestriction N Snext hNextInv) :=
      image_restriction_nilpotent N S hInv hNil
    have hNextDim : Module.finrank K Snext < Module.finrank K S :=
      image_finrank_lt_of_nilpotent N S hInv hSnon hNil
    have ihNext := nilpotent_invariantSubspace_decomposition_framework
      N Snext hNextInv hNextNil
    exact invariantSubspace_decomposition_step_framework N S hInv hSnon ihNext
  · have hSub : Subsingleton S := not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hSnon
    have hSbot : S = ⊥ := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · intro x _hx
        have hx0 : (⟨x, _hx⟩ : S) = 0 := hSub.elim _ _
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hx0
      · exact bot_le
    refine ⟨0, Fin.elim0, fun i => Fin.elim0 i, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · simp [hSbot]
    · intro i
      exact Fin.elim0 i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Jordan.nilpotent_exists_jordanBasisFamily
statement:
theorem nilpotent_exists_jordanBasisFamily
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (N : V →ₗ[K] V) (hN : IsNilpotent N) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (length : Fin r → ℕ)
      (b : (i : Fin r) → Fin (length i + 1) → V),
      IsJordanBasisFamily N r (fun _ => 0) length b
proof:
:= by
  have hTopInv : IsInvariantSubspace N (⊤ : Submodule K V) := by
    intro x _hx
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  have hTopNil : IsNilpotent (invariantRestriction N ⊤ hTopInv) := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hN
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    ext x
    rw [invariantRestriction_coe_pow, hn]
    simp
  obtain ⟨r, length, b, hb⟩ :=
    nilpotent_invariantSubspace_decomposition_framework N ⊤ hTopInv hTopNil
  refine ⟨r, length, b, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨hb.1, ?_⟩, hb.2.2⟩
  simpa using hb.2.1

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.NormalMatrix.commuting_hermitian_joint_orthonormalBasis
statement:
private theorem commuting_hermitian_joint_orthonormalBasis
    {H K : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hH : IsHermitianMatrix H) (hK : IsHermitianMatrix K)
    (hcomm : H * K = K * H) :
    ∃ (b : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) (a c : n → ℂ),
      (∀ j, H *ᵥ ⇑(b j) = a j • ⇑(b j)) ∧
      (∀ j, K *ᵥ ⇑(b j) = c j • ⇑(b j))
proof:
:= by
  let T := Matrix.toEuclideanLin H
  let S := Matrix.toEuclideanLin K
  have hTs : T.IsSymmetric :=
    Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hH
  have hSs : S.IsSymmetric :=
    Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hK
  have hTS : Commute T S := by
    rw [commute_iff_eq]
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
    dsimp only [T, S]
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    simp only [Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin]
    calc
      (H *ᵥ (K *ᵥ x.ofLp)) i = ((H * K) *ᵥ x.ofLp) i :=
        congrFun (Matrix.mulVec_mulVec x.ofLp H K) i
      _ = ((K * H) *ᵥ x.ofLp) i := by rw [hcomm]
      _ = (K *ᵥ (H *ᵥ x.ofLp)) i :=
        congrFun (Matrix.mulVec_mulVec x.ofLp K H).symm i
  let sT : Finset ℂ := Finset.univ.image
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (hTs.eigenvalues finrank_euclideanSpace i : ℂ))
  let sS : Finset ℂ := Finset.univ.image
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card n) => (hSs.eigenvalues finrank_euclideanSpace i : ℂ))
  let V : (↥sS × ↥sT) → Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := fun z =>
    Module.End.eigenspace T z.2.1 ⊓ Module.End.eigenspace S z.1.1
  let f : (↥sS × ↥sT) → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (z.1.1, z.2.1)
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · exact congrArg Prod.fst hxy
    · exact congrArg Prod.snd hxy
  have hAll := hTs.directSum_isInternal_of_commute hSs hTS
  have hAllOrth := hTs.orthogonalFamily_eigenspace_inf_eigenspace hSs
  have hInd : iSupIndep V := by
    change iSupIndep ((fun i : ℂ × ℂ =>
      Module.End.eigenspace T i.2 ⊓ Module.End.eigenspace S i.1) ∘ f)
    exact hAll.submodule_iSupIndep.comp hf
  have hTop : ⨆ z, V z = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hAll.submodule_iSup_eq_top]
    refine iSup_le fun z => ?_
    let W := Module.End.eigenspace T z.2 ⊓ Module.End.eigenspace S z.1
    by_cases hW : W = ⊥
    · simpa only [W, hW] using (bot_le : (⊥ : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n)) ≤ ⨆ z, V z)
    · have hTne : Module.End.eigenspace T z.2 ≠ ⊥ := by
        intro h
        apply hW
        simp [W, h]
      have hSne : Module.End.eigenspace S z.1 ≠ ⊥ := by
        intro h
        apply hW
        simp [W, h]
      obtain ⟨iT, hiT⟩ := hTs.exists_eigenvalues_eq finrank_euclideanSpace
        (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff.mpr hTne)
      obtain ⟨iS, hiS⟩ := hSs.exists_eigenvalues_eq finrank_euclideanSpace
        (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff.mpr hSne)
      have hzT : z.2 ∈ sT := by
        rw [← hiT]
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨iT, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
      have hzS : z.1 ∈ sS := by
        rw [← hiS]
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨iS, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
      let z' : ↥sS × ↥sT := (⟨z.1, hzS⟩, ⟨z.2, hzT⟩)
      exact le_iSup V z'
  have hInt : DirectSum.IsInternal V :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top hInd hTop
  have hOrth : OrthogonalFamily ℂ (fun z => V z) (fun z => (V z).subtypeₗᵢ) := by
    simpa only [V, f] using hAllOrth.comp hf
  let ecard : Fin (Fintype.card n) ≃ n :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _)
  let e₀ := hInt.subordinateOrthonormalBasis finrank_euclideanSpace hOrth
  let e : OrthonormalBasis n ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := e₀.reindex ecard
  let χ : n → ↥sS × ↥sT := fun j =>
    hInt.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex finrank_euclideanSpace (ecard.symm j) hOrth
  refine ⟨e, fun j => (χ j).2.1, fun j => (χ j).1.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hj := hInt.subordinateOrthonormalBasis_subordinate
      finrank_euclideanSpace (ecard.symm j) hOrth
    have heq := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hj.1
    have heq' := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n => x.ofLp) heq
    dsimp only [e, χ]
    rw [OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply]
    have he₀ : e₀ = hInt.subordinateOrthonormalBasis finrank_euclideanSpace hOrth := rfl
    rw [he₀]
    simpa only [T, Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      WithLp.ofLp_smul] using heq'
  · intro j
    have hj := hInt.subordinateOrthonormalBasis_subordinate
      finrank_euclideanSpace (ecard.symm j) hOrth
    have heq := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hj.2
    have heq' := congrArg (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n => x.ofLp) heq
    dsimp only [e, χ]
    rw [OrthonormalBasis.reindex_apply]
    have he₀ : e₀ = hInt.subordinateOrthonormalBasis finrank_euclideanSpace hOrth := rfl
    rw [he₀]
    simpa only [S, Matrix.ofLp_toLpLin, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      WithLp.ofLp_smul] using heq'

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.NormalMatrix.commuting_hermitian_simultaneously_diagonalizable
statement:
private theorem commuting_hermitian_simultaneously_diagonalizable
    {H K : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hH : IsHermitianMatrix H) (hK : IsHermitianMatrix K)
    (hcomm : H * K = K * H) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (a b : n → ℂ),
      IsUnitaryMatrix U ∧
      H = U * Matrix.diagonal a * Uᴴ ∧
      K = U * Matrix.diagonal b * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, a, b, hHe, hKe⟩ :=
    commuting_hermitian_joint_orthonormalBasis hH hK hcomm
  let U : Matrix n n ℂ :=
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toBasis.toMatrix e.toBasis
  have hUmem : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ :=
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n ℂ).toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary e
  have hU : IsUnitaryMatrix U := by
    exact hUmem.1
  have hU_apply (i j : n) : U i j = ⇑(e j) i := rfl
  have hHU : H * U = U * Matrix.diagonal a := by
    ext i j
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hU_apply, Matrix.diagonal, mul_comm] using
      congrFun (hHe j) i
  have hKU : K * U = U * Matrix.diagonal b := by
    ext i j
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hU_apply, Matrix.diagonal, mul_comm] using
      congrFun (hKe j) i
  have hUright : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    change U * star U = 1
    exact hUmem.2
  refine ⟨U, a, b, hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      H = H * 1 := by simp
      _ = H * (U * Uᴴ) := by rw [hUright]
      _ = (H * U) * Uᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * Matrix.diagonal a * Uᴴ := by rw [hHU]
  · calc
      K = K * 1 := by simp
      _ = K * (U * Uᴴ) := by rw [hUright]
      _ = (K * U) * Uᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = U * Matrix.diagonal b * Uᴴ := by rw [hKU]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.NormalMatrix.negI_smul_skewHermitian_isHermitian
statement:
private theorem negI_smul_skewHermitian_isHermitian
    {K : Matrix n n ℂ} (hK : IsSkewHermitianMatrix K) :
    IsHermitianMatrix ((-Complex.I) • K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHermitianMatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, hK]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.NormalMatrix.normal_unitary_diagonalization
statement:
theorem normal_unitary_diagonalization {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsNormalMatrix A) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (eig : n → ℂ),
      IsUnitaryMatrix U ∧
        A = U * Matrix.diagonal eig * Uᴴ
proof:
:= by
  let H := hermitianPart A
  let K := skewHermitianPart A
  have hH : IsHermitianMatrix H := hermitianPart_isHermitian A
  have hK : IsSkewHermitianMatrix K := skewHermitianPart_isSkewHermitian A
  have hKi : IsHermitianMatrix ((-Complex.I) • K) :=
    negI_smul_skewHermitian_isHermitian hK
  have hcomm : H * ((-Complex.I) • K) = ((-Complex.I) • K) * H := by
    have hbase : (A + Aᴴ) * (A - Aᴴ) = (A - Aᴴ) * (A + Aᴴ) := by
      rw [IsNormalMatrix] at hA
      noncomm_ring [hA]
    dsimp [H, K, hermitianPart, skewHermitianPart]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul]
    rw [hbase]
    module
  obtain ⟨U, a, b, hU, hHd, hKd⟩ :=
    commuting_hermitian_simultaneously_diagonalizable hH hKi hcomm
  refine ⟨U, fun i => a i + Complex.I * b i, hU, ?_⟩
  rw [← hermitian_add_skewHermitian A]
  change H + K = _
  rw [hHd]
  have hK_from : K = Complex.I • ((-Complex.I) • K) := by
    simp [smul_smul]
  rw [hK_from, hKd]
  calc
    _ = (U * Matrix.diagonal a) * Uᴴ +
        (U * (Complex.I • Matrix.diagonal b)) * Uᴴ := by
          congr 1
          rw [← Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul]
    _ = U * (Matrix.diagonal a + Complex.I • Matrix.diagonal b) * Uᴴ := by
          noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by
      congr 2
      ext i j
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal, hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SpectralQuadratic.spectral_theorem
statement:
theorem spectral_theorem {n : ℕ} [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (hn : dim ℝ E = n) (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
    (hT : IsSelfAdjointOperator T) :
    ∃ (b : Fin n → E) (μ : Fin n → ℝ),
      IsBasis ℝ b ∧ Orthonormal ℝ b ∧
        ∀ i, T (b i) = μ i • b i
proof:
:= by
  have hTs : T.IsSymmetric := hT
  let B := hTs.eigenvectorBasis hn
  refine ⟨B, hTs.eigenvalues hn, ?_, B.orthonormal, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨B.toBasis.linearIndependent, B.toBasis.span_eq⟩
  · intro i
    exact hTs.apply_eigenvectorBasis hn i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SpectralQuadratic.operatorQuadraticForm_diagonal
statement:
theorem operatorQuadraticForm_diagonal {n : ℕ} (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
    (b : Fin n → E) (μ c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b) (hTb : ∀ i, T (b i) = μ i • b i) :
    operatorQuadraticForm T (∑ i, c i • b i) =
      ∑ i, μ i * (c i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : T (∑ i, c i • b i) = ∑ i, (c i * μ i) • b i := by
    simp_rw [map_sum, map_smul, hTb, smul_smul]
  rw [operatorQuadraticForm, hmap]
  rw [show (∑ i, (c i * μ i) • b i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, (c i * μ i) • b i by simp]
  rw [show (∑ i, c i • b i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, c i • b i by simp]
  rw [hb.inner_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SpectralQuadratic.inertia_normal_form
statement:

    ∃ w : Fin (dim ℝ V) → ℝ,
      (∀ i, w i = -1 ∨ w i = 0 ∨ w i = 1) ∧ IsDiagonalForm Q w
proof:
:= by

    Q.equivalent_one_zero_neg_one_weighted_sum_squared

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SpectralQuadratic.inertia_indices_unique
statement:
theorem inertia_indices_unique (Q : QuadraticForm ℝ V)
    (w : Fin (dim ℝ V) → ℝ) (hw : IsDiagonalForm Q w) :
    positiveIndex Q = Set.ncard {i | 0 < w i} ∧
      negativeIndex Q = Set.ncard {i | w i < 0}
proof:
:= by
  change sigPos Q = Set.ncard {i | 0 < w i} ∧
    sigNeg Q = Set.ncard {i | w i < 0}
  exact ⟨QuadraticForm.sigPos_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares hw,
    QuadraticForm.sigNeg_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares hw⟩

statement:
lemma dim_eq_card_basis {𝕜 : Type*} {V : Type*} [Field 𝕜]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pivotPermutation_isUnit_det
