name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.absoluteValue_apply_rightBasis
statement:
theorem absoluteValue_apply_rightBasis (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E)) :
    absoluteValue T (rightSingularBasis T i) =
      (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) • rightSingularBasis T i
proof:
:= by
  exact (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜 _ i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.absoluteValue_eq_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem absoluteValue_eq_sum_rankOne (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    absoluteValue T = (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E),
      (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) •
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (rightSingularBasis T i)
          (rightSingularBasis T i)).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.ext
  intro j
  rw [absoluteValue]
  rw [(rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.constr_basis]
  change _ = (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E),
    (T.singularValues i : 𝕜) •
      InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (rightSingularBasis T i)
        (rightSingularBasis T i)) (rightSingularBasis T j)
  rw [_root_.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [smul_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply, smul_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [(orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (rightSingularBasis T).orthonormal j j)]
    simp
  · intro i hi hij
    rw [(orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (rightSingularBasis T).orthonormal i j), if_neg hij]
    simp
  · simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.absoluteValue_isPositive
statement:
theorem absoluteValue_isPositive (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    (absoluteValue T).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  rw [absoluteValue_eq_sum_rankOne T]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsPositive.toLinearMap
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_sum Finset.univ
  intro i hi
  apply (InnerProductSpace.isPositive_rankOne_self (rightSingularBasis T i)).smul_of_nonneg
  exact_mod_cast T.singularValues_nonneg i

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.absoluteValue_sq
statement:
theorem absoluteValue_sq (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    (absoluteValue T).comp (absoluteValue T) = T.adjoint.comp T
proof:
:= by
  apply (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.ext
  intro i
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change absoluteValue T (absoluteValue T (rightSingularBasis T i)) =
    T.adjoint (T (rightSingularBasis T i))
  rw [
    absoluteValue_apply_rightBasis, map_smul,
    absoluteValue_apply_rightBasis, smul_smul]
  have heig := T.isSymmetric_adjoint_comp_self.apply_eigenvectorBasis rfl i
  change T.adjoint (T (rightSingularBasis T i)) = _ at heig
  rw [heig, ← T.sq_singularValues_fin rfl i]
  simp [rightSingularBasis, pow_two]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.tail_coordinates_zero_of_orthogonal_kernel
statement:
theorem tail_coordinates_zero_of_orthogonal_kernel (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ z, polarPartialIsometry T b z = 0 → inner 𝕜 x z = 0) :
    ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E), finrank 𝕜 T.range ≤ i.val →
      (rightSingularBasis T).repr x i = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hU := (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
    (fun j => if hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T ⟨j.val, hj⟩) else 0) i
  change polarPartialIsometry T b (rightSingularBasis T i) = _ at hU
  rw [dif_neg (Nat.not_lt.mpr hi)] at hU
  have hinner := hx (rightSingularBasis T i) hU
  rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
  rw [← inner_conj_symm] at hinner
  exact star_eq_zero.mp hinner

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.polarPartialIsometry_apply_eq_rank_sum
statement:
theorem polarPartialIsometry_apply_eq_rank_sum (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F) (x : E) :
    polarPartialIsometry T b x =
      ∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        (rightSingularBasis T).repr x
            (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i) •
          b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  nth_rw 1 [← (rightSingularBasis T).sum_repr x]
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_smul]
  have hbasis (j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E)) :
      polarPartialIsometry T b (rightSingularBasis T j) =
        if hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
          b (rangeIndexEmbedding T ⟨j.val, hj⟩) else 0 := by
    exact (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜 _ j
  simp_rw [hbasis]
  simp only [smul_dite, smul_zero]
  let p : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) → Prop := fun j => j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  let f : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) → F := fun j =>
    if h : p j then (rightSingularBasis T).repr x j •
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T ⟨j.val, h⟩) else 0
  change (∑ j, f j) = _
  calc
    (∑ j, f j) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter p, f j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      by_cases h : p j
      · rw [if_pos h]
      · rw [if_neg h]
        simp [f, h]
    _ = ∑ j : {j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) // p j}, f j := by
      exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (fun j => by simp [p]) f
    _ = _ := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv
        (rankIndexSubtypeEquiv (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T))
      intro i
      dsimp [f, p, rankIndexSubtypeEquiv]
      rw [dif_pos i.property]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.rank_sum_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero
statement:
theorem rank_sum_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E), finrank 𝕜 T.range ≤ i.val →
      (rightSingularBasis T).repr x i = 0) :
    ‖∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        (rightSingularBasis T).repr x
            (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i) •
          b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i)‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) → 𝕜 := fun i =>
    (rightSingularBasis T).repr x
      (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i)
  let v : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) → F := fun i =>
    b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i)
  have hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v :=
    b.orthonormal.comp (rangeIndexEmbedding T) (rangeIndexEmbedding T).injective
  let p : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) → Prop := fun i => i.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  let g : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) → ℝ := fun i =>
    ‖(rightSingularBasis T).repr x i‖ ^ 2
  have hsum : (∑ i, g i) = ∑ j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      g (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) j) := by
    calc
      (∑ i, g i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter p, g i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        by_cases hip : p i
        · rw [if_pos hip]
        · rw [if_neg hip]
          have hz := hx i (Nat.le_of_not_gt hip)
          simp [g, hz]
      _ = ∑ i : {i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E) // p i}, g i := by
        exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (fun i => by simp [p]) g
      _ = _ := by
        apply Fintype.sum_equiv
          (rankIndexSubtypeEquiv (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T))
        intro i
        rfl
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  change ‖∑ i, c i • v i‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2
  calc
    ‖∑ i, c i • v i‖ ^ 2 = RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 (∑ i, c i • v i) (∑ i, c i • v i)) :=
      norm_sq_eq_re_inner _
    _ = RCLike.re (∑ i, starRingEnd 𝕜 (c i) * c i) := by
      rw [hv.inner_sum c c Finset.univ]
    _ = ∑ i, ‖c i‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [map_sum]
      simp [RCLike.conj_mul]
    _ = ∑ i, g (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i) := by rfl
    _ = ∑ i, g i := hsum.symm
    _ = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← (rightSingularBasis T).repr.norm_map x,
        EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.polarPartialIsometry_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero
statement:
theorem polarPartialIsometry_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E), finrank 𝕜 T.range ≤ i.val →
      (rightSingularBasis T).repr x i = 0) :
    ‖polarPartialIsometry T b x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [polarPartialIsometry_apply_eq_rank_sum]
  exact rank_sum_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero T b x hx

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.polarPartialIsometry_isPartialIsometry
statement:
theorem polarPartialIsometry_isPartialIsometry (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F) :
    IsPartialIsometry (polarPartialIsometry T b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact polarPartialIsometry_norm_eq_of_tail_coordinates_zero T b x
    (tail_coordinates_zero_of_orthogonal_kernel T b x hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.polarPartialIsometry_comp_absoluteValue
statement:
theorem polarPartialIsometry_comp_absoluteValue (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (polarPartialIsometry T b).comp (absoluteValue T) = T
proof:
:= by
  apply (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.ext
  intro i
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change polarPartialIsometry T b (absoluteValue T (rightSingularBasis T i)) =
    T (rightSingularBasis T i)
  rw [absoluteValue_apply_rightBasis, map_smul]
  have hU := (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
    (fun j => if hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T ⟨j.val, hj⟩) else 0) i
  change polarPartialIsometry T b (rightSingularBasis T i) = _ at hU
  rw [hU]
  by_cases hi : i.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · rw [dif_pos hi, hb ⟨i.val, hi⟩]
    exact (map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector T ⟨i.val, hi⟩).symm
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    have hzero := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_zero_of_finrank_range_le T i
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)
    simpa using hzero.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_polarDecomposition
statement:
theorem exists_polarDecomposition (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    Nonempty (PolarDecomposition T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_leftSingularBasis T
  exact ⟨{
    positivePart := absoluteValue T
    partialIsometry := polarPartialIsometry T b
    positive := absoluteValue_isPositive T
    square := absoluteValue_sq T
    isPartialIsometry := polarPartialIsometry_isPartialIsometry T b
    factorization := polarPartialIsometry_comp_absoluteValue T b hb }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.subspace_add_mem
statement:
theorem subspace_add_mem {K : Type*} {V : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] {W : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ W) (hv : v ∈ W) : u + v ∈ W
proof:
:=
  hW.2.1 hu hv

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.subspace_smul_mem
statement:
theorem subspace_smul_mem {K : Type*} {V : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] {W : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    (c : K) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ W) : c • v ∈ W
proof:
:=
  hW.2.2 c hv

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.subspace_zero_mem
statement:
theorem subspace_zero_mem {K : Type*} {V : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] {W : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W) :
    (0 : V) ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  rcases hW with ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, _hadd, _hsmul⟩
  have : (0 : K) • z = 0 := zero_smul K z
  have hz0 : (0 : K) • z ∈ W := _hsmul (0 : K) hz
  simpa [this] using hz0

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.subset_span
statement:
theorem subset_span {K : Type*} {V : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] {s : Set V} : s ⊆ span K s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  unfold span
  exact Submodule.subset_span hx

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.span_mono
statement:
theorem span_mono {K : Type*} {V : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] {s t : Set V} (h : s ⊆ t) :
    span K s ⊆ span K t
proof:
:= by
  unfold span
  intro x hx
  exact (Submodule.span_mono h) hx

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.OrthogonalUnitary.isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem
statement:
theorem isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    IsUnitaryMatrix A ↔ A ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsUnitaryMatrix, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using
    (Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff' (A := A)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.OrthogonalUnitary.isOrthogonalMatrix_iff_mem
statement:
theorem isOrthogonalMatrix_iff_mem (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    IsOrthogonalMatrix A ↔ A ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup n ℝ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsOrthogonalMatrix] using
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' (A := A)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.OrthogonalUnitary.unitary_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem] at hA hB ⊢
  exact (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ).mul_mem hA hB

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.OrthogonalUnitary.unitary_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem unitary_conjTranspose {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsUnitaryMatrix A) : IsUnitaryMatrix Aᴴ
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem] at hA ⊢
  simpa [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using Unitary.star_mem hA

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.OrthogonalUnitary.unitary_det_norm
statement:
theorem unitary_det_norm {A : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : IsUnitaryMatrix A) : ‖A.det‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply CStarRing.norm_of_mem_unitary
  exact Matrix.det_of_mem_unitary ((isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem A).mp hA)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.OrthogonalUnitary.orthogonal_det
statement:
theorem orthogonal_det {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : IsOrthogonalMatrix A) : A.det = 1 ∨ A.det = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sq_eq_one_iff]
  simpa [unitary, sq] using!
    Matrix.det_of_mem_unitary ((isOrthogonalMatrix_iff_mem A).mp hA)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_penrose_one
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_penrose_one (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    T.comp ((pseudoinverseWith T b).comp T) = T
proof:
:= by
  apply (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.ext
  intro i
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change T (pseudoinverseWith T b (T (rightSingularBasis T i))) =
    T (rightSingularBasis T i)
  by_cases hi : i.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · let k : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
    have hT := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector T k
    have hσ : T.singularValues k ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt
      (T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr k.isLt)
    rw [show rightSingularBasis T i = rightSingularBasis T
      (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) k) by rfl]
    rw [hT, ← hb k, map_smul]
    have hG := b.toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
      (fun j => if hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
        ((T.singularValues j : 𝕜)⁻¹) • rightSingularBasis T
          (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) ⟨j.val, hj⟩) else 0)
      (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)
    change pseudoinverseWith T b (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)) = _ at hG
    rw [hG]
    rw [dif_pos (by exact k.isLt)]
    change T ((T.singularValues k : 𝕜) •
      ((T.singularValues k : 𝕜)⁻¹ •
        rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) k))) =
      (T.singularValues k : 𝕜) • b (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, hT, ← hb k, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    have hσK : (T.singularValues k : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
    field_simp
  · have hT := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_zero_of_finrank_range_le T i
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)
    simp [hT]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_penrose_two
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_penrose_two (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (pseudoinverseWith T b).comp (T.comp (pseudoinverseWith T b)) =
      pseudoinverseWith T b
proof:
:= by
  apply b.toBasis.ext
  intro j
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hG := b.toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
    (fun q => if hq : q.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
      ((T.singularValues q : 𝕜)⁻¹) • rightSingularBasis T
        (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) ⟨q.val, hq⟩) else 0) j
  change pseudoinverseWith T b (b j) = _ at hG
  change pseudoinverseWith T b (T (pseudoinverseWith T b (b j))) =
    pseudoinverseWith T b (b j)
  rw [hG]
  by_cases hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · rw [dif_pos hj]
    let k : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) := ⟨j.val, hj⟩
    have hσ : T.singularValues k ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt
      (T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr k.isLt)
    have hT := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector T k
    have hGk := b.toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
      (fun q => if hq : q.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
        ((T.singularValues q : 𝕜)⁻¹) • rightSingularBasis T
          (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) ⟨q.val, hq⟩) else 0)
      (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)
    change pseudoinverseWith T b (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)) = _ at hGk
    have hidx : rangeIndexEmbedding T k = j := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hidx] at hGk
    change pseudoinverseWith T b
      (T (((T.singularValues k : 𝕜)⁻¹) •
        rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) k))) = _
    rw [map_smul, hT, ← hb k, map_smul, map_smul]
    rw [hidx, hGk, dif_pos hj]
    have hσK : (T.singularValues k : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
    dsimp [k] at hσK ⊢
    simp [smul_smul, hσK]
  · rw [dif_neg hj]
    simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.orthonormalBasis_sum_rankOne_apply
statement:
theorem orthonormalBasis_sum_rankOne_apply
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
    {m r : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin m) 𝕜 G)
    (e : Fin r ↪ Fin m) (j : Fin m) :
    (∑ i : Fin r, InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (b (e i)) (b (e i))) (b j) =
      if _h : ∃ i, e i = j then b j else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply]
  by_cases h : ∃ i, e i = j
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [dif_pos ⟨i, rfl⟩]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro q _ hqi
      have he : e q ≠ e i := fun h => hqi (e.injective h)
      rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal]
      simp [he]
    · simp
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    have he : e i ≠ j := fun hij => h ⟨i, hij⟩
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal]
    simp [he]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.rangeProjection_apply_leftBasis
statement:
theorem rangeProjection_apply_leftBasis (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i)
    (j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) :
    T (pseudoinverseWith T b (b j)) =
      if _h : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then b j else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hG := b.toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
    (fun q => if hq : q.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
      ((T.singularValues q : 𝕜)⁻¹) • rightSingularBasis T
        (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) ⟨q.val, hq⟩) else 0) j
  change pseudoinverseWith T b (b j) = _ at hG
  rw [hG]
  by_cases hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · rw [dif_pos hj, dif_pos hj]
    let k : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) := ⟨j.val, hj⟩
    have hT := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector T k
    have hσ : T.singularValues k ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt
      (T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr k.isLt)
    have hidx : rangeIndexEmbedding T k = j := Fin.ext rfl
    change T (((T.singularValues k : 𝕜)⁻¹) •
      rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) k)) = b j
    rw [map_smul, hT, ← hb k, hidx, smul_smul]
    have hσK : (T.singularValues k : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
    simp [hσK]
  · rw [dif_neg hj, dif_neg hj]
    simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.kernelProjection_apply_rightBasis
statement:
theorem kernelProjection_apply_rightBasis (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i)
    (j : Fin (finrank 𝕜 E)) :
    pseudoinverseWith T b (T (rightSingularBasis T j)) =
      if _h : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then rightSingularBasis T j else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · rw [dif_pos hj]
    let k : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range) := ⟨j.val, hj⟩
    have hT := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_smul_leftSingularVector T k
    have hσ : T.singularValues k ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt
      (T.singularValues_pos_iff_lt_finrank_range.mpr k.isLt)
    rw [show rightSingularBasis T j = rightSingularBasis T
      (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) k) by rfl]
    rw [hT, ← hb k, map_smul]
    have hG := b.toBasis.constr_basis 𝕜
      (fun q => if hq : q.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range then
        ((T.singularValues q : 𝕜)⁻¹) • rightSingularBasis T
          (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) ⟨q.val, hq⟩) else 0)
      (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)
    change pseudoinverseWith T b (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T k)) = _ at hG
    rw [hG, dif_pos (by exact k.isLt)]
    change (T.singularValues k : 𝕜) •
      (((T.singularValues k : 𝕜)⁻¹) •
        rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) k)) = _
    have hσK : (T.singularValues k : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
    simp [smul_smul, hσK]
  · rw [dif_neg hj]
    have hT := map_rightSingularBasis_eq_zero_of_finrank_range_le T j
      (Nat.le_of_not_gt hj)
    simp [hT]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_eq_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_eq_sum_rankOne (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    T.comp (pseudoinverseWith T b) =
      (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i))
          (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i))).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply b.toBasis.ext
  intro j
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change T (pseudoinverseWith T b (b j)) = _
  rw [rangeProjection_apply_leftBasis T b hb j]
  change _ = (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
    InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜 (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i))
      (b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i))) (b j)
  rw [orthonormalBasis_sum_rankOne_apply b (rangeIndexEmbedding T) j]
  have hiff : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range ↔
      ∃ i, rangeIndexEmbedding T i = j := by
    constructor
    · intro hj
      exact ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hi.symm
      rw [hval]
      exact i.isLt
  by_cases hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · rw [dif_pos hj, dif_pos (hiff.mp hj)]
  · rw [dif_neg hj, dif_neg (fun h => hj (hiff.mpr h))]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_eq_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_eq_sum_rankOne (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (pseudoinverseWith T b).comp T =
      (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜
          (rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i))
          (rightSingularBasis T (Fin.castLE
            (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T) i))).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply (rightSingularBasis T).toBasis.ext
  intro j
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change pseudoinverseWith T b (T (rightSingularBasis T j)) = _
  rw [kernelProjection_apply_rightBasis T b hb j]
  change _ = (∑ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
    InnerProductSpace.rankOne 𝕜
      (rightSingularBasis T ((Fin.castLEEmb (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T)) i))
      (rightSingularBasis T ((Fin.castLEEmb (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T)) i)))
        (rightSingularBasis T j)
  rw [orthonormalBasis_sum_rankOne_apply (rightSingularBasis T)
    (Fin.castLEEmb (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T)) j]
  have hiff : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range ↔
      ∃ i, (Fin.castLEEmb (LinearMap.finrank_range_le T)) i = j := by
    constructor
    · intro hj
      exact ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hi.symm
      rw [hval]
      exact i.isLt
  by_cases hj : j.val < finrank 𝕜 T.range
  · rw [dif_pos hj, dif_pos (hiff.mp hj)]
  · rw [dif_neg hj, dif_neg (fun h => hj (hiff.mpr h))]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_symmetric (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    (T.comp (pseudoinverseWith T b)).IsSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_eq_sum_rankOne T b hb]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_sum Finset.univ fun i hi =>
    InnerProductSpace.isPositive_rankOne_self _).toLinearMap.isSymmetric

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_symmetric
statement:
theorem pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_symmetric (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 F)) 𝕜 F)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin (finrank 𝕜 T.range),
      b (rangeIndexEmbedding T i) = leftSingularVector T i) :
    ((pseudoinverseWith T b).comp T).IsSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_eq_sum_rankOne T b hb]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_sum Finset.univ fun i hi =>
    InnerProductSpace.isPositive_rankOne_self _).toLinearMap.isSymmetric

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_moorePenrosePseudoinverse
statement:
theorem exists_moorePenrosePseudoinverse (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :
    Nonempty (MoorePenrosePseudoinverse T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_leftSingularBasis T
  exact ⟨{
    inverse := pseudoinverseWith T b
    penrose_one := pseudoinverseWith_penrose_one T b hb
    penrose_two := pseudoinverseWith_penrose_two T b hb
    rangeProjection_symmetric := pseudoinverseWith_rangeProjection_symmetric T b hb
    kernelProjection_symmetric := pseudoinverseWith_kernelProjection_symmetric T b hb }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.symmetric_idempotent_residual_minimal
statement:
theorem symmetric_idempotent_residual_minimal (P : F →ₗ[𝕜] F)
    (hsym : P.IsSymmetric) (hidem : P.comp P = P)
    (y z : F) (hz : P z = z) :
    ‖P y - y‖ ≤ ‖z - y‖
proof:
:= by
  let a := z - P y
  let r := P y - y
  have hPa : P a = a := by
    dsimp [a]
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hidem y
    have hPP : P (P y) = P y := by
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
    rw [map_sub, hz, hPP]
  have hPr : P r = 0 := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [map_sub]
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hidem y
    rw [show P (P y) = P y by simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h]
    simp
  have har : inner 𝕜 a r = 0 := by
    rw [← hPa, hsym, hPr, inner_zero_right]
  have hdecomp : z - y = a + r := by
    dsimp [a, r]
    abel
  have hpyth := norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero a r har
  rw [hdecomp]
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  simp only [pow_two]
  rw [hpyth]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_self_nonneg ‖a‖)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.MoorePenrosePseudoinverse.isLeastSquaresSolution
statement:
theorem MoorePenrosePseudoinverse.isLeastSquaresSolution
    {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F} (G : MoorePenrosePseudoinverse T) (y : F) :
    IsLeastSquaresSolution T y (G.inverse y)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let P := T.comp G.inverse
  apply symmetric_idempotent_residual_minimal P
      G.rangeProjection_symmetric (y := y) (z := T x)
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro q
    change T (G.inverse (T (G.inverse q))) = T (G.inverse q)
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun G.penrose_two q
    change G.inverse (T (G.inverse q)) = G.inverse q at h
    rw [h]
  · exact LinearMap.congr_fun G.penrose_one x

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_leastSquaresSolution
statement:
theorem exists_leastSquaresSolution (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (y : F) :
    ∃ x₀, IsLeastSquaresSolution T y x₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := exists_moorePenrosePseudoinverse T
  exact ⟨G.inverse y, G.isLeastSquaresSolution y⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.cauchy_schwarz
statement:
theorem cauchy_schwarz (x y : E) :
    |inner ℝ x y| ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
proof:
:=
  abs_real_inner_le_norm x y

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.inner_self_eq_norm_sq
statement:
theorem inner_self_eq_norm_sq (x : E) :
    inner ℝ x x = ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq x

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.orthogonal_symm
statement:
theorem orthogonal_symm {x y : E} :
    AreOrthogonal x y ↔ AreOrthogonal y x
proof:
:= by
  exact inner_eq_zero_symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.orthonormalize_is_orthonormal
proof:
:= by
  exact InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hv

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.orthonormalize_is_linearly_independent
proof:
:= by
  exact InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed_linearIndependent hv

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.orthonormalize_span_eq
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (orthonormalize v)) =
        Submodule.span ℝ
          (Set.range (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ v)) :=
      InnerProductSpace.span_gramSchmidtNormed_range v
    _ = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) :=
      InnerProductSpace.span_gramSchmidt ℝ v

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.orthonormalize_basis
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨orthonormalize_is_linearly_independent hb.1, ?_⟩,
    orthonormalize_is_orthonormal hb.1⟩
  rw [orthonormalize_span_eq]
  exact hb.2

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.orthogonal_decomposition
statement:
theorem orthogonal_decomposition {n : ℕ} [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (v : Fin n → E) (x : E) :
    ∃! yz : E × E,
      IsLinearCombination v yz.1 ∧
        IsOrthogonalToFamily yz.2 v ∧ x = yz.1 + yz.2
proof:
:= by
  let K : Submodule ℝ E := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)
  let y : E := K.starProjection x
  let z : E := x - y
  have hyK : y ∈ K := K.starProjection_apply_mem x
  have hy : IsLinearCombination v y := by
    rcases (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hyK with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hz : IsOrthogonalToFamily z v := by
    intro i
    exact K.starProjection_inner_eq_zero x (v i)
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i))
  refine ⟨(y, z), ⟨hy, hz, by simp [z]⟩, ?_⟩
  intro yz hyz
  rcases yz with ⟨y', z'⟩
  rcases hyz with ⟨hy', hz', hsum⟩
  have hy'K : y' ∈ K := by
    rcases hy' with ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mpr ⟨c, rfl⟩
  have horth : ∀ w ∈ K, inner ℝ (x - y') w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hsum, add_sub_cancel_left]
    rcases (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hw with ⟨d, rfl⟩
    rw [inner_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    have hzi := hz' i
    change inner ℝ z' (v i) = 0 at hzi
    simp [inner_smul_right, hzi]
  have hproj : y = y' := by
    exact K.eq_starProjection_of_mem_of_inner_eq_zero hy'K horth
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact hproj.symm
  · calc
      z' = x - y' := by rw [hsum]; abel
      _ = x - y := by rw [hproj]
      _ = z := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.adjoint_characterization
statement:
theorem adjoint_characterization [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (x y : E) :
    inner ℝ x (adjointOperator T y) = inner ℝ (T x) y
proof:
:=
  T.adjoint_inner_right x y

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.InnerProduct.self_adjoint_iff_eq_adjoint
statement:
theorem self_adjoint_iff_eq_adjoint [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) :
    IsSelfAdjointOperator T ↔ adjointOperator T = T
proof:
:= by
  change T.IsSymmetric ↔ T.adjoint = T
  exact ⟨LinearMap.IsSymmetric.adjoint_eq,
    fun h => (LinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff T T).mp h.symm⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.swapRows_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapRows_apply_left (A : Matrix m n K) (i j : m) (k : n) :
    swapRows A i j i k = A j k
proof: := Matrix.swap_mul_apply_left i j k A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.swapRows_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapRows_apply_right (A : Matrix m n K) (i j : m) (k : n) :
    swapRows A i j j k = A i k
proof: := Matrix.swap_mul_apply_right i j k A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.swapRows_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem swapRows_apply_of_ne (A : Matrix m n K) {i j r : m} (hri : r ≠ i) (hrj : r ≠ j)
    (k : n) : swapRows A i j r k = A r k
proof:
:=
  Matrix.swap_mul_of_ne hri hrj A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.addRowMultiple_apply_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem addRowMultiple_apply_target (A : Matrix m n K) (i j : m) (c : K) (k : n) :
    addRowMultiple A i j c i k = A i k + c * A j k
proof:
:=
  Matrix.transvection_mul_apply_same i j k c A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne (A : Matrix m n K) {i j r : m} (hri : r ≠ i)
    (c : K) (k : n) : addRowMultiple A i j c r k = A r k
proof:
:=
  Matrix.transvection_mul_apply_of_ne i j r k hri c A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.scaleRow_apply_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleRow_apply_target (A : Matrix m n K) (i : m) (c : K) (j : n) :
    scaleRow A i c i j = c * A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleRow, Matrix.updateRow_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.updateRow_self, Matrix.smul_vecMul, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  have h := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m n K => M i j) (Matrix.one_mul A)
  have hrow : ((1 : Matrix m m K) i ᵥ* A) j = A i j := by
    change (∑ k : m, (1 : Matrix m m K) i k * A k j) = A i j
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using h
  rw [hrow]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.scaleRow_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem scaleRow_apply_of_ne (A : Matrix m n K) {i r : m} (hri : r ≠ i) (c : K) (j : n) :
    scaleRow A i c r j = A r j
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleRow, Matrix.updateRow_mul, hri]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.swapRows_swapRows
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapRows_swapRows (A : Matrix m n K) (i j : m) :
    swapRows (swapRows A i j) i j = A
proof:
:= by
  simp [swapRows, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.swap_mul_self]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.addRowMultiple_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem addRowMultiple_neg (A : Matrix m n K) {i j : m} (hij : i ≠ j) (c : K) :
    addRowMultiple (addRowMultiple A i j c) i j (-c) = A
proof:
:= by
  simp [addRowMultiple, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.transvection_mul_transvection_same i j hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rank_addRowMultiple
statement:
theorem rank_addRowMultiple [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n K) {i j : m} (hij : i ≠ j) (c : K) :
    (addRowMultiple A i j c).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_det_ne_zero
  rw [Matrix.det_transvection_of_ne i j hij c]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rank_swapRows
statement:
theorem rank_swapRows [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n K) (i j : m) :
    (swapRows A i j).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_det_ne_zero
  simp [Matrix.swap]
  split <;> norm_num

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rank_scaleRow
statement:
theorem rank_scaleRow [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n K) (i : m) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (scaleRow A i c).rank = A.rank
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_det_ne_zero
  rw [Matrix.det_updateRow_smul, Matrix.updateRow_eq_self, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]
  exact hc

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.RowEquivalent.rank_eq
statement:
theorem RowEquivalent.rank_eq [Fintype n] {A B : Matrix m n K} (h : RowEquivalent A B) :
    A.rank = B.rank
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | swap A i j => exact (rank_swapRows A i j).symm
  | add A hij c => exact (rank_addRowMultiple A hij c).symm
  | scale A i hc => exact (rank_scaleRow A i hc).symm
  | symm _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.zero_isPivotedBy_top
statement:
theorem zero_isPivotedBy_top [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] :
    (0 : Matrix m n K).IsPivotedBy (fun _ => ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i₁ i₂ hi j₂ hz
    rfl
  · intro i
    constructor
    · intro j hj
      rfl
    · intro c hc
      exact (WithTop.coe_ne_top (a := c) hc.symm).elim

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.exists_rowEchelon_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_rowEchelon_of_eq_zero [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n]
    (A : Matrix m n K) (hA : A = 0) :
    ∃ (R : Matrix m n K) (pivot : m → WithTop n),
      RowEquivalent A R ∧ R.IsPivotedBy pivot
proof:
:= by
  subst A
  exact ⟨0, fun _ => ⊤, RowEquivalent.refl 0, zero_isPivotedBy_top⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.normalize_pivot
statement:
theorem normalize_pivot (A : Matrix m n K) {i r : m} {j : n} (hij : A i j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n K, RowEquivalent A B ∧ B r j = 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := swapRows A r i
  let B := scaleRow S r (A i j)⁻¹
  have hinv : (A i j)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hij
  refine ⟨B, RowEquivalent.trans (RowEquivalent.swap A r i)
    (RowEquivalent.scale S r hinv), ?_⟩
  simp [B, S, hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clear_entry_using_pivot
proof:
:= by
  let B := addRowMultiple A i r (-A i j)
  refine ⟨B, RowEquivalent.add A hri (-A i j), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne A hri.symm (-A i j) j).trans hpivot
  · simp [B, hpivot]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clearRows_rowEquivalent
statement:
theorem clearRows_rowEquivalent (A : Matrix m n K) (r : m) (j : n)
    {rows : List m} (hr : r ∉ rows) : RowEquivalent A (clearRows A r j rows)
proof:
:= by
  induction rows generalizing A with
  | nil => exact RowEquivalent.refl A
  | cons i rows ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or] at hr
      exact RowEquivalent.trans (RowEquivalent.add A (fun h => hr.1 h.symm) (-A i j))
        (ih (A := addRowMultiple A i r (-A i j)) hr.2)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clearRows_preserves_pivot
statement:
theorem clearRows_preserves_pivot (A : Matrix m n K) (r : m) (j : n)
    {rows : List m} (hr : r ∉ rows) (hpivot : A r j = 1) :
    clearRows A r j rows r j = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction rows generalizing A with
  | nil => exact hpivot
  | cons i rows ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or] at hr
      apply ih (A := addRowMultiple A i r (-A i j)) hr.2
      exact (addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne A hr.1 (-A i j) j).trans hpivot

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clearRows_preserves_row_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem clearRows_preserves_row_of_not_mem (A : Matrix m n K) (r k : m) (j : n)
    {rows : List m} (hk : k ∉ rows) : clearRows A r j rows k = A k
proof:
:= by
  induction rows generalizing A with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i rows ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or] at hk
      simp only [clearRows]
      rw [ih (A := addRowMultiple A i r (-A i j)) hk.2]
      funext c
      exact addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne A hk.1 (-A i j) c

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clearRows_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem clearRows_eq_zero_of_mem (A : Matrix m n K) (r : m) (j : n)
    {rows : List m} (hnodup : rows.Nodup) (hr : r ∉ rows) (hpivot : A r j = 1)
    {i : m} (hi : i ∈ rows) : clearRows A r j rows i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction rows generalizing A i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons k rows ih =>
      simp only [List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, not_or] at hnodup hr hi
      rcases hi with hi | hi
      · subst i
        simp only [clearRows]
        rw [clearRows_preserves_row_of_not_mem
          (A := addRowMultiple A k r (-A k j)) (r := r) (k := k) (j := j) hnodup.1]
        simp [hpivot]
      · simp only [clearRows]
        apply ih (A := addRowMultiple A k r (-A k j)) hnodup.2 hr.2
          ((addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne A hr.1 (-A k j) j).trans hpivot) hi

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rowEquivalent_clearColumn
statement:
theorem rowEquivalent_clearColumn (A : Matrix m n K) (r : m) (j : n) :
    RowEquivalent A (clearColumn A r j)
proof:
:= by
  apply clearRows_rowEquivalent
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clearColumn_pivot
statement:
theorem clearColumn_pivot (A : Matrix m n K) (r : m) (j : n) (hp : A r j = 1) :
    clearColumn A r j r j = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply clearRows_preserves_pivot <;> simp_all

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.clearColumn_eq_zero
statement:
theorem clearColumn_eq_zero (A : Matrix m n K) (r : m) (j : n) (hp : A r j = 1)
    {i : m} (hir : i ≠ r) : clearColumn A r j i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply clearRows_eq_zero_of_mem (A := A) (r := r) (j := j)
  · exact Finset.nodup_toList _
  · simp
  · exact hp
  · simp [hir]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prepare_pivot
statement:
theorem prepare_pivot (A : Matrix m n K) {i r : m} {j : n} (hij : A i j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n K, RowEquivalent A B ∧ B r j = 1 ∧ ∀ k ≠ r, B k j = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hAS, hS⟩ := normalize_pivot A (r := r) hij
  let B := clearColumn S r j
  refine ⟨B, hAS.trans (rowEquivalent_clearColumn S r j),
    clearColumn_pivot S r j hS, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  exact clearColumn_eq_zero S r j hS hk

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prependZeroColumn_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem prependZeroColumn_zero (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K) (i : Fin r) :
    prependZeroColumn A i 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prependZeroColumn_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem prependZeroColumn_succ (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) : prependZeroColumn A i j.succ = A i j
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjoinPivot_zero_zero (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K) :
    adjoinPivot v A 0 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjoinPivot_zero_succ (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (j : Fin c) : adjoinPivot v A 0 j.succ = v j
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_succ_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjoinPivot_succ_zero (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i : Fin r) : adjoinPivot v A i.succ 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjoinPivot_succ_succ (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) : adjoinPivot v A i.succ j.succ = A i j
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.dropFirstColumn_prependZeroColumn
statement:
@[simp] theorem dropFirstColumn_prependZeroColumn (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K) :
    dropFirstColumn (prependZeroColumn A) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.dropFirstRow_adjoinPivot
statement:
@[simp] theorem dropFirstRow_adjoinPivot (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K) :
    dropFirstRow (adjoinPivot v A) = prependZeroColumn A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j <;> rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prependZeroColumn_isPivotedBy
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i₁ i₂ hi j₂ hz
    cases j₂ using Fin.cases with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k =>
        exact hp.isRowEchelon hi (fun l hl => hz l.succ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hl))
  · intro i
    constructor
    · intro j hj
      cases j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k =>
          cases hpi : p i with
          | top =>
              apply (hp.isPivotEntry i).1 k
              rw [hpi]
              exact WithTop.coe_lt_top (a := k)
          | coe a =>
              apply (hp.isPivotEntry i).1 k
              rw [hpi]
              rw [shiftPivot, hpi, WithTop.map_coe] at hj
              exact_mod_cast Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp hj)
    · intro d hd
      cases hpi : p i with
      | top =>
          simp [shiftPivot, hpi] at hd
      | coe a =>
          have hda : d = a.succ := by
            simpa [shiftPivot, hpi] using hd.symm
          subst d
          exact (hp.isPivotEntry i).2 a hpi

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_isPivotedBy
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i₁ i₂ hi j₂ hz
    cases i₁ using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
        cases i₂ using Fin.cases with
        | zero => simp at hi
        | succ k =>
            cases j₂ using Fin.cases with
            | zero => rfl
            | succ q =>
                have hzero : (0 : Fin (c + 1)) < q.succ :=
                  Fin.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Fin.succ_ne_zero q)
                exact ((one_ne_zero : (1 : K) ≠ 0) (hz 0 hzero)).elim
    | succ a =>
        cases i₂ using Fin.cases with
        | zero => simp at hi
        | succ b =>
            cases j₂ using Fin.cases with
            | zero => rfl
            | succ q =>
                apply hp.isRowEchelon (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hi)
                intro l hl
                exact hz l.succ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hl)
  · intro i
    cases i using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
        constructor
        · intro j hj
          exact (not_lt_of_ge (bot_le : (0 : WithTop (Fin (c + 1))) ≤ j) hj).elim
        · intro d hd
          simp [consPivot] at hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := hd
          subst d
          exact one_ne_zero
    | succ i =>
        have ht := (prependZeroColumn_isPivotedBy hp).isPivotEntry i
        have hrow : adjoinPivot v A i.succ = prependZeroColumn A i := by
          funext j
          cases j using Fin.cases <;> rfl
        simpa [consPivot, hrow] using ht

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prependZeroColumn_swapRows
statement:
theorem prependZeroColumn_swapRows (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K) (i j : Fin r) :
    prependZeroColumn (swapRows A i j) = swapRows (prependZeroColumn A) i j
proof:
:= by
  ext k l
  cases l using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [swapRows, Matrix.mul_apply, prependZeroColumn]
  | succ q => simp [prependZeroColumn, swapRows, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prependZeroColumn_addRowMultiple
statement:
theorem prependZeroColumn_addRowMultiple (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i j : Fin r) (a : K) :
    prependZeroColumn (addRowMultiple A i j a) =
      addRowMultiple (prependZeroColumn A) i j a
proof:
:= by
  ext k l
  cases l using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [addRowMultiple, Matrix.mul_apply, prependZeroColumn]
  | succ q => simp [prependZeroColumn, addRowMultiple, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.prependZeroColumn_scaleRow
statement:
theorem prependZeroColumn_scaleRow (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K) (i : Fin r) (a : K) :
    prependZeroColumn (scaleRow A i a) = scaleRow (prependZeroColumn A) i a
proof:
:= by
  ext k l
  cases l using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [scaleRow, Matrix.mul_apply, prependZeroColumn]
  | succ q => simp [prependZeroColumn, scaleRow, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rowEquivalent_prependZeroColumn
statement:
theorem rowEquivalent_prependZeroColumn {A B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K}
    (h : RowEquivalent A B) : RowEquivalent (prependZeroColumn A) (prependZeroColumn B)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl A => exact RowEquivalent.refl _
  | swap A i j => simpa [prependZeroColumn_swapRows] using
      RowEquivalent.swap (prependZeroColumn A) i j
  | add A hij a => simpa [prependZeroColumn_addRowMultiple] using
      RowEquivalent.add (prependZeroColumn A) hij a
  | scale A i ha => simpa [prependZeroColumn_scaleRow] using
      RowEquivalent.scale (prependZeroColumn A) i ha
  | symm _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_swapRows
statement:
theorem adjoinPivot_swapRows (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i j : Fin r) :
    adjoinPivot v (swapRows A i j) = swapRows (adjoinPivot v A) i.succ j.succ
proof:
:= by
  ext k l
  cases k using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      rw [swapRows_apply_of_ne]
      · rfl
      · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
      · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm
  | succ q =>
      by_cases hqi : q = i
      · subst q
        cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp
      · by_cases hqj : q = j
        · subst q
          cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp
        · rw [swapRows_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hqi (Fin.succ_inj.mp h))
            (fun h => hqj (Fin.succ_inj.mp h))]
          cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp [swapRows_apply_of_ne A hqi hqj]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_addRowMultiple
statement:
theorem adjoinPivot_addRowMultiple (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i j : Fin r) (a : K) :
    adjoinPivot v (addRowMultiple A i j a) =
      addRowMultiple (adjoinPivot v A) i.succ j.succ a
proof:
:= by
  ext k l
  cases k using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      rw [addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne]
      · rfl
      · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
  | succ q =>
      by_cases hqi : q = i
      · subst q
        cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp
      · rw [addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hqi (Fin.succ_inj.mp h))]
        cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp [addRowMultiple_apply_of_ne A hqi]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.adjoinPivot_scaleRow
statement:
theorem adjoinPivot_scaleRow (v : Fin c → K) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K)
    (i : Fin r) (a : K) :
    adjoinPivot v (scaleRow A i a) = scaleRow (adjoinPivot v A) i.succ a
proof:
:= by
  ext k l
  cases k using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      rw [scaleRow_apply_of_ne]
      · rfl
      · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
  | succ q =>
      by_cases hqi : q = i
      · subst q
        cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp
      · rw [scaleRow_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hqi (Fin.succ_inj.mp h))]
        cases l using Fin.cases <;> simp [scaleRow_apply_of_ne A hqi]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rowEquivalent_adjoinPivot
statement:
theorem rowEquivalent_adjoinPivot (v : Fin c → K) {A B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K}
    (h : RowEquivalent A B) : RowEquivalent (adjoinPivot v A) (adjoinPivot v B)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl A => exact RowEquivalent.refl _
  | swap A i j => simpa [adjoinPivot_swapRows] using
      RowEquivalent.swap (adjoinPivot v A) i.succ j.succ
  | add A hij a => simpa [adjoinPivot_addRowMultiple] using
      RowEquivalent.add (adjoinPivot v A) (fun h => hij (Fin.succ_inj.mp h)) a
  | scale A i ha => simpa [adjoinPivot_scaleRow] using
      RowEquivalent.scale (adjoinPivot v A) i.succ ha
  | symm _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.eq_prependZeroColumn_dropFirstColumn
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  cases j using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simpa using (hzero i).symm
  | succ q => rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.eq_adjoinPivot_drop
statement:
theorem eq_adjoinPivot_drop {r c : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (c + 1)) K)
    (hp : A 0 0 = 1) (hz : ∀ i : Fin r, A i.succ 0 = 0) :
    adjoinPivot (fun j => A 0 j.succ) (dropFirstColumn (dropFirstRow A)) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      cases j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact hp.symm
      | succ q => rfl
  | succ k =>
      cases j using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact (hz k).symm
      | succ q => rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.fin_exists_rowEchelon
statement:
theorem fin_exists_rowEchelon (rows cols : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) K) :
    ∃ (R : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) K) (pivot : Fin rows → WithTop (Fin cols)),
      RowEquivalent A R ∧ R.IsPivotedBy pivot
proof:
:= by
  generalize hd : rows + cols = d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing rows cols with
  | h d ih =>
      cases rows with
      | zero =>
          apply exists_rowEchelon_of_eq_zero
          ext i
          exact Fin.elim0 i
      | succ r =>
          cases cols with
          | zero =>
              apply exists_rowEchelon_of_eq_zero
              ext i j
              exact Fin.elim0 j
          | succ c =>
              by_cases hcol : ∀ i, A i 0 = 0
              · let A' : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin c) K := dropFirstColumn A
                have hlt : (r + 1) + c < d := by omega
                obtain ⟨R', p, hAR, hp⟩ := ih _ hlt (r + 1) c A' rfl
                refine ⟨prependZeroColumn R', shiftPivot p, ?_,
                  prependZeroColumn_isPivotedBy hp⟩
                rw [← eq_prependZeroColumn_dropFirstColumn A hcol]
                exact rowEquivalent_prependZeroColumn hAR
              · push Not at hcol
                obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcol
                obtain ⟨S, hAS, hS00, hScol⟩ := prepare_pivot A (r := 0) hi
                let T : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin c) K := dropFirstColumn (dropFirstRow S)
                have hlt : r + c < d := by omega
                obtain ⟨R', p, hTR, hp⟩ := ih _ hlt r c T rfl
                let v : Fin c → K := fun j => S 0 j.succ
                refine ⟨adjoinPivot v R', consPivot p, ?_, adjoinPivot_isPivotedBy hp v⟩
                have hrec : adjoinPivot v T = S := by
                  apply eq_adjoinPivot_drop S hS00
                  intro k
                  exact hScol k.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero k)
                have hSR : RowEquivalent S (adjoinPivot v R') := by
                  rw [← hrec]
                  exact rowEquivalent_adjoinPivot v hTR
                exact hAS.trans hSR

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.exists_rowEchelon
statement:
theorem exists_rowEchelon {rows cols : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) K) :
    ∃ (R : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) K) (pivot : Fin rows → WithTop (Fin cols)),
      RowEquivalent A R ∧ R.IsPivotedBy pivot
proof:
:=
  fin_exists_rowEchelon rows cols A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.exists_rowEchelon_with_rank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, pivot, hAR, hpivot⟩ := exists_rowEchelon A
  exact ⟨R, pivot, hAR, hpivot, hAR.rank_eq.trans hpivot.rank_eq⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.exists_diagonal_reduction
statement:
theorem exists_diagonal_reduction [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n K) :
    ∃ (L L' : List (Matrix.TransvectionStruct n K)) (d : n → K),
      (L.map Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod * A *
        (L'.map Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod = Matrix.diagonal d
proof:
:=
  Matrix.Pivot.exists_list_transvec_mul_mul_list_transvec_eq_diagonal A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixElimination.rank_eq_pivot_count
proof: := cert.rank_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.LinearMap.injective_iff_kernel_trivial
statement:
theorem injective_iff_kernel_trivial {K V W : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] [AddCommGroup W] [LinearSpace K W]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.LinearMap.dim_eq_of_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem dim_eq_of_linearEquiv {K V W : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] [AddCommGroup W] [LinearSpace K W]
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] [IsFiniteDimensional K W]
    (e : V ≃ₗ[K] W) : dim K V = dim K W
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.LinearMap.quotientKer_dim_eq_rank
statement:
theorem quotientKer_dim_eq_rank {K V W : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [LinearSpace K W]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] W) : quotientKernelDimension K f = rank K f
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.LinearMap.rank_add_nullity
statement:
theorem rank_add_nullity {K : Type*} {V W : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [LinearSpace K W] (f : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    rank K f + nullity K f = dim K V
proof:
:= by
  unfold rank nullity LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.dim

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.LinearMap.matrix_rank_eq_columnRank
statement:
lemma matrix_rank_eq_columnRank {K : Type*} {m n : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n K) :
    A.rank = columnRank K A
proof:
:=

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.LinearMap.rank_mul_le
statement:
lemma rank_mul_le {K : Type*} {m n o : Type*} [Field K]

proof:

theorem rank_transpose_eq {K : Type*} {m n : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem
statement:
theorem isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem {A : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) ℝ} :
    IsSymplecticMatrix A ↔ A ∈ Matrix.symplecticGroup l ℝ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsSymplecticMatrix, standardJ] using
    (SymplecticGroup.mem_iff' (l := l) (R := ℝ) (A := A)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.standardJ_transpose
statement: theorem standardJ_transpose : (standardJ : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) ℝ)ᵀ = -standardJ
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.J_transpose l ℝ

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.standardJ_sq
statement:
theorem standardJ_sq :
    (standardJ : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) ℝ) * standardJ = -1
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.J_squared l ℝ

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.one_isSymplectic
statement:
theorem one_isSymplectic :
    IsSymplecticMatrix (1 : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem]
  exact (Matrix.symplecticGroup l ℝ).one_mem

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.mul_isSymplectic
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem] at hA hB ⊢
  exact (Matrix.symplecticGroup l ℝ).mul_mem hA hB

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.inverse_formula
proof:
:= by
  apply SymplecticGroup.inv_eq_symplectic_inv
  exact isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem.mp hA

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.inv_isSymplectic
statement:
theorem inv_isSymplectic {A : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) ℝ}
    (hA : IsSymplecticMatrix A) : IsSymplecticMatrix A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem]
  rw [inverse_formula hA]
  exact (Matrix.symplecticGroup l ℝ).mul_mem
    ((Matrix.symplecticGroup l ℝ).mul_mem
      (SymplecticGroup.neg_mem (SymplecticGroup.J_mem l ℝ))
      (SymplecticGroup.transpose_mem (isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem.mp hA)))
    (SymplecticGroup.J_mem l ℝ)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticMatrix.det_eq_one
statement:
theorem det_eq_one {A : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) ℝ}
    (hA : IsSymplecticMatrix A) : Matrix.det A = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact SymplecticGroup.det_eq_one (isSymplecticMatrix_iff_mem.mp hA)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SubspaceTheory.subspaceSum_isSubspace
statement:
theorem subspaceSum_isSubspace {W U : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    (hU : IsSubspace K U) : IsSubspace K (subspaceSum W U)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨0, 0, subspace_zero_mem hW, 0, subspace_zero_mem hU, add_zero 0⟩
  · rintro x ⟨w₁, hw₁, u₁, hu₁, rfl⟩ y ⟨w₂, hw₂, u₂, hu₂, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w₁ + w₂, hW.2.1 hw₁ hw₂, u₁ + u₂, hU.2.1 hu₁ hu₂, by abel⟩
  · rintro c x ⟨w, hw, u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c • w, hW.2.2 c hw, c • u, hU.2.2 c hu, by simp [smul_add]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SubspaceTheory.subspaceIntersection_isSubspace
statement:
theorem subspaceIntersection_isSubspace {W U : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    (hU : IsSubspace K U) : IsSubspace K (subspaceIntersection W U)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0, subspace_zero_mem hW, subspace_zero_mem hU⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hxW, hxU⟩ y ⟨hyW, hyU⟩
    exact ⟨hW.2.1 hxW hyW, hU.2.1 hxU hyU⟩
  · rintro c x ⟨hxW, hxU⟩
    exact ⟨hW.2.2 c hxW, hU.2.2 c hxU⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SubspaceTheory.subspaceDim_add_subspaceDim
statement:
theorem subspaceDim_add_subspaceDim {W U : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    (hU : IsSubspace K U) [IsFiniteDimensional K V] :
    subspaceDim K W hW + subspaceDim K U hU =
      subspaceDim K (subspaceSum W U) (subspaceSum_isSubspace hW hU) +
        subspaceDim K (subspaceIntersection W U) (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := W
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem hW
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb; exact hW.2.1 ha hb
      smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; exact hW.2.2 c hx }
  let T : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := U
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem hU
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb; exact hU.2.1 ha hb
      smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; exact hU.2.2 c hx }
  let P : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := subspaceSum W U
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem (subspaceSum_isSubspace hW hU)
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb; exact (subspaceSum_isSubspace hW hU).2.1 ha hb
      smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; exact (subspaceSum_isSubspace hW hU).2.2 c hx }
  let Q : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := subspaceIntersection W U
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU)
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb; exact (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU).2.1 ha hb
      smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; exact (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU).2.2 c hx }
  have hP : P = S ⊔ T := by
    ext x
    simp [P, S, T, subspaceSum, Submodule.mem_sup]
  have hQ : Q = S ⊓ T := by
    ext x
    simp [Q, S, T, subspaceIntersection]
  change Module.finrank K S + Module.finrank K T =
    Module.finrank K P + Module.finrank K Q
  rw [hP, hQ]
  exact (Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq S T).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SubspaceTheory.subspaceDim_directSum
statement:
theorem subspaceDim_directSum {W U : Set V} (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    (hU : IsSubspace K U) [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (hdir : IsDirectSum W U) :
    subspaceDim K (subspaceSum W U) (subspaceSum_isSubspace hW hU) =
      subspaceDim K W hW + subspaceDim K U hU
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := subspaceIntersection W U
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU)
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb; exact (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU).2.1 ha hb
      smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; exact (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU).2.2 c hx }
  have hQ : Q = ⊥ := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hx' : x ∈ W ∩ U := hx
      simpa [hdir x hx'.1 hx'.2]
    · intro hx
      have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa using hx
      subst x
      exact subspace_zero_mem (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU)
  have hinter :
      subspaceDim K (subspaceIntersection W U) (subspaceIntersection_isSubspace hW hU) = 0 := by
    change Module.finrank K Q = 0
    rw [hQ]
    simp
  have hdim := subspaceDim_add_subspaceDim hW hU
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SubspaceTheory.quotientDim_add_subspaceDim
statement:
theorem quotientDim_add_subspaceDim (W : Set V) (hW : IsSubspace K W)
    [IsFiniteDimensional K V] :
    quotientDim K W hW + subspaceDim K W hW = dim K V
proof:
:= by
  let S : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := W
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem hW
      add_mem' := by intro a b ha hb; exact hW.2.1 ha hb
      smul_mem' := by intro c x hx; exact hW.2.2 c hx }
  change Module.finrank K (V ⧸ S) + Module.finrank K S = Module.finrank K V
  exact Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank S

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.add_right

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.self_eq_zero
statement: theorem self_eq_zero (x : E) : ω x x = 0
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.zero_mem_symplecticOrthogonal
statement:
theorem zero_mem_symplecticOrthogonal (S : Set E) :
    0 ∈ symplecticOrthogonal ω S
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.SymplecticForm.toBilin_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem SymplecticForm.toBilin_apply (x y : E) : ω.toBilin x y = ω x y
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.bilin_self_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem bilin_self_eq_zero (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E)
    (hskew : ∀ x y, B x y = -B y x) (x : E) : B x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hskew x x
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.exists_normalized_pair
statement:
private theorem exists_normalized_pair (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E)
    (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) [Nontrivial E] : ∃ x y, B x y = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : E)
  have hex : ∃ y, B x y ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hx (hnd.1 x h)
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨x, (B x y₀)⁻¹ • y₀, ?_⟩
  simp [hy₀]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.normalized_pair_linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro a b hab
  have hy := congrArg (fun z => B z y) hab
  have hx := congrArg (fun z => B x z) hab
  simp [hxy, bilin_self_eq_zero B hskew] at hy hx
  constructor <;> linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.normalized_plane_nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  let W : Submodule ℝ E := Submodule.span ℝ ({x, y} : Set E)
  have hxW : x ∈ W := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  have hyW : y ∈ W := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ hzero
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp hz)
    have hp := hzero ⟨y, hyW⟩
    have hq := hzero ⟨x, hxW⟩
    change B z y = 0 at hp
    change B z x = 0 at hq
    rw [← hab] at hp hq
    have hyx : B y x = -1 := by rw [hskew, hxy]
    simp [hxy, hyx, bilin_self_eq_zero B hskew] at hp hq
    have ha : a = 0 := by linarith
    have hb : b = 0 := by linarith
    apply Subtype.ext
    change z = 0
    rw [← hab, ha, hb]
    simp
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ hzero
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp hz)
    have hp := hzero ⟨y, hyW⟩
    have hq := hzero ⟨x, hxW⟩
    change B y z = 0 at hp
    change B x z = 0 at hq
    rw [← hab] at hp hq
    have hyx : B y x = -1 := by rw [hskew, hxy]
    simp [hxy, hyx, bilin_self_eq_zero B hskew] at hp hq
    have ha : a = 0 := by linarith
    have hb : b = 0 := by linarith
    apply Subtype.ext
    change z = 0
    rw [← hab, ha, hb]
    simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.split_normalized_plane
statement:
private theorem split_normalized_plane (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E)
    (hskew : ∀ x y, B x y = -B y x) (hnd : B.Nondegenerate)
    [IsFiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Nontrivial E] :
    ∃ (x y : E) (W U : Submodule ℝ E),
      B x y = 1 ∧ W = Submodule.span ℝ ({x, y} : Set E) ∧
      U = B.orthogonal W ∧ IsCompl W U ∧
      (B.restrict U).Nondegenerate ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ W = 2 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ U = Module.finrank ℝ E - 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_normalized_pair B hnd
  let W : Submodule ℝ E := Submodule.span ℝ ({x, y} : Set E)
  let U : Submodule ℝ E := B.orthogonal W
  have hrefl : B.IsRefl := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hskew b a, hab, neg_zero]
  have hWnondeg : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate := by
    simpa [W] using normalized_plane_nondegenerate B hskew hxy
  have hcompl : IsCompl W U := by
    simpa [U] using B.isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate hrefl hWnondeg
  have hUorth : B.orthogonal U = W := by
    simpa [U] using B.orthogonal_orthogonal hnd hrefl W
  have hUnondeg : (B.restrict U).Nondegenerate := by
    apply B.nondegenerate_restrict_of_disjoint_orthogonal hrefl
    rw [hUorth]
    exact hcompl.symm.disjoint
  have hlin : LinearIndependent ℝ ![x, y] :=
    normalized_pair_linearIndependent B hskew hxy
  have hWdim : Module.finrank ℝ W = 2 := by
    change Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ ({x, y} : Set E)) = 2
    rw [show ({x, y} : Set E) = Set.range ![x, y] by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro (rfl | rfl)
        · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
        fin_cases i <;> simp]
    simpa using finrank_span_eq_card hlin
  have hUdim : Module.finrank ℝ U = Module.finrank ℝ E - 2 := by
    rw [show U = B.orthogonal W by rfl, B.finrank_orthogonal hnd, hWdim]
  exact ⟨x, y, W, U, hxy, rfl, rfl, hcompl, hUnondeg, hWdim, hUdim⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.prepend_normalized_pair
statement:
private theorem prepend_normalized_pair
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ E) (hskew : ∀ x y, B x y = -B y x)
    {x y : E} (hxy : B x y = 1)
    (W U : Submodule ℝ E) (hW : W = Submodule.span ℝ ({x, y} : Set E))
    (hU : U = B.orthogonal W) (hcompl : IsCompl W U)
    {n : ℕ} (bU : Module.Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ℝ U)
    (hpp : ∀ i j, B (bU (Sum.inl i)) (bU (Sum.inl j)) = 0)
    (hqq : ∀ i j, B (bU (Sum.inr i)) (bU (Sum.inr j)) = 0)
    (hpq : ∀ i j, B (bU (Sum.inl i)) (bU (Sum.inr j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1)) ℝ E,
      (∀ i j, B (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, B (b (Sum.inr i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, B (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hxW : x ∈ W := by rw [hW]; exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  have hyW : y ∈ W := by rw [hW]; exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  let vx : W := ⟨x, hxW⟩
  let vy : W := ⟨y, hyW⟩
  let vW : Fin 2 → W := ![vx, vy]
  have hliW : LinearIndependent ℝ vW := by
    rw [show vW = ![vx, vy] by rfl, LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
    intro a c hac
    have hac' := congrArg Subtype.val hac
    change a • x + c • y = 0 at hac'
    exact LinearIndependent.pair_iff.mp
      (normalized_pair_linearIndependent B hskew hxy) a c hac'
  have hspanW : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range vW) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzpair : (z : E) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ ({x, y} : Set E) := by
      rw [← hW]
      exact z.2
    obtain ⟨a, c, hac⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp hzpair
    have hvx : vx ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range vW) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, by simp [vW, vx]⟩
    have hvy : vy ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range vW) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, by simp [vW, vy]⟩
    have hz' : (z : W) = a • vx + c • vy := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hac.symm
    rw [hz']
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ a hvx) (Submodule.smul_mem _ c hvy)
  let bW₂ : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ W := Module.Basis.mk hliW hspanW
  let bW : Module.Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ W :=
    bW₂.reindex (finSumFinEquiv : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ≃ Fin (1 + 1)).symm
  let bProd : Module.Basis ((Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) ℝ E :=
    (bW.prod bU).map (W.prodEquivOfIsCompl U hcompl)
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1)) ℝ E :=
    bProd.reindex (darbouxIndexEquiv n)
  have bp_zero : b (Sum.inl 0) = x := by
    simp [b, bProd, bW, bW₂, vW, vx, darbouxIndexEquiv]
    rw [finSumFinEquiv_apply_left]
    rfl
  have bq_zero : b (Sum.inr 0) = y := by
    simp [b, bProd, bW, bW₂, vW, vy, darbouxIndexEquiv]
    rw [finSumFinEquiv_apply_right]
    rfl
  have bp_succ (i : Fin n) : b (Sum.inl i.succ) = bU (Sum.inl i) := by
    simp [b, bProd, darbouxIndexEquiv]
  have bq_succ (i : Fin n) : b (Sum.inr i.succ) = bU (Sum.inr i) := by
    simp [b, bProd, darbouxIndexEquiv]
  have hWself (z : W) : B (z : E) (z : E) = 0 := bilin_self_eq_zero B hskew z
  have hxx : B x x = 0 := bilin_self_eq_zero B hskew x
  have hyy : B y y = 0 := bilin_self_eq_zero B hskew y
  have hyx : B y x = -1 := by rw [hskew, hxy]
  have hWU (w : W) (u : U) : B (w : E) (u : E) = 0 := by
    have hu : (u : E) ∈ B.orthogonal W := by simpa [hU] using u.2
    exact hu w w.2
  have hUW (u : U) (w : W) : B (u : E) (w : E) = 0 := by
    have hu : (u : E) ∈ B.orthogonal W := by simpa [hU] using u.2
    rw [hskew, hu w w.2, neg_zero]
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · simpa [bp_zero] using hxx
    · rw [bp_zero, bp_succ]
      exact hWU ⟨x, hxW⟩ (bU (Sum.inl j))
    · rw [bp_succ, bp_zero]
      exact hUW (bU (Sum.inl i)) ⟨x, hxW⟩
    · simpa [bp_succ] using hpp i j
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · simpa [bq_zero] using hyy
    · rw [bq_zero, bq_succ]
      exact hWU ⟨y, hyW⟩ (bU (Sum.inr j))
    · rw [bq_succ, bq_zero]
      exact hUW (bU (Sum.inr i)) ⟨y, hyW⟩
    · simpa [bq_succ] using hqq i j
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
    · simpa [bp_zero, bq_zero] using hxy
    · rw [bp_zero, bq_succ]
      have hj : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ j.succ := (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm
      simp [hj, hWU ⟨x, hxW⟩ (bU (Sum.inr j))]
    · rw [bp_succ, bq_zero]
      simpa using hUW (bU (Sum.inl i)) ⟨y, hyW⟩
    · simpa [bp_succ, bq_succ, Fin.succ_inj] using hpq i j

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.exists_darbouxBasis_bilin
statement:
private theorem exists_darbouxBasis_bilin
    {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ V)
    (hskew : ∀ x y, B x y = -B y x)
    (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) [Module.Finite ℝ V] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ℝ V),
      Module.finrank ℝ V = 2 * n ∧
      (∀ i j, B (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, B (b (Sum.inr i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, B (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  generalize hd : Module.finrank ℝ V = d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing V with
  | h d ih =>
      by_cases hd0 : d = 0
      · subst d
        have hfinzero : Module.finrank ℝ V = 0 := by omega
        haveI : Subsingleton V := Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp hfinzero
        let b : Module.Basis (Fin 0 ⊕ Fin 0) ℝ V := Module.Basis.empty V
        exact ⟨0, b, by simpa using hfinzero, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
      · have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0
        have hfinpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ V := by omega
        letI : Nontrivial V := Module.finrank_pos_iff.mp hfinpos
        letI : LinearSpace ℝ V := ⟨inferInstance⟩
        obtain ⟨x, y, W, U, hxy, hW, hU, hcompl, hUnd, hWdim, hUdim⟩ :=
          split_normalized_plane B hskew hnd
        have hd_ge_two : 2 ≤ d := by
          have hle : Module.finrank ℝ W ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V := Submodule.finrank_le W
          omega
        have hlt : Module.finrank ℝ U < d := by omega
        have hskewU : ∀ a b, B.restrict U a b = -B.restrict U b a := by
          intro a b
          exact hskew a b
        obtain ⟨n, bU, hdimU, hpp, hqq, hpq⟩ :=
          ih (Module.finrank ℝ U) hlt (V := U) (B.restrict U) hskewU hUnd rfl
        obtain ⟨b, hpp', hqq', hpq'⟩ :=
          prepend_normalized_pair B hskew hxy W U hW hU hcompl bU hpp hqq hpq
        refine ⟨n + 1, b, ?_, hpp', hqq', hpq'⟩
        omega

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.exists_darbouxBasis_core
statement:
private theorem exists_darbouxBasis_core [IsFiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ℝ E),
      dim ℝ E = 2 * n ∧
      (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inr i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : ω.toBilin.Nondegenerate := by
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      exact ω.nondegenerate x hx
    · intro x hx
      apply ω.nondegenerate x
      intro y
      rw [ω.skew]
      simp only [SymplecticForm.toBilin_apply] at hx
      rw [hx y, neg_zero]
  simpa only [SymplecticForm.toBilin_apply] using
    exists_darbouxBasis_bilin ω.toBilin ω.skew hnd

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.exists_symplecticBasis
statement:
theorem exists_symplecticBasis [IsFiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p q : Fin n → E),
      dim ℝ E = 2 * n ∧ IsSymplecticBasis ω p q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, b, hdim, hpp, hqq, hpq⟩ := exists_darbouxBasis_core ω
  let p : Fin n → E := fun i => b (Sum.inl i)
  let q : Fin n → E := fun i => b (Sum.inr i)
  refine ⟨n, p, q, hdim, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hpp, hqq, hpq⟩
  have hbfun : Sum.elim p q = (b : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) → E) := by
    funext i
    cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hbfun]
  constructor
  · exact b.linearIndependent
  · exact b.span_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticBasis.even_dim
statement: theorem even_dim (ω : SymplecticForm E) [IsFiniteDimensional ℝ E] : Even (dim ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, p, q, hdim, hb⟩ := exists_symplecticBasis ω
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  omega

theorem exists_dual_basis {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V]

    ∃ φ : Fin n → DualSpace K V,
      IsBasis K φ ∧ ∀ i j, φ i (b j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.TensorExterior.tensor_product_basis
statement:
theorem tensor_product_basis {V : Type v} {W : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup V] [LinearSpace K V] [AddCommGroup W] [LinearSpace K W]
    {n m : ℕ} (b : Fin n → V) (c : Fin m → W)
    (hb : IsBasis K b) (hc : IsBasis K c) :
    IsBasis K (fun p : Fin n × Fin m => pureTensor K (b p.1) (c p.2))
proof:
:= by
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin n) K V := Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  let C : Module.Basis (Fin m) K W := Module.Basis.mk hc.1 (by simpa [hc.2])
  let D := B.tensorProduct C
  have hB (i : Fin n) : B i = b i := by simp [B]
  have hC (j : Fin m) : C j = c j := by simp [C]
  have hD (p : Fin n × Fin m) :
      D p = pureTensor K (b p.1) (c p.2) := by
    rw [show D p = B p.1 ⊗ₜ[K] C p.2 by
      exact Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply' B C p]
    rw [hB, hC]
    rfl
  rw [← funext hD]
  exact ⟨D.linearIndependent, D.span_eq⟩
