name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.LDL_lowerInv_unitLower
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    apply LDL.lowerInv_triangular hA
    change i < j at hij
    exact hij
  · intro i
    rw [LDL.lowerInv, InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_def]
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, sub_eq_self]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro c hc
    rw [Submodule.starProjection_singleton]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
    have hz := LDL.lowerInv_triangular hA (Finset.mem_Iio.mp hc)
    rw [LDL.lowerInv] at hz
    rw [hz]
    simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.LDL_diagEntries_pos
statement:
theorem LDL_diagEntries_pos {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) : ∀ i, 0 < LDL.diagEntries hA i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [LDL.diagEntries, EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp]
  rw [dotProduct_comm, star_star]
  apply hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos
  intro hz
  have hii := congrFun hz i
  change LDL.lowerInv hA i i = 0 at hii
  rw [(LDL_lowerInv_unitLower hA).2 i] at hii
  exact one_ne_zero hii

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.LDL_lower_unitLower
proof:
:= by
  let N := LDL.lowerInv hA
  let L := LDL.lower hA
  let _ := LDL.invertibleLowerInv hA
  have hunit : IsUnit N.det := Matrix.isUnit_det_of_invertible N
  have hNlow : N.IsLowerTriangular := (LDL_lowerInv_unitLower hA).1
  have hNtup : Nᵀ.IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hNlow
    exact hij
  have hNL : N * L = 1 := by
    dsimp only [N, L, LDL.lower]
    exact Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hunit
  have hLtNt : Lᵀ * Nᵀ = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hNL, Matrix.transpose_one]
  have hone : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
    exact if_neg (by
      intro hji
      subst j
      exact lt_irrefl _ hij)
  have hLtup : Lᵀ.IsUpperTriangular :=
    upper_left_factor_of_mul Lᵀ 1 Nᵀ hone hNtup
      (fun i => by simp [N, (LDL_lowerInv_unitLower hA).2 i]) hLtNt
  have hLlow : L.IsLowerTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hLtup
    exact hij
  refine ⟨hLlow, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hprev : ∀ k, k < i → Lᵀ i k = 0 := by
    intro k hki
    apply hLtup
    change k < i
    exact hki
  have heq := mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero Lᵀ Nᵀ i i hNtup hprev
  rw [hLtNt] at heq
  simp only [Matrix.one_apply, if_pos, Matrix.transpose_apply] at heq
  dsimp only [N, L] at heq
  rw [(LDL_lowerInv_unitLower hA).2 i, mul_one] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.choleskyDiagonal_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [choleskyDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, LDL.diag]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simpa [pow_two] using Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (LDL_diagEntries_pos hA i))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.choleskyLower_properties
statement:
theorem choleskyLower_properties {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (choleskyLower hA).IsLowerTriangular ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < choleskyLower hA i i)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := LDL_lower_unitLower hA
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    rw [choleskyLower, choleskyDiagonal, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    rw [hL.1 hij, zero_mul]
  · intro i
    rw [choleskyLower, choleskyDiagonal, Matrix.mul_diagonal, hL.2 i, one_mul]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (LDL_diagEntries_pos hA i)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.choleskyLower_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  rw [choleskyLower, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  have hDt : (choleskyDiagonal hA)ᵀ = choleskyDiagonal hA := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rfl
    · have hji : j ≠ i := fun h => hij h.symm
      simp [choleskyDiagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply, hij, hji]
  rw [hDt]
  calc
    (LDL.lower hA * choleskyDiagonal hA) *
        (choleskyDiagonal hA * (LDL.lower hA)ᵀ) =
        LDL.lower hA *
          (choleskyDiagonal hA * choleskyDiagonal hA) *
            (LDL.lower hA)ᵀ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = LDL.lower hA * LDL.diag hA * (LDL.lower hA)ᵀ := by
      rw [choleskyDiagonal_sq hA]
    _ = A := LDL.lower_conj_diag hA

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_cholesky
statement:
theorem exists_cholesky {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.PosDef) : Nonempty (CholeskyFactorization A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlow, hdiag⟩ := choleskyLower_properties hA
  exact ⟨{
    lower := choleskyLower hA
    lower_triangular := hlow
    lower_diagonal_pos := hdiag
    eq_mul_transpose := (choleskyLower_mul_transpose hA).symm }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.cholesky_cross_factor
statement:
theorem cholesky_cross_factor {n : ℕ}
    (L₁ L₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hL₁ : L₁.IsLowerTriangular) (hdL₁ : ∀ i, 0 < L₁ i i)
    (hprod : L₁ * L₁ᵀ = L₂ * L₂ᵀ) :
    ∃ S, IsOrthogonalMatrix S ∧ L₁ᵀ = S * L₂ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : L₁.det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular L₁ hL₁]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => ne_of_gt (hdL₁ i))
  have hunit : IsUnit L₁.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  let N := L₁⁻¹
  let S := N * L₂
  have hNL : N * L₁ = 1 := by
    dsimp only [N]
    exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul L₁ hunit
  have hLtNt : L₁ᵀ * Nᵀ = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hNL, Matrix.transpose_one]
  have hSR : S * L₂ᵀ = L₁ᵀ := by
    calc
      S * L₂ᵀ = N * (L₂ * L₂ᵀ) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = N * (L₁ * L₁ᵀ) := congrArg (N * ·) hprod.symm
      _ = (N * L₁) * L₁ᵀ := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = L₁ᵀ := by rw [hNL, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hSright : S * Sᵀ = 1 := by
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
    calc
      (N * L₂) * (L₂ᵀ * Nᵀ) = N * (L₂ * L₂ᵀ) * Nᵀ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = N * (L₁ * L₁ᵀ) * Nᵀ := by rw [hprod]
      _ = (N * L₁) * (L₁ᵀ * Nᵀ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hNL, hLtNt, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hSorth : IsOrthogonalMatrix S := by
    rw [isOrthogonalMatrix_iff_mem]
    exact (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin n) ℝ).mpr hSright
  exact ⟨S, hSorth, hSR.symm⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.cholesky_unique
statement:
theorem cholesky_unique {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (fac₁ fac₂ : CholeskyFactorization A) : fac₁.lower = fac₂.lower
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : fac₁.lower * fac₁.lowerᵀ = fac₂.lower * fac₂.lowerᵀ :=
    fac₁.eq_mul_transpose.symm.trans fac₂.eq_mul_transpose
  obtain ⟨S, hSorth, hSR⟩ := cholesky_cross_factor
    fac₁.lower fac₂.lower fac₁.lower_triangular
    fac₁.lower_diagonal_pos hprod
  have hR₁ : fac₁.lowerᵀ.IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    apply fac₁.lower_triangular
    exact hij
  have hR₂ : fac₂.lowerᵀ.IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    apply fac₂.lower_triangular
    exact hij
  let q₁ : PositiveQRFactorization fac₁.lowerᵀ := {
    orthogonal := 1
    upper := fac₁.lowerᵀ
    orthogonal_matrix := by simp [IsOrthogonalMatrix]
    upper_triangular := hR₁
    eq_mul := by simp
    upper_diagonal_pos := by
      intro i
      simpa using fac₁.lower_diagonal_pos i }
  let q₂ : PositiveQRFactorization fac₁.lowerᵀ := {
    orthogonal := S
    upper := fac₂.lowerᵀ
    orthogonal_matrix := hSorth
    upper_triangular := hR₂
    eq_mul := hSR
    upper_diagonal_pos := by
      intro i
      simpa using fac₂.lower_diagonal_pos i }
  have hR := (positive_qr_unique q₁ q₂).2
  apply Matrix.transpose_injective
  exact hR

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_complex_qr
statement:
theorem exists_complex_qr {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    Nonempty (ComplexQRFactorization A)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsUnitaryMatrix (complexQRQ A) := by
    rw [complexQRQ, isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary
      (complexQRBasis A)
  have hR : (complexQRR A).IsUpperTriangular := by
    exact InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis_inv_isUpperTriangular
      finrank_euclideanSpace (complexQRColumns A)
  have hmul : complexQRQ A * complexQRR A = A := by
    rw [complexQRQ, complexQRR, Module.Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix]
    rfl
  exact ⟨{
    unitary := complexQRQ A
    upper := complexQRR A
    unitary_matrix := hU
    upper_triangular := hR
    eq_mul := hmul.symm }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.jordanNormalMatrix_upper
statement:
theorem jordanNormalMatrix_upper (d : JordanFormData ℂ)
    [LinearOrder d.Block] [DecidableEq d.Block] :
    (jordanNormalMatrix d).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  letI := d.blockFintype
  intro p q hpq
  rcases p with ⟨i, k⟩
  rcases q with ⟨j, l⟩
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    have hlk : l < k := by simpa using hpq
    have hsucc : k.val + 1 ≠ l.val := by omega
    simp [jordanNormalMatrix, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, jordanBlock,
      ne_of_gt hlk, hsucc]
  · simp [jordanNormalMatrix, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.jordanNormalMatrix_lex_upper
statement:
theorem jordanNormalMatrix_lex_upper (d : JordanFormData ℂ)
    [LinearOrder d.Block] [DecidableEq d.Block] :
    (Matrix.reindex
      (toLex : (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) ≃
        Lex (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)))
      (toLex : (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)) ≃
        Lex (Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)))
      (jordanNormalMatrix d)).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  letI := d.blockFintype
  intro p q hpq
  rw [Matrix.reindex_apply]
  change (jordanNormalMatrix d) (ofLex p) (ofLex q) = 0
  change Sigma.Lex (· < ·) (fun _ => (· < ·))
      (ofLex q) (ofLex p) at hpq
  rcases hpq with @⟨i, j, a, b, hblock⟩ | @⟨i, a, b, hfiber⟩
  · have hne : j ≠ i := ne_of_gt hblock
    change (jordanNormalMatrix d) ⟨j, b⟩ ⟨i, a⟩ = 0
    simp [jordanNormalMatrix, Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply, hne]
  · exact jordanNormalMatrix_upper d (Sigma.LT.fiber _ _ _ hfiber)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.operatorMatrix_reindex_basis_schur
statement:
theorem operatorMatrix_reindex_basis_schur
    {K V ι κ : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
    [SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.LinearSpace K V]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (b : ι → V)
    (hb : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis K b)
    (hb' : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis K
      (fun k => b (e.symm k))) (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix
        (fun k => b (e.symm k)) hb' T =
      Matrix.reindex e e
        (SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix b hb T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B : Module.Basis ι K V := Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  let B' : Module.Basis κ K V := B.reindex e
  have hB (i : ι) : B i = b i := by simp [B]
  have hB' (k : κ) : B' k = b (e.symm k) := by simp [B', hB]
  change LinearMap.toMatrix
      (Module.Basis.mk hb'.1 (by simpa [hb'.2]))
      (Module.Basis.mk hb'.1 (by simpa [hb'.2])) T =
    Matrix.reindex e e
      (LinearMap.toMatrix (Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2]))
        (Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])) T)
  have hmk : Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2]) = B := by
    ext i
    simp [B]
  have hmk' : Module.Basis.mk hb'.1 (by simpa [hb'.2]) = B' := by
    ext k
    simp [hB']
  rw [hmk, hmk']
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, B', Matrix.reindex_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_ordered_jordan_similar
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_jordan_similar {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ∃ (B P Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      B.IsUpperTriangular ∧ P * Q = 1 ∧ Q * P = 1 ∧ B = P * A * Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : (Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ) := Matrix.toLin' A
  letI : IsAlgClosed ℂ :=
    SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.complex_is_algebraically_closed
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_jordan_normal_basis T
  letI := d.blockFintype
  letI : LinearOrder d.Block := (Fintype.equivFin d.Block).linearOrder
  let I := Σ i : d.Block, Fin (d.length i + 1)
  dsimp [HasJordanNormalBasis] at hd
  change ∃ (b : I → (Fin n → ℂ))
    (hb : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis ℂ b),
      SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix b hb T =
        jordanNormalMatrix d at hd
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hmatrix⟩ := hd
  let BasisI : Module.Basis I ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) :=
    Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  have hcard : Fintype.card I = n := by
    have h := Module.finrank_eq_card_basis BasisI
    simpa [I] using h.symm
  let ILex := Lex I
  let toLexI : I ≃ ILex := toLex
  letI : Fintype ILex := Fintype.ofEquiv I toLexI
  have hcardLex : Fintype.card ILex = n := by
    rw [Fintype.card_congr toLexI.symm, hcard]
  let eo : ILex ≃o Fin n := (Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq ILex hcardLex).symm
  let e : I ≃ Fin n := toLexI.trans eo.toEquiv
  let b' : Fin n → (Fin n → ℂ) := fun i => b (e.symm i)
  let B' : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℂ (Fin n → ℂ) := BasisI.reindex e
  have hB' (i : Fin n) : B' i = b' i := by simp [B', BasisI, b', e]
  have hB'fun : (B' : Fin n → (Fin n → ℂ)) = b' := funext hB'
  have hb' : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis ℂ b' := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hB'fun]
      exact B'.linearIndependent
    · rw [← hB'fun]
      simpa using B'.span_eq
  let J := Matrix.reindex e e (jordanNormalMatrix d)
  have hJ : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix b' hb' T = J := by
    rw [operatorMatrix_reindex_basis_schur e b hb hb' T, hmatrix]
  have hJup : J.IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    dsimp only [J]
    rw [show Matrix.reindex e e (jordanNormalMatrix d) =
        Matrix.reindex eo.toEquiv eo.toEquiv
          (Matrix.reindex toLexI toLexI
            (jordanNormalMatrix d)) by
      ext p q
      rfl]
    rw [Matrix.reindex_apply]
    apply jordanNormalMatrix_lex_upper d
    exact eo.symm.lt_iff_lt.mpr hij
  let std : Fin n → (Fin n → ℂ) := fun i => Pi.single i 1
  have hstd : SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.VectorSpace.IsBasis ℂ std := by
    let Std := Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n)
    have hStd (i : Fin n) : Std i = std i := by
      ext j
      simp [Std, std, Pi.basisFun_apply]
    have hStdFun : (Std : Fin n → (Fin n → ℂ)) = std := funext hStd
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hStdFun]
      exact Std.linearIndependent
    · rw [← hStdFun]
      simpa using Std.span_eq
  have hstandard :
      SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix std hstd T = A := by
    change LinearMap.toMatrix (Module.Basis.mk hstd.1 (by simpa [hstd.2]))
      (Module.Basis.mk hstd.1 (by simpa [hstd.2])) T = A
    have heq : Module.Basis.mk hstd.1 (by simpa [hstd.2]) =
        Pi.basisFun ℂ (Fin n) := by
      ext i j
      simp [std, Pi.basisFun_apply]
    rw [heq, LinearMap.toMatrix_eq_toMatrix']
    exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin' A
  let P := SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.transitionMatrix std b' hstd hb'
  let Q := SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.transitionMatrix b' std hb' hstd
  refine ⟨J, P, Q, hJup, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.transitionMatrix_mul_reverse
      std b' hstd hb'
  · exact SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.reverse_mul_transitionMatrix
      std b' hstd hb'
  · rw [← hJ, SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Coordinates.operatorMatrix_change_basis
      std b' hstd hb' T, hstandard]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_upper_similar
statement:
theorem exists_upper_similar {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    ∃ (B P Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      B.IsUpperTriangular ∧ P * Q = 1 ∧ Q * P = 1 ∧ B = P * A * Q
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_ordered_jordan_similar A

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.complex_mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero
statement:
theorem complex_mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero {n : ℕ}
    (S R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (i j : Fin n)
    (hR : R.IsUpperTriangular) (hprev : ∀ k, k < j → S i k = 0) :
    (S * R) i j = S i j * R j j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single j
  · intro k _ hkj
    rcases lt_trichotomy k j with hlt | heq | hgt
    · rw [hprev k hlt, zero_mul]
    · exact (hkj heq).elim
    · have hz : R k j = 0 := by
        apply hR
        change j < k
        exact hgt
      rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.complex_upper_left_factor_of_mul
statement:
theorem complex_upper_left_factor_of_mul {n : ℕ}
    (S R₁ R₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hR₁ : R₁.IsUpperTriangular) (hR₂ : R₂.IsUpperTriangular)
    (hdR₂ : ∀ i, R₂ i i ≠ 0) (hmul : S * R₂ = R₁) :
    S.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  change j < i at hij
  revert hij
  apply wellFounded_lt.induction j
  intro j ih hij
  have hprev : ∀ k, k < j → S i k = 0 := by
    intro k hkj
    exact ih k hkj (hkj.trans hij)
  have heq : S i j * R₂ j j = 0 := by
    rw [← complex_mul_apply_of_upper_of_left_prefix_zero S R₂ i j hR₂ hprev]
    rw [hmul]
    apply hR₁
    change j < i
    exact hij
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp heq).resolve_right (hdR₂ j)

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_complex_schur
statement:
theorem exists_complex_schur {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    Nonempty (ComplexSchurFactorization A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, P, Q, hBup, hPQ, hQP, hB⟩ := exists_upper_similar A
  let fac := Classical.choice (exists_complex_qr Q)
  let U := fac.unitary
  let R := fac.upper
  have hQ : Q = U * R := fac.eq_mul
  have hUleft : Uᴴ * U = 1 := fac.unitary_matrix
  have hUright : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    have hm := (isUnitaryMatrix_iff_mem U).mp fac.unitary_matrix
    exact Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp hm
  have hRP : R * P = Uᴴ := by
    calc
      R * P = 1 * (R * P) := (Matrix.one_mul _).symm
      _ = (Uᴴ * U) * (R * P) := by rw [hUleft]
      _ = Uᴴ * ((U * R) * P) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Uᴴ * (Q * P) := by rw [← hQ]
      _ = Uᴴ := by rw [hQP, Matrix.mul_one]
  let T := Uᴴ * A * U
  have hTR : T * R = R * B := by
    calc
      T * R = Uᴴ * A * (U * R) := by simp only [T, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Uᴴ * A * Q := by rw [← hQ]
      _ = (R * P) * A * Q := by rw [hRP]
      _ = R * (P * A * Q) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = R * B := by rw [hB]
  have hRBup : (R * B).IsUpperTriangular := fac.upper_triangular.mul hBup
  have hRdet : R.det ≠ 0 := by
    have hQdet : Q.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have := congrArg Matrix.det hQP
      simp [Matrix.det_mul, hz] at this
    intro hRzero
    apply hQdet
    rw [hQ, Matrix.det_mul, hRzero, mul_zero]
  have hRdiag : ∀ i, R i i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular fac.upper_triangular] at hRdet
    exact fun i => Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hRdet i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hTup : T.IsUpperTriangular :=
    complex_upper_left_factor_of_mul T (R * B) R hRBup fac.upper_triangular hRdiag hTR
  refine ⟨{
    unitary := U
    upper := T
    unitary_matrix := fac.unitary_matrix
    upper_triangular := hTup
    eq_mul_conjTranspose := ?_ }⟩
  calc
    A = 1 * A * 1 := by simp
    _ = (U * Uᴴ) * A * (U * Uᴴ) := by rw [hUright]
    _ = U * T * Uᴴ := by simp only [T, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_real_invariant_pair
statement:
theorem exists_real_invariant_pair {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    ∃ (a b : ℝ) (x y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      (x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0) ∧
      A *ᵥ x = a • x - b • y ∧
      A *ᵥ y = b • x + a • y
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ := A.map Complex.ofReal
  let T : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) := Matrix.toLin' C
  letI : IsAlgClosed ℂ :=
    SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Complex.complex_is_algebraically_closed
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := Module.End.exists_eigenvalue T
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hz0⟩ :=
    Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff.mp hμ)
  have hz : T z = μ • z := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hzmem
  let x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => (z i).re
  let y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => (z i).im
  refine ⟨μ.re, μ.im, x, y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hxy
    push Not at hxy
    apply hz0
    funext i
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact congrFun hxy.1 i
    · exact congrFun hxy.2 i
  · funext i
    have hi := congrFun hz i
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hi
    simpa [T, C, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, x, y, Complex.mul_re] using hre
  · funext i
    have hi := congrFun hz i
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hi
    simpa [T, C, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
      Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, x, y, Complex.mul_im, add_comm] using him

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_real_invariant_subspace_finrank_le_two
statement:
private theorem exists_real_invariant_subspace_finrank_le_two {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) :
    ∃ W : Submodule ℝ (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      W ≠ ⊥ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ W ≤ 2 ∧
        ∀ v ∈ W, A *ᵥ v ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ := exists_real_invariant_pair A
  let s : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) := {x, y}
  let W : Submodule ℝ (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) := Submodule.span ℝ s
  refine ⟨W, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hW
    rcases hxy with hx0 | hy0
    · apply hx0
      have hxm : x ∈ W := Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (by simp [s])
      rw [hW] at hxm
      simpa using hxm
    · apply hy0
      have hym : y ∈ W := Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (by simp [s])
      rw [hW] at hym
      simpa using hym
  · calc
      Module.finrank ℝ W ≤ s.toFinset.card := finrank_span_le_card s
      _ ≤ 2 := by
        have hcard : ({x, y} : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)).card ≤ 2 := by
          calc
            _ ≤ ({y} : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le x {y}
            _ = 2 := by simp
        simpa only [s, Set.toFinset_insert, Set.toFinset_singleton] using hcard
  · let T : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) := Matrix.toLin' A
    have hmaps : W ≤ W.comap T := by
      change Submodule.span ℝ s ≤ W.comap T
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      intro v hv
      simp only [s, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
      rcases hv with hv | hv
      · rw [hv]
        change A *ᵥ x ∈ W
        rw [hx]
        exact W.sub_mem (W.smul_mem a (Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (by simp [s])))
          (W.smul_mem b (Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (by simp [s])))
      · rw [hv]
        change A *ᵥ y ∈ W
        rw [hy]
        exact W.add_mem (W.smul_mem b (Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (by simp [s])))
          (W.smul_mem a (Submodule.mem_span_of_mem (by simp [s])))
    intro v hv
    simpa [T, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] using hmaps hv

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.adaptedOrthonormalBasis_inl_mem
statement:
private theorem adaptedOrthonormalBasis_inl_mem
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.adapted_operator_lowerLeft_zero
statement:
private theorem adapted_operator_lowerLeft_zero
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (W : Submodule ℝ E)
    (hW : ∀ v ∈ W, T v ∈ W)
    (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ Wᗮ)) (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ W)) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (adaptedOrthonormalBasis W).toBasis
        (adaptedOrthonormalBasis W).toBasis T (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  change ((adaptedOrthonormalBasis W).repr
    (T (adaptedOrthonormalBasis W (Sum.inl j)))).ofLp (Sum.inr i) = 0
  rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]
  exact ((Submodule.mem_orthogonal' W _).mp (adaptedOrthonormalBasis_inr_mem W i)) _
    (hW _ (adaptedOrthonormalBasis_inl_mem W j))

statement:

    (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ Wᗮ)) :
    adaptedOrthonormalBasis W (Sum.inr i) =
      (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Wᗮ i : E)
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.orthogonalComplementCompression_matrix
statement:
private theorem orthogonalComplementCompression_matrix
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (W : Submodule ℝ E)
    (i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ Wᗮ)) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Wᗮ).toBasis
        (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Wᗮ).toBasis
        (orthogonalComplementCompression T W) i j =
      LinearMap.toMatrix (adaptedOrthonormalBasis W).toBasis
        (adaptedOrthonormalBasis W).toBasis T (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  change ((stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Wᗮ).repr
      (orthogonalComplementCompression T W (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Wᗮ j))).ofLp i =
    ((adaptedOrthonormalBasis W).repr
      (T (adaptedOrthonormalBasis W (Sum.inr j)))).ofLp (Sum.inr i)
  rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
    adaptedOrthonormalBasis_inr_apply, adaptedOrthonormalBasis_inr_apply]
  exact Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_small_invariant_subspace
statement:
private theorem exists_small_invariant_subspace
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
    (hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    ∃ W : Submodule ℝ E,
      W ≠ ⊥ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ W ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ v ∈ W, T v ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hpos)
  let b₀ := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  let e : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) ≃ Fin (n + 1) := finCongr hn
  let b := b₀.reindex e
  let A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ :=
    LinearMap.toMatrix b.toBasis b.toBasis T
  obtain ⟨Wc, hWc0, hWc2, hWcinv⟩ :=
    exists_real_invariant_subspace_finrank_le_two A
  let φ : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) := b.toBasis.equivFun
  let W : Submodule ℝ E := Wc.map φ.symm.toLinearMap
  refine ⟨W, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hzWc, hz0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hWc0
    intro hW
    have hzW : φ.symm z ∈ W := by
      exact ⟨z, hzWc, rfl⟩
    rw [hW] at hzW
    apply hz0
    simpa using congrArg φ hzW
  · simpa only [W, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq] using hWc2
  · intro v hv
    rcases hv with ⟨z, hzWc, rfl⟩
    have hTz := hWcinv z hzWc
    refine ⟨φ (T (φ.symm z)), ?_, by simp⟩
    have hcoord : φ (T (φ.symm z)) = Matrix.mulVec A z := by
      have hm := LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr
        b.toBasis b.toBasis T (φ.symm z)
      have hzrepr : ⇑(b.toBasis.repr (φ.symm z)) = z := by
        ext i
        simp [φ]
      rw [hzrepr] at hm
      symm
      ext i
      simpa [φ, A] using congrFun hm i
    rw [hcoord]
    exact hTz

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_realSchurDecomposition
statement:
private theorem exists_realSchurDecomposition
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) :
    Nonempty (RealSchurDecomposition T)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : Module.finrank ℝ E = 0
  · exact ⟨RealSchurDecomposition.zero T hzero⟩
  · have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ E := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    obtain ⟨W, hW0, hW2, hWinv⟩ := exists_small_invariant_subspace T hpos
    have hWpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ W := by
      exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ((Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.not).mpr hW0)
    have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ Wᗮ < Module.finrank ℝ E := by
      rw [← W.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal]
      omega
    obtain ⟨tail⟩ := exists_realSchurDecomposition (orthogonalComplementCompression T W)
    exact ⟨RealSchurDecomposition.block T W hW0 hW2 hWinv tail⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith_inl_mem
statement:
private theorem adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith_inl_mem

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.adaptedWith_operator_lowerLeft_zero
statement:
private theorem adaptedWith_operator_lowerLeft_zero
    {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (W : Submodule ℝ E)
    (hW : ∀ v ∈ W, T v ∈ W)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (c : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ Wᗮ)
    (i : ι) (j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ W)) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c).toBasis
      (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c).toBasis T (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  change ((adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c).repr
    (T (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c (Sum.inl j)))).ofLp (Sum.inr i) = 0
  rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith_inr_apply]

    (hW _ (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith_inl_mem W c j))

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.orthogonalComplementCompression_matrix_with
statement:
private theorem orthogonalComplementCompression_matrix_with
    {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) (W : Submodule ℝ E)
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ Wᗮ) (i j : ι) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix c.toBasis c.toBasis
        (orthogonalComplementCompression T W) i j =
      LinearMap.toMatrix (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c).toBasis
        (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c).toBasis T (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  change (c.repr (orthogonalComplementCompression T W (c j))).ofLp i =
    ((adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c).repr
      (T (adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W c (Sum.inr j)))).ofLp (Sum.inr i)
  rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply,
    adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith_inr_apply, adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith_inr_apply]
  exact Submodule.inner_orthogonalProjectionOnto_eq_of_mem_left _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.RealSchurDecomposition.toExplicit
statement:
private theorem RealSchurDecomposition.toExplicit
    {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E}
    (d : RealSchurDecomposition T) : Nonempty (ExplicitRealSchur T)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | @zero E _ _ _ T hzero =>
      let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
      letI : IsEmpty (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) := by
        rw [hzero]
        infer_instance
      exact ⟨{
        ι := Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)
        basis := b
        blockUpper := IsRealSchurBlockUpper.empty _ }⟩
  | block T W hW0 hW2 hWinv tail ih =>
      obtain ⟨tailExplicit⟩ := ih
      letI := tailExplicit.indexFintype
      letI := tailExplicit.indexDecidableEq
      let b := adaptedOrthonormalBasisWith W tailExplicit.basis
      have hWpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℝ W :=
        Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ((Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.not).mpr hW0)
      have hsize : Fintype.card (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ W)) = 1 ∨
          Fintype.card (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ W)) = 2 := by
        simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
        omega
      exact ⟨{
        ι := Fin (Module.finrank ℝ W) ⊕ tailExplicit.ι
        basis := b
        blockUpper := IsRealSchurBlockUpper.block _ hsize
          (adaptedWith_operator_lowerLeft_zero T W hWinv tailExplicit.basis)
          (by
            rw [← funext₂ (orthogonalComplementCompression_matrix_with
              T W tailExplicit.basis)]
            exact tailExplicit.blockUpper) }⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.MatrixDecomposition.exists_explicitRealSchur
statement:
theorem exists_explicitRealSchur
    {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) :
    Nonempty (ExplicitRealSchur T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := exists_realSchurDecomposition T
  exact d.toExplicit

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.operatorMatrix_eq_diagonal_of_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem operatorMatrix_eq_diagonal_of_eigenbasis {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (b : ι → V) (hb : IsEigenbasis T b) :
    ∃ μ : ι → K, operatorMatrix b hb.1 T = Matrix.diagonal μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hb.2 with ⟨μ, hμ⟩
  refine ⟨μ, ?_⟩
  classical
  let B := Module.Basis.mk hb.1.1 (by simpa [hb.1.2])
  have hB (j : ι) : B j = b j := by simp [B]
  change LinearMap.toMatrix B B T = Matrix.diagonal μ
  ext i j
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  rw [show T (B j) = μ j • B j by simpa [hB] using hμ j]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    simp
  · simp [hij]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.eigenbasis_of_operatorMatrix_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem eigenbasis_of_operatorMatrix_eq_diagonal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (b : ι → V) (hb : IsBasis K b) (μ : ι → K)
    (hdiag : operatorMatrix b hb T = Matrix.diagonal μ) : IsEigenbasis T b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hb, μ, ?_⟩
  intro j
  classical
  let B := Module.Basis.mk hb.1 (by simpa [hb.2])
  have hB (j : ι) : B j = b j := by simp [B]
  apply B.repr.injective
  ext i
  have hij := congrFun (congrFun hdiag i) j
  have hrepr : B.repr (b j) = Finsupp.single j 1 := by
    rw [← hB j]
    exact B.repr_self j
  rw [map_smul]
  calc
    B.repr (T (b j)) i = Matrix.diagonal μ i j := by
      simpa [operatorMatrix, B, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply] using hij
    _ = μ j * B.repr (b j) i := by
      rw [hrepr]
      by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.exists_eigenbasis_iff_exists_diagonal_matrix
statement:
theorem exists_eigenbasis_iff_exists_diagonal_matrix {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :
    (∃ b : ι → V, IsEigenbasis T b) ↔
      ∃ (b : ι → V) (hb : IsBasis K b) (μ : ι → K),
        operatorMatrix b hb T = Matrix.diagonal μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    rcases operatorMatrix_eq_diagonal_of_eigenbasis T b hb with ⟨μ, hμ⟩
    exact ⟨b, hb.1, μ, hμ⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, μ, hμ⟩
    exact ⟨b, eigenbasis_of_operatorMatrix_eq_diagonal T b hb μ hμ⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.eigenspace_isSubspace
statement:
theorem eigenspace_isSubspace (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) :
    IsSubspace K (eigenspace K T μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0, by simp [eigenspace]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [eigenspace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx hy ⊢
    rw [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
  · intro c x hx
    simp only [eigenspace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx ⊢
    rw [map_smul, hx, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.geometricMultiplicity_le_algebraicMultiplicity
statement:
theorem geometricMultiplicity_le_algebraicMultiplicity [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) (μ : K) :
    geometricMultiplicity T μ ≤ algebraicMultiplicity T μ
proof:
:= by
  let S : Submodule K V :=
    { carrier := eigenspace K T μ
      zero_mem' := subspace_zero_mem (eigenspace_isSubspace T μ)
      add_mem' := by
        intro x y hx hy
        exact (eigenspace_isSubspace T μ).2.1 hx hy
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c x hx
        exact (eigenspace_isSubspace T μ).2.2 c hx }
  have hS : S = Module.End.eigenspace T μ := by
    ext x
    exact Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.symm
  change Module.finrank K S ≤
    Polynomial.rootMultiplicity μ (LinearMap.charpoly T)
  rw [hS]
  exact LinearMap.finrank_eigenspace_le T μ

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.cayleyHamilton
statement:
theorem cayleyHamilton [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial_aeval
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomial_aeval [IsFiniteDimensional K V] (T : V →ₗ[K] V) :

proof:
:= by
  exact minpoly.aeval K T

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial_dvd_characteristicPolynomial
statement:
theorem minimalPolynomial_dvd_characteristicPolynomial [IsFiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] V) : minimalPolynomial T ∣ characteristicPolynomial T
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.LinearAlgebra.Diagonalization.minimalPolynomial_dvd_of_aeval_eq_zero

theorem minimalPolynomial_dvd_of_aeval_eq_zero [IsFiniteDimensional K V]

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_zero
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_zero (base : ℕ) (hbase : 2 ≤ base) :
    hereditaryNatEncode base hbase 0 = .zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [hereditaryNatEncode, Nat.strongRec_eq]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_of_pos
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_of_pos (base : ℕ) (hbase : 2 ≤ base)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n =
      .add (.mul (.basePow (.digit 1))
        (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase (n / base))) (.digit (n % base))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hereditaryNatEncode, Nat.strongRec_eq]
  simp only [dif_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_valid_eval
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_valid_eval (base : ℕ) (hbase : 2 ≤ base) :
    ∀ n, (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).Valid base ∧
      (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).eval base = n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
      obtain rfl | hn := n.eq_zero_or_pos
      · simp [hereditaryNatEncode_zero, HereditaryBaseExpr.Valid,
          HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
      · rw [hereditaryNatEncode_of_pos base hbase hn]
        have hdiv : n / base < n := Nat.div_lt_self hn
          (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hbase)
        have hrec := ih (n / base) hdiv
        constructor
        · exact ⟨⟨lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hbase, hrec.1⟩,
            Nat.mod_lt n (by omega)⟩
        · simp only [HereditaryBaseExpr.eval, hrec.2, pow_one]
          rw [Nat.div_add_mod]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_omega_lt_ceiling
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_omega_lt_ceiling (base : ℕ) (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (n : ℕ) :
    (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).omegaValue <
      hereditaryNatEncodeOmegaCeiling base hbase n
proof:
:=
  Order.lt_succ _

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.ordinalMul_eq_native
statement:
private theorem ordinalMul_eq_native (a b : Ordinal) :
    ordinalMul a b = a * b
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalMul]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.omega_mul_ordinalPow_omega_nat
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [show ((0 + 1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) = Order.succ 0 by norm_num,
        ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_zero]
      simp [ordinalMul]
  | succ k ih =>
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_succ]
      simp only [← Order.succ_eq_add_one]
      rw [ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_succ]
      rw [ordinalMul_eq_native, ordinalMul_eq_native]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ih]
      congr 2

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.nat_pow_succ_div_self
statement:
private theorem nat_pow_succ_div_self (q k : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    q ^ (k + 1) / q = q ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ]
  exact Nat.mul_div_left _ (by omega)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.nat_pow_succ_mod_self
statement:
private theorem nat_pow_succ_mod_self (q k : ℕ) (_hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    q ^ (k + 1) % q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod_left]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_power_omegaValue
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_power_omegaValue (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      (hereditaryNatEncode q hq (q ^ k)).omegaValue =
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (k : Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation]
      have hone : 1 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hq
      rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hone, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hone,
        hereditaryNatEncode_zero]
      simp [HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue, ordinalPow_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation,
        show q ^ (k + 1) / q = q ^ k from nat_pow_succ_div_self q k hq,
        show q ^ (k + 1) % q = 0 from nat_pow_succ_mod_self q k hq,
        ih]
      simpa using omega_mul_ordinalPow_omega_nat k

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_lt_power_omegaValue
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_lt_power_omegaValue {q k n : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q)
    (hn : n < q ^ k) :
    (hereditaryNatEncode q hq n).omegaValue <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (k : Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hereditaryNatEncode_power_omegaValue q hq k]
  exact hereditaryNatEncode_omega_strictMono q hq hn

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedStepWellFounded.certifiedPredecessor_wellFounded
statement: theorem certifiedPredecessor_wellFounded : WellFounded CertifiedPredecessor
proof:
:= by
  let rank : Hydra → Ordinal.{0} := hydraOrdinal.{0}
  have rankWellFounded : WellFounded (InvImage (· < ·) rank) :=
    ordinal_lt_wellFounded.onFun
  apply rankWellFounded.mono
  intro after before certified
  exact certifiedStep_decreases certified

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedStepWellFounded.certifiedStep_accessible
statement:
theorem certifiedStep_accessible (before : Hydra) :
    Acc CertifiedPredecessor before
proof:
:= by
  exact certifiedPredecessor_wellFounded.apply before

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedStepWellFounded.certifiedStep_induction
proof:
:= by
  intro before
  apply certifiedPredecessor_wellFounded.induction before
  intro current ih
  apply step current
  intro after certified
  exact ih after certified

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.runSteps_add
statement:
private theorem runSteps_add (machine : BinaryMachine n) (first second : ℕ)
    (status : ExecutionStatus n) :
    runSteps machine (first + second) status =
      runSteps machine second (runSteps machine first status)
proof:
:= by
  induction first generalizing status with
  | zero => simp [runSteps]
  | succ first ih =>
      rw [Nat.succ_add, runSteps, ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.runSteps_halted
statement:
private theorem runSteps_halted (machine : BinaryMachine n) (steps : ℕ) (tape : Finset ℤ) :
    runSteps machine steps (.halted tape) = .halted tape
proof:
:= by
  induction steps with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih => simpa [runSteps, executeStep] using ih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.haltedAt_mono
statement:
theorem haltedAt_mono (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    Monotone (HaltedAt machine)
proof:
:= by
  intro first later hle hhalted
  obtain ⟨extra, heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
  unfold HaltedAt at hhalted ⊢
  cases hrun : runSteps machine first (blankStart machine) with
  | running config => simp [haltedTape?, hrun] at hhalted
  | halted tape =>
      rw [heq, runSteps_add, hrun, runSteps_halted]
      simp [haltedTape?]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.classicalBusyBeaverTime_is_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem classicalBusyBeaverTime_is_uniform_bound (n : ℕ) :
    IsUniformHaltingBound n (classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n)
proof:
:= by
  intro machine
  constructor
  · intro hhalts
    have hfirst := machineHaltingTime_spec hhalts
    have hle := (classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue_spec n).1 machine
      (machineHaltingTime machine) hfirst
    exact haltedAt_mono machine hle hfirst.1
  · intro hhalted
    exact (eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_haltedAt machine).mpr
      ⟨classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n, hhalted⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.haltsByFuel_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem haltsByFuel_eq_true_iff (fuel : ℕ) (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    haltsByFuel fuel machine = true ↔ HaltedAt machine fuel
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.haltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem haltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound {n bound : ℕ}
    (hbound : IsUniformHaltingBound n bound)
    (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    haltsByFuel bound machine = true ↔ EventuallyHalts machine
proof:
:= by
  rw [haltsByFuel_eq_true_iff, ← hbound machine]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTimeHaltingBound.haltsBy_classical_time_iff
statement:
theorem haltsBy_classical_time_iff (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    haltsByFuel (classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n) machine = true ↔
      EventuallyHalts machine
proof:
:= by
  exact haltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound
    (classicalBusyBeaverTime_is_uniform_bound n) machine

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCodeHalting.codeHaltsByFuel_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem codeHaltsByFuel_eq_true_iff (fuel : ℕ) (code : MachineCode n) :
    codeHaltsByFuel fuel code = true ↔ CodeHaltedAt code fuel
proof:
:= by
  exact haltsByFuel_eq_true_iff fuel (decodeMachine code)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCodeHalting.codeHaltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound
proof:
:= by
  exact haltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound hbound (decodeMachine code)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCodeHalting.codeHaltsBy_classical_time_iff
statement:
theorem codeHaltsBy_classical_time_iff (code : MachineCode n) :
    codeHaltsByFuel (classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n) code = true ↔
      CodeEventuallyHalts code
proof:
:= by
  exact codeHaltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound
    (classicalBusyBeaverTime_is_uniform_bound n) code

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCodeHalting.binaryMachineCode_halting_specification
proof:
:= by
  exact codeHaltsByFuel_decides_of_uniform_bound hbound code

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.equinumerous_iff_exists_bijective
statement:
theorem equinumerous_iff_exists_bijective {α β : Type*} :
    Equinumerous α β ↔ ∃ f : α → β, Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact ⟨e, e.bijective⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective f hf⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.equinumerous_implies_both_le
statement:
theorem equinumerous_implies_both_le {α β : Type*} (h : Equinumerous α β) :
    CardinalLE α β ∧ CardinalLE β α
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨e⟩
  exact ⟨⟨e, e.injective⟩, ⟨e.symm, e.symm.injective⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalLE_refl
statement: theorem cardinalLE_refl (α : Type*) : CardinalLE α α
proof:
:=
  ⟨id, fun _ _ h => h⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalLE_trans
statement:
theorem cardinalLE_trans {α β γ : Type*} (hαβ : CardinalLE α β)
    (hβγ : CardinalLE β γ) : CardinalLE α γ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hαβ with ⟨f, hf⟩
  rcases hβγ with ⟨g, hg⟩
  exact ⟨g ∘ f, hg.comp hf⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cantor_bernstein
statement:
theorem cantor_bernstein {α β : Type*} (hαβ : CardinalLE α β) (hβα : CardinalLE β α) :
    Equinumerous α β
proof:
:= by
  rcases hαβ with ⟨f, hf⟩
  rcases hβα with ⟨g, hg⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Embedding.schroeder_bernstein hf hg
  exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective h hh⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalLE_antisymm
statement:
theorem cardinalLE_antisymm {α β : Type*} (hαβ : CardinalLE α β)
    (hβα : CardinalLE β α) : Equinumerous α β
proof:
:=
  cantor_bernstein hαβ hβα

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cantor_no_surjection
statement: theorem cantor_no_surjection {α : Type*} (f : α → Set α) : ¬ Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  intro hf
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf (diagonalSet f)
  by_cases hD : a ∈ diagonalSet f
  · 
    have hnot : a ∉ f a := hD
    exact hnot (ha ▸ hD)
  · 
    have hmem : a ∈ f a := by
      simpa [diagonalSet] using hD
    exact hD (ha ▸ hmem)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cantor_not_equinumerous
statement: theorem cantor_not_equinumerous (α : Type*) : ¬ Equinumerous α (Set α)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  exact cantor_no_surjection e e.surjective

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalLE_powerSet
statement: theorem cardinalLE_powerSet (α : Type*) : CardinalLE α (Set α)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun x => {x}, Set.singleton_injective⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.not_cardinalLE_powerSet_reverse
statement: theorem not_cardinalLE_powerSet_reverse (α : Type*) : ¬ CardinalLE (Set α) α
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact cantor_not_equinumerous α (cantor_bernstein (cardinalLE_powerSet α) h)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cantor_strictly_smaller_powerSet
statement: theorem cantor_strictly_smaller_powerSet (α : Type*) : CardinalLT α (Set α)
proof:
:=
  ⟨cardinalLE_powerSet α, not_cardinalLE_powerSet_reverse α⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalSum_respects_equinumerous
statement:
theorem cardinalSum_respects_equinumerous {α : Type u} {α' : Type v} {β : Type w}
    (h : Equinumerous α α') : Equinumerous (CardinalSum α β) (CardinalSum α' β)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨e⟩
  exact ⟨Equiv.sumCongr e (Equiv.refl β)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalProduct_respects_equinumerous
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨e⟩
  exact ⟨Equiv.prodCongr e (Equiv.refl β)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalPower_respects_equinumerous
statement:
theorem cardinalPower_respects_equinumerous {α : Type u} {α' : Type v} {β : Type w}
    (h : Equinumerous α α') : Equinumerous (CardinalPower α β) (CardinalPower α' β)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨e⟩
  exact ⟨Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl β) e⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.finiteByEnumeration_has_finite_bound
statement:
theorem finiteByEnumeration_has_finite_bound {α : Type u} (h : FiniteByEnumeration α) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, CardinalLE α (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact ⟨n, (equinumerous_implies_both_le hn).1⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.alephLevel_zero_and_successor
statement:
theorem alephLevel_zero_and_successor (o : Ordinal) :
    AlephLevel 0 = Cardinal.aleph0 ∧
      Order.succ (AlephLevel o) = AlephLevel (o + 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨Cardinal.aleph_zero, Cardinal.succ_aleph o⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.bethLevel_zero_and_successor
statement:
theorem bethLevel_zero_and_successor (o : Ordinal) :
    BethLevel 0 = Cardinal.aleph0 ∧
      BethLevel (Order.succ o) = 2 ^ BethLevel o
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨Cardinal.beth_zero, Cardinal.beth_succ o⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinalCofinality_le
statement: theorem cardinalCofinality_le (c : Cardinal) : CardinalCofinality c ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  exact Ordinal.cof_ord_le c

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.aleph0_is_regular
statement: theorem aleph0_is_regular : RegularCardinal Cardinal.aleph0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨le_rfl, Cardinal.isRegular_aleph0.cof_ord⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.regular_not_singular
statement:
theorem regular_not_singular {c : Cardinal} (h : RegularCardinal c) :
    ¬ SingularCardinal c
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, hs⟩
  exact hs.ne (h.2)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.infinite_regular_or_singular
statement:
theorem infinite_regular_or_singular {c : Cardinal} (hc : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ c) :
    RegularCardinal c ∨ SingularCardinal c
proof:
:= by
  rcases (cardinalCofinality_le c).lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hc, hlt⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hc, heq⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.konig_theorem
statement:
theorem konig_theorem {ι : Type u} (κ μ : ι → Cardinal.{v})
    (h : ∀ i, κ i < μ i) : Cardinal.sum κ < Cardinal.prod μ
proof:
:= by
  exact Cardinal.sum_lt_prod κ μ h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.cardinal_lt_power_cofinality
statement:
theorem cardinal_lt_power_cofinality {c : Cardinal} (hc : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ c) :
    c < c ^ CardinalCofinality c
proof:
:= by
  exact Cardinal.lt_power_cof_ord hc

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.choice_and_wellOrder_available
statement:
theorem choice_and_wellOrder_available {ι : Type u} (A : ι → Type v) (α : Type w) :
    ChoiceFor A ∧ WellOrderable α
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun i => Classical.choice (h i)⟩
  · exact ⟨WellOrderingRel, inferInstance⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.CardinalTheory.continuumHypothesis_iff
statement:
theorem continuumHypothesis_iff :
    ContinuumHypothesis ↔
      2 ^ Cardinal.aleph0 = Cardinal.aleph (1 : Ordinal.{0})
proof:
:= by
  change Cardinal.beth 1 = Cardinal.aleph 1 ↔
    2 ^ Cardinal.aleph0 = Cardinal.aleph 1
  rw [Cardinal.beth_one, Cardinal.two_power_aleph0]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GoogologyNotation.conwayShortChain_equations
statement:
theorem conwayShortChain_equations (a b : ℕ) :
    ConwayShortChain.eval (.singleton a) = a ∧
      ConwayShortChain.eval (.pair a b) = a ^ b
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GoogologyNotation.treeValue_iff
statement:
theorem treeValue_iff (colors value : ℕ) :
    IsTREEValue colors value ↔
      IsTREEAdmissible colors value ∧

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.ordinalAdd_eq_native
statement:
private theorem ordinalAdd_eq_native (a b : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalAdd a b = a + b
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalAdd]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.ordinalAdd_lt_of_lt_right
statement:
theorem ordinalAdd_lt_of_lt_right {left right : Ordinal.{u}} (h : left < right)
    (initial : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalAdd initial left < ordinalAdd initial right
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalAdd_eq_native, ordinalAdd_eq_native]
  exact add_lt_add_right h initial

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.forestOrdinal_append_lt
statement:
theorem forestOrdinal_append_lt (initial : List Hydra) {left right : List Hydra}
    (h : forestOrdinal.{u} left < forestOrdinal.{u} right) :
    forestOrdinal.{u} (initial ++ left) <
      forestOrdinal.{u} (initial ++ right)
proof:
:= by
  induction initial with
  | nil => simpa using h
  | cons child initial ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, forestOrdinal]
      exact ordinalAdd_lt_of_lt_right ih _

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.replaceAtWith_prefix_length
statement:
private theorem replaceAtWith_prefix_length {α : Type*}
    (initial replacement suffix : List α) (entry : α) :
    Hydra.replaceAtWith (initial ++ entry :: suffix) initial.length replacement =
      some (initial ++ replacement ++ suffix)
proof:
:= by
  induction initial with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first initial ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.length_cons, Hydra.replaceAtWith]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.rightmostBranchReplicatedCut_isStep
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨[siblings.length, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · simp
    · simp [Hydra.subtreeAt, Hydra.head]
  · simp only [Hydra.chop]
    rw [show (siblings ++ [Hydra.node [Hydra.head]])[siblings.length]? =
        some (.node [Hydra.head]) by simp]
    simp [Hydra.head, Hydra.replaceAtWith, replaceAtWith_prefix_length]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.rightmostBranchReplicatedCut_decreases
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  simp only [hydraOrdinal]
  apply forestOrdinal_append_lt
  have baseCut : OneLevelReplicatedCut stage
      (.node [.node [Hydra.head]])
      (.node (List.replicate (stage + 1) (.node []))) := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  simpa only [hydraOrdinal] using oneLevelReplicatedCut_decreases baseCut

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraSiblingDescent.rightmostBranchReplicatedCut_verified
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨rightmostBranchReplicatedCut_isStep cut,
    rightmostBranchReplicatedCut_decreases cut⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedStrategyTermination.certifiedStrategy_reachesTerminal
statement:
theorem certifiedStrategy_reachesTerminal (strategy : CertifiedStrategySpec) :
    ∀ start, ReachesTerminal strategy start
proof:
:= by
  apply certifiedStep_induction
  intro state ih
  rcases strategy.progress state with terminal | ⟨next, certified⟩
  · exact ⟨0, state, rfl, terminal⟩
  · rcases ih next certified with ⟨steps, endpoint, trajectory, terminal⟩
    exact ⟨steps + 1, endpoint, ⟨next, certified, trajectory⟩, terminal⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedStrategyTermination.certifiedStrategy_terminates_from
statement:
theorem certifiedStrategy_terminates_from (strategy : CertifiedStrategySpec)
    (start : Hydra) :
    ∃ steps endpoint,
      CertifiedExactSteps steps start endpoint ∧ strategy.Terminal endpoint
proof:
:= by
  exact certifiedStrategy_reachesTerminal strategy start

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Hydra.replaceAtWith_erase_count
statement:
private theorem replaceAtWith_erase_count {α : Type*} (weight : α → Nat)
    (xs : List α) (i : Nat) (ys : List α)
    (hpositive : ∀ x, 0 < weight x)
    (hrep : replaceAtWith xs i [] = some ys) :
    (ys.map weight).sum < (xs.map weight).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing i ys with
  | nil => simp [replaceAtWith] at hrep
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp [replaceAtWith] at hrep
          subst ys
          simpa using hpositive x
      | succ i =>
          simp only [replaceAtWith] at hrep
          cases htail : replaceAtWith xs i [] with
          | none => simp [htail] at hrep
          | some tail =>
              simp [htail] at hrep
              subst ys
              have hlt := ih i tail htail
              simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
              omega

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Hydra.ordinalMeasure_decreases_root_cut
statement:
theorem ordinalMeasure_decreases_root_cut (stage i : Nat) (before after : Hydra)
    (hcut : chop stage before [i] = some after) :
    ordinalMeasure after < ordinalMeasure before
proof:
:= by
  cases before with
  | node children =>
      simp only [chop] at hcut
      cases hchild : children[i]? with
      | none => simp [hchild] at hcut
      | some child =>
          simp only [hchild] at hcut
          cases child with
          | node grandchildren =>
              cases grandchildren with
              | nil =>
                  cases hrep : replaceAtWith children i [] with
                  | none => simp [hrep] at hcut
                  | some remaining =>
                      rw [hrep] at hcut
                      change some (.node remaining) = some after at hcut
                      injection hcut with hafter
                      subst after
                      have hsum := replaceAtWith_erase_count nodeCount children i remaining
                        (fun h => by cases h; simp [nodeCount]) hrep
                      have hnat : 1 + (remaining.map nodeCount).sum <
                          1 + (children.map nodeCount).sum := by omega
                      simp only [ordinalMeasure, nodeCount]
                      exact (Nat.cast_lt (α := Ordinal)).2 hnat
              | cons grandchild grandchildren => simp at hcut

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Hydra.single_head_ordinal_descent
statement:
theorem single_head_ordinal_descent (stage : Nat) :
    ordinalMeasure (.node []) < ordinalMeasure (.node [head])
proof:
:= by
  exact ordinalMeasure_decreases_root_cut stage 0 (.node [head]) (.node [])
    (chop_single_head stage)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCoding.decodeMachine_encodeMachine
statement:
theorem decodeMachine_encodeMachine (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    decodeMachine (encodeMachine machine) = machine
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCoding.encodeMachine_decodeMachine
statement:
theorem encodeMachine_decodeMachine (code : MachineCode n) :
    encodeMachine (decodeMachine code) = code
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCoding.exists_unique_machineCode
statement:
theorem exists_unique_machineCode (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    ∃! code : MachineCode n, decodeMachine code = machine
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨encodeMachine machine, decodeMachine_encodeMachine machine, ?_⟩
  intro code hcode
  calc
    code = encodeMachine (decodeMachine code) := (encodeMachine_decodeMachine code).symm
    _ = encodeMachine machine := congrArg encodeMachine hcode

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCoding.decodeMachineNat_encodeMachine
statement:
theorem decodeMachineNat_encodeMachine (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    decodeMachineNat n (encodeMachine machine).val = some machine
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCoding.decodeMachineNat_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem decodeMachineNat_isSome_iff (n code : ℕ) :
    (decodeMachineNat n code).isSome = true ↔
      code < Fintype.card (BinaryMachine (n + 1))
proof:

    simp [decodeMachineNat, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BinaryMachineCoding.binaryMachine_coding_specification
statement:
theorem binaryMachine_coding_specification (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1),
      decodeMachine (encodeMachine machine) = machine) ∧
      (∀ code : MachineCode n, encodeMachine (decodeMachine code) = code)
proof:

  exact ⟨decodeMachine_encodeMachine, encodeMachine_decodeMachine⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_score
statement:
theorem eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_score (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    EventuallyHalts machine ↔ ∃ score, HasHaltingOnesScore machine score
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨steps, tape, halted⟩
    exact ⟨tape.card, steps, tape, halted, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨score, steps, tape, halted, _⟩
    exact ⟨steps, tape, halted⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.haltsWithin_implies_eventuallyHalts
statement:
theorem haltsWithin_implies_eventuallyHalts (fuel : ℕ)
    (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    HaltsWithin fuel machine → EventuallyHalts machine
proof:
:= by
  intro halts
  rcases (haltsWithin_iff_exists_tape fuel machine).mp halts with ⟨tape, halted⟩
  exact ⟨fuel, tape, halted⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.busyBeaverCandidate_le_of_isValue
statement:
theorem busyBeaverCandidate_le_of_isValue {n value : ℕ}
    (hvalue : IsBusyBeaverValue n value)
    (fuel : ℕ) :
    busyBeaverCandidate n fuel ≤ value
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro machine _
  unfold boundedOnesScore
  cases hrun : runSteps machine fuel (blankStart machine) with
  | running config => exact Nat.zero_le value
  | halted tape =>
      apply hvalue.1 machine tape.card
      exact ⟨fuel, tape, by simp [haltedTape?, hrun]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.exists_candidate_eq_of_isValue
proof:
:= by
  rcases hvalue.2 with ⟨machine, fuel, tape, halted, tape_card⟩
  refine ⟨fuel, le_antisymm (busyBeaverCandidate_le_of_isValue hvalue fuel) ?_⟩
  have score_eq : boundedOnesScore fuel machine = value := by
    unfold boundedOnesScore
    cases hrun : runSteps machine fuel (blankStart machine) with
    | running config =>
        rw [hrun] at halted
        cases halted
    | halted finalTape =>
        rw [hrun] at halted
        simp only [haltedTape?, Option.some.injEq] at halted
        subst finalTape
        exact tape_card
  rw [← score_eq]
  exact boundedOnesScore_le_candidate fuel machine

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaver.isBusyBeaverValue_unique
statement:
theorem isBusyBeaverValue_unique {n x y : ℕ} (hx : IsBusyBeaverValue n x)
    (hy : IsBusyBeaverValue n y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.2 with ⟨machineX, hmachineX⟩
  rcases hy.2 with ⟨machineY, hmachineY⟩
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (hy.1 machineX x hmachineX) (hx.1 machineY y hmachineY)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.div_mul_add_div_eq
statement:
private theorem div_mul_add_div_eq (c Q r : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hr : r < c) :
    (c * Q + r) / c = Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_add_div hc, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr, Nat.add_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.div_mul_add_mod_eq
statement:
private theorem div_mul_add_mod_eq (c Q r : ℕ) (hr : r < c) :
    (c * Q + r) % c = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_baseChange_omegaValue
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_baseChange_omegaValue {b c : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (hereditaryNatEncode c (le_trans hb hbc) ((hereditaryNatEncode b hb n).eval c)).omegaValue =
      (hereditaryNatEncode b hb n).omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
      obtain rfl | hn := n.eq_zero_or_pos
      · simp [hereditaryNatEncode_zero, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
      · have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
        have hcpos : 0 < c := by omega
        have hmodc : n % b < c := lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mod_lt n hbpos) hbc
        have hdiv_lt : n / b < n := Nat.div_lt_self hn (by omega)
        have ihq := ih (n / b) hdiv_lt
        have hEval : (hereditaryNatEncode b hb n).eval c =
            c * (hereditaryNatEncode b hb (n / b)).eval c + n % b := by
          rw [hereditaryNatEncode_of_pos b hb hn]
          simp [HereditaryBaseExpr.eval, pow_one]
        rw [hEval,
          hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation c (le_trans hb hbc)
            (c * (hereditaryNatEncode b hb (n / b)).eval c + n % b),
          hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation b hb n,
          div_mul_add_div_eq c _ (n % b) hcpos hmodc,
          div_mul_add_mod_eq c _ (n % b) hmodc,
          ihq]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.canonicalBaseChangeReencoding_preserves
statement:
theorem canonicalBaseChangeReencoding_preserves (s : CanonicalGoodsteinState) :
    CanonicalBaseChangeOmegaCompatible s
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [CanonicalBaseChangeOmegaCompatible, CanonicalGoodsteinState.baseChangeReencodingMeasure,
    CanonicalGoodsteinState.ordinalMeasure, CanonicalGoodsteinState.expression]
    using hereditaryNatEncode_baseChange_omegaValue (b := s.base) (c := s.base + 1)
      s.base_ge_two (Nat.le_succ s.base) s.value

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ConcretePairingCode.natPairingCode_injective

theorem natPairingCode_injective :

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ConwayRecursion.conwayEval_equations
statement:
theorem conwayEval_equations (a b : ℕ) (c : ConwayArrowTerm) :
    (ConwayArrowTerm.singleton a).eval = a ∧
      (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc (ConwayArrowTerm.singleton a) b).eval = a ^ b ∧
      (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc c 1).eval = c.eval
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_def]
  constructor
  · rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_def]
  · cases c with
    | singleton a =>
        rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_2, ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_1, Nat.pow_one]
    | snoc c b =>
        apply ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_3
        intro a h
        cases h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ConwayRecursion.conwayEval_penultimate_one
statement:
theorem conwayEval_penultimate_one (c : ConwayArrowTerm) (b : ℕ) :
    (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc c 1) b).eval =
      c.eval
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with _ | _ | b
  · apply ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_4
    omega
  · rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_3 (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc c 1) (by
      intro a h
      cases h)]
    exact (conwayEval_equations 0 0 c).2.2
  · apply ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_4
    omega

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ConwayRecursion.conwayEval_two_two_two
statement:
theorem conwayEval_two_two_two :
    (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc (.singleton 2) 2) 2).eval = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_7]
  rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_4 _ 2 (by omega)]
  rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_1]
  rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_3 _ (by intro a h; cases h)]
  rw [ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_2]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ConwayRecursion.conwayEval_recursive
statement:
theorem conwayEval_recursive (c : ConwayArrowTerm) (a b : ℕ) :
    (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc c (a + 2)) (b + 2)).eval =
      (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc
        (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc c
          ((ConwayArrowTerm.snoc (ConwayArrowTerm.snoc c (a + 1)) (b + 2)).eval))
        (b + 1)).eval
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ConwayArrowTerm.eval.eq_7 c a b

    boundedOnesScore fuel machine ≤ busyBeaverCandidate n fuel
