    (Finset.mem_univ machine)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.CanonicalGoodsteinState.expression_valid
statement:
theorem CanonicalGoodsteinState.expression_valid (s : CanonicalGoodsteinState) :
    s.expression.Valid s.base
proof:
:=
  (hereditaryNatEncode_valid_eval s.base s.base_ge_two s.value).1

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.CanonicalGoodsteinState.expression_evaluates
statement:
theorem CanonicalGoodsteinState.expression_evaluates (s : CanonicalGoodsteinState) :
    s.expression.eval s.base = s.value
proof:
:=
  (hereditaryNatEncode_valid_eval s.base s.base_ge_two s.value).2

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.canonicalGoodsteinStep_specification
statement:
theorem canonicalGoodsteinStep_specification (s : CanonicalGoodsteinState) :
    (canonicalGoodsteinStep s).base = s.base + 1 ∧
      (canonicalGoodsteinStep s).expression.Valid (s.base + 1) ∧
      (canonicalGoodsteinStep s).expression.eval (s.base + 1) =
        goodsteinStep s.base s.expression
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨rfl, (canonicalGoodsteinStep s).expression_valid,
    (canonicalGoodsteinStep s).expression_evaluates⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.canonicalGoodsteinStep_omega_lt_of_compatible
statement:
theorem canonicalGoodsteinStep_omega_lt_of_compatible
    (s : CanonicalGoodsteinState)
    (hpositive : 0 < s.expression.eval (s.base + 1))
    (hcompatible : CanonicalBaseChangeOmegaCompatible s) :
    (canonicalGoodsteinStep s).ordinalMeasure < s.ordinalMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : goodsteinStep s.base s.expression < s.expression.eval (s.base + 1) := by
    simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue]
    exact Nat.sub_lt hpositive (by decide)
  have hbase : 2 ≤ s.base + 1 := s.base_ge_two.trans (Nat.le_succ s.base)
  have hmono := hereditaryNatEncode_omega_strictMono (s.base + 1) hbase hstep
  change (hereditaryNatEncode (s.base + 1) _
      (goodsteinStep s.base s.expression)).omegaValue < s.expression.omegaValue
  exact hmono.trans_le hcompatible.le

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next_base
statement:
private theorem HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next_base {e : HereditaryBaseExpr}
    {base : ℕ} (hvalid : e.Valid base) : e.Valid (base + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => trivial
  | digit n => exact lt_trans hvalid (Nat.lt_succ_self base)
  | add left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | mul left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | basePow exponent exponentIH => exact exponentIH hvalid

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.ordinalPow_omega_one
statement:
private theorem ordinalPow_omega_one :
    ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) = Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  change ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ 0) = Ordinal.omega0
  rw [ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_zero]
  simp [ordinalMul]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.basePowerOneTail_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem basePowerOneTail_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression = f.head.eval (base + 1) + base ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  have hone_lt_base : 1 < base := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two f.base_ge_two
  have hhead_next : f.head.Valid (base + 1) :=
    HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next_base f.head_valid
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨f.head_valid, hone_lt_base⟩
  · simp [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
  · exact ⟨hhead_next, Nat.lt_succ_self base⟩
  · simp [BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm.expression, goodsteinStep,
      hereditaryBaseChangeValue, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
  · simp only [BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      BasePowerOneTailBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue,
      ordinalPow_omega_one]
    rw [show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue base = f.head.omegaValue + base by
        simp [ordinalAdd],
      show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue Ordinal.omega0 =
          f.head.omegaValue + Ordinal.omega0 by simp [ordinalAdd]]
    exact (add_lt_add_iff_left f.head.omegaValue).2
      (Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 base)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_tailTailVec
statement:
private theorem primrec_tailTailVec {n : ℕ} :
    @Nat.Primrec'.Vec (n + 2) n (fun w : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) => w.tail.tail)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  refine (@Nat.Primrec'.get (n + 2) (Fin.succ (Fin.succ i))).of_eq ?_
  intro w
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_compHeadTail
proof:
:=
  hf.comp' (Nat.Primrec'.cons (Nat.Primrec'.head (n := n + 1)) primrec_tailTailVec)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_stepSum
proof:
:=
  Nat.Primrec'.add.comp₂ _ (Nat.Primrec'.tail (@Nat.Primrec'.head (n := n)))
    (primrec_compHeadTail hf)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_boundedSum
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : @Nat.Primrec' n
      (fun v => Nat.rec 0 (fun y IH => IH + f (y ::ᵥ v)) (b v)) :=
    Nat.Primrec'.prec' hb (Nat.Primrec'.const 0) (primrec_stepSum hf)
  refine hrec.of_eq (fun v => ?_)
  induction b v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => simp [ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_boundedProd
proof:
:= by
  have hh : @Nat.Primrec' (n + 2) (fun w : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) =>
      w.tail.head * f (w.head ::ᵥ w.tail.tail)) :=
    Nat.Primrec'.mul.comp₂ _ (Nat.Primrec'.tail (@Nat.Primrec'.head (n := n)))
      (primrec_compHeadTail hf)
  have hrec : @Nat.Primrec' n
      (fun v => Nat.rec 1 (fun y IH => IH * f (y ::ᵥ v)) (b v)) :=
    Nat.Primrec'.prec' hb (Nat.Primrec'.const 1) hh
  refine hrec.of_eq (fun v => ?_)
  induction b v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => simp [ih, Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_iterated
proof:
:=
  Nat.Primrec'.prec' hcount hbase
    (hstep.comp' (Nat.Primrec'.cons (Nat.Primrec'.tail (@Nat.Primrec'.head (n := n)))
      primrec_tailTailVec))

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_primitiveRecursion_eq_rec
statement:
private theorem primrec_primitiveRecursion_eq_rec (z : ℕ) (step : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    primitiveRecursion z step n = Nat.rec z (fun y IH => step y IH) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [primitiveRecursion, ih]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.primrec_primitiveRecursion
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : @Nat.Primrec' 3 (fun w : List.Vector ℕ 3 => step w.head w.tail.head) :=
    hstep.comp' (Nat.Primrec'.cons (Nat.Primrec'.head (n := 2))
      (Nat.Primrec'.cons (Nat.Primrec'.tail (@Nat.Primrec'.head (n := 1)))
        Nat.Primrec'.nil))
  refine (Nat.Primrec'.prec' (@Nat.Primrec'.head 0) (Nat.Primrec'.const z) h3).of_eq ?_
  intro v
  exact (primrec_primitiveRecursion_eq_rec z step v.head).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.PartialComputability.programOutput_singleValued
statement:
theorem programOutput_singleValued (program : NatProgram) :
    SingleValued (ProgramOutput program)
proof:
:= by
  intro input x y hx hy
  rcases hx with ⟨fuelX, houtX⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨fuelY, houtY⟩
  exact interpretWithin_output_unique houtX houtY

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.PartialComputability.natComputable_implies_partial
statement:
theorem natComputable_implies_partial {f : ℕ → ℕ} :
    NatComputable f → PartialNatComputable (totalFunctionGraph f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨program, hprogram⟩
  refine ⟨?_, program, ?_⟩
  · intro input x y hx hy
    exact hx.trans hy.symm
  · intro input output
    constructor
    · intro hout
      subst output
      exact hprogram input
    · rintro ⟨fuel, hout⟩
      rcases hprogram input with ⟨correctFuel, hcorrect⟩
      exact interpretWithin_output_unique hout hcorrect

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.PartialComputability.decidesPredicate_iff_computesPartial
statement:
theorem decidesPredicate_iff_computesPartial (program : NatProgram) (P : ℕ → Prop) :
    DecidesPredicate program P ↔
      ComputesPartialFunction program (PredicateCharacteristicGraph P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdec input output
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hP, rfl⟩ | ⟨hP, rfl⟩)
      · rcases hdec input with ⟨_, hone⟩ | ⟨hnot, _⟩
        · exact hone
        · exact False.elim (hnot hP)
      · rcases hdec input with ⟨hyes, _⟩ | ⟨_, hzero⟩
        · exact False.elim (hP hyes)
        · exact hzero
    · intro hout
      rcases hdec input with ⟨hP, hone⟩ | ⟨hP, hzero⟩
      · left
        refine ⟨hP, ?_⟩
        exact programOutput_singleValued program hout hone
      · right
        refine ⟨hP, ?_⟩
        exact programOutput_singleValued program hout hzero
  · intro hcompute input
    by_cases hP : P input
    · left
      exact ⟨hP, (hcompute input 1).mp (Or.inl ⟨hP, rfl⟩)⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨hP, (hcompute input 0).mp (Or.inr ⟨hP, rfl⟩)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.PartialComputability.universal_outputs_encode_iff
statement:
theorem universal_outputs_encode_iff (universal : UniversalNatInterpreter)
    (program : NatProgram) (input output : ℕ) :
    universal.Outputs (universal.encode program) input output ↔
      ProgramOutput program input output
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨fuel, hout⟩ <;> refine ⟨fuel, ?_⟩
  · rwa [universal.simulate] at hout
  · rwa [universal.simulate]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.immediateHaltMachine_has_zero_score
statement:
theorem immediateHaltMachine_has_zero_score (n : ℕ) :
    HasHaltingOnesScore (immediateHaltMachine n) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, ∅, ?_, rfl⟩
  simp [runSteps, executeStep, blankStart, immediateHaltMachine, writeSymbol, haltedTape?]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.runSteps_add
statement:
private theorem runSteps_add (machine : BinaryMachine n) (first second : ℕ)
    (status : ExecutionStatus n) :
    runSteps machine (first + second) status =
      runSteps machine second (runSteps machine first status)
proof:
:= by
  induction first generalizing status with
  | zero => simp [runSteps]
  | succ first ih =>
      rw [Nat.succ_add, runSteps, ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.runSteps_halted
statement:
private theorem runSteps_halted (machine : BinaryMachine n) (steps : ℕ) (tape : Finset ℤ) :
    runSteps machine steps (.halted tape) = .halted tape
proof:
:= by
  induction steps with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih => simpa [runSteps, executeStep] using ih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.hasHaltingOnesScore_unique
statement:
theorem hasHaltingOnesScore_unique {machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)} {x y : ℕ}
    (hx : HasHaltingOnesScore machine x) (hy : HasHaltingOnesScore machine y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨stepsX, tapeX, hrunX, rfl⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨stepsY, tapeY, hrunY, rfl⟩
  have statusX : runSteps machine stepsX (blankStart machine) = .halted tapeX := by
    cases hstatus : runSteps machine stepsX (blankStart machine) with
    | running config => simp [haltedTape?, hstatus] at hrunX
    | halted tape =>
        have htape : tape = tapeX := by simpa [haltedTape?, hstatus] using hrunX
        exact congrArg ExecutionStatus.halted htape
  have statusY : runSteps machine stepsY (blankStart machine) = .halted tapeY := by
    cases hstatus : runSteps machine stepsY (blankStart machine) with
    | running config => simp [haltedTape?, hstatus] at hrunY
    | halted tape =>
        have htape : tape = tapeY := by simpa [haltedTape?, hstatus] using hrunY
        exact congrArg ExecutionStatus.halted htape
  by_cases hle : stepsX ≤ stepsY
  · obtain ⟨difference, heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
    rw [heq, runSteps_add, statusX, runSteps_halted] at statusY
    exact congrArg Finset.card (ExecutionStatus.halted.inj statusY)
  · have hYX : stepsY ≤ stepsX := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle)
    obtain ⟨difference, heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hYX
    rw [heq, runSteps_add, statusY, runSteps_halted] at statusX
    exact congrArg Finset.card (ExecutionStatus.halted.inj statusX).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.eventualOnesScore_spec
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventualOnesScore, dif_pos h]
  exact Classical.choose_spec h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.eventualOnesScore_eq
statement:
private theorem eventualOnesScore_eq {machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)} {score : ℕ}
    (h : HasHaltingOnesScore machine score) : eventualOnesScore machine = score
proof:
:= by
  apply hasHaltingOnesScore_unique (eventualOnesScore_spec ⟨score, h⟩) h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.exists_isBusyBeaverValue
statement: theorem exists_isBusyBeaverValue (n : ℕ) : ∃ value, IsBusyBeaverValue n value
proof:
:= by
  let value := classicalBusyBeaverValue n
  have hupper : ∀ machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1), eventualOnesScore machine ≤ value := by
    intro machine
    exact Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ) (f := eventualOnesScore (n := n))
      (Finset.mem_univ machine)
  obtain ⟨machine, _, hmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (Finset.univ : Finset (BinaryMachine (n + 1)))
      ⟨immediateHaltMachine n, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ (eventualOnesScore (n := n))
  refine ⟨value, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro candidate score hscore
    rw [← eventualOnesScore_eq hscore]
    exact hupper candidate
  · by_cases hhalts : ∃ score, HasHaltingOnesScore machine score
    · refine ⟨machine, ?_⟩
      change HasHaltingOnesScore machine (classicalBusyBeaverValue n)
      rw [classicalBusyBeaverValue, hmax]
      exact eventualOnesScore_spec hhalts
    · have hscore : eventualOnesScore machine = 0 := by
        simp [eventualOnesScore, hhalts]
      have hvalue : value = 0 := hmax.trans hscore
      rw [hvalue]
      exact ⟨immediateHaltMachine n, immediateHaltMachine_has_zero_score n⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverExistence.classicalBusyBeaverValue_spec
statement:
theorem classicalBusyBeaverValue_spec (n : ℕ) :
    IsBusyBeaverValue n (classicalBusyBeaverValue n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨value, hvalue⟩ := exists_isBusyBeaverValue n
  rcases hvalue with ⟨hupper, machine, hattain⟩
  have hchosen_le : classicalBusyBeaverValue n ≤ value := by
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro candidate _
    by_cases hhalts : ∃ score, HasHaltingOnesScore candidate score
    · exact hupper candidate _ (eventualOnesScore_spec hhalts)
    · simp [eventualOnesScore, hhalts]
  have hvalue_le : value ≤ classicalBusyBeaverValue n := by
    rw [← eventualOnesScore_eq hattain]
    exact Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ) (f := eventualOnesScore (n := n))
      (Finset.mem_univ machine)
  have value_eq : value = classicalBusyBeaverValue n :=
    le_antisymm hvalue_le hchosen_le
  rw [← value_eq]
  exact ⟨hupper, machine, hattain⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.certifiedGoodsteinState_specification
statement:
theorem certifiedGoodsteinState_specification (s : CertifiedGoodsteinState) :
    2 ≤ s.base ∧ s.expression.Valid s.base ∧
      s.expression.eval s.base = s.value
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨s.base_ge_two, s.expression_valid, s.expression_evaluates⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.goodsteinReencodingStep_specification
statement:
theorem goodsteinReencodingStep_specification {s t : CertifiedGoodsteinState}
    (h : GoodsteinReencodingStep s t) :
    t.base = s.base + 1 ∧
      t.expression.eval t.base = goodsteinStep s.base s.expression
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨h.1, t.expression_evaluates.trans h.2⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.certifiedGoodsteinSequence_step
statement:
theorem certifiedGoodsteinSequence_step {states : ℕ → CertifiedGoodsteinState}
    (h : IsCertifiedGoodsteinSequence states) (n : ℕ) :
    (states (n + 1)).base = (states n).base + 1 ∧
      (states (n + 1)).value = goodsteinStep (states n).base (states n).expression
proof:
:= by
  exact h n

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.omegaValue_equations
statement:
theorem omegaValue_equations (left right exponent : HereditaryBaseExpr) (n : ℕ) :
    HereditaryBaseExpr.zero.omegaValue = 0 ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.digit n).omegaValue = n ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.add left right).omegaValue =
        ordinalAdd left.omegaValue right.omegaValue ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.mul left right).omegaValue =
        ordinalMul left.omegaValue right.omegaValue ∧
      (HereditaryBaseExpr.basePow exponent).omegaValue =
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 exponent.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.equal_expressions_have_equal_ordinalMeasure
statement:
theorem equal_expressions_have_equal_ordinalMeasure {s t : CertifiedGoodsteinState}
    (h : s.expression = t.expression) : s.ordinalMeasure = t.ordinalMeasure
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CertifiedGoodsteinState.ordinalMeasure, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation (base : ℕ) (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (n : ℕ) :
    (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).omegaValue =
      Ordinal.omega0 * (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase (n / base)).omegaValue +
        (n % base : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · simp [hereditaryNatEncode_zero, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
  · rw [hereditaryNatEncode_of_pos base hbase hn]
    simp only [HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue, ordinalPow_omega_one]
    rw [show ordinalMul Ordinal.omega0
          (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase (n / base)).omegaValue =
          Ordinal.omega0 * (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase (n / base)).omegaValue by
          simp [ordinalMul],
      show ordinalAdd
          (Ordinal.omega0 * (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase (n / base)).omegaValue)
          (n % base : ℕ) =
          Ordinal.omega0 * (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase (n / base)).omegaValue +
            (n % base : ℕ) by simp [ordinalAdd]]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_omega_lt_of_div_eq
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_omega_lt_of_div_eq {base : ℕ} (hbase : 2 ≤ base)
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n < m) (hdiv : n / base = m / base) :
    (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).omegaValue <
      (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase m).omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  have hnEq := hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation base hbase n
  have hmEq := hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation base hbase m
  rw [hnEq, hmEq, hdiv]
  apply (add_lt_add_iff_left _).2
  have hnrepr : base * (n / base) + n % base = n := by
    exact Nat.div_add_mod n base
  have hmrepr : base * (m / base) + m % base = m := by
    exact Nat.div_add_mod m base
  rw [hdiv] at hnrepr
  have hmod : n % base < m % base := by omega
  exact_mod_cast hmod

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.omega_blocks_strictly_separated
statement:
private theorem omega_blocks_strictly_separated {a b : Ordinal} {r s : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b) :
    Ordinal.omega0 * a + (r : Ordinal) <
      Ordinal.omega0 * b + (s : Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : (r : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 :=
    Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 r
  have hwithin : Ordinal.omega0 * a + (r : Ordinal) <
      Ordinal.omega0 * a + Ordinal.omega0 :=
    (add_lt_add_iff_left (Ordinal.omega0 * a)).2 hr
  rw [← Ordinal.mul_succ] at hwithin
  have hblocks : Ordinal.omega0 * Order.succ a ≤
      Ordinal.omega0 * b :=
    mul_le_mul_right (Order.succ_le_iff.mpr hab) Ordinal.omega0
  exact hwithin.trans_le (hblocks.trans le_self_add)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryNatEncode_omega_strictMono
statement:
theorem hereditaryNatEncode_omega_strictMono (base : ℕ) (hbase : 2 ≤ base) :
    StrictMono (fun n ↦ (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).omegaValue)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing n with
  | h m ih =>
      by_cases hdiv : n / base = m / base
      · exact hereditaryNatEncode_omega_lt_of_div_eq hbase hnm hdiv
      · have hquot_le : n / base ≤ m / base :=
          Nat.div_le_div_right hnm.le
        have hquot_lt : n / base < m / base :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne hquot_le hdiv
        have hmpos : 0 < m := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le n) hnm
        have hsmaller : m / base < m :=
          Nat.div_lt_self hmpos (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hbase)
        have hrecursive := ih (m / base) hsmaller hquot_lt
        change (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase n).omegaValue <
          (hereditaryNatEncode base hbase m).omegaValue
        have hnEq := hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation base hbase n
        have hmEq := hereditaryNatEncode_omega_equation base hbase m
        rw [hnEq, hmEq]
        exact omega_blocks_strictly_separated hrecursive

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_successor_base
statement:
private theorem HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_successor_base {e : HereditaryBaseExpr}
    {base : ℕ} (hvalid : e.Valid base) : e.Valid (base + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => trivial
  | digit n => exact lt_trans hvalid (Nat.lt_succ_self base)
  | add left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | mul left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | basePow exponent exponentIH => exact exponentIH hvalid

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.ordinalPow_omega_two
proof:
:= by
  change ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ ((1 : ℕ) : Ordinal)) = _
  rw [ordinalPow_succ]
  have hone : ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) =
      Ordinal.omega0 := by
    change ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ 0) = _
    rw [ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_zero]
    simp [ordinalMul]
  rw [hone]
  simp [ordinalMul]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.omega_mul_nat_add_nat_lt_omega_squared
statement:
private theorem omega_mul_nat_add_nat_lt_omega_squared (base : ℕ) :
    Ordinal.omega0 * base + base < Ordinal.omega0 * Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : Ordinal.omega0 * base + base <
      Ordinal.omega0 * base + Ordinal.omega0 :=
    (add_lt_add_iff_left (Ordinal.omega0 * base)).2
      (Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 base)
  rw [← Ordinal.mul_succ] at hfirst
  exact hfirst.trans (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
    (show Order.succ (base : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 by
      rw [Order.succ_eq_add_one, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add]
      exact Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 (base + 1)) Ordinal.omega0_pos)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.basePowerTwoTail_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem basePowerTwoTail_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) + ((base + 1) * base + base) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  have htwo_lt_base : 2 < base := f.base_ge_three
  have hone_lt_next : 1 < base + 1 := by omega
  have hsquare : (base + 1) ^ 2 =
      ((base + 1) * base + base) + 1 := by
    simp [pow_two, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm,
      Nat.add_left_comm]
  have hhead_next : f.head.Valid (base + 1) :=
    HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_successor_base f.head_valid
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨f.head_valid, htwo_lt_base⟩
  · simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [hsquare]
    omega
  · exact ⟨hhead_next, ⟨⟨hone_lt_next, Nat.lt_succ_self base⟩,
      Nat.lt_succ_self base⟩⟩
  · simp only [BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm.expression, goodsteinStep,
      hereditaryBaseChangeValue, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    simp only [pow_one]
    rw [hsquare]
    omega
  · simp only [BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      BasePowerTwoTailBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue,
      ordinalPow_omega_two]
    have hone : ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) =
        Ordinal.omega0 := by
      change ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ 0) = _
      rw [ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_zero]
      simp [ordinalMul]
    rw [hone]
    have htail : ordinalAdd (ordinalMul Ordinal.omega0 base) base =
        Ordinal.omega0 * base + base := by
      rw [show ordinalMul Ordinal.omega0 base =
        Ordinal.omega0 * base by simp [ordinalMul]]
      simp [ordinalAdd]
    rw [htail,
      show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (Ordinal.omega0 * base + base) =
          f.head.omegaValue + (Ordinal.omega0 * base + base) by simp [ordinalAdd],
      show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (Ordinal.omega0 * Ordinal.omega0) =
          f.head.omegaValue + (Ordinal.omega0 * Ordinal.omega0) by simp [ordinalAdd]]
    exact (add_lt_add_iff_left f.head.omegaValue).2
      (omega_mul_nat_add_nat_lt_omega_squared base)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ComputabilityFoundations.natComputable_iff_exists_program
statement:
theorem natComputable_iff_exists_program (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    NatComputable f ↔
      ∃ program : NatProgram, ∀ input, ∃ fuel,
        interpretWithin program fuel input = some (f input)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ComputabilityFoundations.runSteps_add
statement:
private theorem runSteps_add (machine : BinaryMachine n) (first second : ℕ)
    (status : ExecutionStatus n) :
    runSteps machine (first + second) status =
      runSteps machine second (runSteps machine first status)
proof:
:= by
  induction first generalizing status with
  | zero => simp [runSteps]
  | succ first ih =>
      rw [Nat.succ_add, runSteps, ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ComputabilityFoundations.runSteps_halted
statement:
private theorem runSteps_halted (machine : BinaryMachine n) (steps : ℕ) (tape : Finset ℤ) :
    runSteps machine steps (.halted tape) = .halted tape
proof:
:= by
  induction steps with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih => simpa [runSteps, executeStep] using ih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ComputabilityFoundations.interpretWithin_output_unique
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpretWithin at hx hy
  cases hrun₁ : runSteps program.machine fuel₁ (inputStart program input) with
  | running config => simp [hrun₁] at hx
  | halted tape₁ =>
      simp only [hrun₁, Option.some.injEq] at hx
      cases hrun₂ : runSteps program.machine fuel₂ (inputStart program input) with
      | running config => simp [hrun₂] at hy
      | halted tape₂ =>
          simp only [hrun₂, Option.some.injEq] at hy
          subst x
          subst y
          by_cases hle : fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂
          · obtain ⟨extra, heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
            rw [heq, runSteps_add, hrun₁, runSteps_halted] at hrun₂
            exact congrArg Finset.card (ExecutionStatus.halted.inj hrun₂)
          · have hreverse : fuel₂ ≤ fuel₁ := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle)
            obtain ⟨extra, heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hreverse
            rw [heq, runSteps_add, hrun₂, runSteps_halted] at hrun₁
            exact congrArg Finset.card (ExecutionStatus.halted.inj hrun₁).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ComputabilityFoundations.decidesPredicate_iff_computes_characteristic
statement:
theorem decidesPredicate_iff_computes_characteristic (program : NatProgram)
    (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    DecidesPredicate program P ↔ ComputesNatFunction program (characteristicFunction P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h input
    rcases h input with ⟨hP, fuel, hout⟩ | ⟨hP, fuel, hout⟩
    · exact ⟨fuel, by simpa [characteristicFunction, hP] using hout⟩
    · exact ⟨fuel, by simpa [characteristicFunction, hP] using hout⟩
  · intro h input
    by_cases hP : P input
    · left
      rcases h input with ⟨fuel, hout⟩
      exact ⟨hP, fuel, by simpa [characteristicFunction, hP] using hout⟩
    · right
      rcases h input with ⟨fuel, hout⟩
      exact ⟨hP, fuel, by simpa [characteristicFunction, hP] using hout⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.rightmostSpinePath_two
statement:
private theorem rightmostSpinePath_two (ancestors : List (List Hydra))
    (first second : Nat) (rest : List Nat) :
    ∃ next following tail,
      rightmostSpinePath ancestors (first :: second :: rest) =
        next :: following :: tail
proof:
:= by
  induction ancestors with
  | nil => exact ⟨first, second, rest, rfl⟩
  | cons siblings ancestors ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨next, following, tail, pathEq⟩
      exact ⟨siblings.length, next, following :: tail, by
        simp only [rightmostSpinePath, pathEq]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.replaceAtWith_rightmost
statement:
private theorem replaceAtWith_rightmost {α : Type*}
    (initial : List α) (old new : α) :
    Hydra.replaceAtWith (initial ++ [old]) initial.length [new] =
      some (initial ++ [new])
proof:
:= by
  induction initial with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first initial ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.length_cons, Hydra.replaceAtWith]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.replaceAtWith_prefix_length
statement:
private theorem replaceAtWith_prefix_length {α : Type*}
    (initial replacement suffix : List α) (entry : α) :
    Hydra.replaceAtWith (initial ++ entry :: suffix) initial.length replacement =
      some (initial ++ replacement ++ suffix)
proof:
:= by
  induction initial with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first initial ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.length_cons, Hydra.replaceAtWith]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.subtreeAt_plugRightmostSpine
statement:
theorem subtreeAt_plugRightmostSpine (ancestors : List (List Hydra))
    (focus : Hydra) (localPath : List Nat) :
    Hydra.subtreeAt (plugRightmostSpine ancestors focus)
        (rightmostSpinePath ancestors localPath) =
      Hydra.subtreeAt focus localPath
proof:
:= by
  induction ancestors with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons siblings ancestors ih =>
      simp only [plugRightmostSpine, rightmostSpinePath, Hydra.subtreeAt]
      rw [show (siblings ++ [plugRightmostSpine ancestors focus])[siblings.length]? =
          some (plugRightmostSpine ancestors focus) by simp]
      exact ih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.chop_plugRightmostSpine
statement:
theorem chop_plugRightmostSpine (stage : Nat) (ancestors : List (List Hydra))
    (before after : Hydra) (first second : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (cut : Hydra.chop stage before (first :: second :: rest) = some after) :
    Hydra.chop stage (plugRightmostSpine ancestors before)
        (rightmostSpinePath ancestors (first :: second :: rest)) =
      some (plugRightmostSpine ancestors after)
proof:
:= by
  induction ancestors with
  | nil => exact cut
  | cons siblings ancestors ih =>
      rcases rightmostSpinePath_two ancestors first second rest with
        ⟨next, following, tail, pathEq⟩
      rw [pathEq] at ih
      simp [plugRightmostSpine, rightmostSpinePath, pathEq, Hydra.chop, ih,
        replaceAtWith_rightmost]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.hydraOrdinal_plugRightmostSpine_lt
statement:
theorem hydraOrdinal_plugRightmostSpine_lt (ancestors : List (List Hydra))
    {before after : Hydra} (h : hydraOrdinal.{u} after < hydraOrdinal.{u} before) :
    hydraOrdinal.{u} (plugRightmostSpine ancestors after) <
      hydraOrdinal.{u} (plugRightmostSpine ancestors before)
proof:
:= by
  induction ancestors with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons siblings ancestors ih =>
      simp only [plugRightmostSpine, hydraOrdinal]
      apply forestOrdinal_append_lt
      simp only [forestOrdinal, ordinalAdd_zero]
      exact (exponentiation_isNormal Ordinal.one_lt_omega0).strictMono ih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.rightmostSpineReplicatedCut_isStep
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  let localBefore : Hydra :=
    .node (grandparentSiblings ++ [.node (parentSiblings ++ [Hydra.head])])
  let localAfter : Hydra :=
    .node (grandparentSiblings ++
      List.replicate (stage + 1) (.node parentSiblings))
  have headPath : Hydra.IsHeadPosition localBefore
      [grandparentSiblings.length, parentSiblings.length] := by
    constructor
    · simp
    · simp [localBefore, Hydra.subtreeAt, Hydra.head]
  have chopPath : Hydra.chop stage localBefore
      [grandparentSiblings.length, parentSiblings.length] = some localAfter := by
    simp [localBefore, localAfter, Hydra.chop, Hydra.head,
      replaceAtWith_prefix_length]
  refine ⟨rightmostSpinePath ancestors
      [grandparentSiblings.length, parentSiblings.length], ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · rcases rightmostSpinePath_two ancestors grandparentSiblings.length
        parentSiblings.length [] with ⟨next, following, tail, pathEq⟩
      rw [pathEq]
      simp
    · rw [subtreeAt_plugRightmostSpine]
      exact headPath.2
  · exact chop_plugRightmostSpine stage ancestors localBefore localAfter
      grandparentSiblings.length parentSiblings.length [] chopPath

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraRightmostSpineDescent.rightmostSpineReplicatedCut_decreases
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  apply hydraOrdinal_plugRightmostSpine_lt
  exact parentRightmostHeadReplicatedCut_decreases ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalPow_eq_opow
statement:
theorem ordinalPow_eq_opow (a b : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalPow a b = a ^ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
    · simp [ordinalPow]
    · simp [ordinalPow, hb, Ordinal.zero_opow hb]
  induction b using Ordinal.limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp [ordinalPow, ha]
  | add_one b ih =>
      rw [← Order.succ_eq_add_one b, ordinalPow_succ, ih, Ordinal.opow_succ]
      simp [ordinalMul]
  | limit b hb ih =>
      rw [ordinalPow_limit a b ha hb]
      have hfun : (fun x : Set.Iio b => ordinalPow a x.1) =
          (fun x : Set.Iio b => a ^ x.1) := by
        funext x
        exact ih x.1 x.2
      rw [hfun]
      exact (Ordinal.opow_limit ha hb).symm

proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalPow_eq_opow, ordinalPow_eq_opow]
  exact Ordinal.opow_lt_opow_iff_right ha

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedPlayTermination.no_certifiedInfinitePlay
statement: theorem no_certifiedInfinitePlay : IsEmpty CertifiedInfinitePlay
proof:

statement:
theorem PairingCode.pair_injective (coding : PairingCode) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => coding.pair p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x₁, y₁⟩ ⟨x₂, y₂⟩ hp
  change coding.pair x₁ y₁ = coding.pair x₂ y₂ at hp
  have hx : x₁ = x₂ := by
    rw [← coding.left_pair x₁ y₁, ← coding.left_pair x₂ y₂, hp]
  have hy : y₁ = y₂ := by
    rw [← coding.right_pair x₁ y₁, ← coding.right_pair x₂ y₂, hp]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.ComputabilityDiagonal.no_program_decides_selfHalts
statement:
theorem no_program_decides_selfHalts
    (executable : ExecutableUniversalInterpreter)
    (closure : DiagonalFlipClosure executable.universal) :
    ¬∃ decider, DecidesPredicate decider (SelfHalts executable.universal)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨decider, hdecider⟩
  let diagonal := closure.flip decider
  let diagonalCode := executable.universal.encode diagonal
  have hself_iff : SelfHalts executable.universal diagonalCode ↔
      ∃ output, ProgramOutput diagonal diagonalCode output := by
    unfold SelfHalts diagonalCode diagonal
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨output, hout⟩ <;> refine ⟨output, ?_⟩
    · exact (universal_outputs_encode_iff executable.universal
        (closure.flip decider) diagonalCode output).mp hout
    · exact (universal_outputs_encode_iff executable.universal
        (closure.flip decider) diagonalCode output).mpr hout
  have hdiagonal_iff : (∃ output, ProgramOutput diagonal diagonalCode output) ↔
      ¬SelfHalts executable.universal diagonalCode := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨output, hout⟩
      exact ((closure.flip_spec decider hdecider diagonalCode output).mp hout).2
    · intro hnot
      exact ⟨0, (closure.flip_spec decider hdecider diagonalCode 0).mpr ⟨rfl, hnot⟩⟩
  by_cases hself : SelfHalts executable.universal diagonalCode
  · exact (hdiagonal_iff.mp (hself_iff.mp hself)) hself
  · exact hself (hself_iff.mpr (hdiagonal_iff.mpr hself))

  · obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
    · simp [ordinalPow]

  induction b using Ordinal.limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp [ordinalPow, ha]
  | add_one b ih =>

        Ordinal.opow_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOneLevelDescent.ordinalRepeat_eq_mul
statement:
private theorem ordinalRepeat_eq_mul (term : Ordinal) (n : Nat) :
    ordinalRepeat term n = term * (n : Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ordinalRepeat]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [ordinalRepeat, ih]
      rw [ordinalAdd_eq_native]
      calc
        term + term * (n : Ordinal) = term * (1 + (n : Ordinal)) := by
          rw [mul_add, mul_one]
        _ = term * ((n : Ordinal) + 1) := by
          congr 1
          rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        _ = term * ((Nat.succ n : Nat) : Ordinal) := by
          rw [Nat.cast_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOneLevelDescent.ordinalRepeat_omegaPow_lt_succ
statement:
theorem ordinalRepeat_omegaPow_lt_succ (level : Ordinal) (copies : Nat) :
    ordinalRepeat (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 level) copies <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ level)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalRepeat_eq_mul, ordinalPow_succ]
  rw [ordinalMul_eq_native, ordinalPow_eq_native]
  simpa only [Ordinal.opow_succ] using
    Ordinal.opow_mul_lt_opow (Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 copies)
      (Order.lt_succ level)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOneLevelDescent.oneLevelReplicatedCut_isStep
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨[0, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · simp
    · rfl
  · simp [Hydra.chop, Hydra.replaceAtWith, Hydra.head]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOneLevelDescent.oneLevelReplicatedCut_decreases
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal_replicate]
  simp only [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal, ordinalAdd_zero]
  rw [hydraOrdinal_head, ordinalPow_zero]
  simpa only [ordinalPow_zero, Order.succ_eq_add_one, zero_add] using
    ordinalRepeat_omegaPow_lt_succ 0 (stage + 1)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOneLevelDescent.oneLevelReplicatedCut_verified
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨oneLevelReplicatedCut_isStep cut, oneLevelReplicatedCut_decreases cut⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.set_ext
statement: theorem set_ext {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : A = B ↔ ∀ x : α, x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  
  constructor
  · 
    intro h x
    subst h
    exact Iff.rfl
  · 
    intro h
    exact Set.ext h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.inter_distrib_left
statement:
theorem inter_distrib_left {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) :
    A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  ext x
  constructor
  · 
    rintro ⟨hxA, hxBC⟩
    rcases hxBC with hxB | hxC
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxA, hxC⟩
  · 
    rintro (⟨hxA, hxB⟩ | ⟨hxA, hxC⟩)
    · exact ⟨hxA, Or.inl hxB⟩
    · exact ⟨hxA, Or.inr hxC⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.subset_iff_forall_mem
statement:
theorem subset_iff_forall_mem {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) :
    A ⊆ B ↔ ∀ x : α, x ∈ A → x ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.subset_trans
statement: theorem subset_trans {α : Type*} {A B C : Set α} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hBC : B ⊆ C) : A ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  
  intro x hxA
  exact hBC (hAB hxA)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.subset_antisymm
statement: theorem subset_antisymm {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hBA : B ⊆ A) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  
  
  apply (set_ext A B).2
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hxA
    exact hAB hxA
  · intro hxB
    exact hBA hxB

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.empty_subset
statement: theorem empty_subset {α : Type*} (A : Set α) : (∅ : Set α) ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  
  intro x hx
  exact False.elim hx

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.complement_union
statement: theorem complement_union {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : (A ∪ B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    constructor
    · intro hxA
      exact hx (Or.inl hxA)
    · intro hxB
      exact hx (Or.inr hxB)
  · rintro ⟨hxA, hxB⟩ hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact hxA hx
    · exact hxB hx

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.complement_inter
statement: theorem complement_inter {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : (A ∩ B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ∪ Bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  rw [Set.compl_inter]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Set.diff_inter_complement
statement: theorem diff_inter_complement {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : A \ B = A ∩ Bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  
  exact Set.sdiff_eq A B

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedTransitiveDescent.certifiedExactSteps_zero_iff
statement:
theorem certifiedExactSteps_zero_iff {before after : Hydra} :
    CertifiedExactSteps 0 before after ↔ before = after
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedTransitiveDescent.certifiedExactSteps_succ_decreases
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing before with
  | zero =>
      rcases steps with ⟨middle, first, rfl⟩
      exact certifiedStep_decreases first
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases steps with ⟨middle, first, remaining⟩
      exact (ih remaining).trans (certifiedStep_decreases first)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedTransitiveDescent.certifiedTransitivePredecessor_to_transGen
proof:
:= by
  rcases steps with ⟨n, steps⟩
  induction n generalizing before with
  | zero =>
      rcases steps with ⟨middle, first, rfl⟩
      exact Relation.TransGen.single first
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases steps with ⟨middle, first, remaining⟩
      exact (ih remaining).tail first

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedTransitiveDescent.certifiedTransitivePredecessor_wellFounded
statement:
theorem certifiedTransitivePredecessor_wellFounded :
    WellFounded CertifiedTransitivePredecessor
proof:
:= by
  apply certifiedPredecessor_wellFounded.transGen.mono
  intro after before steps
  exact certifiedTransitivePredecessor_to_transGen steps

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraCertifiedTransitiveDescent.certifiedTransitiveStep_induction
statement:
theorem certifiedTransitiveStep_induction {P : Hydra → Prop}
    (step : ∀ before,
      (∀ after, CertifiedTransitiveStep before after → P after) → P before) :
    ∀ before, P before
proof:
:= by
  intro before
  apply certifiedTransitivePredecessor_wellFounded.induction before
  intro current ih
  apply step current
  intro after steps
  exact ih after steps

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Function.injective_comp
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro a b h
  apply hf
  apply hg
  exact h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Function.surjective_comp
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro c
  rcases hg c with ⟨b, hb⟩
  rcases hf b with ⟨a, ha⟩
  
  exact ⟨a, by simpa [Function.comp] using (congrArg g ha).trans hb⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Function.preimage_union
statement:
theorem preimage_union {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (B C : Set β) :
    f ⁻¹' (B ∪ C) = f ⁻¹' B ∪ f ⁻¹' C
proof:
:= by
  
  
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with hfB | hfC
    · exact Or.inl hfB
    · exact Or.inr hfC
  · rintro (hB | hC)
    · exact Or.inl hB
    · exact Or.inr hC

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Function.preimage_inter
statement:
theorem preimage_inter {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (B C : Set β) :
    f ⁻¹' (B ∩ C) = f ⁻¹' B ∩ f ⁻¹' C
proof:
:= by
  
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfB, hfC⟩
    exact ⟨hfB, hfC⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfB, hfC⟩
    exact ⟨hfB, hfC⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Function.bijective_iff_inverse
statement:
theorem bijective_iff_inverse {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) :
    Function.Bijective f ↔
      ∃ g : β → α, Function.LeftInverse g f ∧ Function.RightInverse g f
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  exact Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.haltedAt_iff_exists_tape
proof:
:= by
  unfold HaltedAt
  cases haltedTape? (runSteps machine time (blankStart machine)) <;> simp

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_haltedAt
statement:
theorem eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_haltedAt (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    EventuallyHalts machine ↔ ∃ time, HaltedAt machine time
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨time, tape, halted⟩
    exact ⟨time, (haltedAt_iff_exists_tape machine time).mpr ⟨tape, halted⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨time, halted⟩
    rcases (haltedAt_iff_exists_tape machine time).mp halted with ⟨tape, htape⟩
    exact ⟨time, tape, htape⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.machineHaltingTime_spec
proof:
:= by
  rw [machineHaltingTime, dif_pos h]
  let witness := (eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_haltedAt machine).mp h
  exact ⟨Nat.find_spec witness, fun earlier hearlier => Nat.find_min witness hearlier⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.isFirstHaltingTime_unique
statement:
theorem isFirstHaltingTime_unique {machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)} {x y : ℕ}
    (hx : IsFirstHaltingTime machine x) (hy : IsFirstHaltingTime machine y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · by_contra hnot
    have hxy : y < x := by omega
    exact (hx.2 y hxy) hy.1
  · by_contra hnot
    have hyx : x < y := by omega
    exact (hy.2 x hyx) hx.1

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.machineHaltingTime_eq
statement:
private theorem machineHaltingTime_eq {machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)} {time : ℕ}
    (htime : IsFirstHaltingTime machine time) : machineHaltingTime machine = time
proof:
:= by
  have hhalts : EventuallyHalts machine :=
    (eventuallyHalts_iff_exists_haltedAt machine).mpr ⟨time, htime.1⟩
  exact isFirstHaltingTime_unique (machineHaltingTime_spec hhalts) htime

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.immediateHaltMachine_first_time
statement:
theorem immediateHaltMachine_first_time (n : ℕ) :
    IsFirstHaltingTime (immediateHaltMachine n) 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold HaltedAt
    simp [runSteps, executeStep, blankStart, immediateHaltMachine, writeSymbol, haltedTape?]
  · intro earlier hearlier
    have heq : earlier = 0 := by omega
    subst earlier
    simp [HaltedAt, runSteps, blankStart, haltedTape?]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue_spec
statement:
theorem classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue_spec (n : ℕ) :
    IsBusyBeaverTimeValue n (classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨machine, _, hmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (Finset.univ : Finset (BinaryMachine (n + 1)))
      ⟨immediateHaltMachine n, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ (machineHaltingTime (n := n))
  have hmachine : EventuallyHalts machine := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hzero : machineHaltingTime machine = 0 := by
      simp [machineHaltingTime, hnot]
    have himmediate : machineHaltingTime (immediateHaltMachine n) = 1 :=
      machineHaltingTime_eq (immediateHaltMachine_first_time n)
    have hle : machineHaltingTime (immediateHaltMachine n) ≤
        classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n := by
      exact Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ) (f := machineHaltingTime (n := n))
        (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue, hmax, hzero, himmediate] at hle
    omega
  constructor
  · intro candidate time htime
    rw [← machineHaltingTime_eq htime]
    exact Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ) (f := machineHaltingTime (n := n))
      (Finset.mem_univ candidate)
  · refine ⟨machine, ?_⟩
    rw [classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue, hmax]
    exact machineHaltingTime_spec hmachine

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.exists_isBusyBeaverTimeValue
statement:
theorem exists_isBusyBeaverTimeValue (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ value, IsBusyBeaverTimeValue n value
proof:
:=
  ⟨classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue n, classicalBusyBeaverTimeValue_spec n⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverTime.isBusyBeaverTimeValue_unique
statement:
theorem isBusyBeaverTimeValue_unique {n x y : ℕ}
    (hx : IsBusyBeaverTimeValue n x) (hy : IsBusyBeaverTimeValue n y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.2 with ⟨machineX, hmachineX⟩
  rcases hy.2 with ⟨machineY, hmachineY⟩
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (hy.1 machineX x hmachineX) (hx.1 machineY y hmachineY)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next
statement:
private theorem HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next {e : HereditaryBaseExpr}
    {base : ℕ} (h : e.Valid base) : e.Valid (base + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => trivial
  | digit n => exact lt_trans h (Nat.lt_succ_self base)
  | add left right leftIH rightIH => exact ⟨leftIH h.1, rightIH h.2⟩
  | mul left right leftIH rightIH => exact ⟨leftIH h.1, rightIH h.2⟩
  | basePow exponent exponentIH => exact exponentIH h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.exponentProtocol
statement:
private theorem HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.exponentProtocol {base : ℕ}
    (f : HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm base) :
    f.exponentExpression.Valid base ∧
      f.exponentExpression.eval (base + 1) = (base + 1) ^ f.exponent ∧
      f.exponentExpression.omegaValue =
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨f.exponent_valid, by
    simp [HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.exponentExpression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.eval], by
    rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.borrowedNumber_lt_power
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (base + 1) ^ ((base + 1) ^ k) :=
    pow_pos (Nat.succ_pos base) _
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.natPower_lt_omegaPower
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : ((q ^ k : ℕ) : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 :=
    Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 (q ^ k)
  have hone_le_k : (1 : Ordinal) ≤ (k : Ordinal) := by
    exact_mod_cast hk
  have homega_le : Ordinal.omega0 ≤ ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (k : Ordinal) := by
    rw [ordinalPow_eq_opow]
    simpa using Ordinal.opow_le_opow_right Ordinal.omega0_pos hone_le_k
  exact hfinite.trans_le homega_le

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.borrowedTail_omega_lt
statement:
private theorem HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.borrowedTail_omega_lt {base : ℕ}
    (f : HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm base) :
    f.borrowedTail.omegaValue <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0
        (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal))
proof:
:= by
  let q := base + 1
  have hq : 2 ≤ q := le_trans f.base_ge_two (Nat.le_succ base)
  have hnumber : q ^ (q ^ f.exponent) - 1 < q ^ (q ^ f.exponent) := by
    simp [q, borrowedNumber_lt_power (base := base) (k := f.exponent)]
  have hencoded :
      (hereditaryNatEncode q hq (q ^ (q ^ f.exponent) - 1)).omegaValue <
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((q ^ f.exponent : ℕ) : Ordinal) :=
    hereditaryNatEncode_lt_power_omegaValue hq hnumber
  have hexponent : ((q ^ f.exponent : ℕ) : Ordinal) <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal) :=
    natPower_lt_omegaPower (q := q) (k := f.exponent) f.exponent_positive
  have houter :
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((q ^ f.exponent : ℕ) : Ordinal) <
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0
          (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal)) :=
    omegaPow_lt_omegaPow_iff.mpr hexponent
  change
    (hereditaryNatEncode q hq (q ^ (q ^ f.exponent) - 1)).omegaValue <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0
        (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal))
  exact hencoded.trans houter

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryPowerExponent_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem hereditaryPowerExponent_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) +
          ((base + 1) ^ ((base + 1) ^ f.exponent) - 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  let q := base + 1
  have hq : 2 ≤ q := le_trans f.base_ge_two (Nat.le_succ base)
  rcases f.exponentProtocol with
    ⟨hexponent_valid, hexponent_eval, hexponent_omega⟩
  have hhead_next : f.head.Valid q :=
    HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next f.head_valid
  have houter_pos : 0 < q ^ (q ^ f.exponent) :=
    pow_pos (Nat.succ_pos base) _
  have hborrowed := hereditaryNatEncode_valid_eval q hq
    (q ^ (q ^ f.exponent) - 1)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨f.head_valid, hexponent_valid⟩
  · simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.expression,
      HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.exponentExpression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt houter_pos))]
  · exact ⟨hhead_next, hborrowed.1⟩
  · simp only [HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.borrowedTail,
      HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.expression,
      HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.exponentExpression,
      goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [hborrowed.2, Nat.add_sub_assoc
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt houter_pos))]
  · simp only [HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      HereditaryPowerExponentBorrowForm.expression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
    rw [hexponent_omega]
    rw [show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue f.borrowedTail.omegaValue =
          f.head.omegaValue + f.borrowedTail.omegaValue by simp [ordinalAdd],
      show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0
            (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal))) =
          f.head.omegaValue +
            ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0
              (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (f.exponent : Ordinal)) by
        simp [ordinalAdd]]
    exact (add_lt_add_iff_left f.head.omegaValue).2 f.borrowedTail_omega_lt

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.orderType_classification
statement:
theorem orderType_classification {α β : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop}
    [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] :
    (Ordinal.type r = Ordinal.type s ↔ Nonempty (r ≃r s)) ∧
      Ordinal.type (α := ℕ) (· < ·) = Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨Ordinal.type_eq, Ordinal.type_nat_lt⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.transfinite_induction
statement:
theorem transfinite_induction {P : Ordinal → Prop}
    (step : ∀ α, (∀ β < α, P β) → P α) : ∀ α, P α
proof:
:= by
  intro α
  exact WellFoundedLT.induction α step

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib
statement: private theorem ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib (a b : Ordinal.{u}) : ordinalAdd a b = a + b
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalAdd]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalAdd_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordinalAdd_zero (a : Ordinal.{u}) : ordinalAdd a 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib, add_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalAdd_succ
statement:
theorem ordinalAdd_succ (a b : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalAdd a (Order.succ b) = Order.succ (ordinalAdd a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib, ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib]
  simp only [Order.succ_eq_add_one]
  rw [add_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.addition_not_commutative
statement:
theorem addition_not_commutative :
    ordinalAdd (1 : Ordinal) Ordinal.omega0 = Ordinal.omega0 ∧
      ordinalAdd Ordinal.omega0 (1 : Ordinal) ≠ Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib, ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib]
  exact ⟨Ordinal.add_omega0 Ordinal.one_lt_omega0,
    ne_of_gt (Order.lt_succ Ordinal.omega0)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalMul_eq_mathlib
statement: private theorem ordinalMul_eq_mathlib (a b : Ordinal.{u}) : ordinalMul a b = a * b
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalMul]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalMul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordinalMul_zero (a : Ordinal.{u}) : ordinalMul a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalMul_eq_mathlib, mul_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalMul_succ
statement:
theorem ordinalMul_succ (a b : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalMul a (Order.succ b) = ordinalAdd (ordinalMul a b) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalMul_eq_mathlib, ordinalMul_eq_mathlib, ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib]
  exact Ordinal.mul_succ a b

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.multiplication_not_commutative
statement:
theorem multiplication_not_commutative :
    ordinalMul (2 : Ordinal) Ordinal.omega0 = Ordinal.omega0 ∧
      ordinalMul Ordinal.omega0 (2 : Ordinal) ≠ Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalMul_eq_mathlib, ordinalMul_eq_mathlib]
  constructor
  · exact Ordinal.natCast_mul_omega0 (by decide)
  · rw [Ordinal.mul_two]
    exact ne_of_gt (lt_add_of_pos_right Ordinal.omega0 Ordinal.omega0_pos)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalPow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordinalPow_zero (a : Ordinal.{u}) : ordinalPow a 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [ordinalPow, Ordinal.limitRecOn_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalPow_succ
statement:
theorem ordinalPow_succ (a b : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalPow a (Order.succ b) = ordinalMul (ordinalPow a b) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Order.succ_eq_add_one]
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp [ordinalPow, ordinalMul_eq_mathlib]
  · simp [ordinalPow, ha, Ordinal.limitRecOn_add_one]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalPow_limit
statement:
theorem ordinalPow_limit (a b : Ordinal.{u}) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : IsSuccLimit b) :
    ordinalPow a b = ⨆ x : Set.Iio b, ordinalPow a x.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ordinalPow, ha, ↓reduceIte]
  exact Ordinal.limitRecOn_limit _ _ _ _ hb

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalPow_eq_mathlib
statement: private theorem ordinalPow_eq_mathlib (a b : Ordinal.{u}) : ordinalPow a b = a ^ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
    · simp [ordinalPow]
    · simp [ordinalPow, hb, Ordinal.zero_opow hb]
  induction b using Ordinal.limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp [ordinalPow, ha]
  | add_one b ih =>
      rw [← Order.succ_eq_add_one b, ordinalPow_succ, ordinalMul_eq_mathlib, ih,
        Ordinal.opow_succ]
  | limit b hb ih =>
      rw [ordinalPow_limit a b ha hb]
      have hfun : (fun x : Set.Iio b => ordinalPow a x.1) =
          (fun x : Set.Iio b => a ^ x.1) := by
        funext x
        exact ih x.1 x.2
      rw [hfun]
      exact (Ordinal.opow_limit ha hb).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.successor_and_limit
statement:
theorem successor_and_limit (a : Ordinal) :
    a < Order.succ a ∧ (∀ b, a < b → ¬ b < Order.succ a) ∧ IsSuccLimit Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Order.lt_succ a, ?_, Ordinal.isSuccLimit_omega0⟩
  intro b hab hbs
  exact (not_le_of_gt hab) (Order.lt_succ_iff.mp hbs)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.lt_supremum_iff
statement:
theorem lt_supremum_iff {ι : Type} [Small ι] (f : ι → Ordinal) (a : Ordinal) :
    a < ⨆ i, f i ↔ ∃ i, a < f i
proof: := Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinalCofinality_eq_mathlib
statement:
private theorem ordinalCofinality_eq_mathlib (a : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ordinalCofinality a = a.cof
proof:
:= by
  exact Ordinal.cof_toType a

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.basic_cofinalities
statement:
theorem basic_cofinalities (a : Ordinal) :
    ordinalCofinality 0 = 0 ∧ ordinalCofinality (Order.succ a) = 1 ∧
      ordinalCofinality Ordinal.omega0 = Cardinal.aleph0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalCofinality_eq_mathlib, ordinalCofinality_eq_mathlib,
    ordinalCofinality_eq_mathlib, Order.succ_eq_add_one]
  exact ⟨Ordinal.cof_zero, Ordinal.cof_add_one a, Ordinal.cof_omega0⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.exponentiation_isNormal
statement:
theorem exponentiation_isNormal {a : Ordinal} (ha : 1 < a) :
    IsNormal (fun β : Ordinal ↦ ordinalPow a β)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ordinalPow_eq_mathlib] using Ordinal.isNormal_opow ha

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.cantorNormalForm_reconstructs
statement:
theorem cantorNormalForm_reconstructs (b o : Ordinal) :
    (Ordinal.CNF b o).foldr
      (fun p r ↦ ordinalAdd (ordinalMul (ordinalPow b p.1) p.2) r) 0 = o
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ordinalAdd_eq_mathlib, ordinalMul_eq_mathlib, ordinalPow_eq_mathlib]
  exact Ordinal.CNF.foldr b o

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.epsilonZero_fixed_and_least
statement:
theorem epsilonZero_fixed_and_least :
    ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Ordinal.epsilon 0) = Ordinal.epsilon 0 ∧
      ∀ α : Ordinal, ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 α ≤ α → Ordinal.epsilon 0 ≤ α
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ordinalPow_eq_mathlib]
  exact ⟨Ordinal.omega0_opow_epsilon 0, fun _ h ↦
    Ordinal.epsilon_zero_le_of_omega0_opow_le h⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Ordinal.ordinal_lt_wellFounded
statement: theorem ordinal_lt_wellFounded : WellFounded ((· < ·) : Ordinal → Ordinal → Prop)
proof:
:=
  Ordinal.lt_wf

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverConvergence.runSteps_add
statement:
private theorem runSteps_add (machine : BinaryMachine n) (first second : ℕ)
    (status : ExecutionStatus n) :
    runSteps machine (first + second) status =
      runSteps machine second (runSteps machine first status)
proof:
:= by
  induction first generalizing status with
  | zero => simp [runSteps]
  | succ first ih =>
      rw [Nat.succ_add, runSteps, ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverConvergence.runSteps_halted
statement:
private theorem runSteps_halted (machine : BinaryMachine n) (steps : ℕ) (tape : Finset ℤ) :
    runSteps machine steps (.halted tape) = .halted tape
proof:
:= by
  induction steps with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ steps ih => simpa [runSteps, executeStep] using ih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverConvergence.boundedOnesScore_mono
statement:
theorem boundedOnesScore_mono (machine : BinaryMachine (n + 1)) :
    Monotone (fun fuel => boundedOnesScore fuel machine)
proof:
:= by
  intro first later hle
  obtain ⟨extra, heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
  unfold boundedOnesScore
  change (match runSteps machine first (blankStart machine) with
    | .running _ => 0
    | .halted ones => ones.card) ≤
    (match runSteps machine later (blankStart machine) with
    | .running _ => 0
    | .halted ones => ones.card)
  cases hrun : runSteps machine first (blankStart machine) with
  | running config => simp only; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | halted tape =>
      simp only
      rw [heq, runSteps_add, hrun, runSteps_halted]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverConvergence.busyBeaverCandidate_mono
statement:
theorem busyBeaverCandidate_mono (n : ℕ) :
    Monotone (busyBeaverCandidate n)
proof:
:= by
  intro first later hle
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro machine _
  exact (boundedOnesScore_mono machine hle).trans
    (Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := boundedOnesScore (n := n) later) (Finset.mem_univ machine))

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverConvergence.busyBeaverCandidate_le_classical
statement:
theorem busyBeaverCandidate_le_classical (n fuel : ℕ) :
    busyBeaverCandidate n fuel ≤ classicalBusyBeaverValue n
proof:
:= by
  exact busyBeaverCandidate_le_of_isValue (classicalBusyBeaverValue_spec n) fuel

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.BusyBeaverConvergence.exists_threshold_candidate_eq_classical
statement:
theorem exists_threshold_candidate_eq_classical (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ threshold, ∀ fuel, threshold ≤ fuel →
      busyBeaverCandidate n fuel = classicalBusyBeaverValue n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨threshold, hthreshold⟩ :=
    exists_candidate_eq_of_isValue (classicalBusyBeaverValue_spec n)
  refine ⟨threshold, ?_⟩
  intro fuel hle
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (busyBeaverCandidate_le_classical n fuel)
  rw [← hthreshold]
  exact busyBeaverCandidate_mono n hle

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_larger_base
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => trivial
  | digit n => exact lt_of_lt_of_le hvalid hbase
  | add left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | mul left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | basePow exponent exponentIH => exact exponentIH hvalid

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.finitePowerBorrowExpansion_eval
statement:
theorem finitePowerBorrowExpansion_eval (base k : ℕ) :
    (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base k).eval (base + 1) =
      (base + 1) ^ k - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [finitePowerBorrowExpansion, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [finitePowerBorrowExpansion, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval, ih]
      rw [← Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.one_le_pow k (base + 1) (by omega))]
      simp [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_add]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.finitePowerBorrowExpansion_valid
statement:
theorem finitePowerBorrowExpansion_valid {base k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ base) :
    (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base k).Valid (base + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [finitePowerBorrowExpansion, HereditaryBaseExpr.Valid]
      exact ⟨⟨lt_trans (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk) (Nat.lt_succ_self base),
          Nat.lt_succ_self base⟩,
        ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hk)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.ordinalPow_omega_nat
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [ordinalPow_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      change ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ (k : Ordinal)) =
        Ordinal.omega0 ^ Order.succ (k : Ordinal)
      rw [ordinalPow_succ, Ordinal.opow_succ, ih]
      simp [ordinalMul]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.finitePowerBorrowExpansion_omega_lt
statement:
theorem finitePowerBorrowExpansion_omega_lt (base : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base k).omegaValue <
      Ordinal.omega0 ^ (k : Ordinal)
proof:
| 0 => by simp [finitePowerBorrowExpansion, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
  | k + 1 => by
      simp only [finitePowerBorrowExpansion, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue,
        ordinalPow_omega_nat]
      rw [show ordinalMul (Ordinal.omega0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) base =
          (Ordinal.omega0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * base by simp [ordinalMul],
        show ordinalAdd ((Ordinal.omega0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * base)
            (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base k).omegaValue =
          (Ordinal.omega0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * base +
            (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base k).omegaValue by simp [ordinalAdd]]
      have hsucc_cast : (((k + 1 : ℕ) : Ordinal)) =
          Order.succ (k : Ordinal) := by
        norm_num [Order.succ_eq_add_one]
      rw [hsucc_cast]
      exact Ordinal.opow_mul_add_lt_opow
        (Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 base)
        (finitePowerBorrowExpansion_omega_lt base k) (Order.lt_succ _)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.finitePower_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem finitePower_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : FinitePowerBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) + ((base + 1) ^ f.exponent - 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  have hhead_next : f.head.Valid (base + 1) :=
    HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_larger_base f.head_valid (Nat.le_succ base)
  have hpow_positive : 0 < (base + 1) ^ f.exponent :=
    pow_pos (by omega) f.exponent
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨f.head_valid, f.exponent_valid⟩
  · simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      FinitePowerBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hpow_positive))]
  · exact ⟨hhead_next,
      finitePowerBorrowExpansion_valid (Nat.le_of_lt f.exponent_valid)⟩
  · simp only [FinitePowerBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      FinitePowerBorrowForm.expression, goodsteinStep,
      hereditaryBaseChangeValue, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [finitePowerBorrowExpansion_eval,
      Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hpow_positive))]
  · simp only [FinitePowerBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      FinitePowerBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue,
      ordinalPow_omega_nat]
    rw [show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base f.exponent).omegaValue =
          f.head.omegaValue +
            (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base f.exponent).omegaValue by simp [ordinalAdd],
      show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (Ordinal.omega0 ^ (f.exponent : Ordinal)) =
          f.head.omegaValue + Ordinal.omega0 ^ (f.exponent : Ordinal) by
            simp [ordinalAdd]]
    exact (add_lt_add_iff_left f.head.omegaValue).2
      (finitePowerBorrowExpansion_omega_lt base f.exponent)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.UniversalMachineInstance.decodeNatProgram_pair
statement:
theorem decodeNatProgram_pair (offset : ℕ) (machine : BinaryMachine (offset + 1)) :

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOrdinalAssignment.hydraOrdinal_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hydraOrdinal_head : hydraOrdinal Hydra.head = 0
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOrdinalAssignment.forestOrdinal_append_head
statement:
theorem forestOrdinal_append_head (children : List Hydra) :
    forestOrdinal (children ++ [Hydra.head]) = Order.succ (forestOrdinal children)
proof:
:= by
  induction children with
  | nil =>
      rw [List.nil_append]
      simp only [forestOrdinal]
      rw [hydraOrdinal_head, ordinalPow_zero, ordinalAdd_zero]
      rw [Order.succ_eq_add_one, zero_add]
  | cons child rest ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, forestOrdinal]
      rw [ih, ordinalAdd_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOrdinalAssignment.rightmostRootHeadCut_decreases
proof:
:= by
  rcases cut with ⟨children, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [hydraOrdinal, hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal_append_head]
  exact Order.lt_succ _

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOrdinalAssignment.forestOrdinal_replicate
statement:
theorem forestOrdinal_replicate (copies : Nat) (parent : Hydra) :
    forestOrdinal (List.replicate copies parent) =
      ordinalRepeat (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraOrdinal parent)) copies
proof:
:= by
  induction copies with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ copies ih =>
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, forestOrdinal, ordinalRepeat]
      rw [ih]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraOrdinalAssignment.hydraOrdinal_verified_interfaces
statement:
theorem hydraOrdinal_verified_interfaces :
    (∀ {before after}, RightmostRootHeadCut before after →
      hydraOrdinal after < hydraOrdinal before) ∧
    (∀ copies parent,
      forestOrdinal (List.replicate copies parent) =
        ordinalRepeat (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraOrdinal parent)) copies)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun cut => rightmostRootHeadCut_decreases cut,
    fun copies parent => forestOrdinal_replicate copies parent⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.coeff_omega_lt
statement:
private theorem coeff_omega_lt (o e : Ordinal) :
    Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 o e < Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : e ∈ List.map Prod.fst (Ordinal.CNF Ordinal.omega0 o)
  · obtain ⟨⟨e', c⟩, hc, he'⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    subst he'
    rw [Ordinal.CNF.coeff_of_mem_CNF hc]
    exact Ordinal.CNF.snd_lt Ordinal.one_lt_omega0 hc
  · rw [Ordinal.CNF.coeff_of_notMem_CNF h]
    exact Ordinal.omega0_pos

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.add_lt_omega0
statement:
private theorem add_lt_omega0 {a b : Ordinal} (ha : a < Ordinal.omega0)
    (hb : b < Ordinal.omega0) : a + b < Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Ordinal.lt_omega0.mp ha
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Ordinal.lt_omega0.mp hb
  rw [← Nat.cast_add]
  exact Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 (m + n)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.filter_add_filter_not_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.filter_apply, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  by_cases h : p e
  · rw [if_pos h]
    simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    simp [h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_zero_right
statement: theorem ordNadd_zero_right (a : Ordinal) : ordNadd a 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordNadd, Ordinal.CNF.coeff_zero_right, add_zero, Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_zero_left
statement: theorem ordNadd_zero_left (b : Ordinal) : ordNadd 0 b = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordNadd, Ordinal.CNF.coeff_zero_right, zero_add, Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_comm
statement: theorem ordNadd_comm (a b : Ordinal) : ordNadd a b = ordNadd b a
proof:
:= by
  have h : Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 a + Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 b =
      Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 b + Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 a := by
    ext e
    rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ordinal.lt_omega0.mp (coeff_omega_lt a e)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ordinal.lt_omega0.mp (coeff_omega_lt b e)
    rw [hm, hn, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_comm]
  rw [ordNadd, ordNadd, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_assoc
statement:
theorem ordNadd_assoc (a b c : Ordinal) :
    ordNadd (ordNadd a b) c = ordNadd a (ordNadd b c)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 (ordNadd a b) =
      Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 a + Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 b := by
    rw [ordNadd, Ordinal.CNF.coeff_eval Ordinal.one_lt_omega0
      (fun e => add_lt_omega0 (coeff_omega_lt a e) (coeff_omega_lt b e))]
  have h₂ : Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 (ordNadd b c) =
      Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 b + Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 c := by
    rw [ordNadd, Ordinal.CNF.coeff_eval Ordinal.one_lt_omega0
      (fun e => add_lt_omega0 (coeff_omega_lt b e) (coeff_omega_lt c e))]
  change Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0
      (Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 (ordNadd a b) + Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 c) =
    Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0
      (Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 a + Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 (ordNadd b c))
  rw [h₁, h₂, add_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.mem_abovePart
statement:
private theorem mem_abovePart {e e' : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.mem_negAbovePart

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.mem_atPart
statement:
