name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.mem_belowPart
statement:
private theorem mem_belowPart {e e' : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}
    (h : e' ∈ (belowPart e f).support) : e' < e
proof:
:= by
  rw [belowPart, Finsupp.support_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at h
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (mem_negAbovePart h.1) h.2

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.atPart_eq_single
statement:
private theorem atPart_eq_single (e : Ordinal) (f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal) :
    atPart e f = Finsupp.single e (f e)
proof:
:= by
  ext e'
  rw [atPart, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  by_cases h : e' = e
  · rw [h, if_pos rfl, Finsupp.single_eq_same, negAbovePart, Finsupp.filter_apply,
      if_pos (lt_irrefl e)]
  · rw [if_neg h, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.abovePart_congr
statement:
private theorem abovePart_congr {f g : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal} {e : Ordinal}
    (h : ∀ e', e < e' → f e' = g e') : abovePart e f = abovePart e g
proof:
:= by
  ext e'
  rw [abovePart, abovePart, Finsupp.filter_apply, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  by_cases he : e < e'
  · rw [if_pos he, if_pos he, h e' he]
  · rw [if_neg he, if_neg he]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.eval_belowPart_lt
proof:
:= by
  apply Ordinal.CNF.eval_lt
  · intro e'
    by_cases h : e' ∈ (belowPart e f).support
    · have hmem := h
      rw [belowPart, Finsupp.support_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hmem
      rw [belowPart, Finsupp.filter_apply, if_pos hmem.2, negAbovePart,
        Finsupp.filter_apply, if_pos (not_lt.mpr (mem_negAbovePart hmem.1))]
      exact hf e'
    · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp h]
      exact Ordinal.omega0_pos
  · intro e' h'
    exact mem_belowPart h'

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.eval_eq_above_add_at_add_below
statement:
private theorem eval_eq_above_add_at_add_below {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}
    (e : Ordinal) :
    Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 f =
      Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (abovePart e f) +
        (Ordinal.omega0 ^ e * f e + Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (belowPart e f))
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : abovePart e f + negAbovePart e f = f := by
    rw [abovePart, negAbovePart]
    exact filter_add_filter_not_eq f (fun e' => e < e')
  have hsplit₂ : atPart e f + belowPart e f = negAbovePart e f := by
    rw [atPart, belowPart, negAbovePart]
    exact filter_add_filter_not_eq (negAbovePart e f) (fun e' => e' = e)
  have h₁ : Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 f =
      Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (abovePart e f) +
        Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (negAbovePart e f) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hsplit]
    rw [Ordinal.CNF.eval_add]
    intro e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂
    exact le_trans (mem_negAbovePart h₂) (mem_abovePart h₁).le
  have h₂ : Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (negAbovePart e f) =
      Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (atPart e f) +
        Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (belowPart e f) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hsplit₂]
    rw [Ordinal.CNF.eval_add]
    intro e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂
    rw [mem_atPart h₁]
    exact (mem_belowPart h₂).le
  rw [h₁, h₂, atPart_eq_single, Ordinal.CNF.eval_single]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.eval_lt_eval_of_agree_above
statement:
private theorem eval_lt_eval_of_agree_above {f g : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}
    (hf : ∀ e, f e < Ordinal.omega0) (_hg : ∀ e, g e < Ordinal.omega0)
    {e : Ordinal} (he : ∀ e', e < e' → f e' = g e') (hlt : f e < g e) :
    Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 f < Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 g
proof:
:= by
  have hf' := eval_eq_above_add_at_add_below (f := f) e
  have hg' := eval_eq_above_add_at_add_below (f := g) e
  rw [hf', hg', abovePart_congr he]
  refine (add_lt_add_iff_left _).2 ?_
  calc Ordinal.omega0 ^ e * f e + Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (belowPart e f)
      < Ordinal.omega0 ^ e * f e + Ordinal.omega0 ^ e :=
        add_lt_add_right (eval_belowPart_lt hf e) _
    _ = Ordinal.omega0 ^ e * (f e + 1) := by rw [mul_add, mul_one]
    _ ≤ Ordinal.omega0 ^ e * g e := by
        apply mul_le_mul_right
        rw [← Order.succ_eq_add_one]
        exact Order.succ_le_iff.mpr hlt
    _ ≤ Ordinal.omega0 ^ e * g e + Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0 (belowPart e g) :=
        le_self_add

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.eval_injective
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ordinal.CNF.coeff_eval Ordinal.one_lt_omega0 hf, h,
    Ordinal.CNF.coeff_eval Ordinal.one_lt_omega0 hg]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.exists_agree_above_of_ne
statement:
private theorem exists_agree_above_of_ne {f g : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal} (h : f ≠ g) :
    ∃ e, (∀ e', e < e' → f e' = g e') ∧ f e ≠ g e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s : Finset Ordinal := (f.support ∪ g.support).filter (fun e => f e ≠ g e) with hs_def
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro hempty
    rw [hs_def] at hempty
    apply h
    ext e
    by_cases he : e ∈ f.support ∪ g.support
    · by_cases hdiff : f e = g e
      · exact hdiff
      · exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hdiff⟩)
          (by rw [hempty]; exact Finset.notMem_empty e)
    · rw [Finset.notMem_union] at he
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp he.1, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp he.2]
  refine ⟨s.max' hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e' he'
    by_contra hdiff
    have hmem : e' ∈ s := by
      rw [hs_def]
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hdiff⟩
      by_cases hf : f e' = 0
      · rw [hf] at hdiff
        exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (Ne.symm hdiff)))
      · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hf))
    exact absurd (Finset.le_max' s e' hmem) (not_le.mpr he')
  · have hmax := Finset.max'_mem s hs
    change s.max' hs ∈ (f.support ∪ g.support).filter (fun e => f e ≠ g e) at hmax
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmax).2

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_right
statement:
theorem ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_right {a b c : Ordinal} (h : a < b) :
    ordNadd c a < ordNadd c b
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 a ≠ Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 b := by
    intro heq
    have hEq : a = b := by
      have := congrArg (Ordinal.CNF.eval Ordinal.omega0) heq
      rwa [Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff, Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff] at this
    exact absurd hEq h.ne
  obtain ⟨e, he, hdiff⟩ := exists_agree_above_of_ne hne
  have hlt' : Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 a e < Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 b e := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hdiff with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · have hcontra := eval_lt_eval_of_agree_above (coeff_omega_lt b) (coeff_omega_lt a)
        (fun e' hh => (he e' hh).symm) h'
      rw [Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff, Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff] at hcontra
      exact absurd hcontra (not_lt.mpr h.le)
  rw [ordNadd, ordNadd]
  refine eval_lt_eval_of_agree_above (e := e) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro e'
    exact add_lt_omega0 (coeff_omega_lt c e') (coeff_omega_lt a e')
  · intro e'
    exact add_lt_omega0 (coeff_omega_lt c e') (coeff_omega_lt b e')
  · intro e' he'
    rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, he e' he']
  · rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]
    exact add_lt_add_right hlt' _

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_left
statement:
theorem ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_left {a b c : Ordinal} (h : a < b) :
    ordNadd a c < ordNadd b c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordNadd_comm a c, ordNadd_comm b c]
  exact ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_right h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.coeff_omega_one
statement:
private theorem coeff_omega_one :
    Ordinal.CNF.coeff Ordinal.omega0 (1 : Ordinal) = Finsupp.single 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Ordinal.CNF.coeff_eval Ordinal.one_lt_omega0 (b := Ordinal.omega0)
    (f := Finsupp.single (0 : Ordinal) (1 : Ordinal)) (by
      intro e
      by_cases h : e = 0
      · subst h
        rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same]
        exact Ordinal.one_lt_omega0
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h]
        exact Ordinal.omega0_pos)
  rwa [Ordinal.CNF.eval_single, Ordinal.opow_zero, one_mul] at h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_one
statement: theorem ordNadd_one (a : Ordinal) : ordNadd a 1 = a + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordNadd, coeff_omega_one, Ordinal.CNF.eval_add]
  · rw [Ordinal.CNF.eval_coeff, Ordinal.CNF.eval_single, Ordinal.opow_zero, one_mul]
  · intro e₁ _ e₂ he₂
    have hmem : (Finsupp.single (0 : Ordinal) (1 : Ordinal)) e₂ ≠ 0 :=
      Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he₂
    have hzero : e₂ = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hmem (Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h)
    subst hzero
    exact zero_le

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.coeff_omega_opow_mul
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
  · subst hn
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, Ordinal.CNF.coeff_zero_right,
      Finsupp.single_eq_zero.mpr rfl]
  · have hn' : (n : Ordinal) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hn
    have hlt : (n : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 := Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 n
    have h := Ordinal.CNF.coeff_opow_mul_add (b := Ordinal.omega0) (e := β)
      (x := (n : Ordinal)) (y := 0) Ordinal.one_lt_omega0 hn' hlt
      (Ordinal.opow_pos β Ordinal.omega0_pos)
    rwa [add_zero, Ordinal.CNF.coeff_zero_right, add_zero] at h

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_opow_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordNadd, coeff_omega_opow_mul, coeff_omega_opow_mul, ← Finsupp.single_add,
    ← Nat.cast_add, Ordinal.CNF.eval_single]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.ordNadd_opow_mul_succ
proof:
:= by
  have h := ordNadd_opow_mul β n 1
  rw [Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at h
  rw [← h]
  exact ordNadd_comm _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.hydraGeneralOrdinal_node
statement:
@[simp] theorem hydraGeneralOrdinal_node (children : List Hydra) :
    hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} (.node children) = forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} children
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_cons (child : Hydra) (rest : List Hydra) :
    forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (child :: rest) =
      ordNadd (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} child))
        (forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} rest)
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_nil : forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.hydraGeneralOrdinal_head
statement: @[simp] theorem hydraGeneralOrdinal_head : hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} Hydra.head = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_append
statement:
theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_append (l₁ l₂ : List Hydra) :
    forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      ordNadd (forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} l₁) (forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} l₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => rw [List.nil_append]; exact (ordNadd_zero_left _).symm
  | cons c l₁ ih =>
      rw [List.cons_append, forestGeneralOrdinal_cons, ih, forestGeneralOrdinal_cons,
        ← ordNadd_assoc]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_replicate
statement:
theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_replicate (n : Nat) (x : Hydra) :
    forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (List.replicate n x) =
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} x) * (n : Ordinal.{u})
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [List.replicate_zero]; exact (mul_zero _).symm
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, forestGeneralOrdinal_cons, ih, ordinalPow_eq_opow,
        ordNadd_opow_mul_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_lt_of_child_lt
statement:
theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_lt_of_child_lt {p q : Hydra} (L R : List Hydra)
    (h : hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} q < hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} p) :
    forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (L ++ q :: R) < forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (L ++ p :: R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [forestGeneralOrdinal_append, forestGeneralOrdinal_append,
    forestGeneralOrdinal_cons, forestGeneralOrdinal_cons]
  have h2 : ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} q) <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} p) :=
    (omegaPow_lt_omegaPow_iff).mpr h
  exact ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_right (ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_left h2)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_replicate_lt
statement:
theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_replicate_lt {p q : Hydra} (n : Nat) (L R : List Hydra)
    (h : ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} q) * (n : Ordinal.{u}) <
      ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} p)) :
    forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (L ++ List.replicate n q ++ R) <
      forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (L ++ p :: R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [forestGeneralOrdinal_append, forestGeneralOrdinal_append,
    forestGeneralOrdinal_append, forestGeneralOrdinal_replicate,
    forestGeneralOrdinal_cons]
  simp only [ordNadd_assoc]
  exact ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_right (ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_left h)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.forestGeneralOrdinal_remove_head
statement:
theorem forestGeneralOrdinal_remove_head (L R : List Hydra) :
    forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (L ++ R) <
      forestGeneralOrdinal.{u} (L ++ Hydra.head :: R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [forestGeneralOrdinal_append, forestGeneralOrdinal_append,
    forestGeneralOrdinal_cons, hydraGeneralOrdinal_head, ordinalPow_zero,
    ordNadd_comm (1 : Ordinal.{u}), ordNadd_one]
  exact ordNadd_lt_ordNadd_right (lt_add_one _)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.subtreeAt_cons
proof:
:= by
  cases h : children[i]? <;> simp [Hydra.subtreeAt, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.isHeadPosition_singleton
statement:
private theorem isHeadPosition_singleton {children : List Hydra} {i : Nat}
    (h : Hydra.IsHeadPosition (.node children) [i]) : children[i]? = some Hydra.head
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := h
  rw [subtreeAt_cons] at h2
  cases hb : children[i]? with
  | none => rw [hb] at h2; exact absurd h2 (by simp)
  | some child =>
      rw [hb] at h2
      simp only [Option.bind_some] at h2
      have hchild : child = Hydra.head := by simpa [Hydra.subtreeAt] using h2
      rw [hchild]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.isHeadPosition_cons
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := h
  rw [subtreeAt_cons] at h2
  cases hb : children[i]? with
  | none => rw [hb] at h2; exact absurd h2 (by simp)
  | some child =>
      refine ⟨child, rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [hb] at h2
      simpa using h2

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.exists_decomp_of_getElem?_eq_some
statement:
private theorem exists_decomp_of_getElem?_eq_some {l : List Hydra} {i : Nat} {x : Hydra}
    (h : l[i]? = some x) : ∃ L R : List Hydra, l = L ++ x :: R ∧ L.length = i
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons c l ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h
          exact ⟨[], l, rfl, rfl⟩
      | succ i =>
          simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h
          obtain ⟨L, R, hl, hlen⟩ := ih h
          exact ⟨c :: L, R, by simp [hl], by simp [hlen]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.replaceAtWith_append_cons
statement:
private theorem replaceAtWith_append_cons (L R : List Hydra) (x : Hydra) (repl : List Hydra) :
    Hydra.replaceAtWith (L ++ x :: R) L.length repl = some (L ++ repl ++ R)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first L ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.length_cons, Hydra.replaceAtWith]
      rw [ih]
      rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.chop_singleton_eq_some
statement:
private theorem chop_singleton_eq_some {stage : Nat} {children : List Hydra} {i : Nat} {a : Hydra}
    (hchild : children[i]? = some Hydra.head)
    (hchop : Hydra.chop stage (.node children) [i] = some a) :
    ∃ cs, Hydra.replaceAtWith children i [] = some cs ∧ a = .node cs
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hydra.chop, hchild] at hchop
  simp only [Hydra.head, Bind.bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq] at hchop
  obtain ⟨cs, hcs, hnode⟩ := hchop
  exact ⟨cs, hcs, hnode.symm⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.chop_pair_eq_some
statement:
private theorem chop_pair_eq_some {stage : Nat} {children : List Hydra} {i j : Nat} {a : Hydra}
    {gs : List Hydra} (hchild : children[i]? = some (.node gs))
    (hchop : Hydra.chop stage (.node children) [i, j] = some a) :
    ∃ pl cs, Hydra.replaceAtWith gs j [] = some pl ∧
      Hydra.replaceAtWith children i (List.replicate (stage + 1) (.node pl)) = some cs ∧
      a = .node cs
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hydra.chop, hchild] at hchop
  simp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff,
    Option.some.injEq] at hchop
  obtain ⟨changed, ⟨ch, hch, hmatch⟩, cs, hcs, hnode⟩ := hchop
  cases ch with
  | node l =>
      cases l with
      | nil =>
          simp only [Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq] at hmatch
          obtain ⟨pl, hpl, hchanged⟩ := hmatch
          refine ⟨pl, cs, hpl, ?_, hnode.symm⟩
          rw [← hchanged] at hcs
          exact hcs
      | cons h t => simp at hmatch

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.chop_deep_eq_some
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hydra.chop] at hchop
  simp only [Bind.bind, Option.pure_def, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq] at hchop
  obtain ⟨child, hchild, changed, hchanged, cs, hcs, hnode⟩ := hchop
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hlist⟩ := hchanged
  refine ⟨child, d, cs, hchild, hd, ?_, hnode.symm⟩
  rw [← hlist] at hcs
  exact hcs

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.chop_generalOrdinal_lt
statement:
private theorem chop_generalOrdinal_lt (stage : Nat) :
    ∀ (path : List Nat) (h a : Hydra), Hydra.IsHeadPosition h path →
      Hydra.chop stage h path = some a →
      hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} a < hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} h
proof:
:= by
  intro path
  induction path with
  | nil =>
      intro h a hpos _
      exact absurd rfl hpos.1
  | cons i rest ih =>
      intro h a hpos hchop
      cases h with
      | node children =>
          cases rest with
          | nil =>
              have hchild : children[i]? = some Hydra.head := isHeadPosition_singleton hpos
              obtain ⟨cs, hcs, rfl⟩ := chop_singleton_eq_some hchild hchop
              obtain ⟨L, R, hdecomp, hlen⟩ := exists_decomp_of_getElem?_eq_some hchild
              subst hdecomp
              rw [← hlen, replaceAtWith_append_cons] at hcs
              simp only [List.append_nil] at hcs
              have hcs' : L ++ R = cs := (Option.some.injEq _ _).mp hcs
              subst hcs'
              exact forestGeneralOrdinal_remove_head L R
          | cons j rest' =>
              cases rest' with
              | nil =>
                  obtain ⟨child, hchild, hsub⟩ := isHeadPosition_cons hpos
                  cases child with
                  | node gs =>
                      have hhead' : gs[j]? = some Hydra.head :=
                        isHeadPosition_singleton ⟨List.cons_ne_nil j [], hsub⟩
                      obtain ⟨pl, cs, hpl, hcs, rfl⟩ := chop_pair_eq_some hchild hchop
                      obtain ⟨L, R, hdecomp, hlen⟩ := exists_decomp_of_getElem?_eq_some hchild
                      subst hdecomp
                      rw [← hlen, replaceAtWith_append_cons] at hcs
                      have hcs' : L ++ List.replicate (stage + 1) (Hydra.node pl) ++ R = cs :=
                        (Option.some.injEq _ _).mp hcs
                      subst hcs'
                      obtain ⟨GL, GR, hgdecomp, hglen⟩ :=
                        exists_decomp_of_getElem?_eq_some hhead'
                      subst hgdecomp
                      rw [← hglen, replaceAtWith_append_cons] at hpl
                      simp only [List.append_nil] at hpl
                      have hpl' : GL ++ GR = pl := (Option.some.injEq _ _).mp hpl
                      subst hpl'
                      rw [hydraGeneralOrdinal_node, hydraGeneralOrdinal_node]
                      apply forestGeneralOrdinal_replicate_lt
                      have hmeasure : hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} (Hydra.node (GL ++ GR)) <
                          hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} (Hydra.node (GL ++ Hydra.head :: GR)) :=
                        forestGeneralOrdinal_remove_head GL GR
                      rw [ordinalPow_eq_opow, ordinalPow_eq_opow]
                      exact Ordinal.opow_mul_lt_opow
                        (Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 (stage + 1)) hmeasure
              | cons k rest'' =>
                  obtain ⟨child, d, cs, hchild, hchop', hcs, rfl⟩ := chop_deep_eq_some hchop
                  obtain ⟨child', hchild', hsub⟩ := isHeadPosition_cons hpos
                  rw [hchild] at hchild'
                  cases hchild'
                  have hhead : Hydra.IsHeadPosition child (j :: k :: rest'') :=
                    ⟨List.cons_ne_nil j (k :: rest''), hsub⟩
                  have hih : hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} d < hydraGeneralOrdinal.{u} child :=
                    ih child d hhead hchop'
                  obtain ⟨L, R, hdecomp, hlen⟩ := exists_decomp_of_getElem?_eq_some hchild
                  subst hdecomp
                  rw [← hlen, replaceAtWith_append_cons] at hcs
                  have hcs' : L ++ [d] ++ R = cs := (Option.some.injEq _ _).mp hcs
                  subst hcs'
                  simpa using forestGeneralOrdinal_lt_of_child_lt L R hih

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.hydraOrdinal_not_general_descent
statement:
theorem hydraOrdinal_not_general_descent :
    ∃ before after : Hydra, Hydra.Step 1 before after ∧
      hydraOrdinal before < hydraOrdinal after
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨.node [.node [Hydra.head, .node [Hydra.head]]],
    .node [.node [.node [Hydra.head]], .node [.node [Hydra.head]]], ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨[0, 0], ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨List.cons_ne_nil 0 [0], rfl⟩
  · have hone : hydraOrdinal (Hydra.node [Hydra.head]) = 1 := by
      rw [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal, hydraOrdinal_head, ordinalPow_zero, forestOrdinal,
        ordinalAdd_zero]
    have homega : hydraOrdinal (Hydra.node [Hydra.node [Hydra.head]]) = Ordinal.omega0 := by
      rw [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal, hone, forestOrdinal, ordinalAdd_zero]
      rw [show (1 : Ordinal) = Order.succ 0 by simp, ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_zero]
      simp [ordinalMul]
    have hforest : forestOrdinal [Hydra.node [Hydra.head]] = Ordinal.omega0 := homega
    have habsorb : ordinalAdd (1 : Ordinal) Ordinal.omega0 = Ordinal.omega0 := by
      rw [show ordinalAdd (1 : Ordinal) Ordinal.omega0 = 1 + Ordinal.omega0 by
        simp [ordinalAdd], Ordinal.one_add_omega0]
    have hinner : hydraOrdinal (Hydra.node [Hydra.head, Hydra.node [Hydra.head]]) =
        Ordinal.omega0 := by
      rw [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal, hydraOrdinal_head, ordinalPow_zero, hforest, habsorb]
    have hbefore : hydraOrdinal (.node [.node [Hydra.head, .node [Hydra.head]]]) =
        Ordinal.omega0 ^ Ordinal.omega0 := by
      rw [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal, hinner, forestOrdinal, ordinalAdd_zero,
        ordinalPow_eq_opow]
    have hafter : hydraOrdinal
        (.node [.node [.node [Hydra.head]], .node [.node [Hydra.head]]]) =
        Ordinal.omega0 ^ Ordinal.omega0 * 2 := by
      rw [hydraOrdinal, forestOrdinal, homega, forestOrdinal, homega, forestOrdinal,
        ordinalAdd_zero]
      rw [show ordinalAdd (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 Ordinal.omega0)
          (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 Ordinal.omega0) =
          Ordinal.omega0 ^ Ordinal.omega0 + Ordinal.omega0 ^ Ordinal.omega0 by
        simp [ordinalAdd, ordinalPow_eq_opow],
        ← Ordinal.mul_two]
    rw [hbefore, hafter, Ordinal.mul_two]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (Ordinal.opow_pos _ Ordinal.omega0_pos)

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.HydraGeneralDescent.hydraStep_generalOrdinal_lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨path, hpos, hchop⟩ := h
  exact chop_generalOrdinal_lt stage path before after hpos hchop

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.positiveDigit_goodstein_descent
statement:
theorem positiveDigit_goodstein_descent {base : ℕ}
    (d : PositiveDigitNormalForm base) :
    goodsteinStep base d.expression = d.digit - 1 ∧
      d.predecessorExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      d.predecessorExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base d.expression ∧
      d.predecessorExpression.omegaValue < d.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  have hpred_lt : d.digit - 1 < d.digit :=
    Nat.sub_one_lt (Nat.ne_of_gt d.positive)
  refine ⟨by simp [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      PositiveDigitNormalForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [PositiveDigitNormalForm.predecessorExpression, HereditaryBaseExpr.Valid]
    exact lt_trans hpred_lt (lt_trans d.valid (Nat.lt_succ_self base))
  · simp [PositiveDigitNormalForm.predecessorExpression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval,
      goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue, PositiveDigitNormalForm.expression]
  · simp only [PositiveDigitNormalForm.predecessorExpression,
      PositiveDigitNormalForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
    exact_mod_cast hpred_lt

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GrowthHierarchy.fundamentalSystem_legal_rules
statement:
theorem fundamentalSystem_legal_rules (system : FundamentalSystem ι)
    (legal : system.Legal) (a : ι) :
    match system.stage a with
    | .zero => True
    | .successor previous => system.below previous a
    | .limit sequence => ∀ n, system.below (sequence n) a
proof:
:= by
  exact legal a

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GrowthHierarchy.hardyApprox_rules
statement:
theorem hardyApprox_rules (system : FundamentalSystem ι) (fuel n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a, system.stage a = .zero → hardyApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = n) ∧
    (∀ a previous, system.stage a = .successor previous →
      hardyApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = hardyApprox system fuel previous (n + 1)) ∧
    (∀ a sequence, system.stage a = .limit sequence →
      hardyApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = hardyApprox system fuel (sequence n) n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a h
    simp [hardyApprox, h]
  constructor
  · intro a previous h
    simp [hardyApprox, h]
  · intro a sequence h
    simp [hardyApprox, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.GrowthHierarchy.fastGrowingApprox_rules
statement:
theorem fastGrowingApprox_rules (system : FundamentalSystem ι) (fuel n : ℕ) :
    (∀ a, system.stage a = .zero → fastGrowingApprox system (fuel + 1) a n = n + 1) ∧
    (∀ a previous, system.stage a = .successor previous →
      fastGrowingApprox system (fuel + 1) a n =
        iterate (fun x => fastGrowingApprox system fuel previous x) (n + 1) n) ∧
    (∀ a sequence, system.stage a = .limit sequence →
      fastGrowingApprox system (fuel + 1) a n =
        fastGrowingApprox system fuel (sequence n) n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a h
    simp [fastGrowingApprox, h]
  constructor
  · intro a previous h
    simp [fastGrowingApprox, h]
  · intro a sequence h
    simp [fastGrowingApprox, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_of_base_le
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => trivial
  | digit n => exact lt_of_lt_of_le hvalid hbase
  | add left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | mul left right leftIH rightIH =>
      exact ⟨leftIH hvalid.1, rightIH hvalid.2⟩
  | basePow exponent exponentIH => exact exponentIH hvalid

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.positiveTail_goodstein_descent
statement:
theorem positiveTail_goodstein_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : PositiveTailNoBorrowForm base) :
    goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) + (f.digit - 1) ∧
      f.predecessorExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.predecessorExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.predecessorExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  have hpred_lt : f.digit - 1 < f.digit :=
    Nat.sub_one_lt (Nat.ne_of_gt f.digit_positive)
  have hpred_succ : f.digit - 1 + 1 = f.digit :=
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr f.digit_positive)
  have hprefix_valid : f.head.Valid (base + 1) :=
    HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_of_base_le f.head_valid (Nat.le_succ base)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      PositiveTailNoBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    omega
  · simp only [PositiveTailNoBorrowForm.predecessorExpression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.Valid]
    exact ⟨hprefix_valid, lt_trans hpred_lt (lt_trans f.digit_valid (Nat.lt_succ_self base))⟩
  · simp only [PositiveTailNoBorrowForm.predecessorExpression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [show goodsteinStep base f.expression =
      f.head.eval (base + 1) + (f.digit - 1) by
        simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
          PositiveTailNoBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
        omega]
  · simp only [PositiveTailNoBorrowForm.predecessorExpression,
      PositiveTailNoBorrowForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
    have hcast : ((f.digit : ℕ) : Ordinal) =
        Order.succ ((f.digit - 1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) := by
      rw [Order.succ_eq_add_one]
      exact_mod_cast hpred_succ.symm
    rw [hcast, ordinalAdd_succ]
    exact Order.lt_succ _

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.BaseExponentOneNormalForm.protocol
statement:
theorem BaseExponentOneNormalForm.protocol {base : ℕ}
    (e : BaseExponentOneNormalForm base) :
    e.expression.Valid base ∧
      e.expression.eval (base + 1) = base + 1 ∧
      e.expression.omegaValue = Ordinal.omega0
proof:
:= by
  have hone_lt_base : 1 < base := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two e.base_ge_two
  refine ⟨hone_lt_base, by simp [BaseExponentOneNormalForm.expression,
    HereditaryBaseExpr.eval], ?_⟩
  simp only [BaseExponentOneNormalForm.expression, HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
  change ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 (Order.succ 0) = Ordinal.omega0
  rw [ordinalPow_succ, ordinalPow_zero]
  simp [ordinalMul]

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.finitePowerBorrowExpansion_valid_at_full_digit_range
proof:
| 0, _ => by trivial
  | k + 1, hk => by
      simp only [finitePowerBorrowExpansion, HereditaryBaseExpr.Valid]
      exact ⟨⟨Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk, Nat.lt_succ_self base⟩,
        finitePowerBorrowExpansion_valid_at_full_digit_range base k
          (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hk)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Googology.hereditaryBaseExponent_goodstein_borrow_descent
statement:
theorem hereditaryBaseExponent_goodstein_borrow_descent {base : ℕ}
    (f : HereditaryBaseExponentTailBorrowForm base) :
    f.expression.Valid base ∧
      goodsteinStep base f.expression =
        f.head.eval (base + 1) + ((base + 1) ^ (base + 1) - 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.Valid (base + 1) ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.eval (base + 1) = goodsteinStep base f.expression ∧
      f.borrowedExpression.omegaValue < f.expression.omegaValue
proof:
:= by
  rcases f.exponent.protocol with ⟨hexponent_valid, hexponent_eval, hexponent_omega⟩
  have hhead_next : f.head.Valid (base + 1) :=
    HereditaryBaseExpr.valid_at_next f.head_valid
  have hpow_positive : 0 < (base + 1) ^ (base + 1) :=
    pow_pos (by omega) (base + 1)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨f.head_valid, hexponent_valid⟩
  · simp only [goodsteinStep, hereditaryBaseChangeValue,
      HereditaryBaseExponentTailBorrowForm.expression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [hexponent_eval]
    rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hpow_positive))]
  · exact ⟨hhead_next,
      finitePowerBorrowExpansion_valid_at_full_digit_range base (base + 1) le_rfl⟩
  · simp only [HereditaryBaseExponentTailBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      HereditaryBaseExponentTailBorrowForm.expression, goodsteinStep,
      hereditaryBaseChangeValue, HereditaryBaseExpr.eval]
    rw [hexponent_eval]
    rw [finitePowerBorrowExpansion_eval,
      Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hpow_positive))]
  · simp only [HereditaryBaseExponentTailBorrowForm.borrowedExpression,
      HereditaryBaseExponentTailBorrowForm.expression,
      HereditaryBaseExpr.omegaValue]
    rw [hexponent_omega]
    have hfinite :
        (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base (base + 1)).omegaValue <
          ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((base + 1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) := by
      rw [ordinalPow_omega_nat]
      exact finitePowerBorrowExpansion_omega_lt base (base + 1)
    have hindex : ((base + 1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 :=
      Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 (base + 1)
    have houter : ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 ((base + 1 : ℕ) : Ordinal) <
        ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 Ordinal.omega0 :=
      (exponentiation_isNormal Ordinal.one_lt_omega0).1 hindex
    have htail := hfinite.trans houter
    rw [show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base (base + 1)).omegaValue =
          f.head.omegaValue +
            (finitePowerBorrowExpansion base (base + 1)).omegaValue by simp [ordinalAdd],
      show ordinalAdd f.head.omegaValue
          (ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 Ordinal.omega0) =
          f.head.omegaValue + ordinalPow Ordinal.omega0 Ordinal.omega0 by
            simp [ordinalAdd]]
    exact (add_lt_add_iff_left f.head.omegaValue).2 htail

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStar_evaluation_continuous

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStar_tendsto_iff_forall
statement:
theorem weakStar_tendsto_iff_forall {l : Filter α} {u : α → StrongDual ℝ E}
    {f : StrongDual ℝ E} :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ StrongDual.toWeakDual (u i)) l
        (nhds (StrongDual.toWeakDual f)) ↔
      ∀ x : E, Tendsto (fun i ↦ u i x) l (nhds (f x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_eval_tendsto_topDualPairing]
  constructor
  · intro h x
    have hx := h x
    change Tendsto (fun i ↦ u i x) l (nhds (f x)) at hx
    exact hx
  · intro h x
    change Tendsto (fun i ↦ u i x) l (nhds (f x))
    exact h x

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.separable_bidual_of_reflexive
statement:
theorem separable_bidual_of_reflexive [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E]
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E))

:= by
  exact hE.denseRange.separableSpace (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E).continuous

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.separable_of_separable_dual
statement:
theorem separable_of_separable_dual
    [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (StrongDual ℝ E)] :
    TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hDcount, hDdense⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense (StrongDual ℝ E)
  let _ : Countable D := hDcount.to_subtype
  have hlt (d : D) : ‖(d : StrongDual ℝ E)‖ - (1 / 8 : ℝ) < ‖(d : StrongDual ℝ E)‖ := by
    norm_num
  let x : D → E := fun d ↦
    Classical.choose ((d : StrongDual ℝ E).exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm (hlt d))
  have hxnorm (d : D) : ‖x d‖ < 1 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      ((d : StrongDual ℝ E).exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm (hlt d))).1
  have hxeval (d : D) :
      ‖(d : StrongDual ℝ E)‖ - (1 / 8 : ℝ) < ‖(d : StrongDual ℝ E) (x d)‖ :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      ((d : StrongDual ℝ E).exists_lt_apply_of_lt_opNorm (hlt d))).2
  let S : Submodule ℝ E := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x)
  have hSclosure : S.topologicalClosure = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr
    intro z
    rw [mem_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_annihilator]
    intro f hf
    have hfzero : f = 0 := by
      by_contra hfne
      let g : StrongDual ℝ E := (‖f‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • f
      have hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hfne
      have hgnorm : ‖g‖ = 1 := by
        simp [g, norm_smul, hfnorm]
      obtain ⟨d, hdD, hdist⟩ := hDdense.exists_dist_lt g (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8)
      let dD : D := ⟨d, hdD⟩
      have hdnorm : (7 / 8 : ℝ) < ‖d‖ := by
        have hrev : ‖g‖ - ‖d‖ ≤ ‖g - d‖ := norm_sub_norm_le g d
        rw [hgnorm, ← dist_eq_norm] at hrev
        linarith
      have hflower : (3 / 4 : ℝ) < ‖d (x dD)‖ := by
        have := hxeval dD
        change ‖d‖ - (1 / 8 : ℝ) < ‖d (x dD)‖ at this
        linarith
      have hfx : f (x dD) = 0 := by
        rw [mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff] at hf
        exact hf (x dD) (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self dD))
      have hgx : g (x dD) = 0 := by
        simp [g, hfx]
      have hupper : ‖d (x dD)‖ < 1 / 8 := by
        calc
          ‖d (x dD)‖ = ‖(d - g) (x dD)‖ := by simp [hgx]
          _ ≤ ‖d - g‖ * ‖x dD‖ := (d - g).le_opNorm (x dD)
          _ < (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
            have hdg : ‖d - g‖ < (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
              rw [norm_sub_rev, ← dist_eq_norm]
              exact hdist
            nlinarith [hxnorm dD, norm_nonneg (d - g)]
      linarith
    simp [hfzero]
  have hSdense : Dense (S : Set E) :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr hSclosure
  have hSseparable : TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable (S : Set E) :=
    (Set.countable_range x).isSeparable.span
  exact hSdense.isSeparable_iff.mp hSseparable

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.separable_dual_of_reflexive
statement:
theorem separable_dual_of_reflexive [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E]
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :

proof:

  let _ : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) :=

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.hahnBanach_dominated_extension
statement:
theorem hahnBanach_dominated_extension [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (S : Submodule ℝ E) (f : S →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (N : E → ℝ)
    (N_hom : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ x, N (c • x) = c * N x)

    (hf : ∀ x : S, f x ≤ N x) :
    ∃ g : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ x : S, g x = f x) ∧ ∀ x, g x ≤ N x
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_extension_of_le_sublinear (⟨S, f⟩ : E →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ) N N_hom N_add hf

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualRestriction_apply
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.reflexive_closedSubspace
statement:
theorem reflexive_closedSubspace
    (S : Submodule ℝ E) (hS : IsClosed (S : Set E))
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro Φ
  let ΦE : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) := Φ.comp (dualRestriction S)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hE ΦE
  have hxS : x ∈ S := by
    apply (mem_closedSubspace_iff_forall_annihilator S hS x).mpr
    intro f hf
    have hrestrict : dualRestriction S f = 0 := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro y
      simpa using (mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff S f).mp hf y y.property
    have hxeval : f x = ΦE f := by
      have := congrArg (fun G : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) ↦ G f) hx
      simpa only [bidual_evaluation] using this
    rw [hxeval]
    simp [ΦE, hrestrict]
  let y : S := ⟨x, hxS⟩
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro g
  obtain ⟨f, hfext, _hfnorm⟩ := exists_extension_norm_eq S g
  have hrestrict : dualRestriction S f = g := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    exact hfext z
  have hxeval : f x = ΦE f := by
    have := congrArg (fun G : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) ↦ G f) hx
    simpa only [bidual_evaluation] using this
  rw [bidual_evaluation]
  change g y = Φ g
  rw [← hrestrict, dualRestriction_apply, show (y : E) = x from rfl, hxeval]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.toStrongDual_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak
statement:
@[simp] private theorem toStrongDual_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak (x : E) :
    WeakDual.toStrongDual
      (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E (toWeakSpace ℝ E x)) =
        NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_eq_preimage_bidualBall
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_eq_preimage_bidualBall :
    weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) =
      NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E ⁻¹'
        (WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹'
          Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hy' : y ∈ (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualLi ℝ) ⁻¹'
        Metric.closedBall (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualLi ℝ (0 : E)) 1 := by
      simpa using hy
    change NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E y ∈
      Metric.closedBall (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E 0) 1 at hy'
    simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, toStrongDual_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak, map_zero] using hy'
  · intro hx
    rw [← (toWeakSpace ℝ E).apply_symm_apply x] at hx
    refine ⟨(toWeakSpace ℝ E).symm x, ?_, by simp⟩
    change WeakDual.toStrongDual
      (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E
        (toWeakSpace ℝ E ((toWeakSpace ℝ E).symm x))) ∈
          Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1 at hx
    have hx' : (toWeakSpace ℝ E).symm x ∈
        (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualLi ℝ) ⁻¹'
          Metric.closedBall (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualLi ℝ (0 : E)) 1 := by
      change NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E ((toWeakSpace ℝ E).symm x) ∈
        Metric.closedBall (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E 0) 1
      simpa only [toStrongDual_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak, map_zero] using hx
    simpa using hx'

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isClosed
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isClosed :
    IsClosed (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [weakClosedUnitBall_eq_preimage_bidualBall]
  exact (weakStar_isClosed_closedBall (E := StrongDual ℝ E) 0 1).preimage
    (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E).continuous

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.closure_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_unitBall
statement:
theorem closure_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_unitBall :
    closure (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) =
      WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹'
        Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact closure_minimal (by
      rintro Φ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (show x ∈ NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E ⁻¹'
        (WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹'
          Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1) by
            rw [← weakClosedUnitBall_eq_preimage_bidualBall]
            exact hx))
      (weakStar_isClosed_closedBall (E := StrongDual ℝ E) 0 1)
  · intro Φ hΦ
    by_contra hnot
    let _ : LocallyConvexSpace ℝ (WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) := by
      change LocallyConvexSpace ℝ
        (WeakBilin (topDualPairing ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)))
      exact WeakBilin.locallyConvexSpace
        (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) (F := StrongDual ℝ E)
        (B := topDualPairing ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E))
    let A := NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)
    have hAconv : Convex ℝ A := by
      dsimp [A]
      change Convex ℝ (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E ''
        (toWeakSpace ℝ E '' Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1))
      exact ((convex_closedBall (0 : E) 1).linear_image
        (toWeakSpace ℝ E).toLinearMap).linear_image
          (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E).toLinearMap
    obtain ⟨l, u, hlu, hul⟩ :=
      geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point hAconv.closure isClosed_closure hnot
    change StrongDual ℝ
      (WeakBilin (topDualPairing ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E))) at l
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := LinearMap.dualEmbedding_surjective
      (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) (F := StrongDual ℝ E)
      (topDualPairing ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) l
    have hl_eval : ∀ Ψ : WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E), l Ψ = Ψ f := by
      intro Ψ
      rw [← hf]
      rfl
    have hu_pos : 0 < u := by
      have hzero : (0 : WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) ∈ closure A := by
        apply subset_closure
        refine ⟨(0 : WeakSpace ℝ E), ?_, by simp⟩
        exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩
      simpa using hlu 0 hzero
    have hf_norm : ‖f‖ ≤ u := by
      apply f.opNorm_le_bound hu_pos.le
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x = 0
      · simp [hx]
      let y := ‖x‖⁻¹ • x
      have hy_norm : ‖y‖ = 1 := by
        simp [y, norm_smul, hx]
      have hy_ball : y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 := by
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hy_norm]
      have hpos : NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E (toWeakSpace ℝ E y) ∈ A :=
        ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ E y, ⟨y, hy_ball, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have hneg : NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E (toWeakSpace ℝ E (-y)) ∈ A := by
        refine ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ E (-y), ⟨-y, ?_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hy_norm]
      have hfy : |f y| < u := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor
        · have := hlu _ (subset_closure hneg)
          have heval : l (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E
              (toWeakSpace ℝ E (-y))) = f (-y) := by
            rw [← hf]
            rfl
          have ht : f (-y) < u := heval ▸ this
          simp only [map_neg] at ht
          linarith
        · have := hlu _ (subset_closure hpos)
          have heval : l (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E
              (toWeakSpace ℝ E y)) = f y := by
            rw [← hf]
            rfl
          exact heval ▸ this
      calc
        ‖f x‖ = ‖‖x‖ • f y‖ := by
          have hxy : x = ‖x‖ • y := by
            simp [y, smul_smul, hx]
          congr 1
          calc
            f x = f (‖x‖ • y) := congrArg f hxy
            _ = ‖x‖ • f y := map_smul f _ _
        _ = ‖x‖ * |f y| := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg x),
            Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ u * ‖x‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x, le_of_lt hfy]
    have hΦf : Φ f ≤ u := by
      have hΦnorm : ‖WeakDual.toStrongDual Φ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        change WeakDual.toStrongDual Φ ∈
          Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1 at hΦ
        exact (mem_closedBall_zero_iff
          (E := StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E))).mp hΦ
      calc
        Φ f ≤ |Φ f| := le_abs_self _
        _ = ‖WeakDual.toStrongDual Φ f‖ := by rfl
        _ ≤ ‖WeakDual.toStrongDual Φ‖ * ‖f‖ :=
          (WeakDual.toStrongDual Φ).le_opNorm f
        _ ≤ 1 * u := mul_le_mul hΦnorm hf_norm (norm_nonneg f) zero_le_one
        _ = u := one_mul u
    rw [← hf] at hul
    change u < Φ f at hul
    exact (hul.trans_le hΦf).false

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_unitBall_approx_bidual_on_finset
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_approx_bidual_on_finset
    (Φ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) (hΦ : ‖Φ‖ ≤ 1)
    (s : Finset (StrongDual ℝ E)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ∀ f ∈ s, |f x - Φ f| < ε
proof:
:= by
  let Φw : WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) := StrongDual.toWeakDual Φ
  let A := NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)
  let U : Set (WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) :=
    ⋂ f ∈ s, (fun Ψ : WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) ↦ Ψ f) ⁻¹'
      Metric.ball (Φ f) ε
  have hΦball : Φw ∈ WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹'
      Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1 := by
    change Φ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1
    exact (mem_closedBall_zero_iff
      (E := StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E))).mpr hΦ
  have hΦclosure : Φw ∈ closure A := by
    rw [closure_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_unitBall]
    exact hΦball
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    apply isOpen_biInter_finset
    intro f _hf
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage
      (WeakBilin.eval_continuous (topDualPairing ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) f)
  have hΦU : Φw ∈ U := by
    simp [U, Φw, hε]
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨU, hΨA⟩ := (mem_closure_iff.mp hΦclosure U hUopen hΦU)
  obtain ⟨xw, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hΨA
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hev := Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hΨU f hf
  change dist ((NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E) (toWeakSpace ℝ E x) f)
    (Φ f) < ε at hev
  simpa only [NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_apply, StrongDual.toWeakDual_apply,
    LinearIsometry.coe_toLinearMap, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
    Function.comp_apply, bidual_evaluation, Real.dist_eq] using hev

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_unitBall_eq_bidual_on_finset
statement:
theorem exists_unitBall_eq_bidual_on_finset
    (hbounded : ∀ u : ℕ → E, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) →
      ∃ x : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
          Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x)))
    (Φ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) (hΦ : ‖Φ‖ ≤ 1)
    (s : Finset (StrongDual ℝ E)) :
    ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ∀ f ∈ s, f x = Φ f
proof:
:= by
  have happrox : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1,
      ∀ f ∈ s, |f x - Φ f| < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    exact exists_unitBall_approx_bidual_on_finset Φ hΦ s (by positivity)
  choose u hu huf using happrox
  have hurange : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) :=
    Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact hu n
  obtain ⟨x, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ := hbounded u hurange
  have hweak : Tendsto (fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u (φ n))) atTop
      (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E x)) :=
    (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := u ∘ φ) (x := x)).mpr (by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hconv)
  have hxweak : toWeakSpace ℝ E x ∈ weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) :=
    weakClosedUnitBall_isClosed.mem_of_tendsto hweak
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ⟨u (φ n), hu (φ n), rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxweak
  have hy_eq : y = x := (toWeakSpace ℝ E).injective hyx
  refine ⟨x, hy_eq ▸ hy, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hbound : ∀ n, |f (u (φ n)) - Φ f| ≤ (((φ n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
    fun n ↦ (huf (φ n) f hf).le
  have hright : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (((φ n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, one_div] using
        (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have habs : Tendsto (fun n ↦ |f (u (φ n)) - Φ f|) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) hbound hright
  have htoΦ : Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (Φ f)) :=
    tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr (by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hconv f) htoΦ

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_mem_of_mem_closure_weakStarImage_on_finset
statement:
theorem exists_mem_of_mem_closure_weakStarImage_on_finset
    {S : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)} {f₀ : StrongDual ℝ E}
    (hf₀ : StrongDual.toWeakDual f₀ ∈ closure (weakStarImage S))
    (t : Finset E) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ f ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ t, |f x - f₀ x| < ε
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (WeakDual ℝ E) :=
    ⋂ x ∈ t, (fun f : WeakDual ℝ E ↦ f x) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (f₀ x) ε
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    apply isOpen_biInter_finset
    intro x _hx
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (WeakDual.eval_continuous x)
  have hf₀U : StrongDual.toWeakDual f₀ ∈ U := by
    simp [U, hε]
  obtain ⟨g, hgU, hgw⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hf₀ U hUopen hf₀U
  obtain ⟨f, hfS, rfl⟩ := hgw
  refine ⟨f, hfS, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hev := Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hgU x hx
  change dist ((StrongDual.toWeakDual f) x) (f₀ x) < ε at hev
  simpa only [StrongDual.toWeakDual_apply, Real.dist_eq] using hev

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_finite_convex_approx_of_weak_tendsto
statement:
theorem exists_finite_convex_approx_of_weak_tendsto
    (u : ℕ → E) (x₀ : E)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u n)) atTop
      (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E x₀)))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t : Finset E, (t : Set E) ⊆ Set.range u ∧
      ∃ y ∈ convexHull ℝ (t : Set E), ‖x₀ - y‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  let C : Set E := convexHull ℝ (Set.range u)
  have hconv : Convex ℝ C := convex_convexHull ℝ (Set.range u)
  have hxweak : toWeakSpace ℝ E x₀ ∈ closure (toWeakSpace ℝ E '' C) := by
    apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hu
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
      subset_closure ⟨u n,
        (subset_convexHull ℝ (Set.range u)) (Set.mem_range_self n), rfl⟩
  have hxnorm : x₀ ∈ closure C := by
    have himage : toWeakSpace ℝ E '' closure C =
        closure (toWeakSpace ℝ E '' C) := hconv.toWeakSpace_closure ℝ
    rw [← himage] at hxweak
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxweak
    exact (toWeakSpace ℝ E).injective hyx ▸ hy
  obtain ⟨y, hyC, hyε⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hxnorm ε hε
  change y ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range u) at hyC
  rw [convexHull_eq_union_convexHull_finite_subsets] at hyC
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hyC
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hyt⟩ := hyC
  refine ⟨t, ht, y, hyt, ?_⟩
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hyε

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.abs_apply_lt_of_mem_convexHull
statement:
private theorem abs_apply_lt_of_mem_convexHull
    (g : StrongDual ℝ E) {t : Set E} {y : E} {ε : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ convexHull ℝ t) (ht : ∀ x ∈ t, |g x| < ε) :
    |g y| < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : t ⊆ g.toLinearMap ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
    intro x hx
    change dist (g x) 0 < ε
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using ht x hx
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (g.toLinearMap ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε) :=
    (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) ε).linear_preimage g.toLinearMap
  have hy' := convexHull_min hsub hconv hy
  change dist (g y) 0 < ε at hy'
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hy'

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.apply_eq_of_mem_convexHull
statement:
private theorem apply_eq_of_mem_convexHull
    (g : StrongDual ℝ E) {t : Set E} {y : E} {c : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ convexHull ℝ t) (ht : ∀ x ∈ t, g x = c) :
    g y = c
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set E := {x | g x = c}
  have htA : t ⊆ A := fun x hx ↦ ht x hx
  have hAconv : Convex ℝ A := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    change g (a • x + b • y) = c
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hx, hy]
    simp [smul_eq_mul, ← add_mul, hab]
  exact convexHull_min htA hAconv hy

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.nextPoint_mem_ball
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.nextPoint_mem_ball
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (st : EberleinHistory E) :
    d.nextPoint st ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_unitBall_eq_bidual_on_finset d.boundedSubsequence d.bidual
    d.bidual_norm (insert d.limitDual st.duals.toFinset))).1

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.nextPoint_limitDual
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.nextPoint_limitDual
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (st : EberleinHistory E) :
    d.limitDual (d.nextPoint st) = d.bidual d.limitDual
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_unitBall_eq_bidual_on_finset d.boundedSubsequence d.bidual
    d.bidual_norm (insert d.limitDual st.duals.toFinset))).2 d.limitDual (by simp)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.nextPoint_oldDual
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.nextPoint_oldDual
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (st : EberleinHistory E)
    {f : StrongDual ℝ E} (hf : f ∈ st.duals) :
    f (d.nextPoint st) = d.bidual f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Classical.choose_spec (exists_unitBall_eq_bidual_on_finset d.boundedSubsequence d.bidual
    d.bidual_norm (insert d.limitDual st.duals.toFinset))).2 f
  simp [hf]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.nextDual_mem
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.nextDual_mem
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (st : EberleinHistory E) :
    d.nextDual st ∈ d.dualSet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mem_of_mem_closure_weakStarImage_on_finset
    d.limit_mem_closure (insert (d.nextPoint st) st.points.toFinset) d.epsilon_pos)).1

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.nextDual_newPoint
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.nextDual_newPoint
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (st : EberleinHistory E) :
    |d.nextDual st (d.nextPoint st) - d.limitDual (d.nextPoint st)| < d.epsilon
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mem_of_mem_closure_weakStarImage_on_finset
    d.limit_mem_closure (insert (d.nextPoint st) st.points.toFinset) d.epsilon_pos)).2
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.nextDual_oldPoint
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.nextDual_oldPoint
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (st : EberleinHistory E) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ st.points) :
    |d.nextDual st x - d.limitDual x| < d.epsilon
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Classical.choose_spec (exists_mem_of_mem_closure_weakStarImage_on_finset
    d.limit_mem_closure (insert (d.nextPoint st) st.points.toFinset) d.epsilon_pos)).2
  simp [hx]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.history_succ_duals
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.history_succ_duals
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (n : ℕ) :
    (d.history (n + 1)).duals = d.dualSequence n :: (d.history n).duals
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.history_succ_points
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.history_succ_points
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) (n : ℕ) :
    (d.history (n + 1)).points = d.pointSequence n :: (d.history n).points
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.dual_mem_history
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.dual_mem_history
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m < n) :
    d.dualSequence m ∈ (d.history n).duals
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [d.history_succ_duals]
      by_cases hmn' : m = n
      · simp [hmn']
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hmn) hmn'))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.point_mem_history

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [d.history_succ_points]
      by_cases hmn' : m = n
      · simp [hmn']
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hmn) hmn'))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.EberleinChoiceData.dualSequence_approximates_pointSequence
statement:
private theorem EberleinChoiceData.dualSequence_approximates_pointSequence
    (d : EberleinChoiceData E) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_ker_isClosed_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_ker_isClosed_of_norm_le
    (hbounded : ∀ u : ℕ → E, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) →
      ∃ x : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
          Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x)))
    (Φ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) (hΦ : ‖Φ‖ ≤ 1) :
    IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice Φ.toLinearMap.ker))
proof:
:= by
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro f₀w hf₀closure
  · let f₀ : StrongDual ℝ E := WeakDual.toStrongDual f₀w
    have hf₀w_eq : StrongDual.toWeakDual f₀ = f₀w := WeakDual.toWeakDual_toStrongDual f₀w
    have hf₀closure' : StrongDual.toWeakDual f₀ ∈
        closure (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice Φ.toLinearMap.ker)) := by
      simpa only [hf₀w_eq] using hf₀closure
    have hf₀ball : ‖f₀‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have hsub : closure (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice Φ.toLinearMap.ker)) ⊆
          WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ E) 1 :=
        closure_minimal (by
          rintro g ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
          simpa using hf.2) weakStar_isCompact_unitBall.isClosed
      exact (mem_closedBall_zero_iff (E := StrongDual ℝ E)).mp (hsub hf₀closure')
    have hΦf₀ : Φ f₀ = 0 := by
      apply abs_eq_zero.mp
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
        intro δ hδ
        let ε := δ / 3
        have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos hδ (by norm_num)
        let d : EberleinChoiceData E :=
          { boundedSubsequence := hbounded
            bidual := Φ
            bidual_norm := hΦ
            dualSet := dualUnitSlice Φ.toLinearMap.ker
            limitDual := f₀
            limit_mem_closure := hf₀closure'
            epsilon := ε
            epsilon_pos := hε }
        have hpointsBounded : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range d.pointSequence) :=
          Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset fun x hx ↦ by
            obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx
            exact d.pointSequence_mem_ball n
        obtain ⟨x₀, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ := hbounded d.pointSequence hpointsBounded
        have hdual_zero (m : ℕ) : d.dualSequence m x₀ = 0 := by
          have heq : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, d.dualSequence m (d.pointSequence (φ k)) = 0 := by
            filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop m] with k hk
            have hmφ : m < φ k := hk.trans_le (hφ.id_le k)
            rw [d.oldDual_pointSequence hmφ]
            exact (d.dualSequence_mem m).1
          exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hconv (d.dualSequence m))
            (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm heq))
        have hweak : Tendsto (fun k ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (d.pointSequence (φ k))) atTop
            (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E x₀)) :=
          (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual
            (u := d.pointSequence ∘ φ) (x := x₀)).mpr (by
              simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hconv)
        obtain ⟨t, htRange, y, hyConv, hyNorm⟩ :=
          exists_finite_convex_approx_of_weak_tendsto
            (fun k ↦ d.pointSequence (φ k)) x₀ hweak hε
        classical
        choose idx hidx using fun z : {z // z ∈ t} ↦ htRange z.property
        let N : ℕ := t.attach.sup fun z ↦ φ (idx z)
        have hleN (z : {z // z ∈ t}) : φ (idx z) ≤ N := by
          exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun z : {z // z ∈ t} ↦ φ (idx z))
            (Finset.mem_attach t z)
        have happrox : ∀ z ∈ (t : Set E),
            |(d.dualSequence N - f₀) z| < ε := by
          intro z hz
          let zs : {z // z ∈ t} := ⟨z, hz⟩
          have hzseq : z = d.pointSequence (φ (idx zs)) := (hidx zs).symm
          rw [hzseq]
          simpa only [sub_apply] using
            d.dualSequence_approximates_pointSequence (hleN zs)
        have hdiffY : |(d.dualSequence N - f₀) y| < ε :=
          abs_apply_lt_of_mem_convexHull (d.dualSequence N - f₀) hyConv happrox
        have hf₀y : f₀ y = Φ f₀ := by
          apply apply_eq_of_mem_convexHull f₀ hyConv
          intro z hz
          obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := htRange hz
          rw [← hk]
          exact d.limitDual_pointSequence (φ k)
        have hdualNorm : ‖d.dualSequence N‖ ≤ 1 :=
          (mem_closedBall_zero_iff (E := StrongDual ℝ E)).mp (d.dualSequence_mem N).2
        have hdualY : |d.dualSequence N y| < ε := by
          have hzero := hdual_zero N
          calc
            |d.dualSequence N y| = ‖d.dualSequence N (y - x₀)‖ := by
              rw [map_sub, hzero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            _ ≤ ‖d.dualSequence N‖ * ‖y - x₀‖ :=
              (d.dualSequence N).le_opNorm (y - x₀)
            _ ≤ 1 * ‖y - x₀‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdualNorm (norm_nonneg _)
            _ < 1 * ε := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
              (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hyNorm) zero_lt_one
            _ = ε := one_mul ε
        have htriangle : |Φ f₀| ≤ |(d.dualSequence N - f₀) y| +
            |d.dualSequence N y| := by
          rw [← hf₀y]
          have := abs_add_le (f₀ y - d.dualSequence N y) (d.dualSequence N y)
          rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
          simpa only [sub_apply, abs_sub_comm] using this
        have : |Φ f₀| < δ := by
          calc
            |Φ f₀| ≤ |(d.dualSequence N - f₀) y| + |d.dualSequence N y| := htriangle
            _ < ε + ε := add_lt_add hdiffY hdualY
            _ < δ := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
        simpa using this.le
      · exact abs_nonneg _
    exact ⟨f₀, ⟨hΦf₀, (mem_closedBall_zero_iff (E := StrongDual ℝ E)).mpr hf₀ball⟩,
      hf₀w_eq⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_ker_isClosed
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_ker_isClosed
    (hbounded : ∀ u : ℕ → E, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) →
      ∃ x : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
          Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x)))
    (Φ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) :
    IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice Φ.toLinearMap.ker))
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := max ‖Φ‖ 1
  have hc : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right ‖Φ‖ 1)
  let Ψ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) := c⁻¹ • Φ
  have hΨnorm : ‖Ψ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ‖Ψ‖ ≤ ‖c⁻¹‖ * ‖Φ‖ := by
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le c⁻¹ Φ
      _ = c⁻¹ * ‖Φ‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc)]
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [inv_mul_le_one₀ hc]
        exact le_max_left ‖Φ‖ 1
  have hker : Ψ.toLinearMap.ker = Φ.toLinearMap.ker := by
    ext f
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    change c⁻¹ * Φ f = 0 ↔ Φ f = 0
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero hc.ne')
    · intro h
      simp [h]
  rw [← hker]
  exact weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_ker_isClosed_of_norm_le hbounded Ψ hΨnorm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.reflexive_of_bounded_sequence_has_weakly_convergent_subsequence
statement:
theorem reflexive_of_bounded_sequence_has_weakly_convergent_subsequence [CompleteSpace E]
    (hbounded : ∀ u : ℕ → E, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) →
      ∃ x : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
          Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x))) :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  intro Φ
  by_cases hΦzero : Φ = 0
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    simp [hΦzero]
  · have hexists : ∃ f₁ : StrongDual ℝ E, Φ f₁ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      apply hΦzero
      ext f
      exact h f
    obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := hexists
    let M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) := Φ.toLinearMap.ker
    have hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)) :=
      weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_ker_isClosed hbounded Φ
    obtain ⟨x, hf₁x, hMx⟩ :=
      exists_weakStar_separator_of_dualUnitSlice_closed M hunit
        (show f₁ ∉ M by simpa [M, LinearMap.mem_ker] using hf₁)
    let x₀ : E := (Φ f₁) • x
    refine ⟨x₀, ?_⟩
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro f
    let g : StrongDual ℝ E := f - (Φ f / Φ f₁) • f₁
    have hgM : g ∈ M := by
      change Φ g = 0
      simp [g, hf₁]
    have hgx : g x = 0 := hMx g hgM
    rw [bidual_evaluation]
    dsimp [x₀]
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hfx : f x = Φ f / Φ f₁ := by
      change f x - (Φ f / Φ f₁) * f₁ x = 0 at hgx
      rw [hf₁x, mul_one] at hgx
      linarith
    rw [hfx]
    field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isBounded_preimage
statement:
private theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isBounded_preimage :
    Bornology.IsBounded ((toWeakSpace ℝ E) ⁻¹' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (toWeakSpace ℝ E) ⁻¹' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) =
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact (toWeakSpace ℝ E).injective hxy ▸ hy
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩]
  exact Metric.isBounded_closedBall

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isCompact_of_reflexive
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isCompact_of_reflexive
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    IsCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : closure
      (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) ⊆
      Set.range (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E) := by
    intro Φ _
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hE (WeakDual.toStrongDual Φ)
    refine ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ E x, ?_⟩
    apply WeakDual.toStrongDual.injective
    simpa only [toStrongDual_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak] using hx
  have hcompact := NormedSpace.isCompact_closure_of_isBounded ℝ E
    (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) weakClosedUnitBall_isBounded_preimage hrange
  simpa only [weakClosedUnitBall_isClosed.closure_eq] using hcompact

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.reflexive_of_weakClosedUnitBall_isCompact
statement:
theorem reflexive_of_weakClosedUnitBall_isCompact
    (hcompact : IsCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))) :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  let J := NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualWeak ℝ E
  have hAcompact : IsCompact (J '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) :=
    hcompact.image J.continuous
  have hAclosed : IsClosed (J '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) := hAcompact.isClosed
  have hclosure : J '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) =
      WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹'
        Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1 := by
    rw [← closure_inclusionInDoubleDualWeak_unitBall]
    exact hAclosed.closure_eq.symm
  intro Φ
  let c : ℝ := max ‖Φ‖ 1
  have hc : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right ‖Φ‖ 1)
  let Ψ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) := c⁻¹ • Φ
  have hΨnorm : ‖Ψ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ‖Ψ‖ ≤ ‖c⁻¹‖ * ‖Φ‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le c⁻¹ Φ
      _ = c⁻¹ * ‖Φ‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc)]
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [inv_mul_le_one₀ hc]
        exact le_max_left ‖Φ‖ 1
  have hΨw : StrongDual.toWeakDual Ψ ∈ J '' weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) := by
    rw [hclosure]
    change Ψ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) 1
    exact (mem_closedBall_zero_iff (E := StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E))).mpr hΨnorm
  obtain ⟨xw, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hJ⟩ := hΨw
  refine ⟨c • x, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  have hΨeval : f x = Ψ f := by
    have := congrArg (fun g : WeakDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) ↦ g f) hJ
    change f x = Ψ f at this
    exact this
  rw [bidual_evaluation, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hΨeval]
  dsimp [Ψ]
  simp [hc.ne']

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive_of_separable
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive_of_separable
    [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E]
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    IsSeqCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (StrongDual ℝ E) :=
    separable_dual_of_reflexive hE
  intro w hw
  choose u hu using hw
  have hJu : ∀ n, ‖NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E (u n)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    rw [norm_bidual_evaluation]
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using (hu n).1
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ :=
    exists_weakStar_convergent_subsequence_of_norm_le_one
      (E := StrongDual ℝ E) (fun n ↦ NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E (u n)) hJu
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hE Φ
  have hpointwise : ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x)) := by
    have h := (weakStar_tendsto_iff_forall.mp hlim)
    intro f
    have hf := h f
    have hval : Φ f = f x := by
      rw [← hx, bidual_evaluation]
    simpa only [bidual_evaluation, hval] using hf
  have hweak : Tendsto (fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u (φ n))) atTop
      (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E x)) :=
    (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := u ∘ φ) (x := x)).mpr (by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hpointwise)
  have hxballw : toWeakSpace ℝ E x ∈ weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) :=
    weakClosedUnitBall_isClosed.mem_of_tendsto hweak
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ⟨u (φ n), (hu (φ n)).1, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ E x, hxballw, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  have hw_eq : w = fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u n) :=
    funext fun n ↦ (hu n).2.symm
  rw [hw_eq]
  exact hweak

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive [CompleteSpace E]
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    IsSeqCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  choose u hu using hw
  let S : Submodule ℝ E := (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range u)).topologicalClosure
  have huS (n : ℕ) : u n ∈ S :=
    (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range u)).le_topologicalClosure
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self n))
  have hSsep : TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable (S : Set E) := by
    change TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable
      (closure (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range u) : Set E))
    exact (Set.countable_range u).isSeparable.span.closure
  let _ : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace S := hSsep.separableSpace
  have hSclosed : IsClosed (S : Set E) :=
    Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range u))
  have hSrefl : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ S) :=
    reflexive_closedSubspace S hSclosed hE
  have hSseq := weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive_of_separable hSrefl
  let us : ℕ → S := fun n ↦ ⟨u n, huS n⟩
  have hus : ∀ n, toWeakSpace ℝ S (us n) ∈ weakClosedUnitBall (E := S) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨us n, ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, us] using (hu n).1
  obtain ⟨ys, hysball, φ, hφ, hconvS⟩ := hSseq hus
  let y : S := (toWeakSpace ℝ S).symm ys
  have hpointwiseS : ∀ g : StrongDual ℝ S,
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ g (us (φ n))) atTop (nhds (g y)) :=
    (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := us ∘ φ) (x := y)).mp (by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, y, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hconvS)
  have hconvE : Tendsto (fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u (φ n))) atTop
      (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E (y : E))) :=
    (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := u ∘ φ) (x := (y : E))).mpr (by
      intro f
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, us, dualRestriction_apply] using
        hpointwiseS (dualRestriction S f))
  have hyball : (y : E) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hysball
    have hz_eq : z = y := (toWeakSpace ℝ S).injective hzy
    have hznorm : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 := (mem_closedBall_zero_iff (E := S)).mp hz
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz_eq ▸ hznorm
  refine ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ E (y : E), ⟨(y : E), hyball, rfl⟩, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  have hw_eq : w = fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u n) :=
    funext fun n ↦ (hu n).2.symm
  rw [hw_eq]
  exact hconvE

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff :
    IsSeqCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) ↔
      ∀ u : ℕ → E, (∀ n, u n ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1) →
        ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
          ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
            Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB u hu
    obtain ⟨xw, ⟨x, hxB, rfl⟩, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ :=
      hB (fun n ↦ ⟨u n, hu n, rfl⟩)
    refine ⟨x, hxB, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
    change Tendsto (fun i ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u (φ i))) atTop
      (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E x)) at hconv
    exact (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := u ∘ φ) (x := x)).mp hconv
  · intro hB w hw
    choose u hu using hw
    obtain ⟨x, hxB, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ := hB u (fun n ↦ (hu n).1)
    refine ⟨toWeakSpace ℝ E x, ⟨x, hxB, rfl⟩, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
    have hw_eq : w = fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u n) :=
      funext fun n ↦ (hu n).2.symm
    rw [hw_eq]
    exact (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := u ∘ φ) (x := x)).mpr (by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hconv)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff_bounded_sequence
statement:
theorem weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff_bounded_sequence :
    IsSeqCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) ↔
      ∀ u : ℕ → E, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) →
        ∃ x : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
          ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
            Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB u hu
    obtain ⟨c, hcpos, hc⟩ := hu.exists_pos_norm_le
    have hvball : ∀ n, c⁻¹ • u n ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 := by
      intro n
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, norm_inv,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hcpos]
      calc
        c⁻¹ * ‖u n‖ ≤ c⁻¹ * c :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc (u n) ⟨n, rfl⟩) (inv_nonneg.mpr hcpos.le)
        _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpos.ne'
    obtain ⟨x, _hxB, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ :=
      (weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff (E := E)).mp hB
        (fun n ↦ c⁻¹ • u n) hvball
    refine ⟨c • x, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
    intro f
    have hscaled : Tendsto (fun n ↦ c * f (c⁻¹ • u (φ n))) atTop
        (nhds (c * f x)) := tendsto_const_nhds.mul (hconv f)
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_mul] using hscaled
  · intro hbounded
    apply (weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff (E := E)).mpr
    intro u hu
    have hrange : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) :=
      Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset fun x hx ↦ by
        obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact hu n
    obtain ⟨x, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ := hbounded u hrange
    have hweak : Tendsto (fun n ↦ toWeakSpace ℝ E (u (φ n))) atTop
        (nhds (toWeakSpace ℝ E x)) :=
      (weak_tendsto_iff_forall_dual (u := u ∘ φ) (x := x)).mpr (by
        simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hconv)
    have hxweak : toWeakSpace ℝ E x ∈ weakClosedUnitBall (E := E) :=
      weakClosedUnitBall_isClosed.mem_of_tendsto hweak
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ ⟨u (φ n), hu (φ n), rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨y, hyB, hyx⟩ := hxweak
    have : y = x := (toWeakSpace ℝ E).injective hyx
    exact ⟨x, this ▸ hyB, φ, hφ, hconv⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.eberlein_smulian_four_way
statement:
theorem eberlein_smulian_four_way [CompleteSpace E] :
    List.TFAE
      [ (Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)),
        (IsCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))),
        (IsSeqCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E))),
        (∀ u : ℕ → E, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) →
          ∃ x : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
            ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
              Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (u (φ n))) atTop (nhds (f x))) ]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := weakClosedUnitBall_isCompact_of_reflexive
  tfae_have 2 → 1 := reflexive_of_weakClosedUnitBall_isCompact
  tfae_have 1 → 3 := weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive
  tfae_have 3 ↔ 4 := weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff_bounded_sequence
  tfae_have 4 → 1 := reflexive_of_bounded_sequence_has_weakly_convergent_subsequence
  tfae_finish
