name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_dualOperator_range_unitSlice_isClosed_of_range_isClosed
statement:
private theorem weakStarImage_dualOperator_range_unitSlice_isClosed_of_range_isClosed
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hdual : IsClosed ((dualOperator T).range : Set (StrongDual ℝ E))) :
    IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice (dualOperator T).range))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : IsClosed ((dualOperator T).range : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) := hdual
  let R := (dualOperator T).rangeRestrict
  have hRsurj : Function.Surjective R := (dualOperator T).surjective_rangeRestrict
  obtain ⟨C, hCpos, hpre⟩ := ContinuousLinearMap.exists_preimage_norm_le
    (𝕜 := ℝ) (𝕜' := ℝ) (E := StrongDual ℝ F)
    (F := (dualOperator T).range) R hRsurj
  let B : Set (WeakDual ℝ F) :=
    WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ F) C
  have hBcompact : IsCompact B := weakStar_isCompact_closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ F) C
  have hImageCompact : IsCompact (weakDualOperator T '' B) :=
    hBcompact.image (weakDualOperator_continuous T)
  have hUnitClosed : IsClosed
      (WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ E) 1) :=
    WeakDual.isClosed_closedBall 0 1
  rw [show weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice (dualOperator T).range) =
      weakDualOperator T '' B ∩
        (WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ E) 1) by
    ext f
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f', ⟨hf'range, hf'norm⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨g, hgR, hgnorm⟩ := hpre ⟨f', hf'range⟩
      have hgdual : dualOperator T g = f' := congrArg Subtype.val hgR
      constructor
      · refine ⟨StrongDual.toWeakDual g, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [B, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hgnorm.trans <| by
            simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (show ‖(⟨f', hf'range⟩ : (dualOperator T).range)‖ ≤ 1 by simpa using hf'norm)
                hCpos.le
        · apply WeakDual.toStrongDual.injective
          exact hgdual
      · simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hf'norm
    · rintro ⟨⟨g, hgB, hgf⟩, hfnorm⟩
      let g' := WeakDual.toStrongDual g
      refine ⟨dualOperator T g', ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor
        · exact (dualOperator T).mem_range_self g'
        · have hstrong := congrArg WeakDual.toStrongDual hgf
          have heq : dualOperator T g' = WeakDual.toStrongDual f := hstrong
          rw [heq]
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hfnorm
      · exact hgf]
  exact hImageCompact.inter_right hUnitClosed |>.isClosed

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator_of_range_isClosed
statement:
private theorem dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator_of_range_isClosed
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hdual : IsClosed ((dualOperator T).range : Set (StrongDual ℝ E))) :
    (dualOperator T).range = StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker
proof:
:= by
  let M := (dualOperator T).range
  have hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)) := by
    simpa [M] using weakStarImage_dualOperator_range_unitSlice_isClosed_of_range_isClosed T hdual
  apply le_antisymm (dualOperator_range_le_ker_annihilator T)
  intro f hf
  by_contra hfM
  obtain ⟨x₀, hfx₀, hMx₀⟩ :=
    exists_weakStar_separator_of_dualUnitSlice_closed M hunit hfM
  have hTx₀ : T x₀ = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hnormne : ‖T x₀‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne
    obtain ⟨g, _hgNorm, hgTx₀⟩ := exists_dual_vector ℝ (T x₀) hnormne
    have hzero := hMx₀ (dualOperator T g) ((dualOperator T).mem_range_self g)
    rw [dualOperator_apply, hgTx₀] at hzero
    exact hnormne hzero
  have hx₀ker : x₀ ∈ T.ker := LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hTx₀
  have hzero := (mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff T.ker f).mp hf x₀ hx₀ker
  rw [hzero] at hfx₀
  norm_num at hfx₀

proof:

  · intro hchar

        ⋂ f : StrongDual ℝ F, ⋂ (_hf : f ∈ (dualOperator T).ker),

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.closedRange_four_way
statement:
theorem closedRange_four_way
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    IsClosed (Set.range T) ↔
      IsClosed ((dualOperator T).range : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) ∧

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarDualOperator_continuousOn_dual_unitBall
statement:
private theorem weakStarDualOperator_continuousOn_dual_unitBall
    (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (hT : IsCompactOperator T) :
    ContinuousOn (weakStarDualOperator T)
      (WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ F) 1)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Set (WeakDual ℝ F) :=
    WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ F) 1
  let S : Set F := closure (T '' closedBall (0 : E) 1)
  have hScompact : IsCompact S := hT.isCompact_closure_image_closedBall 1
  rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff']
  intro f hf ε hε
  obtain ⟨t : Set F, htfin, htcover⟩ :=
    (Metric.totallyBounded_iff.mp hScompact.totallyBounded) (ε / 8) (by positivity)
  have heval (y : F) :
      ∀ᶠ g : WeakDual ℝ F in 𝓝 f, ‖g y - f y‖ < ε / 2 := by
    have hcont : Continuous fun g : WeakDual ℝ F ↦ g y := WeakDual.eval_continuous y
    have htend : Tendsto (fun g : WeakDual ℝ F ↦ g y) (𝓝 f) (𝓝 (f y)) :=
      hcont.continuousAt
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds] at htend
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using htend (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ g : WeakDual ℝ F in 𝓝 f, ∀ y ∈ t, ‖g y - f y‖ < ε / 2 :=
    htfin.eventually_all.mpr fun y hy ↦ heval y
  filter_upwards [hall.filter_mono inf_le_left, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with g hg hgB
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ((dualOperator T g.toStrongDual -
    dualOperator T f.toStrongDual).opNorm_le_bound (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3 * ε / 4) ?_)
    (by linarith)
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    simp
  have hxnorm : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
  let z : E := ‖x‖⁻¹ • x
  have hz : ‖z‖ = 1 := by simp [z, norm_smul, hxnorm.ne']
  have hTzS : T z ∈ S := subset_closure ⟨z, by simp [hz], rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hyt, hTzy⟩ := by
    simpa only [mem_iUnion, mem_ball, dist_comm] using htcover hTzS
  have hfnorm : ‖f.toStrongDual‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [B] using hf
  have hgnorm : ‖g.toStrongDual‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [B] using hgB
  have hdiffnorm : ‖g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual‖ ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual‖ ≤ ‖g.toStrongDual‖ + ‖f.toStrongDual‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 := add_le_add hgnorm hfnorm
      _ = 2 := by norm_num
  have hpoint : ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (T z)‖ < 3 * ε / 4 := by
    calc
      ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (T z)‖
          = ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (y + (T z - y))‖ := by
            congr 2
            abel
      _ = ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) y +
              (g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (T z - y)‖ := by rw [map_add]
      _
          ≤ ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) y‖ +
              ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (T z - y)‖ := by
            exact norm_add_le ((g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) y)
              ((g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (T z - y))
      _ ≤ ‖g y - f y‖ + ‖g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual‖ * ‖T z - y‖ := by
            apply add_le_add
            · simp
            · exact (g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖g y - f y‖ + 2 * ‖T z - y‖ := by
            exact add_le_add (le_refl _)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdiffnorm (norm_nonneg (T z - y)))
      _ < ε / 2 + 2 * (ε / 8) := by
            apply add_lt_add (hg y hyt)
            apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
            simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hTzy
      _ = 3 * ε / 4 := by ring
  have hxrepr : x = ‖x‖ • z := by
    simp [z, smul_smul, hxnorm.ne']
  change ‖(dualOperator T g.toStrongDual - dualOperator T f.toStrongDual) x‖ ≤
    (3 * ε / 4) * ‖x‖
  calc
    ‖(dualOperator T g.toStrongDual - dualOperator T f.toStrongDual) x‖ =
        ‖(dualOperator T g.toStrongDual - dualOperator T f.toStrongDual) (‖x‖ • z)‖ := by
          rw [← hxrepr]
    _ = ‖x‖ * ‖(g.toStrongDual - f.toStrongDual) (T z)‖ := by
          rw [map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_norm]
          congr 2
    _ ≤ ‖x‖ * (3 * ε / 4) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint.le (norm_nonneg x)
    _ = (3 * ε / 4) * ‖x‖ := mul_comm _ _

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_isCompactOperator
statement:
theorem dualOperator_isCompactOperator [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (hT : IsCompactOperator T) :
    IsCompactOperator (dualOperator T)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Set (WeakDual ℝ F) :=
    WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ F) 1
  let A := weakStarDualOperator T
  have hBcompact : IsCompact B := WeakDual.isCompact_closedBall 0 1
  have hABcompact : IsCompact (A '' B) :=
    hBcompact.image_of_continuousOn (weakStarDualOperator_continuousOn_dual_unitBall T hT)
  apply (isCompactOperator_iff_image_closedBall_subset_compact
    (dualOperator T).toLinearMap zero_lt_one).2
  refine ⟨A '' B, hABcompact, ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨StrongDual.toWeakDual f, ?_, rfl⟩
  simpa [A, B, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hf

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.identitySubCompact_injective_iff_surjective
statement:
theorem identitySubCompact_injective_iff_surjective (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    Function.Injective (identitySubCompact K) ↔
      Function.Surjective (identitySubCompact K)
proof:
:= by
  let D := identitySubCompact K
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ D.ker :=
    finiteDimensional_kernel_identitySubCompact K hK
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (E ⧸ D.range) :=
    finiteDimensional_cokernel_identitySubCompact K hK
  have hindex : D.toLinearMap.index = 0 := index_identitySubCompact_eq_zero K hK
  change Function.Injective D ↔ Function.Surjective D
  constructor
  · intro hinj
    have hi := LinearMap.index_of_injective (f := D.toLinearMap) hinj
    rw [hindex] at hi
    have hfin : Module.finrank ℝ (E ⧸ D.range) = 0 := by omega
    have hall : ∀ x : E ⧸ D.range, x = 0 :=
      finrank_zero_iff_forall_zero.mp hfin
    have hsub : Subsingleton (E ⧸ D.range) :=
      ⟨fun x y ↦ (hall x).trans (hall y).symm⟩
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
      (Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp hsub)
  · intro hsurj
    have hi := LinearMap.index_of_surjective (f := D.toLinearMap) hsurj
    rw [hindex] at hi
    have hfin : Module.finrank ℝ D.ker = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hi.symm
    exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp hfin)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dense_iSup_eigenspaces_of_orthogonal_eq_bot
statement:
private theorem dense_iSup_eigenspaces_of_orthogonal_eq_bot
    (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) (h : (⨆ μ, eigenspace T μ)ᗮ = ⊥) :
    Dense ((⨆ μ, eigenspace T μ : Submodule 𝕜 E) : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  let V : Submodule 𝕜 E := ⨆ μ, eigenspace T μ
  have hVorth : Vᗮ = ⊥ := h
  have hclosureOrth : V.topologicalClosureᗮ = ⊥ := by
    rw [V.orthogonal_closure, hVorth]
  have hclosure : V.topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.orthogonal_eq_bot_iff.mp hclosureOrth
  rw [dense_iff_closure_eq, ← V.topologicalClosure_coe, hclosure]
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.compact_isSymmetric_spectral_decomposition
statement:
theorem compact_isSymmetric_spectral_decomposition {T : E →L[𝕜] E}
    (hK : IsCompactOperator T) (hT : (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E).IsSymmetric) :
    (∀ μ, HasEigenvalue (T : End 𝕜 E) μ → star μ = μ) ∧
      OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun μ => eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) μ)
        (fun μ => (eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) μ).subtypeₗᵢ) ∧
      Dense ((⨆ μ, eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) μ : Submodule 𝕜 E) : Set E) ∧
      ∀ μ, μ ≠ 0 → FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomplete :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.orthogonalComplement_iSup_eigenspaces_eq_bot hK hT
  refine ⟨fun _ hμ => hT.conj_eigenvalue_eq_self hμ,
    hT.orthogonalFamily_eigenspaces,
    dense_iSup_eigenspaces_of_orthogonal_eq_bot (T : End 𝕜 E) hcomplete, ?_⟩
  exact fun μ hμ => ContinuousLinearMap.finite_dimensional_eigenspace hK μ hμ

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.image_isOpen_of_surjective_continuousLinearMap
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.identitySubCompact_antilipschitz_on_complement
statement:
private theorem identitySubCompact_antilipschitz_on_complement [CompleteSpace E]
    (K : E →L[ℝ] E) (hK : IsCompactOperator K)
    (C : Submodule ℝ E) (hCclosed : IsClosed (C : Set E))
    (hdisj : Disjoint (identitySubCompact K).ker C) :
    ∃ c, AntilipschitzWith c ((identitySubCompact K).domRestrict C)
proof:
:= by
  let D := (identitySubCompact K).domRestrict C
  rw [antilipschitzWith_iff_exists_mul_le_norm]
  by_contra! hanti
  have hsmall : ∀ c > 0, ∃ x : C, ‖D x‖ < c * ‖x‖ := hanti
  obtain ⟨a : ℝ, ha⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm ℝ
  have ha0 : 0 < ‖a‖⁻¹ := by positivity
  obtain ⟨φ, _hφanti, hφpos, hφlim⟩ := exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto (0 : ℝ)
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃ x : C,
      ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖a‖⁻¹ ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖D x‖ < φ n := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsmall (φ n) (hφpos n)
    have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hz
    obtain ⟨η, _hη, hupper, hlower, _⟩ :=
      rescale_to_shell ha (ε := 1) (by norm_num) hz0
    refine ⟨η • z, hupper.le, by simpa using hlower, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, norm_smul]
    calc
      ‖η‖ * ‖D z‖ < ‖η‖ * (φ n * ‖z‖) :=
        (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz (norm_pos_iff.mpr (by aesop))).trans_le le_rfl
      _ = φ n * ‖η • z‖ := by rw [norm_smul]; ring
      _ ≤ φ n := by
        simpa using mul_le_of_le_one_right (le_of_lt (hφpos n)) hupper.le
  choose x hxupper hxlower hxsmall using hex
  have hDlim : Tendsto (fun n ↦ D (x n)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero_norm (fun n ↦ (hxsmall n).le) hφlim
  have hKcompact : IsCompactOperator (K.comp C.subtypeL) := hK.comp_clm C.subtypeL
  obtain ⟨Q, hQcompact, hQmem⟩ := hKcompact.image_closedBall_subset_compact 1
  obtain ⟨y, _hyQ, ψ, hψmono, hKy⟩ := hQcompact.tendsto_subseq
    (x := fun n ↦ K (x n : E)) fun n ↦ hQmem ⟨x n, by simpa using hxupper n, rfl⟩
  have hxlim : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (x (ψ n) : E)) atTop (𝓝 y) := by
    have hsum : Tendsto (fun n ↦ D (x (ψ n)) + K (x (ψ n) : E)) atTop (𝓝 (0 + y)) :=
      (hDlim.comp hψmono.tendsto_atTop).add hKy
    simpa [D, identitySubCompact_apply] using hsum
  have hyC : y ∈ C := hCclosed.mem_of_tendsto hxlim
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ (x (ψ n)).property)
  have hyker : y ∈ (identitySubCompact K).ker := by
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    have hDz : Tendsto (fun n ↦ identitySubCompact K (x (ψ n) : E)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      change Tendsto (fun n ↦ D (x (ψ n))) atTop (𝓝 0)
      exact hDlim.comp hψmono.tendsto_atTop
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique
      ((identitySubCompact K).continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hxlim)
      hDz
  have hy0 : y = 0 := by
    have hybot : y ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℝ E) := by
      rw [← disjoint_iff.mp hdisj]
      exact ⟨hyker, hyC⟩
    simpa using hybot
  subst y
  rw [NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero] at hxlim
  have hev := hxlim (‖a‖⁻¹) ha0
  rw [eventually_atTop] at hev
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hev
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hxlower (ψ N)) (hN N le_rfl)).elim

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isClosed_range_identitySubCompact
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_identitySubCompact [CompleteSpace E]
    (K : E →L[ℝ] E) (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    IsClosed (Set.range (identitySubCompact K))
proof:
:= by
  let D := identitySubCompact K
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ D.ker := finiteDimensional_kernel_identitySubCompact K hK
  have hcomp : D.ker.ClosedComplemented :=
    Submodule.ClosedComplemented.of_finiteDimensional D.ker
  let C := hcomp.complement
  have hCclosed : IsClosed (C : Set E) := hcomp.isClosed_complement
  have hcompl : IsCompl D.ker C := hcomp.isCompl_complement
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := identitySubCompact_antilipschitz_on_complement K hK C hCclosed hcompl.disjoint
  have hrangeC : IsClosed (Set.range (D.domRestrict C)) :=
    hc.isClosed_range (D.domRestrict C).uniformContinuous
  rw [show Set.range D = Set.range (D.domRestrict C) by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hx : x ∈ D.ker ⊔ C := by
        rw [hcompl.sup_eq_top]
        exact Submodule.mem_top
      obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
      refine ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, ?_⟩
      change D v = D x
      have hDu : D u = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hu
      calc
        D v = D u + D v := by rw [hDu, zero_add]
        _ = D (u + v) := (map_add D u v).symm
        _ = D x := congrArg D huv
    · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩]
  exact hrangeC

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.resolvent_sub_resolvent_same
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_resolvent_same (a : A) {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ resolventSet ℂ a) (hw : w ∈ resolventSet ℂ a) :
    resolvent a z - resolvent a w =
      (w - z) • (resolvent a z * resolvent a w)
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) ↔ IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ A w - a) :=
    ⟨fun _ => hw, fun _ => hz⟩
  have hsub : (algebraMap ℂ A w - a) - (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) = (w - z) • (1 : A) := by
    rw [show (algebraMap ℂ A w - a) - (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) =
        algebraMap ℂ A w - algebraMap ℂ A z by abel]
    rw [← map_sub, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  calc resolvent a z - resolvent a w
      = (algebraMap ℂ A z - a)⁻¹ʳ - (algebraMap ℂ A w - a)⁻¹ʳ := rfl
    _ = (algebraMap ℂ A z - a)⁻¹ʳ *
          ((algebraMap ℂ A w - a) - (algebraMap ℂ A z - a)) *
          (algebraMap ℂ A w - a)⁻¹ʳ := Ring.inverse_sub_inverse hunit
    _ = (w - z) •
          ((algebraMap ℂ A z - a)⁻¹ʳ * (algebraMap ℂ A w - a)⁻¹ʳ) := by
          simp only [hsub, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, smul_mul_assoc]
    _ = (w - z) • (resolvent a z * resolvent a w) := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.resolvent_mul_comm
statement:
theorem resolvent_mul_comm (a : A) (z w : ℂ) :
    resolvent a z * resolvent a w = resolvent a w * resolvent a z
proof:
:= by
  have hx : Commute (algebraMap ℂ A z) a := Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left z a
  have hy : Commute (algebraMap ℂ A w) a := Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left w a
  have hxy : Commute (algebraMap ℂ A z) (algebraMap ℂ A w) :=
    Algebra.commute_algebraMap_left z (algebraMap ℂ A w)
  have h : Commute (algebraMap ℂ A z - a) (algebraMap ℂ A w - a) :=
    (hxy.sub_right hx).sub_left (hy.symm.sub_right (Commute.refl a))
  exact (commute_iff_eq _ _).mp h.ringInverse_ringInverse

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.resolvent_sub_resolvent_same_mul_comm
statement:

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.evaluationOnDualKernel_ker_eq_range
statement:
theorem evaluationOnDualKernel_ker_eq_range (D : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hD : IsClosed (Set.range D)) :
    (evaluationOnDualKernel D).ker = D.range
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    rw [mem_range_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker D hD]
    intro f hf
    exact congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe hy) ⟨f, hf⟩
  · intro hy
    ext f
    exact (mem_range_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker D hD y).mp hy f.1 f.2

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_cokernel_identitySubCompact
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_cokernel_identitySubCompact (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    FiniteDimensional ℝ (E ⧸ (identitySubCompact K).range)
proof:
:= by
  let D := identitySubCompact K
  have hDclosed : IsClosed (Set.range D) := isClosed_range_identitySubCompact K hK
  have hdual : dualOperator D = identitySubCompact (dualOperator K) := by
    simpa [D] using dualOperator_identitySubCompact K
  have hKdual : IsCompactOperator (dualOperator K) :=
    dualOperator_isCompactOperator K hK
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (dualOperator D).ker := by
    rw [hdual]
    exact finiteDimensional_kernel_identitySubCompact (dualOperator K) hKdual
  let Q := evaluationOnDualKernel D
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ (dualOperator D).ker) := by
    exact Subspace.instModuleDualFiniteDimensional
      (K := ℝ) (V := (dualOperator D).ker)
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ Q.range :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_injective Q.range.subtype Q.range.injective_subtype
  have hker : Q.ker = D.range := evaluationOnDualKernel_ker_eq_range D hDclosed
  rw [← hker]
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (V := Q.range) Q.quotKerEquivRange.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_weakStar_convergent_subsequence_of_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_weakStar_convergent_subsequence_of_norm_le_one
    (u : ℕ → StrongDual ℝ E) (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ f : StrongDual ℝ E, ‖f‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ StrongDual.toWeakDual (u (φ n))) atTop
        (nhds (StrongDual.toWeakDual f))
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (WeakDual ℝ E) :=
    WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ E) 1
  have huS : ∀ n, StrongDual.toWeakDual (u n) ∈ S := by
    intro n
    simp [S, Metric.mem_closedBall, hu n]
  obtain ⟨a, haS, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ :=
    (weakStar_isSeqCompact_closedBall (E := E) 0 1).subseq_of_frequently_in
      ((Filter.Eventually.of_forall huS).frequently)
  refine ⟨WeakDual.toStrongDual a, ?_, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  · simpa [S, Metric.mem_closedBall] using haS
  · simpa [Function.comp_def, WeakDual.toWeakDual_toStrongDual] using hlim

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isBounded_range_meanErgodicAverage_of_powerBounded
statement:
private theorem isBounded_range_meanErgodicAverage_of_powerBounded
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) (x : E) :
    Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Metric.isBounded_closedBall :
    Bornology.IsBounded (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (c * ‖x‖))).subset ?_
  rintro y ⟨n, rfl⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (meanErgodicAverage T n) x).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_meanErgodicAverage_le hc hT n) (norm_nonneg x))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_eq_top_of_reflexive
statement:
theorem meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_eq_top_of_reflexive
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hpow⟩ := hT
  have hseq : IsSeqCompact (weakClosedUnitBall (E := E)) :=
    weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_of_reflexive hE
  have hextract :=
    (weakClosedUnitBall_isSeqCompact_iff_bounded_sequence (E := E)).mp hseq
      (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n x)
      (isBounded_range_meanErgodicAverage_of_powerBounded (zero_le_one.trans hc) hpow x)
  obtain ⟨z, φ, hφ, hweak⟩ := hextract
  exact (mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_iff_weak_subsequence_of_powerBounded
    ⟨c, hc, hpow⟩ x).2
    ⟨z, φ, hφ, hweak⟩

    ∃ y, Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n x) atTop (nhds y)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T := by

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_eigenspace_of_compact
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_eigenspace_of_compact (T : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ (eigenspace T.toLinearMap μ)
proof:
:= by
  replace hT := hT.restrict'
    ((mem_invtSubmodule_iff_forall_mem_of_mem _).mp
      (eigenspace_mem_invtSubmodule T.toLinearMap μ))
  rw [restrict_eigenspace, LinearMap.coe_smul, IsCompactOperator.smul_iff₀ hμ] at hT
  rwa [← isCompactOperator_id_iff_finiteDimensional]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.compactOnKernelOfIdentitySub_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem compactOnKernelOfIdentitySub_apply (K : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (x : (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K).ker) :
    compactOnKernelOfIdentitySub K x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change K x.1 = x.1
  have hx := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp x.2
  change x.1 - K x.1 = 0 at hx
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hx).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_kernel_identity_sub_complex
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : IsCompactOperator (compactOnKernelOfIdentitySub K) := by
    apply IsCompactOperator.codRestrict
    · exact hK.comp_clm (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K).ker.subtypeL
    · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K).isClosed_ker
  have hid : compactOnKernelOfIdentitySub K =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K).ker := by
    ext x
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (compactOnKernelOfIdentitySub_apply K x)
  rw [hid] at hcomp
  exact isCompactOperator_id_iff_finiteDimensional.mp hcomp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.compactPowerRemainderComplex_isCompact
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa [compactPowerRemainderComplex] using
        (isCompactOperator_zero : IsCompactOperator (0 : E →L[ℂ] E))
  | succ n ih =>
      have heq : compactPowerRemainderComplex K (n + 1) =
          compactPowerRemainderComplex K n +
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n).comp K := by
        ext x
        change x - ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n) (x - K x) =
          (x - ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n) x) +
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n) (K x)
        rw [map_sub]
        module
      rw [heq]
      exact ih.add (hK.clm_comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_kernel_pow_identity_sub_complex
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensional_kernel_pow_identity_sub_complex
    (K : E →L[ℂ] E) (hK : IsCompactOperator K) (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n).ker
proof:
:= by
  let R := compactPowerRemainderComplex K n
  have hR : IsCompactOperator R := compactPowerRemainderComplex_isCompact K hK n
  have heq : ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - R =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K) ^ n := by
    ext x
    simp [R, compactPowerRemainderComplex]
  rw [← heq]
  exact finiteDimensional_kernel_identity_sub_complex R hR

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_genEigenspace_of_compact
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_genEigenspace_of_compact (T : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ (Module.End.genEigenspace (T : Module.End ℂ E) μ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genEigenspace_nat]
  let K : E →L[ℂ] E := μ⁻¹ • T
  have hK : IsCompactOperator K := hT.smul μ⁻¹
  let D : E →L[ℂ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - K
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℂ (D ^ n).ker := by
    exact finiteDimensional_kernel_pow_identity_sub_complex K hK n
  have hop : T.toLinearMap - μ • LinearMap.id = (-μ) • D.toLinearMap := by
    ext x
    change T x - μ • x = (-μ) • (x - μ⁻¹ • T x)
    simp only [neg_smul, smul_sub, smul_inv_smul₀ hμ]
    module
  have hpow : (T.toLinearMap - μ • LinearMap.id) ^ n =
      ((-μ) ^ n) • (D.toLinearMap ^ n) := by
    rw [hop, smul_pow]
  change FiniteDimensional ℂ
    (LinearMap.ker ((T.toLinearMap - μ • LinearMap.id) ^ n))
  have hker : LinearMap.ker ((T.toLinearMap - μ • LinearMap.id) ^ n) =
      LinearMap.ker (D.toLinearMap ^ n) := by
    rw [hpow, LinearMap.ker_smul _ _ (pow_ne_zero n (neg_ne_zero.mpr hμ))]
  have hDker : LinearMap.ker (D.toLinearMap ^ n) = (D ^ n).ker := by
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_pow]
  have hall : LinearMap.ker ((T.toLinearMap - μ • LinearMap.id) ^ n) =
      (D ^ n).ker := hker.trans hDker
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hall.symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finite_spectrum_norm_ge_of_compact
statement:
theorem finite_spectrum_norm_ge_of_compact (T : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    {μ : ℂ | μ ∈ spectrum ℂ T ∧ ε ≤ ‖μ‖}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set ℂ := {μ : ℂ | μ ∈ spectrum ℂ T ∧ ε ≤ ‖μ‖}
  change S.Finite
  by_contra hSfinite
  have hSinf : S.Infinite := Set.not_finite.mp hSfinite
  let _ : Infinite S := Set.infinite_coe_iff.mpr hSinf
  let e : ℕ ↪ S := Infinite.natEmbedding S
  let μ (n : ℕ) : ℂ := (e n).1
  have hμmem (n : ℕ) : μ n ∈ spectrum ℂ T := (e n).2.1
  have hμnorm (n : ℕ) : ε ≤ ‖μ n‖ := (e n).2.2
  have hμne (n : ℕ) : μ n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hn
    have h := hμnorm n
    rw [hn, norm_zero] at h
    linarith
  have hμinj : Function.Injective μ := by
    intro m n hmn
    exact e.injective (Subtype.ext hmn)
  have heigen (n : ℕ) : HasEigenvalue (T : Module.End ℂ E) (μ n) :=
    (hT.hasEigenvalue_iff_mem_spectrum (hμne n)).mpr (hμmem n)
  choose v hv using fun n ↦ (heigen n).exists_hasEigenvector
  have hvli : LinearIndependent ℂ v :=
    Module.End.eigenvectors_linearIndependent' (T : Module.End ℂ E) μ hμinj v hv
  let V (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ E :=
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun i : Fin n ↦ v i)
  have hV_mono {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : V m ≤ V n := by
    apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, i.2.trans_le hmn⟩, rfl⟩
  have hVmono (n : ℕ) : V n ≤ V (n + 1) := hV_mono (Nat.le_succ n)
  have hv_not_mem (n : ℕ) : v n ∉ V n := by
    have hli : LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ v i) :=
      hvli.comp (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ (i : ℕ)) Fin.val_injective
    have hlast := (linearIndependent_finSucc'.mp hli).2
    have heq : Fin.init (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ v i) = fun i : Fin n ↦ v i := by
      ext i
      rfl
    rw [heq] at hlast
    exact hlast
  have hv_mem_succ (n : ℕ) : v n ∈ V (n + 1) := by
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨Fin.last n, by simp⟩
  have hVproper (n : ℕ) : V n < V (n + 1) :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (hVmono n) fun h ↦ hv_not_mem n (h ▸ hv_mem_succ n)
  have hVclosed (n : ℕ) : IsClosed (V n : Set E) := by
    let _ : FiniteDimensional ℂ (V n) :=
      FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite ℂ (Set.finite_range fun i : Fin n ↦ v i)
    exact (V n).closed_of_finiteDimensional
  obtain ⟨c : ℂ, hc⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm ℂ
  have hx (n : ℕ) : ∃ x : E, x ∈ V (n + 1) ∧
      1 ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1 + ‖c‖ ∧ ∀ y ∈ V n, 1 ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed
        ((V n).comap (V (n + 1)).subtype : Set (V (n + 1))) := by
      exact (hVclosed n).preimage (V (n + 1)).subtypeL.continuous
    obtain ⟨z : V (n + 1), hznorm, hdist⟩ :=
      riesz_lemma_of_norm_lt hc (show ‖c‖ < 1 + ‖c‖ by linarith) hclosed
        ⟨⟨Classical.choose (SetLike.exists_of_lt (hVproper n)),
            (Classical.choose_spec (SetLike.exists_of_lt (hVproper n))).1⟩,
          (Classical.choose_spec (SetLike.exists_of_lt (hVproper n))).2⟩
    refine ⟨z.1, z.2, by simpa using hdist 0 (by simp), hznorm, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact hdist ⟨y, hVmono n hy⟩ (by simpa)
  choose x hxV _hxlower hxupper hxfar using hx
  have hT_mem_V (n : ℕ) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ V n) : T z ∈ V n := by
    apply Submodule.span_induction (p := fun z _ ↦ T z ∈ V n) _ (by simp)
        (fun a b _ _ ha hb ↦ by simpa using Submodule.add_mem (V n) ha hb)
        (fun a z _ hz ↦ by simpa using Submodule.smul_mem (V n) a hz) hz
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change T (v i) ∈ V n
    have hi := mem_eigenspace_iff.mp (hv i).1
    change T (v i) = μ i • v i at hi
    rw [hi]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hsub_mem_V (n : ℕ) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ V (n + 1)) :
      T z - μ n • z ∈ V n := by
    apply Submodule.span_induction (p := fun z _ ↦ T z - μ n • z ∈ V n) _
        (by simp) (fun a b _ _ ha hb ↦ by
          rw [map_add, smul_add, add_sub_add_comm]
          exact Submodule.add_mem (V n) ha hb)
        (fun a z _ hz ↦ by
          rw [map_smul]
          simpa only [smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_comm] using
            Submodule.smul_mem (V n) a hz) hz
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change T (v i) - μ n • v i ∈ V n
    have hi_eigen := mem_eigenspace_iff.mp (hv i).1
    change T (v i) = μ i • v i at hi_eigen
    rw [hi_eigen]
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) = n
    · rw [hi]
      simp
    · have hil : (i : ℕ) < n := by omega
      have hi' : Fin n := ⟨i, hil⟩
      have hvV : v i ∈ V n := by
        apply Submodule.subset_span
        refine ⟨⟨i.val, hil⟩, ?_⟩
        rfl
      rw [← sub_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem (V n) (μ i - μ n) hvV
  have hsep (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m < n) : ε ≤ ‖T (x n) - T (x m)‖ := by
    let y : E := x n - (μ n)⁻¹ • (T (x n) - T (x m))
    have hymem : y ∈ V n := by
      have hxm : x m ∈ V n := hV_mono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hmn) (hxV m)
      have hbase : T (x n) - μ n • x n - T (x m) ∈ V n :=
        Submodule.sub_mem _ (hsub_mem_V n (hxV n)) (hT_mem_V n hxm)
      have hy : y = -(μ n)⁻¹ • (T (x n) - μ n • x n - T (x m)) := by
        dsimp [y]
        simp only [neg_smul, smul_sub, inv_smul_smul₀ (hμne n)]
        module
      rw [hy]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hbase
    have heq : T (x n) - T (x m) = μ n • (x n - y) := by
      calc
        T (x n) - T (x m) = μ n • ((μ n)⁻¹ • (T (x n) - T (x m))) := by
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hμne n), one_smul]
        _ = μ n • (x n - y) := by simp [y]
    rw [heq, norm_smul]
    calc
      ε ≤ ‖μ n‖ := hμnorm n
      _ = ‖μ n‖ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖μ n‖ * ‖x n - y‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hxfar n y hymem) (norm_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQcompact, hQmem⟩ := hT.image_closedBall_subset_compact (1 + ‖c‖)
  obtain ⟨y, _hyQ, ψ, hψmono, hTx⟩ := hQcompact.tendsto_subseq
    (x := fun n ↦ T (x n)) fun n ↦ hQmem ⟨x n, by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hxupper n, rfl⟩
  have hcauchy := hTx.cauchySeq
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff'] at hcauchy
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcauchy ε hε
  have hlt := hN (N + 1) (by omega)
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hlt
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt)
    (hsep (ψ N) (ψ (N + 1)) (hψmono (by omega)))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.tendsto_zero_of_injective_spectrum_sequence
statement:
theorem tendsto_zero_of_injective_spectrum_sequence (T : E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) (μ : ℕ → ℂ) (hμ : ∀ n, μ n ∈ spectrum ℂ T)
    (hμinj : Function.Injective μ) :
    Tendsto μ atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero]
  intro ε hε
  let S : Set ℂ := {z : ℂ | z ∈ spectrum ℂ T ∧ ε ≤ ‖z‖}
  have hSfinite : S.Finite := finite_spectrum_norm_ge_of_compact T hT hε
  have hpre : (μ ⁻¹' S).Finite := hSfinite.preimage hμinj.injOn
  let F : Finset ℕ := hpre.toFinset
  rw [eventually_atTop]
  refine ⟨F.sup id + 1, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hnorm
  have hnS : μ n ∈ S := ⟨hμ n, le_of_not_gt hnorm⟩
  have hnF : n ∈ F := by
    simpa [F] using hnS
  have hnle : n ≤ F.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hnF
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isFredholm_and_index_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
private theorem isFredholm_and_index_zero_of_isUnit (B : F →L[ℝ] F) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    B.IsFredholm ∧ B.toLinearMap.index = 0
proof:
:= by
  let V : F →L[ℝ] F := hB.unit.inv
  have hVB : V.comp B = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    change hB.unit.inv * B = 1
    calc
      hB.unit.inv * B = hB.unit.inv * (hB.unit : F →L[ℝ] F) :=
        congrArg (hB.unit.inv * ·) hB.unit_spec.symm
      _ = 1 := hB.unit.inv_val
  have hBV : B.comp V = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    change B * hB.unit.inv = 1
    calc
      B * hB.unit.inv = (hB.unit : F →L[ℝ] F) * hB.unit.inv :=
        congrArg (· * hB.unit.inv) hB.unit_spec.symm
      _ = 1 := hB.unit.val_inv
  have hqi : V.IsQuasiInverse B := by
    constructor
    · change V.toLinearMap.comp B.toLinearMap ≈ LinearMap.id
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_comp, hVB]
      change LinearMap.id ≈ LinearMap.id
      rfl
    · change B.toLinearMap.comp V.toLinearMap ≈ LinearMap.id
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_comp, hBV]
      change LinearMap.id ≈ LinearMap.id
      rfl
  have hBfred : B.IsFredholm :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_isQuasiInverse hqi
  have hbij : Function.Bijective B :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective.mp hB
  have hindex : B.toLinearMap.index = 0 := by
    let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ B.ker := hBfred.finite_ker
    let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (F ⧸ B.range) := hBfred.finite_coker
    have hi := LinearMap.index_of_surjective (f := B.toLinearMap) hbij.2
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hbij.1] at hi
    simpa using hi
  exact ⟨hBfred, hindex⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_fredholm_smallPerturbation_radius
statement:
theorem exists_fredholm_smallPerturbation_radius {T : E →L[ℝ] F}
    (hT : T.IsFredholm) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ K : E →L[ℝ] F, ‖K‖ < ε →
      (T + K).IsFredholm ∧
        (T + K).toLinearMap.index = T.toLinearMap.index
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hT.exists_isQuasiInverse
  let ε : ℝ := (‖S‖ + 1)⁻¹
  have hε : 0 < ε := by
    dsimp [ε]
    positivity
  refine ⟨ε, hε, fun K hK ↦ ?_⟩
  let U : E →L[ℝ] F := T + K
  let A : F →L[ℝ] F := K.comp S
  have hAnorm : ‖A‖ < 1 := by
    calc
      ‖A‖ ≤ ‖K‖ * ‖S‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le K S
      _ ≤ ‖K‖ * (‖S‖ + 1) := by gcongr; norm_num
      _ < ε * (‖S‖ + 1) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hK (by positivity)
      _ = 1 := by
        dsimp [ε]
        rw [inv_mul_cancel₀]
        positivity
  let B : F →L[ℝ] F := 1 + A
  have hBunit : IsUnit B := by
    have hneg : ‖-A‖ < 1 := by simpa using hAnorm
    have hu := isUnit_one_sub_of_norm_lt_one hneg
    simpa [B, sub_neg_eq_add] using hu
  obtain ⟨hBfred, hBindex⟩ := isFredholm_and_index_zero_of_isUnit B hBunit
  let R : F →L[ℝ] F := T.comp S - ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F
  have hRfinite : R.toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change (T.toLinearMap.comp S.toLinearMap - LinearMap.id).HasFiniteRange
    exact LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange.mp hS.2.equiv
  have hRcompact : IsCompactOperator R :=
    isCompactOperator_of_hasFiniteRange_clm R hRfinite
  have hUS : U.comp S = B + R := by
    ext x
    simp [U, A, B, R]
    module
  have hUSfred : (U.comp S).IsFredholm := by
    rw [hUS]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.add_compact hBfred hRcompact
  have hUSindex : (U.comp S).toLinearMap.index = 0 := by
    rw [hUS, fredholmIndex_add_compact hBfred hRcompact, hBindex]
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := hUSfred.exists_isQuasiInverse
  have hUfred : U.IsFredholm := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_isQuasiInverse (v := S.comp W)
    exact hS.symm.of_comp_left hW
  have hSfred : S.IsFredholm :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_isQuasiInverse hS.symm
  have hTSindex : (T.comp S).toLinearMap.index = 0 := by
    have hTScompact : IsCompactOperator (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S) := by
      have hfin :
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
        change (LinearMap.id - T.toLinearMap.comp S.toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange
        simpa only [neg_sub] using
          (LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange.mp hS.2.equiv).neg
      exact isCompactOperator_of_hasFiniteRange_clm _ hfin
    have heq : T.comp S = identitySubCompact
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S) := by
      ext x
      simp [identitySubCompact_apply]
    rw [heq, index_identitySubCompact_eq_zero _ hTScompact]
  have hcompU := fredholmIndex_comp hUfred hSfred
  have hcompT := fredholmIndex_comp hT hSfred
  rw [hUSindex] at hcompU
  rw [hTSindex] at hcompT
  refine ⟨hUfred, ?_⟩
  change U.toLinearMap.index = T.toLinearMap.index
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_ker_eq_range_annihilator
statement:
theorem dualOperator_ker_eq_range_annihilator (T : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (dualOperator T).ker = StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.range
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hf y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    simpa using congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe hf) x
  · intro hf
    ext x
    exact hf (T x) (T.mem_range_self x)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_range_le_ker_annihilator
statement:
theorem dualOperator_range_le_ker_annihilator (T : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (dualOperator T).range ≤ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hf
  rw [mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff]
  intro x hx
  have hTx : T x = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx
  change g (T x) = 0
  rw [hTx, map_zero]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.continuousAnnihilator_isClosed
statement:
theorem continuousAnnihilator_isClosed (S : Submodule ℝ E) :
    IsClosed (StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S : Set (StrongDual ℝ E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) =
      ⋂ x ∈ S, ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ) x).ker by
    ext f
    simp [mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff, LinearMap.mem_ker]]
  exact isClosed_biInter fun x _ ↦ ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ) x).isClosed_ker

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] private theorem dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator_apply_coe (T : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (f : StrongDual ℝ F) :
    (dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator T f : StrongDual ℝ E) = dualOperator T f
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator_surjective_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsurj
    apply le_antisymm (dualOperator_range_le_ker_annihilator T)
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hsurj ⟨f, hf⟩
    exact ⟨g, congrArg Subtype.val hg⟩
  · intro heq f
    have hf : (f : StrongDual ℝ E) ∈ (dualOperator T).range := heq.symm ▸ f.property
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨g, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    exact hg

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.quotientKerOperator_mk
statement:
@[simp] private theorem quotientKerOperator_mk (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    quotientKerOperator T (T.ker.mkQ x) = T x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.quotientKerOperator_injective
statement:
private theorem quotientKerOperator_injective (T : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    Injective (quotientKerOperator T)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  revert hxy
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on T.ker x ?_
  intro a
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on T.ker y ?_
  intro b hab
  change T a = T b at hab
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
  rw [map_sub]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hab

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.quotientKerOperator_range
statement:
private theorem quotientKerOperator_range (T : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    Set.range (quotientKerOperator T) = Set.range T
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | _ x => exact ⟨x, quotientKerOperator_mk T x⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨T.ker.mkQ x, quotientKerOperator_mk T x⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.quotientKerFunctional_mk
statement:
@[simp] private theorem quotientKerFunctional_mk (T : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (f : StrongDual ℝ E) (hf : f ∈ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker) (x : E) :
    quotientKerFunctional T f hf (T.ker.mkQ x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator_of_isClosed_range
statement:
theorem dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator_of_isClosed_range
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hT : IsClosed (Set.range T)) :
    (dualOperator T).range = StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (dualOperator_range_le_ker_annihilator T)
  intro f hf
  let _ : IsClosed (T.ker : Set E) := T.isClosed_ker
  let Q := quotientKerOperator T
  have hQinj : Injective Q := quotientKerOperator_injective T
  have hQrange : IsClosed (Set.range Q) := by
    rw [quotientKerOperator_range]
    exact hT
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := ContinuousLinearMap.antilipschitz_of_injective_of_isClosed_range
    (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := HasQuotient.Quotient E T.ker) (F := F) Q hQinj hQrange
  let qf := quotientKerFunctional T f hf
  have hbound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : E, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * ‖T x‖ := by
    refine ⟨‖qf‖ * K, ?_⟩
    intro x
    have hqf : ‖qf (T.ker.mkQ x)‖ ≤ ‖qf‖ * ‖T.ker.mkQ x‖ := qf.le_opNorm _
    have hanti := hK.le_mul_dist (T.ker.mkQ x) 0
    simp only [dist_zero_right, map_zero, Q, quotientKerOperator_mk] at hanti
    calc
      ‖f x‖ = ‖qf (T.ker.mkQ x)‖ := by rw [quotientKerFunctional_mk]
      _ ≤ ‖qf‖ * ‖T.ker.mkQ x‖ := hqf
      _ ≤ ‖qf‖ * (K * ‖T x‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hanti (norm_nonneg qf)
      _ = (‖qf‖ * K) * ‖T x‖ := by ring
  let frange : StrongDual ℝ T.range := f.toLinearMap.compLeftInverse T.toLinearMap
  obtain ⟨g, hg, _hgnorm⟩ := hahnBanach_exists_extension_norm_eq T.range frange
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  ext x
  have happly := LinearMap.compLeftInverse_apply_of_bdd
    f.toLinearMap T.toLinearMap hbound x (T x) rfl
  have hgTx := hg ⟨T x, T.mem_range_self x⟩
  change g (T x) = f x
  rw [hgTx]
  exact happly

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isClosed_range_of_dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_of_dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (heq : (dualOperator T).range = StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker) :
    IsClosed (Set.range T)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : IsClosed (T.ker : Set E) := T.isClosed_ker
  let _ : IsClosed (StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) :=
    continuousAnnihilator_isClosed T.ker
  have hsurj : Surjective (dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator T) :=
    (dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator_surjective_iff T).2 heq
  obtain ⟨C, hCpos, hpre⟩ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.exists_preimage_norm_le
      (𝕜 := ℝ) (𝕜' := ℝ) (E := StrongDual ℝ F)
      (F := StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker)
      (dualOperatorToKerAnnihilator T) hsurj
  let Q := quotientKerOperator T
  have hQnorm : ∀ q, ‖q‖ ≤ C * ‖Q q‖ := by
    intro q
    by_cases hq₀ : q = 0
    · subst q
      simp
    obtain ⟨φ, hφnorm, hφq⟩ := exists_dual_vector ℝ q (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hq₀)
    let f : StrongDual ℝ E := φ.comp T.ker.mkQL
    have hfann : f ∈ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker := by
      rw [mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff]
      intro x hx
      have hx₀ : T.ker.mkQL x = 0 := by
        rw [Submodule.mkQL_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
        exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero T.ker).2 hx
      simp [f, hx₀]
    let y : StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker := ⟨f, hfann⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hgy, hgnorm⟩ := hpre y
    have hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≤ 1 := by
      have hmk : ‖T.ker.mkQL‖ ≤ 1 := by
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
        intro x
        rw [one_mul, Submodule.mkQL_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
        exact Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le T.ker x
      calc
        ‖f‖ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖T.ker.mkQL‖ := φ.opNorm_comp_le T.ker.mkQL
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := by simpa [hφnorm] using hmk
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have hynorm : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [y] using hfnorm
    have hφg : φ q = g (Q q) := by
      refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on T.ker q ?_
      intro x
      have hcoe := congrArg Subtype.val hgy
      have happly := congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe hcoe) x
      change φ (T.ker.mkQ x) = g (Q (T.ker.mkQ x))
      rw [show Q (T.ker.mkQ x) = T x by exact quotientKerOperator_mk T x]
      simpa [f, y] using happly.symm
    calc
      ‖q‖ = |φ q| := by simp [hφq]
      _ = |g (Q q)| := by rw [hφg]
      _ = ‖g (Q q)‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖Q q‖ := g.le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ (C * ‖y‖) * ‖Q q‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgnorm (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (C * 1) * ‖Q q‖ := by gcongr
      _ = C * ‖Q q‖ := by rw [mul_one]
  let K : NNReal := ⟨C, hCpos.le⟩
  have hanti : AntilipschitzWith K Q := by
    apply (antilipschitzWith_iff_le_mul_dist).2
    intro q r
    change dist q r ≤ C * dist (Q q) (Q r)
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hQnorm (q - r)
  have hclosedQ : IsClosed (Set.range Q) :=
    hanti.isClosed_range Q.uniformContinuous
  rwa [quotientKerOperator_range] at hclosedQ

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isClosed_range_iff_dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_iff_dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator
    [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    IsClosed (Set.range T) ↔
      (dualOperator T).range = StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T.ker
proof:
:=
  ⟨dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator_of_isClosed_range T,
    isClosed_range_of_dualOperator_range_eq_ker_annihilator T⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff
statement:
theorem mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff (S : Submodule ℝ E) (f : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    f ∈ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact StrongDual.mem_polarSubmodule ℝ S f

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.continuousAnnihilator_anti
statement:
theorem continuousAnnihilator_anti {S T : Submodule ℝ E} (hST : S ≤ T) :
    StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ T ≤ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  rw [mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff] at hf ⊢
  exact fun x hx ↦ hf x (hST hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_annihilator
statement:
theorem mem_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_annihilator (S : Submodule ℝ E) (x : E) :
    x ∈ S.topologicalClosure ↔
      ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E, f ∈ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S → f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx f hf
    apply S.topologicalClosure_minimal _ f.isClosed_ker hx
    intro y hy
    exact (mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff S f).mp hf y hy
  · intro hx
    by_contra hxc
    obtain ⟨f, c, hfS, hcfx⟩ :=
      separate_closed_convex_point (s := (S.topologicalClosure : Set E))
        S.topologicalClosure.convex S.isClosed_topologicalClosure hxc
    have hcpos : 0 < c := by
      simpa using hfS 0 S.topologicalClosure.zero_mem
    have hfzero : ∀ y ∈ S, f y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      by_contra hfy
      have hzmem : ((c + 1) / f y) • y ∈ S.topologicalClosure :=
        S.le_topologicalClosure (S.smul_mem ((c + 1) / f y) hy)
      have hz := hfS _ hzmem
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfy] at hz
      linarith
    have hfxzero := hx f ((mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff S f).mpr hfzero)
    rw [hfxzero] at hcfx
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_closedSubspace_iff_forall_annihilator
statement:
theorem mem_closedSubspace_iff_forall_annihilator (S : Submodule ℝ E)
    (hS : IsClosed (S : Set E)) (x : E) :
    x ∈ S ↔ ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E, f ∈ StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S → f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (mem_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_annihilator S x).mp (S.le_topologicalClosure hx)
  · intro hx
    exact S.topologicalClosure_minimal le_rfl hS
      ((mem_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_annihilator S x).mpr hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_reflexive
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_reflexive {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ : Module.Dual ℝ E ≃ₗ[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ E := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_surjective e₁.toLinearMap e₁.surjective
  let e₂ : Module.Dual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) ≃ₗ[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) :=
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_surjective e₂.toLinearMap e₂.surjective
  apply (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank ?_).mp
    (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDualLi ℝ).injective
  calc
    finrank ℝ E = finrank ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ E) := Subspace.dual_finrank_eq.symm
    _ = finrank ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E) := e₁.finrank_eq
    _ = finrank ℝ (Module.Dual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) := Subspace.dual_finrank_eq.symm
    _ = finrank ℝ (StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) := e₂.finrank_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.realHilbert_reflexive
statement:
theorem realHilbert_reflexive {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  intro Φ
  let R := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E
  let g : StrongDual ℝ E := Φ.comp R.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  let x : E := R.symm g
  refine ⟨x, ContinuousLinearMap.ext ?_⟩
  intro f
  change f x = Φ f
  calc
    f x = inner ℝ (R.symm f) x := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply.symm
    _ = inner ℝ x (R.symm f) := real_inner_comm _ _
    _ = g (R.symm f) := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    _ = Φ (R (R.symm f)) := rfl
    _ = Φ f := congrArg Φ (R.apply_symm_apply f)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.bidual_evaluation
statement:
theorem bidual_evaluation (x : E) (f : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E x f = f x
proof:
:= by
  exact NormedSpace.dual_def ℝ E x f

statement:

    ‖NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by

statement:

    Function.Injective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.reflexive_iff_every_bidual_is_evaluation
statement:
theorem reflexive_iff_every_bidual_is_evaluation :
    Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E) ↔
      ∀ Φ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E), ∃ x : E, ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E, Φ f = f x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h Φ
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h Φ
    exact ⟨x, fun f ↦ bidual_evaluation x f⟩
  · intro h Φ
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h Φ
    refine ⟨x, ContinuousLinearMap.ext ?_⟩
    intro f
    exact (bidual_evaluation x f).trans (hx f).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.existsUnique_bidual_evaluation
statement:
theorem existsUnique_bidual_evaluation
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E))
    (Φ : StrongDual ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)) :
    ∃! x : E, ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E, Φ f = f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (reflexive_iff_every_bidual_is_evaluation (E := E)).mp hE Φ
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  apply bidual_evaluation_injective (E := E)
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro f
  rw [bidual_evaluation, bidual_evaluation, ← hx f, ← hy f]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicAverage_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem meanErgodicAverage_apply (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
    meanErgodicAverage T n x = birkhoffAverage ℝ T _root_.id n x
proof:
:= by
  simp [meanErgodicAverage, birkhoffAverage, birkhoffSum]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.IsPowerBounded.nonneg_bound
statement:
theorem IsPowerBounded.nonneg_bound {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcn⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨c, hc.trans' zero_le_one, hcn⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isBounded_orbit_of_powerBounded
proof:
:= by
  refine isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.2 ⟨c * ‖x‖, Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  have hn := (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (T ^ n) x).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hT n) (norm_nonneg x))
  simp only [id_eq]
  have hiter : T^[n] x = (T ^ n) x := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply, pow_succ]
  rw [hiter]
  exact hn

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.norm_meanErgodicAverage_le
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hc
  intro x
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp only [meanErgodicAverage_apply, birkhoffAverage_zero', Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hc (norm_nonneg x)
  simp only [meanErgodicAverage, smul_apply]
  rw [norm_smul]
  calc
    ‖((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹‖ * ‖(∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), T ^ k) x‖
        ≤ ((n + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖(T ^ k) x‖ := by
          rw [norm_inv, norm_natCast]
          simp only [Nat.cast_add_one]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (by simpa only [sum_apply] using
              (norm_sum_le (Finset.range (n + 1)) fun k ↦ (T ^ k) x))
            (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
    _ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c * ‖x‖ := by
          gcongr with k hk
          exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (T ^ k) x).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hT k) (norm_nonneg x))
    _ = c * ‖x‖ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add_one]
      field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicAverage_fixed
proof:
:= by
  rw [meanErgodicAverage_apply]
  have hfix : IsFixedPt T x := by simpa [IsFixedPt] using hx
  exact hfix.birkhoffAverage_eq ℝ _root_.id (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_difference
proof:
:= by
  have horbit : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range (_root_.id <| T^[·] x)) := by
    exact isBounded_orbit_of_powerBounded hT x
  have htel := tendsto_birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage ℝ horbit
  convert htel using 1
  ext n
  simp [meanErgodicAverage_apply, birkhoffAverage, birkhoffSum,
    iterate_map_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.uniformEquicontinuous_meanErgodicAverage
proof:
:= by
  let C : NNReal := ⟨c, hc⟩
  apply LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous _ C
  intro n
  exact (meanErgodicAverage T n).lipschitz.weaken (by
    change ‖meanErgodicAverage T n‖₊ ≤ C
    exact_mod_cast norm_meanErgodicAverage_le hc hT n)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_differenceClosure
statement:
theorem tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_differenceClosure {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c)
    {y : E} (hy : y ∈ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n y) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hequi := (uniformEquicontinuous_meanErgodicAverage hc hT).equicontinuous
  have hclosed : IsClosed
      {z : E | Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n z) atTop (nhds 0)} :=
    hequi.isClosed_setOfPred_tendsto continuous_const
  have hsubset : ((T - 1).range : Set E) ⊆
      {z : E | Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n z) atTop (nhds 0)} := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_difference hc hT x
  have hyclosure : y ∈ closure ((T - 1).range : Set E) := by
    change y ∈ (T - 1).range.topologicalClosure at hy
    change y ∈ (T - 1).range.topologicalClosure
    exact hy
  exact (closure_minimal hsubset hclosed) hyclosure

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_fixed
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ne_atTop 0] with n hn
  exact (meanErgodicAverage_fixed hx hn).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_add_fixed_differenceClosure
statement:
theorem tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_add_fixed_differenceClosure
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c)
    {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T)
    (hy : y ∈ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n (x + y)) atTop (nhds x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_add, add_zero] using
    (tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_fixed hx).add
      (tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_differenceClosure hc hT hy)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodic_sup_le_convergence
statement:
theorem meanErgodic_sup_le_convergence [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) :
    meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T ⊔ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T ≤
      meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
  exact ⟨x, tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_add_fixed_differenceClosure hc hT hx hy⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicAverage_commute
statement:
theorem meanErgodicAverage_commute (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) :
    (meanErgodicAverage T n).comp T = T.comp (meanErgodicAverage T n)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change meanErgodicAverage T n (T x) = T (meanErgodicAverage T n x)
  simp only [meanErgodicAverage, smul_apply, sum_apply, map_smul, map_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  change ((T ^ k) * T) x = (T * (T ^ k)) x
  rw [← pow_succ, ← pow_succ']

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dual_annihilator_meanErgodicAverage
statement:
theorem dual_annihilator_meanErgodicAverage {T : E →L[ℝ] E}
    {f : StrongDual ℝ E} (hf : f ∈ (dualOperator (T - 1)).ker)
    (x : E) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    f (meanErgodicAverage T n x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  have hfix (u : E) : f (T u) = f u := by
    have hzero := congrArg (fun g : StrongDual ℝ E ↦ g u) hf
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [dualOperator_apply] using hzero)
  have hiter (k : ℕ) : f (T^[k] x) = f x := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        exact (hfix _).trans ih
  simp only [meanErgodicAverage, smul_apply, sum_apply, map_smul, map_sum]
  simp [hiter, hn]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_fixed_of_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage
proof:
:= by
  have htel := tendsto_birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage ℝ
    (isBounded_orbit_of_powerBounded hT x)
  have hzero : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ T (meanErgodicAverage T n x) - meanErgodicAverage T n x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    convert htel using 1
    ext n
    rw [← meanErgodicAverage_apply, ← meanErgodicAverage_apply]
    have hcomm := congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E ↦ A x) (meanErgodicAverage_commute T n)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hcomm.symm
  have hlimit : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ T (meanErgodicAverage T n x) - meanErgodicAverage T n x)
      atTop (nhds (T z - z)) := (T.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hz).sub hz
  have : T z - z = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hlimit hzero
  change T z = z
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.sub_mem_differenceClosure_of_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage
statement:
theorem sub_mem_differenceClosure_of_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {x z : E}
    (hz : Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n x) atTop (nhds z)) :
    x - z ∈ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_range_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker]
  intro f hf
  have hfz : Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (meanErgodicAverage T n x)) atTop (nhds (f z)) :=
    f.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hz
  have hfx : Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (meanErgodicAverage T n x)) atTop (nhds (f x)) := by
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ne_atTop 0] with n hn
    exact (dual_annihilator_meanErgodicAverage hf x hn).symm
  have : f z = f x := tendsto_nhds_unique hfz hfx
  simp [this]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodic_convergence_le_sup
statement:
theorem meanErgodic_convergence_le_sup [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) :
    meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T ≤
      meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T ⊔ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
  have hzfix : z ∈ meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T :=
    mem_fixed_of_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage hc hT hz
  have hdiff : x - z ∈ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T :=
    sub_mem_differenceClosure_of_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage hz
  apply Submodule.mem_sup.mpr
  exact ⟨z, hzfix, x - z, hdiff, by abel⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_eq_sup
statement:
theorem meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_eq_sup [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) :
    meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T =
      meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T ⊔ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (meanErgodic_convergence_le_sup hc hT)
    (meanErgodic_sup_le_convergence hc hT)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.disjoint_meanErgodicFixed_differenceClosure
statement:
theorem disjoint_meanErgodicFixed_differenceClosure
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) :
    Disjoint (meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T) (meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hxfix hxdiff
  have htoX := tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_fixed hxfix
  have hto0 := tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_differenceClosure hc hT hxdiff
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique htoX hto0

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_sup_of_meanErgodicAverage_weak_subsequence
statement:
theorem mem_sup_of_meanErgodicAverage_weak_subsequence
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (_hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c)
    {x z : E} {φ : ℕ → ℕ} (hφ : StrictMono φ)
    (hweak : ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x)) atTop (nhds (f z))) :
    x ∈ meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T ⊔ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T
proof:
:= by
  have htel := tendsto_birkhoffAverage_apply_sub_birkhoffAverage ℝ
    (isBounded_orbit_of_powerBounded hT x)
  have hzero : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ T (meanErgodicAverage T n x) - meanErgodicAverage T n x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    convert htel using 1
    ext n
    rw [← meanErgodicAverage_apply, ← meanErgodicAverage_apply]
    have hcomm := congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E ↦ A x) (meanErgodicAverage_commute T n)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hcomm.symm
  have hzfix : z ∈ meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T := by
    change T z = z
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply SeparatingDual.eq_zero_of_forall_dual_eq_zero (R := ℝ) (V := E)
    intro f
    have hlim : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ f (T (meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x) -
          meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x)) atTop (nhds (f (T z - z))) := by
      simpa only [map_sub, dualOperator_apply] using
        (hweak (dualOperator T f)).sub (hweak f)
    have h0 : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ f (T (meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x) -
          meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, map_sub, map_zero] using
        (f.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hzero.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop))
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim h0
  have hdiff : x - z ∈ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T := by
    rw [mem_range_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker]
    intro f hf
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x))
        atTop (nhds (f x)) := by
      apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
      filter_upwards [hφ.tendsto_atTop.eventually (eventually_ne_atTop 0)] with n hn
      exact (dual_annihilator_meanErgodicAverage hf x hn).symm
    have : f z = f x := tendsto_nhds_unique (hweak f) hconst
    simp [this]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨z, hzfix, x - z, hdiff, by abel⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_iff_weak_subsequence
statement:
theorem mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_iff_weak_subsequence [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) (x : E) :
    x ∈ meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T ↔
      ∃ z : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
          Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x)) atTop (nhds (f z))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z, _root_.id, strictMono_id, ?_⟩
    intro f
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] using f.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hz
  · rintro ⟨z, φ, hφ, hweak⟩
    apply meanErgodic_sup_le_convergence hc hT
    exact mem_sup_of_meanErgodicAverage_weak_subsequence hc hT hφ hweak

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.norm_fixed_le_norm_add_differenceClosure
statement:
theorem norm_fixed_le_norm_add_differenceClosure
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c)
    {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T)
    (hy : y ∈ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ c * ‖x + y‖
proof:
:= by
  have hlim := (tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_add_fixed_differenceClosure hc hT hx hy).norm
  apply le_of_tendsto hlim
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
    (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (meanErgodicAverage T n) (x + y)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_meanErgodicAverage_le hc hT n)
        (norm_nonneg (x + y)))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicAddMap_apply
proof:
:= by
  simp [meanErgodicAddMap]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicAddMap_antilipschitz
statement:
private theorem meanErgodicAddMap_antilipschitz
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) :
    ∃ K, AntilipschitzWith K (meanErgodicAddMap T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [antilipschitzWith_iff_exists_mul_le_norm]
  refine ⟨(c + 1)⁻¹, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro p
  have hx : ‖(p.1 : E)‖ ≤ c * ‖(p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)‖ :=
    norm_fixed_le_norm_add_differenceClosure hc hT p.1.property p.2.property
  have hy : ‖(p.2 : E)‖ ≤ (c + 1) * ‖(p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)‖ := by
    calc
      ‖(p.2 : E)‖ = ‖((p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)) - (p.1 : E)‖ := by
        congr 1
        abel
      _ ≤ ‖(p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)‖ + ‖(p.1 : E)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖(p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)‖ + c * ‖(p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)‖ :=
        add_le_add_right hx _
      _ = (c + 1) * ‖(p.1 : E) + (p.2 : E)‖ := by ring
  have hp : ‖p‖ ≤ (c + 1) * ‖meanErgodicAddMap T p‖ := by
    rw [Prod.norm_def, meanErgodicAddMap_apply]
    exact max_le
      (hx.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _)) hy
  calc
    (c + 1)⁻¹ * ‖p‖ ≤ (c + 1)⁻¹ * ((c + 1) * ‖meanErgodicAddMap T p‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
    _ = ‖meanErgodicAddMap T p‖ := by field_simp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.range_meanErgodicAddMap
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    rw [meanErgodicAddMap_apply]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup p.1.property p.2.property
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
    refine ⟨(⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩), ?_⟩
    simpa [meanErgodicAddMap_apply] using hxy

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isClosed_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule
statement:
theorem isClosed_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hT : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) :
    IsClosed (meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : IsClosed (meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T : Set E) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.isClosed_eqLocus T 1
  letI : CompleteSpace (meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T) := IsClosed.completeSpace_coe
  let _ : IsClosed (meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T : Set E) :=
    Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure (T - 1).range
  letI : CompleteSpace (meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T) := IsClosed.completeSpace_coe
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := meanErgodicAddMap_antilipschitz hc hT
  have hrange : IsClosed (Set.range (meanErgodicAddMap T)) :=
    hK.isClosed_range (meanErgodicAddMap T).uniformContinuous
  rw [range_meanErgodicAddMap T, ← meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_eq_sup hc hT] at hrange
  exact hrange

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.map_mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule
statement:
theorem map_mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T) :
    T x ∈ meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨T z, ?_⟩
  have hTz : Tendsto (fun n ↦ T (meanErgodicAverage T n x)) atTop (nhds (T z)) :=
    T.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hz
  convert hTz using 1
  ext n
  exact congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E ↦ A x) (meanErgodicAverage_commute T n)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodic_decomposition_of_powerBounded
statement:
theorem meanErgodic_decomposition_of_powerBounded [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T) :
    meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T =
        meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T ⊔ meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T ∧
      Disjoint (meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T) (meanErgodicDifferenceClosure T) ∧
      IsClosed (meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc⟩ := hT
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := zero_le_one.trans hc1
  exact ⟨meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_eq_sup hc0 hc,
    disjoint_meanErgodicFixed_differenceClosure hc0 hc,
    isClosed_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule hc0 hc⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_iff_weak_subsequence_of_powerBounded
statement:
theorem mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_iff_weak_subsequence_of_powerBounded
    [CompleteSpace E] {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T) (x : E) :
    x ∈ meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule T ↔
      ∃ z : E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ E,
          Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (meanErgodicAverage T (φ n) x)) atTop (nhds (f z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc⟩ := hT
  exact mem_meanErgodicConvergenceSubmodule_iff_weak_subsequence
    (zero_le_one.trans hc1) hc x

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_apply

theorem dualOperator_apply (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (f : StrongDual ℝ F) (x : E) :

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.norm_dualOperator_le
statement: theorem norm_dualOperator_le (T : E →L[ℝ] F) : ‖dualOperator T‖ ≤ ‖T‖

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.identitySubCompact_compactPowerRemainder
statement:
@[simp]
theorem identitySubCompact_compactPowerRemainder (K : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) :
    identitySubCompact (compactPowerRemainder K n) = identitySubCompact K ^ n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [compactPowerRemainder, identitySubCompact_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.compactPowerRemainder_isCompactOperator
statement:
theorem compactPowerRemainder_isCompactOperator (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) (n : ℕ) :
    IsCompactOperator (compactPowerRemainder K n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa [compactPowerRemainder] using
        (zero_isCompactOperator (E := E) (F := E))
  | succ n ih =>
      have heq : compactPowerRemainder K (n + 1) =
          compactPowerRemainder K n + (identitySubCompact K ^ n).comp K := by
        ext x
        simp [compactPowerRemainder, identitySubCompact_apply, pow_succ]
        module
      rw [heq]
      exact ih.add (hK.clm_comp (identitySubCompact K ^ n))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isClosed_range_pow_identitySubCompact
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_pow_identitySubCompact (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) (n : ℕ) :
    IsClosed (Set.range (identitySubCompact K ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← identitySubCompact_compactPowerRemainder K n]
  exact isClosed_range_identitySubCompact _
    (compactPowerRemainder_isCompactOperator K hK n)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_kernel_pow_identitySubCompact
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_kernel_pow_identitySubCompact (K : E →L[ℝ] E)

    FiniteDimensional ℝ (identitySubCompact K ^ n).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [← identitySubCompact_compactPowerRemainder K n]
  exact finiteDimensional_kernel_identitySubCompact _
    (compactPowerRemainder_isCompactOperator K hK n)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.finiteDimensional_cokernel_pow_identitySubCompact
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_cokernel_pow_identitySubCompact (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℝ (E ⧸ (identitySubCompact K ^ n).range)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← identitySubCompact_compactPowerRemainder K n]
  exact finiteDimensional_cokernel_identitySubCompact _
    (compactPowerRemainder_isCompactOperator K hK n)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_kernel_pow_stabilizes
statement:
private theorem exists_kernel_pow_stabilizes (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (identitySubCompact K ^ (n + 1)).ker =
      (identitySubCompact K ^ n).ker
proof:
:= by
  let S : E →L[ℝ] E := identitySubCompact K
  let V (n : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ E := (S ^ n).ker
  by_contra! h
  have hVmono {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p ≤ q) : V p ≤ V q := by
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hpq
    intro u hu
    change (S ^ (p + d)) u = 0
    rw [Nat.add_comm, pow_add]
    change (S ^ d) ((S ^ p) u) = 0
    have hu0 : (S ^ p) u = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hu
    rw [hu0, map_zero]
  have hproper (n : ℕ) : V n < V (n + 1) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (hVmono (Nat.le_succ n)) ?_
    exact Ne.symm (h n)
  obtain ⟨a : ℝ, ha⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm ℝ
  have hx (n : ℕ) : ∃ x : E, x ∈ V (n + 1) ∧
      1 ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1 + ‖a‖ ∧ ∀ y ∈ V n, 1 ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed
        ((V n).comap (V (n + 1)).subtype : Set (V (n + 1))) := by
      exact (S ^ n).isClosed_ker.preimage (V (n + 1)).subtypeL.continuous
    obtain ⟨z : V (n + 1), hznorm, hdist⟩ :=
      riesz_lemma_of_norm_lt ha (show ‖a‖ < 1 + ‖a‖ by linarith) hclosed
        ⟨⟨Classical.choose (SetLike.exists_of_lt (hproper n)),
            (Classical.choose_spec (SetLike.exists_of_lt (hproper n))).1⟩,
          (Classical.choose_spec (SetLike.exists_of_lt (hproper n))).2⟩
    refine ⟨z.1, z.2, by simpa using hdist 0 (by simp), hznorm, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact hdist ⟨y, hVmono (Nat.le_succ n) hy⟩ (by simpa)
  choose x hxV _hxlower hxupper hxfar using hx
  obtain ⟨Q, hQcompact, hQmem⟩ :=
    hK.image_closedBall_subset_compact (1 + ‖a‖)
  obtain ⟨y, _hyQ, ψ, hψmono, hKx⟩ := hQcompact.tendsto_subseq
    (x := fun n ↦ K (x n)) fun n ↦ hQmem ⟨x n, by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hxupper n, rfl⟩
  have hS_mem (j : ℕ) {u : E} (hu : u ∈ V (j + 1)) : S u ∈ V j := by
    change (S ^ j) (S u) = 0
    have hu0 : (S ^ (j + 1)) u = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hu
    rw [pow_succ] at hu0
    exact hu0
  have hsep (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m < n) : 1 ≤ ‖K (x n) - K (x m)‖ := by
    let z := S (x n) - S (x m) + x m
    have hz : z ∈ V n := by
      dsimp [z, V]
      apply Submodule.add_mem
      · exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (hS_mem n (hxV n))
          (hVmono hmn.le (hS_mem m (hxV m)))
      · exact hVmono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hmn) (hxV m)
    have heq : K (x n) - K (x m) = x n - z := by
      dsimp [z, S]
      simp [identitySubCompact_apply]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    exact hxfar n z hz
  have hcauchy := hKx.cauchySeq
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff'] at hcauchy
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcauchy 1 (by norm_num)
  have hlt := hN (N + 1) (by omega)
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hlt
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt)
    (hsep (ψ N) (ψ (N + 1)) (hψmono (by omega)))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualOperator_pow
statement:
private theorem dualOperator_pow (T : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) :
    dualOperator (T ^ n) = dualOperator T ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      change dualOperator (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (StrongDual ℝ E)
      exact dualOperator_id
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      change dualOperator ((T ^ n).comp T) =
        (dualOperator T ^ n).comp (dualOperator T)
      rw [dualOperator_comp, ih]
      exact (Commute.self_pow (dualOperator T) n).eq

    A = B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_closedSubspace_iff_forall_annihilator A hA,
    mem_closedSubspace_iff_forall_annihilator B hB, hann]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.kernel_pow_eq_of_stabilizes
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : LinearMap.ker (T.toLinearMap ^ k) =
