name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_isCompl_kernel_range_pow
statement:
private theorem exists_isCompl_kernel_range_pow (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ IsCompl (identitySubCompact K ^ N).ker
      (identitySubCompact K ^ N).range
proof:
:= by
  let S := identitySubCompact K
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_kernel_pow_stabilizes K hK
  have hKdual : IsCompactOperator (dualOperator K) :=
    dualOperator_isCompactOperator K hK
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_kernel_pow_stabilizes (dualOperator K) hKdual
  let N := max k d + 1
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by simp [N]
  have hk_le_N : k ≤ N := by simp [N]; omega
  have hd_le_N : d ≤ N := by simp [N]; omega
  have hk_le_2N : k ≤ 2 * N := hk_le_N.trans (by omega)
  have hd_le_2N : d ≤ 2 * N := hd_le_N.trans (by omega)
  have hkN : (S ^ k).ker = (S ^ N).ker := by
    have h := kernel_pow_eq_of_stabilizes S (m := N - k) hk
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hk_le_N] at h
  have hk2N : (S ^ k).ker = (S ^ (2 * N)).ker := by
    have h := kernel_pow_eq_of_stabilizes S (m := 2 * N - k) hk
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hk_le_2N] at h
  have hker : (S ^ N).ker = (S ^ (2 * N)).ker := hkN.symm.trans hk2N
  let Sd := identitySubCompact (dualOperator K)
  have hdN : (Sd ^ d).ker = (Sd ^ N).ker := by
    have h := kernel_pow_eq_of_stabilizes Sd (m := N - d) hd
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hd_le_N] at h
  have hd2N : (Sd ^ d).ker = (Sd ^ (2 * N)).ker := by
    have h := kernel_pow_eq_of_stabilizes Sd (m := 2 * N - d) hd
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hd_le_2N] at h
  have hdualKer : (dualOperator (S ^ N)).ker =
      (dualOperator (S ^ (2 * N))).ker := by
    rw [dualOperator_pow, dualOperator_pow,
      dualOperator_identitySubCompact K]
    exact hdN.symm.trans hd2N
  have hann : StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ (S ^ N).range =
      StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ (S ^ (2 * N)).range := by
    rw [← dualOperator_ker_eq_range_annihilator,
      ← dualOperator_ker_eq_range_annihilator]
    exact hdualKer
  have hrange : (S ^ N).range = (S ^ (2 * N)).range :=
    closedSubmodule_eq_of_annihilator_eq _ _
      (isClosed_range_pow_identitySubCompact K hK N)
      (isClosed_range_pow_identitySubCompact K hK (2 * N)) hann
  refine ⟨N, hNpos, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    rintro x hxker ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by
      have hxker0 : (S ^ N) x = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hxker
      have hyS : (S ^ N) y = x := hy
      have hy2 : (S ^ (2 * N)) y = 0 := by
        rw [show 2 * N = N + N by omega, pow_add]
        change (S ^ N) ((S ^ N) y) = 0
        rw [hyS]
        exact hxker0
      have hyN : y ∈ (S ^ N).ker := hker.symm ▸ hy2
      calc
        x = (S ^ N) y := hy.symm
        _ = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hyN
    exact hx0
  · rw [codisjoint_iff]
    apply top_unique
    intro x _hx
    have hSx : (S ^ N) x ∈ (S ^ (2 * N)).range := by
      rw [← hrange]
      exact (S ^ N).mem_range_self x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hSx
    apply Submodule.mem_sup.mpr
    refine ⟨x - (S ^ N) y, ?_, (S ^ N) y,
      (S ^ N).mem_range_self y, sub_add_cancel _ _⟩
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    change (S ^ N) (x - (S ^ N) y) = 0
    rw [map_sub]
    have hpow : (S ^ (2 * N)) y = (S ^ N) ((S ^ N) y) := by
      rw [show 2 * N = N + N by omega, pow_add]
      rfl
    rw [← hpow]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hy.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.index_eq_zero_of_isCompl_kernel_range
statement:
private theorem index_eq_zero_of_isCompl_kernel_range (T : E →L[ℝ] E)

proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.index_eq_finrank_sub]
  have hfin : Module.finrank ℝ (E ⧸ T.range) = Module.finrank ℝ T.ker :=
    (T.range.quotientEquivOfIsCompl T.ker hcompl.symm).finrank_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.index_pow_identitySubCompact
statement:
private theorem index_pow_identitySubCompact (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) (n : ℕ) :
    (identitySubCompact K ^ n).toLinearMap.index =
      n * (identitySubCompact K).toLinearMap.index
proof:
:= by
  let S := identitySubCompact K
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
      change (LinearMap.id : E →ₗ[ℝ] E).index = 0
      exact LinearMap.index_id
  | succ n ih =>
      let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (S ^ n).ker :=
        finiteDimensional_kernel_pow_identitySubCompact K hK n
      let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (E ⧸ (S ^ n).range) :=
        finiteDimensional_cokernel_pow_identitySubCompact K hK n
      let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ S.ker :=
        finiteDimensional_kernel_identitySubCompact K hK
      let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (E ⧸ S.range) :=
        finiteDimensional_cokernel_identitySubCompact K hK
      rw [pow_succ]
      change (((S ^ n).toLinearMap ∘ₗ S.toLinearMap)).index = _
      rw [LinearMap.index_comp, ih]
      push_cast
      ring

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.index_identitySubCompact_eq_zero
statement:
theorem index_identitySubCompact_eq_zero (K : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    (identitySubCompact K).toLinearMap.index = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hNpos, hcompl⟩ := exists_isCompl_kernel_range_pow K hK
  have hpow : (identitySubCompact K ^ N).toLinearMap.index = 0 :=
    index_eq_zero_of_isCompl_kernel_range _ hcompl
  rw [index_pow_identitySubCompact K hK N] at hpow
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hpow with hN | hindex
  · have : (N : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hNpos)
    exact (this hN).elim
  · exact hindex

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isClosed_cauchy_points_of_operatorNorm_bound
proof:
:= by
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro x hx
  change CauchySeq (fun q => g q x)
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
  intro ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (3 * (C + 1))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε (by positivity)
  have hδ_eq : δ * (3 * (C + 1)) = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hx δ hδ
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hy (ε / 3) (by positivity)
  have hsmall : C * dist x y < ε / 3 := by
    calc
      C * dist x y ≤ C * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy.le hC
      _ < ε / 3 := by nlinarith
  have hdist : ∀ q, dist (g q x) (g q y) ≤ C * dist x y := by
    intro q
    calc
      dist (g q x) (g q y) = ‖g q (x - y)‖ := by rw [map_sub, dist_eq_norm]
      _ ≤ ‖g q‖ * ‖x - y‖ := (g q).le_opNorm (x - y)
      _ ≤ C * dist x y := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h q) (norm_nonneg (x - y))
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro m hm n hn
  have htriangle : dist (g m x) (g n x) ≤
      dist (g m x) (g m y) + dist (g m y) (g n y) + dist (g n x) (g n y) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (g m x) (g m y) + dist (g m y) (g n x) := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ dist (g m x) (g m y) +
          (dist (g m y) (g n y) + dist (g n y) (g n x)) :=
        by linarith [dist_triangle (g m y) (g n y) (g n x)]
      _ = _ := by rw [dist_comm (g n y) (g n x)]; ring
  linarith [hdist m, hdist n, hN m hm n hn]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dense_open_nonCauchy_points_of_operatorNorm_bound
proof:
:= by
  let S := cauchyPointsSubmodule g
  have hproper : S ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hz
    have hmem : z ∈ S := by rw [htop]; trivial
    exact hz hmem
  have hInterior : interior (S : Set E) = ∅ := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hproper (S.eq_top_of_nonempty_interior' (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne))
  exact ⟨interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mp hInterior,
    (isClosed_cauchy_points_of_operatorNorm_bound hC h).isOpen_compl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_dense_Gδ_nonCauchy_points
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hbound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q, ‖g q‖ ≤ C
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbound
    have hCnonneg : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg (g 0)).trans (hC 0)
    obtain ⟨hDense, hOpen⟩ := dense_open_nonCauchy_points_of_operatorNorm_bound hCnonneg hC hz
    exact ⟨_, hDense, hOpen.isGδ, Subset.rfl⟩
  · have hpoint : ∃ z : E, ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ q, C < ‖g q z‖ := by
      by_contra hpoint
      push Not at hpoint
      obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := uniform_operatorNorm_bound_of_pointwise_bounded hpoint
      exact hbound ⟨C, hC⟩
    have hcommon := condensation_dense_Gδ (g := fun _ : ℕ => g) (fun _ => hpoint)
    have hsingle : Dense {x : E | ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ q, C < ‖g q x‖} ∧
        IsGδ {x : E | ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ q, C < ‖g q x‖} := by
      simpa only [forall_const] using hcommon
    refine ⟨_, hsingle.1, hsingle.2, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hcauchy
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcauchy.isBounded_range.exists_norm_le
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hx C
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hC _ (mem_range_self q))) hq

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.condensation_divergence_dense
proof:
:= by
  choose S hDense hGδ hSub using fun p => exists_dense_Gδ_nonCauchy_points (h p)
  apply (dense_iInter_of_Gδ hGδ hDense).mono
  intro x hx p

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.condensation_nonconvergence_exists
statement:
theorem condensation_nonconvergence_exists [∀ p, BanachSpace (F p)]
    {g : ∀ p : ℕ, ℕ → E →L[ℝ] F p}
    (h : ∀ p, ∃ z : E, ¬ ∃ y : F p, Tendsto (fun q => g p q z) atTop (𝓝 y)) :
    ∃ x : E, ∀ p, ¬ ∃ y : F p, Tendsto (fun q => g p q x) atTop (𝓝 y)
proof:
:= by
  have hCauchy : ∀ p, ∃ z : E, ¬ CauchySeq (fun q => g p q z) := by
    intro p
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h p
    exact ⟨z, fun hc => hz (cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hc)⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := condensation_divergence_exists hCauchy
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro p hlimit
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hlimit
  exact hx p hy.cauchySeq

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isCompactOperator_of_hasFiniteRange_clm
statement:
theorem isCompactOperator_of_hasFiniteRange_clm {X Y : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    (R : X →L[ℝ] Y) (hR : R.toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange) :
    IsCompactOperator R
proof:
:= by
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ R.range := .of_fg hR
  have hrange : IsCompactOperator R.rangeRestrict :=
    isCompactOperator_of_locallyCompactSpace_dom R.rangeRestrict
  have hcomp : IsCompactOperator (R.range.subtypeL.comp R.rangeRestrict) :=
    hrange.clm_comp R.range.subtypeL
  simpa using hcomp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.identitySubCompact_isFredholm
proof:
:= by
  let D := identitySubCompact K
  have hclosed : IsClosed (D.range : Set E) := by
    simpa [LinearMap.coe_range] using isClosed_range_identitySubCompact K hK
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ D.ker :=
    finiteDimensional_kernel_identitySubCompact K hK
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (E ⧸ D.range) :=
    finiteDimensional_cokernel_identitySubCompact K hK
  have hstrict : _root_.Topology.IsStrictMap D := by
    let _ : IsClosed (D.range : Set E) := hclosed
    let _ : CompleteSpace D.range := IsClosed.completeSpace_coe
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective D.rangeRestrict :=
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp D.toLinearMap.range_rangeRestrict
    have hopen : IsOpenMap D.rangeRestrict := D.rangeRestrict.isOpenMap hsurj
    exact D.toLinearMap.isStrictMap_iff_isOpenQuotientMap_rangeRestrict.mpr
      ⟨hsurj, D.rangeRestrict.continuous, hopen⟩
  exact
    { isStrictMap := hstrict
      isClosed_range := hclosed
      finite_ker := inferInstance
      finite_coker := inferInstance
      closedComplemented_ker :=
        Submodule.ClosedComplemented.of_finiteDimensional D.ker }

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.add_compact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hT.exists_isQuasiInverse
  let U : E →L[ℝ] F := T + K
  let C : F →L[ℝ] F := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - U.comp S
  have hfinite :
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change (LinearMap.id - T.toLinearMap.comp S.toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange
    simpa only [neg_sub] using
      (LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange.mp hS.2.equiv).neg
  have hfiniteCompact :
      IsCompactOperator (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S) :=
    isCompactOperator_of_hasFiniteRange_clm _ hfinite
  have hKS : IsCompactOperator (K.comp S) := IsCompactOperator.comp_right hK S
  have hC : IsCompactOperator C := by
    have heq : C = (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S) - K.comp S := by
      ext x
      simp [C, U]
      module
    rw [heq]
    exact hfiniteCompact.sub hKS
  have hUS : U.comp S = identitySubCompact C := by
    ext x
    simp [C, identitySubCompact_apply]
  have hUSfred : (U.comp S).IsFredholm := by
    rw [hUS]
    exact identitySubCompact_isFredholm C hC
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := hUSfred.exists_isQuasiInverse
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_isQuasiInverse (v := S.comp W)
  exact hS.symm.of_comp_left hW

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.fredholmIndex_add_compact
proof:
:= by
  let U : E →L[ℝ] F := T + K
  have hU : U.IsFredholm := ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.add_compact hT hK
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hT.exists_isQuasiInverse
  have hSfred : S.IsFredholm :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_isQuasiInverse hS.symm
  let C₀ : F →L[ℝ] F := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S
  let C₁ : F →L[ℝ] F := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - U.comp S
  have hfinite₀ :
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F - T.comp S).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change (LinearMap.id - T.toLinearMap.comp S.toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange
    simpa only [neg_sub] using
      (LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange.mp hS.2.equiv).neg
  have hC₀ : IsCompactOperator C₀ :=
    isCompactOperator_of_hasFiniteRange_clm _ hfinite₀
  have hC₁ : IsCompactOperator C₁ := by
    have hKS : IsCompactOperator (K.comp S) := IsCompactOperator.comp_right hK S
    have heq : C₁ = C₀ - K.comp S := by
      ext x
      simp [C₀, C₁, U]
      module
    rw [heq]
    exact hC₀.sub hKS
  have hTS : T.comp S = identitySubCompact C₀ := by
    ext x
    simp [C₀, identitySubCompact_apply]
  have hUS : U.comp S = identitySubCompact C₁ := by
    ext x
    simp [C₁, identitySubCompact_apply]
  have hcompU := fredholmIndex_comp hU hSfred
  have hcompT := fredholmIndex_comp hT hSfred
  rw [hUS, index_identitySubCompact_eq_zero C₁ hC₁] at hcompU
  rw [hTS, index_identitySubCompact_eq_zero C₀ hC₀] at hcompT
  change U.toLinearMap.index = T.toLinearMap.index
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.uniform_operatorNorm_bound_of_pointwise_bounded

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.fredholmIndex_comp

      T.toLinearMap.index + S.toLinearMap.index

  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℝ (G ⧸ T.range) := hT.finite_coker

statement:
theorem isStarNormal_iff_adjoint_commute (T : E →L[𝕜] E) :

proof:

  constructor

    rwa [star_eq_adjoint] at hh
  · intro h
    have hh : star T * T = T * star T := by rwa [← star_eq_adjoint] at h
    exact hh

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_range_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker
statement:
theorem mem_range_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker
    (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (y : F) :
    y ∈ T.range.topologicalClosure ↔
      ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ F, f ∈ (dualOperator T).ker → f y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_annihilator]
  constructor
  · intro h f hf
    exact h f ((dualOperator_ker_eq_range_annihilator T).symm ▸ hf)
  · intro h f hf
    exact h f (dualOperator_ker_eq_range_annihilator T ▸ hf)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.mem_range_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker
statement:
theorem mem_range_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (hT : IsClosed (Set.range T)) (y : F) :
    y ∈ T.range ↔
      ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ F, f ∈ (dualOperator T).ker → f y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_range_topologicalClosure_iff_forall_dualOperator_ker T y]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact T.range.le_topologicalClosure hy
  · apply T.range.topologicalClosure_minimal le_rfl
    rw [show (T.range : Set F) = Set.range T by ext; simp]
    exact hT

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_continuousAnnihilator_isClosed
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_continuousAnnihilator_isClosed (S : Submodule ℝ E) :
    IsClosed (weakStarImage (StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show weakStarImage (StrongDual.polarSubmodule ℝ S : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) =
      ⋂ x ∈ S, {f : WeakDual ℝ E | f x = 0} by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      exact fun x hx ↦ (mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff S f).mp hf x hx
    · intro hg
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hg
      refine ⟨WeakDual.toStrongDual g, ?_, WeakDual.toWeakDual_toStrongDual g⟩
      exact (mem_continuousAnnihilator_iff S _).2 hg]
  exact isClosed_biInter fun x _ ↦
    isClosed_singleton.preimage (WeakDual.eval_continuous x)

statement:

@[simp] private theorem c0OfTendsto_apply (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu) (n : ℕ) :

proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0Truncation_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem c0Truncation_apply (u : C₀(ℕ, ℝ)) (N n : ℕ) :
    c0Truncation u N n = if n < N then u n else 0
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0Truncation_tendsto
statement:
private theorem c0Truncation_tendsto (u : C₀(ℕ, ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (c0Truncation u) atTop (nhds u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly,
    Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hu := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (zero_at_infty u) ε hε
  rw [Filter.cocompact_eq_cofinite, Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop] at hu
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hu
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with M hM
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n < M
  · simpa [c0Truncation, hn] using hε
  · simpa [c0Truncation, hn, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using
      hN n (hM.trans (not_lt.mp hn))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0Single_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem c0Single_apply (i n : ℕ) :
    c0Single i n = if i = n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : i = n
  · subst n
    simp [c0Single]
  · simp [c0Single, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0_finset_sum_apply
statement:
private theorem c0_finset_sum_apply (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, a i • c0Single i) n = ∑ i ∈ s, a i * c0Single i n
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert, hi, not_false_eq_true,
        ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.add_apply, ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.smul_apply, ih,
        smul_eq_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0_dual_coordinates_sum_le
statement:
private theorem c0_dual_coordinates_sum_le (Λ : C₀(ℕ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, |Λ (c0Single i)| ≤ ‖Λ‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : C₀(ℕ, ℝ) :=
    ∑ i ∈ s, (if 0 ≤ Λ (c0Single i) then (1 : ℝ) else -1) • c0Single i
  have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by
    change ‖v.toBCF‖ ≤ 1
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le zero_le_one]
    intro n
    have hvn : v n =
        ∑ i ∈ s, (if 0 ≤ Λ (c0Single i) then 1 else -1) * c0Single i n := by
      change (∑ i ∈ s, (if 0 ≤ Λ (c0Single i) then 1 else -1) • c0Single i) n = _
      exact c0_finset_sum_apply s
        (fun i ↦ if 0 ≤ Λ (c0Single i) then (1 : ℝ) else -1) n
    rw [show v.toBCF n = v n from rfl, hvn, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    by_cases hn : n ∈ s
    · simp only [c0Single_apply]
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ Λ (c0Single n) <;> simp [h, hn]
    · simp [c0Single_apply, hn]
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ s, |Λ (c0Single i)| = Λ v := by
      simp only [v, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ Λ (c0Single i)
      · simp [h, abs_of_nonneg h]
      · simp [h, abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h)]
    _ ≤ |Λ v| := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ‖Λ‖ * ‖v‖ := Λ.le_opNorm v
    _ ≤ ‖Λ‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg Λ)
    _ = ‖Λ‖ := mul_one _

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0_dual_coordinates_summable
statement:
private theorem c0_dual_coordinates_summable (Λ : C₀(ℕ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Summable fun i ↦ |Λ (c0Single i)|
proof:
:= by
  apply summable_of_sum_le (fun i ↦ abs_nonneg (Λ (c0Single i)))
  exact c0_dual_coordinates_sum_le Λ

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0_dual_coordinates_tsum_le
statement:
private theorem c0_dual_coordinates_tsum_le (Λ : C₀(ℕ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∑' i, |Λ (c0Single i)| ≤ ‖Λ‖
proof:
:=
  (c0_dual_coordinates_summable Λ).tsum_le_of_sum_le (c0_dual_coordinates_sum_le Λ)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0Truncation_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem c0Truncation_eq_sum (u : C₀(ℕ, ℝ)) (N : ℕ) :
    c0Truncation u N = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, u i • c0Single i
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [c0_finset_sum_apply]
  simp [c0Truncation, c0Single_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.c0_dual_hasSum_coordinates
statement:
private theorem c0_dual_hasSum_coordinates (Λ : C₀(ℕ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : C₀(ℕ, ℝ)) :
    HasSum (fun i ↦ Λ (c0Single i) * u i) (Λ u)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ := c0_dual_coordinates_summable Λ
  have hnorm : Summable fun i ↦ ‖Λ (c0Single i) * u i‖ :=
    (hΛ.mul_left ‖u‖).of_nonneg_of_le (fun i ↦ norm_nonneg _) fun i ↦ by
      calc
        ‖Λ (c0Single i) * u i‖ = |Λ (c0Single i)| * |u i| := by
          rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ |Λ (c0Single i)| * ‖u‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm u.toBCF i) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖u‖ * |Λ (c0Single i)| := mul_comm _ _
  rw [hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat_of_summable_norm hnorm]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun N ↦ Λ (c0Truncation u N)) atTop (nhds (Λ u)) :=
    (Λ.continuous.tendsto u).comp (c0Truncation_tendsto u)
  apply hlim.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with N
  rw [c0Truncation_eq_sum, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualEvaluationToC0Linear_norm_le
proof:
:= by
  change ‖(c0OfTendsto (fun i ↦ f (x i)) (dual_eval_tendsto_zero x hx₀ f)).toBCF‖ ≤
    1 * ‖f‖
  rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (mul_nonneg zero_le_one (norm_nonneg f))]
  intro i
  exact (f.le_opNorm (x i)).trans <| by
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx i) (norm_nonneg f)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_dual_annihilating_submodule_of_quotient_norm_pos
statement:
private theorem exists_dual_annihilating_submodule_of_quotient_norm_pos
    {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (Y : Submodule ℝ E) (z : E) (hz : 0 < ‖Y.mkQ z‖) :
    ∃ Λ : StrongDual ℝ E, ‖Λ‖ ≤ 1 ∧ Λ z = ‖Y.mkQ z‖ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y, Λ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgz⟩ := exists_dual_vector ℝ (Y.mkQ z) (ne_of_gt hz)
  let Λ : StrongDual ℝ E := g.comp Y.mkQL
  have hmk : ‖Y.mkQL‖ ≤ 1 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
    intro x
    rw [one_mul, Submodule.mkQL_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    exact Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le (S := Y) x
  refine ⟨Λ, (g.opNorm_comp_le Y.mkQL).trans ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hg] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmk (norm_nonneg g)
  · simpa [Λ, Submodule.mkQL_apply] using hgz
  · intro y hy
    have hy₀ : Y.mkQL y = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQL_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero Y).2 hy
    simp [Λ, hy₀]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.quotient_norm_ge_of_separated_image
statement:
private theorem quotient_norm_ge_of_separated_image
    {A B : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    [SeminormedAddCommGroup B] [NormedSpace ℝ B]
    (T : A →L[ℝ] B) (M : Submodule ℝ A) (f₀ : A) {δ : ℝ}
    (hsep : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖T f - T f₀‖) :
    δ ≤ ‖(Submodule.map T.toLinearMap M).mkQ (T f₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  let Y := Submodule.map T.toLinearMap M
  change δ ≤ ‖QuotientAddGroup.mk' Y.toAddSubgroup (T f₀)‖
  rw [quotient_norm_mk_eq]
  apply le_csInf
  · exact ⟨‖T f₀ + 0‖, ⟨0, Y.zero_mem, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro r hr
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hr
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h := (hsep (-f) (M.neg_mem hf)).le
    have heq : T (-f) - T f₀ = -(T f₀ + T f) := by
      rw [map_neg]
      module
    rw [heq, norm_neg] at h
    exact h

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_summable_dual_separator
statement:
private theorem exists_summable_dual_separator
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X)) (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X)
    (x : ℕ → X) (hx₀ : Tendsto x atTop (nhds 0)) (hx : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ 1)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖dualEvaluationToC0 x hx₀ hx f - dualEvaluationToC0 x hx₀ hx f₀‖) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, Summable (fun i ↦ |a i|) ∧ (∑' i, |a i|) ≤ δ⁻¹ ∧
      HasSum (fun i ↦ a i * f₀ (x i)) 1 ∧
      ∀ f ∈ M, HasSum (fun i ↦ a i * f (x i)) 0
proof:
:= by
  let T := dualEvaluationToC0 x hx₀ hx
  let Y := Submodule.map T.toLinearMap M
  have hq : δ ≤ ‖Y.mkQ (T f₀)‖ := quotient_norm_ge_of_separated_image T M f₀ hsep
  have hqpos : 0 < ‖Y.mkQ (T f₀)‖ := hδ.trans_le hq
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛnorm, hΛf₀, hΛM⟩ :=
    exists_dual_annihilating_submodule_of_quotient_norm_pos Y (T f₀) hqpos
  let c : ℝ := Λ (T f₀)
  have hc : δ ≤ c := by simpa [c, hΛf₀] using hq
  have hcpos : 0 < c := hδ.trans_le hc
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun i ↦ Λ (c0Single i)
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun i ↦ c⁻¹ * b i
  have hb : Summable fun i ↦ |b i| := c0_dual_coordinates_summable Λ
  have ha : Summable fun i ↦ |a i| := by
    simpa [a, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hcpos)] using hb.mul_left c⁻¹
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      ∑' i, |a i| = c⁻¹ * ∑' i, |b i| := by
        simp_rw [a, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hcpos)]
        exact tsum_mul_left
      _ ≤ c⁻¹ * ‖Λ‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (c0_dual_coordinates_tsum_le Λ) (inv_nonneg.mpr hcpos.le)
      _ ≤ c⁻¹ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΛnorm (inv_nonneg.mpr hcpos.le)
      _ = c⁻¹ := mul_one _
      _ ≤ δ⁻¹ := (inv_le_inv₀ hcpos hδ).2 hc
  · have hsum := (c0_dual_hasSum_coordinates Λ (T f₀)).const_smul c⁻¹
    simpa only [a, b, T, dualEvaluationToC0_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, c,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpos.ne'] using hsum
  · intro f hf
    have hTf : T f ∈ Y := ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hsum := (c0_dual_hasSum_coordinates Λ (T f)).const_smul c⁻¹
    have hzero : Λ (T f) = 0 := hΛM (T f) hTf
    simpa only [a, b, T, dualEvaluationToC0_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, hzero,
      mul_zero] using hsum

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualSubmodule_normClosed_of_weakStarUnitSlice_closed
statement:
theorem dualSubmodule_normClosed_of_weakStarUnitSlice_closed
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))) :
    IsClosed (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isSeqClosed_iff_isClosed]
  intro u f huM huf
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ :=
    (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ X)).mp
      (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto u huf)
  let c : ℝ := max R 1
  have hc : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right R 1)
  have huc_mem : ∀ n, c⁻¹ • u n ∈ dualUnitSlice M := by
    intro n
    constructor
    · exact M.smul_mem _ (huM n)
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos hc, inv_mul_le_one₀ hc]
      have hun : dist (u n) 0 ≤ R := hR (Set.mem_range_self n)
      have hun' : ‖u n‖ ≤ R := by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hun
      exact hun'.trans (le_max_left R 1)
  have hweak : Tendsto (fun n ↦ StrongDual.toWeakDual (c⁻¹ • u n)) atTop
      (nhds (StrongDual.toWeakDual (c⁻¹ • f))) := by
    apply dual_norm_tendsto_implies_weakStar
    exact huf.const_smul c⁻¹
  have hscaled : StrongDual.toWeakDual (c⁻¹ • f) ∈
      weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M) := by
    apply hunit.isSeqClosed (x := fun n ↦ StrongDual.toWeakDual (c⁻¹ • u n))
    · intro n
      exact ⟨c⁻¹ • u n, huc_mem n, rfl⟩
    · exact hweak
  obtain ⟨g, hgM, hg⟩ := hscaled
  have hgf : g = c⁻¹ • f := StrongDual.toWeakDual.injective hg
  have : c • g = f := by simp [hgf, hc.ne']
  rw [← this]
  exact M.smul_mem c hgM.1

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_dualSubmodule_norm_gap_of_weakStarUnitSlice_closed
statement:
theorem exists_dualSubmodule_norm_gap_of_weakStarUnitSlice_closed
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    {f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X} (hf₀ : f₀ ∉ M) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X)) :=
    dualSubmodule_normClosed_of_weakStarUnitSlice_closed M hunit
  have hf₀c : f₀ ∈ (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X))ᶜ := hf₀
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hclosed.isOpen_compl f₀ hf₀c
  refine ⟨ε / 2, half_pos hε, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  have hfball : f ∉ Metric.ball f₀ ε := fun h ↦ hball h hf
  have hεdist : ε ≤ dist f f₀ := by
    apply not_lt.mp
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hfball
  exact (half_lt_self hε).trans_le <| by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hεdist

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_isCompact
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_isCompact
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))) :
    IsCompact (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))
proof:
:= by
  refine weakStar_isCompact_unitBall.of_isClosed_subset hunit ?_
  rintro g ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  simpa [dualUnitSlice, Metric.mem_closedBall] using hf.2

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_smul_dualUnitSlice_isCompact
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_smul_dualUnitSlice_isCompact
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))) (R : ℝ) :
    IsCompact ((fun f : WeakDual ℝ X ↦ R • f) '' weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))
proof:
:= by
  exact (weakStarImage_dualUnitSlice_isCompact M hunit).image (continuous_const_smul R)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_dualBallSlice_eq_smul
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_dualBallSlice_eq_smul
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X)) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    weakStarImage (dualBallSlice M R) =
      (fun f : WeakDual ℝ X ↦ R • f) '' weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨StrongDual.toWeakDual (R⁻¹ • f), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨R⁻¹ • f, ?_, rfl⟩
      constructor
      · exact M.smul_mem _ hf.1
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hR)]
        have hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≤ R := by
          simpa [dualBallSlice, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hf.2
        exact (inv_mul_le_one₀ hR).2 hfnorm
    · simp [← map_smul, hR.ne']
  · rintro ⟨g, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨R • f, ?_, by simp [map_smul]⟩
    constructor
    · exact M.smul_mem _ hf.1
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos hR]
      have hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≤ 1 := by
        simpa [dualUnitSlice, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hf.2
      exact (mul_le_iff_le_one_right hR).2 hfnorm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_dualBallSlice_isCompact
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_dualBallSlice_isCompact
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    IsCompact (weakStarImage (dualBallSlice M R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [weakStarImage_dualBallSlice_eq_smul M hR]
  exact weakStarImage_smul_dualUnitSlice_isCompact M hunit R

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarEvaluationBand_isClosed
statement:
theorem weakStarEvaluationBand_isClosed
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) (S : Set X) (ε : ℝ) :
    IsClosed (weakStarEvaluationBand f₀ S ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show weakStarEvaluationBand f₀ S ε =
      ⋂ x ∈ S, {f | |f x - f₀ x| ≤ ε} by
    ext
    simp [weakStarEvaluationBand]]
  exact isClosed_biInter fun x _ ↦
    isClosed_le ((WeakDual.eval_continuous x).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarPriorBand_isClosed
statement:
private theorem weakStarPriorBand_isClosed (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) (δ : ℝ)
    (L : List (Finset X)) : IsClosed (weakStarPriorBand f₀ δ L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show weakStarPriorBand f₀ δ L =
      ⋂ k : ℕ, ⋂ hk : k < L.length, ⋂ x : X, ⋂ _hx : x ∈ L[k]'hk,
        {g : WeakDual ℝ X | |g x - f₀ x| ≤ δ * k} by
    ext g
    simp [weakStarPriorBand]]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun k ↦ isClosed_iInter fun hk ↦ isClosed_iInter fun x ↦
    isClosed_iInter fun _ ↦
      isClosed_le ((WeakDual.eval_continuous x).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dual_norm_sub_le_of_mem_unitEvaluationBand
statement:
private theorem dual_norm_sub_le_of_mem_unitEvaluationBand
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {g : WeakDual ℝ X} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hg : g ∈ weakStarEvaluationBand f₀ (Metric.closedBall (0 : X) 1) ε) :
    ‖WeakDual.toStrongDual g - f₀‖ ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_of_unit_norm hε
  intro x hx
  have h := hg x (by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx.le)
  simpa [weakStarEvaluationBand, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionCompactSet_isCompact
statement:
private theorem detectionCompactSet_isCompact
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (L : List (Finset X)) :
    IsCompact (detectionCompactSet M f₀ δ L)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : 0 < ‖f₀‖ + δ * (L.length + 1) := by positivity
  exact ((weakStarImage_dualBallSlice_isCompact M hunit hR).inter_right
    (WeakDual.isClosed_closedBall f₀ (δ * (L.length + 1)))).inter_right
      (weakStarPriorBand_isClosed f₀ δ L)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionCompactSet_inter_unitBand_empty
statement:
private theorem detectionCompactSet_inter_unitBand_empty
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X)) (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (st : DetectionState M f₀ δ) :
    detectionCompactSet M f₀ δ st.sets ∩
      weakStarEvaluationBand f₀ (Metric.closedBall (0 : X) 1)
        (δ * st.sets.length) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, _hcenter⟩, hprior⟩ := hg.1
  have hnorm : ‖f - f₀‖ ≤ δ * st.sets.length := by
    simpa using dual_norm_sub_le_of_mem_unitEvaluationBand f₀
      (mul_nonneg hδ.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hg.2
  exact (st.invariant f hf.1 hnorm) hprior

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_finite_weakStarEvaluation_witness
statement:
theorem exists_finite_weakStarEvaluation_witness
    (K : Set (WeakDual ℝ X)) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) (B : Set X) (ε : ℝ)
    (hall : K ∩ weakStarEvaluationBand f₀ B ε = ∅) :
    ∃ S : Finset {x // x ∈ B},
      K ∩ ⋂ x ∈ S, {f : WeakDual ℝ X | |f x.1 - f₀ x.1| ≤ ε} = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hall' :
      K ∩ ⋂ x : {x // x ∈ B}, {f : WeakDual ℝ X | |f x.1 - f₀ x.1| ≤ ε} = ∅ := by
    rw [← hall]
    congr 1
    ext f
    simp [weakStarEvaluationBand]
  apply hK.elim_finite_subfamily_closed
      (fun x : {x // x ∈ B} ↦ {f : WeakDual ℝ X | |f x.1 - f₀ x.1| ≤ ε})
  · intro x
    exact isClosed_le ((WeakDual.eval_continuous x.1).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const
  · exact hall'

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_next_detection_finset
statement:
private theorem exists_next_detection_finset
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (st : DetectionState M f₀ δ) :
    ∃ S : Finset {x // x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : X) 1},
      detectionCompactSet M f₀ δ st.sets ∩
        ⋂ x ∈ S, {f : WeakDual ℝ X |
          |f x.1 - f₀ x.1| ≤ δ * st.sets.length} = ∅
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_finite_weakStarEvaluation_witness
    (detectionCompactSet M f₀ δ st.sets)
    (detectionCompactSet_isCompact M hunit f₀ hδ st.sets)
    f₀ (Metric.closedBall (0 : X) 1) (δ * st.sets.length)
    (detectionCompactSet_inter_unitBand_empty M f₀ hδ st)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarPriorBand_append_left
statement:
private theorem weakStarPriorBand_append_left
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) (δ : ℝ) (L : List (Finset X)) (S : Finset X)
    {g : WeakDual ℝ X} (hg : g ∈ weakStarPriorBand f₀ δ (L ++ [S])) :
    g ∈ weakStarPriorBand f₀ δ L
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk x hx
  apply hg k (by simp; omega) x
  simpa [List.getElem_append_left hk] using hx

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarPriorBand_append_last
statement:
private theorem weakStarPriorBand_append_last
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) (δ : ℝ) (L : List (Finset X)) (S : Finset X)
    {g : WeakDual ℝ X} (hg : g ∈ weakStarPriorBand f₀ δ (L ++ [S]))
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    |g x - f₀ x| ≤ δ * L.length
proof:
:= by
  have hk : L.length < (L ++ [S]).length := by simp
  exact hg L.length hk x (by simpa using hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_next_detection_state
statement:
private theorem exists_next_detection_state
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (st : DetectionState M f₀ δ) :
    ∃ st' : DetectionState M f₀ δ,
      ∃ S : Finset X, st'.sets = st.sets ++ [S]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_next_detection_finset M hunit f₀ hδ st
  classical
  let S' : Finset X := S.image Subtype.val
  refine ⟨⟨st.sets ++ [S'], by simp, ?_, ?_⟩, S', rfl⟩
  · intro T hT x hx
    rw [List.mem_append] at hT
    rcases hT with hT | hT
    · exact st.norm_le_one T hT x hx
    · have hTS : T = S' := by simpa using hT
      subst T
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using y.property
  · intro f hf hnorm hprior
    have hold : StrongDual.toWeakDual f ∈ weakStarPriorBand f₀ δ st.sets :=
      weakStarPriorBand_append_left f₀ δ st.sets S' hprior
    have hcenter : ‖f - f₀‖ ≤ δ * (st.sets.length + 1) := by
      simpa using hnorm
    have hfnorm : ‖f‖ ≤ ‖f₀‖ + δ * (st.sets.length + 1) := by
      calc
        ‖f‖ = ‖f₀ + (f - f₀)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖f₀‖ + ‖f - f₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖f₀‖ + δ * (st.sets.length + 1) := by gcongr
    have hcompact : StrongDual.toWeakDual f ∈ detectionCompactSet M f₀ δ st.sets := by
      refine ⟨⟨⟨f, ⟨hf, ?_⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, hold⟩
      · simpa [dualBallSlice, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hfnorm
      · simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hcenter
    have hfinite : StrongDual.toWeakDual f ∈
        ⋂ x ∈ S, {g : WeakDual ℝ X |
          |g x.1 - f₀ x.1| ≤ δ * st.sets.length} := by
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
      intro x hx
      apply weakStarPriorBand_append_last f₀ δ st.sets S' hprior
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have : StrongDual.toWeakDual f ∈
        detectionCompactSet M f₀ δ st.sets ∩
          ⋂ x ∈ S, {g : WeakDual ℝ X |
            |g x.1 - f₀ x.1| ≤ δ * st.sets.length} := ⟨hcompact, hfinite⟩
    rw [hS] at this
    exact this

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.nextDetectionState_sets
statement:
private theorem nextDetectionState_sets
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (st : DetectionState M f₀ δ) :
    (nextDetectionState M hunit f₀ hδ st).sets =
      st.sets ++ [nextDetectionFinset M hunit f₀ hδ st]
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_next_detection_state M hunit f₀ hδ st))

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionStates_length
statement:
private theorem detectionStates_length
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) (n : ℕ) :
    (detectionStates M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n).sets.length = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [detectionStates, initialDetectionState]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [detectionStates, nextDetectionState_sets, List.length_append, ih]
      simp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionStates_sets_eq_blocks
statement:
private theorem detectionStates_sets_eq_blocks
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) (n : ℕ) :
    (detectionStates M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n).sets =
      (List.range (n + 1)).map (detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [detectionStates, initialDetectionState, detectionBlock]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [detectionStates, nextDetectionState_sets, ih]
      simp [List.range_succ, detectionBlock]

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionBlock_norm_le_one
statement:
private theorem detectionBlock_norm_le_one
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) (k : ℕ) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k) : ‖x‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp [detectionBlock] at hx
  | succ k =>
      let st := detectionStates M hunit f₀ hδ hgap (k + 1)
      have hmem : detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap (k + 1) ∈ st.sets := by
        dsimp [st]
        rw [detectionStates, nextDetectionState_sets]
        simp [detectionBlock]
      exact st.norm_le_one _ hmem x hx

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_detectionBlock_separating
statement:
private theorem exists_detectionBlock_separating
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖)
    (f : StrongDual ℝ X) (hf : f ∈ M) :
    ∃ k > 0, ∃ x ∈ detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k,
      δ * k < |(StrongDual.toWeakDual f) x - f₀ x|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge (‖f - f₀‖ / δ)
  let st := detectionStates M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n
  have hnorm : ‖f - f₀‖ ≤ δ * st.sets.length := by
    rw [detectionStates_length M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n]
    have hbase : ‖f - f₀‖ ≤ δ * n := by
      have hn' := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp hn
      simpa [mul_comm] using hn'
    exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_le.2 (Nat.le_succ n)) hδ.le)
  have hnot := st.invariant f hf hnorm
  rw [weakStarPriorBand] at hnot
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hnot
  obtain ⟨k, hnot⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
  obtain ⟨hk, hnot⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
  obtain ⟨x, hnot⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
  obtain ⟨hx, hnot⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
  have hsep := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hk' : k < n + 1 := by simpa [st, detectionStates_length M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n] using hk
  have hx' : x ∈ detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k := by
    have hsets := detectionStates_sets_eq_blocks M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n
    have hx'' : x ∈ (detectionStates M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n).sets[k] := by
      simpa [st] using hx
    simpa [hsets, hk'] using hx''
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [detectionBlock] at hx'
    | succ k => omega
  exact ⟨k, hkpos, x, hx', hsep⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionPoint_norm_le_one
statement:
private theorem detectionPoint_norm_le_one
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) (k j : ℕ) :
    ‖detectionPoint M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k j‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold detectionPoint
  split_ifs with hj
  · apply detectionBlock_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k
    exact Finset.mem_toList.mp (List.getElem_mem hj)
  · simp

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_detectionPoint_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem exists_detectionPoint_eq_of_mem
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) (k : ℕ) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k) :
    ∃ j, detectionPoint M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k j = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxlist : x ∈ (detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k).toList :=
    Finset.mem_toList.mpr hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := List.get_of_mem hxlist
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  rw [detectionPoint, dif_pos (by simpa using j.isLt)]
  exact hj

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionSequence_norm_le_one
statement:
private theorem detectionSequence_norm_le_one
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [detectionSequence]
  split_ifs with hk
  · simp
  · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))]
    calc
      ((Nat.unpair n).1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖detectionPoint M hunit f₀ hδ hgap (Nat.unpair n).1
          (Nat.unpair n).2‖ ≤ ((Nat.unpair n).1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (detectionPoint_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap _ _) (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [mul_one, inv_le_one₀]
        · exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk)
        · exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionSequence_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem detectionSequence_tendsto_zero
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) :
    Tendsto (detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hε
  let K : ℕ := q + 1
  let F : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range K).biUnion fun k ↦
    (Finset.range (detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k).card).image (Nat.pair k)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := F.exists_nat_subset_range
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hnF : n ∉ F := by
    intro hnmem
    have := hN hnmem
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at this
    omega
  let p := Nat.unpair n
  by_cases hp₀ : p.1 = 0
  · simpa [detectionSequence, p, hp₀] using hε
  by_cases hpK : K ≤ p.1
  · have hpoint := detectionPoint_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap p.1 p.2
    rw [show detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n =
        (p.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ • detectionPoint M hunit f₀ hδ hgap p.1 p.2 by
      simp [detectionSequence, p, hp₀]]
    rw [dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))]
    calc
      (p.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖detectionPoint M hunit f₀ hδ hgap p.1 p.2‖ ≤
          (p.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        exact inv_anti₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_pos q)) (by exact_mod_cast hpK)
      _ < ε := by simpa [K, one_div] using hq
  · have hplt : p.1 < K := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hpK
    have hpj : ¬p.2 < (detectionBlock M hunit f₀ hδ hgap p.1).card := by
      intro hpj
      apply hnF
      rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      refine ⟨p.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr hplt, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_image]
      exact ⟨p.2, Finset.mem_range.mpr hpj, Nat.pair_unpair n⟩
    have hpoint : detectionPoint M hunit f₀ hδ hgap p.1 p.2 = 0 := by
      simp [detectionPoint, hpj]
    simpa [detectionSequence, p, hp₀, hpoint] using hε

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.detectionSequence_uniformly_separates
statement:
private theorem detectionSequence_uniformly_separates
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : ∀ f ∈ M, δ < ‖f - f₀‖) :
    ∀ f ∈ M, δ <
      ‖dualEvaluationToC0 (detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
          (detectionSequence_tendsto_zero M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
          (detectionSequence_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap) f -
        dualEvaluationToC0 (detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
          (detectionSequence_tendsto_zero M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
          (detectionSequence_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap) f₀‖
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨k, hk, x, hx, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_detectionBlock_separating M hunit f₀ hδ hgap f hf
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_detectionPoint_eq_of_mem M hunit f₀ hδ hgap k hx
  let n := Nat.pair k j
  let u := dualEvaluationToC0 (detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
    (detectionSequence_tendsto_zero M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
    (detectionSequence_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap)
  have hseq : detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n = (k : ℝ)⁻¹ • x := by
    simp [n, detectionSequence, Nat.unpair_pair, hk.ne', hj]
  have hkinv : 0 < (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  have hcoord : δ < |f (detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n) -
      f₀ (detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap n)| := by
    rw [hseq, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsep hkinv
    have hkne : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk.ne'
    have hleft : (k : ℝ)⁻¹ * (δ * k) = δ := by
      field_simp
    have hright : (k : ℝ)⁻¹ * |(StrongDual.toWeakDual f) x - f₀ x| =
        |(k : ℝ)⁻¹ * f x - (k : ℝ)⁻¹ * f₀ x| := by
      calc
        (k : ℝ)⁻¹ * |(StrongDual.toWeakDual f) x - f₀ x| =
            |(k : ℝ)⁻¹| * |(StrongDual.toWeakDual f) x - f₀ x| := by
              rw [abs_of_pos hkinv]
        _ = |(k : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((StrongDual.toWeakDual f) x - f₀ x)| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
        _ = |(k : ℝ)⁻¹ * f x - (k : ℝ)⁻¹ * f₀ x| := by
          congr 1
          change (k : ℝ)⁻¹ * (f x - f₀ x) = _
          ring
    rw [hleft, hright] at hm
    exact hm
  apply hcoord.trans_le
  have hpoint := BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm (u f - u f₀).toBCF n
  simpa [u, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hpoint

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dualSeparator_of_summable_series
statement:
theorem dualSeparator_of_summable_series [CompleteSpace X]
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X)) (f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X)
    (x : ℕ → X) (hx : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ 1) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : Summable fun i ↦ |a i|) {C : ℝ} (haC : ∑' i, |a i| ≤ C)
    (hf₀ : HasSum (fun i ↦ a i * f₀ (x i)) 1)
    (hM : ∀ f ∈ M, HasSum (fun i ↦ a i * f (x i)) 0) :
    ∃ x₀ : X, f₀ x₀ = 1 ∧ ‖x₀‖ ≤ C ∧ ∀ f ∈ M, f x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : Summable fun i ↦ ‖a i • x i‖ :=
    ha.of_norm_bounded fun i ↦ by
      simpa [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg] using
        mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg (a i)) (hx i)
  have hax : Summable fun i ↦ a i • x i := hnorm.of_norm
  refine ⟨∑' i, a i • x i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [f₀.map_tsum hax]
    simpa [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hf₀.tsum_eq
  · exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm).trans <|
      (hnorm.tsum_le_tsum (fun i ↦ by
        simpa [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg] using
          mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg (a i)) (hx i)) ha).trans haC
  · intro f hf
    rw [f.map_tsum hax]
    simpa [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using (hM f hf).tsum_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.exists_weakStar_separator_of_dualUnitSlice_closed
statement:
theorem exists_weakStar_separator_of_dualUnitSlice_closed [CompleteSpace X]
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M)))
    {f₀ : StrongDual ℝ X} (hf₀ : f₀ ∉ M) :
    ∃ x₀ : X, f₀ x₀ = 1 ∧ ∀ f ∈ M, f x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hgap⟩ :=
    exists_dualSubmodule_norm_gap_of_weakStarUnitSlice_closed M hunit hf₀
  let x := detectionSequence M hunit f₀ hδ hgap
  have hx₀ : Tendsto x atTop (nhds 0) :=
    detectionSequence_tendsto_zero M hunit f₀ hδ hgap
  have hx : ∀ i, ‖x i‖ ≤ 1 :=
    detectionSequence_norm_le_one M hunit f₀ hδ hgap
  have hsep : ∀ f ∈ M, δ <
      ‖dualEvaluationToC0 x hx₀ hx f - dualEvaluationToC0 x hx₀ hx f₀‖ := by
    simpa [x] using detectionSequence_uniformly_separates M hunit f₀ hδ hgap
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haNorm, hf₀sum, hMsum⟩ :=
    exists_summable_dual_separator M f₀ x hx₀ hx hδ hsep
  obtain ⟨x₀, hf₀x₀, _hx₀norm, hMx₀⟩ :=
    dualSeparator_of_summable_series M f₀ x hx a ha haNorm hf₀sum hMsum
  exact ⟨x₀, hf₀x₀, hMx₀⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_submodule_isClosed_of_dualUnitSlice_closed
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_submodule_isClosed_of_dualUnitSlice_closed [CompleteSpace X]
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X))
    (hunit : IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))) :
    IsClosed (weakStarImage (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show weakStarImage (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X)) =
      ⋂ x : X, ⋂ (_h : ∀ f ∈ M, f x = 0),
        {g : WeakDual ℝ X | g x = 0} by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      intro x hx
      exact hx f hf
    · intro hg
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hg
      by_contra hnot
      have hf₀ : WeakDual.toStrongDual g ∉ M := by
        intro hmem
        apply hnot
        exact ⟨WeakDual.toStrongDual g, hmem, WeakDual.toWeakDual_toStrongDual g⟩
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀one, hx₀zero⟩ :=
        exists_weakStar_separator_of_dualUnitSlice_closed M hunit hf₀
      have hgzero : g x₀ = 0 := hg x₀ hx₀zero
      have : g x₀ = 1 := by simpa using hx₀one
      linarith]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun x ↦ isClosed_iInter fun _ ↦
    isClosed_singleton.preimage (WeakDual.eval_continuous x)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.weakStarImage_submodule_isClosed_iff_dualUnitSlice_closed
statement:
theorem weakStarImage_submodule_isClosed_iff_dualUnitSlice_closed [CompleteSpace X]
    (M : Submodule ℝ (StrongDual ℝ X)) :
    IsClosed (weakStarImage (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X))) ↔
      IsClosed (weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hM
    rw [show weakStarImage (dualUnitSlice M) =
        weakStarImage (M : Set (StrongDual ℝ X)) ∩
          WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℝ X) 1 by
      ext g
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨f, ⟨hfM, hfball⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨f, hfM, rfl⟩, by simpa using hfball⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨f, hfM, hfg⟩, hgball⟩
        refine ⟨f, ⟨hfM, ?_⟩, hfg⟩
        simpa [← hfg, StrongDual.toStrongDual_toWeakDual] using hgball]
    exact hM.inter weakStar_isCompact_unitBall.isClosed
  · exact weakStarImage_submodule_isClosed_of_dualUnitSlice_closed M

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.textbookFace_iff_nonempty_convex_isExtreme
statement:
theorem textbookFace_iff_nonempty_convex_isExtreme :
    F.Nonempty ∧ Convex ℝ F ∧ IsExtreme ℝ K F ↔
      F.Nonempty ∧ Convex ℝ F ∧ F ⊆ K ∧
        ∀ ⦃x₀⦄, x₀ ∈ K → ∀ ⦃x₁⦄, x₁ ∈ K →
          ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ F → z ∈ openSegment ℝ x₀ x₁ → x₀ ∈ F ∧ x₁ ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, hconv, hface⟩
    refine ⟨hne, hconv, hface.subset, ?_⟩
    intro x₀ hx₀ x₁ hx₁ z hz hseg
    exact ⟨hface.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₀ hx₁ hz hseg,
      hface.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₀ hx₁ hz hseg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, hconv, hsub, hface⟩
    exact ⟨hne, hconv,
      ⟨hsub, fun {x₀} hx₀ {x₁} hx₁ {z} hz hseg ↦ (hface hx₀ hx₁ hz hseg).1⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.tendsto_meanErgodicLimitVector
statement:
private theorem tendsto_meanErgodicLimitVector
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) (x : E) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ meanErgodicAverage T n x) atTop
      (nhds (meanErgodicLimitVector hT hE x))
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_of_reflexive hT hE x)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.norm_meanErgodicLimitLinearMap_le
statement:
private theorem norm_meanErgodicLimitLinearMap_le
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E))
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖T ^ n‖ ≤ c) (x : E) :
    ‖meanErgodicLimitLinearMap hT hE x‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_tendsto (tendsto_meanErgodicLimitVector hT hE x).norm
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
    (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (meanErgodicAverage T n) x).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_meanErgodicAverage_le hc hpow n) (norm_nonneg x))

statement:
theorem meanErgodicLimitOperator_mem_fixed
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)

    meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE x ∈ meanErgodicFixedSubmodule T
proof:
:= by

  exact mem_fixed_of_tendsto_meanErgodicAverage (zero_le_one.trans hc) hpow

    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicLimitOperator_commute
statement:
theorem meanErgodicLimitOperator_commute
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE).comp T =
      T.comp (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique
    (tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE (T x))
  have hlim := (T.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    (tendsto_meanErgodicAverage_meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE x))
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using hlim.congr' <|
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ by
      exact (congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E ↦ A x) (meanErgodicAverage_commute T n)).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.T_comp_meanErgodicLimitOperator
statement:
theorem T_comp_meanErgodicLimitOperator
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)

    T.comp (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE) = meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicLimitOperator_idempotent
statement:
theorem meanErgodicLimitOperator_idempotent
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE).comp (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE) =
      meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact meanErgodicLimitOperator_apply_fixed hT hE
    (meanErgodicLimitOperator_mem_fixed hT hE x)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.meanErgodicLimitOperator_identities
statement:
theorem meanErgodicLimitOperator_identities
    {T : E →L[ℝ] E} (hT : IsPowerBounded T)
    (hE : Function.Surjective (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℝ E)) :
    (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE).comp T = meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE ∧
      T.comp (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE) = meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE ∧
      (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE).comp (meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE) =
        meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE
proof:
:= by
  have hTS := T_comp_meanErgodicLimitOperator hT hE
  exact ⟨(meanErgodicLimitOperator_commute hT hE).trans hTS, hTS,
    meanErgodicLimitOperator_idempotent hT hE⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.unbounded_on_tail_of_unbounded
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h (max C (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ‖a i‖))
  refine ⟨q, ?_, (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hq⟩
  by_contra hn
  have hmem : q ∈ Finset.range N := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hn)
  have hsum : ‖a q‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ‖a i‖ :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => norm_nonneg (a i)) hmem
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsum.trans (le_max_right _ _))) hq

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.isOpen_norm_exceeds_set
statement:
theorem isOpen_norm_exceeds_set (g : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] F) (C : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {x : E | ∃ q, C < ‖g q x‖}
proof:
:= by
  have heq : {x : E | ∃ q, C < ‖g q x‖} = ⋃ q, {x : E | C < ‖g q x‖} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [heq]
  exact isOpen_iUnion (fun q => isOpen_lt continuous_const (g q).continuous.norm)

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.dense_norm_exceeds_set_of_unbounded
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.dense_iff]
  intro x r hr
  by_contra hball
  have hbound : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, ∀ q, ‖g q y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro y hy q
    by_contra hq
    exact hball ⟨y, hy, q, lt_of_not_ge hq⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  let t : ℝ := r / (‖z‖ + 1)
  have ht : 0 < t := div_pos hr (by positivity)
  have ht_eq : t * (‖z‖ + 1) = r := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
  have ht_norm : ‖t • z‖ < r := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
    nlinarith
  have hnear : x + t • z ∈ Metric.ball x r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    simpa using ht_norm
  have hcenter : x ∈ Metric.ball x r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hz (2 * C / t)
  have hlarge : 2 * C < t * ‖g q z‖ := by
    have hlarge' := (div_lt_iff₀ ht).mp hq
    simpa [mul_comm] using hlarge'
  have hdiff : ‖g q (t • z)‖ ≤ 2 * C := by
    calc
      ‖g q (t • z)‖ = ‖g q (x + t • z) - g q x‖ := by simp
      _ ≤ ‖g q (x + t • z)‖ + ‖g q x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * C := by linarith [hbound (x + t • z) hnear q, hbound x hcenter q]
  rw [map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht] at hdiff
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hdiff) hlarge

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.condensation_dense_Gδ
proof:
:= by
  let U : ℕ → ℕ → Set E := fun p m => {x | ∃ q, (m : ℝ) < ‖g p q x‖}
  have hEq : {x : E | ∀ p, ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ q, C < ‖g p q x‖} = ⋂ p, ⋂ m, U p m := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hx p m
      exact hx p m
    · intro hx p C
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt C
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hx p m
      exact ⟨q, hm.trans hq⟩
  have hOpen : ∀ p m, IsOpen (U p m) :=
    fun p m => isOpen_norm_exceeds_set (g p) m
  have hDense : ∀ p m, Dense (U p m) :=
    fun p m => dense_norm_exceeds_set_of_unbounded (h p) m
  have hGδ : ∀ p, IsGδ (⋂ m, U p m) :=
    fun p => IsGδ.iInter_of_isOpen (hOpen p)
  rw [hEq]
  exact ⟨dense_iInter_of_Gδ hGδ
    (fun p => banach_dense_iInter_of_isOpen (hOpen p) (hDense p)), IsGδ.iInter hGδ⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.condensation_exists
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (condensation_dense_Gδ h).1.nonempty
  exact ⟨x, fun p C N => unbounded_on_tail_of_unbounded (hx p) C N⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.FunctionalAnalysis.condensation_of_unbounded_operatorNorm
proof:
:= by
  apply condensation_exists
  intro p
  by_contra hpoint
  push Not at hpoint
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := uniform_operatorNorm_bound_of_pointwise_bounded hpoint
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h p C
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hC q)) hq

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.intToNat_injective
statement: theorem intToNat_injective : Function.Injective intToNat
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  rcases le_or_gt 0 z with hz | hz <;> rcases le_or_gt 0 w with hw | hw
  · rw [intToNat_of_nonneg hz, intToNat_of_nonneg hw] at h
    have hzw : z.toNat = w.toNat := by omega
    have hz' : (z.toNat : ℤ) = z := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hz
    have hw' : (w.toNat : ℤ) = w := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hw
    omega
  · rw [intToNat_of_nonneg hz, intToNat_of_neg (not_le.mpr hw)] at h
    have hb : 1 ≤ (-w).toNat := by
      have hw' : (0 : ℤ) < -w := by omega
      have := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hw')
      omega
    omega
  · rw [intToNat_of_neg (not_le.mpr hz), intToNat_of_nonneg hw] at h
    have hb : 1 ≤ (-z).toNat := by
      have hz' : (0 : ℤ) < -z := by omega
      have := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hz')
      omega
    omega
  · rw [intToNat_of_neg (not_le.mpr hz), intToNat_of_neg (not_le.mpr hw)] at h
    have hbz : 1 ≤ (-z).toNat := by
      have hz' : (0 : ℤ) < -z := by omega
      have := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hz')
      omega
    have hbw : 1 ≤ (-w).toNat := by
      have hw' : (0 : ℤ) < -w := by omega
      have := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hw')
      omega
    have hzw : (-z).toNat = (-w).toNat := by omega
    have hz' : ((-z).toNat : ℤ) = -z := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have hw' : ((-w).toNat : ℤ) = -w := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    omega

statement: theorem countable_int_univ : (Set.univ : Set ℤ).Countable
proof:
:= by

  exact SandronesLibrary.SetTheory.Cardinal.countable_iUnion _ countable_intHalves

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.countable_int

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.infinite_nat_univ

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.infinite_not_imp_uncountable

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.nat_real_infinite_contrast

      (Set.univ : Set ℝ).Infinite ∧ ¬ (Set.univ : Set ℝ).Countable
proof:
:=
  ⟨Set.infinite_univ, Set.countable_univ, Set.infinite_univ,

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.card_powerset_fin_three

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.card_fin_three_lt_powerset

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.card_finset_powerset_fin_three

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.subset_zero_two_mem

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Countability.no_surjection_fin_three_powerset

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.shift_apply

proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_doubleAddOne_S
statement: theorem image_doubleAddOne_S : doubleAddOne '' S = ({1, 3, 5} : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [S, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [doubleAddOne]
  · intro hy
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp [S], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp [S], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by simp [S], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_doubleAddOne
statement: theorem preimage_doubleAddOne : doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({1, 3, 5} : Set ℕ) = S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, S, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, doubleAddOne]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_doubleAddOne_13
statement: theorem preimage_doubleAddOne_13 : doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({1, 3} : Set ℕ) = ({0, 1} : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, doubleAddOne]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_doubleAddOne_35
statement: theorem preimage_doubleAddOne_35 : doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({3, 5} : Set ℕ) = ({1, 2} : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, doubleAddOne]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_doubleAddOne_T
statement: theorem preimage_doubleAddOne_T : doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({3, 5, 7} : Set ℕ) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, T, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, doubleAddOne]

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_doubleAddOne_union
statement:
theorem preimage_doubleAddOne_union :
    doubleAddOne ⁻¹' (({1, 3} : Set ℕ) ∪ {3, 5}) = ({0, 1, 2} : Set ℕ)
proof:

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_union_instance
statement:
theorem preimage_union_instance :
    doubleAddOne ⁻¹' (({1, 3} : Set ℕ) ∪ {3, 5}) =

proof:
:= by
  rw [preimage_doubleAddOne_13, preimage_doubleAddOne_35, preimage_doubleAddOne_union]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_doubleAddOne_inter
statement:
theorem preimage_doubleAddOne_inter :
    doubleAddOne ⁻¹' (({1, 3, 5} : Set ℕ) ∩ {3, 5, 7}) = ({1, 2} : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_inter_instance
statement:
theorem preimage_inter_instance :
    doubleAddOne ⁻¹' (({1, 3, 5} : Set ℕ) ∩ {3, 5, 7}) =
      doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({1, 3, 5} : Set ℕ) ∩ doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({3, 5, 7} : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimage_doubleAddOne, preimage_doubleAddOne_T, preimage_doubleAddOne_inter]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, S, T, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_doubleAddOne_T
statement: theorem image_doubleAddOne_T : doubleAddOne '' T = ({3, 5, 7} : Set ℕ)

:= by

    simp only [T, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [doubleAddOne]
  · intro hy
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, by simp [T], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by simp [T], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩
    · exact ⟨3, by simp [T], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_doubleAddOne_inter

    · exact ⟨1, by simp [inter_S_T], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by simp [inter_S_T], by norm_num [doubleAddOne]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_inter_doubleAddOne

proof:
:= by
  rw [image_doubleAddOne_inter, image_doubleAddOne_S, image_doubleAddOne_T]
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_sq_zero_one_two
statement: theorem image_sq_zero_one_two : sq '' ({0, 1, 2} : Set ℤ) = ({0, 1, 4} : Set ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [sq]
  · intro hy
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp, by norm_num [sq]⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp, by norm_num [sq]⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by simp, by norm_num [sq]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_sq_one
statement: theorem preimage_sq_one : sq ⁻¹' ({1} : Set ℤ) = ({-1, 1} : Set ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, sq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hfac : (x - 1) * (x + 1) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h1 | h1
    · right; linarith
    · left; linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.preimage_sq_four
statement: theorem preimage_sq_four : sq ⁻¹' ({4} : Set ℤ) = ({-2, 2} : Set ℤ)

:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, sq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hfac : (x - 2) * (x + 2) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h1 | h1
    · right; linarith
    · left; linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_sq_negOne
statement: theorem image_sq_negOne : sq '' negOne = ({1} : Set ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [negOne, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst hx
    norm_num [sq]
  · intro hy
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    exact ⟨-1, by simp [negOne], by norm_num [sq]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_sq_posOne
statement: theorem image_sq_posOne : sq '' posOne = ({1} : Set ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [posOne, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst hx
    norm_num [sq]
  · intro hy
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    exact ⟨1, by simp [posOne], by norm_num [sq]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_sq_inter_empty
statement: theorem image_sq_inter_empty : sq '' (negOne ∩ posOne) = (∅ : Set ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hempty : negOne ∩ posOne = (∅ : Set ℤ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [negOne, posOne, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
      iff_false]
    omega
  rw [hempty, Set.image_empty]

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.image_sq_inter_subset
statement:
theorem image_sq_inter_subset :
    sq '' (negOne ∩ posOne) ⊆ sq '' negOne ∩ sq '' posOne
proof:
:=
  Set.image_inter_subset sq negOne posOne

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.sq_image_inter_ne
statement:
theorem sq_image_inter_ne :
    sq '' (negOne ∩ posOne) ≠ sq '' negOne ∩ sq '' posOne
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hmem : (1 : ℤ) ∈ sq '' negOne ∩ sq '' posOne :=
    ⟨⟨-1, by simp [negOne], by norm_num [sq]⟩,
      ⟨1, by simp [posOne], by norm_num [sq]⟩⟩
  rw [← h] at hmem
  rcases hmem with ⟨x, hx, _⟩
  simp only [negOne, posOne, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.exists_image_inter_ne
statement:
theorem exists_image_inter_ne :
    ∃ A B : Set ℤ, sq '' (A ∩ B) ≠ sq '' A ∩ sq '' B
proof:
:=
  ⟨negOne, posOne, sq_image_inter_ne⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.half_surjective_not_injective

theorem half_surjective_not_injective :

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.shift_injective

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.shift_surjective

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.Functions.shift_comp_apply

  have h1 : Ordinal.omega0 + 1 = Order.succ Ordinal.omega0 := by rw [Order.succ_eq_add_one]
  rw [Ordinal.add_omega0 Ordinal.one_lt_omega0, h1]
  exact (Order.lt_succ Ordinal.omega0).ne

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.OrdinalArithmetic.addition_right_cancellation_fails
statement:
theorem addition_right_cancellation_fails :
    ordinalAdd (1 : Ordinal) Ordinal.omega0 = ordinalAdd (2 : Ordinal) Ordinal.omega0 ∧
      (1 : Ordinal) ≠ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by norm_num⟩
  rw [ordinalAdd_eq_add, ordinalAdd_eq_add]
  have h1lt : (1 : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 := Ordinal.one_lt_omega0
  have h2lt : (2 : Ordinal) < Ordinal.omega0 := Ordinal.natCast_lt_omega0 2
  rw [Ordinal.add_omega0 h1lt, Ordinal.add_omega0 h2lt]

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.OrdinalArithmetic.multiplication_left_cancellation

proof:
:= by
  rw [ordinalMul_eq_mul, ordinalMul_eq_mul] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hc h

      (2 : Ordinal.{u}) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by norm_num⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [ordinalMul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  exact two_mul_omega_eq_omega.{u}

name: SandronesLibrary.Examples.SetTheory.OrdinalArithmetic.cnf_omegaPlusOne

    Ordinal.CNF Ordinal.omega0 omegaPlusOneOrd = [(1, 1), (0, 1)]
proof:

  rw [omegaPlusOneOrd_eq]
  have h := Ordinal.CNF.opow_mul_add (b := Ordinal.omega0) (e := 1) (x := 1) (y := 1)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simp)
  simpa [Ordinal.CNF.of_lt (b := Ordinal.omega0) (o := 1) (by norm_num)
    Ordinal.one_lt_omega0] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfCompleteQuotient_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cfCompleteQuotient_zero (ξ : ℝ) : cfCompleteQuotient ξ 0 = ξ
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfCompleteQuotient_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cfCompleteQuotient_succ (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    cfCompleteQuotient ξ (n + 1) = (Int.fract (cfCompleteQuotient ξ n))⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfCompleteQuotient_one
statement: theorem cfCompleteQuotient_one (ξ : ℝ) : cfCompleteQuotient ξ 1 = (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfDigit_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cfDigit_zero (ξ : ℝ) : cfDigit ξ 0 = ⌊ξ⌋
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.IsEventuallyPeriodic.mono
statement:
theorem IsEventuallyPeriodic.mono {a : ℕ → ℤ} {N L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (h : ∀ n, N ≤ n → a (n + L) = a n) {N' : ℕ} (hN : N ≤ N') :
    IsEventuallyPeriodic a
proof:
:=
  ⟨N', L, hL, fun n hn => h n (le_trans hN hn)⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.IsEventuallyPeriodic.mul_period
statement:
theorem IsEventuallyPeriodic.mul_period {a : ℕ → ℤ} (h : IsEventuallyPeriodic a) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ N L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ n, N ≤ n → a (n + k * L) = a n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, L, hL, hper⟩ := h
  refine ⟨N, L, hL, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ k n, N ≤ n → a (n + k * L) = a n := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro n _; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro n hn
      have h1 : n + (k + 1) * L = n + k * L + L := by ring
      rw [h1, hper (n + k * L) (le_trans hn (Nat.le_add_right n (k * L))), ih n hn]
  exact key k n hn

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.continuedFractionConvergent_succ_eq
statement:
theorem continuedFractionConvergent_succ_eq (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    continuedFractionConvergent ξ (n + 1) =
      (⌊ξ⌋ : ℤ) + (continuedFractionConvergent (cfCompleteQuotient ξ 1) n)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  continuedFractionConvergent_succ ξ n

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfCompleteQuotient_succ_eq_gaussMap
statement:
theorem cfCompleteQuotient_succ_eq_gaussMap (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    cfCompleteQuotient ξ (n + 1) = cfGaussMap (cfCompleteQuotient ξ n)
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfCompleteQuotient_add
statement:
theorem cfCompleteQuotient_add (ξ : ℝ) (m k : ℕ) :
    cfCompleteQuotient ξ (m + k) = (cfGaussMap^[k]) (cfCompleteQuotient ξ m)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.add_succ, cfCompleteQuotient_succ_eq_gaussMap, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfDigit_eventuallyPeriodic_of_completeQuotient_eq
statement:
theorem cfDigit_eventuallyPeriodic_of_completeQuotient_eq {ξ : ℝ} {N L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (h : cfCompleteQuotient ξ (N + L) = cfCompleteQuotient ξ N) :
    IsEventuallyPeriodic (cfDigit ξ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨N, L, hL, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  have h1 : cfCompleteQuotient ξ (N + k) = (cfGaussMap^[k]) (cfCompleteQuotient ξ N) :=
    cfCompleteQuotient_add ξ N k
  have h2 : cfCompleteQuotient ξ (N + L + k) =
      (cfGaussMap^[k]) (cfCompleteQuotient ξ (N + L)) :=
    cfCompleteQuotient_add ξ (N + L) k
  have h3 : cfCompleteQuotient ξ (N + L + k) = cfCompleteQuotient ξ (N + k) := by
    rw [h2, h1, h]
  rw [show N + k + L = N + L + k by omega]
  simp only [cfDigit]
  rw [h3]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.irr_sqrt_natCast
statement:
private lemma irr_sqrt_natCast (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) :
    Irrational (√(d : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (irrational_sqrt_intCast_iff (z := (d : ℤ))).mpr ⟨hns, Int.natCast_nonneg d⟩
  simpa using h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.two_le_of_not_isSquare
statement: private lemma two_le_of_not_isSquare (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) : 2 ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : d ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hns ⟨1, by norm_num⟩
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hd (Ne.symm h1)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.one_lt_sqrt_natCast
statement:
private lemma one_lt_sqrt_natCast (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) :
    1 < √(d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 ≤ d := two_le_of_not_isSquare d hd hns
  rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  norm_num
  exact_mod_cast h2

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrt_natCast_pos
statement: private lemma sqrt_natCast_pos (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) : 0 < √(d : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hd)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFState_eq_iterate
statement:
theorem sqrtCFState_eq_iterate (d : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    sqrtCFState d n = (sqrtCFStep d)^[n] (0, 1)
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFStep_apply
statement:
theorem sqrtCFStep_apply (d : ℕ) (s : ℤ × ℤ) :
    sqrtCFStep d s =
      (sqrtCFPartialQuotient d s * s.2 - s.1,
        ((d : ℤ) - (sqrtCFPartialQuotient d s * s.2 - s.1) ^ 2) / s.2)
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFState_succ
statement:
theorem sqrtCFState_succ (d : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    sqrtCFState d (n + 1) = sqrtCFStep d (sqrtCFState d n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sqrtCFState_eq_iterate, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFState_spec
statement:
private theorem sqrtCFState_spec (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) (n : ℕ) :
    (sqrtCFState d n).2 ≠ 0 ∧
      (sqrtCFState d n).2 ∣ (d : ℤ) - (sqrtCFState d n).1 ^ 2 ∧
      cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n =
        (((sqrtCFState d n).1 : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)) / ((sqrtCFState d n).2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [sqrtCFState]
    · simp [sqrtCFState]
    · simp [sqrtCFState]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hQ, hdvd, hξ⟩ := ih
    set s : ℤ × ℤ := sqrtCFState d n with hs
    set a : ℤ := sqrtCFPartialQuotient d s with ha
    set P' : ℤ := a * s.2 - s.1 with hP'def
    set Q' : ℤ := ((d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2) / s.2 with hQ'def
    have hξs : cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n = ((s.1 : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)) / (s.2 : ℝ) := hξ
