    have hQℝ : (s.2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    have hstate : sqrtCFState d (n + 1) = (P', Q') := by
      rw [sqrtCFState_succ, sqrtCFStep_apply]
    have ha_eq : a = ⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ := by
      rw [ha, sqrtCFPartialQuotient, hξs]
    have hfract : Int.fract (cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n) =
        (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) / (s.2 : ℝ) := by
      have h2 : cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n -
            (⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ : ℝ) =
          ((s.1 : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) - ⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ * (s.2 : ℝ)) /
            (s.2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [hξs]
        field_simp
      have h3 : (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) / (s.2 : ℝ) =
          ((s.1 : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) - ⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ * (s.2 : ℝ)) /
            (s.2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [hP'def, ha_eq]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [← Int.self_sub_floor (cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n), h2, ← h3]
    have hP'_ne : (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hPeq : (P' : ℝ) = √(d : ℝ) := by linarith
      exact (irr_sqrt_natCast d hd hns).ne_rat (P' : ℚ) (by push_cast; linarith)
    have hinv : (Int.fract (cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n))⁻¹ =
        (s.2 : ℝ) / (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hfract, inv_div]
    have hdvd' : s.2 ∣ (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdvd
      refine ⟨m - a ^ 2 * s.2 + 2 * a * s.1, ?_⟩
      have hkey : (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 =
          ((d : ℤ) - s.1 ^ 2) - a ^ 2 * s.2 ^ 2 + 2 * a * s.2 * s.1 := by
        rw [hP'def]; ring
      rw [hkey, hm]; ring
    have hQQ' : s.2 * Q' = (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 := by
      rw [hQ'def]; exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel' hdvd'
    have hdP' : (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      refine hns ⟨P', ?_⟩
      rw [← sq]; linarith
    have hQ'ne : Q' ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hzero : s.2 * Q' = 0 := by rw [h0, mul_zero]
      rw [hQQ'] at hzero
      exact hdP' hzero
    have hQ'ℝ : (Q' : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQ'ne
    have hstep : cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) (n + 1) =
        ((P' : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)) / (Q' : ℝ) := by
      rw [cfCompleteQuotient_succ, hinv, div_eq_div_iff hP'_ne hQ'ℝ]
      have hQQ'ℝ : (s.2 : ℝ) * (Q' : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast hQQ'
      rw [hQQ'ℝ]
      have hcomm : (P' : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) = √(d : ℝ) + P' := by ring
      rw [hcomm]
      ring_nf
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) by positivity)]
      ring
    rw [hstate]
    exact ⟨hQ'ne, ⟨s.2, by rw [← hQQ', mul_comm]⟩, hstep⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfCompleteQuotient_sqrt_fract_pos
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Int.fract_nonneg _) (Ne.symm ?_)
  intro h0
  obtain ⟨hQ, -, hξ⟩ := sqrtCFState_spec d hd hns n
  have hQℝ : ((sqrtCFState d n).2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hfloor : cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n =
      ((⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    have h := Int.floor_add_fract (cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n)
    rw [h0, add_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hmul : ((sqrtCFState d n).1 : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) =
      ((⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((sqrtCFState d n).2 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (((sqrtCFState d n).1 : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)) / ((sqrtCFState d n).2 : ℝ) =
        ((⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hξ]
      exact hfloor
    rwa [div_eq_iff hQℝ] at h1
  have hsqrt : √(d : ℝ) =
      ((⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((sqrtCFState d n).2 : ℝ) -
        ((sqrtCFState d n).1 : ℝ) := by
    linarith [hmul]
  exact (irr_sqrt_natCast d hd hns).ne_rat
    (((⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ : ℤ) * (sqrtCFState d n).2 -
      (sqrtCFState d n).1 : ℤ) : ℚ)
    (by push_cast; exact hsqrt)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.one_lt_cfCompleteQuotient_sqrt
statement:
private theorem one_lt_cfCompleteQuotient_sqrt (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 1 < cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : n ≠ 0)
  rw [cfCompleteQuotient_succ]
  rw [one_lt_inv₀ (cfCompleteQuotient_sqrt_fract_pos d hd hns k)]
  exact Int.fract_lt_one _

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFStep_bounds
statement:
private theorem sqrtCFStep_bounds (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ))
    {P Q : ℤ} (hP0 : 0 < P) (hPu : (P : ℝ) < √(d : ℝ)) (hQ0 : 0 < Q)
    (hQu : (Q : ℝ) < 2 * √(d : ℝ)) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hdvd : Q ∣ (d : ℤ) - P ^ 2)
    {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : ξ = ((P : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ)) (hξ1 : 1 < ξ) :
    0 < ⌊ξ⌋ * Q - P ∧
      ((⌊ξ⌋ * Q - P : ℤ) : ℝ) < √(d : ℝ) ∧
      0 < ((d : ℤ) - (⌊ξ⌋ * Q - P) ^ 2) / Q ∧
      ((((d : ℤ) - (⌊ξ⌋ * Q - P) ^ 2) / Q : ℤ) : ℝ) < 2 * √(d : ℝ) ∧
      (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹ = (Q : ℝ) / (√(d : ℝ) - ((⌊ξ⌋ * Q - P : ℤ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  set P' : ℤ := ⌊ξ⌋ * Q - P with hP'def
  set Q' : ℤ := ((d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2) / Q with hQ'def
  have hQℝ : (Q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hQ0ℝ : (0 : ℝ) < Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ0
  have hIrr : Irrational (√(d : ℝ)) := irr_sqrt_natCast d hd hns
  have hP'cast : (P' : ℝ) = (⌊ξ⌋ : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) - (P : ℝ) := by
    rw [hP'def]; push_cast; ring
  have hfract : Int.fract ξ = (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ) := by
    have h2 : ξ - (⌊ξ⌋ : ℝ) = ((P : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) - ⌊ξ⌋ * (Q : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ) := by
      rw [hξ]
      field_simp
    have h3 : (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ) =
        ((P : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) - ⌊ξ⌋ * (Q : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ) := by
      rw [hP'def]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [← Int.self_sub_floor ξ, h2, ← h3]
  have hP'_ne : (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hPeq : (P' : ℝ) = √(d : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact hIrr.ne_rat (P' : ℚ) (by push_cast; linarith)
  have hinv : (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹ = (Q : ℝ) / (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hfract, inv_div]
  have hfract_pos : 0 < Int.fract ξ := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Int.fract_nonneg ξ) (Ne.symm ?_)
    rw [hfract]
    exact div_ne_zero hP'_ne hQℝ
  have hξ'1 : 1 < (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [one_lt_inv₀ hfract_pos]
    exact Int.fract_lt_one ξ
  have hsub : √(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) = (Q : ℝ) / (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hinv]
    field_simp
  have hsub_pos : 0 < √(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) := by
    rw [hsub]
    exact div_pos hQ0ℝ (by positivity)
  have hsub_lt : √(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hsub, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹)]
    nlinarith [hξ'1, hQ0ℝ]
  have hP'lt : (P' : ℝ) < √(d : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hP'pos : 0 < P' := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hle : P' ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hcon
    have hleℝ : (P' : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hle
    have haQ_le : (⌊ξ⌋ : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ≤ (P : ℝ) := by linarith [hP'cast]
    have ha_gt : ξ - 1 < (⌊ξ⌋ : ℝ) := by
      have := Int.lt_floor_add_one ξ
      linarith
    have hξQ : ξ * (Q : ℝ) = (P : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) := by
      rw [hξ]; field_simp
    have hQ_gt : √(d : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) := by nlinarith [haQ_le, ha_gt, hQ0ℝ, hξQ]
    have hξ_lt_two : ξ < 2 := by
      rw [hξ, div_lt_iff₀ hQ0ℝ]
      nlinarith [hPu, hQ_gt]
    have ha_one : ⌊ξ⌋ = 1 := by
      refine Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num <;> linarith
    have hposℝ : (0 : ℝ) < (P' : ℝ) := by
      have : (P' : ℝ) = (Q : ℝ) - (P : ℝ) := by rw [hP'cast, ha_one]; ring
      linarith [hQ_gt, hPu]
    exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast hposℝ : 0 < P') hcon
  have hdvd' : Q ∣ (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdvd
    refine ⟨m - ⌊ξ⌋ ^ 2 * Q + 2 * ⌊ξ⌋ * P, ?_⟩
    have hkey : (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 =
        ((d : ℤ) - P ^ 2) - ⌊ξ⌋ ^ 2 * Q ^ 2 + 2 * ⌊ξ⌋ * Q * P := by
      rw [hP'def]; ring
    rw [hkey, hm]; ring
  have hQQ' : Q * Q' = (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 := by
    rw [hQ'def]; exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel' hdvd'
  have hdP' : (d : ℤ) - P' ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    refine hns ⟨P', ?_⟩
    rw [← sq]; linarith
  have hQ'ne : Q' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hzero : Q * Q' = 0 := by rw [h0, mul_zero]
    rw [hQQ'] at hzero
    exact hdP' hzero
  have hcast : (Q' : ℝ) = ((d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) ^ 2) / (Q : ℝ) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hQℝ, mul_comm]
    exact_mod_cast hQQ'
  have hQ'pos : 0 < Q' := by
    have hsq : (P' : ℝ) ^ 2 < (d : ℝ) := by
      have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (P' : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hP'pos.le
      nlinarith [hP'lt, hnn, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) by positivity)]
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (Q' : ℝ) := by
      rw [hcast]
      exact div_pos hpos hQ0ℝ
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hQ'lt : (Q' : ℝ) < 2 * √(d : ℝ) := by
    have hD : (d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ) ^ 2 =
        (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) * (√(d : ℝ) + (P' : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) by positivity)]
    have h1 : (√(d : ℝ) - (P' : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ) = 1 / (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hinv]
      field_simp
    rw [hcast, hD, ← div_mul_eq_mul_div, h1, one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹)]
    nlinarith [hP'lt, hξ'1, sqrt_natCast_pos d hd]
  exact ⟨hP'pos, hP'lt, hQ'pos, hQ'lt, hinv⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFState_bounds
statement:
private theorem sqrtCFState_bounds (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) :
    ∀ n, 1 ≤ n →
      0 < (sqrtCFState d n).1 ∧ ((sqrtCFState d n).1 : ℝ) < √(d : ℝ) ∧
        0 < (sqrtCFState d n).2 ∧ ((sqrtCFState d n).2 : ℝ) < 2 * √(d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro _
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
    · subst hn
      have hstate : sqrtCFState d 1 = (⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋, (d : ℤ) - ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ ^ 2) := by
        simp [sqrtCFState_eq_iterate, sqrtCFStep, sqrtCFPartialQuotient]
      rw [hstate]
      have hIrr : Irrational (√(d : ℝ)) := irr_sqrt_natCast d hd hns
      have ha0_nonneg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ :=
        Int.le_floor.mpr (by push_cast; positivity)
      have ha0_pos : 0 < ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ := by
        have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ :=
          Int.le_floor.mpr (by push_cast; exact le_of_lt (one_lt_sqrt_natCast d hd hns))
        omega
      have ha0_lt : (⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) < √(d : ℝ) := by
        refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Int.floor_le _) ?_
        intro h
        exact hIrr.ne_rat (⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℚ) (by push_cast; exact h.symm)
      refine ⟨ha0_pos, ha0_lt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hsq : (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
        have h1 : ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 < (d : ℝ) := by
          have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ha0_nonneg
          nlinarith [ha0_lt, hnn, hsq]
        have h2 : (((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) < ((d : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; exact h1
        have h3 : (⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) ^ 2 < (d : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
        omega
      · have hlt1 : √(d : ℝ) - ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) < 1 := by
          have := Int.lt_floor_add_one (√(d : ℝ)); linarith
        have hlt2 : √(d : ℝ) + ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * √(d : ℝ) := by
          have := Int.floor_le (√(d : ℝ)); linarith
        have hprod := mul_lt_mul hlt1 hlt2
          (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < √(d : ℝ) + ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ))
          (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        have hsq : (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
        push_cast
        nlinarith [hprod, hsq]
    · obtain ⟨hP0, hPu, hQ0, hQu⟩ := ih hn
      obtain ⟨hQne, hdvd, hξ⟩ := sqrtCFState_spec d hd hns n
      have hξ1 : 1 < cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n := one_lt_cfCompleteQuotient_sqrt d hd hns hn
      have hstep := sqrtCFStep_bounds d hd hns hP0 hPu hQ0 hQu hQne hdvd hξ hξ1
      have hstate : sqrtCFState d (n + 1) =
          (⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ * (sqrtCFState d n).2 - (sqrtCFState d n).1,
            ((d : ℤ) - (⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ * (sqrtCFState d n).2 -
              (sqrtCFState d n).1) ^ 2) / (sqrtCFState d n).2) := by
        rw [sqrtCFState_succ, sqrtCFStep_apply, sqrtCFPartialQuotient, ← hξ]
      have h1 : (sqrtCFState d (n + 1)).1 =
          ⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ * (sqrtCFState d n).2 - (sqrtCFState d n).1 := by
        rw [hstate]
      have h2 : (sqrtCFState d (n + 1)).2 =
          ((d : ℤ) - (⌊cfCompleteQuotient (√(d : ℝ)) n⌋ * (sqrtCFState d n).2 -
            (sqrtCFState d n).1) ^ 2) / (sqrtCFState d n).2 := by
        rw [hstate]
      rw [h1, h2]
      exact ⟨hstep.1, hstep.2.1, hstep.2.2.1, hstep.2.2.2.1⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCFState_mem_box
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨hP0, hPu, hQ0, hQu⟩ := sqrtCFState_bounds d hd hns n hn
  rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc]
  exact ⟨⟨hP0, Int.le_floor.mpr (le_of_lt hPu)⟩, ⟨hQ0, Int.le_floor.mpr (le_of_lt hQu)⟩⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_sqrtCFState_repetition
statement:
private theorem exists_sqrtCFState_repetition (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) :
    ∃ N L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧
      L ≤ (Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ ×ˢ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).card ∧
      sqrtCFState d N = sqrtCFState d (N + L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set T : Finset (ℤ × ℤ) :=
    Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ ×ˢ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋ with hT
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun i : Fin (T.card + 1) => sqrtCFState d ((i : ℕ) + 1))
      ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (T.card + 1))) ↑T := by
    intro i _
    exact sqrtCFState_mem_box d hd hns ((i : ℕ) + 1) (by omega)
  have hlt : T.card < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (T.card + 1))).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  obtain ⟨i, -, j, -, hij, hst⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (T.card + 1)))) (t := T) hlt hmaps
  have hjcard : (j : ℕ) ≤ T.card := by
    have := j.2
    omega
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hltij | hgtij
  · refine ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, (j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ), by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    have hidx : (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)) = (j : ℕ) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hidx]
    exact hst
  · refine ⟨(j : ℕ) + 1, (i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ), by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    have hidx : (j : ℕ) + 1 + ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ)) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hidx]
    exact hst.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sqrtCF_period_of_state_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  have hiter : sqrtCFState d (N + k) = sqrtCFState d (N + L + k) := by
    have h1 : sqrtCFState d (N + k) = (sqrtCFStep d)^[k] (sqrtCFState d N) := by
      rw [sqrtCFState_eq_iterate, Nat.add_comm N k, Function.iterate_add_apply,
        ← sqrtCFState_eq_iterate]
    have h2 : sqrtCFState d (N + L + k) = (sqrtCFStep d)^[k] (sqrtCFState d (N + L)) := by
      rw [sqrtCFState_eq_iterate, Nat.add_comm (N + L) k, Function.iterate_add_apply,
        ← sqrtCFState_eq_iterate]
    rw [h1, h2, hstate]
  have hdigit : ∀ m : ℕ, cfDigit (√(d : ℝ)) m = sqrtCFPartialQuotient d (sqrtCFState d m) := by
    intro m
    simp only [cfDigit, sqrtCFPartialQuotient, (sqrtCFState_spec d hd hns m).2.2]
  rw [show N + k + L = N + L + k by omega, hdigit, hdigit, hiter]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfDigit_sqrt_eventuallyPeriodic
statement:
theorem cfDigit_sqrt_eventuallyPeriodic (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) :
    IsEventuallyPeriodic (cfDigit (√(d : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, L, hL, -, hstate⟩ := exists_sqrtCFState_repetition d hd hns
  exact ⟨N, L, hL, sqrtCF_period_of_state_eq d hd hns hstate⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_cfDigit_sqrt_period_le
statement:
theorem exists_cfDigit_sqrt_period_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (d : ℤ)) :
    ∃ N L : ℕ, 0 < L ∧ L ≤ 2 * d ∧
      ∀ n, N ≤ n → cfDigit (√(d : ℝ)) (n + L) = cfDigit (√(d : ℝ)) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, L, hL, hLcard, hstate⟩ := exists_sqrtCFState_repetition d hd hns
  refine ⟨N, L, hL, ?_, sqrtCF_period_of_state_eq d hd hns hstate⟩
  have hcard : (Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ ×ˢ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) ⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).card =
      (⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat * (⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat := by
    rw [Finset.card_product, Int.card_Icc, Int.card_Icc]
    norm_num
  rw [hcard] at hLcard
  have hfl1 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
  have hfl2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
  have h1 : ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℝ) ≤ √(d : ℝ) := by
    have hz : ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℤ) = ⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hfl1
    have hcast : ((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℝ) = (⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, hz]
    rw [hcast]
    exact Int.floor_le _
  have h2 : ((⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℝ) ≤ 2 * √(d : ℝ) := by
    have hz : ((⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℤ) = ⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hfl2
    have hcast : ((⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℝ) = (⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, hz]
    rw [hcast]
    exact Int.floor_le _
  have hreal : (((⌊√(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat * (⌊2 * √(d : ℝ)⌋).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    nlinarith [h1, h2, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) by positivity)]
  exact le_trans hLcard (by exact_mod_cast hreal)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.cfDigit_sqrt_sq_add_one
statement:
theorem cfDigit_sqrt_sq_add_one (a : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    cfDigit (√(((a ^ 2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) n = 2 * (a : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set d : ℕ := a ^ 2 + 1 with hd
  set s : ℝ := √(d : ℝ) with hs
  have hd_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [hd]; push_cast; positivity
  have hsq : s ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hd_pos.le
  have ha_lt : (a : ℝ) < s := by
    rw [hs, Real.lt_sqrt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (a : ℝ)), hd]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have ha_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (a : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hs_lt : s < (a : ℝ) + 1 := by
    rw [hs, Real.sqrt_lt' (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (a : ℝ) + 1), hd]
    push_cast
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a : ℝ), ha_one]
  have hfloor_s : ⌊s⌋ = (a : ℤ) := by
    refine Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  have hfract_s : Int.fract s = s - (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Int.self_sub_floor s, hfloor_s]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hinv : (s - (a : ℝ))⁻¹ = s + (a : ℝ) := by
    refine inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right ?_
    have h1 : (s - (a : ℝ)) * (s + (a : ℝ)) = s ^ 2 - (a : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h1, hsq, hd]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hfloor_sa : ⌊s + (a : ℝ)⌋ = 2 * (a : ℤ) := by
    refine Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  have hfix : cfGaussMap (s + (a : ℝ)) = s + (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [cfGaussMap]
    have h2 : Int.fract (s + (a : ℝ)) = s - (a : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Int.self_sub_floor (s + (a : ℝ)), hfloor_sa]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h2, hinv]
  have hq1 : cfCompleteQuotient s 1 = s + (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [cfCompleteQuotient_succ, cfCompleteQuotient_zero, hfract_s, hinv]
  have hiter : ∀ k : ℕ, (cfGaussMap^[k]) (s + (a : ℝ)) = s + (a : ℝ) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, hfix]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  have hquot : cfCompleteQuotient s (1 + k) = s + (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [cfCompleteQuotient_add, hq1, hiter k]
  simp only [cfDigit, hquot, hfloor_sa]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pellSolution_ratio_isConvergent
statement:
theorem pellSolution_ratio_isConvergent {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬IsSquare d)
    {a : PellSolution d} (hx : 1 < a.x) (hy : 0 < a.y) :
    ∃ n, ((a.x : ℚ) / (a.y : ℚ)) = continuedFractionConvergent (√(d : ℝ)) n
proof:
:= by
  
  have hd1 : 1 < d := by
    have hle : (1 : ℤ) ≤ d := by omega
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
    · exact h
    · subst h
      exact absurd (show IsSquare (1 : ℤ) from ⟨1, by ring⟩) hns
  set q : ℚ := (a.x : ℚ) / (a.y : ℚ) with hq
  
  have hcop : IsCoprime a.x a.y := by
    refine ⟨a.x, -(d * a.y), ?_⟩
    rw [← a.equation]
    ring
  have hgcd : Int.gcd a.x a.y = 1 := Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp hcop
  have hnat : Nat.Coprime a.x.natAbs a.y.natAbs := by
    simpa [Nat.Coprime, Int.gcd_def] using hgcd
  
  have hden : (q.den : ℤ) = a.y := by
    rw [hq]
    exact Rat.den_div_eq_of_coprime hy hnat
  have hdenR : (q.den : ℝ) = (a.y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hden
  have hcast : (q : ℝ) = (a.x : ℝ) / (a.y : ℝ) := by
    rw [hq]; push_cast; ring
  have hdR : (1 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hsq : √(d : ℝ) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hd0
  have hyR : (0 : ℝ) < (a.y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hxR : (1 : ℝ) < (a.x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have heq : (a.x : ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) * (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 := by exact_mod_cast a.equation
  
  have hmain : |√(d : ℝ) - (a.x : ℝ) / (a.y : ℝ)| < 1 / (2 * (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    set r : ℝ := (a.x : ℝ) / (a.y : ℝ) with hr
    have hrpos : 0 < r := by positivity
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = (a.x : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [hr]; field_simp
    
    have hprod : (√(d : ℝ) - r) * (√(d : ℝ) + r) = -(1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [show (√(d : ℝ) - r) * (√(d : ℝ) + r) = (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 - r ^ 2 by ring]
      rw [hsq, hr2]
      field_simp
      linarith [heq]
    have hsum_pos : 0 < √(d : ℝ) + r := by
      linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (d : ℝ), hrpos]
    have habs : |√(d : ℝ) - r| * (√(d : ℝ) + r) = 1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← abs_of_pos hsum_pos, ← abs_mul, hprod, abs_neg]
      exact abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr (pow_pos hyR 2))
    have hkey : |√(d : ℝ) - r| = (1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) / (√(d : ℝ) + r) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hsum_pos)]
      exact habs
    have hsqrt_gt_one : 1 < √(d : ℝ) := by
      have := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hdR
      simpa using this
    
    have hr_gt : √(d : ℝ) < r := by
      have hr2' : r ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) + 1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hr2]
        field_simp
        linarith [heq]
      have hsqlt : (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
        rw [hsq, hr2']
        have : 0 < 1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_div_pos.mpr (pow_pos hyR 2)
        linarith
      have := sq_lt_sq.mp hsqlt
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), abs_of_pos hrpos] at this
    have hsum_gt_two : 2 < √(d : ℝ) + r := by linarith
    rw [hkey]
    have hpos1 : 0 < 1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_div_pos.mpr (pow_pos hyR 2)
    have hstep : (1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) / (√(d : ℝ) + r) < (1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) / 2 :=
      div_lt_div_of_pos_left hpos1 (by norm_num) hsum_gt_two
    have hfin : (1 / (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) / 2 = 1 / (2 * (a.y : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
    linarith [hstep, hfin]
  apply legendreApproximation_is_convergent
  change |√(d : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)| < 1 / (2 * (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2)
  rw [hcast, hdenR]
  exact hmain

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_int_contsAux
statement:
private theorem exists_int_contsAux (v : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ A B : ℤ, (GenContFract.of v).contsAux n = (⟨(A : ℝ), (B : ℝ)⟩ : GenContFract.Pair ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rcases n with _ | _ | n
    · exact ⟨1, 0, by simp [GenContFract.contsAux]⟩
    · exact ⟨⌊v⌋, 1, by simp [GenContFract.contsAux, GenContFract.of_h_eq_floor]⟩
    · rcases h : (GenContFract.of v).s.get? n with _ | gp
      · obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := ih (n + 1) (by omega)
        exact ⟨A, B, by simp only [GenContFract.contsAux, h]; exact hAB⟩
      · obtain ⟨A₁, B₁, h1⟩ := ih (n + 1) (by omega)
        obtain ⟨A₀, B₀, h0⟩ := ih n (by omega)
        obtain ⟨ifp, hstream, hb⟩ :=
          GenContFract.IntFractPair.exists_succ_get?_stream_of_gcf_of_get?_eq_some h
        have ha : gp.a = 1 := GenContFract.of_partNum_eq_one (GenContFract.partNum_eq_s_a h)
        refine ⟨ifp.b * A₁ + A₀, ifp.b * B₁ + B₀, ?_⟩
        rw [GenContFract.contsAux_recurrence h h0 h1]
        cases gp with
        | mk a b => simp_all

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.rat_den_le_dens
statement:
private theorem rat_den_le_dens {v : ℝ} {q : ℚ} {n : ℕ}
    (hconv : (GenContFract.of v).convs n = (q : ℝ))
    (hpos : 0 < (GenContFract.of v).dens n) :
    q.den ≤ (GenContFract.of v).dens n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := exists_int_contsAux v (n + 1)
  have hnums : (GenContFract.of v).nums n = (A : ℝ) := by
    rw [GenContFract.num_eq_conts_a, GenContFract.nth_cont_eq_succ_nth_contAux, hAB]
  have hdens : (GenContFract.of v).dens n = (B : ℝ) := by
    rw [GenContFract.den_eq_conts_b, GenContFract.nth_cont_eq_succ_nth_contAux, hAB]
  have hqAB : q = (A : ℚ) / (B : ℚ) := by
    apply Rat.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
    push_cast
    rw [← hconv, GenContFract.conv_eq_num_div_den, hnums, hdens]
  have hBpos : 0 < B := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (B : ℝ) := by rw [← hdens]; exact hpos
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hdvd : (q.den : ℤ) ∣ B := by
    have h := Rat.den_dvd A B
    rw [← Rat.intCast_div_eq_divInt] at h
    rwa [← hqAB] at h
  have hle : (q.den : ℤ) ≤ B := Int.le_of_dvd hBpos hdvd
  have hleNat : q.den ≤ B.toNat := by omega
  have hBnat : ((B.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = (B : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hBpos.le
  rw [hdens, ← hBnat]
  exact_mod_cast hleNat

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.rat_num_eq_mul_den
statement:
private theorem rat_num_eq_mul_den (q : ℚ) :
    (q.num : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) * (q.den : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun r : ℚ => (r : ℝ)) (Rat.num_div_den q)
  push_cast at h
  rw [div_eq_iff (by exact_mod_cast q.den_nz : (q.den : ℝ) ≠ 0)] at h
  exact h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.convergent_pellForm_bounded
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hq
  set q : ℚ := continuedFractionConvergent (√(d : ℝ)) n with hqdef
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd.le
  have hsq : (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hd0
  have hqconv : (q : ℝ) = ((Real.convergent (√(d : ℝ)) n : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hqdef]
    rfl
  have hconv : (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).convs n = (q : ℝ) :=
    (Real.convs_eq_convergent (√(d : ℝ)) n).trans hqconv.symm
  
  have hnum := rat_num_eq_mul_den q
  have hform : (q.num : ℝ) ^ 2 - (d : ℝ) * (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2
      = (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 - (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by
    have h2 : (d : ℝ) * (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 = (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [hsq]
    rw [hnum, h2]; ring
  have hfac : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 - (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2
      = ((q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)) * ((q : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)) := by ring
  by_cases hterm : (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).TerminatedAt n
  · 
    have hvq : (q : ℝ) = √(d : ℝ) := by
      have h := GenContFract.of_correctness_of_terminatedAt (v := √(d : ℝ)) hterm
      rw [hconv] at h
      exact h.symm
    have hqd : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 = (√(d : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by rw [hvq]
    rw [hform, hqd, sub_self, mul_zero, abs_zero]
    positivity
  · have hdens_pos : 0 < (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n := by
      have hfib := GenContFract.succ_nth_fib_le_of_nth_den (v := √(d : ℝ)) (n := n)
        (Or.inr (mt (GenContFract.terminated_stable (Nat.pred_le n)) hterm))
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.fib_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)
      linarith
    have hdenle : q.den ≤ (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n :=
      rat_den_le_dens hconv hdens_pos
    
    have hb : |√(d : ℝ) - (q : ℝ)|
        ≤ 1 / ((GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n
            * (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens (n + 1)) := by
      have h := GenContFract.abs_sub_convs_le (v := √(d : ℝ)) (n := n) hterm
      rwa [hconv] at h
    have hmono : (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n
        ≤ (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens (n + 1) := GenContFract.of_den_mono
    have hdenleR : (q.den : ℝ) ≤ (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n := by exact_mod_cast hdenle
    have hmonoR : (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n
        ≤ (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens (n + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hmono
    have hprod : (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2
        ≤ (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens n
            * (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens (n + 1) := by
      have h2 : (q.den : ℝ) ≤ (GenContFract.of (√(d : ℝ))).dens (n + 1) :=
        hdenleR.trans hmonoR
      have h := mul_le_mul hdenleR h2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
      simpa [sq] using h
    have hb1 : |(q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h := hb.trans (one_div_le_one_div_of_le
        (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2) hprod)
      rwa [abs_sub_comm] at h
    have h1 : (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 * |(q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb1 (sq_nonneg (q.den : ℝ))
      rwa [mul_one_div, div_self (by positivity : (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 ≠ 0)] at h
    have h2 : |(q : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * √(d : ℝ) + 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hsplit : (q : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ) = ((q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)) + 2 * √(d : ℝ) := by ring
      rw [hsplit]
      calc |((q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)) + 2 * √(d : ℝ)|
          ≤ |(q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)| + |2 * √(d : ℝ)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |(q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)| + 2 * √(d : ℝ) := by
              rw [show |2 * √(d : ℝ)| = 2 * √(d : ℝ) from abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        _ ≤ 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 * √(d : ℝ) := by linarith
        _ = 2 * √(d : ℝ) + 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h3 : 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have hge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q.den : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt q.pos)
        nlinarith
      have h := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hge
      simpa using h
    have key : (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 * |(q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)| * |(q : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)|
        ≤ 2 * √(d : ℝ) + 1 := by
      calc (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 * |(q : ℝ) - √(d : ℝ)| * |(q : ℝ) + √(d : ℝ)|
          ≤ 1 * (2 * √(d : ℝ) + 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 2 * √(d : ℝ) + 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * √(d : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    rw [hform, hfac, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (q.den : ℝ))]
    linarith [key]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primeMultiplicity_eq_factorization
statement:
theorem primeMultiplicity_eq_factorization {n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    primeMultiplicity n p = n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeMultiplicity
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · rw [← hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]
    exact Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := fun k ↦ p ^ k ∣ n) (Nat.zero_le n)
      (show p ^ 0 ∣ n by simp)
  · exact Nat.le_findGreatest (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.factorization_lt p hn))
      ((hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn).2 le_rfl)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primeMultiplicity_zero
statement: theorem primeMultiplicity_zero (p : ℕ) : primeMultiplicity 0 p = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.findGreatest_le 0)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.prime_factorization_reconstructs
statement:
theorem prime_factorization_reconstructs {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.factorization.prod (fun p e ↦ p ^ e) = n
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.eq_of_prime_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_prime_factorization_eq {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, m.factorization p = n.factorization p) : m = n
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq hm hn h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.eq_of_primeMultiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_primeMultiplicity_eq {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → primeMultiplicity m p = primeMultiplicity n p) : m = n
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_prime_factorization_eq hm hn
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.Prime
  · simpa [primeMultiplicity_eq_factorization hp hm,
      primeMultiplicity_eq_factorization hp hn] using h p hp
  · simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.continuedFractionConvergent_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem continuedFractionConvergent_zero (ξ : ℝ) :
    continuedFractionConvergent ξ 0 = (⌊ξ⌋ : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.convergent_zero ξ

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.continuedFractionConvergent_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem continuedFractionConvergent_succ (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    continuedFractionConvergent ξ (n + 1) =
      (⌊ξ⌋ : ℤ) + (continuedFractionConvergent (Int.fract ξ)⁻¹ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.convergent_succ ξ n

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exact_rational_isBestApproximation
statement:
theorem exact_rational_isBestApproximation (q : ℚ) :
    IsBestRationalApproximation (q : ℝ) q
proof:
:= by
  intro r _
  simp [rationalApproximationError]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_bestApproximationIn
statement:
theorem exists_bestApproximationIn (ξ : ℝ) {s : Finset ℚ} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ q, IsBestApproximationIn ξ s q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hqs, hq⟩ := s.exists_min_image (rationalApproximationError ξ) hs
  exact ⟨q, hqs, hq⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendreApproximation_is_convergent
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.exists_rat_eq_convergent hq

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.isIntegerSquare_iff_isSquare
statement: theorem isIntegerSquare_iff_isSquare (d : ℤ) : IsIntegerSquare d ↔ IsSquare d
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsIntegerSquare, eq_comm] using (isSquare_iff_exists_sq d).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pell_comp_x
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pell_comp_x (a b : PellSolution d) :
    (a.comp b).x = a.x * b.x + d * (a.y * b.y)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pell_comp_y
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pell_comp_y (a b : PellSolution d) :
    (a.comp b).y = a.x * b.y + a.y * b.x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_positive_pellSolution
statement:
theorem exists_positive_pellSolution {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬IsSquare d) :
    ∃ a : PellSolution d, 1 < a.x ∧ 0 < a.y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, hax, hay⟩ := Pell.Solution₁.exists_pos_of_not_isSquare hd hns
  exact ⟨⟨a.x, a.y, a.prop⟩, hax, hay⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_positive_pellSolution_of_not_integerSquare
statement:
theorem exists_positive_pellSolution_of_not_integerSquare {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hns : ¬IsIntegerSquare d) :
    ∃ a : PellSolution d, 1 < a.x ∧ 0 < a.y
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_positive_pellSolution hd
  rwa [← isIntegerSquare_iff_isSquare]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_fundamentalPellSolution
statement:
theorem exists_fundamentalPellSolution {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hns : ¬IsSquare d) :
    ∃ a : PellSolution d, IsFundamentalPellSolution a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Pell.IsFundamental.exists_of_not_isSquare hd hns
  refine ⟨⟨a.x, a.y, a.prop⟩, ha.1, ha.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  let b' : Pell.Solution₁ d := Pell.Solution₁.mk b.x b.y b.equation
  have hb' : 1 < b'.x := by simpa [b'] using hb
  simpa [b'] using ha.2.2 hb'

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_fundamentalPellSolution_of_not_integerSquare
statement:
theorem exists_fundamentalPellSolution_of_not_integerSquare {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hns : ¬IsIntegerSquare d) :
    ∃ a : PellSolution d, IsFundamentalPellSolution a
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_fundamentalPellSolution hd
  rwa [← isIntegerSquare_iff_isSquare]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.toMathlib_x
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PellSolution.toMathlib_x {d : ℤ} (a : PellSolution d) :
    a.toMathlib.x = a.x
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.toMathlib_y
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PellSolution.toMathlib_y {d : ℤ} (a : PellSolution d) :
    a.toMathlib.y = a.y
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.toMathlib_injective
statement:
theorem PellSolution.toMathlib_injective {d : ℤ} :
    Function.Injective (PellSolution.toMathlib (d := d))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have hx : a.x = b.x := by simpa using congrArg Pell.Solution₁.x h
  have hy : a.y = b.y := by simpa using congrArg Pell.Solution₁.y h
  cases a; cases b; simp_all

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.toMathlib_one
statement:
theorem PellSolution.toMathlib_one (d : ℤ) :
    (PellSolution.one d).toMathlib = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Pell.Solution₁.ext <;> simp [PellSolution.one]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.toMathlib_comp
statement:
theorem PellSolution.toMathlib_comp {d : ℤ} (a b : PellSolution d) :
    (a.comp b).toMathlib = a.toMathlib * b.toMathlib
proof:
:= by
  apply Pell.Solution₁.ext <;> simp [PellSolution.comp]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.pow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PellSolution.pow_zero {d : ℤ} (a : PellSolution d) :
    a.pow 0 = PellSolution.one d
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.pow_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem PellSolution.pow_succ {d : ℤ} (a : PellSolution d) (n : ℕ) :
    a.pow (n + 1) = (a.pow n).comp a
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.toMathlib_pow
statement:
theorem PellSolution.toMathlib_pow {d : ℤ} (a : PellSolution d) (n : ℕ) :
    (a.pow n).toMathlib = a.toMathlib ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [PellSolution.toMathlib_one]
  | succ n ih => rw [PellSolution.pow_succ, PellSolution.toMathlib_comp, ih, _root_.pow_succ]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.PellSolution.isFundamental_toMathlib
statement:
theorem PellSolution.isFundamental_toMathlib {d : ℤ} {a : PellSolution d}
    (ha : IsFundamentalPellSolution a) : Pell.IsFundamental a.toMathlib
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using ha.1
  · simpa using ha.2.1
  · intro b hb
    exact ha.2.2 ⟨b.x, b.y, b.prop⟩ (by simpa using hb)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.IsFundamentalPellSolution.subsingleton
statement:
theorem IsFundamentalPellSolution.subsingleton {d : ℤ} {a b : PellSolution d}
    (ha : IsFundamentalPellSolution a) (hb : IsFundamentalPellSolution b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  apply PellSolution.toMathlib_injective
  exact Pell.IsFundamental.subsingleton (PellSolution.isFundamental_toMathlib ha)
    (PellSolution.isFundamental_toMathlib hb)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_pow_eq_of_fundamental
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Pell.IsFundamental.eq_pow_of_nonneg (a := b.toMathlib)
    (PellSolution.isFundamental_toMathlib ha) (by simpa using hx) (by simpa using hy)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  apply PellSolution.toMathlib_injective
  rw [PellSolution.toMathlib_pow]
  exact hn

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pos_iff_exists_pow
statement:
theorem pos_iff_exists_pow {d : ℤ} {a : PellSolution d} (ha : IsFundamentalPellSolution a)
    (b : PellSolution d) : (0 < b.x ∧ 0 ≤ b.y) ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, b = a.pow n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    exact exists_pow_eq_of_fundamental ha hx hy
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    have hax : 0 < a.toMathlib.x := by simpa using (zero_lt_one.trans ha.1)
    have hay : 0 < a.toMathlib.y := by simpa using ha.2.1
    have hx' : (a.pow n).x = (a.toMathlib ^ n).x := by
      simpa using congrArg Pell.Solution₁.x (PellSolution.toMathlib_pow a n)
    have hy' : (a.pow n).y = (a.toMathlib ^ n).y := by
      simpa using congrArg Pell.Solution₁.y (PellSolution.toMathlib_pow a n)
    constructor
    · rw [hx']; exact Pell.Solution₁.x_pow_pos hax n
    · rw [hy']
      cases n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k => exact (Pell.Solution₁.y_pow_succ_pos hax hay k).le

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_pos_pow_eq_of_fundamental
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_eq_of_fundamental ha (zero_lt_one.trans hx) hy.le
  refine ⟨n, ?_, hn⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
  · rw [h, PellSolution.pow_zero] at hn
    rw [hn] at hx
    simp [PellSolution.one] at hx
  · exact h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_fundamental_pellSolution_pow_classification
statement:
theorem exists_fundamental_pellSolution_pow_classification {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hns : ¬IsSquare d) :
    ∃ a : PellSolution d, IsFundamentalPellSolution a ∧
      ∀ b : PellSolution d, (0 < b.x ∧ 0 ≤ b.y) ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, b = a.pow n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_fundamentalPellSolution hd hns
  exact ⟨a, ha, fun b => pos_iff_exists_pow ha b⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_quadratic_reciprocity_product
statement:
theorem legendre_quadratic_reciprocity_product {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    legendreSym q p * legendreSym p q = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2 * (q / 2))
proof:
:= by
  exact legendreSym.quadratic_reciprocity hp hq hpq

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_quadratic_reciprocity
statement:
theorem legendre_quadratic_reciprocity {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    legendreSym q p = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2 * (q / 2)) * legendreSym p q
proof:
:= by
  have hqmod : ((q : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    norm_cast
    exact prime_ne_zero p q hpq
  have hsq : legendreSym p q ^ 2 = 1 := legendreSym.sq_one p hqmod
  calc
    legendreSym q p = legendreSym q p * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
    _ = legendreSym q p * legendreSym p q ^ 2 := by rw [hsq]
    _ = (legendreSym q p * legendreSym p q) * legendreSym p q := by ring
    _ = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p / 2 * (q / 2)) * legendreSym p q := by
      rw [legendre_quadratic_reciprocity_product hp hq hpq]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_reciprocity_one_mod_four
statement:
theorem legendre_reciprocity_one_mod_four {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p % 4 = 1) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q p = legendreSym p q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    rfl
  · have hp2 : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro h
      subst p
      norm_num at hp
    rw [legendre_quadratic_reciprocity hp2 hq hpq, pow_mul,
      neg_one_pow_div_two_of_one_mod_four hp, one_pow, one_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_reciprocity_three_mod_four
statement:
theorem legendre_reciprocity_three_mod_four {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p % 4 = 3) (hq : q % 4 = 3) :
    legendreSym q p = -legendreSym p q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [(legendreSym.eq_zero_iff p p).2 (by simp)]
    simp
  · have hp2 : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro h
      subst p
      norm_num at hp
    have hq2 : q ≠ 2 := by
      intro h
      subst q
      norm_num at hq
    rw [legendre_quadratic_reciprocity hp2 hq2 hpq, pow_mul,
      neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four hp,
      neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four hq, neg_one_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_reciprocity_one_mod_four
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    rfl
  · have hqp : (((q : ℕ) : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
      norm_cast
      exact prime_ne_zero p q hpq
    have hpq' : (((p : ℕ) : ℤ) : ZMod q) ≠ 0 := by
      norm_cast
      exact prime_ne_zero q p (Ne.symm hpq)
    rw [← legendre_eq_one_iff_quadraticResidue hqp,
      ← legendre_eq_one_iff_quadraticResidue hpq',
      legendre_reciprocity_one_mod_four hp hq]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_reciprocity_three_mod_four
proof:
:= by
  have hqp : (((q : ℕ) : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    norm_cast
    exact prime_ne_zero p q hpq
  rw [← legendre_eq_one_iff_quadraticResidue hqp,
    ← legendre_eq_neg_one_iff_quadraticNonresidue,
    legendre_reciprocity_three_mod_four hp hq]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity
statement:
theorem jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity {a b : ℕ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : Odd b) :
    jacobiSym a b = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (a / 2 * (b / 2)) * jacobiSym b a
proof:
:= by
  exact jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity ha hb

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.jacobi_reciprocity_one_mod_four
statement:
theorem jacobi_reciprocity_one_mod_four {a b : ℕ} (ha : a % 4 = 1) (hb : Odd b) :
    jacobiSym a b = jacobiSym b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity (odd_iff.mpr (odd_of_mod_four_eq_one ha)) hb,
    pow_mul, neg_one_pow_div_two_of_one_mod_four ha, one_pow, one_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.jacobi_reciprocity_three_mod_four
statement:
theorem jacobi_reciprocity_three_mod_four {a b : ℕ} (ha : a % 4 = 3) (hb : b % 4 = 3) :
    jacobiSym a b = -jacobiSym b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity (odd_iff.mpr (odd_of_mod_four_eq_three ha))
      (odd_iff.mpr (odd_of_mod_four_eq_three hb)),
    pow_mul, neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four ha,
    neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four hb, neg_one_mul]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.linearDiophantine_of_gcd_mul
statement:
theorem linearDiophantine_of_gcd_mul (a b k : ℤ) :
    LinearDiophantineSolvable a b ((Int.gcd a b : ℤ) * k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Int.gcdA a b * k, Int.gcdB a b * k, ?_⟩
  calc
    a * (Int.gcdA a b * k) + b * (Int.gcdB a b * k) =
        (a * Int.gcdA a b + b * Int.gcdB a b) * k := by ring
    _ = (Int.gcd a b : ℤ) * k := by rw [← Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.linearDiophantine_iff_gcd_dvd
statement:
theorem linearDiophantine_iff_gcd_dvd (a b c : ℤ) :
    LinearDiophantineSolvable a b c ↔ (Int.gcd a b : ℤ) ∣ c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
    exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.gcd_dvd_left a b) x)
      (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (Int.gcd_dvd_right a b) y)
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact linearDiophantine_of_gcd_mul a b k

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.coprime_iff_linearDiophantine_all
statement:
theorem coprime_iff_linearDiophantine_all (a b : ℤ) :
    Int.gcd a b = 1 ↔ ∀ c : ℤ, LinearDiophantineSolvable a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hgcd c
    apply (linearDiophantine_iff_gcd_dvd a b c).mpr
    rw [hgcd]
    exact one_dvd c
  · intro h
    have hdvdInt : (Int.gcd a b : ℤ) ∣ (1 : ℤ) :=
      (linearDiophantine_iff_gcd_dvd a b 1).mp (h 1)
    have hdvdNat : Int.gcd a b ∣ (1 : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hdvdInt
    exact Nat.dvd_one.mp hdvdNat

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_iff_isSquare
statement:
theorem quadraticResidue_iff_isSquare (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    IsQuadraticResidue n a ↔ IsSquare (a : ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsQuadraticResidue, isSquare_iff_exists_sq, eq_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_zero
statement: theorem quadraticResidue_zero (n : ℕ) : IsQuadraticResidue n 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨0, by simp⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_mul
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨y, hy⟩
  refine ⟨x * y, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_pow, hx, hy]
  norm_cast

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_eq_one_iff_quadraticResidue
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticResidue_iff_isSquare]
  exact legendreSym.eq_one_iff p ha

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_eq_neg_one_iff_quadraticNonresidue
statement:
theorem legendre_eq_neg_one_iff_quadraticNonresidue {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} :
    legendreSym p a = -1 ↔ IsQuadraticNonresidue p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [legendreSym.eq_neg_one_iff, IsQuadraticNonresidue, quadraticResidue_iff_isSquare]
  constructor
  · intro hnotSquare
    refine ⟨?_, hnotSquare⟩
    intro ha
    apply hnotSquare
    rw [ha]
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · exact fun h ↦ h.2

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_iff_eulerCriterion
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticResidue_iff_isSquare]
  exact ZMod.euler_criterion p ha

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.legendre_eq_neg_one_pow_gaussUpperHalfCount
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [gaussUpperHalfCount] using ZMod.gauss_lemma hp ha

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticResidue_iff_gaussUpperHalfCount_even
proof:
:= by
  rw [← legendre_eq_one_iff_quadraticResidue ha,
    legendre_eq_neg_one_pow_gaussUpperHalfCount hp ha,
    neg_one_pow_eq_one_iff_even (by norm_num : (-1 : ℤ) ≠ 1)]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.quadraticNonresidue_iff_gaussUpperHalfCount_odd
proof:
:= by
  rw [← legendre_eq_neg_one_iff_quadraticNonresidue,
    legendre_eq_neg_one_pow_gaussUpperHalfCount hp ha,
    neg_one_pow_eq_neg_one_iff_odd (by norm_num : (-1 : ℤ) ≠ 1)]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.jacobi_prime_denominator
statement:
theorem jacobi_prime_denominator (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : ℤ) :
    jacobiSym a p = legendreSym p a
proof:
:= by
  exact (jacobiSym.legendreSym.to_jacobiSym p a).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.jacobi_square_of_coprime
statement:
theorem jacobi_square_of_coprime {a : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hcop : a.gcd n = 1) :
    jacobiSym (a ^ 2) n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two, jacobiSym.mul_left]
  rcases jacobiSym.eq_one_or_neg_one hcop with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.jacobi_one_not_sufficient_for_quadraticResidue
statement:
theorem jacobi_one_not_sufficient_for_quadraticResidue :
    jacobiSym 2 15 = 1 ∧ ¬IsQuadraticResidue 15 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [jacobiSym.at_two (by exact ⟨7, by norm_num⟩ : Odd 15)]
    norm_num [χ₈]
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    fin_cases x <;> (revert hx; decide)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.euclidean_division
statement:
theorem euclidean_division (m n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ q r : ℕ, m = q * n + r ∧ r < n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨m / n, m % n, ?_, Nat.mod_lt m hn⟩
  simpa [mul_comm, add_comm] using (Nat.mod_add_div m n).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.dvd_gcd_iff
statement: theorem dvd_gcd_iff {d m n : ℕ} : d ∣ Nat.gcd m n ↔ d ∣ m ∧ d ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.dvd_gcd_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.bezout_identity
statement:
theorem bezout_identity (m n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, (Nat.gcd m n : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) * a + (n : ℤ) * b
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨m.gcdA n, m.gcdB n, Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab m n⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.coprime_iff_exists_int_linear_combination
statement:
theorem coprime_iff_exists_int_linear_combination (m n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime m n ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, (m : ℤ) * a + (n : ℤ) * b = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := bezout_identity m n
    exact ⟨a, b, by simpa [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp h] using hab.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hab⟩
    rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
    have hdiv : Int.gcd (m : ℤ) (n : ℤ) ∣ 1 :=
      Int.gcd_dvd_iff.mpr ⟨a, b, hab.symm⟩
    simpa [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast] using Nat.dvd_one.mp hdiv

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.prime_dvd_mul_iff
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_mul_iff {p m n : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    p ∣ m * n ↔ p ∣ m ∨ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  exact hp.dvd_mul

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_prime_dvd_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem exists_prime_dvd_of_one_lt {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hn.ne'

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.congruent_iff_modEq
statement: theorem congruent_iff_modEq (n a b : ℕ) : Congruent n a b ↔ a ≡ b [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.modEq_iff_zmod_eq
statement:
theorem modEq_iff_zmod_eq (n a b : ℕ) :
    a ≡ b [MOD n] ↔ (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff a b n).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.modEq_add_mul_pow
statement:
theorem modEq_add_mul_pow {n a b c d k : ℕ} (hab : a ≡ b [MOD n])
    (hcd : c ≡ d [MOD n]) :
    a + c ≡ b + d [MOD n] ∧ a * c ≡ b * d [MOD n] ∧ a ^ k ≡ b ^ k [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hab.add hcd, hab.mul hcd, hab.pow k⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.congruent_add_mul_pow
statement:
theorem congruent_add_mul_pow {n a b c d k : ℕ} (hab : Congruent n a b)
    (hcd : Congruent n c d) :
    Congruent n (a + c) (b + d) ∧ Congruent n (a * c) (b * d) ∧
      Congruent n (a ^ k) (b ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [congruent_iff_modEq] at hab hcd
  exact ⟨hab.add hcd, hab.mul hcd, hab.pow k⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.chinese_remainder_exists
statement:
theorem chinese_remainder_exists {m n a b : ℕ} (h : m.Coprime n) :
    ∃ x : ℕ, x ≡ a [MOD m] ∧ x ≡ b [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨Nat.chineseRemainder h a b, (Nat.chineseRemainder h a b).property⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.chinese_remainder_exists_congruent
statement:
theorem chinese_remainder_exists_congruent {m n a b : ℕ} (h : m.Coprime n) :
    ∃ x : ℕ, Congruent m x a ∧ Congruent n x b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxa, hxb⟩ := chinese_remainder_exists h
  exact ⟨x, (congruent_iff_modEq _ _ _).2 hxa, (congruent_iff_modEq _ _ _).2 hxb⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.eulerTotient_eq_natTotient
statement: theorem eulerTotient_eq_natTotient (n : ℕ) : EulerTotient n = n.totient
proof:
:= by
  simp [EulerTotient, Nat.totient, Nat.coprime_comm]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.reduced_residue_card
statement:
theorem reduced_residue_card (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    Fintype.card (ZMod n)ˣ = n.totient
proof:
:= by
  exact ZMod.card_units_eq_totient n

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.reduced_residue_card_eulerTotient
statement:
theorem reduced_residue_card_eulerTotient (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    Fintype.card (ZMod n)ˣ = EulerTotient n
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerTotient_eq_natTotient]
  exact reduced_residue_card n

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.euler_theorem
statement:
theorem euler_theorem {a n : ℕ} (h : a.Coprime n) :
    a ^ n.totient ≡ 1 [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.ModEq.pow_totient h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.euler_theorem_congruent
statement:
theorem euler_theorem_congruent {a n : ℕ} (h : a.Coprime n) :
    Congruent n (a ^ EulerTotient n) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerTotient_eq_natTotient, congruent_iff_modEq]
  exact euler_theorem h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.fermat_little_theorem_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem fermat_little_theorem_of_not_dvd {a p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpa : ¬p ∣ a) :
    a ^ (p - 1) ≡ 1 [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : a.Coprime p := Nat.coprime_comm.mp (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hpa)
  simpa [Nat.totient_prime hp] using euler_theorem hcop

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.fermat_little_theorem
statement:
theorem fermat_little_theorem (a : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    a ^ p ≡ a [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpa : p ∣ a
  · have ha0 : a ≡ 0 [MOD p] := Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr hpa
    have h0a : 0 ^ p ≡ a [MOD p] := by
      simpa [zero_pow hp.ne_zero] using ha0.symm
    exact (ha0.pow p).trans h0a
  · have h := (fermat_little_theorem_of_not_dvd hp hpa).mul_right a
    simpa [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.one_le] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pythagorean_parameters_form_triple
statement:
theorem pythagorean_parameters_form_triple (m n : ℤ) :
    IsPythagoreanTriple (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) (2 * m * n) (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsPythagoreanTriple
  ring

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primitivePythagorean_classification
statement:
theorem primitivePythagorean_classification {x y z : ℤ}
    (h : IsPrimitivePythagoreanTriple x y z) (hx : x % 2 = 1) (hz : 0 < z) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ,
      x = m ^ 2 - n ^ 2 ∧
        y = 2 * m * n ∧
          z = m ^ 2 + n ^ 2 ∧
            Int.gcd m n = 1 ∧
              (m % 2 = 0 ∧ n % 2 = 1 ∨ m % 2 = 1 ∧ n % 2 = 0) ∧ 0 ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨htrip, hgcd⟩
  have hmathlib : PythagoreanTriple x y z := by
    simpa [IsPythagoreanTriple, PythagoreanTriple, pow_two] using htrip
  exact hmathlib.coprime_classification' hgcd hx hz

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.pythagorean_classification
statement:
theorem pythagorean_classification {x y z : ℤ} :
    IsPythagoreanTriple x y z ↔
      ∃ k m n : ℤ,
        (x = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) ∧ y = k * (2 * m * n) ∨
            x = k * (2 * m * n) ∧ y = k * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2)) ∧
          (z = k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) ∨ z = -k * (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsPythagoreanTriple, PythagoreanTriple, pow_two] using
    (PythagoreanTriple.classification (x := x) (y := y) (z := z))

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.prime_iff_passesTrialDivision
statement:
theorem prime_iff_passesTrialDivision (n : ℕ) :
    n.Prime ↔ PassesTrialDivision n
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.prime_def_le_sqrt

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primeTest_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem primeTest_eq_true_iff (n : ℕ) :
    primeTest n = true ↔ PassesTrialDivision n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prime_iff_passesTrialDivision]
  simp [primeTest]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primeTest_eq_false_iff
statement:
theorem primeTest_eq_false_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    primeTest n = false ↔ ∃ d : ℕ, d ∣ n ∧ 2 ≤ d ∧ d < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [show primeTest n = false ↔ ¬n.Prime by simp [primeTest]]
  exact Nat.not_prime_iff_exists_dvd_lt hn

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primeTest_97
statement: theorem primeTest_97 : primeTest 97 = true
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [primeTest]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.primeTest_221
statement: theorem primeTest_221 : primeTest 221 = false ∧ 13 ∣ 221
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [primeTest]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.euclid_prime_above
statement:
theorem euclid_prime_above (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, n < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n.factorial + 1
proof:
:= by
  let p := (n.factorial + 1).minFac
  have hfactorial : n.factorial + 1 ≠ 1 := by
    exact ne_of_gt (Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.factorial_pos n))
  have hp : p.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime hfactorial
  have hpdiv : p ∣ n.factorial + 1 := Nat.minFac_dvd _
  have hnp : n < p := by
    by_contra h
    have hp_factorial : p ∣ n.factorial := hp.dvd_factorial.mpr (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)
    have hp_one : p ∣ 1 := (Nat.dvd_add_iff_right hp_factorial).mpr hpdiv
    exact hp.not_dvd_one hp_one
  exact ⟨p, hnp, hp, hpdiv⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.euclid_trialDivision_above
statement:
theorem euclid_trialDivision_above (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, n < p ∧ PassesTrialDivision p ∧ p ∣ n.factorial + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hnp, hp, hpdiv⟩ := euclid_prime_above n
  exact ⟨p, hnp, (prime_iff_passesTrialDivision p).1 hp, hpdiv⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.infinitely_many_primes
statement: theorem infinitely_many_primes : Set.Infinite {p : ℕ | p.Prime}
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.infinite_of_not_bddAbove
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hnp, hp, -⟩ := euclid_prime_above n
  exact (not_le_of_gt hnp) (hn hp)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.infinitely_many_trialDivision_primes
statement:
theorem infinitely_many_trialDivision_primes :
    Set.Infinite {p : ℕ | PassesTrialDivision p}
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.infinite_of_not_bddAbove
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hnp, hp, -⟩ := euclid_trialDivision_above n
  exact (not_le_of_gt hnp) (hn hp)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_int_nums
statement:
theorem exists_int_nums (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (GenContFract.of ξ).nums n = (z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, bb, h⟩ := exists_int_contsAux ξ (n + 1)
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rw [GenContFract.num_eq_conts_a, GenContFract.nth_cont_eq_succ_nth_contAux, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_int_dens
statement:
theorem exists_int_dens (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n = (z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, bb, h⟩ := exists_int_contsAux ξ (n + 1)
  refine ⟨bb, ?_⟩
  rw [GenContFract.den_eq_conts_b, GenContFract.nth_cont_eq_succ_nth_contAux, h]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.of_irrational_not_terminatedAt
statement:
theorem of_irrational_not_terminatedAt {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    ¬(GenContFract.of ξ).TerminatedAt n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := GenContFract.of_correctness_of_terminates (v := ξ) ⟨n, h⟩
  refine hξ ⟨ξ.convergent m, ?_⟩
  rw [Real.convs_eq_convergent] at hm
  exact hm.symm

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.dens_pos
statement:
theorem dens_pos {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ℝ) ≤ (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n := by
    rcases n with _ | n
    · exact GenContFract.succ_nth_fib_le_of_nth_den (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact GenContFract.succ_nth_fib_le_of_nth_den (Or.inr (of_irrational_not_terminatedAt hξ n))
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.fib_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n)
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.dens_add_two
statement:
theorem dens_add_two (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {gp : GenContFract.Pair ℝ}
    (h : (GenContFract.of ξ).s.get? (n + 1) = some gp) :
    (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 2) =
      gp.b * (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) + (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := GenContFract.contsAux_recurrence (g := GenContFract.of ξ) h rfl rfl
  have hpa : gp.a = 1 :=
    GenContFract.of_partNum_eq_one (GenContFract.partNum_eq_s_a h)
  simp only [GenContFract.den_eq_conts_b, GenContFract.nth_cont_eq_succ_nth_contAux]
  rw [hrec, hpa]
  simp

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.dens_lt_dens_succ
statement:
theorem dens_lt_dens_succ {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : Irrational ξ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n < (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨gp, hgp⟩ : ∃ gp, (GenContFract.of ξ).s.get? (m + 1) = some gp := by
    have h : ¬(GenContFract.of ξ).TerminatedAt (m + 1) :=
      of_irrational_not_terminatedAt hξ (m + 1)
    rw [GenContFract.terminatedAt_iff_s_none] at h
    exact Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp h
  have hpart : (GenContFract.of ξ).partDens.get? (m + 1) = some gp.b := by
    simp [GenContFract.partDens, hgp]
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ gp.b := GenContFract.of_one_le_get?_partDen hpart
  rw [dens_add_two ξ m hgp]
  have h1 : (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (m + 1) ≤ gp.b * (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (m + 1) := by
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (le_of_lt (dens_pos hξ (m + 1)))
  linarith [dens_pos hξ m]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.nums_eq_continuantNumerator
statement:
theorem nums_eq_continuantNumerator (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (GenContFract.of ξ).nums n = (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (exists_int_nums ξ n).choose_spec

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.dens_eq_continuantDenominator
statement:
theorem dens_eq_continuantDenominator (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n = (continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (exists_int_dens ξ n).choose_spec

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.continuant_determinant
statement:
theorem continuant_determinant (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    continuantNumerator ξ n * continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1)
      - continuantDenominator ξ n * continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (GenContFract.of ξ).nums n * (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1)
      - (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * (GenContFract.of ξ).nums (n + 1) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) :=
    SimpContFract.determinant (s := SimpContFract.of ξ) (n := n)
      (of_irrational_not_terminatedAt hξ n)
  rw [nums_eq_continuantNumerator, dens_eq_continuantDenominator,
    nums_eq_continuantNumerator, dens_eq_continuantDenominator] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.exists_stream_fr_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_stream_fr_ne_zero (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ ifp : GenContFract.IntFractPair ℝ,
      GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream ξ n = some ifp ∧ ifp.fr ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream ξ (n + 1) ≠ none := by
    have h' := of_irrational_not_terminatedAt hξ n
    rwa [GenContFract.of_terminatedAt_n_iff_succ_nth_intFractPair_stream_eq_none] at h'
  obtain ⟨ifp, hifp⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp h
  obtain ⟨ifp_n, hstream, hfr, -⟩ :=
    GenContFract.IntFractPair.succ_nth_stream_eq_some_iff.mp hifp
  exact ⟨ifp_n, hstream, hfr⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.sub_convs_eq_neg_one_pow_div
statement:
theorem sub_convs_eq_neg_one_pow_div (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).convs n = (-1) ^ n / D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ifp, hstream, hfr⟩ := exists_stream_fr_ne_zero ξ hξ n
  refine ⟨((GenContFract.of ξ).contsAux (n + 1)).b *
    (ifp.fr⁻¹ * ((GenContFract.of ξ).contsAux (n + 1)).b +
      ((GenContFract.of ξ).contsAux n).b), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hB : 0 < ((GenContFract.of ξ).contsAux (n + 1)).b := by
      have hBeq : ((GenContFract.of ξ).contsAux (n + 1)).b = (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n := by
        rw [← GenContFract.nth_cont_eq_succ_nth_contAux, ← GenContFract.den_eq_conts_b]
      rw [hBeq]
      exact dens_pos hξ n
    have hfr0 : 0 < ifp.fr :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (GenContFract.IntFractPair.nth_stream_fr_nonneg hstream) (Ne.symm hfr)
    have hpB : 0 ≤ ((GenContFract.of ξ).contsAux n).b := GenContFract.zero_le_of_contsAux_b
    positivity
  · rw [GenContFract.sub_convs_eq hstream, if_neg hfr]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.delta_mul_delta_succ_neg
statement:
theorem delta_mul_delta_succ_neg (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).nums n) *
      ((GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) * ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).nums (n + 1)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, h₁⟩ := sub_convs_eq_neg_one_pow_div ξ hξ n
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂, h₂⟩ := sub_convs_eq_neg_one_pow_div ξ hξ (n + 1)
  have e₁ : (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).nums n
      = (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * (ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).convs n) := by
    rw [GenContFract.conv_eq_num_div_den]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (dens_pos hξ n)]
  have e₂ : (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) * ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).nums (n + 1)
      = (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) * (ξ - (GenContFract.of ξ).convs (n + 1)) := by
    rw [GenContFract.conv_eq_num_div_den]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (dens_pos hξ (n + 1))]
  rw [e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂]
  have hQ₁ : 0 < (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n := dens_pos hξ n
  have hQ₂ : 0 < (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) := dens_pos hξ (n + 1)
  have hnum : (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) *
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (-1) ^ (n + 1)) < 0 := by
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | h
    · rw [h.neg_one_pow, h.add_one.neg_one_pow]
      nlinarith
    · rw [h.neg_one_pow, h.add_one.neg_one_pow]
      nlinarith
  have key : (GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ n / D₁) *
      ((GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) / D₂))
      = ((GenContFract.of ξ).dens n * (GenContFract.of ξ).dens (n + 1) *
          ((-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (-1) ^ (n + 1))) / (D₁ * D₂) := by
    field_simp
  rw [key]
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hnum (mul_pos hD₁ hD₂)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.convergent_cast_eq
statement:
theorem convergent_cast_eq (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((continuedFractionConvergent ξ n : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ) / (continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change ((Real.convergent ξ n : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
  rw [← Real.convs_eq_convergent, GenContFract.conv_eq_num_div_den,
    nums_eq_continuantNumerator, dens_eq_continuantDenominator]

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.convergent_den_le_continuantDenominator
statement:
theorem convergent_den_le_continuantDenominator (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((continuedFractionConvergent ξ n).den : ℤ) ≤ continuantDenominator ξ n
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < continuantDenominator ξ n := by
    rw [← Int.cast_pos (R := ℝ), ← dens_eq_continuantDenominator]
    exact dens_pos hξ n
  have hq : continuedFractionConvergent ξ n
      = Rat.divInt (continuantNumerator ξ n) (continuantDenominator ξ n) := by
    apply Rat.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
    rw [Rat.cast_divInt, convergent_cast_eq]
  rw [hq]
  exact Int.le_of_dvd hpos (Rat.den_dvd _ _)

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.abs_sub_convergent_le_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem abs_sub_convergent_le_of_decomposition (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Irrational ξ) (n : ℕ)
    {p q a b : ℤ}
    (hp : (p : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) * (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)
      + (b : ℝ) * (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))
    (hq : (q : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) * (continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ)
      + (b : ℝ) * (continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))
    (hq0 : 0 < (q : ℝ))
    (hqlt : (q : ℝ) < (continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ)) :
    |(continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)| ≤
      |(q : ℝ) * ξ - (p : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)) *
      ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
        (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ)) < 0 := by
    have h := delta_mul_delta_succ_neg ξ hξ n
    rwa [dens_eq_continuantDenominator, nums_eq_continuantNumerator,
      dens_eq_continuantDenominator, nums_eq_continuantNumerator] at h
  have hQn : 0 < (continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) := by
    rw [← dens_eq_continuantDenominator]; exact dens_pos hξ n
  have hQn1 : 0 < (continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← dens_eq_continuantDenominator]; exact dens_pos hξ (n + 1)
  have hdecomp : (q : ℝ) * ξ - (p : ℝ) =
      (a : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)) +
      (b : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
        (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hp, hq]; ring
  have hab : (a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    rw [not_le] at hcon
    rcases (mul_pos_iff.mp hcon) with ⟨ha0, hb0⟩ | ⟨ha0, hb0⟩
    · have haZ : (0 : ℤ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha0
      have hbZ : (0 : ℤ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb0
      have ha1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (a : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (1 : ℤ) ≤ a by omega)
      have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show (1 : ℤ) ≤ b by omega)
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (le_of_lt hQn)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (le_of_lt hQn1)
      linarith
    · have haZ : a < (0 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast ha0
      have hbZ : b < (0 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hb0
      have ha1 : (a : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show a ≤ (-1 : ℤ) by omega)
      have hb1 : (b : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show b ≤ (-1 : ℤ) by omega)
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (le_of_lt hQn)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 (le_of_lt hQn1)
      linarith
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    rw [ha] at hq
    simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_add] at hq
    have hbR0 : 0 < (b : ℝ) := by
      have h := hq0; rw [hq] at h
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_left h (le_of_lt hQn1)
    have hbR1 : (b : ℝ) < 1 := by
      have h := hqlt; rw [hq] at h
      exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ hQn1).mp (by simpa using h)
    have hbZ : (1 : ℤ) ≤ b := by
      have : (0 : ℤ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hbR0
      omega
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbZ
    linarith
  have hsign : 0 ≤ ((a : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ -
      (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ))) *
      ((b : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
        (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))) := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ ((a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) *
        (((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)) *
         ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
          (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))) :=
      mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hab (le_of_lt hδ)
    calc 0 ≤ ((a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ)) *
        (((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)) *
         ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
          (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))) := h1
      _ = ((a : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ -
            (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ))) *
          ((b : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
            (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))) := by ring
  have htri : |(a : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ -
        (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ))| ≤
      |(a : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)) +
        (b : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ) * ξ -
          (continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) : ℝ))| := by
    rw [(abs_add_eq_add_abs_iff _ _).mpr (mul_nonneg_iff.mp hsign)]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)
  have hone : |((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ))| ≤
      |(a : ℝ) * ((continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ))| := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    have ha1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(a : ℝ)| := by
      have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |a| := Int.one_le_abs ha0
      exact_mod_cast this
    calc |(continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)|
        = 1 * |(continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ - (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)| := by ring
      _ ≤ |(a : ℝ)| * |(continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) * ξ -
            (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ)| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 (abs_nonneg _)
  rw [hdecomp]
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Elementary.convergent_isBestRationalApproximation
statement:
theorem convergent_isBestRationalApproximation {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : Irrational ξ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    IsBestRationalApproximation ξ (continuedFractionConvergent ξ n)
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  set P : ℤ := continuantNumerator ξ n with hP
  set Q : ℤ := continuantDenominator ξ n with hQ
  set P' : ℤ := continuantNumerator ξ (n + 1) with hP'
  set Q' : ℤ := continuantDenominator ξ (n + 1) with hQ'
  have hQpos : 0 < (Q : ℝ) := by rw [hQ, ← dens_eq_continuantDenominator]; exact dens_pos hξ n
  have hQ'pos : 0 < (Q' : ℝ) := by
    rw [hQ', ← dens_eq_continuantDenominator]; exact dens_pos hξ (n + 1)
  have hQlt : (Q : ℝ) < (Q' : ℝ) := by
    have h := dens_lt_dens_succ hξ hn
    rwa [dens_eq_continuantDenominator, dens_eq_continuantDenominator] at h
  have hdle : (r.den : ℤ) ≤ Q :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hr) (convergent_den_le_continuantDenominator ξ hξ n)
  have hqle : (r.den : ℝ) ≤ (Q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdle
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < (r.den : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast r.den_pos
  have hqlt : (r.den : ℝ) < (Q' : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hqle hQlt
  have hdet : P * Q' - Q * P' = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [hP, hQ, hP', hQ']; exact continuant_determinant ξ hξ n
  have hDsq : (P * Q' - Q * P') * (P * Q' - Q * P') = 1 := by
    rw [hdet]
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd (n + 1) with h | h
    · rw [h.neg_one_pow]; ring
    · rw [h.neg_one_pow]; ring
  have hpZ : r.num = (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P') * P +
      (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q) * P' := by
    have h : (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P') * P +
        (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q) * P'
        = (P * Q' - Q * P') * (P * Q' - Q * P') * r.num := by ring
    rw [h, hDsq, one_mul]
  have hqZ : r.den = (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P') * Q +
      (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q) * Q' := by
    have h : (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P') * Q +
        (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q) * Q'
        = (P * Q' - Q * P') * (P * Q' - Q * P') * r.den := by ring
    rw [h, hDsq, one_mul]
  have hpR : (r.num : ℝ) =
      (((P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P') : ℤ) : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) +
      (((P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (P' : ℝ) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℝ)) hpZ
    simpa using h
  have hqR : (r.den : ℝ) =
      (((P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P') : ℤ) : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) +
      (((P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (Q' : ℝ) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℝ)) hqZ
    simpa using h
  have hcore := abs_sub_convergent_le_of_decomposition ξ hξ n
    (p := r.num) (q := r.den)
    (a := (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.num * Q' - r.den * P'))
    (b := (P * Q' - Q * P') * (r.den * P - r.num * Q))
    hpR hqR hq0 hqlt
  · have e1 : rationalApproximationError ξ (continuedFractionConvergent ξ n) =
        |(Q : ℝ) * ξ - (P : ℝ)| / (Q : ℝ) := by
      rw [rationalApproximationError, convergent_cast_eq]
      have hcast : (continuantNumerator ξ n : ℝ) = (P : ℝ) := by rw [hP]
      have hcast' : (continuantDenominator ξ n : ℝ) = (Q : ℝ) := by rw [hQ]
      rw [hcast, hcast']
      have : ξ - (P : ℝ) / (Q : ℝ) = ((Q : ℝ) * ξ - (P : ℝ)) / (Q : ℝ) := by
        field_simp
      rw [this, abs_div, abs_of_pos hQpos]
    have e2 : rationalApproximationError ξ r =
        |(r.den : ℝ) * ξ - (r.num : ℝ)| / (r.den : ℝ) := by
      rw [rationalApproximationError, Rat.cast_def]
      have : ξ - (r.num : ℝ) / (r.den : ℝ) =
          ((r.den : ℝ) * ξ - (r.num : ℝ)) / (r.den : ℝ) := by field_simp
      rw [this, abs_div, abs_of_pos hq0]
    rw [e1, e2]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hQpos hq0]
    have h1 : |(Q : ℝ) * ξ - (P : ℝ)| * (r.den : ℝ) ≤
        |(r.den : ℝ) * ξ - (r.num : ℝ)| * (r.den : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcore (le_of_lt hq0)
    have h2 : |(r.den : ℝ) * ξ - (r.num : ℝ)| * (r.den : ℝ) ≤
        |(r.den : ℝ) * ξ - (r.num : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqle (abs_nonneg _)
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.isCompl_iff_disjoint_sup_eq_top
statement:
theorem isCompl_iff_disjoint_sup_eq_top {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (p q : Submodule R M) :
    IsCompl p q ↔ Disjoint p q ∧ p ⊔ q = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompl_iff, codisjoint_iff]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.mem_sup_iff_exists_add
statement:
theorem mem_sup_iff_exists_add {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p q : Submodule R M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ p ⊔ q ↔ ∃ y ∈ p, ∃ z ∈ q, y + z = x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_sup

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.exists_add_of_isCompl
statement:
theorem exists_add_of_isCompl {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p q : Submodule R M} (h : IsCompl p q) (x : M) :
    ∃ y ∈ p, ∃ z ∈ q, y + z = x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_sup.mp (by rw [codisjoint_iff.mp h.codisjoint]; exact Submodule.mem_top)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.add_eq_add_iff_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem add_eq_add_iff_of_disjoint {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p q : Submodule R M} (h : Disjoint p q) {y y' : p} {z z' : q} :
    (y : M) + (z : M) = (y' : M) + (z' : M) ↔ y = y' ∧ z = z'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsum
    have heq : (y : M) - (y' : M) = (z' : M) - (z : M) := by
      rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, hsum, add_comm]
    have hyy' : (y : M) - (y' : M) ∈ p := p.sub_mem y.2 y'.2
    have hzz' : (y : M) - (y' : M) ∈ q := by rw [heq]; exact q.sub_mem z'.2 z.2
    have hzero : (y : M) - (y' : M) = 0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp h _ hyy' hzz'
    have h1 : y = y' := Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero)
    have h1M : (y : M) = (y' : M) := Subtype.ext_iff.mp h1
    have h2 : (y' : M) + (z : M) = (y' : M) + (z' : M) := by
      have hh := hsum
      rw [h1M] at hh
      exact hh
    exact ⟨h1, Subtype.ext (add_left_cancel h2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.decomposition_unique_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem decomposition_unique_of_disjoint {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p q : Submodule R M} (h : Disjoint p q) {x : M}
    {yz yz' : p × q} (h₁ : (yz.1 : M) + (yz.2 : M) = x)
    (h₂ : (yz'.1 : M) + (yz'.2 : M) = x) : yz = yz'
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (yz.1 : M) + (yz.2 : M) = (yz'.1 : M) + (yz'.2 : M) := h₁.trans h₂.symm
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (add_eq_add_iff_of_disjoint h).mp hsum
  exact Prod.ext h1 h2

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.isCompl_iff_existsUnique_decomposition
statement:
theorem isCompl_iff_existsUnique_decomposition {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] (p q : Submodule R M) :
    IsCompl p q ↔ ∀ x : M, ∃! yz : p × q, (yz.1 : M) + (yz.2 : M) = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hsum⟩ := exists_add_of_isCompl h x
    exact ⟨(⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩), hsum, fun yz' hyz' =>
      decomposition_unique_of_disjoint h.disjoint hyz' hsum⟩
  · intro h
    rw [isCompl_iff_disjoint_sup_eq_top]
    constructor
    · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
      intro x hx hy
      have hA : ((⟨x, hx⟩ : p) : M) + ((0 : q) : M) = x := by simp
