      have hB : ((0 : p) : M) + ((⟨x, hy⟩ : q) : M) = x := by simp
      have hEq := (h x).unique (y₁ := ((⟨x, hx⟩ : p), (0 : q)))
        (y₂ := (((0 : p), (⟨x, hy⟩ : q)))) hA hB
      simpa using congrArg (fun t : p × q => (t.1 : M)) hEq
    · rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
      intro x
      obtain ⟨yz, hyz, -⟩ := h x
      exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨yz.1, yz.1.2, yz.2, yz.2.2, hyz⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.prodEquivOfIsCompl_apply
statement:
theorem prodEquivOfIsCompl_apply {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (p q : Submodule R M) (h : IsCompl p q) (yz : p × q) :
    Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl p q h yz = (yz.1 : M) + (yz.2 : M)
proof:

  Submodule.coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl' p q h yz

theorem directSum_of_apply_same {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_toModule_lof
statement:
theorem directSum_toModule_lof {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N) (i : ι) (x : M i) :
    DirectSum.toModule R ι N φ (DirectSum.lof R ι M i x) = φ i x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof R i x

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_toModule_unique
statement:
theorem directSum_toModule_unique {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N)
    (g : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] N) (hg : ∀ (i : ι) (x : M i), g (DirectSum.lof R ι M i x) = φ i x) :
    g = DirectSum.toModule R ι N φ
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  refine DirectSum.induction_on v ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro i x
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R ι M i x, hg i x, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  · intro u v hu hv
    rw [map_add, map_add, hu, hv]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_lof_ext_iff
statement:
theorem directSum_lof_ext_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N) (g : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] N) :
    g = DirectSum.toModule R ι N φ ↔ ∀ (i : ι) (x : M i), g (DirectSum.lof R ι M i x) = φ i x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h i x => by rw [h, DirectSum.toModule_lof], fun hg => directSum_toModule_unique φ g hg⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.directSum_existsUnique_toModule
statement:
theorem directSum_existsUnique_toModule {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (φ : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃! g : (⨁ i, M i) →ₗ[R] N, ∀ (i : ι) (x : M i), g (DirectSum.lof R ι M i x) = φ i x
proof:
:=
  ⟨DirectSum.toModule R ι N φ, fun i x => DirectSum.toModule_lof R i x,
    fun g hg => (directSum_lof_ext_iff φ g).mpr hg⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.isCompl_iff_isInternal_fin_two
statement:

proof:
:= by
  have huniv : (Set.univ : Set (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.module_axioms
statement:
theorem module_axioms {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (r s : R) (x y : M) :
    r • (x + y) = r • x + r • y ∧ (r + s) • x = r • x + s • x ∧
      (r * s) • x = r • (s • x) ∧ (1 : R) • x = x ∧ (0 : R) • x = 0 ∧ r • (0 : M) = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨smul_add r x y, add_smul r s x, mul_smul r s x, one_smul R x, zero_smul R x, smul_zero r⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.submodule_closure
statement:
theorem submodule_closure {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S : Submodule R M) :
    (0 : M) ∈ S ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x + y ∈ S) ∧ (∀ (a : R) (x : M), x ∈ S → a • x ∈ S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨S.zero_mem, fun _x hx _y hy => S.add_mem hx hy, fun a _x hx => S.smul_mem a hx⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.submodule_of_closure
statement:
theorem submodule_of_closure {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {s : Set M} (h0 : (0 : M) ∈ s) (hadd : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x + y ∈ s)
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : R) (x : M), x ∈ s → a • x ∈ s) :
    ∃ S : Submodule R M, (S : Set M) = s
proof:
:=
  ⟨{ carrier := s, zero_mem' := h0, add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy => hadd x hx y hy,
     smul_mem' := fun a {x} hx => hsmul a x hx }, rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.submodule_eq_iff
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S T : Submodule R M} : S = T ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ T
proof:
:=
  SetLike.ext_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_iff {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M → N) :
    (∃ F : M →ₗ[R] N, ⇑F = f) ↔
      (∀ x y : M, f (x + y) = f x + f y) ∧ (∀ (a : R) (x : M), f (a • x) = a • f x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨F.map_add, F.map_smul⟩
  · rintro ⟨hadd, hsmul⟩
    refine ⟨LinearMap.mk (AddHom.mk f hadd) ?_, rfl⟩
    intro a x
    exact hsmul a x

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_ext_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_ext_iff {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] {F G : M →ₗ[R] N} : F = G ↔ ∀ x, F x = G x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h x => by rw [h], fun h => LinearMap.ext h⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_map_zero
statement:
theorem linearMap_map_zero {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]

proof:
:=
  F.map_zero

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_mem_ker_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_mem_ker_iff {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]

    x ∈ LinearMap.ker F ↔ F x = 0

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.linearMap_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem linearMap_mem_range_iff {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (F : M →ₗ[R] N) (y : N) :
    y ∈ LinearMap.range F ↔ ∃ x, F x = y
proof:
:=

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.isSubspace_iff_exists_submodule
statement:
theorem isSubspace_iff_exists_submodule {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
    [LinearSpace K V] (W : Set V) :
    IsSubspace K W ↔ ∃ S : Submodule K V, (S : Set V) = W
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨v0, hv0⟩, hadd, hsmul⟩
    have h0 : (0 : V) ∈ W := by
      have h : (0 : K) • v0 ∈ W := hsmul (0 : K) hv0
      simpa using h
    exact submodule_of_closure h0 (fun x hx y hy => hadd hx hy) (fun a x hx => hsmul a hx)
  · rintro ⟨S, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨0, S.zero_mem⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ hx _ hy
      exact S.add_mem hx hy
    · rintro c _ hx
      exact S.smul_mem c hx

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_submodule_self
statement:
theorem twoSidedIdealSet_iff_exists_submodule_self {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Set R) :
    AbstractAlgebra.Ring.TwoSidedIdealSet I ↔ ∃ S : Submodule R R, (S : Set R) = I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hI
    exact submodule_of_closure hI.1.1 (fun x hx y hy => hI.1.2.1 hx hy)
      (fun a x hx => by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hI.1.2.2.2 a hx)
  · rintro ⟨S, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · refine ⟨S.zero_mem, (fun {_ _} hx hy => S.add_mem hx hy), ?_,
        (fun r {_x} hx => by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using S.smul_mem r hx)⟩
      intro x hx
      simpa [neg_one_smul] using S.smul_mem (-1 : R) hx
    · refine ⟨S.zero_mem, (fun {_ _} hx hy => S.add_mem hx hy), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        simpa [neg_one_smul] using S.smul_mem (-1 : R) hx
      · intro r x hx
        have h : r • x ∈ S := S.smul_mem r hx
        rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at h

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_liftQ_mk
statement:
theorem quotient_liftQ_mk {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (p : Submodule R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (h : p ≤ LinearMap.ker f)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_liftQ_comp_mkQ

theorem quotient_liftQ_comp_mkQ {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (p : Submodule R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (h : p ≤ LinearMap.ker f) :

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_liftQ_exists_unique
statement:
theorem quotient_liftQ_exists_unique {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (p : Submodule R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (∃! g : M ⧸ p →ₗ[R] N, g.comp p.mkQ = f) ↔ p ≤ LinearMap.ker f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, _⟩ x hx
    have h0 : p.mkQ x = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact hx
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← LinearMap.congr_fun hg x]
    simp [h0]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨p.liftQ f h, Submodule.liftQ_mkQ p f h, ?_⟩
    intro g hg
    exact Submodule.linearMap_qext p (hg.trans (Submodule.liftQ_mkQ p f h).symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_liftQ_unique
statement:
theorem quotient_liftQ_unique {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (p : Submodule R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (h : p ≤ LinearMap.ker f)
    {g : M ⧸ p →ₗ[R] N} (hg : g.comp p.mkQ = f) : g = p.liftQ f h
proof:
:=
  Submodule.linearMap_qext p (hg.trans (Submodule.liftQ_mkQ p f h).symm)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_hom_ext
proof:
:=
  Submodule.quot_hom_ext p g₁ g₂ h

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_factor_mkQ
statement:
theorem quotient_factor_mkQ {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p p' : Submodule R M} (h : p ≤ p') (x : M) :
    Submodule.factor h (p.mkQ x) = p'.mkQ x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.factor_mk h x

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_factor_surjective
statement:
theorem quotient_factor_surjective {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p p' : Submodule R M} (h : p ≤ p') : Function.Surjective (Submodule.factor h)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.factor_surjective h

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_subsingleton_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_subsingleton_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p : Submodule R M} : Subsingleton (M ⧸ p) ↔ p = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.quotient_nontrivial_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_nontrivial_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {p : Submodule R M} : Nontrivial (M ⧸ p) ↔ p ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.subset_span
statement:
theorem subset_span {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {s : Set M} : s ⊆ Submodule.span R s
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.mem_span_iff
statement:
theorem mem_span_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (s : Set M) (x : M) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span R s ↔ ∀ p : Submodule R M, s ⊆ p → x ∈ p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_span

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_le_iff_subset
statement:
theorem span_le_iff_subset {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (s : Set M) (p : Submodule R M) :
    Submodule.span R s ≤ p ↔ s ⊆ p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_eq_iff_subset_and_le
statement:
theorem span_eq_iff_subset_and_le {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (s : Set M) (p : Submodule R M) :
    Submodule.span R s = p ↔ s ⊆ p ∧ ∀ q : Submodule R M, s ⊆ q → p ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    subst h
    exact ⟨subset_span, fun q hq => (span_le_iff_subset s q).mpr hq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hsp, hleast⟩
    exact le_antisymm ((span_le_iff_subset s p).mpr hsp) (hleast _ subset_span)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_eq_sInf
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_induction
statement:
theorem span_induction {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {s : Set M} {P : M → Prop}
    (mem : ∀ x ∈ s, P x) (zero : P 0) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (smul : ∀ (a : R) x, P x → P (a • x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span R s, P x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact Submodule.span_induction (fun x hx => mem x hx) zero
    (fun x y _ _ hx hy => add x y hx hy) (fun a x _ hx => smul a x hx) hx

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_mono
statement:
theorem span_mono {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {s t : Set M} (h : s ⊆ t) : Submodule.span R s ≤ Submodule.span R t
proof:
:=
  (span_le_iff_subset s (Submodule.span R t)).mpr (Set.Subset.trans h subset_span)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_eq_of_submodule
statement:
theorem span_eq_of_submodule {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (p : Submodule R M) : Submodule.span R (p : Set M) = p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_eq p

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_span
statement:
theorem span_span {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (s : Set M) :
    Submodule.span R (Submodule.span R s : Set M) = Submodule.span R s
proof:
:=
  span_eq_of_submodule (Submodule.span R s)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_empty
statement:
theorem span_empty {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Submodule.span R (∅ : Set M) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.empty_subset _)) bot_le

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_univ
statement:
theorem span_univ {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Submodule.span R (Set.univ : Set M) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr fun x => subset_span (Set.mem_univ x)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_union
statement:
theorem span_union {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (s t : Set M) :
    Submodule.span R (s ∪ t) = Submodule.span R s ⊔ Submodule.span R t
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact (le_sup_left : Submodule.span R s ≤ Submodule.span R s ⊔ Submodule.span R t)
        (Submodule.subset_span hx)
    · exact (le_sup_right : Submodule.span R t ≤ Submodule.span R s ⊔ Submodule.span R t)
        (Submodule.subset_span hx)
  · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
    · exact Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.Subset.trans Set.subset_union_left Submodule.subset_span)
    · exact Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.Subset.trans Set.subset_union_right Submodule.subset_span)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.span_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem span_eq_bot_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {s : Set M} : Submodule.span R s = ⊥ ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h x hx => by
      have hx' : x ∈ Submodule.span R s := subset_span hx
      rw [h] at hx'
      exact hx',
    fun h => le_antisymm
      ((span_le_iff_subset s ⊥).mpr fun x hx => (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr (h x hx)) bot_le⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.mem_span_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem mem_span_singleton_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (x y : M) : x ∈ R ∙ y ↔ ∃ a : R, a • y = x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_span_singleton

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.map_span
statement:
theorem map_span {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (F : M →ₗ[R] N) (s : Set M) :
    Submodule.map F (Submodule.span R s) = Submodule.span R (F '' s)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Submodule.subset_span hx)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.firstIsoHom_mk
statement:
theorem firstIsoHom_mk {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M) :
    firstIsoHom f (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = ⟨f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Submodule.liftQ_apply (LinearMap.ker f) f x)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.firstIsoHom_ker
statement:
theorem firstIsoHom_ker {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : LinearMap.ker (firstIsoHom f) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  revert hx
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on (LinearMap.ker f) x fun m hx => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, firstIsoHom_mk] at hx
  have hm : f m = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hx
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hm

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.firstIsoHom_injective
statement:
theorem firstIsoHom_injective {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : Function.Injective (firstIsoHom f)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (firstIsoHom_ker f)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.firstIsoHom_surjective
statement:
theorem firstIsoHom_surjective {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : Function.Surjective (firstIsoHom f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk x, Subtype.ext rfl⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.first_iso_mk
statement:
theorem first_iso_mk {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M) :
    (first_iso f (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) : N) = f x
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (firstIsoHom_mk f x)

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.secondIsoHom_ker
statement:
theorem secondIsoHom_ker {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S T : Submodule R M) :
    LinearMap.ker (secondIsoHom S T) = Submodule.comap S.subtype T
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, secondIsoHom, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_inclusion,
    Submodule.subtype_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.second_iso_mem_comap_iff
statement:
theorem second_iso_mem_comap_iff {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S T : Submodule R M) (x : ↥S) :
    x ∈ Submodule.comap S.subtype T ↔ (x : M) ∈ S ⊓ T
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.mem_inf]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨x.2, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.secondIsoMap_ker
statement:
theorem secondIsoMap_ker {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S T : Submodule R M) : LinearMap.ker (secondIsoMap S T) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot (Submodule.comap S.subtype T) (secondIsoHom S T) _
    (le_of_eq (secondIsoHom_ker S T))

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.secondIsoMap_surjective
statement:
theorem secondIsoMap_surjective {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S T : Submodule R M) : Function.Surjective (secondIsoMap S T)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on (Submodule.comap (S ⊔ T).subtype T) y ?_
  intro x
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hst⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp x.2
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨s, hs⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [secondIsoMap, Submodule.liftQ_apply, secondIsoHom, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.inclusion_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.coe_sub]
  have hx : (x : M) = s + t := hst.symm
  rw [hx]
  have hsub : s - (s + t) = -t := by abel
  rw [hsub]
  exact Submodule.neg_mem _ ht

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.second_iso_mk
statement:
theorem second_iso_mk {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (S T : Submodule R M) (x : ↥S) :
    second_iso S T (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (Submodule.inclusion le_sup_left x)
proof:
:= by
  change secondIsoMap S T (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = _
  rw [secondIsoMap, Submodule.liftQ_apply, secondIsoHom, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Submodule.mkQ_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.factor_ker
statement:
theorem factor_ker {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S T : Submodule R M} (h : S ≤ T) :
    LinearMap.ker (Submodule.factor h) = T.map S.mkQ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on S x fun m => ?_
  change (Submodule.factor h) (S.mkQ m) = 0 ↔ S.mkQ m ∈ T.map S.mkQ
  rw [Submodule.factor_mk, Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · intro hm
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hm
    exact ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, htm⟩
    have h1 : t - m ∈ S := (Submodule.Quotient.eq S).mp htm
    have h2 : t - m ∈ T := h h1
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    have hm : m = t - (t - m) := by abel
    rw [hm]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem T ht h2

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.thirdIsoMap_ker
statement:
theorem thirdIsoMap_ker {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S T : Submodule R M} (h : S ≤ T) : LinearMap.ker (thirdIsoMap h) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot (T.map S.mkQ) (Submodule.factor h) _ (le_of_eq (factor_ker h))

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.thirdIsoMap_surjective
statement:
theorem thirdIsoMap_surjective {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S T : Submodule R M} (h : S ≤ T) : Function.Surjective (thirdIsoMap h)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on T y fun m => ?_
  exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (S.mkQ m), by
    rw [thirdIsoMap, Submodule.liftQ_apply, Submodule.factor_mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply]⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.CommutativeAlgebra.Module.third_iso_mk_mk
statement:
theorem third_iso_mk_mk {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S T : Submodule R M} (h : S ≤ T) (x : M) :
    third_iso h (Submodule.Quotient.mk (S.mkQ x)) = Submodule.Quotient.mk x
proof:
:= by
  change thirdIsoMap h (Submodule.Quotient.mk (S.mkQ x)) = Submodule.Quotient.mk x
  rw [thirdIsoMap, Submodule.liftQ_apply, Submodule.factor_mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.SourceSplit.indP_injective
statement:
theorem SourceSplit.indP_injective {a : ℕ → ℝ} (S : SourceSplit a) :
    Function.Injective S.indP
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Sum.inl.inj
  exact S.equiv.injective hij

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.SourceSplit.indQ_injective
statement:
theorem SourceSplit.indQ_injective {a : ℕ → ℝ} (S : SourceSplit a) :
    Function.Injective S.indQ
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Sum.inr.inj
  exact S.equiv.injective hij

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.BlockEnds.posCount_strictMono
statement: theorem BlockEnds.posCount_strictMono (E : BlockEnds) : StrictMono E.posCount
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      have h := E.neg_before_pos 0
      rw [E.nblock_zero, E.pblock_eq 0, E.negCount_zero] at h
      simpa [E.posCount_zero] using h
  | succ n =>
      have h := E.neg_before_pos (n + 1)
      rw [E.nblock_eq n, E.pblock_eq (n + 1)] at h
      omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.BlockEnds.negCount_strictMono
statement: theorem BlockEnds.negCount_strictMono (E : BlockEnds) : StrictMono E.negCount
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  have h := E.pos_before_neg n
  rw [E.pblock_eq n, E.nblock_eq n] at h
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.BlockEnds.nblock_strictMono
statement: theorem BlockEnds.nblock_strictMono (E : BlockEnds) : StrictMono E.nblock
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  exact lt_trans (E.neg_before_pos n) (E.pos_before_neg n)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.BlockEnds.pblock_strictMono
statement: theorem BlockEnds.pblock_strictMono (E : BlockEnds) : StrictMono E.pblock
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      have h := E.neg_before_pos 0
      rw [E.nblock_zero] at h
      simpa [E.pblock_zero] using h
  | succ n =>
      exact lt_trans (E.pos_before_neg n) (E.neg_before_pos (n + 1))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.not_negBlock_of_posBlock
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨l, hleft, hright⟩
  rcases le_total l k with hlk | hkl
  · by_cases heq : l = k
    · subst l
      omega
    · have hlt : l + 1 ≤ k := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hlk heq)
      have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono.monotone hlt
      exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hright.trans hmono)) hpos.1
  · by_cases heq : k = l
    · subst l
      omega
    · have hlt : k + 1 ≤ l := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hkl heq)
      have hmono := E.pblock_strictMono.monotone hlt
      have hstep := E.pblock_strictMono.monotone (Nat.le_succ l)
      exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hpos.2.trans (hmono.trans hstep))) hleft

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.nblock_add_posBlockLength
statement:
theorem nblock_add_posBlockLength (E : BlockEnds) (k : ℕ) :
    E.nblock k + (E.posCount (k + 1) - E.posCount k) = E.pblock (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [E.nblock_zero, E.posCount_zero, E.pblock_eq 0, E.negCount_zero]
      omega
  | succ k =>
      have hk : k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 := by omega
      rw [E.nblock_eq k, E.pblock_eq (k + 1), hk]
      have h : E.posCount (k + 1) < E.posCount (k + 2) :=
        E.posCount_strictMono (by omega)
      omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.pblock_add_negBlockLength
statement:
theorem pblock_add_negBlockLength (E : BlockEnds) (k : ℕ) :
    E.pblock (k + 1) + (E.negCount (k + 1) - E.negCount k) = E.nblock (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [E.pblock_eq k, E.nblock_eq k]
  have h : E.negCount k < E.negCount (k + 1) :=
    E.negCount_strictMono (by omega)
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.BlockEnds.posCount_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem BlockEnds.posCount_tendsto_atTop (E : BlockEnds) :
    Tendsto E.posCount atTop atTop
proof: := E.posCount_strictMono.tendsto_atTop

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.BlockEnds.negCount_tendsto_atTop
statement:
theorem BlockEnds.negCount_tendsto_atTop (E : BlockEnds) :
    Tendsto E.negCount atTop atTop
proof: := E.negCount_strictMono.tendsto_atTop

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.exists_posCount_block
statement:
theorem exists_posCount_block (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ k, j < E.posCount (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp E.posCount_tendsto_atTop (j + 1) with ⟨k, hk⟩
  exact ⟨k, lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self j) (hk (k + 1) (Nat.le_succ k))⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.exists_negCount_block
statement:
theorem exists_negCount_block (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ k, j < E.negCount (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp E.negCount_tendsto_atTop (j + 1) with ⟨k, hk⟩
  exact ⟨k, lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self j) (hk (k + 1) (Nat.le_succ k))⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.posTagBlock_spec
statement:
theorem posTagBlock_spec (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    j < E.posCount (posTagBlock E j + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_spec (exists_posCount_block E j)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.negTagBlock_spec
statement:
theorem negTagBlock_spec (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    j < E.negCount (negTagBlock E j + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_spec (exists_negCount_block E j)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.posCount_le_posTagBlock
statement:
theorem posCount_le_posTagBlock (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    E.posCount (posTagBlock E j) ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 < posTagBlock E j := by
    by_contra hz
    simp only [Nat.not_lt, Nat.le_zero] at hz
    rw [hz, E.posCount_zero] at h
    omega
  have hlt : posTagBlock E j - 1 < posTagBlock E j := Nat.sub_lt hpos Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hmin := Nat.find_min (exists_posCount_block E j) hlt
  have hle : E.posCount (posTagBlock E j - 1 + 1) ≤ j := by
    simpa [posTagBlock] using hmin
  have heq : posTagBlock E j - 1 + 1 = posTagBlock E j := by omega
  rw [heq] at hle
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.negCount_le_negTagBlock
statement:
theorem negCount_le_negTagBlock (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    E.negCount (negTagBlock E j) ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hpos : 0 < negTagBlock E j := by
    by_contra hz
    simp only [Nat.not_lt, Nat.le_zero] at hz
    rw [hz, E.negCount_zero] at h
    omega
  have hlt : negTagBlock E j - 1 < negTagBlock E j := Nat.sub_lt hpos Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hmin := Nat.find_min (exists_negCount_block E j) hlt
  have hle : E.negCount (negTagBlock E j - 1 + 1) ≤ j := by
    simpa [negTagBlock] using hmin
  have heq : negTagBlock E j - 1 + 1 = negTagBlock E j := by omega
  rw [heq] at hle
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.posTagPreimage_mem_posBlock
statement:
theorem posTagPreimage_mem_posBlock (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    E.nblock (posTagBlock E j) < posTagPreimage E j + 1 ∧
      posTagPreimage E j + 1 ≤ E.pblock (posTagBlock E j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let k := posTagBlock E j
  have hlow : E.posCount k ≤ j := posCount_le_posTagBlock E j
  have hhigh : j < E.posCount (k + 1) := posTagBlock_spec E j
  have hlen := nblock_add_posBlockLength E k
  change E.nblock k < E.nblock k + (j - E.posCount k) + 1 ∧
    E.nblock k + (j - E.posCount k) + 1 ≤ E.pblock (k + 1)
  constructor <;> omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.negTagPreimage_mem_negBlock
statement:
theorem negTagPreimage_mem_negBlock (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    E.pblock (negTagBlock E j + 1) < negTagPreimage E j + 1 ∧
      negTagPreimage E j + 1 ≤ E.nblock (negTagBlock E j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let k := negTagBlock E j
  have hlow : E.negCount k ≤ j := negCount_le_negTagBlock E j
  have hhigh : j < E.negCount (k + 1) := negTagBlock_spec E j
  have hlen := pblock_add_negBlockLength E k
  change E.pblock (k + 1) < E.pblock (k + 1) + (j - E.negCount k) + 1 ∧
    E.pblock (k + 1) + (j - E.negCount k) + 1 ≤ E.nblock (k + 1)
  constructor <;> omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.posBlock_unique
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hkl | hlk
  · have hstep := E.pos_before_neg k
    have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono.monotone (show k + 1 ≤ l by omega)
    have : E.pblock (k + 1) < r := lt_trans hstep (lt_of_le_of_lt hmono hl.1)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hk.2) this
  · have hstep := E.pos_before_neg l
    have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono.monotone (show l + 1 ≤ k by omega)
    have : E.pblock (l + 1) < r := lt_trans hstep (lt_of_le_of_lt hmono hk.1)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hl.2) this

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.negBlock_unique
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hkl | hlk
  · have hstep : E.nblock (k + 1) < E.pblock (k + 2) := by
      simpa using E.neg_before_pos (k + 1)
    have hmono := E.pblock_strictMono.monotone (show k + 2 ≤ l + 1 by omega)
    have : E.nblock (k + 1) < r := lt_trans hstep (lt_of_le_of_lt hmono hl.1)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hk.2) this
  · have hstep : E.nblock (l + 1) < E.pblock (l + 2) := by
      simpa using E.neg_before_pos (l + 1)
    have hmono := E.pblock_strictMono.monotone (show l + 2 ≤ k + 1 by omega)
    have : E.nblock (l + 1) < r := lt_trans hstep (lt_of_le_of_lt hmono hk.1)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hl.2) this

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.posCount_interval_unique
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hkl | hlk
  · have hmono := E.posCount_strictMono.monotone (show k + 1 ≤ l by omega)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hmono.trans hl.1)) hk.2
  · have hmono := E.posCount_strictMono.monotone (show l + 1 ≤ k by omega)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hmono.trans hk.1)) hl.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.negCount_interval_unique
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hkl | hlk
  · have hmono := E.negCount_strictMono.monotone (show k + 1 ≤ l by omega)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hmono.trans hl.1)) hk.2
  · have hmono := E.negCount_strictMono.monotone (show l + 1 ≤ k by omega)
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hmono.trans hk.1)) hl.2

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_posTagPreimage
statement:
theorem blockTag_posTagPreimage (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    blockTag E (posTagPreimage E j) = Sum.inl j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let k := posTagBlock E j
  let ℓ := posTagPreimage E j
  let r := ℓ + 1
  have hmem : E.nblock k < r ∧ r ≤ E.pblock (k + 1) := by
    exact posTagPreimage_mem_posBlock E j
  have hnotneg : ¬ ∃ q, E.pblock (q + 1) < r ∧ r ≤ E.nblock (q + 1) :=
    not_negBlock_of_posBlock E hmem
  have hfind : Nat.find ((E.covers r (by omega)).resolve_right hnotneg) = k := by
    apply posBlock_unique E (Nat.find_spec ((E.covers r (by omega)).resolve_right hnotneg)) hmem
  have hlow : E.posCount k ≤ j := posCount_le_posTagBlock E j
  change blockTag E ℓ = Sum.inl j
  simp only [blockTag]
  rw [dif_neg hnotneg]
  rw [hfind]
  change Sum.inl (E.posCount k + (r - E.nblock k - 1)) = Sum.inl j
  have hoff : r - E.nblock k - 1 = j - E.posCount k := by
    dsimp [r, ℓ, posTagPreimage, k]
    omega
  rw [hoff]
  exact congrArg Sum.inl (Nat.add_sub_of_le hlow)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_negTagPreimage
statement:
theorem blockTag_negTagPreimage (E : BlockEnds) (j : ℕ) :
    blockTag E (negTagPreimage E j) = Sum.inr j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let k := negTagBlock E j
  let ℓ := negTagPreimage E j
  let r := ℓ + 1
  have hmem : E.pblock (k + 1) < r ∧ r ≤ E.nblock (k + 1) := by
    exact negTagPreimage_mem_negBlock E j
  let hExists : ∃ q, E.pblock (q + 1) < r ∧ r ≤ E.nblock (q + 1) := ⟨k, hmem⟩
  have hfind : Nat.find hExists = k := by
    apply negBlock_unique E (Nat.find_spec hExists) hmem
  have hlow : E.negCount k ≤ j := negCount_le_negTagBlock E j
  change blockTag E ℓ = Sum.inr j
  simp only [blockTag]
  rw [dif_pos ⟨k, hmem⟩]
  rw [hfind]
  change Sum.inr (E.negCount k + (r - E.pblock (k + 1) - 1)) = Sum.inr j
  have hoff : r - E.pblock (k + 1) - 1 = j - E.negCount k := by
    dsimp [r, ℓ, negTagPreimage, k]
    omega
  rw [hoff]
  exact congrArg Sum.inr (Nat.add_sub_of_le hlow)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock
statement:
theorem blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock (E : BlockEnds) {ℓ k : ℕ}
    (hmem : E.pblock (k + 1) < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.nblock (k + 1)) :
    blockTag E ℓ = Sum.inr
      (E.negCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.pblock (k + 1) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hExists : ∃ q, E.pblock (q + 1) < ℓ + 1 ∧
      ℓ + 1 ≤ E.nblock (q + 1) := ⟨k, hmem⟩
  have hfind : Nat.find hExists = k := by
    apply negBlock_unique E (Nat.find_spec hExists) hmem
  simp only [blockTag]
  rw [dif_pos ⟨k, hmem⟩]
  rw [hfind]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock
statement:
theorem blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock (E : BlockEnds) {ℓ k : ℕ}
    (hmem : E.nblock k < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.pblock (k + 1)) :
    blockTag E ℓ = Sum.inl
      (E.posCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.nblock k - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnotneg : ¬ ∃ q, E.pblock (q + 1) < ℓ + 1 ∧
      ℓ + 1 ≤ E.nblock (q + 1) := not_negBlock_of_posBlock E hmem
  have hfind : Nat.find ((E.covers (ℓ + 1) (by omega)).resolve_right hnotneg) = k := by
    apply posBlock_unique E
      (Nat.find_spec ((E.covers (ℓ + 1) (by omega)).resolve_right hnotneg)) hmem
  simp only [blockTag]
  rw [dif_neg hnotneg]
  rw [hfind]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.negTag_offset_mem_interval
statement:
theorem negTag_offset_mem_interval (E : BlockEnds) {ℓ k : ℕ}
    (hmem : E.pblock (k + 1) < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.nblock (k + 1)) :
    E.negCount k ≤ E.negCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.pblock (k + 1) - 1) ∧
      E.negCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.pblock (k + 1) - 1) < E.negCount (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := pblock_add_negBlockLength E k
  constructor
  · exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.posTag_offset_mem_interval
statement:
theorem posTag_offset_mem_interval (E : BlockEnds) {ℓ k : ℕ}
    (hmem : E.nblock k < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.pblock (k + 1)) :
    E.posCount k ≤ E.posCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.nblock k - 1) ∧
      E.posCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.nblock k - 1) < E.posCount (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := nblock_add_posBlockLength E k
  constructor
  · exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply
statement:
theorem blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply {a : ℕ → ℝ} (S : SourceSplit a)
    (E : BlockEnds) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E ℓ = S.equiv (blockTag E ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockIndex, blockTag, SourceSplit.indP, SourceSplit.indQ]
  split <;> rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockIndex_bijective_of_blockTag_bijective
statement:
theorem blockIndex_bijective_of_blockTag_bijective {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (S : SourceSplit a) (E : BlockEnds)
    (hTag : Function.Bijective (blockTag E)) :
    Function.Bijective (blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E = fun ℓ => S.equiv (blockTag E ℓ) by
    funext ℓ
    exact blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply S E ℓ]
  exact S.equiv.bijective.comp hTag

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_injective_of_block_recursion
statement:
theorem blockTag_injective_of_block_recursion (E : BlockEnds)
    : Function.Injective (blockTag E)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rcases E.covers (x + 1) (by omega) with ⟨kx, hx⟩ | ⟨kx, hx⟩
  · rcases E.covers (y + 1) (by omega) with ⟨ky, hy⟩ | ⟨ky, hy⟩
    · rw [blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock E hx,
        blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock E hy] at hxy
      have hj := Sum.inl.inj hxy
      have hyI : E.posCount ky ≤ E.posCount kx +
          (x + 1 - E.nblock kx - 1) ∧
          E.posCount kx + (x + 1 - E.nblock kx - 1) < E.posCount (ky + 1) := by
        rw [hj]
        exact posTag_offset_mem_interval E hy
      have hk := posCount_interval_unique E (posTag_offset_mem_interval E hx) hyI
      subst ky
      omega
    · rw [blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock E hx,
        blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock E hy] at hxy
      cases hxy
  · rcases E.covers (y + 1) (by omega) with ⟨ky, hy⟩ | ⟨ky, hy⟩
    · rw [blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock E hx,
        blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock E hy] at hxy
      cases hxy
    · rw [blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock E hx,
        blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock E hy] at hxy
      have hj := Sum.inr.inj hxy
      have hyI : E.negCount ky ≤ E.negCount kx +
          (x + 1 - E.pblock (kx + 1) - 1) ∧
          E.negCount kx + (x + 1 - E.pblock (kx + 1) - 1) < E.negCount (ky + 1) := by
        rw [hj]
        exact negTag_offset_mem_interval E hy
      have hk := negCount_interval_unique E (negTag_offset_mem_interval E hx) hyI
      subst ky
      omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_surjective_of_block_recursion
statement:
theorem blockTag_surjective_of_block_recursion (E : BlockEnds)
    : Function.Surjective (blockTag E)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl j => exact ⟨posTagPreimage E j, blockTag_posTagPreimage E j⟩
  | inr j => exact ⟨negTagPreimage E j, blockTag_negTagPreimage E j⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.blockTag_bijective_of_block_recursion
statement:
theorem blockTag_bijective_of_block_recursion (E : BlockEnds)
    :
    Function.Bijective (blockTag E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨blockTag_injective_of_block_recursion E,
    blockTag_surjective_of_block_recursion E⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.lowerTarget_tendsto
statement:
theorem lowerTarget_tendsto (α : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (lowerTarget α) atTop (𝓝 α)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => α - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 α)
  simpa using
    (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => α) atTop (𝓝 α)).sub
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.upperTarget_tendsto
statement:
theorem upperTarget_tendsto (β : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (upperTarget β) atTop (𝓝 β)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => β + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 β)
  simpa using
    (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => β) atTop (𝓝 β)).add
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.lowerTarget_lt_upperTarget
statement:
theorem lowerTarget_lt_upperTarget {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) (m n : ℕ) :
    lowerTarget α m < upperTarget β n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [lowerTarget, upperTarget]
  have hm : 0 < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hn : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.choose_positive_tail
proof:
:= by
  rcases tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hp (y + 1) with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨max start N, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  have := hN (max start N) (le_max_right _ _)
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.firstPositiveCrossing_spec
statement:
theorem firstPositiveCrossing_spec {p : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hp : Tendsto (partialSum p) atTop atTop) (start : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    start ≤ firstPositiveCrossing p hp start y ∧
      y < partialSum p (firstPositiveCrossing p hp start y)
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_spec (choose_positive_tail hp start y)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.choose_negative_tail
proof:
:=
  choose_positive_tail hq start y

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.firstNegativeCrossing_spec
statement:
theorem firstNegativeCrossing_spec {q : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hq : Tendsto (partialSum q) atTop atTop) (start : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    start ≤ firstNegativeCrossing q hq start y ∧
      y < partialSum q (firstNegativeCrossing q hq start y)
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_spec (choose_negative_tail hq start y)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudinPosCount_succ
statement:
theorem rudinPosCount_succ (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop)
    (α β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1) =
      firstPositiveCrossing P hP (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β n + 1)
        (upperTarget β n + partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n))
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudinNegCount_succ
statement:
theorem rudinNegCount_succ (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop)
    (α β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1) =
      firstNegativeCrossing Q hQ (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n + 1)
        (partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) - lowerTarget α n)
proof: := rfl

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_upper_endpoint_crosses
statement:
theorem rudin_upper_endpoint_crosses (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop)
    (α β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    upperTarget β n <
      partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) -
        partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rudinPosCount_succ]
  have h := (firstPositiveCrossing_spec hP
    (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β n + 1)
    (upperTarget β n + partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n))).2
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_lower_endpoint_crosses
statement:
theorem rudin_lower_endpoint_crosses (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop)
    (α β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) -
      partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) < lowerTarget α n
proof:
:= by
  rw [rudinNegCount_succ]
  have h := (firstNegativeCrossing_spec hQ
    (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n + 1)
    (partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) - lowerTarget α n)).2
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_positive_start_le_succ
statement:
theorem rudin_positive_start_le_succ (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) (n : ℕ) :
    partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) ≤
      upperTarget β (n + 1) + partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := rudin_lower_endpoint_crosses P Q hP hQ α β n
  linarith [lowerTarget_lt_upperTarget hαβ n (n + 1)]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_negative_start_le
statement:
theorem rudin_negative_start_le (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) (n : ℕ) :
    partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n) ≤
      partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) - lowerTarget α n
proof:
:= by
  have hupp := rudin_upper_endpoint_crosses P Q hP hQ α β n
  linarith [lowerTarget_lt_upperTarget hαβ n n]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudinPosCount_succ_lt
statement:
theorem rudinPosCount_succ_lt (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) (α β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1) <
      rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rudinPosCount_succ P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)]
  have h := (firstPositiveCrossing_spec hP
    (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1) + 1)
    (upperTarget β (n + 1) + partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)))).1
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudinNegCount_succ_lt
statement:
theorem rudinNegCount_succ_lt (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) (α β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n <
      rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rudinNegCount_succ]
  have h := (firstNegativeCrossing_spec hQ
    (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β n + 1)
    (partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) - lowerTarget α n)).1
  omega

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudinPosCount_strictMono
statement:
theorem rudinPosCount_strictMono (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) (α β : ℝ) :
    StrictMono (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      change 0 < firstPositiveCrossing P hP 1 (upperTarget β 0 + partialSum Q 0)
      have h := (firstPositiveCrossing_spec hP 1
        (upperTarget β 0 + partialSum Q 0)).1
      omega
  | succ n => exact rudinPosCount_succ_lt P Q hP hQ α β n

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudinNegCount_strictMono
statement:
theorem rudinNegCount_strictMono (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) (α β : ℝ) :
    StrictMono (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β)
proof:
:=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (rudinNegCount_succ_lt P Q hP hQ α β)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.firstPositiveCrossing_after_overshoot
proof:
:= by
  let m := firstPositiveCrossing p hp (prev + 1) y
  have hm : prev + 1 ≤ m := (firstPositiveCrossing_spec hp (prev + 1) y).1
  have hpred : partialSum p (m - 1) ≤ y := by
    by_cases heq : m = prev + 1
    · simpa [m, heq] using hprev
    · have hlt : m - 1 < m := by omega
      have hstart : prev + 1 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
      by_contra hnot
      have hcross : y < partialSum p (m - 1) := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hmin := Nat.find_min' (choose_positive_tail hp (prev + 1) y)
        (m := m - 1) ⟨hstart, hcross⟩
      change m ≤ m - 1 at hmin
      omega
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
  have hm_succ : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
  change partialSum p m ≤ y + p (m - 1)
  rw [hm_succ, partialSum, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  change partialSum p (m - 1) + p (m - 1) ≤ y + p (m - 1)
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.firstNegativeCrossing_after_overshoot
proof:
:= by
  exact firstPositiveCrossing_after_overshoot hq hprev

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_upper_endpoint_overshoot
statement:
theorem rudin_upper_endpoint_overshoot (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) (n : ℕ) :
    partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 2)) -
        partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) ≤
      upperTarget β (n + 1) +
        P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 2) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rudinPosCount_succ P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)]
  have hov := firstPositiveCrossing_after_overshoot hP
    (rudin_positive_start_le_succ P Q hP hQ hαβ n)
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_lower_endpoint_overshoot
statement:
theorem rudin_lower_endpoint_overshoot (P Q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum P) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum Q) atTop atTop) {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) (n : ℕ) :
    lowerTarget α n - Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1) - 1) ≤
      partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1)) -
        partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rudinNegCount_succ]
  have hov := firstNegativeCrossing_after_overshoot hQ
    (rudin_negative_start_le P Q hP hQ hαβ n)
  linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.liminf_limsup_of_endpointWitness
statement:
theorem liminf_limsup_of_endpointWitness {g : ℕ → ℝ} {α β : ℝ}
    (h : EndpointWitness g α β) :
    Filter.liminf (partialSum g) atTop = α ∧
      Filter.limsup (partialSum g) atTop = β
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hlow, ⟨u, hu, hα⟩, hupp, ⟨v, hv, hβ⟩⟩
  have hlow₁ := hlow 1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hupp₁ := hupp 1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hInfBounded : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (fun x y : ℝ => x ≥ y) atTop (partialSum g) :=
    ⟨α - 1, hlow₁⟩
  have hInfCobounded : Filter.IsCoboundedUnder (fun x y : ℝ => x ≥ y) atTop (partialSum g) :=
    Filter.isCoboundedUnder_ge_of_eventually_le atTop hupp₁
  have hSupCobounded : Filter.IsCoboundedUnder (fun x y : ℝ => x ≤ y) atTop (partialSum g) :=
    Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_eventually_le atTop hlow₁
  have hSupBounded : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (fun x y : ℝ => x ≤ y) atTop (partialSum g) :=
    ⟨β + 1, hupp₁⟩
  apply And.intro
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Filter.liminf_le_iff hInfCobounded hInfBounded]
      intro y hy
      have hev : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, partialSum g (u k) < y :=
        (tendsto_order.1 hα).2 y hy
      exact hu.tendsto_atTop.frequently hev.frequently
    · rw [Filter.le_liminf_iff hInfCobounded hInfBounded]
      intro y hy
      have hε : 0 < (α - y) / 2 := by linarith
      filter_upwards [hlow ((α - y) / 2) hε] with N hN
      linarith
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Filter.limsup_le_iff hSupCobounded hSupBounded]
      intro y hy
      have hε : 0 < (y - β) / 2 := by linarith
      filter_upwards [hupp ((y - β) / 2) hε] with N hN
      linarith
    · rw [Filter.le_limsup_iff hSupCobounded hSupBounded]
      intro y hy
      have hev : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, y < partialSum g (v k) :=
        (tendsto_order.1 hβ).1 y hy
      exact hv.tendsto_atTop.frequently hev.frequently

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.direct_block_evidence_of_rudin_hypotheses
statement:
theorem direct_block_evidence_of_rudin_hypotheses
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {α β : ℝ}
    (hαβ : α ≤ β)
    (S : SourceSplit a)
    (hPzero : Tendsto (signedPositive a S.indP) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hQzero : Tendsto (signedNegative a S.indQ) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum (signedPositive a S.indP)) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum (fun j => -signedNegative a S.indQ j)) atTop atTop) :
    DirectBlockEvidence S α β
proof:
:= by
  let P := signedPositive a S.indP
  let Q := fun j => - signedNegative a S.indQ j
  have hEnds : ∃ E : BlockEnds,
      E.posCount = rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β ∧
      E.negCount = rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β := by
    let hpstrict := rudinPosCount_strictMono P Q hP hQ α β
    let hnstrict := rudinNegCount_strictMono P Q hP hQ α β
    refine ⟨{
      posCount := rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β
      negCount := rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β
      pblock := rudinPBlock P Q hP hQ α β
      nblock := rudinNBlock P Q hP hQ α β
      posCount_zero := rfl
      negCount_zero := rfl
      pblock_zero := rfl
      nblock_zero := rfl
      neg_before_pos := ?_
      pos_before_neg := ?_
      pblock_eq := by intro k; rfl
      nblock_eq := by intro k; rfl
      covers := ?_ }, rfl, rfl⟩
    · intro k
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          change 0 < rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β 1 + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β 0
          have h := hpstrict (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)
          simp [rudinNegCount] at h ⊢
          omega
      | succ k =>
          change rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) <
            rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)
          exact Nat.add_lt_add_right (hpstrict (by omega)) _
    · intro k
      change rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β k <
        rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (hnstrict (by omega)) _
    · intro ell hell
      have hNstrict : StrictMono (fun k => rudinNBlock P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)) := by
        apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
        intro k
        change rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) <
          rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) + rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2)
        exact Nat.add_lt_add (hpstrict (by omega)) (hnstrict (by omega))
      have hexists : ∃ k, ell ≤ rudinNBlock P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) := by
        rcases tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hNstrict.tendsto_atTop ell with ⟨k, hk⟩
        exact ⟨k, hk k le_rfl⟩
      set k := Nat.find hexists with hkdef
      have hk : ell ≤ rudinNBlock P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) := Nat.find_spec hexists
      have hprev : rudinNBlock P Q hP hQ α β k < ell := by
        rw [hkdef]
        by_cases hzero : Nat.find hexists = 0
        · rw [hzero]
          change 0 < ell
          exact hell
        · have hpos : 0 < Nat.find hexists := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
          apply Nat.lt_of_not_ge
          intro hle
          have hcandidate : ell ≤ rudinNBlock P Q hP hQ α β
              ((Nat.find hexists - 1) + 1) := by
            rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hzero)]
            exact hle
          have hmin := Nat.find_min' hexists (m := Nat.find hexists - 1) hcandidate
          omega
      by_cases hpos : ell ≤ rudinPBlock P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hprev, hpos⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hpos, hk⟩
  rcases hEnds with ⟨E, hpos, hneg⟩
  have hPositiveBlockSum : ∀ k,
      ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico (E.nblock k) (E.pblock (k + 1)),
        blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E ℓ =
      partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 1)) - partialSum P (E.posCount k) := by
                                                    
                   
    intro k
    have hterm : ∀ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico (E.nblock k) (E.pblock (k + 1)),
        blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E ℓ =
          P (E.posCount k + (ℓ - E.nblock k)) := by
      intro ℓ hℓ
      have hmem : E.nblock k < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.pblock (k + 1) := by
        simpa [Finset.mem_Ico] using hℓ
      change a (blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E ℓ) = _
      rw [blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply S E,
        blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock E hmem]
      change a (S.equiv (Sum.inl (E.posCount k + (ℓ + 1 - E.nblock k - 1)))) =
        a (S.equiv (Sum.inl (E.posCount k + (ℓ - E.nblock k))))
      congr 3
      omega
    calc
      _ = ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico (E.nblock k) (E.pblock (k + 1)),
          P (E.posCount k + (ℓ - E.nblock k)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ℓ hℓ => hterm ℓ hℓ)
      _ = _ := by
        have hlen := nblock_add_posBlockLength E k
        rw [← hlen, Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        have hsplit := Finset.sum_range_add P (E.posCount k)
          (E.posCount (k + 1) - E.posCount k)
        change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (E.posCount (k + 1) - E.posCount k),
          P (E.posCount k + i)) = partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 1)) -
            partialSum P (E.posCount k)
        simp only [partialSum] at hsplit ⊢
        have hcount : E.posCount k + (E.posCount (k + 1) - E.posCount k) =
            E.posCount (k + 1) := by
          exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (E.posCount_strictMono.monotone (by omega))
        rw [hcount] at hsplit
        linarith
  have hNegativeBlockSum : ∀ k,
      ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico (E.pblock (k + 1)) (E.nblock (k + 1)),
        blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E ℓ =
      -(partialSum Q (E.negCount (k + 1)) - partialSum Q (E.negCount k)) := by
                                                      
                          
    intro k
    have hterm : ∀ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico (E.pblock (k + 1)) (E.nblock (k + 1)),
        blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E ℓ =
          -Q (E.negCount k + (ℓ - E.pblock (k + 1))) := by
      intro ℓ hℓ
      have hmem : E.pblock (k + 1) < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.nblock (k + 1) := by
        simpa [Finset.mem_Ico] using hℓ
      change a (blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E ℓ) = _
      rw [blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply S E,
        blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock E hmem]
      dsimp [Q, signedNegative, SourceSplit.indQ]
      rw [neg_neg]
      congr 3
      omega
    calc
      _ = ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.Ico (E.pblock (k + 1)) (E.nblock (k + 1)),
          -Q (E.negCount k + (ℓ - E.pblock (k + 1))) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ℓ hℓ => hterm ℓ hℓ)
      _ = _ := by
        have hlen := pblock_add_negBlockLength E k
        rw [← hlen, Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        have hsplit := Finset.sum_range_add Q (E.negCount k)
          (E.negCount (k + 1) - E.negCount k)
        change -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (E.negCount (k + 1) - E.negCount k),
          Q (E.negCount k + i)) = -(partialSum Q (E.negCount (k + 1)) -
            partialSum Q (E.negCount k))
        simp only [partialSum] at hsplit ⊢
        have hcount : E.negCount k + (E.negCount (k + 1) - E.negCount k) =
            E.negCount (k + 1) := by
          exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (E.negCount_strictMono.monotone (by omega))
        rw [hcount] at hsplit
        linarith
  have hEndpointSums : ∀ k,
      partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.pblock (k + 1)) =
        partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 1)) - partialSum Q (E.negCount k) ∧
      partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.nblock (k + 1)) =
        partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 1)) - partialSum Q (E.negCount (k + 1)) := by
                                             
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        constructor
        · simp only [partialSum]
          rw [← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
          simpa [partialSum, E.nblock_zero, E.posCount_zero, E.negCount_zero] using
            hPositiveBlockSum 0
        · simp only [partialSum]
          rw [← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
          rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive (f := blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E)
            (by omega) (E.pos_before_neg 0).le]
          simp only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
          have hp0 := hPositiveBlockSum 0
          rw [E.nblock_zero, Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range] at hp0
          rw [hp0, hNegativeBlockSum 0]
          simp [partialSum, E.posCount_zero, E.negCount_zero, sub_eq_add_neg]
    | succ k ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨ihp, ihn⟩
        have hpnext : partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.pblock (k + 2)) =
            partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 2)) - partialSum Q (E.negCount (k + 1)) := by
          simp only [partialSum]
          rw [← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
          rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive (f := blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E)
            (by omega) (E.neg_before_pos (k + 1)).le]
          have hp := hPositiveBlockSum (k + 1)
          have ihn' : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (E.nblock (k + 1)),
              blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E i =
              partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 1)) - partialSum Q (E.negCount (k + 1)) := by
            simpa [partialSum, Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range] using ihn
          rw [ihn', hp]
          simp only [partialSum] at hp ⊢
          linarith
        constructor
        · simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hpnext
        · simp only [partialSum]
          rw [← Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
          rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive (f := blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E)
            (by omega) (E.pos_before_neg (k + 1)).le]
          have hn := hNegativeBlockSum (k + 1)
          have hpnext' : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 0 (E.pblock (k + 2)),
              blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E i =
              partialSum P (E.posCount (k + 2)) - partialSum Q (E.negCount (k + 1)) := by
            simpa [partialSum, Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range] using hpnext
          rw [hpnext', hn]
          simp only [partialSum] at hn ⊢
          linarith
  have hPosLast : Tendsto
      (fun k => P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β) atTop atTop :=
      (rudinPosCount_strictMono P Q hP hQ α β).tendsto_atTop
    have hshift : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => k + 2) atTop atTop := by
      exact (show StrictMono (fun k : ℕ => k + 2) by
        intro i j hij
        change i + 2 < j + 2
        omega).tendsto_atTop
    have hidx : Tendsto (fun k => rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) - 1)
        atTop atTop := (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 1).comp (hc.comp hshift)
    exact hPzero.comp hidx
  have hNegLast : Tendsto
      (fun k => Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β) atTop atTop :=
      (rudinNegCount_strictMono P Q hP hQ α β).tendsto_atTop
    have hshift : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) atTop atTop := by
      exact (show StrictMono (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) by
        intro i j hij
        change i + 1 < j + 1
        omega).tendsto_atTop
    have hidx : Tendsto (fun k => rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) - 1)
        atTop atTop := (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 1).comp (hc.comp hshift)
    simpa [Q, Function.comp_def] using hQzero.neg.comp hidx
  have hPosTerm : ∀ {k ℓ},
      E.nblock k ≤ ℓ → ℓ < E.pblock (k + 1) →
      0 ≤ blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E ℓ := by
    intro k ℓ hleft hright
    have hmem : E.nblock k < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.pblock (k + 1) := by omega
    change 0 ≤ a (blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E ℓ)
    rw [blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply S E,
      blockTag_eq_inl_of_posBlock E hmem]
    exact S.nonnegative _
  have hNegTerm : ∀ {k ℓ},
      E.pblock (k + 1) ≤ ℓ → ℓ < E.nblock (k + 1) →
      blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E ℓ ≤ 0 := by
    intro k ℓ hleft hright
    have hmem : E.pblock (k + 1) < ℓ + 1 ∧ ℓ + 1 ≤ E.nblock (k + 1) := by omega
    change a (blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E ℓ) ≤ 0
    rw [blockIndex_eq_sourceSplit_apply S E,
      blockTag_eq_inr_of_negBlock E hmem]
    exact (S.negative _).le
  have hPosPartialBounds : ∀ {k N},
      E.nblock k ≤ N → N ≤ E.pblock (k + 1) →
      partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.nblock k) ≤
        partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) N ∧
      partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) N ≤
        partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.pblock (k + 1)) := by
    intro k N hleft hright
    constructor
    · have hs : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (E.nblock k) N,
          blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E i := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro i hi
        exact hPosTerm (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1
          (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2 hright)
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hleft] at hs
      exact sub_nonneg.mp hs
    · have hs : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico N (E.pblock (k + 1)),
          blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E i := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro i hi
        exact hPosTerm (hleft.trans (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1)
          (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hright] at hs
      exact sub_nonneg.mp hs
  have hNegPartialBounds : ∀ {k N},
      E.pblock (k + 1) ≤ N → N ≤ E.nblock (k + 1) →
      partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.nblock (k + 1)) ≤
        partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) N ∧
      partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) N ≤
        partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.pblock (k + 1)) := by
    intro k N hleft hright
    constructor
    · have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico N (E.nblock (k + 1)),
          blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E i ≤ 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonpos
        intro i hi
        exact hNegTerm (hleft.trans (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1)
          (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hright] at hs
      simpa [partialSum] using (sub_nonpos.mp hs)
    · have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (E.pblock (k + 1)) N,
          blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E i ≤ 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonpos
        intro i hi
        exact hNegTerm (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1
          (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2 hright)
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hleft] at hs
      simpa [partialSum] using (sub_nonpos.mp hs)
  have hEndpoint : EndpointWitness (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) α β := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    ·                                      
      intro ε hε
      have hL : Tendsto
          (fun k => lowerTarget α k - Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) - 1))
          atTop (𝓝 α) := by
        simpa using (lowerTarget_tendsto α).sub hNegLast
      have hev : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
          α - ε < lowerTarget α k -
            Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) - 1) :=
        (tendsto_order.1 hL).1 _ (by linarith)
      rcases eventually_atTop.1 hev with ⟨K, hK⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (E.nblock (K + 1))] with N hN
      have hbase : 0 < E.nblock (K + 1) := by
        rw [← E.nblock_zero]
        exact E.nblock_strictMono (by omega)
      have hNpos : 0 < N := hbase.trans_le hN
      rcases E.covers N hNpos with ⟨k, hkleft, hkright⟩ | ⟨k, hkleft, hkright⟩
      · have hkstage : K + 1 ≤ k := by
          by_contra hnot
          have hkle : k ≤ K := by omega
          have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono.monotone (show k + 1 ≤ K + 1 by omega)
          have hgap := E.pos_before_neg k
          omega
        have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
        have hkpred : K ≤ k - 1 := by omega
        have hend : α - ε ≤ partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.nblock k) := by
          have htail := (hK (k - 1) hkpred).le
          have hover := rudin_lower_endpoint_overshoot P Q hP hQ hαβ (k - 1)
          have hsum := (hEndpointSums (k - 1)).2
          rw [← hpos, ← hneg] at hover
          rw [← hneg] at htail
          have hsucc : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
          rw [hsucc] at htail hover hsum
          linarith
        exact hend.trans (hPosPartialBounds hkleft.le hkright).1
      · have hkstage : K ≤ k := by
          by_contra hnot
          have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono (show k + 1 < K + 1 by omega)
          omega
        have htail := (hK k hkstage).le
        have hover := rudin_lower_endpoint_overshoot P Q hP hQ hαβ k
        have hsum := (hEndpointSums k).2
        rw [← hpos, ← hneg] at hover
        rw [← hneg] at htail
        have hend : α - ε ≤
            partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.nblock (k + 1)) := by
          linarith
        exact hend.trans (hNegPartialBounds hkleft.le hkright).1
    ·                             
      refine ⟨fun k => E.nblock (k + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply E.nblock_strictMono.comp
        intro i j hij
        change i + 1 < j + 1
        omega
      · have hdirect : Tendsto
            (fun k => partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)) -
              partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1))) atTop (𝓝 α) := by
          have hlower : Tendsto
              (fun k => lowerTarget α k - Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1) - 1))
              atTop (𝓝 α) := by
            simpa using (lowerTarget_tendsto α).sub hNegLast
          have hs : Tendsto
              (fun k => partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)) -
                partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)))
              atTop (𝓝 α) := by
            apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
              hlower (lowerTarget_tendsto α)
            · exact Eventually.of_forall fun k =>
                rudin_lower_endpoint_overshoot P Q hP hQ hαβ k
            · exact Eventually.of_forall fun k =>
                (rudin_lower_endpoint_crosses P Q hP hQ α β k).le
          exact hs
        apply hdirect.congr'
        exact Eventually.of_forall fun k => by
          rw [← hpos, ← hneg]
          exact (hEndpointSums k).2.symm
    ·                                      
      intro ε hε
      have hshift : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) atTop atTop := by
        exact (show StrictMono (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) by
          intro i j hij
          change i + 1 < j + 1
          omega).tendsto_atTop
      have hU : Tendsto
          (fun k => upperTarget β (k + 1) +
            P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 β) := by
        have ht := (upperTarget_tendsto β).comp hshift
        simpa using ht.add hPosLast
      have hev : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
          upperTarget β (k + 1) +
            P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) - 1) < β + ε :=
        (tendsto_order.1 hU).2 _ (by linarith)
      rcases eventually_atTop.1 hev with ⟨K, hK⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (E.nblock (K + 2))] with N hN
      have hbase : 0 < E.nblock (K + 2) := by
        rw [← E.nblock_zero]
        exact E.nblock_strictMono (by omega)
      have hNpos : 0 < N := hbase.trans_le hN
      rcases E.covers N hNpos with ⟨k, hkleft, hkright⟩ | ⟨k, hkleft, hkright⟩
      · have hkstage : K + 2 ≤ k := by
          by_contra hnot
          have hkle : k + 1 ≤ K + 2 := by omega
          have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono.monotone hkle
          have hgap := E.pos_before_neg k
          omega
        have hkpred : K ≤ k - 1 := by omega
        have htail := (hK (k - 1) hkpred).le
        have hover := rudin_upper_endpoint_overshoot P Q hP hQ hαβ (k - 1)
        have hsum := (hEndpointSums k).1
        rw [← hpos, ← hneg] at hover
        rw [← hpos] at htail
        have hsucc1 : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
        have hsucc2 : k - 1 + 2 = k + 1 := by omega
        rw [hsucc1, hsucc2] at htail hover
        have hend : partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.pblock (k + 1)) ≤ β + ε := by
          linarith
        exact (hPosPartialBounds hkleft.le hkright).2.trans hend
      · have hkstage : K + 1 ≤ k := by
          by_contra hnot
          have hmono := E.nblock_strictMono (show k + 1 < K + 2 by omega)
          omega
        have hkpred : K ≤ k - 1 := by omega
        have htail := (hK (k - 1) hkpred).le
        have hover := rudin_upper_endpoint_overshoot P Q hP hQ hαβ (k - 1)
        have hsum := (hEndpointSums k).1
        rw [← hpos, ← hneg] at hover
        rw [← hpos] at htail
        have hsucc1 : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
        have hsucc2 : k - 1 + 2 = k + 1 := by omega
        rw [hsucc1, hsucc2] at htail hover
        have hend : partialSum (blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E) (E.pblock (k + 1)) ≤ β + ε := by
          linarith
        exact (hNegPartialBounds hkleft.le hkright).2.trans hend
    ·                             
      refine ⟨fun k => E.pblock (k + 2), ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply E.pblock_strictMono.comp
        intro i j hij
        change i + 2 < j + 2
        omega
      · have hdirect : Tendsto
            (fun k => partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2)) -
              partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1))) atTop (𝓝 β) := by
          have hshift : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) atTop atTop := by
            exact (show StrictMono (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) by
              intro i j hij
              change i + 1 < j + 1
              omega).tendsto_atTop
          have htarget : Tendsto (fun k => upperTarget β (k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 β) :=
            (upperTarget_tendsto β).comp hshift
          have hupper : Tendsto
              (fun k => upperTarget β (k + 1) +
                P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 β) := by
            simpa using htarget.add hPosLast
          have hs : Tendsto
              (fun k => partialSum P (rudinPosCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 2)) -
                partialSum Q (rudinNegCount P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)))
              atTop (𝓝 β) := by
            apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
              htarget hupper
            · exact Eventually.of_forall fun k =>
                (rudin_upper_endpoint_crosses P Q hP hQ α β (k + 1)).le
            · exact Eventually.of_forall fun k =>
                rudin_upper_endpoint_overshoot P Q hP hQ hαβ k
          exact hs
        apply hdirect.congr'
        exact Eventually.of_forall fun k => by
          rw [← hpos, ← hneg]
          simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using (hEndpointSums (k + 1)).1.symm
  refine ⟨E, ?_, hEndpoint⟩
  exact blockIndex_bijective_of_blockTag_bijective S E
    (blockTag_bijective_of_block_recursion E)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.direct_rudin_rearrangement
statement:
theorem direct_rudin_rearrangement
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {α β : ℝ}
    (hαβ : α ≤ β)
    (S : SourceSplit a)
    (hPzero : Tendsto (signedPositive a S.indP) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hQzero : Tendsto (signedNegative a S.indQ) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hP : Tendsto (partialSum (signedPositive a S.indP)) atTop atTop)
    (hQ : Tendsto (partialSum (fun j => -signedNegative a S.indQ j)) atTop atTop) :
    DirectBlockEvidence S α β
proof:
:= by
  exact direct_block_evidence_of_rudin_hypotheses hαβ S hPzero hQzero hP hQ

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.term_tendsto_zero_of_partialSum_tendsto
statement:
private theorem term_tendsto_zero_of_partialSum_tendsto
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {s : ℝ} (ha : Tendsto (partialSum a) atTop (𝓝 s)) :
    Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc := ha.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  simpa [partialSum, Finset.sum_range_succ] using hsucc.sub ha

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.not_summable_parts_of_conditionallyConvergent
statement:
private theorem not_summable_parts_of_conditionallyConvergent
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ConditionallyConvergent a) :
    ¬Summable (fun n => (a n)⁺) ∧ ¬Summable (fun n => (a n)⁻)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ⟨⟨s, ha⟩, habs⟩
  have hneg_of_pos (hp : Summable (fun n => (a n)⁺)) :
      Summable (fun n => (a n)⁻) := by
    have hp_lim := hp.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
    have hn_lim : Tendsto (partialSum (fun n => (a n)⁻)) atTop
        (𝓝 (∑' n, (a n)⁺ - s)) := by
      convert hp_lim.sub ha using 1
      funext n
      simp only [partialSum]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      linarith [posPart_sub_negPart (a i)]
    rcases hn_lim.bddAbove_range with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact summable_of_sum_range_le (fun n => negPart_nonneg (a n)) fun n => hc ⟨n, rfl⟩
  have hpos_of_neg (hn : Summable (fun n => (a n)⁻)) :
      Summable (fun n => (a n)⁺) := by
    have hn_lim := hn.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
    have hp_lim : Tendsto (partialSum (fun n => (a n)⁺)) atTop
        (𝓝 (s + ∑' n, (a n)⁻)) := by
      convert ha.add hn_lim using 1
      funext n
      simp only [partialSum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      linarith [posPart_sub_negPart (a i)]
    rcases hp_lim.bddAbove_range with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact summable_of_sum_range_le (fun n => posPart_nonneg (a n)) fun n => hc ⟨n, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hn := hneg_of_pos hp
    apply habs
    apply Summable.of_abs
    simpa only [posPart_add_negPart] using hp.add hn
  · intro hn
    have hp := hpos_of_neg hn
    apply habs
    apply Summable.of_abs
    simpa only [posPart_add_negPart] using hp.add hn

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.infinite_sign_sets_of_conditionallyConvergent
proof:
:= by
  rcases not_summable_parts_of_conditionallyConvergent ha with ⟨hp, hn⟩
  constructor
  · intro hfinite
    apply hp
    apply summable_of_hasFiniteSupport
    apply hfinite.subset
    intro n hnmem
    change (a n)⁺ ≠ 0 at hnmem
    by_contra hnonneg
    exact hnmem (posPart_eq_zero.mpr (le_of_not_ge hnonneg))
  · intro hfinite
    apply hn
    apply summable_of_hasFiniteSupport
    apply hfinite.subset
    intro n hnmem
    change (a n)⁻ ≠ 0 at hnmem
    by_contra hneg
    exact hnmem (negPart_eq_zero.mpr (le_of_not_gt hneg))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.sourceSplit_of_infinite_sign_sets
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Set ℕ := {n | 0 ≤ a n}
  have hs : Set.Infinite s := hpos
  have hsc : Set.Infinite (sᶜ : Set ℕ) := by
    convert hneg using 1
    ext n
    simp [s, not_le]
  let _ : Infinite s := Set.Infinite.to_subtype hs
  let _ : Infinite (sᶜ : Set ℕ) := Set.Infinite.to_subtype hsc
  let ep : ℕ ≃ s := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let en : ℕ ≃ (sᶜ : Set ℕ) := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let e : ℕ ⊕ ℕ ≃ ℕ := (Equiv.sumCongr ep en).trans (Equiv.Set.sumCompl s)
  refine ⟨{ equiv := e, nonnegative := ?_, negative := ?_ }⟩
  · intro j
    have hp := (ep j).property
    change 0 ≤ a (ep j : ℕ) at hp
    simpa [e] using hp
  · intro j
    have hn' := (en j).property
    change ¬0 ≤ a (en j : ℕ) at hn'
    have hn : a (en j : ℕ) < 0 := not_le.mp hn'
    simpa [e] using hn

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.rudin_data_of_conditionallyConvergent
statement:
private theorem rudin_data_of_conditionallyConvergent
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ConditionallyConvergent a) :
    ∃ S : SourceSplit a,
      Tendsto (signedPositive a S.indP) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (signedNegative a S.indQ) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (partialSum (signedPositive a S.indP)) atTop atTop ∧
      Tendsto (partialSum (fun j => -signedNegative a S.indQ j)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rcases infinite_sign_sets_of_conditionallyConvergent ha with ⟨hpos, hneg⟩
  let S := Classical.choice (sourceSplit_of_infinite_sign_sets hpos hneg)
  rcases not_summable_parts_of_conditionallyConvergent ha with ⟨hp, hn⟩
  rcases ha.1 with ⟨s, hsum⟩
  have hzero := term_tendsto_zero_of_partialSum_tendsto hsum
  have hPzero : Tendsto (signedPositive a S.indP) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    hzero.comp S.indP_injective.nat_tendsto_atTop
  have hQzero : Tendsto (signedNegative a S.indQ) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    hzero.comp S.indQ_injective.nat_tendsto_atTop
  have hPnot : ¬Summable (signedPositive a S.indP) := by
    intro hP
    have hP' : Summable (fun j => a (S.equiv (Sum.inl j))) := by
      change Summable (fun j => a (S.indP j)) at hP
      simpa only [SourceSplit.indP] using hP
    have hleft : Summable ((fun n => (a n)⁺) ∘ S.equiv ∘ Sum.inl) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, posPart_eq_self.mpr (S.nonnegative _)] using hP'
    have hright : Summable ((fun n => (a n)⁺) ∘ S.equiv ∘ Sum.inr) := by
      simp [Function.comp_def, posPart_eq_zero.mpr (S.negative _).le]
    apply hp
    exact S.equiv.summable_iff.mp
      (Summable.sum ((fun n => (a n)⁺) ∘ S.equiv) hleft hright)
  have hQnot : ¬Summable (fun j => -signedNegative a S.indQ j) := by
    intro hQ
    have hleft : Summable ((fun n => (a n)⁻) ∘ S.equiv ∘ Sum.inl) := by
      simp [Function.comp_def, negPart_eq_zero.mpr (S.nonnegative _)]
    have hright : Summable ((fun n => (a n)⁻) ∘ S.equiv ∘ Sum.inr) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, signedNegative, SourceSplit.indQ,
        negPart_eq_neg.mpr (S.negative _).le] using hQ
    apply hn
