    exact S.equiv.summable_iff.mp
      (Summable.sum ((fun n => (a n)⁻) ∘ S.equiv) hleft hright)
  refine ⟨S, hPzero, hQzero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (not_summable_iff_tendsto_nat_atTop_of_nonneg S.nonnegative).mp hPnot
  · apply (not_summable_iff_tendsto_nat_atTop_of_nonneg
      (fun j => neg_nonneg.mpr (S.negative j).le)).mp hQnot

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.EndpointWitness.tendsto
statement:
private theorem EndpointWitness.tendsto {g : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (h : EndpointWitness g r r) : Tendsto (partialSum g) atTop (𝓝 r)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hlow, -, hupp, -⟩
  rw [tendsto_order]
  constructor
  · intro y hy
    have hε : 0 < (r - y) / 2 := by linarith
    filter_upwards [hlow ((r - y) / 2) hε] with n hn
    linarith
  · intro y hy
    have hε : 0 < (y - r) / 2 := by linarith
    filter_upwards [hupp ((y - r) / 2) hε] with n hn
    linarith

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.exists_rearrangement_endpointWitness
proof:
:= by
  rcases rudin_data_of_conditionallyConvergent ha with
    ⟨S, hPzero, hQzero, hP, hQ⟩
  rcases direct_rudin_rearrangement hαβ S hPzero hQzero hP hQ with
    ⟨E, hbij, hw⟩
  let e : ℕ ≃ ℕ := Equiv.ofBijective (blockIndex S.indP S.indQ E) hbij
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  have heq : (fun n => a (e n)) = blockSeries a S.indP S.indQ E := by
    funext n
    rfl
  simpa only [heq] using hw

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.exists_rearrangement_liminf_limsup
statement:
theorem exists_rearrangement_liminf_limsup {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : ConditionallyConvergent a) {α β : ℝ} (hαβ : α ≤ β) :
    ∃ e : ℕ ≃ ℕ,
      Filter.liminf (partialSum (fun n => a (e n))) atTop = α ∧
      Filter.limsup (partialSum (fun n => a (e n))) atTop = β
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_rearrangement_endpointWitness ha hαβ with ⟨e, he⟩
  exact ⟨e, liminf_limsup_of_endpointWitness he⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.RudinDirect.riemann_rearrangement
statement:
theorem riemann_rearrangement {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ConditionallyConvergent a) (r : ℝ) :
    ∃ e : ℕ ≃ ℕ, Tendsto (partialSum (fun n => a (e n))) atTop (𝓝 r)
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_rearrangement_endpointWitness ha (α := r) (β := r) le_rfl with ⟨e, he⟩
  exact ⟨e, he.tendsto⟩

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct_eq_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem cauchyProduct_eq_antidiagonal (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    cauchyProduct a b n =
      ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, a ij.1 * b ij.2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cauchyProduct] using
    (Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
      (fun i j => a i * b j) n).symm

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.sum_cauchyProduct_eq_triangle
statement:
theorem sum_cauchyProduct_eq_triangle (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, cauchyProduct a b n) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, a i * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - i), b j
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cauchyProduct, Finset.mul_sum] using
    (Finset.sum_range_diag_flip N (fun i j => a i * b j))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct_summable_absolute
statement:
theorem cauchyProduct_summable_absolute {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : Summable (fun n => |a n|))
    (hb : Summable (fun n => |b n|)) :
    Summable (fun n => |cauchyProduct a b n|)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cauchyProduct, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    (summable_norm_sum_mul_range_of_summable_norm
      (f := a) (g := b)
      (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using ha)
      (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb))

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.hasSum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute
statement:
theorem hasSum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : Summable (fun n => |a n|))
    (hb : Summable (fun n => |b n|)) :
    HasSum (cauchyProduct a b) ((∑' n, a n) * ∑' n, b n)
proof:
:= by
  change HasSum
    (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k * b (n - k))
    ((∑' n, a n) * ∑' n, b n)
  exact hasSum_sum_range_mul_of_summable_norm
    (f := a) (g := b)
    (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using ha)
    (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb)

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.tsum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute
statement:
theorem tsum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ha : Summable (fun n => |a n|))
    (hb : Summable (fun n => |b n|)) :
    (∑' n, cauchyProduct a b n) = (∑' n, a n) * ∑' n, b n
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasSum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute ha hb).tsum_eq

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.isCauSeq_abs_of_tendsto
statement:
lemma isCauSeq_abs_of_tendsto {u : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ}
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)) : IsCauSeq abs u
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  have hhalf : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hu (ε / 2) hhalf with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨N, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have hj' := hN j hj
  have hN' := hN N le_rfl
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at hj' hN'
  calc
    |u j - u N| ≤ |u j - l| + |l - u N| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    _ = |u j - l| + |u N - l| := by rw [abs_sub_comm l]
    _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add hj' hN'
    _ = ε := add_halves ε

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.tendsto_sum_cauchyProduct_of_left_absolute
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_cauchyProduct_of_left_absolute {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {B : ℝ}
    (ha : Summable (fun n => |a n|))
    (hb : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, b n) atTop (𝓝 B)) :
    Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, cauchyProduct a b n)
      atTop (𝓝 ((∑' n, a n) * B))
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : Summable a := summable_of_absolute ha
  let pA : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n
  let pB : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, b n
  let pC : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, cauchyProduct a b n
  have hA : Tendsto pA atTop (𝓝 (∑' n, a n)) := ha'.tendsto_sum_tsum_nat
  have hB : Tendsto pB atTop (𝓝 B) := hb
  have hAbsA : IsCauSeq abs (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, |a n|) :=
    isCauSeq_abs_of_tendsto ha.tendsto_sum_tsum_nat
  have hCauB : IsCauSeq abs pB := isCauSeq_abs_of_tendsto hB
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun N => pA N * pB N - pC N) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    rcases cauchy_product hAbsA hCauB ε hε with ⟨N, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    simpa [pA, pB, pC, cauchyProduct, Real.dist_eq] using hN n hn
  have hprod : Tendsto (fun N => pA N * pB N) atTop
      (𝓝 ((∑' n, a n) * B)) := hA.mul hB
  have hC : Tendsto pC atTop (𝓝 ((∑' n, a n) * B)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, sub_sub_cancel] using hprod.sub hdiff
  simpa [pC] using hC

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.tendsto_sum_cauchyProduct_of_right_absolute
statement:
theorem tendsto_sum_cauchyProduct_of_right_absolute {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {A : ℝ}
    (ha : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n) atTop (𝓝 A))
    (hb : Summable (fun n => |b n|)) :
    Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, cauchyProduct a b n)
      atTop (𝓝 (A * ∑' n, b n))
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_sum_cauchyProduct_of_left_absolute (a := b) (b := a) hb ha
  have heq : cauchyProduct b a = cauchyProduct a b := by
    funext n
    rw [cauchyProduct_eq_antidiagonal, cauchyProduct_eq_antidiagonal]
    rw [← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
    simp only [Prod.swap, mul_comm]
  simpa [heq, mul_comm] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.cauchyProduct_mul_pow
statement:
theorem cauchyProduct_mul_pow (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    cauchyProduct (fun k => a k * x ^ k) (fun k => b k * x ^ k) n =
      cauchyProduct a b n * x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cauchyProduct, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have hkn : k ≤ n := by
    have : k < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    omega
  calc
    (a k * x ^ k) * (b (n - k) * x ^ (n - k)) =
        (a k * b (n - k)) * (x ^ k * x ^ (n - k)) := by ring
    _ = (a k * b (n - k)) * x ^ n := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hkn]

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.tsum_cauchyProduct_mul_pow
statement:
theorem tsum_cauchyProduct_mul_pow {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    {A B : ℝ}
    (ha : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n) atTop (𝓝 A))
    (hb : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, b n) atTop (𝓝 B))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) :
    (∑' n, cauchyProduct a b n * x ^ n) =
      (∑' n, a n * x ^ n) * ∑' n, b n * x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have haS : Summable (fun n => a n * x ^ n) :=
    summable_powerSeries_of_norm_lt_one ha.cauchySeq (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hx)
  have hbS : Summable (fun n => b n * x ^ n) :=
    summable_powerSeries_of_norm_lt_one hb.cauchySeq (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hx)
  have h := tsum_cauchyProduct_of_absolute haS.abs hbS.abs
  simpa only [cauchyProduct_mul_pow] using h

name: SandronesLibrary.Analysis.Series.abel_cauchyProduct
statement:
theorem abel_cauchyProduct {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {A B C : ℝ}
    (ha : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n) atTop (𝓝 A))
    (hb : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, b n) atTop (𝓝 B))
    (hc : Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, cauchyProduct a b n)
      atTop (𝓝 C)) :
    C = A * B
proof:
:= by
  have haAbel := Real.tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt ha
  have hbAbel := Real.tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt hb
  have hcAbel := Real.tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt hc
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝[<] 1, 0 < x :=
    (eventually_gt_nhds zero_lt_one).filter_mono inf_le_left
  have hlt : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝[<] 1, x < 1 := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  have hformula :
      (fun x => ∑' n, cauchyProduct a b n * x ^ n) =ᶠ[𝓝[<] 1]
        (fun x => (∑' n, a n * x ^ n) * ∑' n, b n * x ^ n) := by
    filter_upwards [hpos, hlt] with x hx0 hx1
    exact tsum_cauchyProduct_mul_pow ha hb (by simpa [abs_of_pos hx0] using hx1)
  have hprod : Tendsto
      (fun x => (∑' n, a n * x ^ n) * ∑' n, b n * x ^ n)
      (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 (A * B)) := haAbel.mul hbAbel
  have hcProduct : Tendsto (fun x => ∑' n, cauchyProduct a b n * x ^ n)
      (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 (A * B)) := hprod.congr' hformula.symm
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hcAbel hcProduct
